name: Multi Chronos: Coach Stopwatch
description:
Multi Chronos is a simple multi stopwatch and lap timer for coaches who time several athletes at once. It is built for the trackside, the pool deck and the course: one hand, eyes on the athletes.

ONE-HANDED
The Lap and Start button sits on the right edge of every card, under your thumb. Lap-all and start-all are at the bottom of the screen.

NO ACCIDENTAL STOPS
Stop and Reset are held for half a second. Time is counted from the moment your finger touches the button, so holding never adds to the measurement.

DISTANCE TARGET AND AUTO FINISH
Enter the lap distance and the total distance: 400 m × 5 = 2 km. On the last lap the Lap button becomes Finish and stops the timer at that moment. A bar under each card shows the distance left.

6 ATHLETES ON ONE SCREEN
Cards tighten as you add athletes. Up to six fit on one screen; more scroll.

CROSSING MODE (BETA)
When athletes cross in a pack, press one button for each crossing and the times queue up. Assign them to athletes afterwards, in crossing order.

READABLE OUTDOORS
High-contrast dark theme and large digits. The screen stays on while a timer runs, and every press gives a short buzz.

PRIVACY
No account. No ads. Athlete names and times are stored on your device only and are never sent to a server.

FREE
• 3 timers
• Laps, distance target, crossing mode
• English and Turkish

PRO (ONE-TIME PAYMENT, NO SUBSCRIPTION)
• Unlimited timers
• Saved sessions and history
• CSV export and sharing
• Accent colours

USE IT AS
• a lap timer and split timer for track and field
• a swim coach stopwatch on the pool deck
• a group timer for relays, intervals and time trials
• a race timer for triathlon, cycling, rowing and skating training

A Dreamise Application.
Support: dreamise.support@gmail.com

name: Doorway Surfers
description:
Grab the bars, rookie. The orders are piling up.

DOORWAY SURFERS is a one-thumb bike-courier game set in a hand-inked street-art world. Weave through traffic, swerve around opening car doors, squeeze past protest marches and food carts, then deliver the order the only way a real courier would: straight through the customer's front door.

ONE THUMB, FULL SPEED
• Keep your thumb on the screen and drag to steer. Holding on means pedaling, fast.
• Corners don't turn for you: drag into every turn, or run wide into the curb.
• Barrier across the road? Swipe down to slide right under it at full speed.
• Let go and your bike keeps its speed but drifts off on its own… until it crashes. Grab the bars!
• Downhill? Let go and coast straight hands-off… you just can't steer.

FIVE CITIES, 100 DELIVERIES
• Stockholm: cobbled lanes, trams, slush and fika (free).
• Paris: roundabouts, croissants and a strike on every corner.
• Seoul: neon alleys, steam and baedal mopeds at night.
• San Francisco: brutal hills, cable cars and Karl the Fog.
• New Delhi: auto-rickshaws, wedding processions, cows that own the road, and butter chicken that can't wait. The final boss of traffic.
Every level is procedurally built, and an adaptive Street Director keeps every ride on the edge, whatever your skill.

WORLD LEADERBOARD
• Every delivery scores points. Climb the weekly and all-time boards, for each city or the whole world.
• Pick your courier tag and flag. No account, no sign-up.
• Fresh weekly board every Monday.

COLLECT & CUSTOMIZE
• 3 golden feathers hidden on every route.
• 70+ cosmetics: bikes, lids, hoodies, massively baggy jeans, kicks, delivery bags and pigeon pals that ride on your handlebar.
• Earn tips on every run. Cosmetics never change how the game plays.

BOOST!
• Double-tap to fire a rocket booster: a few seconds of top speed that blasts every car, cart and cow out of your way in a puff of dust.
• Free boosters turn up on the streets; grab more in the Shop.

NO ADS. NO TRACKING. NO ENERGY TIMERS.
Play offline, as long as you like (the leaderboard catches up when you're back online). Unlock new cities once and they're yours forever. Restore Purchases is in Settings.

Coo the pigeon is your dispatcher. Don't let Coo down.

name: Angaro Mail
description:
Angaro Mail brings order to your email – all your accounts in one place, on iPhone, iPad and Mac, and synced with Android, Windows and the webmail.

TIDY
• Sorted automatically: people, updates, newsletters and invoices kept apart
• Later and Done – your inbox becomes a to-do list
• Swipe all the way to delete or mark as done

CALENDAR & CONTACTS INCLUDED
• Accept meeting invitations with one tap
• Contacts with your own pictures and birthday reminders
• Synced end-to-end encrypted across all your devices

PRIVATE
• Tracking pixels are blocked
• App lock with Face ID or PIN
• No ads, your data is never sold

FOR EVERY MAILBOX
Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo and any other provider with IMAP and SMTP.

ANGARO PRO
• PEYK, the AI assistant: summarise emails and get reply suggestions
• Templates and send later
• Vault: keep sensitive emails end-to-end encrypted
• Encrypted email with PGP and large attachments up to 2 GB
• Rules & filters, reminders, read receipts and extra colour themes

Try Angaro Pro free for 14 days, then monthly or yearly. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

IN 13 LANGUAGES
Deutsch, English, Italiano, Français, Español, Português, Nederlands, Polski, Türkçe, Українська, Čeština, Svenska, Dansk.

Terms of Use: https://angaro.io/en/terms
Privacy Policy: https://angaro.io/en/privacy

name: Slop Codex
description:
Slop Codex is a working set of ideas, names, and tools for the anti-patterns of AI-assisted software work. It is a card deck you can flip, a gallery you can walk, a journal for what shows up on your team, and a place to keep the longer write-ups that give those cards their meaning.

THE DECKS
Every card from the Volume I, II, and III decks, rendered natively: the four developer classes and their archetypes, the organizational NPCs, the emergent roles and misbehaving agents, and the monsters, artifacts, and spells that travel with them. Tap to flip a card, swipe through a deck, search by name, trait, or flavor text, filter by type and rarity, and switch between the native rendering and the printed face. Favorite the ones you keep meeting. A card of the day keeps the vocabulary in play.

CARDS AND THE IDEAS BEHIND THEM
Every card links to the chapters that unpack it, and every chapter lists the cards that appear in it. Jump from the Scope Creep Kraken to the Aberrations chapter and back. The long-form text stays on your device: paper, sepia, and night themes, adjustable type, tables and footnotes, bookmarks, saved passages, and a place to pick up where you left off. Download a chapter as you open it, or take a whole set offline. When a chapter is revised, the app tells you and fetches the update.

THE GALLERY
More than three hundred illustrations — card art, openings, and covers — grouped by set, type, or volume. Pinch to zoom, swipe between images, see which card or chapter each one belongs to, and read the illustration brief behind it.

THE FIELD JOURNAL
Log a sighting when a monster, NPC, or runaway agent shows up in a meeting, a pull request, or an incident. Pick the card, note the date, the context, and how bad it got. Over time the journal shows which anti-patterns your team actually meets. Add a note to any card.

SHARE A NAME FOR IT
Share a card as an image, turn a passage into a quote card in three styles, share a sighting, save an illustration to Photos, and send a link that opens straight to a card or a chapter.

Works offline. No account, no tracking, no analytics. Notes and the journal never leave your device.

An independent work of commentary and criticism by Timothy O'Brien, from Discursive. Dungeons & Dragons and D&D are trademarks of Wizards of the Coast LLC and are referenced for commentary only.

name: Birthday Song With Name: Croon
description:
Sing a birthday song with their name — and sound great doing it.

Croon turns your voice into a heartfelt video card. Pick a song, type their name, and sing along with the music. Croon knows every note of the melody, so it gently moves each note you sing onto the right pitch while keeping your own voice. Then it mixes you with the band and wraps it all in a beautiful card with their photo and name, ready to send on WhatsApp, Instagram or Messages.

HOW IT WORKS
• Type their name and add a photo
• Pick a song and a key that suits your voice
• Sing along: the lyrics scroll karaoke-style with their name in the song, and a note lane shows when you're on pitch
• Croon tunes your voice to the melody and shows how many notes you hit, before and after
• Choose a card style, add a message and share the video

SONGS
• Happy Birthday — Piano, Party and Acoustic versions (free)
• Love & Celebrations pack: It's Your Day, My Favourite Person and Happy Anniversary — original songs written for Croon

MADE FOR EVERYONE
• No singing experience needed: the melody guide plays softly in your ears
• Natural tuning that sounds like you, or Strong tuning for a polished finish
• Works with earphones or the phone speaker

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your iPhone. Your voice, photos and videos are never uploaded. No account, no ads, no tracking.

PRICES
Recording, tuning and sharing are free. A small "Made with Croon" tag appears on free videos. Remove it for one card, unlock the Love & Celebrations songs, or get Croon Unlimited — one-time purchases, never a subscription.

"Happy Birthday to You" is in the public domain. All other songs and arrangements are original to Croon.

name: Hop Cup
description:
Place wooden ramps, bouncy rubber pads, and seesaws to bounce the ball cleanly into the porcelain cup.

Hop Cup is a handcrafted tactile physics puzzle toy built for calm, satisfying trick shots — with zero ads, zero energy timers, and 100% offline play.

FEATURES
• 48 Handcrafted Puzzles across 4 chapters: Wooden Desk, Rubber Bounce, Brass Pegboard, and Seesaw Workshop
• Fresh Daily Cup: A brand-new verified physics puzzle every single day of the year
• Tactile Toybox Feel: Crisp wooden clacks, porcelain cup chimes, subtle haptics, and dotted trajectory trails from your last shot
• Customize Your Desk: Unlockable ball materials, cup glazes, and cozy workshop board themes
• Fair One-Time Unlock: Play Chapter 1 (12 levels) and the Daily Cup free forever. Unlock the full campaign or Complete Toybox Edition once — no subscriptions, ever.

name: Online Temple: Bow & Meditate
description:
Sit together in silence with people from around the world in a 3D Buddhist hall.
There is no chat — only gestures: bowing, joining palms and counting the mala. That is what makes it quiet.

■ A hall you share
· Sit on a cushion and see the others in your room. When someone bows, you see it.
· Greet with joined palms. No words needed.

■ Practice on your own
· 108 bows: one tap, one bow. Your count adds up day by day.
· Mala: move one bead at a time as you count.
· Walk around the pagoda and the grounds — the yard, the hill path, a hermitage on the cliff.

■ Chanting services together
· At service time, the temple bell, the moktak and the Heart Sutra ring out for everyone at once.
· Listen on your own: the Heart Sutra in classical Chinese and a monk's chanting, recorded in a real temple.

■ 29 temples across Asia
· Walk through famous temples from many countries — Bulguksa, Kinkaku-ji, Borobudur, the Shwedagon Pagoda, Tiger's Nest and more.
· The sky and sounds change from dawn to night.

■ Offerings that stay
· Hang a lantern: your name and wish hang from the hall's ceiling for everyone who visits.
· Roof tile offering: your wish, written on a tile, goes up on the hall's roof next month and stays. You can go and find your tile.
· Light a candle, light up the hall, offer incense.

■ Practice Pass (optional)
· Chanting keeps playing with the screen off.
· Real temple chanting from Japan, China, Vietnam, Thailand and Bhutan.
· A 30-day lantern every month.

■ Free for everyone
Sitting, bowing, the mala, walking the pagoda, every chanting service and the Heart Sutra and chanting tracks are free.
There are no ads inside the hall, during services or while you are seated.

※ Offerings are symbolic within the app and are not donations to a real temple.
※ Lantern names and tile wishes are public and moderated with word filters and reports.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://onlinetemple.apps-privacy.com/privacy/

name: Mileminder: Car Maintenance
description:
Mileminder keeps your car maintenance log and reminds you when service is due, by date or by mileage, whichever comes first. Offline, private and with no account.

SMART REMINDERS BY DATE OR MILEAGE
Most service apps only count calendar days. Mileminder learns how far you drive from your own odometer updates and estimates when the next oil change, tire rotation, brake check or fluid service is due.
• Starter schedules for oil, filters, tire rotation, brakes, coolant, transmission fluid, spark plugs and wipers, all editable to match your owner's manual
• Clear OK, Due Soon and Overdue status with miles or days remaining
• Logging a service automatically restarts the matching schedule
• Optional monthly reminder to update your odometer

COMPLETE SERVICE HISTORY
• Date, odometer, parts and labor cost, DIY or shop, notes
• Receipt photos attached to each entry
• Total cost per vehicle, split into parts and labor, with cost per mile or km
• Service history PDF, ready to hand to a buyer when you sell

FUEL LOG
• Fill-ups with volume, price, odometer and full-tank toggle
• MPG or L/100 km between full tanks, cost per mile or km

DOCUMENT REMINDERS
• Expiry dates for registration, insurance, inspection or warranty, with reminders

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your records stay on your iPhone. No sign-in, no ads. Export a backup file any time and restore it on a new phone.

MILEMINDER PRO
Free: 2 vehicles, full reminders, service and fuel log, 1 free PDF report.
Pro unlocks unlimited vehicles, unlimited PDF and CSV exports and unlimited receipt photos. Choose monthly, yearly or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in your App Store account settings.

Intervals are generic starting points; always follow your owner's manual. Not affiliated with any vehicle manufacturer.
The app is in English.

Terms: https://arifinazis.github.io/AppFactoryBlueprint/compliance/terms/mileminder-ios.html
Privacy: https://arifinazis.github.io/AppFactoryBlueprint/compliance/privacy_policy/mileminder-ios.html

name: Yadigâr: İzlerin Atölyesi
description:
Yadigâr: İzlerin Atölyesi, eski eşyaları inceleyip onardığın sakin bir restorasyon oyunu.

Atölyene gelen her eşyanın bir sahibi ve bir hikâyesi var: dededen kalan bir radyo, kurmalı bir müzik kutusu, cep pusulası, ipli bir kukla, körüklü bir kamera, gramofon, guguklu saat… Eşyayı çevir, yakından bak, dinle, dokun. Çiziklerden, aşınmalardan ve lekelerden onun nasıl kullanıldığını ve neyin bozulduğunu çıkar.

NASIL OYNANIR
• İncele: Eşyayı üç boyutlu olarak döndür, izleri bul, sesini dinle.
• Teşhis et: Topladığın ipuçlarıyla arızanın gerçek nedenini seç. Her ipucu doğru cevabı göstermez.
• Planla: Sahibinin notunu oku. Eşya yeni gibi mi olmalı, yoksa hatıraları taşıyan izler korunmalı mı?
• Onar: Parmağınla temizle, sök, yağla, yapıştır, ayarla.
• Arşivle: Teslim ettiğin eşyalar dükkânının rafında yerini alır.

İÇİNDE NELER VAR
• Mahalle atölyesinden kıyıdaki fenere, kukla sahnesinden saatçi dükkânına uzanan 9 bölüm ve 25 vaka
• Elle yapılan temizlik ve onarım adımları
• Acele ettirmeyen, puan kovalatmayan sakin bir tempo
• İnternetsiz oynanabilir

İlk dört bölüm ücretsizdir. Kalan bölümler "Tam Atölye" ile açılır; reklamları kaldırmak için ayrı bir seçenek de vardır. Bütün satın almalar tek seferliktir, abonelik yoktur.

Gizlilik: https://virel.com.tr/yasal/yadigar

name: Flexina Run
description:
Race through a neon city in a three-lane arcade runner. Switch lanes, jump, roll under obstacles and trigger overclock at the right moment.

CHOOSE YOUR RUN
Play NORMAL, SLIDE, RUSH or MIRROR. Start on your board and chain rails in Slide. Rush speeds up the run; Mirror reverses your left and right controls. The daily challenge and League add their own courses and records.

EXPLORE 15 DISTRICTS
From the Docks to the Metro, the Canals, the Icefield and the Spaceport, each district has its own scenery and atmosphere. Your run earnings rebuild each district, one site at a time.

27 RUNNERS AND 15 BOARDS
Choose your character, upgrade their card with fragments and build your loadout. Boards change your look while keeping the same handling. Outfits and trails complete your collection.

BOSS DUELS ON THE TRACK
Dodge attacks, charge your gauge and land the finisher. Between duels, keep your combos going and chase your records.

GOALS FOR EVERY SESSION
Daily missions, a weekly event, a four-week season and 40 achievements give you more to work towards. The League is local: your score competes with simulated rivals, and you can race alongside the ghost of your best attempt.

YOUR PROGRESS GOES WITH YOU
Sign in with Game Center: your progress is saved to your iCloud and follows you between devices. Signing in is optional: with no account or no network you can still play, and your progress stays on the device.

PURCHASES AND ADS
The game is free to download. In-app purchases are optional, and each product shows its contents before payment, with no paid random draws. Rewarded videos are offered as a choice. Interstitial ads may also appear when leaving the results after two completed runs. No ads appear during a run.

YOUR CONTROLS
Portrait interface, touch controls, keyboard and gamepad support, larger text, a colour-blind palette, reduced flashes and adjustable haptics. Play in French or English.

name: 스카왕: 스터디카페 키우기
description:
작은 스터디카페를 열고, 공부하러 오는 손님들을 맞으며 전국 1등 스카로 키우는 도트 타이쿤 게임이에요.

■ 우리 스카 열기
· 스카 이름을 짓고 1층 작은 열람실에서 시작해요.
· 오픈석, 칸막이석, 1인실, 개별석, 스터디룸, 노트북석까지 자리를 하나씩 늘려요.
· 출입 키패드, 키오스크, 폰부스, 커피머신, 안마의자… 시설은 하나씩 사서 갖춰요. 짓기 전에 미리보기로 먼저 볼 수 있어요.

■ 손님 돌보기
· 고3 수험생, 공시생, 대학생, 직장인. 손님마다 준비하는 시험이 달라요.
· 조는 손님은 깨우고, 떠드는 손님에겐 "쉿!"
· 시험이 코앞인 손님에게 선물을 챙겨 주면, 합격하고 나서 보석을 들고 찾아와요.

■ 사장님의 하루
· 순찰·청소·휴게실·안내 알바와 새벽 청소 직원을 뽑아요.
· 낡은 책상과 의자는 고쳐 가며 써요.
· 하루가 끝나면 영수증으로 그날 장사를 확인해요. 적자가 나도 다시 벌어서 일어서면 돼요.
· 관리일지에서 손님 유형, 나이대, 준비 중인 시험, 시간대별 입장을 한눈에 봐요.
· 배속(x2, x3)으로 빠르게 돌리거나, 일시정지하고 천천히 꾸며요.

■ 넓히고 꾸미기
· 2층 집중층, 3층 노트북·카페층까지 넓혀요. 4층과 5층 루프탑은 업데이트로 열려요.
· 바닥, 벽지, 러그, 줄조명, 화분으로 층마다 다르게 꾸며요.
· 미션과 합격 소식으로 모은 보석으로 테마를 바꾸면 배경음악까지 바뀌어요.

■ 창밖의 사계절
· 큰 창으로 봄 벚꽃비, 여름 비, 가을 낙엽, 겨울 눈이 보여요.
· 낮과 밤, 테마마다 배경음악이 달라요.

■ 자리를 비워도
· 키오스크와 출입 키패드를 갖추면 자리를 비운 동안에도 무인 운영으로 조금씩 벌어요.

회원가입 없이 바로 시작하고, 인터넷 없이도 할 수 있어요. 게임 기록은 이 폰 안에만 저장돼요.

name: 攻略筆記
description:
把 RPG 攻略整理成好查的筆記，打到一半卡關時，打開就能找到要看的那段。

【收錄遊戲】
・聖火降魔錄 萬縷千絲
・歧路旅人
・女神異聞錄5 皇家版
・英雄傳說 空之軌跡 the 2nd
內容持續更新，新遊戲會陸續加入。

【離線閱讀】
・攻略內建在 app 裡，沒有網路也能讀
・不用註冊，也不用登入

【問攻略】
・用中文直接提問，例如某個對手的推薦等級
・回答只根據找到的攻略段落；攻略沒寫到的，會直接告訴你沒寫到
・每天有固定問答次數，畫面上會顯示剩餘次數

【去廣告訂閱】
・免費使用時，畫面底部會顯示廣告
・訂閱後移除廣告：每月 NT$30，或每年 NT$300

訂閱說明：
・費用在確認購買時向 Apple 帳號收取
・訂閱會自動續訂，除非在目前週期結束前至少 24 小時關閉
・可在 Apple 帳號的訂閱設定中管理或取消

使用條款：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
隱私權政策：https://questnotes.app/privacy

攻略由 AI 依公開資料整理撰寫，可能有誤，請以遊戲內資訊與官方公告為準。

本 app 為玩家製作的非官方攻略，與各遊戲的開發商及發行商沒有關聯，也未獲其授權或贊助。遊戲名稱與商標屬於各自的權利人。

name: Miette: Absorption
description:
Miette is a robot the size of an ant. You guide her through a house full of bugs, one zone at a time: under the table, behind the outlet, inside the cabinet.

Fights are automatic. When Miette touches a bug, the fight starts on its own. If she wins, she absorbs part of its stats: ants give attack, pill bugs give defense, flies give speed. So you pick which bugs to fight based on what you want to build up.

Every fight costs energy. When it runs out, the run ends and the absorbed stats are lost. Your gear, keys, beacons, and skills stay, and the next run goes further.

• 144 zones and 43 species of bugs
• 9 gear slots, sets, and a forge
• A skill tree with 6 branches
• Bosses that block passages, and companions to recruit
• Play with one hand, offline
• No ads, no data collected
• Controller and keyboard support, on iPhone and iPad
• A night mode
• Save synced with iCloud
• In French, English, German, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Japanese, and Korean

The ground floor is free, about 3 hours of play. A one-time purchase unlocks the rest of the house: the garden, upstairs, the basement, and the attic.

name: Notik
description:
Notik, lise ve üniversite öğrencileri için ders programı, not defteri ve sınav takibini tek bir uygulamada birleştirir. Vize notunu girdiğin anda finalde en az kaç alman gerektiğini söyler.

HAFTALIK DERS PROGRAMI
• Derslerini gün ve saatiyle, derslik ve hoca bilgisiyle ekle
• Haftalık görünümde dersler, sınavlar ve çalışma oturumları bir arada
• Her derse kendi rengi; programda, notlarda ve sınavlarda aynı renk

GEÇME NOTU HESABI
• Vize, final, yazılı, quiz ve proje ağırlıklarını bir kez tanımla
• İlk notun açıklanınca sonraki sınavda en az kaç alman gerektiğini anında gör
• Final barajını hesaba katar; geçmeyi garantilediğinde açıkça söyler
• Lise (1. ve 2. yazılı) ve üniversite (vize ve final) şablonları hazır

SINAVLAR VE SONUÇLAR
• Sınav günü, saati, salonu ve konuları
• Geri sayımla hangi sınava kaç gün kaldığını hep bil
• Dönem ortalaman ve açıklanan sonuçların ayrı ekranda

ÖDEV TAKİBİ
• Teslim tarihine göre sıralı liste: bu hafta, gelecek hafta, tamamlanan
• Yaklaşan ödevler ana ekranda

DERS NOTLARI

• Tahtanın ya da kitabın fotoğrafını notuna ekle

name: 台風予報から日本列島を逃がせ！-台風から逃げるゲーム
description:
「台風〇号が発生しました。今後の進路に警戒してください」
――だったら、日本列島のほうが逃げればいい。

天気予報の画面そっくりの地図の上で、次々に発生する台風から日本列島をドラッグで動かして逃げるゲームです。
ルールはひとつ。台風の赤い円（暴風域）に触れたら上陸＝ゲームオーバー。
何日生き延びられるかが、あなたの記録になります。

◆ あそび方はかんたん
・画面のどこでもドラッグすると、日本列島が同じ方向に動きます
・台風は白い点線の「予報進路」を出しながら近づいてきます。でも予報はあくまで予報。急に曲がってきます
・黄色い円（強風域）をかすめて逃げきると「ニアミス」ボーナス
・青い「H」（太平洋高気圧）を取ると、しばらく台風をはね返せます

◆ 台風はだんだん本気になる
・日にちが進むほど台風の数が増え、速く、しつこく追いかけてきます
・「強い」「非常に強い」台風は暴風域が大きい
・北へ抜けた台風は温帯低気圧に変わって消えます。うまく「やり過ごす」のがコツ

◆ 他の国に迷惑をかけないでください
逃げるのに夢中で日本列島を隣の国に押しつけると、「外交問題に発展」「国連が困惑」などの速報が流れます。
迷惑をかけた国の数は、最後にしっかり記録されます。

◆ 対戦モード（リアルタイム1対1）
友だちとルーム番号で、またはランダムで対戦。先に上陸したほうの負け（時間無制限）。
ニアミス2回で相手に「非常に強い台風」を送りつけたり、高気圧で相手の台風を加速させたり、予報円を消したり。相手の画面はミニ地図で見えます。相手が見つからなければコンピュータと対戦。

◆ 月間ランキング
ニックネームを登録して、「生き延びた日数」と「対戦ポイント」の2つの月間ランキングに挑戦。TOP100と自分の順位が見られます。毎月1日にリセット。

◆ 記録をシェア
ゲームオーバー画面から「〇日生き延びた・迷惑をかけた国：〇か国」を、LINE・X・メッセージなど好きなアプリに送れます。
友だちと日数を競ってみてください。

◆ スマホならではの遊び方
・「傾き操作」をオンにすると、スマホを傾けた向きに日本列島が動きます（ドラッグと併用できます）
・上陸・ニアミス・高気圧バリアの瞬間にスマホが振動
・ひとり用モードは通信なしで遊べます（ランキングと対戦だけインターネットを使います）
・月間ランキングの締め切り前日に通知でお知らせ（ランキング画面でオン／オフ）

◆ 天気予報番組そのもの
日付つきの台風情報、赤いテロップ、暴風域・強風域・予報円。
本物の気象情報ではなく、すべて架空のゲームです。実際の防災情報は気象庁などの公式情報をご確認ください。

地図：Natural Earth（パブリックドメイン）
台風の名前：気象庁「台風のアジア名」リストをもとにしています

name: 123TG Orbit
description:
Keep the guess you made before the answer.

A basket feels like about 60. A plan seems to need an hour. Four packs might cover everyone. Everyday numbers often begin with a quick judgment, and that first thought deserves a place in the record.

123TG Orbit is an estimation notebook built around a simple sequence: Estimate, Calculate, Review. Save what you think, work through the inputs, then put both numbers in perspective.

Suppose you estimated 60 and the calculation produces 57.40. Orbit keeps your original judgment and shows the +2.60 difference on an interactive number line. You can zoom, move the view, inspect the formulas and write down what you noticed. The comparison stays connected to the inputs that produced it.

If one number feels too specific, save a lower and upper bound instead. Review whether the reference falls inside your interval and see its width. Both endpoints are included, and the interval width stays visible alongside the coverage result.

Bring a question from your own day.

Build a shopping basket with item prices and quantities, one currency, and clearly ordered discounts, specified tax and extra fees. Put together a time plan with separate hours and minutes, preparation, buffers and explicitly named parallel tasks. Keep the date when a start time runs past midnight.

Count groups and loose items, or work out how many whole packs meet a requirement and what remains. Explore lengths, rectangular perimeters, areas and cuboid volumes with dimensionally correct unit conversions.

For a question that needs its own structure, build a labeled calculation chain. Choose operations, connect earlier steps and identify the final target without writing a complex formula.

Give a particular step a second look.

Save optional independent step estimates before revealing their results. In a custom chain, substitute an estimate for one node and recalculate what follows. Follow how that one change affects the final result while the other inputs stay fixed.

A retry creates a new attempt while preserving the original. Previous results stay hidden during the new estimate, and the record retains that you have seen a reference before. What If gives changed inputs a separate workspace. Correcting a reference keeps its earlier version and your saved judgment.

Over time, your notebook becomes something you can return to.

Search and filter History by scene, date, estimate type, attempt and reference source. Insights separates original first attempts from retries and shows numerical direction, interval coverage and range widths using eligible records.

Drafts save locally so you can leave a question unfinished. Export history as CSV, an exploration with calculation steps as PDF, and charts as PNG. A complete backup preserves drafts, versions and retry relationships for restoration.

Core features work offline, with no account required. Your questions and notes are not automatically uploaded. The interface follows your iPhone's light or dark appearance and respects Reduce Motion.

name: Abo Abo: Would You Rather?
description:
Abo Abo is a party game where one phone is all you need.

Reveal a card, read the dilemma out loud — and the fun begins: debates, explanations and surprising answers from your friends. Decided? Swipe left for A, right for B. Then see how groups around the world answered the same question.

HOW TO PLAY
• The host taps the card to reveal it
• Reads the dilemma out loud
• The group votes and explains their choice
• Swipe left for A, right for B

5 PACKS, 200 DILEMMAS
• Fun & Silly — absurd and funny situations to warm up
• For Couples — get to know each other better

• Philosophical — values, morals and the meaning of life

Perfect for parties, road trips, date nights, team building or just an evening with friends.

What would you choose?

name: Act Early, Gain Dividend
description:
Build stronger business judgment in a few minutes a day.

Act Early, Gain Dividend is a daily business coach built around a simple routine: listen, answer, act. Each day of the 14-day Launch Sprint brings one short audio lesson (about five minutes), a 5-question quiz that checks what actually stuck, and one small real-world action challenge that takes about two minutes.

Every lesson pairs a true founder story with one established business framework, explained in plain language:

• Day 1 — Calculated risk: cap the downside, using Airbnb's cereal-box fundraise
• Day 2 — Sunk cost and the Concorde trap: judge from today forward
• Day 3 — Pay yourself first: automating savings before spending
• Day 4 — Runway: cash divided by monthly burn
• Day 5 — Smoke tests: sell it before you build it
• Day 6 — Pricing anchors and decoys: the $429 bread maker
• Day 7 — BATNA: why your walk-away is your power in negotiation
• Day 8 — Disagree and commit: decide fast, execute together
• Day 9 — Unit economics: why LTV must beat CAC
• Day 10 — Positioning: who it's for, what it replaces
• Day 11 — The risk ladder: fund, cover, then invest
• Day 12 — Expected value and regret minimization: the 80-year-old test
• Day 13 — Dilution math: what 20% really costs
• Day 14 — Boss Level: a 10-question review across the whole sprint

THREE LANGUAGES, PROPERLY ADAPTED
Choose English, Hindi, or Spanish at setup. The Hindi and Spanish editions are culturally adapted versions of the same curriculum — local founder stories, local currency examples — not word-for-word translations.

CLIMB THE LADDER
Earn XP for listening, answering, and completing your daily action. Your streak and XP move you up a career ladder from Intern to Associate, Manager, VP, and CEO.

FREE TO START, ONE PAYMENT TO FINISH
Days 1–3 are completely free, no card required. Act Early Pro unlocks Days 4–14 — every lesson, quiz, and action challenge — for a one-time payment of $9.99. No subscription, nothing renews: pay once and the full sprint is yours forever.

FOUNDING COMMUNITY — EARLY BUYERS GET MORE
Every early buyer also receives Founding Community access, opening at launch: a founding-member place alongside other builders working through the same sprint. Early buyers lock in early-bird discounts on every future course. Coming courses — Real Estate Investing, M&A, and startup building — sort community members into build tracks (startup, real estate, M&A), the first step on the founding path toward a community accelerator: members who build together, match into teams, and pitch what they've made. Founding members are invited first, at founding terms.

EDUCATION, NOT ADVICE
Act Early, Gain Dividend teaches general business and money concepts for education only. It does not provide financial, investment, tax, or legal advice, and nothing in the app is a recommendation to buy, sell, or invest in anything.

name: AkselSkift
description:
AkselSkift samler planlægning, produktion og overlevering mellem skift i værksteder med kombineret drejning og fræsning. Følg hver ordre fra materialekontrol og ressourcebooking til kvalitetskontrol, vedligeholdelse og afslutning.

• **Planlæg efter bekræftet kapacitet.** Fordel ordremængder på skift, og se, hvad der mangler at blive planlagt. Knyt opgaver til maskiner, operatører og kontrolressourcer med tydelige afhængigheder og deadlines.

• **Opdag konflikter før omplanlægning.** Se overlappende bookinger, klargøring og vedligeholdelsesvinduer. Gennemgå alternative ressourcer og konsekvenser for efterfølgende opgaver, leveringstid og omkostninger, før ændringer godkendes.

• **Følg arbejdet på gulvet.** Registrér fremdrift, ventetid, tomgang, omarbejde og maskinhændelser. Tilføj fotos, målinger og noter med kilde og tidspunkt. Manglende eller forsinkede data vises som forhold, der kræver kontrol.

• **Bevar kvalitet og sporbarhed.** Dokumentér kontrollen af de første emner, måleresultater og gældende kontrolversion. Afgræns berørte partier ved afvigelser, registrér genkontrol, og lad autoriserede kvalitetsansvarlige frigive de godkendte emner.

• **Saml vedligeholdelse og omkostninger.** Følg serviceopgaver, reservedele, nedetid, arbejdstimer, energiforbrug og materialer. Sammenlign kapacitetsscenarier med synlige forudsætninger og datakilder.

Arbejd videre med gemte arbejdsordrer og registreringer offline. Ændringer, der afventer synkronisering, er tydeligt markeret. Gennemgå historik og revisioner, og forhåndsvis data før eksport som CSV med tilhørende indeks over kvalitetsdokumentation.

name: Alıver
description:
Don't forget at home, remember at the store.

Alıver is your family's shared shopping list. Whoever notices something running
out adds it; whoever passes by the store picks it up. Everyone sees who is buying
what in real time, so nothing gets bought twice and nothing gets forgotten.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• One shared list: Everyone in the family sees the same list, updated instantly.
• "I'm buying it": Claim an item so others know it's taken care of.
• "Pick up on the way home": Hand someone a small shopping run.
• My items: See just the things that are on you.
• Reminders: Remember what matters, on time.
• Category, quantity, unit and note: "2 kg, full fat" stays with the item.
• Works offline: Add and check off items with no signal; it syncs when you're back online.
• Easy invites: Invite family with a one-time link and decide who else can invite.

YOUR PRIVACY
No ads, no tracking. Your list is visible only to your family. You can delete your
account from inside the app at any time.

FREE
Alıver is free for a family of two. Bigger families can add 3 more member spots
with a single one-time payment. No subscription.

name: Anime Japanese: Listen & Learn
description:
Start with one Japanese phrase. Listen again, follow the kana, and discover when to use it.

Anime Japanese brings everyday conversation and original anime-style and gaming examples into illustrated listening cards. It teaches through phrases and scenes, rather than streaming clips from shows.

• Explore 846 entries across 58 topics, from greetings, school and travel to adventures and teamwork.
• Read Japanese, kana, translations, scene context, and usage notes. Learn the difference between polite speech, casual conversation, and forceful story dialogue.
• Choose from three Japanese voices and set their order. Each selected voice reads the same entry once.
• Tap individual words in groups covering numbers, days, dates, months, forms of address, and more.
• Browse topics, search, save favorites, and use continuous listening, list repeat, playback speed, and a sleep timer.
• Content and audio are included for offline listening. No account, advertising, or learning analytics.
• Swipe up or down to change cards and left to see usage notes. Turn on continuous playback to hear the next phrase automatically. On the back, playback stops after the current phrase so you can read.
• Learn on iPhone, iPad, and iPhone Duo, including its outer and unfolded inner display.

Try 50 entries free with all three voices. One purchase unlocks audio for the other 796 entries; text explanations remain browsable. No auto-renewing subscription. The App Store shows your local price.

The interface and explanations support English, Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese for Taiwan and Hong Kong. Japanese text and audio stay in Japanese. Favorites and playback position are stored on your device; learning-data cloud sync is not provided. Audio is generated in advance.

For anime and game fans who want to practice Japanese through short expressions. Dramatic dialogue is not always suitable for formal conversation: check each card’s usage notes.

name: Arcana: Tarot Journal
description:
Arcana is a quiet space for symbolic reflection and your own words. The cards do not decide for you. They offer a moment to notice what matters and choose a small next step.

A DAILY CARD
Reveal one card, explore its symbolism, and save what resonates.

THREE-CARD READINGS

Arcana is for adult entertainment and personal reflection. Interpretations are composed on-device from original texts about card symbolism, not by an AI service. Tarot cannot establish facts, read minds or guarantee future events. It is not professional advice.

name: Baby & Bond
description:
Baby & Bond helps mothers and fathers interact with their baby, build a bond and help their baby be happy. Every day it suggests simple ideas to play, watch and be together, matched to your baby’s exact stage from 0 to 18 months.

Enter your baby’s birth date (and the due date, if they were born early) and the app works out their age and suggests what to do today. No accounts, no sign-up.

EVERY DAY
• Three ideas for today from different themes: bonding, massage, sensory, motor, communication and autonomy.
• Not quite right? Ask for another idea from the same stage.
• A short note on what’s happening at this stage and a principle to keep in mind.

36 TWO-WEEK STAGES
• Every activity for each stage, with a filter by theme.
• Browse the previous or next stage if your baby is ahead or behind.
• Corrected age for premature babies and support for twins.

A GUIDE TO COME BACK TO
• Principles for playing with your baby.
• Baby’s cues: when they want to play and when they need a break.
• Baby massage: basic movements and how to adapt them to age.
• Safety and screens.
• Sources of information.
• Save your favorite activities.

BABY LEADS
Every activity reminds you of the essentials: play when your baby is awake, calm and alert, and stop if they seem overwhelmed.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
Your baby’s profile and saved activities are stored on your device. You can delete them any time from Settings.

AVAILABLE IN ENGLISH, ESPAÑOL, CATALÀ AND FRANÇAIS
Change the language inside the app without changing the one on your iPhone.

FREE TO TRY, ONE PAYMENT TO UNLOCK EVERYTHING
Free: one of the three daily ideas, the current stage, the safety guide and up to 3 saved activities. With a one-time purchase, no subscription, you unlock every stage, all three daily ideas with “Another idea”, the full guide and unlimited saved activities.

Baby & Bond is a play and bonding app. It isn’t a pediatric app and doesn’t assess development: for health or development questions, talk to your pediatrician.

name: BakeWatch
description:
Το BakeWatch είναι ο βοηθός του τεχνικού βαφής για τον έλεγχο του φούρνου ξήρανσης.
﻿
Παρακολουθήστε σε πραγματικό χρόνο την καμπύλη θερμοκρασίας ανά ζώνη, ρυθμίστε την ταχύτητα αλυσίδας (m/min), υπολογίστε τον χρόνο παραμονής και καταγράψτε κάθε αμάξωμα με τον αριθμό του από την είσοδο έως την έξοδο του φούρνου.
﻿
Το εφαρμοσμένο θερμικό ισοδύναμο (bake integral) σας βοηθά να κρίνετε αν το φιλμ βαφής κινδυνεύει από υπερθέρμανση (εύθραυστο) ή υποθέρμανση (δεν στεγνώνει). Οι συναγερμοί δεσμεύονται πάντα στον αριθμό αμαξώματος για πλήρη ιχνηλασιμότητα.
﻿
Κύριες δυνατότητες:
• Καμπύλη θερμοκρασίας πολλαπλών ζωνών έναντι προφίλ συνταγής
• Διαχείριση ταχύτητας αλυσίδας και εκτίμηση χρόνου παραμονής
• Παρακολούθηση αμαξωμάτων με αριθμό αμαξώματος
• Συναγερμοί υπερθέρμανσης και υποθέρμανσης με επιβεβαίωση
• Ρυθμίσεις διεργασίας: μήκος φούρνου, παράθυρο παραμονής, όρια θερμικού ισοδυνάμου, στόχοι ζωνών
• Τοπική αποθήκευση δεδομένων και εργαλεία επίδειξης για εκπαίδευση
﻿
Το BakeWatch κλείνει τον κύκλο της διεργασίας: καμπύλη → αλυσίδα → αμάξωμα → συναγερμός — ώστε κάθε βαφή να παραμένει εντός του παραθύρου σκλήρυνσης.

name: BandUp: IELTS Vocabulary
description:
Learn the vocabulary you need for IELTS, with meanings in English, Russian and Uzbek.

BandUp gives you 3,900 IELTS words, each with a clear definition and an example sentence. Uzbek and Russian meanings help you understand and remember words faster in the language you think in.

WHAT YOU GET
• 3,900 IELTS words with definitions and example sentences
• Uzbek and Russian meanings
• Flashcards with spaced repetition, so you review words just before you forget them
• Works offline: study on the bus, at school, anywhere
• Study reminders to help you keep a daily habit
• Available in English, Russian and Uzbek

BANDUP PRO

• Yearly: $17.99 per year
• Monthly: $2.99 per month
Prices are shown for the United States and may vary by country.

name: BasketMind: Grocery Planner
description:
BasketMind helps you organize grocery shopping, manage your pantry, and keep your food budget under control.

SMART SHOPPING LISTS
Create grocery lists, add quantities and prices, and keep track of what you need to buy.

GROCERY BUDGET
Set your shopping budget and monitor expenses as you plan and complete purchases.

PANTRY MANAGEMENT
Keep track of the ingredients you have at home. Update quantities as you use products.

RECIPES & INGREDIENTS
Browse recipes, see which ingredients you already have, and add missing ingredients to your shopping list.

SHOPPING HISTORY
Review completed shopping trips and keep a record of your purchases.

BARCODE SCANNING
Scan product barcodes to look up available product information using Open Food Facts.

PERSONALIZE YOUR EXPERIENCE
Choose between light and dark themes, multiple languages, and supported currencies.

YOUR SHOPPING, YOUR CONTROL
No account required. Your grocery lists, pantry items, and shopping history are stored locally on your device. Some barcode lookups require an internet connection.

BasketMind — a simpler way to plan groceries, organize your kitchen, and manage everyday shopping.

name: Beam - Send files to PC
description:
Beam moves photos, videos, files, links and notes between your iPhone and your computer. Open beam.uploadbetter.com on the computer, type the code the app shows, and they're connected. After that, anything you send shows up on the other one right away.

Everything is end-to-end encrypted. It's locked on your iPhone and unlocked on your computer, and our server can't read it.

What you can do:
• Send from any app with Share to Beam: Photos, Files, Safari, and anything else with a Share button.
• Open what your computer sends in iOS's viewer, save photos to your library, or save files to Files.
• Get a notification when something arrives. It says which device sent what kind of thing, never what's in it.
• Already use Beam in Safari, Chrome or another browser on your iPhone? The app takes that same Beam, as the same device.
• Use it on your iPad too, and on more computers with Beam Pro.
• Use it with Upload Better for Chrome: what you send from your iPhone is right there in every upload box on your computer.

Beam Free: 2 devices, files up to 50 MB, kept for 2 days, 1 GB a day, 1 share link a day.

Beam Pro: up to 5 devices, files up to 5 GB, kept for 14 days, 25 GB a day, 20 share links a day. $4.99 a month or $29.99 a year. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period; cancel in Settings, under your name, then Subscriptions.

No account, no ads, no tracking.

name: Bearing Catalog & Calculator
description:
Bearing Catalog (BearCore) is a fast, practical bearing reference for engineers, technicians and maintenance teams.

• Over 5,600 bearings: deep groove ball, Y-bearings, angular contact, self-aligning ball, cylindrical roller, needle roller, tapered roller, spherical roller, toroidal, thrust bearings and cam followers
• Search by name or dimensions: filter by bore (d), outer diameter (D) and width (B) with ±0.5 mm tolerance
• Technical details: dynamic and static load ratings, fatigue load limit, reference and limiting speed, technical drawing
• Engineering calculation: lists suitable bearings with their L10 life for your radial and axial load, speed and target life
• Maintenance tracking: installation date, lubrication interval and reminder notifications for your favorite bearings
• PDF data sheet: create it with your own company name and logo, then save and share
• One-tap search from the home screen widget and app icon shortcuts
• Turkish, English, German, French and Hindi; light and dark theme

BEARING CATALOG PRO
The yearly Pro subscription removes all ads, gives unlimited bearing details and calculations without watching ads, and lets the app work without an internet connection. In the free version, bearing details and calculations require an internet connection.

The subscription renews automatically every year at the same price unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. name: Bibo Puzzle - Slide & Solve
description:
“Just one more round,” says Bibo the cat. Then he spots a puzzle he thinks he can solve a little faster.

Open Bibo Puzzle and pick one of four games:

• Picture Slide — Slide the pieces back into place. Choose from 12 built-in illustrations or turn one of your own photos into a puzzle. Even a picture of your cat napping can keep you busy!
• Number Slide — Slide numbered tiles into the empty space until they’re back in order. Start with a 2×2 board and see how you do when it grows to 8×8.
• Honey Lights — Tap a light to flip it and its neighbors above, below, and to either side. Can you turn them all off? That light you just switched off might come right back on!
• Block Puzzle — Drag little pastry blocks from the tray onto the board. Fill a row or column to clear it and score points. Save a little room for the next piece!

Take it easy in Free Play, or unlock levels and collect stars in Journey. If you like racing the clock, try Time Trial in Picture Slide, Number Slide, or Honey Lights and see if you can beat your own record.

Each game has an interactive tutorial so you can try a few moves first. Your unfinished games are saved for later, and History lets you check your results or replay a favorite challenge.

Play offline with the built-in games and illustrations on iPhone and iPad.

name: Birds Now: Bird Migration Map
description:
Where is the Barn Swallow right now? Have the swans arrived yet?
Birds Now shows where 100 migratory birds are traveling, on a soft, hand-drawn-style 3D globe.

- SEE WHERE THEY ARE TODAY
Spin the globe with your finger and pinch to zoom. Choose a bird to mark where it is likely to be today, with its breeding grounds, wintering grounds, stopovers and its full year's route drawn as a glowing line. Plain-language status tells you more: "Taiwan → The Philippines", "Over the sea", "About 12 days to arrival".

- PICK ANY DATE
Your birthday, a trip, next spring: choose any date and see where each bird will be that day. You can also scrub along the year timeline.

- REPLAY A YEAR OF MIGRATION
Press play to fast-forward through the seasons while the globe follows your bird. Watch the Bar-tailed Godwit fly nonstop from Alaska to New Zealand.

- SHUFFLE MODE
When no bird is selected, a handful of randomly chosen migrants flap across the globe. It is relaxing just to watch.

- SURROUNDED BY BIRDSONG
While you watch the globe, birdsong recorded in the wild plays softly in the background. It mixes with your own music, and you can turn it off or change the volume in Settings.

- A FIELD GUIDE WITH REALISTIC ILLUSTRATIONS
Barn Swallow, Whooper Swan, Hooded Crane, Steller's Sea Eagle, Arctic Tern, Bar-tailed Godwit, Short-tailed Albatross, Spoon-billed Sandpiper, Whooping Crane, Ruby-throated Hummingbird, Atlantic Puffin, European Bee-eater, Rainbow Bee-eater and many more: 100 migratory birds from Japan and around the world.
Each page has length, wingspan and weight, a migration calendar, a migration secret, and where and when to see the bird, illustrated in a field-guide style. Mark the birds you have seen to build your collection.

- GREAT FOR
- Birders and bird watchers
- Anyone who looks forward to the first swallow of spring
- Science projects and nature learning
- Globe and map lovers

- ABOUT THE POSITIONS
The app does not track real birds. Positions are estimates calculated from each population's known breeding, stopover and wintering areas and their typical timing, based on published research and observations.

- ALSO
- For iPhone and iPad, in English and Japanese
- The globe and the guide work offline (except ads)
- Free with ads. A one-time "Remove Ads" in-app purchase removes all ads

Map data: Made with Natural Earth
Birdsong: Freesound (CC0)

name: Bluff Party: Imposter Game
description:
Gather your friends around one phone: everyone sees the secret word, except one. Who is the impostor? Bluff your way through and don't get caught!

Bluff Party is a bluffing word game for groups of 3 to 12 players. No setup, no accounts, no internet. Pass the phone around, check your role in secret and let the game begin.

HOW TO PLAY
• Pass the phone around; everyone checks their role without showing anyone.
• Innocents see the secret word. The impostor only gets a small hint.
• Take turns giving a short clue about the word. Too obvious and the impostor catches on; too vague and suspicion turns to you.
• Discuss, question each other and vote in secret: who's the impostor? Catch the right person and the innocents win; accuse the wrong one and the impostor wins.

TWO GAME MODES
• Classic: describe the word with spoken clues.
• Drawing: draw the word against the clock. Drawings are revealed anonymously in a shuffled gallery, and who drew what is shown at the end. Guaranteed laughs.

VOTING & SCOREBOARD
• Secret vote: the phone goes around and everyone votes without showing anyone. The votes, and who voted for whom, are revealed together at the end. On a tie, there's one more vote between the tied players.
• Score points across rounds: +1 for each innocent who voted for the impostor, +2 when the impostor escapes. Who will win the night?
• In a hurry? Quick vote lets the group pick one suspect together.
• Add an optional discussion timer (30 seconds to 5 minutes) with a sound and vibration alert when time is up.

FEATURES
• 900+ words in 8 categories: food, animals, jobs, countries, objects, sports, places, nature. Over 1,100 with the Pro packs.
• Every word has its own impostor hint, not too easy and not too hard.
• The same word never repeats until a category is used up.
• The number of impostors adjusts to the number of players.
• Fully offline: play on camping trips, road trips, house parties, at school… anywhere.
• Sound and vibration effects (can be turned off in Settings).
• 7 languages: English, Türkçe, Português (Brasil), Español (Latinoamérica), Bahasa Indonesia, Русский, 中文.
• Player names and settings stay on your phone.

BLUFF PARTY PRO
One-time payment, no subscription. Buy once, everything that comes next is yours:
• No ads
• Special word packs: Party Night, Hometown and Hard Mode with abstract concepts (future packs included)
• Create your own categories with your group's own words and hints
• Choose the number of impostors yourself

The free version contains ads. Ads only appear after a game is over, when you leave the result screen. Never in the middle of a game.

Birthdays, house parties, New Year's Eve or just a regular night in… with Bluff Party, everyone at the table is a suspect!

name: BookListen: Audiobook Player
description:
BookListen plays the audiobooks you already own. Add an M4B, MP3 or ZIP file and pick up exactly where you stopped.

ADD YOUR BOOKS
• M4B, MP3, M4A, AAC, WAV, FLAC and more
• A ZIP, a whole folder or several files at once
• From the Files app, Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive

LISTEN YOUR WAY
• Chapters from M4B and CUE files, with a slider for the current chapter
• Speed from 0.75x to 2x
• Sleep timer
• A short rewind when you resume, so you don't lose the thread
• Keeps playing with the screen off, with lock screen and headphone controls

YOUR LIBRARY
• Continue listening in one tap
• Progress and time left for every book
• Rename books and mark them finished
• Dark mode

PREMIUM
BookListen is free, with a small banner ad. Premium is a one-time purchase that removes the ads and adds bookmarks with your own notes. You can try it free for 14 days.

No account needed. Your books stay on your phone.

name: BriefPilot: German Letters
description:
A letter from the Jobcenter, the Finanzamt or the Ausländerbehörde, and you only understand half of it? BriefPilot explains official German mail in your own language.

HOW IT WORKS
• Photograph the letter: the text is read right on your phone
• Personal data is removed before the AI analyses the letter
• See at once: what kind of letter is it, what must you do, and by when

WHAT YOU GET
• Explanations in your language: the app comes in 10 languages, explanations in many more
• For appointments: what to bring and which documents to prepare
• Payment details (amount, IBAN, reference, due date) with one-tap copy
• What happens if you ignore the letter
• A glossary of Amtsdeutsch terms
• A scam warning for fake Inkasso letters

DEADLINES AND REMINDERS
• Add appointments and deadlines to your phone calendar with reminders
• Push notifications before time runs out
• Objection deadlines (Widerspruch, Einspruch) calculated for you

WRITE YOUR REPLY
• Draft a formal German letter with a translation: objection, instalment request, deadline extension or appointment rescheduling
• Export as PDF or email

ALSO INCLUDED
• Ask follow-up questions about your letter in a chat
• Letter archive with search

YOUR PRIVACY
Photos and letters stay on your phone. Before the AI analysis, names, addresses and bank details are removed on your device; the anonymised text is processed by DeepSeek (China) only after you agree. Account data is stored in the EU (Frankfurt).

GOOD TO KNOW
BriefPilot is not legal advice and cannot promise any outcome. For important cases, contact an advice centre or a lawyer. BriefPilot is an independent app and is not affiliated with any German authority.

SUBSCRIPTION
A subscription is required: yearly with a 3-day free trial, or weekly. Subscription auto-renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage in account settings.

name: British Cat: Learn English
description:
A little cat has moved into your room — and the only way to keep it fed and happy is to learn a bit of English every day.

HOW IT WORKS
• One story = one lesson. Short, funny, original stories about the cat and the people who once looked after it.
• Hear the same story three times: today, yesterday and tomorrow. Tenses sink in without a single grammar rule.
• Listen and answer, learn key phrases, say them out loud, build sentences with your fingers.
• Hold any word to see what it means — no downloads, no internet needed.

A CAT THAT NEEDS YOU
• Every story you finish puts food in the bowl.
• Earn coins and furnish the cat's room: beds, toys, lamps, plants, a cat tree, seasonal decorations.
• The cat plays, sleeps, chases a laser dot and climbs on the furniture — in a cosy 3D room at the bottom of the screen.
• Skip a few days and the cat will miss you. Come back and it will purr.
• Teens and adults can invite a friend: your cats race while you both learn.

FOR EVERY AGE
• Kids: simple stories about the cat itself.
• Teens: the twins Maya and Leo, their school, their band, their first start-up.
• Adults: Mrs Hill's trip around the world and everyone who ever looked after the cat.
• Six levels from Starter to C1, a placement test, level exams and more than 460 stories — months of daily play.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Menus, hints and translations in Ukrainian, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian, Polish, Turkish, Chinese and Japanese.

PREMIUM (one purchase, forever)
Three Perfect tenses for every story, full translations, extra tasks, a review of past lessons, special treats and new rooms. No subscription, no ads, ever.

Your progress stays on your device and in your own iCloud. No ads, no tracking.

Premium Forever

Perfect tenses, translations and extra tasks

name: BSuelio: Fuel & Mileage
description:
BSuelio keeps your vehicle history in one place: fuel, expenses, maintenance and trips.

YOUR EVERYDAY VEHICLE LOG
• Record fill-ups, odometer readings and vehicle expenses.
• Follow fuel consumption and running costs calculated from your records.
• Keep service reminders by date or mileage.
• Record trips manually and review distance, duration, start/end times and available speed statistics.
• Find nearby fuel stations from OpenStreetMap. Downloaded station catalogs remain available offline; fuel prices are not provided.
• Import, export and keep local backups of your records.

OPTIONAL BSUELIO PREMIUM
• Manage more vehicles and unlimited active, recurring reminders.
• Scan receipts and odometer readings, then review the results before saving.
• Enable automatic trip detection and recording.
• Resolve trip start and end addresses after enabling a separate location-sharing consent, without a monthly address allowance.
• Use advanced reports and available PDF exports.

Automatic recording depends on location and motion permissions, your settings and iOS background restrictions. Optional address recognition sends only the trip endpoints to Apple's service. Station data coverage and freshness vary by area. Scanned values and estimated costs should be checked before use.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Premium is available as an optional monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscription. The localized price and billing period are displayed before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account on confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.

When Premium ends, your saved history remains available to read and export. Free access supports writing to one vehicle and up to three active reminders.

Terms of Use: https://www.bsbackupplayer.pl/privacy-policy/#bsp-terms-bsuelio-en

name: BudgetEasy - Spese e Budget
description:
BudgetEasy ti aiuta a capire dove vanno i tuoi soldi, senza fatica e senza rinunciare alla privacy. Niente account, niente pubblicità: i tuoi dati restano sul tuo iPhone.

UNA SPESA IN UNA RIGA
Scrivi «Pizza -24,50 Carta» o «Taxi 40/2 USD»: l'app riconosce importo, conto, categoria e valuta, e fa anche i calcoli. Puoi aggiungere una spesa anche con Siri, dal widget o dal Centro di Controllo.

TUTTI I TUOI CONTI
Conto corrente, risparmio, carta di credito, contanti, investimenti e conti deposito con interessi, ognuno nella sua valuta. Trasferimenti anche tra valute diverse, con i tassi di riferimento della Banca Centrale Europea al cambio del giorno.

BUDGET SOTTO CONTROLLO
Imposta un budget mensile, anche per singola categoria, e vedi subito quanto resta e quanto puoi spendere oggi. Un avviso ti segnala quando arrivi all'80% e al 100%.

STATISTICHE CHIARE
Grafici per categoria, mese e anno, calendario delle spese, spese fisse e variabili, andamento del patrimonio netto. Apple Intelligence scrive un riepilogo del tuo mese, direttamente sul dispositivo.

AUTOMATICO DOVE SERVE
• Transazioni ricorrenti per affitto, stipendio e abbonamenti
• Categorie e sottocategorie, con suggerimenti automatici
• Spese divise su più categorie
• Scontrini fotografati o scansionati e allegati alle transazioni, con lettura automatica di negozio, totale e data

OBIETTIVI, PRESTITI E MUTUI
Metti da parte per un viaggio o per le emergenze e segui i progressi. Tieni traccia dei soldi prestati e restituiti, persona per persona, e del tuo mutuo con il piano di ammortamento.

IMPORT ED EXPORT
Importa gli estratti conto della tua banca in CSV, XLSX, OFX/QFX, CAMT.053 o PDF. Esporta le transazioni in CSV e crea un backup completo quando vuoi.

PRIVACY PRIMA DI TUTTO
• I dati restano sul dispositivo: nessun account, nessun server, nessun tracciamento
• Blocco con Face ID, Touch ID o codice
• Nascondi gli importi con un tocco
• Widget per Home Screen e Lock Screen, che rispettano le tue impostazioni di privacy

E ANCORA
Tema chiaro, scuro o nero, una guida illustrata e l'interfaccia in italiano e in inglese.

BudgetEasy migliora di continuo grazie a chi la usa: se hai un suggerimento o trovi un problema, scrivimi dal link Supporto. Leggo ogni messaggio.

BudgetEasy è uno strumento per tenere traccia delle tue finanze personali: i calcoli sono indicativi e non costituiscono consulenza finanziaria.

name: Bunnybook: Tile Match Puzzle
description:
The bunnies of a little coloring-book village have lost their colors — and forgotten who they are.

Match three tiles to clear each page. Every page you finish brings back one memory: a bunny's name, its colors, its habits, its job and its home. Collect them all and watch each house, each bunny and finally the whole village fill with soft watercolor.

• Calm triple-match puzzles drawn in ink on white paper
• 100 bunnies across 10 villages, each with its own story
• A Journal for every bunny to fill with memory sketches
• Decorate each bunny's cozy room with furniture
• Play offline, at your own pace — no timers in the puzzles
• Helpers like Undo, Shuffle and an extra slot when you need them

Free to play. Optional in-app purchases (helper packs and hearts) and optional reward videos — nothing pops up by itself.

name: Cardless: Direct Debit
description:
Direct Debit Dashboard gives you a clear view of your Direct Debit business, right on your iPhone.

See your payments, subscriptions, customers and mandates in one place. Check how much you've collected over the period you choose, find failed or pending payments quickly, and open any payment or customer for the full detail.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Dashboard: totals and trends for the period you pick
• Payments: search and filter every payment, with status and charge dates
• Subscriptions: see active plans and edit them
• Customers and mandates: view who pays you and how
• Create: set up payments, subscriptions and installments with Premium
• Home screen widgets to check your numbers at a glance
• Try it with sample data before you connect your account

FREE AND PREMIUM
The free version includes the dashboard with ads. Premium removes the ads and unlocks creating payments, subscriptions and installments. Plans renew automatically until canceled. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple ID settings. Restore purchases is available on the paywall.

Direct Debit Dashboard is an independent app. It is not made by, endorsed by or affiliated with any Direct Debit provider. You need an account with a supported provider and an access token to see your live data.

name: Cartones Lotería Mexicana
description:
Crea y personaliza tus cartones de lotería mexicana desde tu iPhone.

• Cuadrículas de 4×4 y 5×5.
• Exportación en PDF e imágenes JPG para guardar, compartir e imprimir.

name: Cladivo: AI Outfit Planner
description:
What should you wear today? Cladivo is an AI outfit planner that turns the clothes you own into looks for your plans, your style, and the weather.

YOUR WARDROBE, IN ONE PLACE
Photograph your clothes to build a digital closet. Remove backgrounds, review AI-detected clothing details, and organize pieces by type, color, and more.

ASK YOUR AI STYLIST
Choose an occasion and a vibe, or describe what you have in mind. Your AI stylist suggests outfits from your wardrobe. Ask for a change, refine the look, and choose what to wear.

DRESS FOR YOUR DAY
Enable optional local weather context to help shape outfit suggestions. Keep track of what you wear and find fresh ways to combine familiar pieces.

SHOP WITH YOUR CLOSET IN MIND
Discover pieces that work with what you already own. Build around a favorite item, explore options, or find ideas for a gap in your wardrobe. Save ideas and visit retailer links when you're ready.

Cladivo requires an active monthly or annual subscription, or an eligible free trial. There is no free plan. Eligible subscribers can start a 7-day free trial where offered. Local prices and eligibility are shown before purchase.

name: CodeSheet QR Studio
description:
CodeSheet makes QR codes for the real world: menus, product labels, table tents, flyers, and event badges.

STATIC CODES, NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Create as many static QR codes as you like. They work without signing in and are saved on your device.

DYNAMIC CODES
Dynamic codes point to a short link that you can change later, so the printed code never has to be reprinted. Free accounts get 2 active dynamic codes. CodeSheet Pro gets up to 100.

BATCH IMPORT
Import a CSV file with a label and destination for each row. Add an optional type column (link, email, or text) to mix code types. Check every row before anything is created.

PRINT AND DOWNLOAD
Print codes on standard sticker sheets, centered and sized to fit. Add names under each code, choose the gap between codes, and create a PDF to share or print.
Download any code as a vector PDF for print shops, or as a 1200 × 1200 PNG for screens. Download a whole batch as a ZIP with one PDF per code, each named after its label, or as one sheet PDF.

CUSTOM LOOKS AND COLORS
Choose from 10 looks and 10 colors. Each code keeps its own style when printed.

CONTENT TYPES
Make codes for more than links:
• Link: a web page, as before.
• Email: scanning opens a new email to the address you choose, with a subject and message filled in. Free.
• Text: scanning shows your text, up to 500 characters, such as a Wi-Fi password or a note. Free.
• Contact card (Pro): scanning offers to save a person to Contacts with name, phone, and email.

LOGOS (PRO)
Add your logo in the middle of a code. The app checks the image and uses High error correction so the code still scans.

SCAN COUNTS
See total scans for every code for free. CodeSheet Pro adds hourly, device, and country breakdowns and a ranking of your codes.

CHECK A CODE
Scan or photograph any QR code to see where it leads before you open it.

SAFETY
Codes that link to harmful sites can be reported, and blocked destinations are disabled. Links to IP addresses and URL shorteners are not allowed.

CODESHEET PRO
$4.99 per month, auto-renewing. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Your subscription renews monthly unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of use: https://c.threedollarqrcode.com/terms

name: Cogglow: Gear Puzzle
description:
Drop glowing gears onto pegs until the motor’s spin reaches every lamp. No timer, no lives, no fail state – just a few calm minutes and the click of teeth catching.

The rules come from the picture: gears that touch turn the other way, so the length of a chain decides which way a lamp spins, and a bigger gear reaches further. Drag a gear from the tray onto a peg and watch the spin travel tooth by tooth until the glass domes fill with light. More gears than needed still work; the fewest earn three stars.

• 60 levels in three halls: Brass teaches meshing, direction and bolts; Neon brings two coloured motors whose trains must never touch; Chrome has motors that must agree
• Every level is checked by a solver: there is always exactly one shortest way
• Gear of the Day: a new board every day, the same for everyone, with a streak, streak freezes and a share card
• Stuck? A hint lights one peg and the gear it needs
• Every gear is drawn in code: real teeth, a soft glow, light and dark menus, a less-motion mode
• Plays offline, in 18 languages

Free to play with optional ads between levels; one purchase removes them. The Brass hall and the Gear of the Day are free; Neon and Chrome open with stars, or at once with a one-time purchase; one bundle opens both and removes the ads. No account needed.

Take a breath. Drop a gear.

name: Cullwise: Photo Cleanup by AI
description:
Write which photos are safe to delete, in your own words. Cullwise judges your photos one by one against that rule and marks only the ones at or above your confidence threshold as delete candidates. You decide the ones that need review.

WHO IT IS FOR
- You save receipts, screenshots, and product photos as notes
- Your camera roll has thousands of photos, and finished notes are mixed in with memories
- Swiping through photos one at a time does not last past a few thousand

HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick a category or write your own: a name, and a sentence about what kind of photo it is. For example, "receipts" or "price tag photos"
2. Run Judge. Each photo gets a confidence score for how well it matches
3. Photos at or above your threshold become delete candidates. Photos a little below it go to Needs review
4. Review, then delete them together

FEATURES
- Rules in your own words, not only fixed categories chosen by the app
- Every result comes with a confidence score. A slider on the results screen sets where delete candidates start, and moving it costs no tickets
- Nothing is deleted automatically. Deleted photos go to Recently Deleted in iOS, where you can restore them for about 30 days
- Clearing screenshots in bulk from the Home screenshots card uses no tickets
- No subscription. You pay by tickets, one per photo judged. 200 are free every month. Purchased tickets never expire
- No account. With the same Apple Account, your purchased tickets come back on a new iPhone
- Available in Japanese and English

YOUR PHOTOS
The photos being judged, the text of your category rules, the shot date, and whether each photo is a screenshot are sent through our server to an external AI service. The app asks for your permission before sending.

REQUIREMENTS
iPhone with iOS 26 or later.

Tickets are in-app purchases (consumable). Prices are shown on the purchase screen.

name: Dipwick: Car Care Log
description:
Your car asks for attention in small ways: an oil change that slipped, tires that never got rotated, a registration tag that expires next week. Dipwick keeps all of it in one calm logbook and speaks up before anything is late.

JUST SAY WHAT YOU DID
Type or dictate a sentence such as "oil change 52,300 mi $89 yesterday at Joe's" or "filled 12.4 gal $46". Dipwick works out the type of job, the odometer, the cost, the date and the shop, and fills in the form for you to check. It is read on your phone, not sent anywhere.

SNAP THE RECEIPT
Photograph a receipt or pick one from your library. Text recognition on the device pulls out the total, date, fuel quantity and odometer when they are printed. The photo stays with the entry, on your phone only.

A PLAN THAT FITS YOUR CAR
Pick drivetrain, year and mileage and Dipwick proposes a service plan from a curated table of typical intervals, then adjusts it: older, higher-mileage cars get shorter fluid intervals, turbo engines get shorter oil intervals, hard use is allowed for, and hybrids and electric cars skip what they do not need. If you log the same job a few times, the plan follows your own habit. Every line explains why, lists its sources, and reminds you to check your owner's manual, which always wins.

DUE BY DATE AND BY MILEAGE
Each service line has a dipstick gauge that fills as the interval is used up. Dipwick learns how far you drive each month, so a mileage deadline becomes a calendar date, and reminders arrive on the day it is due and a week before.

FUEL ECONOMY, COST PER MILE, FORECAST
Fill-ups give you miles per gallon or litres per 100 km, spending by month, and cost per mile or kilometre. The cost outlook adds up planned services, fuel at your usual rate and an allowance for surprises, so next year's bill is no surprise.

SEVERAL VEHICLES, ONE APP
Cars, trucks, hybrids and electric vehicles, each with its own colour, units and history. On iPad the garage opens up into a full workspace with a sidebar.

YOURS TO KEEP
Export any vehicle to CSV or a tidy PDF service history, handy for selling a car. No account, no server: everything lives on your device.

ADS AND ADS-OFF OPTIONS
Dipwick is free and shows ads. Remove them with an optional monthly subscription, Dipwick Ad-free ($2.99 per month in the US, price varies by country). Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase and renews automatically each month unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID account settings after purchase. You can also watch rewarded videos to earn ad-free time. name: Dolmuş
description:
A dolmuş is Istanbul’s shared minibus: it fills up with strangers, rolls across the city, and lets everyone out at their own stop. Now you decide who sits where.

Everybody on board is headed somewhere different. Some are leaving at Çarşı, some at Hastane, and some are riding all the way to Garaj. You tap a seat for each passenger as they climb on. At each stop, whoever’s leaving walks to the door, and anyone sitting in their way has to stand up. Every stand-up costs you a heart of patience.

So seat the first to leave near the door and the last to leave in the back. Find two seats side by side for passengers with suitcases, and fill the folding seats last. Finish the ride with nobody standing up and you’ll collect all three stars!

A fair puzzle: no timers, no waiting for lives, and Undo is always free. You see who is getting on at the next stop. Lose, and the game shows where the ride slipped away, so you can try again from there.

• Plays offline, no account needed

The game is free and contains ads. There are no ads in the first levels, and no level ever requires an ad or a purchase. No Ads is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. Coin packs are also available in the app.

• Start with two old boats and a borrowed tender
• Earn coins and refit bigger holds and stronger engines
• Buy a longliner for deep-water moonfish and a pot boat for crab
• Upgrade your ice works, repair yard and harbor office
• Earn gold, silver and bronze medals and rise through eight reputation ranks

COMMAND THE WHOLE FLEET
• Tenders collect from your boats at sea so the catch keeps moving
• Choose nets, selective gear, longlines or pots for each ground
• Set a line, send the boat elsewhere, and come back when it has soaked
• Sell fresh to chefs, send older fish to the smokehouse and bulk to the cannery

THE SEA CHANGES THE PLAN
• Real waves, from glassy calm to storm seas, and a full day and night
• Forecast storms close grounds, and tidal streams speed you up or slow you down
• Feeding frenzies triple your catch while they last
• Prices surge and crash, so the best buyer keeps changing

TEN CHAPTERS, FIVE REGIONS, SIX PORTS
Sail from Spratwater Bay through Ribbon Reefs, Windmill Sound, Midnight Shelf and Frostwake Reach in 48 operations, racing your rival Niko on the way to the Grand Tide Festival. When the story ends, the harbor board keeps offering new jobs.

FAIR TO PLAY

Take back your time. Focused is an app blocker and screen time manager that helps you use your iPhone on purpose: block distracting apps, set daily limits, and focus with a Pomodoro timer. Free, no ads, no account.

name: Fodry-Plan & Craft
description:
Card Foundry premieňa plánovanie dielne na svižnú strategickú hru založenú na kartách, ťahoch a premyslenom rozmiestnení.

Rozmiestňujte suroviny, spracovateľské stanice, montážne pracoviská a podporné zariadenia na obmedzenej ploche. Plánujte výrobné recepty, vyvažujte zásoby dreva, kovu, energie a nástrojov a postupne posúvajte materiály výrobným reťazcom, až kým nesplníte objednávky.

Vylepšujte stanice pre vyššiu efektivitu, väčšiu kapacitu, úsporu energie alebo rýchlejšiu výrobu. Presúvajte a otáčajte stroje, prepájajte dopravníky a využívajte bonusy za vhodné susedstvo. Keď začnú dochádzať zdroje, rozhodujte sa medzi konkurenčnými objednávkami.

name: ForkLoad: Forklift Load AR
description:
Why does a 2.5-ton forklift tip forward when lifting a 2.0-ton machine crate?
Standard nameplate capacity only applies at a 500mm load center. Adding a hang-on side-shifter, raising a 3-stage triplex mast, or handling deep pallets on fork extensions rapidly slashes safe lifting capacity.

ForkLoad is a bi-directional industrial safety calculator built on ANSI/ITSDF B56.1 and OSHA 1910.178 front-axle fulcrum moment balance physics.

Key Features:
1. Fork AR Scanner & 4-Zone Safe Load Overlay
- Measure fork blade and extension sleeve length using ARKit 3D raycasting or 2-point photo calibration.
- Instantly overlay color-coded safe load zones (500mm Safe, 700mm Caution, 900mm Extension Warning, Tip Danger) directly onto the fork image and export annotated safety stamp photos.

2. Cargo-to-Forklift Reverse Tonnage & Sleeve Recommender
- Enter or scan cargo depth, width, height, and weight (or estimate weight automatically from 3D volume and material bulk density).
- Automatically computes the true load center (including 62% asymmetric machinery offset), required fork extension sleeve length, and recommends the safest forklift class from 1.5T to 7.0T.

3. Digital Data Plate Matrix & Fleet Inspection Ledger
- View full Load Center (500 to 1200mm) by Mast Height (3.0m to 7.0m) derating tables and log site safety inspections across your forklift fleet.

ForkLoad Pro Subscription:
- Unlock unlimited AR scans, stamped photo exports, and unlimited fleet profiles with Yearly Pro or Monthly Pro.
