name: Fyrune Forge
description:
Ziri, a friendly fire imp with one spiral horn and one cracked horn, tends a forge that only wakes when the right rune meets the right socket. A four-sided Rune Wheel stands at the centre. Fire, Water, Leaf, and Moon must face the orbs drifting in from every side.

Swipe the wheel, or use the left and right forge controls, and seat each rune before it strikes the anvil. True matches raise the score, the combo, and the forge heat. A cold forge makes the next orbs rush. Hearts guard the firebox, and the level ends if they break or the timer runs out.

Thirty levels climb through Copper Hearth, Moss Furnace, Moonlit Anvil, Crystal Crucible, and the Eternal Forge. Golden runes fit any socket. Frozen runes lock a turn. Twin runes demand two seats in a row. Cracked runes burn on a short fuse. Pulse runes charge Forge Pulse, a three-second hold that must be spent with care.

Choose Spark, Flare, or Inferno. Keep stars, rune fragments, and achievements in the Forge Journal. Fyrune Forge is original, offline, and ready whenever the hammer is.

name: Galeboard
description:
Fictional continent. This is not real weather and not a forecast.

Galeboard puts you on duty at the chart desk of Aunder, a continent that exists only in this game. Each game day is one shift: a synoptic chart in the morning, your prognosis by midday, the verdict when tomorrow’s chart comes in. Here is a week of it.

Monday’s chart
The 00 h chart is waiting: lows and highs with their central pressure, isobars every 4 hPa, warm fronts with red half-discs, cold fronts with blue triangles, purple occlusions, the steering arrows and a pale ghost of yesterday’s centres. You see where every system was and where the flow is taking it. A small tag at the west edge tells you what arrives tomorrow.

Midweek, at the prognosis board
Drag each centre to where it will be in 24 hours. Pull the end of a cold front forward — it runs a quarter faster than its low — and watch it close on the warm front until the two occlude. Deepen a fronted low, fill an occluded one, slow anything near the Greyspine ridge. From your chart the desk suggests the weather at eight stations; you can change any cell: wind on an eight-point compass, force from calm to gale, none, showers, rain or snow.

Friday’s verdict
Issue the sheet and the next chart is laid over yours. Every cell is scored — direction, force, precipitation — and the day gets a skill percentage and up to three pennants. Days are fixed, not random: the model behind them is small, deterministic and written out in the Forecaster’s primer, so every one of the 84 days can be read to a perfect score.

The seasons
Spring teaches isobar spacing and Buys Ballot’s law. Summer adds showers along cold fronts. Autumn brings fast cyclones and occlusions. Winter brings snow where the air mass is cold enough and a ridge that holds systems back. Four seasons of 21 days, each day opening when the one before is issued.

Coins
You earn coins by issuing forecasts, by the day’s first desk shift and by a full week on duty. Spend them on a steering hint (the 24-hour path of one system), on checking one station’s real wind before you issue, or on chart styles and pen colours. Coins never open days and never change a score. Coin packs are also available as one-time purchases.

Galeboard Pro
One purchase, not a subscription: Summer, Autumn and Winter (63 more days), the Free desk with endless days grown from a seed, and all three chart styles — Classic blank, Night desk and Archive sepia. Spring, the desk shift and every hint are free.

Galeboard has no account, no ads, no analytics and no network connection. It never asks where you are. Units for wind can be Beaufort, knots or metres per second.

name: Gallop Races
description:
Diventa fantino e vivi le corse al galoppo da dentro la pista: entri negli stalli, le porte si aprono e il gruppo parte insieme a te. Da lì in poi il cavallo lo guidi tu.

UNA CORSA VERA, NON UN CLIC
Due redini, sinistra e destra: alzandole chiedi velocità, la differenza tra le due ti sposta in pista. Il fiato cala se spingi troppo presto; la frusta dà uno scatto, ma va usata al momento giusto. Resta alla corda, aspetta il varco, attacca negli ultimi 400 metri.

LE DISTANZE DEL GALOPPO
Corri le distanze vere delle corse in piano:
• 1000 metri, la velocità pura
• 1600 metri, il miglio
• 2400 metri, la distanza classica dei grandi Derby
La partenza arretra con la distanza e il traguardo resta lì, come negli ippodromi veri. I pali dei metri e i parziali ogni 200 metri ti dicono come stai andando.

DUE IPPODROMI
• Valle Regia: la grande pista con le tribune, lo steccato bianco e la siepe interna
• La Pineta: un ippodromo di campagna in erba, tra i pini marittimi

IL TUO FANTINO, LA TUA CASACCA
Scegli il tuo fantino tra 17, ognuno con abilità, riflessi, concentrazione e strategia diversi, e dagli il tuo nome. Indossa le casacche che sblocchi salendo di livello, oppure disegna la tua con colori, motivi e il tuo logo.

LA TUA SCUDERIA
Corri con i cavalli a noleggio, guadagna monete con i piazzamenti e compra il tuo cavallo. Solo i cavalli tuoi si possono allenare per migliorarne velocità e resistenza.

RECORD E SFIDE ONLINE
I tuoi tempi migliori per ogni pista e distanza entrano nelle classifiche online: punta alla top 10. Oppure sfida altri giocatori in una corsa online.

RIGUARDA LA CORSA
All'arrivo c'è il replay: rivedi la volata da ogni angolazione e condividi la tua vittoria.

Il gioco è gratuito. Le gemme, che servono per gli allenamenti, si possono acquistare nel gioco; tutto il resto si guadagna correndo.

name: GéoBioAssist
description:
GéoBioAssist is the fieldwork companion for geobiology practitioners. Record your readings on site, place them on a floor plan and hand your client a clear report, with no internet connection and no account needed.

READINGS
• Hartmann grid, Curry grid, water veins, geological faults, cosmo-telluric chimneys and electromagnetic fields
• Intensity from 1 to 10, notes, photo and GPS position for each reading
• A water vein or a fault is drawn as a line through your points (vein A, vein B…)
• Sort and filter by type, room and level

FLOOR PLANS
• Scan a room with LiDAR (iPhone and iPad with LiDAR): the plan is drawn for you, with walls, doors, windows and dimensions
• Hide a false door (a wardrobe door, for example), straighten the plan, and get the area and perimeter
• Or import an image, a PDF, or a plan exported from Moasure (CSV or DXF)
• Place your readings with a tap, then zoom in and drag them to the exact spot

HARTMANN AND CURRY GRIDS
• Mark a point on a grid line and the app draws the whole network at real scale
• Set the direction of North with a compass, adjust the meshes, or set the spacing from two measured points
• Crossings are marked on the plan; show or hide each grid

GLOBAL PLAN AND LEVELS
• Assemble all the plans of a job on one global plan: each room at its true size, turned and snapped to its neighbours
• Add, move and read your readings right on the global plan
• Floors and basements: one global plan per level. The ground floor networks (Hartmann, Curry, veins, faults, chimneys) carry over to every level, while electromagnetic fields stay specific to each level
• On Mac, the global plan opens in its own window that you can resize freely

REPORTS
• A PDF report per job: client details, summary, readings in detail with photos, the global plan of each level, and each room's plan with numbered readings
• Share or save it in one tap

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
• No account, no server, no tracking
• Optional iCloud sync between your devices, using your own iCloud account
• Export a job as a .geobio file to move it between your iPhone, iPad and Mac, and import it without creating duplicates

FREE, THEN FULL VERSION BY SUBSCRIPTION
• Free: up to 3 jobs, with readings and plans
• Full version by subscription, monthly or yearly: unlimited jobs, PDF reports, LiDAR scanning, global plan and levels, iCloud sync
• 1 month free trial, then the subscription renews automatically until you turn it off in your Apple account settings
• One subscription covers your iPhone, iPad and Mac
• Without a subscription, your jobs stay readable and exportable

description:

Pick the 10 things that make a good day for you: drinking water, moving, reading, sleeping earlier, whatever helps you. Then tick off what you did each day. Every item is worth 10%, so every day scores between 0 and 100%.

Little dots on your home screen, one dot per day. Grey means 0%, deep orange means 100%. See at a glance how much sunshine you've collected over the last months. Also available for the lock screen.

The exercise library includes a demo video and a step-by-step guide for every exercise. Movements are sorted by gym area, so you can find what you need fast, whether you're at the rack, the cables or the pull-up bar.

CALORIE AND PROTEIN TARGETS
Get daily calorie and protein targets calculated from your weight, height, age and goal. Simple numbers that support your training instead of fighting it.

Browse 32 recipes with photos, filtered by diet style such as vegetarian or vegan and by allergies. Good food that fits your plan makes sticking with it easier.

Scuola di pasticceria e arte bianca: corsi e masterclass con i maestri del settore, in due laboratori professionali a Nembro, alle porte di Bergamo, per professionisti e appassionati. Impari a riconoscere un impasto che ha preso forza, una frolla lavorata al punto giusto, una lievitazione che si legge a colpo d'occhio: i gesti del mestiere, quelli che nessun libro riesce a spiegare fino in fondo.

SCEGLI IL TUO PROSSIMO CORSO
• Il calendario completo, con date, maestri e posti ancora disponibili

• Paghi sul checkout sicuro di gsilab.it con carta, Apple Pay, PayPal o bonifico

GSI LAB, IL TUO LABORATORIO IN TASCA

name: Harpwren
description:
Your lever harp, set for any key in seconds.

You choose a key and a mode → Harpwren shows which levers to raise, and which to leave down, on your own strings.
You choose a key your tuning cannot reach → Harpwren shows which note is missing a half step, and the base tuning where it would play.
You choose two keys for a change mid-piece → Harpwren shows the letters to flip and how many levers that is across your range, lowest string first.
You choose your strings, lowest note and base tuning → Harpwren shows the harp on its side, every string with its letter, octave and lever, C and F strings in your colours.
You choose a string and tap Replace → Harpwren shows its material, age and earlier strings, and marks strings older than the threshold you set.
You choose a string that buzzes or sounds off → Harpwren shows it in your regulation notes with a status (ok, check, adjust), ready for the next technician visit.
You choose your tuning → Harpwren shows every key and mode it plays: major, natural minor, Dorian, Mixolydian, Lydian, Phrygian, Locrian, harmonic and melodic minor, and both pentatonics.

What it is not
Harpwren is not a tuner. It never uses the microphone, never records or plays sound, and asks for no permissions. It does not know string lifetimes either: the age thresholds are yours. There is no account and no network use; everything stays on your iPhone.

Free and Pro
Free: one harp from 22 to 40 strings in E-flat or C tuning, the string chart, the key finder for every key and mode, key changes, the list of playable keys, the string log and regulation notes. Nothing is time-limited.
Pro, a one-time purchase: several harps, printing the chart with levers set and the sheet of keys for your tuning (PDF), CSV export of the string log, custom base tunings with per-string exceptions, and set lists that count lever flips between pieces and find the order with the fewest.

name: Heartless Hearts
description:
Heartless Hearts is the classic four-player card game Hearts. Play locally against the computer or create a room and play with friends on phones, tablets and the web. No account is required.

Finish with the lowest score by avoiding hearts and the queen of spades – or try to shoot the moon by taking every point card. Choose from three AI difficulty levels.

Customize the score limit and shoot-the-moon rules. Try the omnibus variant, where the jack of diamonds reduces your score. Choose illustrated cards, adjust the sound and switch between English and Norwegian. Resume an unfinished local game when you return to the app.

Local games against AI work offline. Online games require an internet connection; friends join using a room code. This version contains no advertising or in-app purchases.

name: Hemlio: Tailor Job Tracker
description:
Hemlio is a job notebook for alteration shops, tailors and seamstresses. Keep your paper ticket. Hemlio keeps every alteration findable: what came in, what to do with each garment, the measurements, the money and the pickup.

Know what's due today
See overdue work, jobs due today and garments ready for pickup in one list. Search by name, ticket number, phone or rack.

Quick intake at the counter
Type the customer's name or the paper ticket number, tap the garments that came in (trousers, shirt, dress, coat and more) and choose the pickup date. Phone, rack, quote, deposit and notes are there when you need them. Unfinished entries are kept as a draft.

Every garment, clearly noted
Each piece gets its own instructions and status: Received, In progress, Ready or Picked up. Changed something by mistake? Undo.

Measurements that mean what you wrote
Record whether a value is a total, on the fold or per side, and whether it's a body measurement, a finished size or an alteration change. Enter fractions like 2½. Corrections keep the earlier value and date.

Pickups and balances together
See the quote, deposit, payments and what's still owed. Record a partial pickup when only some garments leave.

Tell customers it's ready
Hemlio prepares a short message with the balance and ticket number. You send it from Messages or WhatsApp. Nothing is sent automatically.

Every customer, remembered
Past and open jobs, notes and dated body measurements. Start a repeat job from an earlier one.

Your records stay on your phone
No account, no ads, works offline. Back up your jobs and photos to a file you keep, export CSV for spreadsheets or share a PDF job summary. Optional App Lock with Face ID or passcode.

Simple monthly subscription
Free for your first 20 jobs, then a monthly subscription unlocks unlimited new jobs. Cancel anytime in your App Store settings. Jobs you've entered always stay editable and exportable.

The subscription renews automatically each month at the price shown in the app until you cancel at least 24 hours before the renewal date. Payment is charged to your Apple Account.

name: HIBI Town
description:
Welcome to HIBI Town, a cozy farming and life game you share with players around the world.

GROW YOUR FARM
Till the soil, plant carrots, pumpkins, strawberries and sunflowers, and harvest them when they're ripe. Your crops keep growing even while you're away.

RAISE ANIMALS AND MAKE THINGS
Build a chicken coop, a cow barn and a pig pen, collect eggs and milk, bake in the bakery and fill orders for coins.

EXPLORE A LIVING TOWN
Travel the world map to the town plaza, the shopping mall, the café, the beach and its bar, the countryside orchard, the old prison museum and the mountain temple.

FISH, GATHER AND COLLECT
Cast a line at the beach, find shells and fruit, and fill your collection book.

DRESS UP AND DECORATE
Hundreds of clothes, hats and decorations. Make your character and your farm your own.

PLAY TOGETHER
Meet other players, chat, wave and dance, add friends, visit and help on each other's farms, trade, join clubs and play cards at the arcade with in-game coins.

A KIND PLACE
Report and block tools, a chat filter and moderators keep the town friendly. No ads, no real-money purchases.

For players aged 13 and over. An internet connection is needed.

name: Hoa Xinh TMS
description:
Hoa Xinh TMS giúp người dùng theo dõi công việc, dự án và lịch họp trên điện thoại.

• Theo dõi công việc được giao và cập nhật tiến độ.
• Xem dự án, thành viên và tài liệu theo quyền truy cập.
• Tra cứu lịch họp và thông báo trong hệ thống.

Ứng dụng yêu cầu tài khoản Hoa Xinh TMS do đơn vị quản lý cung cấp. Các chức năng khả dụng phụ thuộc quyền truy cập của tài khoản và cấu hình hệ thống.

name: Hold That Voice
description:
Hold That Voice gives you a private place to keep the voices you love. Record a bedtime story, a familiar greeting, or a memory told in someone’s own words.

• Use guided prompts to get a conversation started.
• Record with everyone’s consent, then name and save the clip.
• Listen again whenever you like. Your recordings stay on your iPhone.

Start with up to five recordings. A one-time purchase unlocks unlimited recordings, audio export, and an optional app lock using Face ID or your device passcode.

name: Hoopie: Learn Hand Embroidery
description:
Learn hand embroidery one small step at a time, with a coach that actually looks at your stitches.

Hoopie is a friendly embroidery app for total beginners and returning stitchers. Follow a short lesson, stitch along in your own hoop, then snap a photo. Hoopie's AI coach looks closely at your stitches and tells you what's working and exactly what to fix next, like "the stitches on the left curve are longer than the rest".

HOW IT WORKS
• Follow one small step: clear diagrams show where the needle comes up and goes down
• Watch the stitch: animated guides show each needle move, at normal or slow speed
• Snap your hoop: take a photo or choose one from your library
• Get specific feedback: a score, what you did well and 1–2 fixes you can try right away

LEARN THE STITCHES EVERY PROJECT USES
Start with the line stitches every pattern relies on: running stitch, back stitch, stem stitch and split stitch. Then move on to French knots, satin stitch and your first lazy daisy flower. Each lesson takes 10–20 minutes and ends with a small finished piece.

A STITCH LIBRARY YOU'LL KEEP COMING BACK TO
28 hand embroidery stitches, each with an animated step-by-step guide, numbered needle points, the common mistakes and how to fix them:
• Lines: running, back, stem, split, straight, chain, twisted chain, whipped back stitch, couching
• Fills: satin, long and short (thread painting), seed, trellis couching, turkey work
• Knots: French knot, colonial knot, bullion knot, pistil stitch
• Flowers & leaves: lazy daisy, woven wheel rose, ribbed spider wheel, fishbone, fly, fern
• Borders: blanket (buttonhole), cross stitch, herringbone, feather
Search by name or by what you want to make, like "roses" or "leaves".

MADE FOR BEGINNERS
• A personal 4-week stitch plan based on your level, goals and time
• Trace mode: show the pattern full screen and trace it onto your fabric
• Left-handed? Every diagram can be mirrored to match your hand
• Daily reminders and a streak to build a calm, screen-free habit
• My hoops keeps your photos, so you can see how far you've come
• Available in 33 languages

WHAT YOU NEED
A hoop, some cotton fabric, embroidery floss, a needle and a washable pen. New to all of it? Hoopie gives you a simple starter list.

HOOPIE PRO
Free: the first lessons and 3 photo critiques a day.
Pro unlocks every lesson (knots, satin stitch and flowers), up to 50 photo critiques a day and the full animated stitch library.

Hoopie Pro is available as a weekly or yearly auto-renewing subscription. The yearly plan includes a free trial for eligible new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm your purchase, or when the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vSFv1EJWClCh2omr19RBC7PDaFtTsfQ2N8vbvWvb7bRw9rtJvGGwkiFqg59P_wJKQ/pub

Happy stitching!

name: Hop & Spell
description:
Hold to charge, let go to hop. Every block Pip lands on adds a letter to the tower on its head. Spell a word, bank it, and keep hopping. The longer the word, the bigger the score.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Hold anywhere on the screen to charge, release to hop. A longer hold means a longer hop.
• Near blocks carry easy letters, far blocks the rare ones worth more.
• Land dead centre and the letter turns gold for double points. Keep it up for a gold streak.
• When the letters on Pip's head spell a word of 3 to 7 letters, tap Bank. Bank a long one and Pip throws its arms up while the word lights up.
• Miss a block and the run is over, with Pip holding up your best word.
• In Endless and Easy, land on a Jolly and pick any letter you like.

A NEW DAILY EVERY DAY
One course a day, with the same blocks and letters for every player. Play it, then share your result and see how your friends did on exactly the same day.

ENDLESS AND EASY
Play Endless runs whenever you like, as long as you can last. Easy mode adds an aim marker and warns you before a dead end.

DRESS PIP YOUR WAY
Pick Pip's colour, face and extras, from glasses to a moustache. Finish every Daily of a month and Pip earns that month's bow, which can't be bought.

FREE TO PLAY, NO ADS
The Daily, Endless and Easy are free, every day. There are no ads, no accounts and no tracking, and your scores stay on your phone.

HOP & SPELL PLUS (OPTIONAL, ONE PAYMENT)
Plus is a one-time in-app purchase. It unlocks every past Daily to play again, every new one as it passes, and every colour, face and extra for Pip. It never helps a Daily score. No subscription. With Family Sharing, up to five family members can use it too.

name: IDBooth: Passport Photo Maker
description:
IDBooth turns a photo of you into a passport, visa or ID photo that follows the rules, at home, in a minute.

OFFICIAL SIZES
US passport and visa (2x2 in), UK passport, Schengen visa, Canada, Australia, India passport, visa and OCI, popular visas, Indian exam forms and any custom size.

AUTO CROP AND PLAIN BACKGROUND
IDBooth finds your face, sizes your head and eye line to the rules for that document and replaces the background with plain white or light blue. Nudge and zoom if you want, with a live check that tells you when the head size is right.

DIGITAL OR PRINT
Save the exact digital file, compressed to the KB limit online forms ask for, or a 4x6 inch (10x15 cm) sheet with several copies to print at any photo shop.

SIGNATURE TOO
Photograph your signature on white paper and export it at the size and file limit exam forms need.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Face detection and background removal run on your phone. Your photos are never uploaded. No account, no sign-in.

FREE, WITH AN OPTIONAL PRO
IDBooth is free with ads and 3 saves a day. Watch a short video for one more. IDBooth Pro is a one-time purchase that removes ads and limits. No subscription.

Acceptance is decided by the issuing office: check their latest rules for glasses, lighting and expression.

Questions? support@pizazoo.com

name: Inbox Whisper
description:
Inbox Whisper is a simple, professional email app with an AI assistant built in. Connect your Outlook or any IMAP mailbox and let Whisper help you through your inbox.

• Summaries: know what each email is about before you open it
• Smart inbox: important mail first, plus unread and smart views
• AI drafts: replies ready for you to review, edit and send
• Ask: ask about your email in plain words
• Folders: your Outlook folders and subfolders, with favourites
• Alerts: new-mail notifications, plus Telegram alerts and replies
• English and Arabic, with a bigger-text option
• App lock with Face ID

Your privacy: nothing is sent to AI until you agree, and you can withdraw at any time. Your email is never used to train AI models.

Plans: start with a free trial. Personal and Pro plans are auto-renewing subscriptions inside the app.

Terms of Use: https://inboxwhisper.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://inboxwhisper.com/privacy/

name: INSSU
description:
숭실대학교의 다양한 인스타그램 소식을 한곳에, INSSU.

학과 학생회부터 동아리와 소모임까지, 여러 계정을 오가며 찾던 캠퍼스 소식을 모아 확인하세요.

• 나에게 맞는 소식
학과와 관심 단체를 설정해 필요한 소식을 골라 볼 수 있어요.

• 이미지로 훑어보기
게시물 이미지를 넘겨 보며 새로운 공지를 빠르게 확인하세요.

• 일정 한눈에 보기
AI가 게시물 본문에서 정리한 행사·신청·마감 일정을 달력에서 확인하세요.

• 검색과 북마크
궁금한 소식을 검색하고, 다시 보고 싶은 공지는 저장해 두세요.

• 인스타그램 원문 연결
자세한 내용은 원본 게시물에서 바로 확인할 수 있어요.

AI가 정리한 정보에는 오류나 누락이 있을 수 있습니다. 중요한 일정과 신청 조건은 반드시 원본 게시물에서 확인해 주세요. 계정 상태와 수집 주기에 따라 일부 소식이 늦게 반영되거나 누락될 수 있습니다.

INSSU는 숭실대학교 및 Meta·Instagram의 공식 앱이 아닌 독립 서비스입니다.

문의: inssu.support@gmail.com
개인정보처리방침: https://ssumoa.duckdns.org/privacy

name: Iskra: Habit & Goal Tracker
description:
Small steps. Visible progress.

Iskra is a habit and goal tracker built around an honest table. A row of check marks shows the week you kept going; every gap shows exactly where you slipped. Check off your day in one tap, set goals you can measure and watch them move.

THE TABLE
• A week or a whole month on one screen
• Done, not done and no check-in, each with its own mark
• Every day's result as a percentage
• Weekly and monthly habits in their own sections

HABITS YOUR WAY
• Every day, on chosen weekdays, several times a week or once a month
• Reminders at the time you choose, an evening summary and quiet hours
• A note for the day: a few words about how it went
• Streak milestones saved as trophies

GOALS YOU CAN MEASURE
• Weight, savings, books or project stages, each with its own result and percentage
• Milestones at 25, 50 and 75% with dates
• Savings and debt goals: contributions, payments, what's saved and what's left, in any currency
• Link habits to a goal and pin key goals to the Today screen

CALENDAR AND STATISTICS
• Every day of the month with a completion ring
• This week vs last week, this month vs last month, in percentage points
• Today's unfinished day never spoils the comparison

MEET ISKRA
A little fox cheers your check-ins and falls asleep on your schedule. Keep her reactions for big wins only, or turn them off.

IPHONE, IPAD AND APPLE WATCH
• Check off habits right from your wrist
• A Home Screen widget shows your goal and its next step
• English, Russian, German, French and Arabic

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Do I need an account? No. There is no sign-up.
Where is my data stored? On your device. Make a backup or export your history to CSV any time in Settings.
Are there ads? No.

FREE AND PRO
Free: one active goal and up to three active habits, with the table, calendar and statistics.
Iskra Pro: all goals and habits without limits, Health metrics in goals, and the widget and Apple Watch for every goal. Try Pro free for 3 days, with no subscription and no charge.
Iskra Pro is an auto-renewable subscription: 1 month, 6 months or 1 year. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it any time in your Apple Account settings.

ABOUT HEALTH DATA
With your permission, Iskra reads steps, sleep and calories from the Health app, only for the goals you choose. It never writes to Health, and the data stays on your device.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://iskra.my/en/privacy/
Questions or ideas: hello@iskra.my

name: iSpiro
description:
iSpiro is a quiet place to meditate and breathe. Choose a time or a breath, close your eyes, and let gentle bells guide you. No account, no ads, no tracking.

MEDITATION TIMER
• Pick a duration with one tap or set your own
• A short settle-in countdown before you begin
• Seven hand-picked bells for the start, the end and intervals
• Interval bells every few minutes, or at exact times you choose
• Bells keep ringing with the screen locked and the silent switch on, through headphones, Bluetooth or AirPlay

GUIDED BREATHING
• Box breathing (4-4-4-4), 4-7-8 relax and coherent breathing
• Design your own rhythm with up to eight steps
• A glowing orb, soft cue tones and gentle haptics guide every breath
• Practise by minutes or by number of cycles

YOUR JOURNEY
• A practice calendar, current and best streaks
• Weekly, monthly and yearly charts of your minutes
• Gentle reminders on the days and times you choose, plus an optional evening streak nudge
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show your streak
• Optionally save sessions to Apple Health as Mindful Minutes

REFLECTION & JOURNAL
• Rate how you feel before and after each session
• Answer your own reflection questions
• Keep a private journal of what came up
• See how your practice lifts your mood over time

MUSIC FOR YOUR SESSION
• Choose a calm Apple Music playlist or one of your own
• Songs are queued to fill your session, and the music falls away just before the closing bell

STAYS WITH YOU
• Lock Screen and Dynamic Island show your timer with Pause and Music controls
• Seven calming themes, from misty pines to a cosmic sky
• Works on iPhone and iPad, with private iCloud sync between your devices
• Available in English, Spanish and French

FREE AT ITS CORE
Start with 14 days of everything, free, with no sign-up and no payment details. Afterwards, the timer, every bell, all breathing patterns (including your own), streaks, reminders, mood check-ins, your journal and the Live Activity stay free.

iSpiro Premium adds all 7 themes, Apple Music in your sessions, your own reflection questions, mood trends and journal export. Premium is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscription.

• Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase.
• Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.
• Apple Music playback requires an Apple Music subscription.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your sessions, moods and notes stay on your devices and in your own iCloud. We never see them.

iSpiro is a wellness app and does not provide medical advice. Breathing exercises can cause light-headedness; stop if you feel unwell, and talk to your doctor if you have a medical condition.

name: Jarlet: Save Recipes & More
description:
Save the recipes, places, products and posts you find, and find them again when you need them. Jarlet reads what you save on your iPhone or iPad, sorts it, and turns recipes into cards you can cook from.

SAVE FROM ANYWHERE
• Tap Share, then Jarlet, in Safari, Photos and the apps you use every day. Works with links from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and any website.
• Paste a copied link, or add screenshots, photos, PDFs and notes.
• Bring in the screenshots you've already taken, and skip the ones you don't need.
• Saving takes under a second; the reading happens afterwards.

SORTED FOR YOU
• Jarlet works out what each save is: a recipe, place, product, series or film, article, quote or video post, and gives it a title.
• A series or a film becomes a card; a post that lists several, a list to tick off. What shall we watch tonight? picks one.
• Text in screenshots is read on your device, so you can search for it.
• Search finds anything you saved, with or without accents.
• Not sure about a save? "Check these" shows which.
• Group saves into collections, keep favourites close and archive what you're done with.
• Remind me: pick a time and a save comes back to you then. A weekly reminder can bring back one you never opened.
• Widgets keep a pinned note or your latest saves on the Home Screen. Tick off a list right there.
• Saves also turn up in your device's search.
• Smart collections fill themselves: quick recipes, saves you haven't opened, and what you saved from Instagram or TikTok.
• Sort through your saves one at a time: swipe to keep or archive, or get a reminder.
• Ask Siri to add milk to your list or open a recipe. Save your latest screenshot from Control Center or the Action button.

RECIPES, DONE PROPERLY
• Recipes from websites, captions and screenshots become clean cards with ingredients and steps.
• Change the servings and the quantities scale with them.
• Star your favourites: they come first in Recipes, like a cookbook of your own.
• Tick off ingredients as you go, then cook one step at a time with the screen kept on.
• What can I cook tonight? Add what's in your kitchen and see which of your recipes fit, and what's missing.
• Plan the week's menu and get one shopping list, with the amounts added up.
• Cups, ounces and °F in metric with one tap.
• Cook hands-free: a time in a step becomes a timer on the Lock Screen, steps are read aloud, and you say "next" instead of tapping.
• Share a recipe as a tidy picture or as text.
• If the source only had part of a recipe, the card says so. Jarlet never makes up the missing parts.
• The original is always one tap away.

ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
• Sync with iCloud for the same saves on all your devices, in your private iCloud.
• Share a shopping list and tick it off together.
• Tick off your lists on Apple Watch.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• No account, no ads and no analytics.
• Your saves stay on your device, or in your own private iCloud if you turn on sync. They're read with Apple's on-device models on devices with Apple Intelligence, and with built-in rules on every other device.
• Voice commands in cook mode are understood on your device. Nothing is recorded.
• A link's preview comes straight from the site, as in a browser. Nothing goes through us.
• Export everything as JSON, Markdown and images, whenever you like.

JARLET PRO
One purchase, no subscription, and Family Sharing included. Saving, search and sorting stay free and unlimited. Pro adds:
• Unlimited recipe cards (15 are free).
• Importing any number of screenshots at once (50 per import are free).
• Export everything.
• Smart collections and hands-free cooking.
• iCloud sync, shared lists and Jarlet on Apple Watch.

Jarlet needs iOS 26 or iPadOS 26 or later. Features that use Apple's on-device model need a device with Apple Intelligence; everything else works on any device that runs iOS 26 or iPadOS 26. The Apple Watch app needs watchOS 26.

Privacy policy: https://jarlet.app/privacy
Support: hello@jarlet.app

We will carefully read, organize, summarize, and refer to it in future improvements. We cannot promise to make immediate changes every time, but we will do our best to ensure that reasonable suggestions are responded to.

name: Kamelo: Cube Solver & Timer
description:
Kamelo teaches you to solve a puzzle cube by yourself, one step at a time, with a 3D cube you can turn with your finger. Start with the 3x3 or the 2x2, both free.

LEARN THE BEGINNER METHOD
Seven short steps for the 3x3: cross, first layer corners, middle edges, yellow cross, yellow edges, corner position and corner twist. Each step shows the moves on a 3D cube, plays them slowly, and explains them in plain words. Kami, a small chameleon, adds a hint when you need one.

TRY IT, THEN MOVE ON
Every step has a practice cube where only that step is left to do. Solve it on the screen or on your real cube, as many times as you like, until the moves stick.

SOLVE MY CUBE
Stuck with a scrambled cube? Paint its stickers into the app and Kamelo solves it with the same beginner steps you are learning, split into named stages, one move at a time: "Turn the right face clockwise". If two stickers cannot both be right, it tells you which ones to check.

TIMER
Hold, release, solve. Fair random scrambles, optional 15 second inspection with +2 and DNF, best time, ao5 and ao12, and one daily scramble shared by everyone.

KAMELO PRO, ONE PURCHASE
- 4x4 and Pyraminx lessons
- Algorithm trainer: 57 OLL and 21 PLL cases with animation and practice
- Full stats and history chart
One price, yours for good. No subscription, no ads, no account.

Kamelo works offline. Your solves and lesson progress sync through your own iCloud if you turn it on. The 3D cube can also be turned with on-screen move keys, and every step is read by VoiceOver.

Kamelo is not affiliated with any puzzle brand.

name: Keypop Coloring
description:
A calm color puzzle made of soft, squishy keyboard keys.

Every picture in Keypop Coloring starts out jumbled and gray. Tap a key that sits on the wrong color, park it, and pop it into the spot where it belongs. Each key lands with a gentle click, and the picture comes back to life around it.

ELEVEN COZY PLACES TO RESTORE
Start in a little flower field, then wake up a forgotten farm piece by piece. The barn gets its paint back, the orchard blooms, the animals wander out. Then travel on to a seaside harbor, a maple town, a mountain lodge, a blossom garden, a desert oasis, a rainforest, a night carnival, a coral reef and a lake for a swimming day. Every puzzle you solve restores one more part of the scene.

A WINTER TREAT
Holiday Square is open for the season until January 6.

RELAXING, NOT RUSHED
• Over 1,000 puzzles
• No timers and no move limits
• Every puzzle can be solved without help
• A new daily puzzle, with a streak that forgives a missed day
• Satisfying clicky keys with soft sounds and gentle buzzes
• Plays offline

EASY TO LEARN, FUN TO MASTER
• Start with tiny pictures that teach you as you go
• Wide striped keys and pinned keys add a twist as you go deeper
• Stuck? Shift a color home or add extra slots to your keyboard
• See how you did with your taps, your time and your rank

MADE TO FEEL GOOD
Soft colors, cute keys and cozy scenes. Nothing to rush and nothing to lose. Keypop Coloring is for anyone who loves color by number, sorting puzzles, tidy keyboards, or a quiet few minutes to unwind.

Keypop Coloring is free to play, with ads between puzzles, optional reward videos and optional in-app purchases for helpers. No account needed.

Keypop Club is an optional auto-renewing subscription, $4.99 a month or $29.99 a year. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Kibro - Learn & Understand AI
description:
Everyone is talking about AI. Time to find out what you can do with it.

You've chatted with a chatbot. But what makes a good answer? What can AI actually do? And when should you question what it tells you?

Take the next step with Kibro. Learn to understand AI, use it with purpose, and assess its results critically. Clear lessons, hands-on exercises, and prompts you can copy help you move from trying AI to using it with confidence.

YOUR STARTING POINT FOR AI
No technical background needed. Learn the basics, make sense of key terms, and discover what AI could help you do.

BETTER PROMPTS. MORE FROM YOUR IDEAS.
Good results start with clear instructions. Practice adding useful context and shaping your requests. Copy example prompts and try them in an AI tool of your choice.

A LEARNING PATH THAT TAKES YOU FURTHER
Stop jumping from one random AI tip to the next. Pick a topic and work through connected lessons, one step at a time.

TURN AHA MOMENTS INTO KNOWLEDGE
Check your understanding with short knowledge checks and exercises. Spot gaps and build a stronger foundation for your next step.

SEE HOW FAR YOU'VE COME
Earn XP for completed lessons and reach new learning levels. See your progress and keep going.

MAKE SENSE OF THE JARGON
Find clear explanations of key AI terms in the glossary. Look something up and get straight back to learning.

AI keeps evolving. Your knowledge can too.

Get Kibro. Understand what's possible. Discover what you can do with it.

One complete lesson is free. Full access requires an auto-renewing monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time Lifetime purchase. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings.

Additional terms: https://www.giminger.com/kibro/nutzungsbedingungen.html

description: Kiertomittari on kiertomittareiden mitoituslaskin. Se laskee mittausalueen ja tarkkuuden, anturin pulssit, nayton pavivitystaajuuden, kalibrointivirheen, tietomuistin seka kotelon suojausluokan. Kuusi moduulia, esiasetukset ja viitetaulu. Toimii ilman verkkoyhteytta.

name: KPSS Atama & Tercih Robotu
description:
KPSS ile Sağlık Bakanlığı atamalarına tercih yapacaksan, Tercih Robotu tercih döneminden önce nereye yerleşebileceğini görmeni sağlar.

PUANININ YERİNİ GÖR
• Puanını ÖSYM sonuç belgenle doğrula, mesleğindeki doğrulanmış adaylar arasında kaçıncı olduğunu canlı takip et.
• Meslektaşlarının puan yığılmasını grafikte gör.

TERCİH SİMÜLASYONU
• 30 tercihlik listeni oluştur, sürükleyerek sırala.
• Belgesi doğrulanmış adayların listeleriyle düzenli aralıklarla gerçek yerleştirme kuralına göre simülasyon çalışır; hangi tercihine yerleştiğini gör.
• Gerçek ölçekte tahmin: bütün adaylar tercih yapmış gibi yerleşme ihtimalini hesaplar.

KADRO VE TABAN PUANLARI
• Ön lisans, lisans ve ortaöğretim düzeyinde tüm Sağlık Bakanlığı kadroları.
• Her kadronun 10 döneme uzanan taban–tavan geçmişi ve yeni dönem taban tahmini.
• Kurumu haritada aç, il il kontenjanları karşılaştır.

CANLI TERCİH HARİTASI
• Meslektaşlarının hangi illere yığıldığını, il il rekabeti ve puanının yettiği kontenjanları haritada gör.

MESLEKTAŞ SOHBETİ
• Kendi mesleğinin odasında meslektaşlarınla konuş; doğrulanmış adayların puanı adının yanında görünür.

TERCİH ROBOTU PRO
Gerçek ölçekte tahmin, taban puan tahmini, kadro rekabeti, canlı harita ölçüleri ve puan yığılması Pro ile açılır. İlk 3 gün ücretsizdir; sonra aylık ücretlendirilir. Abonelik, dönem bitmeden en az 24 saat önce iptal edilmezse otomatik yenilenir. Ayarlar > Apple Kimliği > Abonelikler'den yönetebilirsin.

Puan doğrulama, tercih listesi, simülasyon sonucu, kadrolar ve sohbet her zaman ücretsizdir.

Tercih Robotu resmî bir ÖSYM ya da T.C. Sağlık Bakanlığı uygulaması değildir. Veriler ÖSYM'nin yayımladığı kılavuz ve yerleştirme sonuçlarından derlenir; simülasyon sonuçları tahmindir, atama garantisi değildir.

name: Learn AI Hacking: Botfoolery
description:
Ever wondered how people get AI chatbots to spill secrets or break their own rules? Botfoolery teaches you AI red teaming: testing AI systems on purpose, with permission, so their weak spots can be fixed.

No coding needed to start. Nibs, a cheerful (and slightly gullible) robot, walks you along a road map of short lessons, each one a few minutes long.

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN • What AI hacking really means, and the golden rule of only testing what you're allowed to • How a chatbot reads your messages • Prompt injection and leaking hidden system prompts • Disguises, filter dodges, role-play and jailbreaks • Hidden instructions and poisoned data • Fooling a model's eyes, copycats and memory leaks • Why AI agents with too much power are risky • The OWASP Top 10 for LLM apps, and how to write your first finding report

PRACTISE IN THE VAULT Try what you learn on safe, built-in practice bots: The Trusting Bot, The Word Filter, The Output Guard, The Stubborn Bot and The Review Summariser. Each one guards a secret. Can you get it out?

MADE FOR LEARNING • Works completely offline. No account, no sign-up, no tracking. • Your progress is saved on your device. • Friendly, plain-English explanations for curious beginners, students and anyone starting in cybersecurity.

FREE TO START Base Camp and Prompt Alley (the first 6 stops) and the first 4 Vault levels are free. Unlock the full road map, all 16 stops and every Vault level, with a single one-time purchase. No subscription.

Botfoolery is for education. Always follow the law and only test systems you own or have permission to test.

name: Learn English – America Easy
description:
America Easy (أمريكا سهلة) teaches Arabic speakers the American English they need in real life. The whole app — menus, explanations and word meanings — is in Arabic.

Made for Arabs living in the US, and for those getting ready to move there for work, study or to join family.

• 57 lessons in 8 levels, on a road trip across America from New York to Los Angeles.
• Real-life situations: renting an apartment, the bank, the DMV and your driver's license, jobs and job interviews, your kids' school, the doctor and pharmacy, government offices, money and bills.
• Spell your name, email and address in English: "How do you spell that?"
• Every word has a picture, clear American audio, the Arabic meaning, and a pronunciation hint written in Arabic letters.
• Tips for the sounds Arabic speakers find hard: P, V, TH and CH.
• Short dialogues, quizzes, listening games and a Word Bank for review.
• Sahl, your travel buddy, plus Kids Mode and background music you can choose.

This app teaches the English language only. It is not legal, tax or financial advice.

Privacy: no account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress stays on your device.

Level 1 is free, plus two preview lessons from later levels. The Pro subscription unlocks all levels and games (monthly or yearly, with a free trial for new subscribers). Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage them in your account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://amaroki2004-code.github.io/america-easy-arabic-privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Lectio: Catholic Bible
description:
Lectio is a Catholic Bible made for reading and prayer. All seventy-three books, eight translations, Bishop Challoner's notes, and Gustave Doré's engravings, beautifully set and fully offline.

EIGHT CATHOLIC BIBLES
• Douay-Rheims, Challoner revision, with Bishop Challoner's notes
• Douay-Rheims, 1899 American Edition
• World English Bible, Catholic Edition
• Catholic Public Domain Version
• World English Bible, British Edition
• American Standard Version
• Clementine Vulgate (Latin, 1598), with the Glossa Ordinaria
• Hetzenauer Vulgate (Latin, 1914)
Switch from the version button and you stay on the same verse, even across the different numbering of the Psalms.

A READER WORTHY OF SCRIPTURE
Continuous scrolling through each book, one verse to a line as the Douay-Rheims was printed, justified type, and light, sepia, and dark themes. Choose from four typefaces and set the size and spacing you like.

DORÉ'S BIBLE ENGRAVINGS
237 of Gustave Doré's famous engravings, from the Creation to the New Jerusalem, each set beside the verse it shows. Tap one to see it full screen and zoom into the detail.

SELECT, HIGHLIGHT, AND NOTE
Tap a verse number to select a verse. Touch and hold a word and drag to select exactly the words you want, or hold at the edge of the page to select whole lines. Highlight in six colors, write notes, bookmark, copy, share, and compare a passage across every translation. Your highlights and notes follow you into every version.

EVERY WORD EXPLAINED
Touch and hold any word for its meaning: Lectio's glossary of Douay-Rheims words (Pasch, azymes, Paralipomenon), a complete English dictionary, and the World English Bible glossary. Challoner's notes and the translators' footnotes are a tap away.

READ THE WHOLE BIBLE
Five reading plans: the Bible in a year, the Old and New Testaments together, the Bible in two years, the New Testament in 90 days, and the Gospels in 40 days. Each day takes about the same time to read. Lectio notices when you finish a chapter, keeps your streak, and shows how much of the Bible you've read.

YOUR DAY IN THE CHURCH
The home screen shows the liturgical season and day, a verse for the day, and where you left off. Widgets bring the verse of the day, your place, and today's reading to your Home Screen and Lock Screen.

LECTIO PRO: A STUDY COMPANION
Subscribe to Lectio Pro to ask anything about Scripture and the Faith. Answers are written on your iPhone from the Bible, Challoner's notes, the Church Fathers, the Catechism of the Council of Trent, the Catholic Encyclopedia, and other public-domain Catholic works, with tappable references. Explain any passage, see what a word means in its verse (including the Latin of the Vulgate), and reflect on the daily verse. Subscribers can also choose a gold-cross app icon.
The study assistant runs entirely on your device. Nothing you ask is sent anywhere. It needs an iPhone or iPad that supports Apple Intelligence. Like any assistant it can make mistakes, so weigh its answers against Scripture and the teaching of the Church.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your reading, highlights, and notes stay on your device.

Everything except the study assistant is free.

Lectio Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, billed monthly or yearly through your Apple Account. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it any time in Lectio's Settings or in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.squishedpixels.com/lectio/privacy-policy-lectio

name: Life Timelapse: Photo a Day
description:
Some changes are too slow to see: a plant reaching for the light, a garden through the seasons, a room taking shape, your own face over a year. Life Timelapse helps you capture them one photo at a time, then turns those photos into a time-lapse video.

PHOTOGRAPH THE SAME SCENE, AGAIN AND AGAIN
• Create a project for anything that changes, and shoot it every day or every week.
• The camera feels like the iPhone camera you know: lenses, zoom, focus and exposure, timer, grid and level.
• The camera opens on the same lens and zoom you used last time.

LINE UP EVERY SHOT
• A see-through overlay of your previous photo sits over the viewfinder, so each shot matches the last.
• Switch the overlay to your baseline photo, adjust its opacity, or turn it into a black-and-white silhouette that is easy to line up with.

NEVER MISS A DAY
• Set up to five reminders per project, at the times and on the days you choose.
• Once today's photo is taken, that day's remaining reminders stay quiet.
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show your streak and whether today's photo is done.

A SMOOTH TIME-LAPSE IN ONE TAP
• Auto-align steadies small shifts between photos.
• Deflicker evens out jumps in brightness and color.
• Choose 1 to 30 photos per second and see the video length as you go.
• Pick a date range, add a date stamp, and hold the first and last photo for a moment.
• Save to Photos or share as an MP4.

YOUR PHOTOS STAY YOURS
• Photos are stored on your iPhone and never uploaded to our servers. There is no account and no tracking.
• Your original photos are never changed. Alignment and deflicker happen only in the exported video, so you can export again with different settings at any time.
• Browse and export every photo at any time, whether or not you buy the full version.

FREE TO START, ONE-TIME UNLOCK
Life Timelapse is free with one project, with every capture, reminder and overlay feature included. A one-time purchase of the full version adds:
• Unlimited projects
• 4K export and HEVC
• No Life Timelapse watermark on exported videos
No subscription. Restore your purchase for free on a new iPhone.

Available in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean.

name: Likab
description:
Likab — продукты напрямую от производителей Дагестана: мёд, рыба, баранина и другое мясо, сыр и молочное, фрукты, орехи, урбеч, саженцы и многое другое. Без перекупщиков.

СМОТРИТЕ, КАК ЭТО ДЕЛАЮТ
• Видео с хозяйства у товаров: пасека, пруд, пастбище — как есть
• Истории и посты производителей. Подпишитесь — их новое увидите первыми
• Отметка «Проверенный производитель» у тех, чьё хозяйство мы проверили

РЕЙСЫ И «СКИНЕМСЯ»
• Производитель едет в город — закажите заранее, он привезёт попутно
• Тушу или большую партию берите долями с соседями — выходит дешевле

НАПРЯМУЮ
• Звоните или пишите в WhatsApp и Telegram прямо из карточки
• Цену, количество и встречу обсуждаете сами
• Отзывы оставляют только те, кто действительно связывался с производителем

ПРОДАВАЙТЕ СВОЁ
• Снимите видео до минуты, укажите цену и место — после проверки модератором объявление появится в ленте
• Помощник подскажет название и описание
• Рейсы и сборы помогают продать больше за одну поездку

Уведомления подскажут, когда заказ подтвердили, сбор заполнился или производитель выложил новое.

Оплата — напрямую производителю при встрече или переводом. Likab не берёт комиссию с покупателей.

name: LingoStep - 総合英語学習
description:
「英語を、毎日の習慣に。」

LingoStep（リンゴステップ）は、英単語・英文法・リスニング・リーディングを1日5分からステップ形式で学べる総合英語学習アプリです。
入門（Pre-A1）から中級（B1）まで、自分のレベルに合わせたカリキュラムで無理なく基礎から着実にステップアップできます。

【LingoStepの特徴】
◆ 4技能を網羅した段階的カリキュラム
・英単語：例文・発音音声・記憶フラグ付きの単語カード & クイズ
・英文法：わかりやすい日本語解説、穴埋め・語順並び替え問題
・リスニング：ナチュラルな英語音声の聞き取りと内容理解
・リーディング：レベル別の短文・長文読解と設問演習

◆ 忘却曲線に基づく復習システム
間違えた問題や苦手な単語は、最適な間隔（翌日・3日後・7日後・14日後・30日後）で自動的に復習一覧へピックアップ。忘れる前に定着させます。

◆ 続けたくなる学習記録・分析
連続学習日数や毎日の学習時間を自動集計。週・月ごとの達成度をグラフで可視化し、日々のモチベーションをサポートします。

◆ アカウント登録不要・オフライン対応
面倒な会員登録やログインは一切不要。すべての学習進捗はお手元の端末内に安全に保存され、通信環境を気にせずいつでもどこでも学べます。

【こんな方におすすめ】
・中学英語や基礎からやり直したい
・英単語と文法をセットで効率よく学びたい
・リスニングの基礎力をつけたい
・スキマ時間で英語学習を習慣化したい

name: Linkak — Digital Business Card
description:
Linkak turns your business card into a live page: your name, photo, ways to reach you and all your links, in one link.

Share it any way
• A QR code any phone can scan, no app needed.
• Add it to Apple Wallet, ready on your lock screen.
• Write it to an NFC sticker or card: one tap opens it.
• Send it on WhatsApp or any app.

Keep other people's cards
• Scan a Linkak card and swap cards in one tap.
• Add any paper card to your contacts, in the same place.
• Expo mode: every card you scan is tagged with the event for follow-up.

Design it on your phone
• Templates, header shapes, wallpapers, fonts and buttons.
• See your real page change with every tap.
• A card in two languages, Arabic and English.

A shop with no commission
• Show your products with price, photos and description; each product has its own link to share.
• Customers pick items and send you the order on WhatsApp with the total. No commission on sales.

Your card on your phone's screens
• A widget with your card's QR on the Home Screen, Lock Screen and in StandBy.
• A "Show my card" button in Control Center or on the Action button.
• Live expo mode: a Lock Screen counter of who visited, saved and contacted you.

See who looked
• Views, clicks and Wallet adds.
• A "Message me" form that sends you visitors' messages, with an instant notification.

Linkak Pro (optional subscription)
Full branding with your colours and fonts, detailed stats, every contact from your page, unlimited products, and no Linkak badge.
The subscription renews automatically at the same price until you cancel in your App Store account settings, at least 24 hours before the period ends.

Privacy Policy: https://linkak.app/privacy

name: Little Joy Arcade
description:
Little Joy Arcade is made for iPhone Duo: grab plush animals with your own claw machines, fill your Sticker Book and grow a cozy arcade full of happy customers.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
• Unfolded, the claw machine stands on the top screen and your controls sit below it, right under the claw.
• Every prize you win drops through the hinge into your tray.
• Fold or unfold mid-game: the arcade rearranges itself and nothing is lost.
• Also plays on any iPhone and on iPad.

HOW TO PLAY
• Slide the rail to move the claw, watch for the glowing ring, then press GRAB.
• When the ring glows, you catch the prize. A caught prize is never dropped.
• Every play is free: no timers, no lives, no energy.
• Spend coins to level up a machine (a wider claw and more coins) or to build the next one.
• Customers play your machines too. Tap a coin box to collect what they paid.

THE PRIZE HALL (FREE)
• Five claw machines, each with its own twist: Farm, Meadow, Safari, Jungle and Snow.
• 30 plush animals to collect, from a chick to a narwhal, plus shiny gold versions.
• A Sticker Book with a page for every machine.
• Ten levels per machine, with stars to earn along the way.

THE PLUSH SHELF
• Build every machine you own and a shelf of 12 giant plushies opens, from Honey Bear to the Grand Chick.
• Buy them one by one with your coins. They wiggle and squeak when you tap them.
• A Plush Shelf page in your Sticker Book shows the ones still to come.

LITTLE JOY PLUS: ONE-TIME UNLOCK
• Opens the Arcade Row, a glowing second room next door to the Prize Hall.
• Five more games: Hay Loft, Bunny Bounce, Bubble Pond, Pup Parade and Seal Hoops.
• 15 ribbons to win and an Arcade page in your Sticker Book.
• One payment, shared with your family through Family Sharing.
• Plus never sells coins, levels or skips, and the purchase sits behind a grown-up check.

FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
• Big buttons, very few words and cheerful arcade sounds.
• Short sessions that fit a spare minute, or a long cozy afternoon.

No ads. No account. No tracking. Nothing leaves your device.

name: Live Minutes: Meeting Notes
description:
Live Minutes records your meeting and transcribes it as people talk. Add two to four attendees and it tells the speakers apart. After the meeting, tap Write up minutes to pull out a table of contents and candidate decisions and action items. Tick the ones that are right to confirm them. All of it runs on your iPhone.

NO TIME LIMIT
Nothing goes to a server, so there is no limit on how long a meeting runs. Record a three-hour workshop or a full lecture. The only limit is the storage space on your iPhone. Choose lossless recording (about 80 MB per hour) or compressed (about 14 MB per hour).

NO WAITING FOR THE TRANSCRIPT
Words appear on screen as they are spoken. There is no upload and no queue, so the transcript is ready when you stop. Take notes while you record, and record more in the same meeting later.

WHO SAID WHAT
Add two to four attendees, and the speakers are told apart automatically. Pick an attendee on a speaker label to name that speaker in every paragraph. Tap a paragraph to play the recording from that point.

MINUTES YOU CONFIRM
After the meeting, tap Write up minutes. The app reads the transcript and lists the contents of the meeting, with candidate decisions and action items. Only the candidates you tick become decisions and action items, and you can edit their wording. Name the speakers first, and the minutes use their names.

Minutes are written on your iPhone, so a long meeting takes a while. If you leave the app before it finishes, put your iPhone on the charger. iOS usually finishes it later while the iPhone is idle, often overnight.

NO SERVER, NO ACCOUNT
Live Minutes doesn't send your audio, transcripts or minutes to a server. There is no account, no ads and no analytics.

PRICE
- Free to download.
- Recording, transcription and telling speakers apart are free, with no limit.
- Minutes are free for 3 meetings.
- A one-time Lifetime purchase removes the limit. It is not a subscription. To restore it on another iPhone or after reinstalling, open Settings in the app and tap Restore Purchases.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Writing up minutes needs a one-time download of an AI model, up to about 3.7 GB depending on your iPhone. It downloads over Wi-Fi unless you change that in Settings. You can record and transcribe while it downloads. On an iPhone with Apple Intelligence, you can write up minutes with Apple Intelligence instead, with nothing to download.
- The first time you transcribe a language that isn't on your iPhone yet, iOS downloads it once.
- Writing up minutes needs an iPhone with at least 4 GB of memory.
- Speakers are told apart automatically only in meetings of up to four attendees.
- Telling speakers apart downloads a small model (about 22 MB) the first time.
- Transcription can miss words, especially technical terms and people talking over each other. Check the candidates before you tick them.

name: Locuspect
description:
Locuspect er et feltverktøy for systematiske observasjoner av offentlige byrom.

Opprett egne feltprosjekter og registrer lysforhold, temperatur, luftfuktighet, lufttrykk, stedskontekst og andre observasjoner fra området. Tydelige tidslinjer og trenddiagrammer gjør det enkelt å følge utviklingen i dataene, mens romlige visninger hjelper deg med å organisere områder, ruter og observasjonspunkter.

Locuspect passer til undersøkelser av parker, gater, møteplasser, skoleområder, nabolag og arkitektoniske miljøer. Appen samler hele arbeidsflyten – fra den første observasjonen til sammenligning, analyse og rapportering.

Viktige funksjoner:
- Opprett og organiser feltprosjekter
- Registrer lys, temperatur, luftfuktighet og lufttrykk
- Legg til strukturerte miljø- og stedsobservasjoner
- Utforsk utviklingen gjennom visuelle trenddiagrammer
- Filtrer registreringer etter dato, prosjekt og datatype
- Sammenlign resultater fra ulike tidsperioder
- Organiser områder, ruter og observasjonspunkter
- Se prosjektoversikter og lag strukturerte rapporter
- Oppdag nye detaljer gjennom utforskingsoppgaver
- Bruk eksempeldata til å utforske hele arbeidsflyten
Locuspect gjør hver byvandring til en strukturert feltundersøkelse og bygger et tydelig arkiv over hvordan offentlige rom oppleves og endrer seg over tid.

name: Lorbeer – Recipes & Cookbook
description:
Lorbeer turns recipe links into clean recipes – no ads, no life story, no pop-ups. Share a link and Lorbeer sorts out ingredients, steps and times. At the stove, cook mode walks you through it step by step. With Lorbeer Pro, videos, photos and copied text become recipes too.

RECIPES FROM ANYWHERE, IN ONE PLACE
– Paste a link or share it straight from Safari and other apps. Sites that publish recipe data – which most do – are imported for free. For sites without recipe data, the AI reads the page (Lorbeer Pro).
– Videos and posts from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Pinterest become recipes (Lorbeer Pro).
– Snap a cookbook page or grandma's handwritten recipe card, up to four pages at once (Lorbeer Pro).
– Paste text from a chat, a note or an email: the AI sorts out ingredients and steps (Lorbeer Pro).
– You review everything before it is saved. Nothing lands in your collection without your say.

EVERY RECIPE IN THE SAME CLEAN FORMAT
– Change the servings and every quantity scales, sensibly rounded.
– Consistent units: tablespoon, tbsp and EL all become tbsp.
– The original line of every ingredient is kept.
– Everything is editable: title, ingredients, steps, times.

ONE STEP, ONE GLANCE
– One step per screen, large text and exactly the ingredients you need right now.
– Timers at a tap that keep running in the background and let you know when it is time.
– The screen stays on, even with dough on your fingers.
– With every step, a laurel branch grows.

YOUR COLLECTION, BEAUTIFULLY SORTED
– Folders and favourites, organised the way your kitchen works.
– Search by title and ingredient: spinach left in the fridge? Lorbeer finds every recipe with it.
– Send ingredients to the Bring! shopping list app with one tap.
– The same collection on your iPhone and in the browser.

WEEK PLANNED, SHOPPING DONE (Lorbeer Pro)
– Put dishes on the days of the week and set the servings.
– The week's shopping: every ingredient scaled and combined.
– Household: invite one more person – a shared collection, a shared plan, no second subscription.

INDEPENDENT, AD-FREE, BUILT WITH YOU
Lorbeer is an independent project. No ads, no tracking across other apps and websites – your recipes belong to you. What comes next is shaped by the community: on the public roadmap you suggest features and vote.

LORBEER FREE AND LORBEER PRO
Lorbeer is free to use: link import from recipe sites with recipe data, collection, search, cook mode, editing and Bring!, without limits. New accounts get Lorbeer Pro free for 30 days, no payment details needed. Lorbeer Pro unlocks AI imports from videos, photos and text, AI import from sites without recipe data, cover images for recipes without a photo, the meal plan and the household – and funds the further development of Lorbeer.

Lorbeer Pro is a yearly subscription. You choose the amount from three tiers; the features are the same at every amount. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically for another year unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://lorbeer-recipes.com/en/datenschutz

Lorbeer is independent and not affiliated with the platforms and services mentioned.

name: Lyewise: Soap Calculator
description:
Lyewise is a soap calculator built for makers who sell what they make. Calculate lye and water with confidence, let the Optimizer design a recipe from the oils on your shelf, print ingredient labels with INCI names, and track every batch from mixing bowl to market table.

LYE CALCULATOR (FREE)
• 140+ oils, butters and waxes with reference SAP values and fatty acid profiles
• NaOH for bars, KOH for liquid soap, or dual lye
• Superfat, lye purity and three water methods: % of oils, lye concentration or water:lye ratio
• Fragrance by % or ounces per pound, citric acid compensation and additives
• Enter oils by percent or by weight, in grams, ounces or pounds
• Hardness, cleansing, conditioning, bubbly, creamy, iodine and INS with recommended ranges
• Fatty acid chart and plain-language warnings
• Size a recipe to your mold
• Starter recipes: castile, bastille, palm-free, salt bar and more

RECIPE OPTIMIZER (PRO)
Pick the oils you have, set limits like "coconut at most 30%", and choose a goal: balanced, gentle, big lather or hard and long-lasting. Lyewise finds the percentages that hit the target and can pick the cheapest blend using your supply prices.

INGREDIENT LABELS (PRO)
Generate ingredient lists in descending order by weight: INCI before saponification, saponified INCI (sodium olivate, sodium cocoate…) or plain English. Add your shop name, net weight and lot number, then export a printable PDF.

BATCHES & CURE TRACKING
• Make a batch from any recipe with an automatic lot number
• Step-by-step make mode with exact weights
• Cure countdown and a reminder when bars are ready
• Photos, notes and ratings for every batch

SUPPLIES & COST PER BAR (PRO)
Track stock and prices for oils, lye, fragrance and packaging. Each batch shows its cost per bar, and making a batch takes ingredients out of stock.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your recipes stay on your iPhone.

SAFETY
Lye is caustic. Lyewise calculates from reference data; always double-check a recipe before you make it. Labeling rules differ by country.

Lyewise Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription (the yearly plan includes a free trial) or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period.

Turn real objects into detailed, textured 3D models — and print them. MeshMint uses Apple's Object Capture technology to reconstruct true-to-scale 3D models right on your iPhone or iPad, then exports them ready for your 3D printer or favorite 3D software.

NO SUBSCRIPTION. EVER.
Most 3D scanning apps charge every month. MeshMint doesn't. Try every feature free for 7 days, then unlock MeshMint forever with a single one-time purchase of $5.99. Unlimited scans, unlimited exports, all future updates included.

BUILT FOR 3D PRINTING
• Export directly to Bambu Studio 3MF — the model opens already centered on the build plate of your A1 mini, A1, P1P, P1S, P2S, X1 Carbon, X1E, H2S or H2D

PROFESSIONAL 3D MODELS
• Detailed geometry with high-resolution photo textures

Your music collection deserves a player that puts you in control.

Mixtape plays the audio files you own on your iPhone, iPad, or compatible Sonos speakers. Import songs and folders through Files, organize playlists, and choose where you listen.

YOUR FILES, TOGETHER Add music from your device, iCloud Drive, or other providers available in Files. Copy tracks into your library for offline listening, or keep them in their original location. Keep a diary worth revisiting

name: My LAN – Home Network
description:
My LAN brings your home network and your Home app together. It finds everything connected to your Wi-Fi, matches it with your HomeKit accessories, and shows your home room by room: what's online, how warm it is, which lights are on, and what needs a look.

MADE FOR HOMEKIT
• Connect HomeKit and My LAN links each device on the network to its accessory, so it gets the name and room you gave it in the Home app.
• Rooms stay in sync both ways: move a device to another room in My LAN and it moves in Home too.
• Accessories behind a bridge, like lights, sensors and valves, appear in their rooms even though they aren't on Wi-Fi themselves.
• Tap the HomeKit badge on a device to control it: a TV's remote, a camera's live view, or the switches and readings of anything else.

HOME PAGES (MY LAN PRO)
• Climate: every room's temperature on one comfort ring, with a dial to set the target and the mode.
• Lights: every light in its own color, with brightness, room by room.
• Appliances: outlets, switches, fans, purifiers and garden watering, with countdowns and run times.
• Cameras: every HomeKit camera live, in one place.
• TV: a remote for your HomeKit TVs.

KNOW EVERY DEVICE ON YOUR NETWORK
• My LAN finds every phone, computer, TV, speaker, camera, printer and smart plug, names it from what it announces, and recognizes the maker.
• Sort each device as Mine or a Visitor's with a swipe. Anything that joins later shows up under New, so a strange device never goes unnoticed.
• Give devices your own names and icons, put them in rooms, add tags, and see when each one was online.
• Network Health times your router, the internet and DNS.

KEEP IT SAFE (MY LAN PRO)
• Security Check: findings for every device, like Telnet left open on a camera or a database reachable from the network, with what to do about each.
• Deep Scan: checks a device for risky ports a normal scan skips.
• Port Forward Audit: shows which devices your router has opened to the internet over UPnP.

MY LAN PRO is a one-time purchase, no subscription. It unlocks Pro on your iPad and Mac, and Family Sharing shares it with your family.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no tracking. Scan results stay on your devices and in your own iCloud, which keeps your iPad and Mac in sync; the names and rooms from Home show up on your Mac too.
• My LAN only looks at your local network and your Home, and never changes your router's settings.

My LAN needs permission to access your local network, and access to your Home data for the HomeKit features.

name: My Tennis Story
description:
Mateo is 11 and new at the tennis club. Four seasons to win a tennis scholarship before his 16th birthday. Who will you spend time with?

TWO WAYS TO PLAY

LOVE, LOYALTY & GLORY: the story (first 4 weeks free)
Play as Mateo. Every week brings a choice, drawn like a comic: practise with Alex, meet Inés and Hana, help Mom after her night shift, or train 30 more minutes. Your choices shape your stats, your friendships, your team and your career.

• Keep your promises: say yes to two friends for the same evening and both will remember.
• Grampa's Time Machine takes you back to the first week of a season. You keep what you learned.

CHALLENGE: build your own player
Make your player and play the whole career from the Town League to the Nationals. Rookie is free; Star and No Mercy come with the full version.

REAL TENNIS, REAL TACTICS
• Your coach teaches one small tactic at a time, on court, in a few short lines.

• Practise every day: drills and mini-games raise your stats.

The game works offline. No ads, no tracking, no account. Your saves stay on your device.
12 languages: English, Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, Nederlands, Português, Русский, Українська, 日本語, 中文, 한국어.

FREE TO START, ONE PURCHASE FOR ALL
Free: Challenge mode on Rookie, the whole career, and the story's first 4 weeks. One purchase, the full version, opens the rest of the story (Love, Loyalty & Glory) and the Star and No Mercy difficulties: tougher teams and trickier lessons. Pay once, play forever. No subscription.

name: NetsuDeta: Temperature Log
description:
Open, enter, close.

NetsuDeta keeps temperature records for you and your family.
Choose a person, enter a temperature, and return to the Home Screen to save it. Completed entries also save when you switch people. Unfinished input is kept so you can continue next time.

TEMPERATURE ENTRY
Enter 65 for 36.5°C or 383 for 38.3°C without tapping a decimal point. Move the large temperature display up or down to adjust it by 0.1°C. To record a new measurement with the same value, tap Record temperature.

SEPARATE RECORDS FOR EACH PERSON
Add up to four people for free. Create avatars by choosing hair, clothes, accessories, and colors. The selected person appears from the waist up; others appear as gray full-body avatars.

HISTORY AND CHARTS
Keep unlimited readings and view your full history for free. Correct temperatures and measurement times, archive records, and restore them later.
Free charts cover the last 30 days, including today. The chart starts with today. Scroll horizontally or pinch to change the displayed period.

APPLE HEALTH
With permission, save this iPhone user's temperatures to Apple Health. Use the import button to read their temperatures from Apple Health. Free imports cover the last 30 days, including today.
Family members' records are not connected to Apple Health. Editing or archiving an imported copy in NetsuDeta does not change the original Apple Health record.

EXPORT AND IMPORT
Save and share record files. Importing the same records again does not add duplicates.

NETSUDETA PLUS
An optional one-time purchase unlocks more than four people, full-history charts, and imports for the full Apple Health history you allow the app to read.
Temperature recording, the full history list, Export and Import, and saving your own temperatures to Apple Health remain free.

Records are stored on your iPhone. Temperature entry and history work offline, and no account is needed to record temperatures.
Temperatures are recorded in Celsius, from 30.0°C to 45.0°C. NetsuDeta does not diagnose illness or decide whether a reading is normal or a fever.

name: Nidoe: Daily Art Prompts
description:
Nidoe gives you one drawing prompt a day, then brings the same prompt back later so you can see your own drawings side by side.

Draw on paper with whatever you like. When you finish, photograph the drawing and it goes into your sketchbook. 30 days later the prompt returns. Draw it again from memory, and Nidoe places the two drawings next to each other with the number of days between them. There are no scores and no rankings. It is only you then and you now.

• Today: one prompt for everyone. Draw it on paper, then take a photo or choose one from Photos

• Side by side: your old and new drawings in date order, with the days between them
• Sketchbook: every drawing grouped by prompt, plus a calendar of the days you drew

[Premium]

READ, PRACTISE, AND BUILD COMBOS
Use spoken answers or tap the reading choices. Hear the correct reading when you miss, try again, and build a combo that keeps counting throughout your chosen round. Replay a challenge or move on to your next group.

TRAIN AT YOUR OWN PACE
Listen to bundled Japanese recordings, explore stroke order, and practise kana through example words with translated meanings.

name: OCEASTRA
description:
LA MER NE SE RÉSUME PAS À LA MÉTÉO.

Un vent qui se lève, une houle qui se propage, un courant qui change, des reliefs invisibles sous la surface…

L’océan est un monde en mouvement. OCEASTRA vous invite à le découvrir autrement.

Explorez les conditions marines grâce à une carte interactive de l’Europe de l’Ouest qui réunit météo, courants, vagues et données océanographiques.

Que vous soyez passionné de mer, navigateur, pêcheur ou simplement curieux, découvrez ce qui se passe au-dessus et au-dessous de l’eau.

LES COURANTS MARINS PRENNENT VIE

Visualisez les courants grâce à des particules animées qui révèlent leurs directions et leurs mouvements.

Déplacez la carte, zoomez et explorez les différentes zones maritimes.

MÉTÉO ET ÉTAT DE LA MER

* Vent et rafales avec leurs directions
* Hauteur et direction des vagues
* Houle et évolution des conditions
* Pression atmosphérique et isobares
* Température de l’air

Explorez les échéances disponibles pour suivre l’évolution des prévisions.

DÉCOUVREZ L’OCÉAN SOUS LA SURFACE

* Température de l’eau
* Salinité
* Chlorophylle observée par satellite
* Informations sur le phytoplancton
* Turbidité de l’eau

La disponibilité des données varie selon les zones et les sources.

EXPLOREZ LES FONDS MARINS

Découvrez les reliefs sous-marins grâce à la bathymétrie, aux profondeurs colorées et aux courbes de niveau.

Observez les paysages invisibles qui façonnent les océans.

UNE AUTRE FAÇON DE COMPRENDRE LA MER

Choisissez les informations qui vous intéressent et explorez librement la carte.

Téléchargez OCEASTRA et découvrez une nouvelle façon d’explorer la mer.

name: Okay*ish
description:
Something just happened and it’s stuck in your head. Okay*ish uses laughter to help you get through the moment and lighten the load, in under two minutes.

HOW IT WORKS

Type what happened. The rude comment, the argument you keep replaying, the coworker who did the thing again.
Get three reframes. Swipe right on the ones that make you laugh, left on the ones that don’t.
Get back to your day.

Want a little more? Ask for a one-liner or a song suggestion to go with it.

IT LEARNS WHAT MAKES YOU LAUGH
Every swipe teaches the llama a bit more about your style, so the reframes get closer to what lands for you. Choose a voice too, from Friendly to Unfiltered.

COPING TOOL FOR IN THE MOMENT
Okay*ish doesn’t fix what happened, and it isn’t therapy. It’s for the moment you’re in right now, when something has a hold on you and you need a way through it. No journaling, no streaks, no homework. Just a little lighter, and back to your day.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Sometimes the thing that’s bugging you isn’t something you can say out loud. Or it’s about the person you’d normally tell. Okay*ish is a private place to let it out. There’s no one on the other end, nothing to explain, and no one to judge you.

Okay*ish doesn’t keep what you type. Your words go to our AI provider only to write your reframes. The AI doesn’t remember you from one time to the next. The app saves only which reframes made you laugh, never the story itself.

Okay*ish is for adults 18+.
