name: PackProof
description:
PackProof — професійний інструмент для пакувальників і складських команд. Допомагає фіксувати фотодокази захисту упаковки перед відправкою й блокує закриття завдання, якщо обов’язкові пункти не виконані.
﻿
Що робить PackProof
• Створює картку пакування з номером замовлення, SKU, назвою товару, типом коробки та ім’ям пакувальника
• Дає стандартний контрольний список захисту: кутові протектори, перлинова вата / пінополіетилен, перевірка типу коробки, скотч, транспортна етикетка та (за потреби) маркування «Крихке»
• Дозволяє робити фото з камери або обирати з галереї
• Зберігає докази локально з часовою міткою та водяним знаком для аудиту
• Показує прогрес по кожній картці та підсвічує, яких фото ще бракує
﻿
Ворота відповідності (Compliance Gate)
Закрити завдання можна лише тоді, коли всі обов’язкові пункти мають валідні фото. Якщо чогось бракує — система чітко показує список пропусків. Так «усне підтвердження» замінюється перевіреним фотослідом і знижує ризик пошкоджень у дорозі та повернень.
﻿
Зручно в зміні
• Огляд зміни: рівень закриття, активні картки, готові до закриття, пропуски
• Індекс захисту та черга пріоритету (спочатку найменш готові завдання)
• Швидкі дії: нова картка, готові до закриття, архів, стандарт захисту

• Клонування останньої картки та сортування за прогресом
• Архів закритих доказів із можливістю поділитися звітом і фото
﻿
Для кого
Пакувальники, оператори фулфілменту, e-commerce склади та команди якості відвантаження.
﻿
PackProof допомагає тримати дисципліну пакування просто, швидко й прозоро — без зайвих кольорів, із спокійним професійним інтерфейсом для роботи на лінії.

name: Panel Games
description:
Panel Games is a set of daily logic puzzles built around a fire alarm control panel. Every key on the panel opens a different puzzle, and every day brings new boards. Clear all four and the display reads SYSTEM NORMAL.

THE FOUR DAILY PUZZLES (FREE)

ACKNOWLEDGE — Open Circuit
Turn the wire tiles until every device is wired back to the panel with no open circuits.

ALARM SILENCE — Silence
Each press toggles a horn/strobe and the ones next to it. Silence the whole floor in as few presses as you can.

SYSTEM RESET — Resistors
Put one end-of-line resistor in every row, column and zone. No two can touch, not even diagonally.

DRILL — Smoke Test
Check every room without opening one full of smoke. Numbers tell you how many neighboring rooms have smoke, and every floor can be solved by logic alone. No guessing.

EVERY PUZZLE IS FAIR
Every board is guaranteed solvable, and Resistors, Smoke Test, Wire Run and Ground Fault each have exactly one answer, so you never have to guess. Everyone gets the same boards on the same day.

FULL PANEL (ONE-TIME UNLOCK)
• Practice boards in every size, in every game, as many as you want
• Wire Run: join devices with runs of one or two wires, no crossings, one circuit
• Ground Fault: find the hidden faulted runs from the meter readings along the edges
• Every add-on game we add later
One purchase, no subscription, and Family Sharing is on.

ALSO
• Full-panel streak: how many days in a row you've reached SYSTEM NORMAL
• Game Center leaderboards for each daily puzzle, plus achievements
• Event history on the panel, hints and undo in every game
• Works offline; light and dark mode
• No ad networks, no tracking, no account

Made by the fire alarm techs at Rainier Fire.

name: Pealwright
description:
The ropes are still, the ringers wait, and the treble's ringer looks at you. You are composing tonight: the order of the bells is yours to change, one row at a time, and every row has to be new.

How a row changes
A row is the order in which the bells strike, written as figures: 123456 is rounds. From one row to the next, only neighbours may swap, and several pairs may swap at once. Mark the gaps under the current row, press Ring, and hear the new row struck in rhythm. Ring a row that has already sounded and it is false: the move is refused and the earlier row lights up.

What the levels ask
Reach: get from the start row to the target in as few changes as you can.
Palette: the same, but only with the changes a real method uses, such as x and 14.
Touch: the method rings itself lead by lead; at each lead end you call Plain, Bob or Single to meet the condition - an exact length, a row to pass through, or no early return - and come round without a single false row.
There are 96 levels in 8 towers, from four bells to seven: Plain Hunt, Plain Bob Minimus, Doubles and Minor, Grandsire Doubles and Grandsire Triples. Every level was searched to the end before it was included, so its minimum is proven and shown to you. Clean means you matched it, Steady means one or two over, Rung means you got there.
The blue line shows the path of any bell through your rows. Method cards set out the place notation, one lead, and what a Bob and a Single change. The craft explains rows, changes, truth and calls in plain words.

Coins and Pro
Coins come from ringing: 2 for every true row the first time a level is rung, 30 for the first Clean, and 50 for the first level of each day. They pay for hints - Next change, False ahead, Call position - and for bell voices and line colours. Levels never open for coins, the balance never goes below zero, and nothing is random. Coin packs are also available.
Towers 1 to 3 are free, with hints and the daily bonus. Pro, one payment and not a subscription, opens towers 4 to 8 and Practice, where you ring any method freely, follow your own bell, call Bobs and Singles, and see your misses on the blue line.

The bell sounds are synthesized for this app. No account, no network, no ads, no tracking.

name: Pruva Sailing
description:
Pruva brings start preparation, race recording and measurement-based tactical assessment together. No account is required. Your race data stays on your device.

PREPARE YOUR START
Synchronize 10- and 5-minute countdowns with one-second adjustments. View start-line distance when real GPS and both line endpoints are available. Follow the timer on Apple Watch and Live Activity.

ONE COCKPIT
Switch between the tactical map and Race HUD. Inspect speed, heading and wind from a supported boat Wi-Fi feed, including each measurement's source and age. Tactical recommendations remain unavailable when required inputs are missing or stale.

COURSE AND RECORDING
Edit marks, prepare a sequential course or import GPX/CSV/JSON course files. Record using the phone GPS or a compatible boat GPS. Review available speed, VMG and maneuver measurements in your logbook. Share a story image, GPX, CSV or JSON backup when you choose.

THREE LANGUAGES
Switch between Turkish, English and Russian in the app. Use typed commands, with optional on-device speech recognition and language assistance where the device and language support them. An independent mute setting silences app speech.

REQUIREMENTS
iOS/iPadOS 26 or later; watchOS 26 or later for the optional Watch companion. Boat data requires an accessible IP feed in a supported NMEA 0183, Signal K, GoFree or NMEA 2000 gateway format. iPhone does not connect directly to a physical NMEA 2000 network. Compatibility with every manufacturer and firmware is not guaranteed.

Boat telemetry pauses when iPhone is in the background. A user-started GPS recording may continue while the screen is locked, subject to permissions, and may increase battery use. Phone GPS alone does not provide a complete tactical sensor set.

Pruva is not a nautical chart, collision avoidance system or racing rules referee. Calculations depend on current measurements and crew assumptions; no future weather or race result is guaranteed.

name: Quinta Duel
description:
Quinta Duel is the Quinta dice game for two. Invite a friend, take your turns whenever it suits you,
  and see who finishes with the higher score. It works between iPhones and Android phones.

  INVITE A FRIEND
  Tap Invite a Friend and send the link or code by Messages, Mail or any app. The person who invites
  picks a 3-column game (shorter) or the full 6-column game, and goes first. No account, email or
  password — just choose the name your friends will see.

  TAKE YOUR TURNS, THEN HAND OFF
  You play 3 turns, then it's your friend's turn for 3. You get a notification when it's your turn, so
  a game can last a coffee break or a whole week. See what your friend scored while you were away,
  and peek at their sheet any time.

  PRACTICE ANY TIME
  No one to play right now? Tap Enter a Code and type PLAYME to play Quinta Bot, a computer partner
  that takes its turns right away.

  ROLL FOR THE QUINTA
  Hold the dice you want and reroll the rest, up to three rolls a turn. Five of a kind is a Quinta:
  bank it for 50, earn free rolls, and once your Quinta row is full, every Quinta you roll adds a +100
  bonus.

  FAIR DICE
  Every die is rolled by the Quinta Duel server, so nobody can cheat.

  PLAY YOUR WAY
  • Up to 10 games going at once, with friends on iPhone or Android
  • Your win–loss–tie record against each friend
  • Rematch with one tap when a game ends
  • If a friend stops playing, they get a reminder after 3 days; after 4 days you can end the game and
  take the win
  • Pick a box, see your score, then Commit — no accidental taps
  • Full rules built in

  FRIENDLY BY DESIGN
  There's no chat and no matching with strangers — you only play people you invite or who invite you.
  Names are checked for offensive words, and you can block or report a player at any time.

  Quinta Duel is free to play with ads. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns them off for good on
  every device signed in to your Apple ID.

name: Quoinset
description:
Quoinset is a puzzle about the white between words. You are the compositor in a hand-setting shop. The letters of every line already stand in the composing stick, reversed and upside down as real metal type does. The words are given and never change. Your work is the spacing.

In the case

A hundred jobs wait in five type cases of twenty. Single lines come first, then headings centred with quads, then set paragraphs where the breaks are fixed, then paragraphs where you choose where each line ends, and finally whole pages: a heading over two columns. Every job is fixed and the same for everyone. Nothing is random.

On the stick

Pick a gap and drop space sorts into it from the box: em 60 units, en 30, thin 12, hair 5. The line must fill the measure exactly. One unit short and it will not justify, and the stick tells you how many units are left. Some widths cannot be made from metal at all, so you plan around them.

A line is judged on evenness, the widest gap minus the narrowest, and then on how few sorts you used. On the galley, gaps that stand under one another for three lines make a river; a last line of one word is a widow. The proof marks both in blue pencil and gives up to three impressions.

The best setting of every job was worked out in advance by dynamic programming and checked by tests, so three impressions are always within reach and always mean the same thing.

Locking the chase

A page goes into an iron chase with wooden furniture and four quoins. Turn them with the key, a step at a time and evenly all round. Drive one too far and the forme bows; leave a line loose and it drops when you lift. A clean lift test on the first try earns its own reward.

Coins and Pro

Coins come from justified lines, even paragraphs, clean lock-ups and a daily composing stint of three lines. They pay for two hints, Best spacing and Find the river, and for the look of the shop: case wood, stick metal and proof ink. Boxes of coins can also be bought. Coins never open jobs or change any rule.

Cases 1 and 2, forty jobs, are free and complete. Quoinset Pro is a single purchase that opens cases 3 to 5, the Proof sheet that sets your work beside the best setting line by line, and printing a proof or saving it as PDF.

No account, no network, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on your iPhone.

ORGANISE INTO STACKS

IMPORT IN SECONDS
Paste a link, snap a photo of a cookbook page or handwritten card, or type a recipe out. AI pulls out the ingredients and steps for you to check before saving.

PLAN YOUR WEEK

LES CHIFFRES QUI COMPTENT

name: Remoxa
description:
Remoxa puts your computer on your iPhone and iPad. Connect to your Mac's built-in Screen Sharing or to any VNC server on Windows and Linux – and use it as if you were sitting in front of it.

HOW IT FEELS

WINDOWS AND LINUX TOO

TRY IT WITHOUT A COMPUTER

name: Rilkuilt
description:

After: enter both price tags on the Weigh-up shelf. Rilkuilt prices them per kilo (4.98 against 4.29), ribbons the winner and shows the bigger bag costs about 14% less per kilo.

Before: a 6 x 330 ml multipack next to a 2 L bottle.
After: enter each pack's price, size and count in any unit: g, kg, oz, lb, ml, L, US fl oz, pints, gallons, count, sheets or loads. Rilkuilt compares two to six packs at one unit price, and if you say how much you need, shows the bill for each.

Before: "Buy 2, get 1 free." "3 for 5." "25% off." Which is the real deal?
After: Specials reads the sign and prints a till receipt showing what each pack really costs.

Before: a price tag abroad in €/kg when you think in $/lb.
After: Abroad converts it with the exchange rate you type in from your bank app, card fees included, and swaps units so the price reads the way you shop at home.

Before: forgetting what you paid last time.
After: save a weigh-up to Baskets and note the lowest price you've seen for each item in the Price Book.

Shopper's Notes
About 18 short notes on unit prices, mixed shelf units, drained weight, price per wash, BOGOF and 3-for-2 maths, was/now prices, pounds and kilos, sales tax abroad and keeping a price book. New notes arrive online and stay readable in the shop.

Basket Cloud
Back up your baskets and Price Book with one tap and bring them back on a new phone. No account needed: the app uses an anonymous ID, refreshes the copy every few hours, and you can delete it any time.

Suggestion slip
Want another unit or deal type? Send a note from inside the app.

Your currency symbol, metric or US units and decimals live in Till Settings. Exchange rates are never fetched; you type the one your bank uses. Everything is saved on your iPhone first and works with no signal.

NAME YOUR PRICE

name: Ritame - футболът ни събира
description:
Playing tonight? Ritame is an app for amateur football in Varna, Bulgaria: one “I’m in” button, and everyone sees how many spots are left and who else is coming. No more counting “+1” in the group chat.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Browse nearby matches and join with one tap. You’re number 9 of 12 — clear, not “maybe”.
• Organising? Set up a match in a minute: venue, time, number of players, price per person. Choose who sees it — everyone or only invited players.
• Invite people by name inside Ritame, and keep track of who’s coming and who has paid.
• Someone dropped out? The first reserve gets a notification and takes the spot. If they don’t take it in time, it goes to the next in line.
• A “locker room” for regulars: groups with chat and invitations for every next match. “Repeat for next week” makes a new match with the same squad.
• Varna venues with photos, address, sizes, prices and free slots (for municipal pitches that publish a schedule). You can add your own venues too.
• After the match, vote for the player of the match.

PHONE NOTIFICATIONS
Invitations, a freed-up spot, a reminder the day before, “Are you still coming?” three hours before, a changed or cancelled match, and group messages. You choose which ones you want, and there are quiet hours at night.

SAFER BY DESIGN
Report and block users, your profile is visible only to people from a shared match or group, and you can delete your account in the app. Ritame is for people aged 16 and over. No ads, no tracking.

LANGUAGES
Bulgarian and English, with a switch in the top bar.

Ritame doesn’t book pitches for you. It shows when they’re free and where to book, while the match itself is organised here.

We started in Varna: Aksakovo, Vladislavovo, Mladost, Asparuhovo, Spartak, Zhechka, Technical University, Trinity, Chaika, Vinitsa, Sea Garden. More cities soon.

name: Roll Scanner

name: Ruban: Carousel & Film Looks
description:
Ruban turns your photos into seamless carousels and develops them with real film simulations.

SEAMLESS CAROUSELS
Compose on one long canvas cut into perfectly aligned slides. A photo can span two or three slides, and the seams line up when people swipe through your post.
• Carousel (4:5, 1:1, 3:4, 1.91:1), story (9:16) and profile grid formats
• 26 layouts: panoramas, seams, collages, film strips and more
• 29 frames, 67 fonts, 141 stickers, shapes and freehand drawing
• Plain, gradient or photo backgrounds, sharp or blurred
• Layers, snapping guides, precise crop and rotation
• Every slide exported in order, up to 2160 px, to your gallery or straight to your favourite apps

TEMPLATES READY TO FILL
Pick a template, drop your photos into its zones and your post is ready.
• More than 70 templates by Ruban: seasons, travel, film, collage, stationery, fashion, food, celebrations…
• Templates shared by the community, checked before they go public
• Build your own in the same editor, with photo zones of any proportions and transparent PNG images, then keep them or publish them under a public name

REAL FILM SIMULATIONS
Ruban does not stack filters: it simulates the analog chain, from the light reaching the negative to the final print.
• 43 film looks: colour negatives, slides, cinema stocks, black and white, instant film, and the colour science of popular digital cameras
• 9 print papers and printer lights, to fine-tune colour as in a darkroom
• Grain that follows the density of the image, halation around highlights, bloom, vignette and light leaks
• Save your settings as recipes, apply them in one tap, share them or try the community's

COMPLETE RETOUCHING
• Exposure, white balance, contrast, highlights, shadows, texture, clarity, dehaze, vibrance
• Curves, colour mixer, colour grading, chrome effect, fade
• Sharpening and noise reduction
• Straightening, perspective and automatic levelling
• Local adjustments with linear and radial masks
• Your own .cube LUTs

RAW FILES WELCOME
With Ruban Pro, import Apple ProRAW and DNG files as well as JPEG and HEIC photos, and develop them with all the latitude of the raw data. Everything is rendered on the GPU of your iPhone or iPad, in real time, with no server involved.

ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
During the trial and with Ruban Pro, your projects, templates, photos, recipes and LUTs follow your account on your iPhone, iPad and Mac.

A BUG OR AN IDEA?
Write to us from the app: the answer comes back in the app.

SIMPLE PRICING
• 7-day free trial with everything unlocked, no payment details needed
• Then a single purchase, Ruban Pro, to keep everything for good: no subscription
• Or keep the basics for free: simple carousel tools and a few layouts, with ads

Your purchase is tied to your Ruban account: it follows you on your iPhone, iPad and Mac.

name: Rumi: Love Poems & Widgets

Become their favorite poet.

Read the Bible a chapter at a time. When a passage should stay near, put it on the widget.

No account. No ads. No subscription. Seven days to try it. Then one purchase keeps it.

name: SE AI: Service Engineer
description:
SE AI is an assistant for service engineers who maintain medical equipment: ultrasound, ventilators and anaesthesia machines, patient monitors, X-ray, CT and MRI, laboratory analysers.

Describe the fault in your own words or take a photo of the machine's screen. SE AI searches manufacturers' service manuals and repairs worked through by engineers, and answers:
• what most likely failed;
• what to check and in what order;
• which parts are needed, with part numbers when the number is on record.

Every answer has a source. SE AI always shows where the information comes from: the manufacturer's manual, a repair confirmed by an engineer, or a colleague's version that is not confirmed. It does not pass a guess off as fact, and it does not name a part number that is not on record.

Read the screen with the camera. Point the camera at the error code or the serial plate and tap the line: it goes straight into your question.

Sites and machines. Add sites and machines with serial numbers, or just write in the chat: SE AI recognises the site and the model and offers to file the chat under the right machine.

Machine memory. Every machine has notes and a history. In a new chat about a machine, SE AI takes into account what has already happened to it.

Drafts, not actions. During the conversation SE AI prepares a work order, a service report, a parts request and a maintenance plan. They all stay drafts until the engineer approves them. Nothing is sent anywhere on its own.

Who it is for: service engineers, hospital biomedical engineers, service companies and distributors.

Access: 3 free questions after you sign in. After that, the SE AI subscription gives up to 30 questions a day. It renews every month until you cancel; you can cancel at any time in your Apple ID subscription settings.

Important: SE AI gives advice based on colleagues' experience and manuals, but it is not the manufacturer's instructions. Work with high voltage, gases and radiation only according to the manufacturer's service documentation. Brand and model names are used only to identify equipment; SE AI is not affiliated with the manufacturers.

name: Seedcurve
description:
Seedcurve walks one batch of chocolate through tempering, from the first melt to the test strip. It works with chocolate types, dark, milk and white, and with the temperatures printed on your package.

1. Melt
Pick dark, milk or white chocolate and a method: seeding with tempered chocolate, tabling on a stone, or 1 % cocoa butter powder at 34–35 °C. Seedcurve shows the target curve for that combination and starts a stage timer that keeps the right time even if you leave the app. The screen stays on while the curve is running.

2. Seed
Seed Math works out how much tempered seed brings your hot melt down to the working temperature on its own. It uses a heat balance with your batch mass, melt temperature, kitchen temperature and the fat content from the label, and warns you when the seed falls outside a sensible 15–40 % of the batch. If the melt is already cooler than the working temperature, it says so instead of showing a number. The result is a starting point, not a promise.

3. Work
Log a thermometer reading with one button. Your readings are drawn over the target band for each stage. A reading that climbs more than half a degree over the working band after cooling is flagged as temper lost, and one that drops well under the cooling band is flagged as thickening.

4. Check
Answer a few questions about the test strip: how long it took to set, the snap, the gloss, streaks and release. Seedcurve gives a verdict, In temper, Under-crystallized or Over-crystallized, and one or two changes to try on the next batch. The bloom atlas, with drawn surface samples, helps you tell fat bloom from sugar bloom with a warm finger or a drop of water and explains what causes each defect.

Free, and staying free: all three chocolate types and methods, Seed Math, the stage timer with readings, the test strip, the eight-article bloom atlas and a logbook of 15 batches. Pro is a single purchase that adds an unlimited logbook, your own chocolate profiles from the package temperatures and fat, eight more articles on moulding defects such as thin and thick shells, bubbles, cracks, white dots and chips, the in-temper rate by method and by profile, and CSV export. Seedcurve works offline and has no account, no analytics and no permissions.

name: SHADOW MATCH: Shadow Studio
description:
See an object from a different angle.

SHADOW MATCH is a quiet spatial puzzle game about rotating three-dimensional sculptures and directing light to find a target silhouette. Warm studio lighting, original wooden forms and simple controls keep your attention on discovery.

• 30 handcrafted puzzles with increasing complexity
• First 10 puzzles free
• Later puzzles introduce tilt, articulated parts and two lights
• Free daily puzzle and free hints
• 10 interface languages, including English and Turkish
• Portrait and landscape play on iPhone and iPad
• Offline local saves, precise buttons, reduced motion and contrast options

Two additional worlds, each with 10 puzzles, are optional one-time purchases. A porcelain finish is sold separately; four base materials are included. No ads or subscriptions. Purchases and restoration require an internet connection. Daily puzzles are curated from existing levels and may include free previews from additional worlds.

Gameplay relies on visual silhouette recognition. Progress is stored on your device; cloud sync between devices is not provided.

name: Sharp: Memory & Focus
description:
Train your mind with Sharp: a collection of quick games for memory, attention, speed and reasoning.
Small games.
No brainrot.

Play at your own pace. Review your scores, accuracy, attempts and training time in your progress and statistics. Build a profile across memory, attention and reasoning. Compare your performance with other players.

No account is needed to play. Sign in only if you want to link progress across devices. Set an optional daily reminder and adjust your profile settings whenever you like.

Sharp is made for brain-training games and entertainment.
Just 10–15 minutes of meaningful training per day.
Track your Personal Best and watch yourself improve.
Results are not a medical assessment or diagnosis.

name: Shh, Snap!
description:
Fold to hide, and the cats come closer. Unfold, and snap.

November at 12 Persimmon Lane. Three cats and a magpie wander an alley of ripening persimmons, and Grandma, who runs the photo studio at the end of the lane, wants their pictures: a cat squeezed into a box, a cat loafing on a sunny wall, a great big yawn.

The trouble is, animals hide from people. So you fold your phone and duck behind the bushes. When a cat settles in, open the phone: that's your camera. Stay open too long and they'll spot you and run.

■ THE FOLD IS THE CONTROLLER
• Fold = Hide: peek through the bushes on the outer screen
• Unfold = Camera: the scene widens into a camera as you open the phone
• Half-fold = Tripod: animals come by even when you're not hiding
• iPhones that don't fold use the [Hide] and [Raise camera] buttons

■ GRANDMA'S TEN REQUESTS
A cat in a box, a cat loaf, a mid-yawn, eye contact, two side by side, the magpie's treasure, the magpie's persimmon and more. Grandma has a word for every photo.

■ AN ALLEY FOR EVERY SEASON
From December through February, snow falls on Moonlit Stairs, a winter alley with ten new requests. You can also pick the alley yourself in the menu.

■ YOUR CAT
Fill three requests and a kitten follows you home. Choose its coat and name, fill its bowl, play with a feather, and press and hold to hear it purr. As the days of care add up, it grows from kitten to grown-up, and it never gets sick or leaves.

■ NEW: DECORATIONS
Collar colors, charms (bow, bandana, flower, star tag) and beds (tangerine box, check blanket) for your cat. Try anything on before you buy.
• Dandy Pack (one-time purchase): 4 collar colors, 4 charms, 2 beds
• Alley Supporters (monthly, yearly or lifetime): everything in the Dandy Pack plus seasonal decorations, with new ones each season. It also supports the developer.
Care, photos, requests and both alleys are free for everyone.

■ ON A CHARGING STAND
The alley becomes a quiet clock with the date, battery and missed calls. When a moment is worth catching, a soft glow at the edge lets you know. At night it turns dim and red, and your cat sleeps in its bed until you pick up the phone.

■ WHILE YOU'RE AWAY
A gentle notification tells you when a request can be filled (three a day at most, none at night), and a Lock Screen widget shows the alley. When you come back, a trail camera has caught whoever stopped by.

■ 11 LANGUAGES
English, Korean, Japanese, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Simplified and Traditional Chinese, and Arabic.

No ads, no loot boxes, no sign-in, no data collection. Plays offline.

Alley Supporters monthly and yearly plans are auto-renewing subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in Settings › [your name] › Subscriptions. Alley Supporters Lifetime and the Dandy Pack are one-time purchases.

name: Shouty Chick
description:
Stop tapping. Start shouting!

This chick doesn't care about buttons. It only listens to your voice.

Mumble, and it walks.
Shout, and it jumps.
Hold that shout, and it jumps even higher.
Go quiet, and it stops and waits for you.

Sounds easy? Try yelling "AAAH!" at your phone at the bus stop, in the office, or in front of your parents. That's the real challenge.

SHOUT YOUR WAY THROUGH 100 STAGES
From orchards, wetlands and auroras to harbors and observatories. The traps get trickier. Your voice gets stronger.

CHICK PARTY: 2–4 PLAYERS TAKE TURNS
Pass one phone around and find out who shouts best and whose voice cracks first. Perfect for parties. Your neighbors may disagree.

TOO EASY?
Climb through Easy, Normal and Hard. Boss difficulty is waiting.

FREE TO PLAY
One purchase unlocks Boss difficulty and unlimited Party play.

Don't worry: the chick only measures volume. Nothing is recorded or uploaded. What you just shouted stays between you and your neighbors.

name: ShuttleClip: Badminton Edits
description:
ShuttleClip is an AI video editor made for badminton players.

After a game you often have a long video, with the best rallies buried somewhere inside. Scrubbing through it to find serves, trim endings and export clips can take longer than the game itself. ShuttleClip does that part for you.

Pick a match video and ShuttleClip finds the rallies automatically. Preview them, keep the ones you like, then export a single highlight video or save each rally as its own clip.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Find rallies automatically with an engine tuned to the rhythm of badminton
- Get the best rallies picked for you, then fine-tune any start or end point
- Export one highlight video, or separate clips for each rally
- Save favorite rallies and come back to them any time
- Keep drafts and pick up where you left off
- Record matches and scores, stored on your device
- Works for singles, doubles, games and training sessions

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your videos are analyzed and edited on your device. There is no account to create, and ShuttleClip does not upload your videos.

SHUTTLECLIP PRO
Upgrade for the full experience:
- Export without a watermark
- Smooth transitions between rallies
- Faster exports, plus Auto Follow that keeps you in frame

Pro is available as a monthly, quarterly or yearly auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it any time in your App Store account settings.

Camera angle, court lighting and players blocking the view can affect detection. If a rally is cut in the wrong place, adjust it in the editor or contact us through our support page.

name: SideOut Volley
description:
Volleyball in the Wallonia-Brussels Federation, in your pocket.

SideOut brings together the results, fixtures and standings of every FVWB league, from Nationale 1 to the provincial divisions, for women's and men's teams.

YOUR VOLLEYBALL WEEK
Star your teams, clubs and leagues: their games for the week appear as soon as you open the app, with results and kick-off times. Move from week to week in one tap.

THE SCORE, SET BY SET
Every game shows the score of each set, the venue with directions in Apple Maps, Google Maps or Waze, both teams' form and the first-leg result.

YOUR TEAM'S FORM
Next game, latest results, win rate and the full fixture list for every team.

LIVE STANDINGS
The table for every league, with each team's latest results.

ONE CLUB AT A TIME
Pick a club to see all its teams, filter by women, men or level, and star the ones you follow.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your favorites stay on your phone
• In French, Dutch and English
• Light or dark theme

Spotted a wrong score? Report it from the game screen.

Data comes from the FVWB's public competition portal and updates every 15 minutes during games. SideOut is an independent app and is not affiliated with the FVWB.

name: Sillfern: Houseplant Care
description:
Most plant apps give every plant the same calendar. Sillfern works out each plant's rhythm from four things that really change how fast a pot dries: the species, the pot, the window it sits by, and the time of year. Then it shows its working, so you can disagree with it.

WHAT YOU DO
Add your rooms and tell Sillfern which way each window faces. Add a plant from the library of 63 common houseplants and say where it sits and what it lives in. From then on the Today screen lists only what needs attention, grouped by room, so one lap of the house is one list.

A SCHEDULE THAT READS YOUR HOME
- Window direction, distance from the glass and a sheer curtain give each spot a light score, and every plant has the range it likes.
- Pot width, material (terracotta dries faster than glazed ceramic) and drainage change the pace.
- Day length at your latitude slows drinking in the dark months and pauses feeding. No location permission is used; you choose a latitude.
- Say the soil was still damp or bone dry and the rhythm shifts a little, within limits.
- Open any plant and read Why this rhythm: each factor, its effect, and the public guide behind it.

CALM BY DESIGN
- Water rounds by room with one Round done button, and an Undo.
- No streaks, no scores, no guilt. A late plant is just "a little late".
- One quiet summary reminder on days something is due, plus a few pot checks. Notifications are scheduled on your device.
- A Home Screen and Lock Screen widget shows today's plants by room.

A PHOTO TIMELINE
Add photos to any plant and see its growth beside the watering, feeding and repotting you logged. Photos stay on your device.

SOURCED, WITH HONEST LIMITS
Care guidance rests on named university extension guides, and each fact links to its source. The numbers per species are Sillfern's own starting estimates, and conditions vary: check your plant. Pet notes summarise ASPCA listings with a vet-or-poison-control reminder. Sillfern does not identify plants from photos and gives no medical or veterinary advice.

FOR iPHONE AND iPAD
Built for both: a sidebar and two-column plant pages on iPad, a tab bar on iPhone.

FREE, WITH OPTIONAL AD-FREE
Sillfern is free and shows ads. An optional monthly subscription (Sillfern Plus, billed monthly, renews automatically until cancelled in your Apple Account settings) removes them, or you can watch short videos to switch ads off for a while. name: Singwell: Voice Coach
description:
Singwell is a private voice coach for anyone who wants to sing better: in the shower, in a choir or on stage. It listens to you sing, shows your pitch as you go and plans a short workout for your voice every day. Start free. No account needed.

• A voice check-up: your lowest and highest notes, how well you match a pitch, how steady you hold it and your longest note
• Find your voice type, from bass to soprano, and watch your range grow
• A daily workout of about five minutes, planned around your range: warm-ups, long notes, steps, jumps and scales
• A live pitch graph that shows your voice against the target note while you sing
• Learn a song phrase by phrase, in your key: each note on its own, then the melody, then the words
• Ear training, harmony practice and 4-week programs built around your goal
• Hear your progress: each check-up keeps a short clip, so you can compare your first one with today
• Gentle on your voice: Singwell tells you when you push too high, too loud or for too long
• A daily reminder, if you want one
• Plus: the full daily workout, every song, programs, your full history and progress charts, and every progress clip

Your voice is analysed on your iPhone and never uploaded. No account, no ads, no analytics. Singwell is a practice tool, not medical advice: if your voice hurts or stays hoarse, see a doctor.

The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. The yearly plan includes a 1-week free trial for new subscribers.

name: Sinopia: AR Trace & Draw
description:
Trace any picture by hand. Point your phone at a sheet of paper or a canvas, and Sinopia lays the picture's outlines over it on screen. You draw them with your own pencil, pen or brush.

THE PICTURE STAYS ON THE PAPER
Sinopia anchors the picture to the paper, so it holds still when you tilt the phone or your hand covers the sheet, and it works on a sheet bigger than the screen. Mark the corners of the sheet and the picture follows it when the paper slides. Prop your phone on a glass or a stand and both hands are free.

ANY PHOTO BECOMES CLEAN OUTLINES
Choose a photo from your library. Sinopia turns it into line art on your phone: show the lines, the details, the shading or the shapes, set how much detail you want, and pick the line color. Remove the background in one tap, then crop, straighten and set the brightness and contrast. See your photo as outlines for free, and trace it with Pro.

30 PICTURES TO START FROM
Flowers, birds, sea life, plants, animals and Japanese prints, from public domain art. Three are free.

LETTERING
Type a word, pick a font, and trace it. Good for signs, cards, murals and calligraphy practice.

TRACE FROM ANY APP
Share a picture from Photos, Safari or any other app to "Trace in Sinopia".

YOUR PHOTOS STAY ON YOUR PHONE
No account, no upload, no ads. The camera and the outlines all run on your phone.

SINOPIA PRO
Pro lets you trace your own photos, unlocks every template and lettering, and saves recordings without the Sinopia mark. Choose a yearly subscription with a free week to try it, a monthly one, or buy it once for life. Subscriptions renew until you cancel them in Settings.

A sinopia is the red underdrawing fresco painters traced on the wall before they painted over it.

name: Siriel - Markdown Writer
description:
Siriel is a quiet place to write and revise, on iPhone and iPad. Your notes are plain Markdown files in a folder you choose, in iCloud Drive or anywhere in Files, so they open in any app, now and in twenty years.

Pick the folder you already write in on your Mac and carry on where you left off. Siriel doesn't import, convert or lock anything away.

WRITING
• A clean editor that shows Markdown as you write it: headings, lists, tables, checklists, links and images
• Links between notes with [[double brackets]], and a tap to follow them
• Properties at the top of a note, for a chapter's number, its point of view or its stage
• Move a note through your own workflow, from draft to revised to done
• Word count and reading time for the note you're working on
• Light and dark, on iPhone and on a full-screen iPad with the library beside you

YOUR FOLDER, AS IT IS
• Every folder and note in your vault, with the icons and colours you gave them
• Tables of notes (bases) shown read-only, so you can check where a manuscript stands
• If a note changed on another device while you were editing, Siriel shows both versions side by side, word by word, and lets you choose. Nothing is overwritten silently.

AN EDITOR IN THE MARGIN, IF YOU WANT ONE
• Select a passage and ask for a Proofread or a Rewrite
• Uses your own key for Anthropic, OpenAI or OpenRouter. Siriel asks before anything is sent for the first time, and the key stays in this device's Keychain.
• Nothing is sent until you ask

VOICE NOTES
• Say a thought and it becomes a note, with the recording saved beside it
• Transcribed on this device. The speech model downloads only if you choose to, and nothing goes to a server.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no analytics, no tracking. Siriel has no server, so there is nothing to collect. Your notes go where your folder goes, and nowhere else.

Siriel for Mac is free too, and works on the same folder.

name: Site Manager for Netlify

Site Manager for Netlify lets you keep an eye on your Netlify sites and act on them from your iPhone.

Connect with a Netlify personal access token and get:

- All your sites in one list, with custom domains, repositories and last update time
- A dashboard for each site: deploy activity, success rate and quick links

name: Skimlane: Traffic Weave
description:
Skimlane turns the open road into a game of nerve and rhythm. Drag to steer, slip through the gaps and pass cars as closely as you dare. Every close pass adds a link to a glowing thread that streams behind your car, and the longer the chain, the bigger your multiplier.

THREAD THE TRAFFIC
• One-thumb drag steering: easy to learn, hard to put down
• Weave close past cars to grow your thread chain and multiplier
• One hit cuts the thread, so every gap is a choice

SLIPSTREAM AND DASH
• Tuck in behind cars to fill the slipstream meter
• Release a dash for a burst of speed and a surge of points

AROUND 60 MISSIONS, 4 ROUTES
• Coastal Sunset, Mountain Pass, Neon Tunnel and Salt Flat
• Night and rain variants change the mood and the challenge
• Hand-tuned goals that ask for a different style each time

MORE TO DRIVE
• Endless mode: chase your longest chain
• A garage of cars with weave perks that change how you play, not just how fast you go
• Phase, Echo and Beacon: spatial power-ups that bend the space around your car

PLAY ANYWHERE
• Fully offline, no account needed
• Free to play with optional ads and in-app purchases

Find the rhythm, thread the gaps and see how long your chain can grow.

name: Smart Chess Club
description:
Learn chess one small step at a time, on a 3D board with friendly animal heroes.

LEARN
30 short lessons in 6 chapters take you from your first move to your first checkmate:
- Meet the board, then how each piece moves: rook, bishop, queen, knight, pawn and king
- Check and checkmate
- Special moves: castling, en passant, promotion, and why stalemate is a draw
- Simple tricks: free pieces, forks, pins and skewers
- Checkmate patterns: back-rank mate, smothered mate, the two-rook ladder, king and queen, king and rook
- Opening rules and first endgames

Each step lights up the squares that matter. Stuck? Tap Hint. A wrong move simply hops back so you can try again. Finish a lesson to earn stars (three stars for no mistakes). Finish every lesson in a chapter to open the next one.

PUZZLES
300 puzzles, easiest first, in six kinds: Mate in 1, Mate in 2, Fork, Pin, Free piece and Promotion. The computer plays the first move, then it is your turn to find the answer. Build a streak and see how many you can solve in a row.

PLAY AND WATCH
- Play a full game against the computer.
- Two players: pass the phone and play a friend; the board turns for each player.
- Watch and learn: sit back while the computer plays both sides, and change the speed when you like.

A BOARD THAT COMES ALIVE
Play with a classic polished set, or download the free animal characters: a lion king with a gold crown and a whole court of animal friends, plus themed boards like a sunny castle courtyard. When a piece is captured, the camera swoops in for a short, playful scene - the captured piece takes a bow or a tumble, with no scary or violent moments. Tap to skip any scene.

YOUR SETTINGS
- Capture scenes: Full, Big captures only, or Off
- Reduce motion
- Sound and vibration on or off

PLAYS OFFLINE, NO ACCOUNT
- No sign-in; lessons, puzzles and games work offline (extra characters and themes are optional downloads)
- No ads and no in-app purchases
- We do not collect any data: your stars and puzzle progress stay on your device

Turn the board any way you like, zoom in close to your pieces, and learn chess at your own pace.

name: Smart Exam Grader for Teachers

Photograph your students' answer sheets, the Smart Exam Grader marks them, and you check and approve every mark yourself.

SNAP THE PAPERS. THE MARKS ARE READY.
Photograph answer sheets with your camera. The grader reads each answer and marks every question.

NAMES READ FROM THE PAPER
No need to add students first: the grader reads the name off the answer sheet. Or photograph your roster, or import it from a file.

YOU HAVE THE FINAL SAY
Every paper waits for your approval. Check the grader's reading and change any mark before you publish it.

YOUR CLASS IN ONE PLACE
Class average, the class exam record, and class mastery.

RESULTS STRAIGHT FROM THE TEACHER
Share the class code with your students. Each student sees only the results you publish for them.

LESSONS AND QUIZZES FROM YOUR SOURCES
Add your books and materials, and build lessons and quizzes from them.

Upgrade to get more.

- Monthly: renews every month until you cancel.

name: Smoosh: Days Together Widget
description:
Smoosh counts the days you've been together and keeps the number where you both see it: on your Home Screen and your Lock Screen. Two little creatures, one for each of you, squish cheeks when you think of each other.

DAYS TOGETHER
• Set the day it all started and see it in days, and in years, months and days.
• Smoosh spots the round ones for you: 100 days, 1,000 days, every anniversary. You get a reminder that morning.

PAIR UP
• Invite your partner with a link or a 6-digit code. Once they join, you both see the same counter, the same names and the same background.
• Got an invite? Tap the link: Smoosh opens with the code already filled in.

SEND A SMOOSH
• Tap the heart in the app or right on the widget. Your partner gets a notification and sees it on their widget.
• Both tap within the same minute, and it's a match.

KEEP YOUR STREAK
• Every day one of you smooshes, your streak grows. The little flame next to your names keeps count.
• Earn badges along the way: 3, 5 and 10 days, a whole month, 100 days, a year. They stay, even if a streak ends.

WIDGETS
• A small widget for your Home Screen with your day count and a heart you can tap.
• Coming up: a countdown to your next date, right on the Home Screen.

OUR DATES
• Add your own dates: the first trip, moving in, a concert next month.
• Coming up counts down, the ones behind you count up. Set "every year" for anniversaries and birthdays.
• Reminders come a day before and on the day, for both of you.

LOOKS
• Pick a pattern for your home screen together: Plain, Dots and Hearts are free.
• Dress the two creatures up together, and you both see the same outfit.

NO ACCOUNT
• No email, no password, no ads. Sign-in is anonymous, and only your partner sees what you share.

SMOOSH PRO
One subscription unlocks Pro for both of you. If one of you pays, the other gets it too.
• Bigger widgets: Medium and Large, in your outfit and background.

A cute, ad-free block puzzle: pack the bento with no gaps!
Rolled omelet, rice balls, octopus sausages… fit adorable side-dish friends into the lunchbox until every cell is filled.

- A 60-stage story with Corosuke, Onimaru and Tamarun
- A new Today's Bento every day

- Switch between your bentos in one tap under My Bentos

PERFECT FOR
- A quick, relaxing break

name: SOBE: Hide & Seek Horror
description:
Five children played one last game of hide and seek in Echo Cove. None of them were found. Years later, Deniz comes back to their grandmother's house, and an old radio starts to count.

Ebe is very tall, blindfolded and patient. It cannot see you. It hears you. Every running step, every door and every creaking board tells it where to go.

YOUR LAST ROUND IS YOUR BEST TRICK
Each night has three rounds. When a round ends, the path you walked comes back as a blue ghost called your Echo, second by second. It opens the doors you opened and makes the noises you made.
- Let your old mistake pull Ebe away from you
- Stand your Echo on a pressure plate and walk through the door it holds
- Plan your next route from above before the round starts
- Turn your torch off and your past glows in the dark

FIVE PLACES, FIVE SETS OF RULES
- Room: floorboards that give you away
- Corridor: a closed school wing where the lights go out one by one
- Forest: fog, rustling bushes, a compass and a trail of string
- Train Tracks: a closed line, a hand car and a ghost train that wipes your Echoes
- Beach: the tide rises every round and the map gets smaller

Fifteen nights, 4 to 7 minutes each, and a story hidden in 60 clue cards.

HORROR WITHOUT BLOOD
No blood and no death. The fear comes from sound, darkness and holding your breath in a locker while something stands outside. Get caught and a long hand reaches out, SOBE! fills the screen and the round begins again. The tasks you finished stay finished.

Set the fear level, turn off flashing and play with one finger in Settings. No account, no energy timer, no loot boxes, no chat. Available in 44 languages. Best played with headphones.

name: SpaceVoy Satellite Tracker ISS
description:
Explore Earth and everything above it.

Right now, nearly 20,000 satellites and pieces of debris are circling our planet. SpaceVoy puts them on a beautiful 3D Earth, placed from the latest tracking data, refreshed once a day. Tap one to find out what it is, who sent it up there and why it matters.

A 3D EARTH TO EXPLORE
• The International Space Station and every Starlink satellite, free
• Day and night, city lights and the glow of the northern lights
• Zoom from deep space down to sharp NASA imagery
• Search by name or catalog number, or switch to a flat map

TONIGHT, WHERE YOU ARE
• When the International Space Station crosses your sky, and exactly where to look
• The next Starlink train: that string of lights you may have seen
• A reminder before good ISS passes
• Meteor showers, planets, the Moon and your best bet for the night

WHAT'S THAT LIGHT?
Saw something moving up there? Tell SpaceVoy what it looked like: how it moved, its color, whether it flashed. It helps you work out what you saw.

LEARN BY PLAYING

description:
You come down to the water at the bottom of the tide, and the first thing you notice is a flake of lilac glass in the wrack line. Tidefrost is a notebook for that moment: a jar for every piece the sea gives back, described by its colour, size and shape, the beach where you found it and the day you walked it.

Turn the piece over and the Shard Reader asks what you can see. How was the lip finished — laid on, tooled, or made by a machine? Where does the mould seam stop? Is there a pontil scar or a suction ring on the base, a sun-purple or straw cast in the glass, raised letters on the side? Every answer carries its own span of years, and the app keeps only the years they share, showing which sign set each end. When two signs cannot both be true, it tells you plainly that they disagree and which one to look at again, instead of inventing a date.

Further along the sand, the Feature Atlas keeps thirty drawn articles on lips, seams, bases, tints and embossing, each with how to tell it apart and the mistakes collectors usually make. The Colour Atlas holds thirty-two colours on a rarity scale of our own, from Shoreline to Abyss, and beside each one the share it has in your own jar — a colour under two percent of your finds is marked as rare for you.

Hold a piece up to the light and the Frost Gauge asks four questions about its edges, sheen, crescent pits and outline, then names its stage from Glint to Pebble. A Glint is still sharp and glossy, and the app suggests giving it back to the sea for a few more years.

Before the next walk, Tide Windows shows the new and full moons for the coming months, computed on the phone, with the days around them when the largest tidal ranges usually leave more of the shore uncovered. Not a tide forecast: a window points you to the right days, and the time of low water on your beach comes from local tide tables.

Everything stays on your phone. There is no account and no network, and the app never asks for the camera, your photos or your location.

The free version dates, grades and keeps up to 40 finds from 2 beaches with three months of tide windows. Tidefrost Pro, a one-time purchase, removes those limits and adds 24 atlas articles on base codes, closures, pharmacy and table glass, a 24-month calendar with perigean windows, statistics by beach and year, and CSV export.

• Reports for 7, 30 or 90 days
• Your whole message history, searchable

BUILT FOR YOUR TEAM
• Invite your team with the right role for each person
• Notifications for payments, campaigns, low balance and sender IDs
• Face ID or fingerprint lock, dark mode, English and French

One credit sends one SMS part. No subscription: you only pay for what you send.

Traitz Sms is made in Cameroon by Traitz Tech.

name: Trickbook
description:
Which trick should I learn next?
Open the library. Twelve tricks, each broken into four illustrated steps: foot position, the pop, the catch, the landing. Search by name, filter by what you can already do. Start with the one your mates keep landing.

I can do it regular. Does that count as learned?
Not yet. Every trick has four variations — Normal, Switch, Fakie and Nollie — and Trickbook keeps a separate score for each. Landing a kickflip switch is a different trick, and the log treats it that way.

How does it know if I landed it?
It doesn't. You do. Tap landed or missed after each attempt, undo if your thumb lied, and the success rate updates. No camera, no sensors, no guessing: the honest number is the one you enter.

What's a line?
A run through the park: this trick off that ledge, that variation over the next gap, in order. Name it, build it from your tricks and the obstacles at your spot, then rehearse it against a countdown and see what held up and what didn't.

Am I actually getting better?
Progress shows your overall rate, every trick on its own, and a dated history of sessions you can open one by one. Three weeks ago you were landing one in six. Now it's one in three. That's the answer.

Anything else?
Your stance, haptics and optional practice reminders in Settings. Everything stays on your phone. No account, no internet, no purchases, no ads.

Pick a trick. Count the attempts. Watch the number move.

name: Uncooked: Fix Attention Span
description:
How long can you actually focus? Uncooked measures your attention span in seconds, then gives you about 15 minutes of training a day to work on it.

THE ATTENTION TEST
Shapes appear one at a time for 2 minutes. Tap for every shape, but not the diamond. Your attention span is your longest unbroken stretch in the zone: every shape right, at your own steady pace. You get it in seconds, with your level: Fried, Cooked, Simmer, Chill or Uncooked. For reference, a 2023 study found that people aged 19 to 32 average 76 seconds.

DAILY TRAINING
- Breath focus: follow the ring and tap when your mind drifts. The target grows as you get steadier.
- Reading with questions: short reads on topics you pick, from history and space to music and money, each followed by a few questions. In research, reading with questions cut mind-wandering roughly in half.
- Phone-down hour: choose 30, 60 or 90 minutes and keep your phone down. A countdown shows on your Lock Screen. In a 2025 randomized study of 467 adults, two weeks off mobile internet measurably improved focus.

WATCH YOUR NUMBER MOVE
- A weekly check to see how your span changes
- A 30-day plan built from your answers
- Streaks and progress over time
- A daily reminder at the time you pick
- Learn: short articles on why your phone is hard to put down and how to focus
- Home Screen widgets
- A share card for your score

NO ACCOUNT
No sign-up and no login. Your answers, checks and training are saved on your iPhone. Erase my data, in Profile, deletes them.

Uncooked is a training app, not a medical test. It does not diagnose or treat any condition.

SUBSCRIPTION
Uncooked Pro is an auto-renewing subscription: $39.99 per year or $5.99 per week in the US. Prices vary by country, and the app shows the exact price before you buy. No free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://attention.magentic.bid/terms
Privacy Policy: https://attention.magentic.bid/privacy

name: VelquiraNostem
description: VelquiraNostem is a design calculator for skid-steer loaders. Calculate rated operating capacity (ROC), bucket volume, boom lift height, hydraulic breakout force, lateral stability, travel speed and cycle time. Enter the machine weight, bucket dimensions, pump pressure and cylinder diameter, and the app calculates all values in real time. Export the results as a PDF, CSV or DXF file.

name: Verimeter: AR Tape Measure
description:
Verimeter turns your iPhone and iPad camera into an all-in-one measuring kit. Point it at something and measure length, height, volume, angles and even whole rooms, with no tape measure needed.

FREE TOOLS
• Length and distance: tap two points to measure, or see how far away an object is
• Height, area and volume: walls, floors and boxes in a few taps
• Angle, slope and level: a protractor and spirit level in your pocket

PRO TOOLS
• One-tap box volume: aim at a box and get width, depth, height and volume
• Automatic person height and body measurements (shoulders, arms, legs)
• Foot size with shoe size conversion for your country
• Room floor plan with wall lengths and area
• Floor and wall flatness, with bumps and dips shown in color
• Paint and wallpaper calculator, furniture placement preview
• Diameter, 3D scan volume and surface area, speed
• Measure later from saved photos

Pro is a one-time purchase and also removes ads. You can also watch an ad to try a Pro tool once.

HANDY EXTRAS
• Edge snap: the crosshair snaps to edges and corners
• A short guide the first time you open each tool
• Save up to 10 named results per tool
• Metric (cm, m) and imperial (in, ft) units

GOOD TO KNOW
• Measurements are most accurate on iPhone Pro and iPad Pro models with LiDAR. Some tools, such as floor plans and 3D scans, require LiDAR.
• Results are for reference. For precise building or crafting work, double-check with a real tape measure.

name: Verso — Photo Stories
description:
Give your photos a back. Gather the moments you want to keep in a tactile album with cloth covers, paper pages and three print styles. Turn each photo over to write by hand, type a memory, or add a voice note.

See your album as a 3D keepsake. Open its cover, turn pages, rotate and resize it, or place it on a real table with AR on compatible devices.

Choose your own cover, captions, dates and places. Find written memories with on-device search. Share a card showing both sides, or export a Pro album as a PDF keepsake.

Start free with one album and thirty prints, typing, handwriting and card sharing. Verso Pro is an optional one-time purchase for unlimited albums and prints, voice notes up to three minutes, and PDF export. The app shows the current local price before purchase.

No account or ads. Albums are saved on your device. Optional place lookup uses the coordinates already in selected photos; it never requests your current location. English and Simplified Chinese. Cross-device album sync is not included.

name: VETTS for Vets
description:
VETTS for Vets is the app for veterinarians and veterinary clinics that answer questions from pet owners through the VETTS platform: for VETTS itself, or for their own clinic, group or organisation.

Please note: this is not the VETTS app in which pet owners consult a VETTS vet. VETTS for Vets is the workplace on the other side. Clinics use the VETTS platform for their own clients: questions come in through the clinic's website or portal, and the clinic's vets answer them here. You need an account from VETTS or from the clinic or organisation you work for.

FOR VETS AND CLINICS
• An inbox of new questions, per clinic and according to your schedule
• Pick up a question, answer it and close it, also on the go
• With every question: the animal's details, a summary of the intake and earlier conversations
• Messages in another language are translated, and you see what the client will read of your answer
• Dictate your answer instead of typing
• View photos and videos from the client, and attach a photo or PDF yourself
• Quick replies for what you write often
• Notes for colleagues, and hand a conversation over to a colleague
• Notifications for a new question or a reply from a client, only within the hours you set

FOR PET OWNERS
Did your clinic send you a link to your conversation by text message or email? If this app is on your phone, the link opens here. Read the answer, reply right away, and find your conversations again later. No account needed.

PRIVACY
A notification never contains what the client wrote. Data is stored in the EU. No ads, no tracking.

name: Video Compressor: Squeeze MP4
description:
Make large videos easier to store, send, and share — without uploading a single frame.

VideoCompressor shows the estimated output size before compression starts, so you know what you will get. Choose a clear preset, export only the audio, or process a whole album with Pro.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Compress videos to practical sharing sizes
• Keep the original resolution with High Quality
• Choose 720p, 480p, or the smallest 320p output
• Extract audio as an M4A file
• See the estimated file size before export
• Compare a frame from the original and compressed video
• Save a compressed copy while preserving the original capture date
• Queue up to 20 clips with Pro
• Receive a notification when a queue finishes

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Compression happens locally with Apple's video engine. There is no account, no video upload, no tracking, and no server that sees your footage. Your videos stay on your iPhone.

FREE AND PRO

Use one free video compression each day. Squeeze Pro unlocks unlimited exports, album queues, High Quality, Custom settings, and audio-only export.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple ID settings. A lifetime purchase is also available.

name: Video Translator: Dub & Sub
description:
Translate the speech in a video, then keep it as captions or hear it in a new voice.

Video Translator turns what is said into another language. Add translated captions and burn them into a new video, or dub the clip so a new voice speaks the translation. Music and other sounds stay, with the original voice lowered. Your original file is left as it is.

What you can do
• Detect the language spoken in a clip
• Translate the words into captions
• Edit any line before you save
• Burn the captions into a new video
• Dub the clip with a new voice
• Save in up to 1080p

The video stays on your phone. Audio from the clip is sent to create the transcript, the translation, and the dubbed voice.

One free minute is included so you can try it. Subscribe for more minutes, longer clips, and no ads.

Subscriptions
• Dub & Sub Weekly: $1.99 per week, with 20 minutes each week
• Dub & Sub Monthly: $4.99 per month, with 120 minutes each month
• Dub & Sub Yearly: $29.99 per year, with 200 minutes each month

name: Vision360: Photo & Video
description:
Feel like you are there again.

Vision360 opens your 360° photos and videos and lets you choose how to explore and share them. Look around with a swipe, change your perspective and turn a sphere into a frame worth keeping.

EXPLORE YOUR COLLECTION
Connect Photos and choose a folder to browse its albums and subfolders, or open media from Files. “All 360° photos” gathers photos from your albums and lets you browse by year, month and day.

FIND YOUR PERSPECTIVE
Drag to look around and pinch to zoom. Switch between Natural, Rectilinear, Ultra wide and Tiny Planet views. Adjust direction, tilt, horizon and aspect ratio.

RECORD AND SHARE
Export a photo frame as a JPEG or a flat video with a fixed view. Record your exploration in 4K UHD, 16:9, HEVC: hold and drag to control zoom. Crop detail depends on the original, and video features require compatible hardware.

COMPARE AND IMMERSE
View two items side by side with linked direction and zoom. Use the gyroscope on compatible devices or split view for a headset. Spatial movement uses ARKit and requires an uncovered camera; it does not reconstruct real depth. Show your view on a TV using Screen Mirroring.

KEEP YOUR ORIGINALS
Adjustments are saved in local projects. Exports are new items; photos and recordings can be saved to the Vision360 album. No Vision360 account, advertising or tracking.

TRIAL AND UNLOCK
Free download. Start the 7-day trial to use every feature. When the trial ends, viewing, importing, editing, comparison and export are locked until you purchase the permanent unlock. Your files and projects are not deleted. One in-app purchase unlocks Vision360 forever: no subscription and no automatic charge after the trial. The price is shown before you buy.

Vision360 supports monoscopic equirectangular spherical media. Processed exports are flat and SDR; HDR, stereoscopic 360° media and processed spherical exports are not supported. Projects do not sync between devices.

name: VOLTERRA Procurement
description:
VOLTERRA Procurement este un spațiu de lucru pentru pregătirea achizițiilor și documentațiilor în proiecte electrice de înaltă, medie și joasă tensiune.

• Organizează proiecte, beneficiari, amplasamente și limite de furnizare.
• Creează liste BOQ cu echipamente, cantități și specificații tehnice.
• Pregătește RFQ, cereri de ofertă și fișe tehnice.
• Calculează CAPEX și planifică tranșele de plată în cashflow.
• Compară ofertele introduse după cost, termen și conformitate declarată.
• Pregătește indexul dosarului și al cărții tehnice, cu etape FAT, SAT, montaj, commissioning și As-built.
• Exportă documente PDF, BOQ CSV și backupuri de proiecte.

Explorează gratuit proiectul demonstrativ. Abonamentul Pro deblochează proiecte noi și exportul documentelor. Sunt disponibile planuri lunare și anuale, cu prețul și perioada afișate de Apple înainte de achiziție.

Datele sunt păstrate local. Portalul opțional pentru solicitări și răspunsuri necesită configurarea separată a unui serviciu HTTPS de către operator.

Estimările folosesc datele introduse de utilizator. Modelele și documentele necesită verificare și aprobare profesională. Proformele sunt ciorne, nu facturi fiscale. Echipamentele, lucrările și consultanța inginerească personalizată nu sunt incluse în abonamentul software.

name: Voxfira: Mic Monitor & Reverb
description:
Make a little room for your voice.

Hear yourself through headphones, check a sustained note, sing with your own backing track, and listen back to a take. Everything you record or import stays on your iPhone. No account, ads, tracking, or data collection.

START WITH THE FREE VERSION
• Live voice monitoring with Natural and Small Room sound presets.
• Note names, frequency, and a cents gauge for single-note singing.
• Adjustable A4 reference from 430 to 450 Hz, with letter names or solfege.
• Import one MP3, M4A, or WAV backing track, up to 10 minutes long.
• Record takes up to 30 seconds; listen, rename, and delete locally.

PRO — ONE-TIME IN-APP PURCHASE
• All seven sound presets.
• An eight-second pitch history curve.
• Multiple imported backing tracks and A–B looping.
• Recordings without the free version's time limit.
• Recording export and sharing.
The current price is shown in the app. Restore a previous purchase in Settings.

FOR COMFORTABLE PRACTICE
Wired or USB-C headphones work best. Bluetooth introduces extra delay. With the built-in speaker, live voice monitoring is automatically muted to prevent feedback; pitch detection, backing playback, and recording still work. Pitch detection is intended for one voice singing one note at a time. The app does not include commercial songs or a song catalog.

name: VSVP Attendance App
description:
VSVP Attendance App helps event volunteers and organizers record attendance by scanning QR codes on ID cards.
Sign in with your account, open the scanner and point your camera at a participant's ID card QR code. The app looks up the registration, shows the participant's details and marks them as checked in. If a card has already been scanned, the app warns you straight away so you can avoid duplicate entries.
KEY FEATURES
• Fast QR scanning: check in attendees in seconds using your phone's camera.
• Registration details: see the participant's subscription and registration information right after a scan.
• Duplicate detection: get an "Already scanned" alert if an ID card has already been checked in.
• Scan history: review every scan made on your device, copy a participant's UUID and download the scan list.
• Offline-friendly: scans are saved on your device and synced when you are back online. You are reminded to sync before you log out.
• Secure access: only authorized users can sign in and record attendance.
Whether you are managing a single entrance or a large gathering, VSVP Attendance App keeps check-in simple, accurate and paperless.
Note: This app is intended for authorized VSVP staff and volunteers. A valid login is required.

name: Vzato – Medication Reminder
description:
Vzato reminds you of every medication at the right time and, above all, tells you whether you already took it. No more "did I take it this morning?".

• One big card for the dose that is due, with a big Taken button
• Reminders with Taken, Snooze and Skip, repeated when you don't confirm
• Tablets, half and quarter tablets, drops, millilitres, teaspoons, puffs
• History with a calendar, corrections, export for your doctor (CSV)
• Supply tracking: counts down by itself, warns when you run low and estimates when you run out
• Supply check: count the pills at home and Vzato shows whether the records match
• Photos of the package, the pill and the leaflet
• Home screen and Lock Screen widgets with a Taken button
• Sync between iPhone, iPad and Mac through your own iCloud
• Activity log: who recorded a dose, when and on which device
• Czech, Slovak, English and Hungarian

Privacy first: no account, no server, no analytics, no ads. The developer never sees your data.

Vzato is free and open source (MPL-2.0).

Vzato is not a medical device and does not replace your doctor or pharmacist. It gives no medical advice; it reminds you and keeps your own records.

name: W-01: Your Workout Companion
description:
W-01 is a workout companion app.  Log your workouts every day in a very easy to use format.  No internet needed.  No external server.  No subscription - just a really simple workout tracker.  The calendar shows each day you worked out, and streaks are stored the entire time.

In the app, you'll meet W-01.  Totally optional friend, just encouraging you to keep going!

The goal isn't to be fancy - it's to make tracking workouts simpler.

name: Wanderlst
description:
WNDR turns your surroundings into a guided tour of history. Open the app and it finds Wikipedia articles about places near you, starting with the closest. Swipe to skip, tap back to revisit, and tap the arrow to get directions.

• Nearby stories: landmarks, buildings, parks, and places of local interest • Walking or driving directions to any story • Local food ideas based on the area • Bookmarks and history while the app is open • Explore any city on the map without sharing your location

Article text comes from Wikipedia and is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0. Each card links to the full article.

WNDR is free and has no ads or accounts. Optional tips are available in the app.

name: WatchFootball: Goal Alerts
description:
WatchFootball follows one club: yours. Pick the league and your club, no account needed, and get the live score, goal alerts and the next match on your iPhone, on the Lock Screen and on your Apple Watch.

FREE
• Live score with minute and scorers
• Goal alert for your club
• Match center: live ticker, table and line-ups
• No ads, no betting, no news feed

ALERTS ONLY FOR YOUR CLUB
A switch for each event: your goal, goal against, line-up, kick-off, half-time and full-time, red card and missed penalty. No alerts for matches you don't follow.

SPOILER PROTECTION (with Season Pass)
Your TV or stream runs behind? Delay every alert by up to 60 seconds. Or sync with your TV: at the next goal tap "Goal seen on TV" and WatchFootball takes the gap as your delay.

IPHONE
• Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island while the match is on (with Season Pass)
• Widgets for the Home Screen and the Lock Screen: live score or next match with countdown, and table position
• Every widget shows when it was last updated

APPLE WATCH
• Complications: live score, countdown to kickoff, table position
• Watch app with the live score
• Goal alerts with their own look and haptic, different for your goal and a goal against

SEASON PASS (optional, 14-day free trial)
Alerts for line-up, kick-off, half time, full time, red cards and penalties, plus the spoiler delay, TV sync and the Live Activity. Live score and goal alert stay free.

UNOFFICIAL
WatchFootball is an unofficial fan app with no connection to any club, league or association. Clubs appear as a neutral shield with initials in club colours, never as a crest or logo.

Terms of Use: https://watchfootball.store/terms
Privacy: https://watchfootball.store/privacy
Questions or a data error? support@watchfootball.store

name: Who’d it be? – Party Game
description:
Who is always late? Who would give up first on a desert island? In “Who’d it be?” everyone secretly votes for the friend who fits the question best. You score when you side with the majority. By the end you’ll know who really reads the group best.

HOW IT WORKS
• Create a room and share the code or QR code
• Friends join with the app or simply play in their browser, no download needed
• Everyone votes on their own phone, then comes the big reveal
• For 3 to 12 players, 10, 15 or 20 rounds

WHAT’S INSIDE
• 120 free questions: Social, Skills and Future
• 20 question packs with 40 questions each: Chaos & Cringe, Adventure & What If, Big Brain, Animal Kingdom, Roast, Food & Drink, Throwback, Movies & TV, Wanderlust, Sports & Games, Work Life, Christmas, Love & Dating, Music, Gaming & Online, Family, What If, School & College, Summer & Festivals and Spicy
• Big Brain and Animal Kingdom serve a “Did you know?” fact after every question
• Build your own blob avatar with hairstyles, glasses, hats, patterns and backgrounds
• Your rules: voting time, self-votes, “Nobody” as an answer, anonymous mode and auto-advance
• Titles for everyone at the end and a result card to share

FAIR FOR EVERYONE
• The host unlocks, everyone in the room plays. Guests never pay.
• Party Pass: buy once, every pack forever, Spicy included
• Or pick just the packs you want
• No subscription, no ads, no account, no tracking

Perfect for game night, birthdays, bachelor and bachelorette parties, house parties, school trips, the office Christmas party or your next road trip.

A game by YNOAI.

name: WorkProof: Job Reports
description:
WorkProof helps solo tradespeople record repair and maintenance jobs before leaving the site. Keep the work, the photos and the customer handover together in one report.

RECORD THE JOB
Add customer and job details, the job date, work carried out, time spent, materials and outstanding items. Use the handover checklist or add your own checks.

SHOW BEFORE AND AFTER
Import photos or use your iPhone camera. Label them Before or After and add captions so your customer can understand what changed.

REVIEW AND SIGN
Review the report with your customer and collect their signature on your iPhone. Signed reports are locked. Create a new draft if you need to record a change.

SHARE A CLEAR PDF
Preview a multipage PDF with the work notes, checklist, photos and signature. Share it using the iOS share sheet or save it to Files. Your business name is included in the free tier.

WORK OFFLINE
Reports stay on your device. No account, server, ads, AI or analytics. An internet connection is needed for App Store purchases and restoration. iOS device backup depends on your settings; WorkProof does not provide cloud sync or recovery.

FREE AND PRO
The free tier includes three stored reports, photos, signatures and PDF export. Delete a report to free a slot. WorkProof Pro is an optional one-time in-app purchase that unlocks unlimited reports, your logo on PDFs without the WorkProof footer, and saved reusable checklists. The price is shown in the app before purchase. No subscription. Restore Pro with the same Apple Account.

WorkProof documents a job handover. It is not an invoice, safety certification or qualified electronic signature. Export important PDFs before deleting reports or uninstalling the app.

name: Yamba Taxi
description:
Yamba Taxi, votre mobilité simplement.

Née à Pointe-Noire, Yamba Taxi est une entreprise de mobilité qui rend vos déplacements et vos envois plus simples, plus sûrs et plus transparents.

TAXI
• Commandez un taxi en quelques secondes, sans inscription : votre nom et votre téléphone suffisent.
• Le prix vous est proposé avant le départ : vous l’acceptez ou proposez le vôtre.
• Suivez votre chauffeur en direct sur la carte et recevez une notification à chaque étape.
• Code de prise en charge : vous êtes sûr de monter dans le bon taxi.
• Transfert aéroport, chauffeur à disposition, trajets réguliers et courses réservées à l’avance.

LIVRAISON
• Envoyez documents, colis et achats partout en ville.
• Code de livraison et photo de remise : la preuve que le colis est arrivé.
• Plusieurs destinations en une seule course.
• « Courses pour moi » : nous faisons vos achats et vous les livrons.

SÉCURITÉ
• Chauffeurs identifiés et formés.
• Partagez votre trajet en direct avec un proche.
• Bouton d’alerte relié à l’équipe Yamba Taxi pendant la course.

PAIEMENT
• Espèces au chauffeur, Mobile Money (MTN, Airtel) ou carte prépayée Yamba.
