ASSISTANCE
• Messagerie avec votre chauffeur et l’équipe Yamba Taxi.
• Objet oublié : prévenez le chauffeur jusqu’à 72 h après la course.
• Pas de crédit ? Bipez nous, on vous rappelle en moins de 10 minutes.

Disponible en français et en anglais.
www.yambataxi.com

name: ZUREQ Shopper
description:
Search independent online shops in one place. ZUREQ Shopper is a native iPhone app for the ZUREQ marketplace API: type what you need, pick a country or the whole EU, and get real products from real shops with live prices and stock.

SEARCH
- One search across many independent shops
- Choose a market: a single country or all of the EU
- Filter by price range and in-stock only
- Live price and availability check before you buy
- Open the shop's checkout page straight from the app

WATCHLIST
- Star any product to keep an eye on it
- Refresh to see how every price moved since you added it

SHOPPING LIST
- Type up to 10 things you need
- Get in-stock options for each, pick one per item
- Picks are grouped by shop with a total and one checkout button per shop

CREDITS
- See your ZUREQ plan, remaining credits and what each action costs
- Warning before you run out

Sign in with your ZUREQ account or paste an API key from chat.zureq.io/developers. Your sign-in and lists stay on your phone; nothing is tracked.

ZUREQ Shopper is an independent app built on the public ZUREQ API. Orders and payments happen on the shop's own website.

name: Школа Поколение
description:
Школа Поколение — приложение одной частной школы «Поколение» в Воронеже для будущих семей, родителей учеников и педагогов.

БЕЗ РЕГИСТРАЦИИ
• Сведения о школе, программах, полном дне и контактах.
• Предварительный расчёт стоимости обучения: формат, число месяцев и вступительный взнос. Питание, учебники и форма оплачиваются отдельно; окончательные условия подтверждает школа.
• Личный список подготовки к экскурсии с сохранением отметок на устройстве.
• Связь с приёмной по телефону и почте, маршрут до школы. Отправку письма подтверждаете вы в почтовом приложении.
• Справка с поиском и инструкциями для родителей и учителей.

РОДИТЕЛЯМ
В закрытом кабинете доступны расписание, темы и домашние задания, оценки и комментарии учителей, объявления, суммы и статусы оплаты обучения. Родитель видит только детей, связанных с его профилем.

УЧИТЕЛЯМ
Расписание назначенных классов и предметов, добавление уроков и домашних заданий, выставление оценок и комментариев. Набор действий ограничен ролью и назначениями.

КАК ПОЛУЧИТЬ КАБИНЕТ
Родителей и учителей регистрирует администратор школы. Он связывает родителей с детьми и назначает учителям классы и предметы. Самостоятельной регистрации нет. Если доступ ещё не выдан или пароль забыт, обратитесь к администратору.

В профиле можно изменить пароль, завершить другие сессии и подать запрос на удаление аккаунта. Срок обработки запроса — до 30 календарных дней.

На экране входа доступен явный демонстрационный режим с вымышленными данными для родителей, учителей и администратора. Он работает без интернета, изменения остаются на устройстве. Для реального кабинета требуется интернет.

Приложение не принимает оплату банковскими картами и не переводит деньги. Расчёт стоимости, список подготовки и письмо без отправки не являются заявкой, бронированием или договором.

name: أوراق - مكتبتك في هاتفك
description:
أوراق مكتبتك في هاتفك. تطلب منه الكتب والكتب الدراسية والملازم والروايات وكتب الأطفال والقرطاسية، وتطبع ملفاتك وكتبك، ويوصلك الطلب لباب البيت، وتدفع نقداً للمندوب عند الاستلام.

شنو تلگى بأوراق؟
• الكتب الدراسية حسب المرحلة، من الأول المتوسط لحد السادس الإعدادي (علمي وأدبي).
• ملازم الأساتذة للمواد الدراسية.
• روايات وأدب وشعر وتطوير الذات وعلوم وتاريخ.
• كتب أطفال يختارها الأهل لعيالهم.
• قرطاسية ومستلزمات الدراسة.

اطبع ملفاتك وكتبك
• ارفع ملف PDF أو صور من موبايلك: كتاب، ملزمة، بحث أو أوراق.
• اختار الطباعة أبيض وأسود أو ملونة، وجه واحد أو وجهين، وحجم A4 أو A5.
• حدد عدد النسخ والتجليد (تدبيس أو حلزوني أو حراري).
• تشوف السعر قبل ما تطلب، ونوصل المطبوع لباب بيتك ويا باقي طلبك.

تصفّح قبل ما تطلب
كثير من الكتب بيها عينة مجانية. تفتحها داخل التطبيق وتقرأ صفحات منها، وتختار حجم الخط ولون الصفحة (فاتح، ورقي، ليلي) حتى تقرر براحتك.

لگّي كتابك بسهولة
• ابحث باسم الكتاب أو المؤلف أو المكتبة.
• صفّي النتائج حسب التصنيف والمرحلة الدراسية والسعر، أو اعرض الكتب اللي بيها عينة بس.
• رتّب حسب الأكثر قراءة أو الأعلى تقييماً أو الأحدث.

طلب بسيط بخطوات واضحة
• أضف الكتب للسلة وغيّر الكمية متى ما تريد.
• اختر محافظتك واكتب منطقتك وأقرب نقطة دالة.
• تشوف ملخص المبلغ ورسوم التوصيل قبل ما تأكد الطلب.
• الدفع نقداً عند الاستلام. ماكو بطاقة وماكو دفع مسبق.

تابع طلبك
بـ«طلباتي» تشوف كل طلب وحالته خطوة بخطوة، وتوصلك إشعارات لما تتغير حالة الطلب.

مكتبتي والمفضلة
احفظ الكتب اللي تعجبك بالمفضلة، وارجع للكتاب اللي جاي تقرأ عينته من نفس الصفحة اللي وگفت عليها.

التوصيل لباب البيت
نوصّل لكل محافظات العراق. رسوم التوصيل تبين لك بالسلة حسب محافظتك قبل ما تأكد الطلب.

خصوصيتك
ماكو إعلانات بالتطبيق، وما نتتبعك ولا نبيع بياناتك. نستخدم اسمك وعنوانك ورقمك حتى نوصلك طلبك ونتواصل وياك بخصوصه بس، والملفات اللي ترفعها للطباعة نستخدمها للطباعة بس وتنحذف تلقائياً بعد فترة.

حمّل أوراق، واختار كتابك الجاي.

name: 데굴데굴 여행: 굴리고 찍어라!
description:
네모는 빨간 도장이 달린 작은 상자예요. 여권을 챙겨 여행을 떠난 네모를 데굴데굴 굴려서, 나라마다 기다리는 서류에 도장을 꾹 찍어 주세요.

■ 굴리면 아랫면이 바뀌어요
한 칸 굴릴 때마다 네모의 아랫면이 바뀌어요. 도장 면이 서류 위에 딱 닿도록 길을 생각해 보세요. 머릿속으로 미리 굴려 보는 재미가 있어요.

■ 나라마다 새 여행
우리 집 마당에서 연습하고 우리 동네, 빵 마을, 고양이 섬, 눈 나라, 별 우체국을 지나 더 먼 나라까지 떠나요. 나라 끝 국경 판을 넘으면 여권에 큰 입국 도장이 찍혀요.

■ 새 발판이 계속 나와요
한 번 지나가면 부서지는 크래커, 단추를 밟으면 생기는 바게트 다리, 들어가면 다른 곳으로 나오는 포탈, 쭉 미끄러지는 얼음, 도장 색을 바꾸는 잉크대까지. 새 발판이 처음 나올 때는 움직이는 안내가 먼저 보여 줘요.

■ 여권에 도장 꾹
판을 깨면 여권에 도장이 하나씩 쌓여요. 별 세 개를 노려 다시 도전해도 좋아요. 매일 들르면 출석 수첩에 출석 도장도 찍혀요.

■ 꾸미기 큐브
딸기잼 자국을 찍는 빵큐브, 발도장을 찍는 냥큐브처럼 네모 대신 굴릴 꾸미기 큐브를 골라 보세요. 국경을 넘으면 선물로 받는 꾸미기도 있고, 상점에서 먼저 굴려 본 뒤 살 수 있는 꾸미기도 있어요. 꾸미기는 모양과 연출만 바뀌고 판이 쉬워지지는 않아요.

■ 천천히, 내 속도로
시간 제한이 없어요. 되돌리기와 처음부터는 언제든 무제한이고, 막히면 다음 한 수를 알려 주는 힌트가 있어요. 소리는 낮고 둥글게, 화면은 차분하게 만들었어요.

■ 광고와 광고 제거
판 사이에 가끔 광고가 나와요. 처음 몇 판과 판을 푸는 도중에는 나오지 않아요. '광고 제거'를 사면 판 사이 광고가 사라지고 힌트도 광고 없이 바로 받아요.

인터넷이 없어도 할 수 있어요. 회원가입도 없어요.

name: 클라우드윙: 클래식 비행 슈팅

name: 乙4ライン｜危険物乙4 試験対策
description:
3科目を、合格ラインへ。

乙4ラインは、危険物取扱者 乙種第4類を学ぶための独立した学習アプリです。独自問題600問を、正解だけでなく、ほかの選択肢が違う理由から理解していきます。

【選んだ答えの、その先まで】
・全600問に、正解と各選択肢の解説
・解説から参考資料を確認
・物理・化学の考え方を図でも確認

【苦手を集めて、もう一度】
・気になる問題を保存
・間違えた問題をまとめて復習
・後日の復習と学習記録で、自分のペースをつくる

【3科目それぞれの合格基準】
一般受験に対応した35問・120分の模試を収録。法令15問中9問、物理・化学10問中6問、性質・消火10問中6問が目標です。合計点だけでなく、各科目の結果を別々に確認できます。科目免除の専用形式には対応していません。

【まずは30問を無料で】
3科目から10問ずつ、解説・保存・復習・学習記録を試せます。完全版は1回の購入で全600問と模試を利用できます。定期購入や自動更新はありません。価格は購入前にApp Storeから取得して表示します。購入の復元にも対応しています。

【毎日の学習を、使いやすく】
iPhoneとiPad、ライト・ダーク表示、大きな文字に対応。任意の学習リマインダーと触覚フィードバックは設定から変更できます。学習データは端末内に保存され、アカウント、広告、解析SDK、トラッキングはありません。

乙4ラインの問題・解説・図は独自に作成した学習用コンテンツです。消防試験研究センターや行政機関の公式アプリではなく、本試験の問題の再現や合格を保証するものではありません。

name: 基本情報技術者 科目A 過去問ドリル
description:

・図や表は IPA の問題の図をそのまま表示し、拡大して見られます
・解いている最中に広告は出ません

科目A（2026年度）の公開問題20問と、午前（2019年度秋期）の過去問79問を無料で解けます。

残りの問題がすべて解けるようになり、広告も表示されなくなります。

description:
英検たんごは、英検の5級から1級までの英単語・熟語をおぼえるアプリです。
よく出る語から順に、暗記カード・4択クイズ・熟語の穴埋めで練習できます。

「おぼえていない」語だけ、自分で入れた「マイリスト」の語だけにしぼって練習できます。カードにメモも書けます。

name: 行山喇 Trail Stamp
description:
Trail Stamp takes you along Hong Kong's four long-distance trails: the MacLehose, Wilson, Hong Kong and Lantau Trails. That's 40 sections, 298 km and 576 distance posts. Offline maps show the way, posts are stamped automatically as you pass them, and an AI guide tells you about the hills, rocks and history along the way.

AI Guide
• Narration at trail spots: where to look, what it is, the rock's age and the story behind it, read aloud
• Narration for every distance post: what you can see, what's underfoot, what's next
• Ask by voice anytime, for example "What am I looking at?", "Where's the nearest toilet?" or "How much longer to go?". Before answering, it checks your position, the Observatory weather and official records
• Narration downloads with each section and plays without signal
• Read aloud in Mandarin, Cantonese or English
• New accounts get a free Day Pass on their first hike, with the AI guide fully on for 24 hours

Automatic stamps
• Posts are stamped automatically as you reach them, with your phone in your pocket
• Every post is a badge with its number and the date you passed it, with a badge wall for each trail
• Check in with a photo within 35 m of a trail spot

Offline maps
• Routes and Lands Department topographic maps are saved on your phone
• See where you are, how far the next post is, and how far you've strayed from the trail
• Estimates whether you'll finish before dark at your pace, and suggests the nearest exit when needed
• Observatory warnings and trail closures before you set off
• Keeps recording with the screen locked

Certificates and exploration reports
• Certificates carry your name, the official distance, total ascent and date, with a serial you can scan to verify
• Exploration reports record your track, time, elevation profile and the posts you stamped
• Whole-trail certificates, and a Grand Slam for all four trails; save certificates and reports as images to share

Emergency help
• An SOS button stays on the hike screen and calls 999 in one tap
• Shows the nearest distance post, a sentence you can read out, HK1980 grid and latitude/longitude, and the nearest AEDs

Free: routes, offline maps, distance-post stamps, photo check-ins, voice prompts, section briefings, certificates and posters.
AI Guide Pass: a Day Pass (unlimited for 24 hours) or a yearly subscription (unlimited for a year). The yearly subscription renews automatically and can be cancelled anytime in iPhone Settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://trailstamp.app/privacy

Routes, distance posts and facilities come from open data published by AFCD, the Antiquities and Monuments Office, the Lands Department and the Hong Kong Observatory. Trail Stamp is an independent app by TopoMind Limited, not an official government app. Check the weather and trail conditions before you set off; in an emergency, call 999.

name: MIDI to Audio Converter
description:
MIDI to Audio Converter turns your MIDI files into real audio: MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, AAC, OGG, Opus and AIFF. Everything is rendered on your device by a SoundFont synthesizer. It works offline, and your files never leave your device.

BATCH CONVERTER
• Add single files or whole folders including subfolders (drag and drop on Mac and Windows)
• Converts several files in parallel, with progress and time left for each file
• Choose the format, bitrate or bit depth, sample rate (22.05 to 96 kHz) and mono or stereo
• Keep the folder structure and name the files with a template
• Safe by design: your MIDI files are only read and existing files are never overwritten. If you add a file you have already converted, you choose whether to convert it again or skip it
• Save your favourite settings as presets

SOUND
• Built-in GeneralUser GS soundbank, ready to go
• Download more free soundbanks in the app, or import your own SF2 and SF3 files and TiMidity GUS patch sets (e.g. EAW) as a zip
• Reverb (room, hall, plate, cathedral), chorus and delay
• Tempo from 25 % to 300 %, transpose by ±24 semitones, speed (tempo and pitch together, like a turntable)
• Loudness normalisation (−14, −16 or −23 LUFS), volume, fade-out and natural reverb tails
• Trim the start and the end

LIVE PLAYER
• Play MIDI files through any soundbank, with falling notes or a piano roll and an 88-key keyboard
• 16-channel mixer: mute, solo, volume, pan and instrument for every channel, drum kit selector
• A/B loop, playlists, shuffle and repeat

• Change the soundbank, effects, tempo and transposition while you listen, then save the result as an audio file

Opens .mid, .midi, .kar and .rmi files (Standard MIDI File type 0 and 1).

FREE DEMO
Try everything for free. In the demo, playback and conversion stop after 20 seconds per file, and effects, tempo and pitch changes are locked. Unlock the full version with a monthly subscription or a one-time purchase. Both unlock exactly the same features.

No ads. No account. No tracking.

name: MEMATT: Clear & Hold

description:
The war is over. The mines are not.

In MEMATT: Clear & Hold you drive MEMATT, an unmanned armoured mine-clearing vehicle. Every operation has two phases: first clear the corridor, then defend the same ground.

CLEAR
• Find buried mines with the scanner and lift them safely with the flail in MINE MODE.
• Every mine you lift gives scrap — or leave it in place and turn it into a trap for the enemy.

HOLD

CAMPAIGN

TIMER
• Drag the disk or tap the digits to set the minutes

• Disk color: red, blue, green, purple or orange

• Focus mode fills the screen with the disk

POMODORO AND MATCHES

STUDY RECORDS

SOUNDS AND HEADS-UP ALERTS

ONLY ON iPhone

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no analytics and no account. Wontimer collects no data.

name: עוזרון
description:
עוזרון היא אפליקציה עצמאית ואינה מופעלת, מאושרת או מיוצגת על ידי צה״ל או משרד הביטחון. המידע הרשמי למשרתי מילואים מתפרסם באתר https://www.miluim.idf.il/ בלבד.

עוזרון נועדה לחסוך את העבודה השגרתית שסביב תקופת מילואים: הרשמה לטופס כניסה רכובה, מעקב על המשמרות, תזכורות בזמן, והכנת בקשות החזר לקרן הסיוע. הכול נשאר במכשיר שלך — אין חשבון משתמש, אין הרשמה, ואין שרת שאוסף את הפרטים שלך.

הרשמה לכניסה רכובה
• שמירת הפרטים שאתה ממלא כל פעם מחדש: שם, מספר אישי, טלפון, סוג שירות, דרגה ופרטי רכב.
• מילוי טופס Microsoft Forms שאתה מגדיר — ידנית בלחיצה אחת, או בהתראה בשעה שהטופס נפתח: הקשה עליה פותחת את האפליקציה והרישום נשלח מיד.
• אזהרה לפני הרשמה כפולה לאותו תאריך, והיסטוריית הרשמות לצפייה בכל עת.
• אפשר להגדיר את הפרטים והתזמונים גם כשהטופס סגור.

משמרות ויומן
• ייבוא לוח המשמרות מגיליון Google שאתה מקבל הרשאת צפייה אליו.
• הוספת המשמרות ליומן באייפון, כולל זיהוי שינויים שנוספו לגיליון מאז הסנכרון האחרון ואישור שלך לפני העדכון.

תזכורות
• התראה ביום שלפני משמרת.
• תזכורת לבקשת מיטה ב-BOQ למשמרת הקרובה, עם חיוג למוצב מנהלה.

הודעות WhatsApp מוכנות
• דוח משמרות שבועי למשרד המילואים.
• הודעת התייצבות לפני משמרת.
• הודעה למוצב מנהלה לאחר רישום למשמרת צהריים.
ההודעות נפתחות ב-WhatsApp לבדיקה שלך — השליחה תמיד בידיים שלך.

קרן הסיוע
• קטלוג של נושאי הסיוע לפי הטופס הרשמי, ובהם כביש 6, טיפול בילדים ובייביסיטר, שאגת הארי, מעבר דירה, קייטנות, נזק לרכב או לציוד אישי, אובדן הכנסה של בן/בת זוג, מענקים לעצמאים ולבני זוג, ועוד.
• בדיקה איזה נושא רלוונטי לך בחודש מסוים ואיזה מסמכים נדרשים.
• צירוף המסמכים מראש, ומילוי טבלת סכומים לפי שנה וחודש היכן שהטופס הרשמי דורש זאת.
• מצב מונחה שממלא עבורך את הטופס הרשמי ומצרף את המסמכים, כשהשליחה הסופית נשארת בלחיצה שלך.
• תזכורת חודשית שלא תפספס החזר שמגיע לך.

אישור כניסה רכובה
מסך נקי להצגה בש״ג עם התאריך, השם, המספר האישי ומספר הרכב.

פרטיות
• הפרטים, המסמכים וההיסטוריה נשמרים במכשיר בלבד, ונשלחים רק כשאתה מבצע פעולה.
• אין מסד נתונים חיצוני של פרטים אישיים ואין לי גישה לתשובות, למסמכים או להודעות שאתה שולח.
• גישת Google לגיליון היא הרשאת צפייה בלבד.
• אין פרסומות, אין מעקב ואין איסוף נתוני שימוש.
• בהגדרות יש מחיקה מלאה של כל המידע מהמכשיר.
מדיניות הפרטיות המלאה: https://sites.google.com/view/rachuvon/בית

הרשאות
אינטרנט, התראות, יומן, רענון ברקע, והתחברות ל-Google לצורך קריאת הגיליון.

האפליקציה בעברית ובאנגלית, עם מצב כהה ובהיר.

name: Duda
description:
Du brauchst das halbe Schuljahr, bis du die Namen deiner neuen Klassen kannst? Dann kommen zwei Wochen Ferien, und die Hälfte ist wieder weg? Dann ist duda genau das Richtige für dich.

duda bringt dir die Namen deiner Schülerinnen und Schüler bei: mit ein paar Minuten am Tag und so, dass sie auch nach den Ferien noch sitzen.

IN MINUTEN STARTKLAR
Sichere den Sitzplan aus TeacherTool als PDF und öffne ihn in duda. Fotos, Namen und Sitzplätze werden automatisch erkannt. Alternativ importierst du Fotos aus der Mediathek, aus Ordnern oder zusammen mit einer CSV-Liste. Vor dem Speichern kannst du alles prüfen und korrigieren.

5 NAMEN AUF EINMAL
Statt 28 Gesichtern auf einmal lernst du immer nur fünf neue Namen. Erst wenn diese sitzen, kommen die nächsten fünf. Jeder Name wird vorgestellt und dann mehrmals abgefragt, mit wachsenden Abständen dazwischen.

WISSENSCHAFTLICH LERNEN STATT PAUKEN
duda nutzt verteiltes Wiederholen (Spaced Repetition). Jeder Name kommt genau dann wieder dran, wenn du ihn sonst vergessen würdest: erst nach einem Tag, dann nach drei, sieben, vierzehn Tagen und so weiter. So wandern die Namen ins Langzeitgedächtnis. Die Übungen werden mit der Zeit schwerer, vom Wiedererkennen bis zum freien Erinnern.

VIELE ÜBUNGSARTEN
• Wie heißt das Kind? Name zum Foto wählen.
• Wo ist …? Das richtige Gesicht finden.
• Wer sitzt hier? Namen direkt am Sitzplan lernen.
• Namen frei eintippen
• Karteikarten
• Tempo-Runde und Zuordnungsspiel
• Verwechslungs-Training: duda merkt sich, wen du oft vertauschst, und lässt dich genau diese Kinder gezielt üben.

KNIFFLIG, ABER FAIR
Die Antwortmöglichkeiten sind keine leichten Treffer. duda zeigt dir ähnliche Kinder: gleiches Geschlecht, gleiche Klasse, Sitznachbarn. Wenn du richtig geraten hast, sagst du das mit „War geraten“, und der Name kommt früher wieder dran.

DEINE KLASSEN, DEINE PRIORITÄTEN
Markiere Klassen als wichtig, optional oder pausiert, und ordne sie per Drag & Drop. Die neuen Fünften lernst du zuerst, die Vertretungsklasse kommt danach dran. Bunte Kacheln zeigen auf einen Blick, wie viele Namen schon sitzen.

DRANBLEIBEN MACHT SPASS
• Tägliche Erinnerung zu deiner Wunschzeit
• Statistiken zu deinem Lernfortschritt
• Erfolge und Auszeichnungen für Serien und gelernte Klassen

DATENSCHUTZ
Schülerfotos und Namen bleiben auf deinem Gerät. Es gibt kein Konto und kein Tracking. Auch die Texterkennung im Sitzplan läuft komplett auf dem Gerät.

Für iPhone und iPad.

name: Zodiac Birthday Tracker
description:
Zodiac Birthday Tracker is a birthday reminder that does the hard part for you. Add the people you love, and you'll be reminded before every birthday and on the day. When it comes, their card is ready: a reading of their exact birthday, written to send.

• A card for every birthday: each of the 366 days of the year has its own reading, so March 14 isn't just "a Pisces". Every card is warm, a little witty, and written to make them smile.
• Reminders that arrive in time: a few days before and on the day, at the time you choose. Several birthdays on one day come as one reminder.
• What they'd love: every reading ends with an idea for the day, whether that's a gift, a plan or a message.
• Your own day: start with your birthday and see your reading and your card, ready to share when it's your turn.
• Send it anywhere: the card goes out as an image with a message through any app you already use.
• Add people your way: type in a name and a date, or pick the friends whose birthdays are already saved in your contacts. A birth year is optional; add it to see who's turning 30.

Private by design: no account, no sign-up, no ads. Your birthday, your people and your reminders stay on your phone.

name: LastTime: Life Event Tracker
description:
When was the last time?

A haircut. A fresh air filter. A visit to the library. Some things matter, even when they don't belong on a to-do list. LastTime gives those moments a place to live.

REMEMBER AT A GLANCE
Create trackers for the people, places, and everyday things in your life. See the most recent record and how much time has passed. Search, filter, and sort to find what you need.

RECORD IN A MOMENT
Log an event now, or choose a date and add the details later. Add notes and keep a history you can look back on. Undo a quick log when you need to.

SAY IT, THEN REVIEW IT
Speak or type an English or Mandarin command, such as “Record a haircut for yesterday.” Review the tracker, date, and details before saving. Voice recording requires microphone and speech recognition permission.

EVERYDAY FINANCES, ORGANIZED
Keep manual records of subscriptions, cards, applications, expenses, donations, cell lines, and issuer rules. Review supported calculations and export records for your own files. LastTime does not connect to your bank or make payments.

AT HOME ON YOUR DEVICES
Use an interface designed for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Follow your device language or choose one of 30 interface languages in Settings. Voice commands support English and Mandarin.

YOUR RECORDS, YOUR CHOICE
Start without creating an account. Records stay on your device by default. Export a backup or spreadsheet when you choose, and manage local recovery backups in Settings. No ads or advertising trackers.

LastTime is a personal recordkeeping tool. Health entries are a journal, not medication guidance, diagnosis, or medical advice. Finance entries are manual records, not financial advice. Keep separate backups of important information.

OPTIONAL NON-HEALTH SYNC
Keep health trackers and their history on your device. Optionally sync other records through your private iCloud account after approving them individually. Review names and notes before approval; do not include health information. Sync runs while LastTime is open.

name: LevelGo: подготовка к ОРТ
description:
LevelGo помогает готовиться к ОРТ: видеоуроки по каждому разделу, домашние задания после уроков и пробные тесты в формате настоящего экзамена. Занимайтесь на русском или кыргызском языке, в своём темпе, с телефона.

НАЧНИТЕ БЕЗ РЕГИСТРАЦИИ
Ответьте на три вопроса: в каком вы классе, какой балл хотите получить и сколько минут в день готовы заниматься. Приложение составит план подготовки и предложит короткий пробный тест. Результат увидите сразу, а аккаунт понадобится только для того, чтобы сохранить его и продолжить.

КУРСЫ ПО РАЗДЕЛАМ ОРТ
Математика, чтение и понимание, аналогии и дополнение предложений, практическая грамматика. Каждый курс разбит на модули и короткие видеоуроки, которые удобно смотреть по дороге в школу. После урока — домашнее задание и разбор ошибок: видно, где ошиблись и какой ответ правильный.

ПРОБНЫЕ ТЕСТЫ КАК НА ЭКЗАМЕНЕ
Те же разделы, ограничение по времени и подсчёт баллов по шкале теста. После каждой попытки — итоговый балл и результат по каждому предмету и разделу. История попыток сохраняется, так что рост результата видно по цифрам, а не на глаз.

ПОИСК ПО ТЕМАМ
Нужно повторить проценты или дроби перед контрольной? Найдите урок по названию темы и не листайте весь курс.

ПРОГРЕСС НА ОДНОМ ЭКРАНЕ
Продолжить с того места, где остановились, посмотреть статистику тестов и календарь занятий можно на главном экране.

КОНСУЛЬТАЦИЯ
Не знаете, с какого курса начать? Оставьте заявку прямо в приложении — менеджер LevelGo перезвонит и поможет выбрать.

ДЛЯ КОГО
Для учеников 10–11 классов и выпускников, которые сдают ОРТ (ЖРТ) в Кыргызстане и хотят поступить на грант.

Аккаунт можно удалить в любой момент в профиле.

Политика конфиденциальности: https://levelgo.kg/privacy/
Условия использования: https://levelgo.kg/terms/

name: ReadWrite: Quiet Words
description:
Read / Write is a quiet place for words that want to be understood.
Share a few honest lines — up to 300 characters. People who read them don't press a button; they answer with a reflection: a short, kind response in their own words. You can reply to a reflection, and the conversation stays small and human.
WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT • No likes, no follower counts, no badges. Just your name under your words. • Text only: no photos, no links, no ads. • Reflections, not reactions. Tap a ready reply, or start a sentence and finish it yourself. • Keep what reaches you. Hold a reflection and it stays beside your writing, like a note in the margin. • Read the people you like. Only you see who reads you. • Read in the languages you choose. The app speaks English, Spanish, Turkish, German and French.
KINDNESS IS THE RULE Every writing and reflection is checked before anyone sees it. Insults, hate, threats and profanity never get through, in any language. You can report or block anyone in a tap, and reports are reviewed by a person within 24 hours.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN Sign in with Apple or Google. Nobody sees your email — only your nickname. No tracking, no analytics, no data sold. Delete your account any time from the menu.
For people aged 16 and over

name: Pairs: Calm Memory Match
description:
Pairs is a calm memory game. Turn over two cards. If they match, they stay. Clear the board in as few moves as you can.

Each match plays a soft marimba note. Match pairs in a row and the notes climb into a little tune. A quiet music loop plays in the background, and you can turn it off in Settings.

WHAT’S INSIDE • Free play on three board sizes: 4×4, 4×5 and 6×6 • 20 levels, with 1 to 3 stars to earn on each • Special cards in later levels: ice cards that crack first, locked cards that wait for a neighbour, and shuffle cards that mix the board when you miss • Three power-ups: Peek, Hint and Freeze • A daily board, the same deal for every player that day, and a streak to keep going • Three card sets: Fruit, Animals and Space

PLAY YOUR WAY • No account, no ads, no tracking • Works fully offline • Large text, VoiceOver and Reduce Motion support • A dark design that is easy on the eyes

name: KidsTube - Videos
description:
KidsTube is a calm place for little viewers. No endless feed and no recommendations that pull a child away: only shows that someone has picked.

• Easy to find your way: sections by age, with dozens of shows and thousands of videos.
• Approved by a person: no video appears before someone has approved it. Videos that stop working are removed automatically.
• A calm player: when an episode ends, the next one from the same show follows. No comments and no sidebar of recommendations.
• No subscription and no ads.

With a free account, for parents:
• Favorites with a heart, on every device you sign in on.
• Recently watched, to find that one clip again.
• A daily limit and a bedtime: when time is up, nothing starts until tomorrow.
• A PIN, so your child can't use the settings or sign out.

You can sign in with email, Google or Apple. You can delete your account and everything that comes with it at any time in the app.

Videos play through YouTube, in privacy-enhanced mode.

name: DayLight Bible
description:
DayLight Bible is a calm, fast Bible reader with real study tools. No ads, no tracking, and no account needed.

READ
• Eleven complete translations, free to read: Berean Standard Bible, World English Bible, Free Bible Version, Literal Standard Version, Majority Standard Bible, King James Version, American Standard Version, Young's Literal Translation, Reina-Valera 1909 (Spanish), Louis Segond 1910 (French) and Luther 1912 (German)
• Compare two translations verse by verse
• Works offline: the whole Bible is on your phone
• Listen: have any chapter read aloud, with a sleep timer
• Adjustable text size, light and dark mode, and the screen can stay on while you read

STUDY
• Cross-references for nearly 20,000 verses
• Tap a verse to see the original Hebrew and Greek words behind it, with definitions
• Matthew Henry's Concise Commentary on nearly every chapter
• Search every word, or jump straight to a reference like "Psalm 23" or "John 3:16"

GROW
• Verse of the day, with an optional daily reminder
• Reading plans: the Bible in a year, the New Testament in 90 days, the Gospels in 30 days, Psalms & Proverbs in 60 days. Run as many at once as you like
• Highlight in four colours, bookmark, and write notes, then back them up to a file
• A reading streak, a fresh challenge every week, and badges to earn as you read, highlight and share

ENCOURAGEMENT
Having a hard day? Say how you feel, or pick anxious, grieving, lonely, weary and more, and get verses that speak to it, with a short word of comfort and a prayer. Your check-ins stay on your device.

SYNC (OPTIONAL)
Sign in with just your email to keep highlights, notes and reading plans in sync across your iPhone, Android and the web. Delete your account at any time from Settings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Without an account, nothing leaves your device. With one, we store only your email and what you choose to sync, used for nothing else.

Bible texts are in the public domain. Cross-references by OpenBible.info (CC BY). Hebrew and Greek lexicons by STEPBible.org, Tyndale House, Cambridge (CC BY 4.0).

name: CleanMyTV Home Studio
description:
Make your Android TV feel like your own.

CleanMyTV is an independent companion for compatible Android TV and Google TV devices. Design a quieter Home screen, organise your favourite apps, and manage your TV setup from your iPhone or iPad on the same private network.

A HOME SCREEN YOU CAN SHAPE
Explore eight bundled Home designs: Aurora, Essential, Amber Atelier, Ink & Mist, Pixel Harbor, Orbit, Window Kitten and Golden Retriever. Adjust columns, wallpaper dimming, greetings and favourite app order. Preview your choices on your phone before explicitly applying them to the TV. The preview is an illustration of the launcher layout.

GUIDED SETUP
Follow the setup guide to connect your TV, choose a template and review the changes. CleanMyTV can install its companion TV launcher and help you select it as Home on supported devices. Save your setup progress and return later. Home is checked again on a later connection after the TV restarts, without blocking the rest of setup.

APPS AND STORAGE
Browse TV apps, search and sort the list, hide apps from Home, and inspect storage figures reported by Android. Supported app controls include disabling eligible apps and removing eligible user-installed apps after confirmation. Disabled apps can be enabled in the TV settings. Removing an app also removes its local TV data. Hiding or disabling an app does not free its installed files or data. Storage reports may be cached or unavailable on some TVs.

RECOVERY WHEN YOU NEED IT
Home setup records the original Home before changing it. Use Restore original Home while connected to the same TV with that local record available. This does not restore uninstalled apps or their data.

TRY BEFORE CONNECTING
Explore the clearly labelled demo mode without a TV. Demo actions change only the demo. Choose System, Light or Dark appearance for the companion app.

CHECK COMPATIBILITY FIRST
• Requires Android TV or Google TV 8 or later with Network ADB or supported encrypted Wireless debugging, and TV-side authorisation.
• Your iPhone or iPad and TV must be on the same trusted local IPv4 or IPv6 network. Enter the TV address and port manually. IPv6 supports unique-local addresses and link-local addresses with an explicit interface scope.
• For encrypted Wireless debugging, choose Pair with a code and enter the TV’s separate pairing and connection ports plus its six-digit code.
• Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Roku and VIDAA are not supported. Fire TV Home replacement is not supported.
• Home selection and restart behaviour depend on the TV manufacturer and firmware.
• The companion interface supports English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. The TV launcher language can follow the TV system or your selected language; app names come from the TV.

Legacy Network ADB is unencrypted; supported Wireless debugging uses TLS. Enable debugging only on a trusted network and turn it off on the TV when finished. Disconnecting the app does not turn off the TV's debugging service.

CleanMyTV is an independent app and is not affiliated with Google or any TV manufacturer.

name: Figures: Unit Price & Convert
description:
The shelf tag says per ounce. The other one says per pound. Figures.

Figures finds the real best price on the shelf, then converts the cups, tablespoons, and milliliters in between. You bring the numbers; Figures does the math.

COMPARE PRICES
• Enter each item's price, count, and size. Figures puts every item in the same unit, crowns the cheapest with a Best price badge, and shows how much more the others cost.
• Mix sizes and units: a 12 oz bag against a 1 kg bag, a 6-pack against a dozen.
• Sales, coupons, and tax: percent off and amount off together, in the order the store takes them, with tax before or after.
• Close enough is close enough: items within 2% of the best price are marked as a near tie, so a few cents don't decide for you. You choose the threshold.
• Comparisons save automatically, so last week's olive oil showdown is still there.

CONVERT ANYTHING
• Type a number and see it in every unit at once, not just one: cups, milliliters, tablespoons, and fluid ounces, all updating as you type.
• 29 categories, from cooking measures and feet and inches to fuel economy, data storage, and pressure.
• Search by unit: "psi" finds Pressure, and "cooking" finds Volume.
• Two-part entry for feet and inches, stone and pounds, and hours and minutes.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Show the units you use, hide the rest, and keep favorites on top.
• Pick a color theme, how many decimals, what counts as close enough, a default sales tax, and the currency prices show in (handy when shopping abroad).

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on your iPhone and works offline, so the store basement with one bar is fine.
• Figures doesn't look up prices or convert currencies; it works from the numbers you enter.

Works with VoiceOver, the largest text sizes, and Dark Mode.

name: F.A.O.E.D: Fly Attack
description:
After the end of the world, the skies over a ruined city belong to raiders and alien machines.
You fly a warplane welded together from scrap, skimming the broken towers at rooftop height — the lower you fly, the faster you charge, but the flak, rooftop guns and collapsing skyscrapers are that much closer.

LOW-ALTITUDE AERIAL COMBAT
• Third-person chase camera — fly freely in any direction between the towers
• Fly low to charge energy, lock on to multiple targets and unleash homing missile salvos
• Climb too high and the flak curtain will tear you apart

A CITY YOU CAN DESTROY
• Buildings topple in the direction they are hit and break apart into slabs, panels and rebar
• Cars, signs and glass curtain walls all shatter

COLOSSAL BOSSES
• Balloon scavengers, armed cargo airships, a giant salvage mech, the war airship "Red Whale", a flying carrier…
• The final battle: the sky-covering alien wreck "The Hollow Mantle"

30+ MISSIONS, THREE DISTRICTS, CAVES AND THE DEEP
• Sweeps, convoy intercepts, stronghold strikes, meteor-shower survival and a fleet battle
• Dusk in the south, sandstorms in the center, a red night in the north — with changing weather
• Beat the game to unlock bonus stages: plunge into a sinkhole cave and a drowned basin to face an abyssal leviathan

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
• Boss Rush: every boss back to back, against the clock
• Endless: wave after wave, each one tougher than the last
• Daily Challenge: a new mission with a special twist every day
• Game Center leaderboards and achievements

PLANES AND UPGRADES
• A hangar of very different aircraft, including a gunship helicopter and a heavy bomber — speed, agility, armor, bombs and firepower
• Upgrade your main gun, missiles, ground weapons, thunder strike and wingman formations
• Medals, hidden planes, a night livery and multiple difficulty levels

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Floating or fixed stick, left-handed layout, adjustable button size and opacity
• Accessibility: color-blind mode, UI text size, auto missile salvo, aim assist, reduced shake & flash
• MFi / Xbox / PlayStation controller support and haptics
• No ads, no in-app purchases; plays offline (Game Center leaderboards need a connection)

name: Belltide: Schedule & Reminders
description:
See what’s next, and how long you have until it starts.

Belltide helps you organize classes, shifts and everyday routines with recurring schedules, countdowns and local reminders.

PLAN REPEATING EVENTS
Create one-time, daily, weekly, monthly or yearly events. Set repeat intervals, choose weekdays and use alternating-week schedules for classes and routines.

SEE YOUR WEEK CLEARLY
Switch between a weekly timetable and an agenda. Check upcoming events, their times and locations, then open an event for details.

ADJUST JUST ONE OCCURRENCE
Postpone or skip an occurrence, change its time or location, or add an extra arrangement without rewriting the whole schedule.

KEEP THE NEXT EVENT IN VIEW
Use Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets or enable Live Activities. Reopen Belltide to sync the latest schedule. Live Activities may expire and do not automatically continue to the next event in the background.

CHOOSE YOUR REMINDERS
Set advance notifications for events. Optional system alarms are available when you enable them and grant permission. Notifications follow your system settings.

START WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
Your schedules are stored locally on your device. Customize the appearance, language, first day of the week and date format.

Requires iPhone with iOS 26 or later. Notification and alarm features require the relevant system permissions.

name: Tsugi Itsu Dakke
description:
"Tsugi Itsu Dakke" is a lifestyle maintenance tracking app that helps you keep track of infrequent but important tasks and replacement schedules.
Easily manage maintenance items for your children, yourself, home, car, pets, digital data, and contracts.

Key Features:
- Categorized management for family, home, car, and more
- Quick preset registration for common maintenance tasks
- Smart recommendations based on children's age
- One-tap execution recording and custom date logging
- Clear status indicators for upcoming and overdue tasks

name: AegisBT
description:
AegisBT acerca el monitoreo ambiental y las alertas tempranas a tu iPhone. Consulta información de las estaciones disponibles y recibe avisos para mantenerte informado sobre las condiciones de tu comunidad.

Con AegisBT puedes consultar lecturas meteorológicas, visualizar alertas geolocalizadas en el mapa, revisar el historial de mensajes y acceder a recomendaciones de prevención.

Las alertas se identifican por niveles N1, N2 y N3 para facilitar su interpretación. Activa las notificaciones para recibir los avisos enviados a través del sistema.

La disponibilidad de información depende de las estaciones instaladas y de su conexión. Las notificaciones por internet requieren conectividad y los permisos correspondientes. La recepción local por Bluetooth requiere equipos AegisBT compatibles dentro del alcance.

El acceso administrativo está reservado a usuarios autorizados.

AegisBT es una herramienta de apoyo a la prevención. Ante una emergencia, sigue las indicaciones de Protección Civil y de las autoridades de tu localidad.

name: BayMarker
description:
Two basement levels can look exactly alike. Leave yourself the details that distinguish yours: the bay number, the garage name and the elevator you walked past.

Tap a floor shortcut or type the level as it appears on the sign. Add a landmark in your own words, or keep a photo of the entrance with the card. The level and bay stay in large type when you reopen the app.

BayMarker holds one current spot. Finish parking when you collect the car to clear the card and its photo. No GPS or internet connection is needed.

name: Tawasul تواصل
description:
تواصل — نظام إدارة المدرسة المتكامل

• بوابات للإدارة والمعلم والموظف والطالب وولي الأمر
• حضور الطلاب والموظفين مع أجهزة البصمة وبطاقات QR
• الدرجات الشهرية والفصلية والاختبارات وطباعة الشهادات
• الدروس والواجبات والجدول والإجازات
• المحاسبة والرسوم والفواتير والرواتب
• شؤون الموظفين وشؤون الطلاب والقبول الإلكتروني
• رسائل وإشعارات فورية بين المدرسة والأسرة
• تعدد الحسابات وتبديل الأدوار والدخول برقم الجوال
• استيراد البيانات من Excel

name: Virtual Online
description:
Virtual Online gives you a temporary phone number for receiving verification SMS codes, so you can keep your personal number private.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a service, such as WhatsApp, Telegram, Google, Instagram, TikTok and hundreds more.
• Choose a country and get a number in seconds.
• Your verification code appears live in the app. No refreshing, no second app.
• If no code arrives, your order is cancelled and refunded to your balance automatically.

ONE-TIME NUMBERS
Need a code once? Buy a number for a single verification. The price is shown before you buy, and you only pay when a number is reserved for you.

NUMBER RENTALS
Need to keep the same number? Rent one for several days and receive every code sent to it until the rental ends. Handy for accounts you will log in to again later.

BUILT FOR PRIVACY AND CONTROL
• Keep your real phone number off sign-up forms.
• Optional two-step sign-in with an emailed code.
• Delete your account yourself at any time from Profile → Delete account.
• See every order, code and balance movement in your history.

SIMPLE AND CLEAR
• Live prices and stock for each country and service.
• One balance for all your orders.
• Copy codes and numbers with one tap.
• Available in English and French.

Please use Virtual Online responsibly and only with services whose terms allow it. Fraud, spam and abuse are not allowed and may lead to account closure.

Need help? Support is available in the app through WhatsApp or Telegram, and at https://virtualonline.shop/support

Privacy Policy: https://virtualonline.shop/privacy
Terms of Service: https://virtualonline.shop/terms

name: OrderStation by Postree
description:
Postree Order Station is the order-taking app for restaurants and takeaways on Postree online ordering. It lives on the tablet or phone at the counter: every new order rings until someone answers, is accepted with a ready time in one tap, and prints its receipt and kitchen docket on the printer you already have.

NEW ORDERS, ACCEPTED IN SECONDS
• Every new order rings and takes over the screen until someone deals with it
• Accept with a ready time in one tap, or reject with a reason
• Add time to an order that needs longer; the customer is told by email
• Orders placed while you are closed wait quietly and ring when you open

A LIVE BOARD FOR THE COUNTER
• New, In progress and Ready, as a list or a kanban board
• Collection, delivery and dine-in with the table number
• Paid or unpaid at a glance, with the cash still to collect
• Bookings and scheduled orders on their own tab
• Today's sales, order count and average ticket

PRINTING AT THE COUNTER
• Customer receipts and kitchen dockets on your network receipt printer, over Wi-Fi or LAN
• Epson, Xprinter and other ESC/POS printers, and Star printers (TSP100, TSP143, TSP650II, TSP700II, mC-Print, mPOP) in Star raster or StarPRNT mode
• 58 mm and 80 mm paper, with the print width set online so nothing is cut off at the edge
• Auto print every accepted order, reprint any docket, test print
• The same templates and kitchen categories as your Postree web admin

MENU AND SERVICE CONTROL
• Mark items sold out or hide them, add-ons and sizes included
• Stop taking orders for an hour, two hours or the rest of today, or switch collection, delivery or dine-in off
• Auto-reject orders nobody accepts in time, with a card payment refunded
• Choose the alarm sound

MADE FOR THE RESTAURANT
• Keeps the screen on while signed in
• iPhone and iPad, with a side-rail layout on tablets
• Reminds staff out loud to reopen the app if it goes into the background, because orders ring while the app is open
• Lets the manager know if the tablet goes offline during opening hours

Postree Order Station needs a Postree restaurant account. Sign in with your restaurant's Postree address and your staff email. To learn more about Postree online ordering, visit mypostree.com.

name: ShadeSeat
description:
Hot sun through the window for the whole ride? ShadeSeat tells you which side of the vehicle is likely to get less direct sunlight on your journey, so you can pick the shadier seat before you board.

HOW IT WORKS
• Enter where you're going and when you leave, and choose car or bus.
• ShadeSeat uses the route, distance and travel time from Apple Maps for your departure time.
• It works out where the sun will be at every point of the trip and compares the sunlight reaching each side of the vehicle.
• You get one clear answer for the whole journey: sit on the left, sit on the right, or either side.

SEE THE SUN MOVE
Scrub through the journey on the map and watch the sun's direction change at every bend. A timeline shows when the sun is on each side, and play/pause lets you preview the whole trip.

MADE FOR REAL JOURNEYS
• Buses: confirm the road route, add the places your bus passes through, or import a GPX route file.
• Honest results: "Timing-sensitive" tells you when a small delay could change the answer, and every result shows where its route and timing came from.
• Works anywhere in the world, including night-time and polar journeys.
• Left and right are always as you face the front of the vehicle.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no tracking. Your saved trips stay on your iPhone. ShadeSeat asks for your location only when you tap Current Location.

ShadeSeat estimates direct sunlight from the sun's position and the route. Clouds, buildings, trees, tinted windows and your exact seat can change what you feel.

name: KeptDiary
description:
KeptDiary is a quiet place to notice how your days feel.

Tap a face, add a few tags if you like — slept well, ran, friends, rain — and you're done. Over time KeptDiary shows you the shape of your weeks: a calendar of moods, a mood cloud and a daily mood chart, the tags that show up on your best and hardest days, and your whole year in coloured dots.

Goals
Turn any tag into a small goal, like "Run 3× a week" or "Read every day". See how often you hit it, your streak, and how your mood moves on the days you do.

Private by design
• No account, no sign-up
• Everything stays on your phone — nothing is uploaded
• Export a backup file whenever you want, and restore or merge it on any device

Made for real life
• Times stay right when you travel across time zones
• English and Thai
• Light and dark appearance
• A gentle daily reminder, only if you want one

KeptDiary is a personal journal, not a medical app.

name: RimCraft
description:
Give every rim repair a clear record with RimCraft. Organize your vessels, mark the spots that need attention, and keep inspection notes and repair photos together in one offline workspace.

Whether you are documenting a chipped bowl, a tarnished metal rim, or a loose seam on a teapot, RimCraft helps you return to the same location and follow your work from first inspection to personal review.

Map issues around the rim

Tap the circular workbench to place a marker at a clock position. Record gaps, oxidation, deformation, loose joints, rim chips, or other observations. Add severity, notes, and a repair status to each marker. Save a reference note and photo to keep the same orientation between sessions.

Keep each piece organized

Create projects with a name, object type, material, rim diameter, cover photo, and notes. Search by name, filter by progress, and archive projects for later reference.

Make inspections easier to follow

Use the built in checklist for surfaces, joints, shape, and rim integrity. Mark each item as Pass, Needs Attention, or Not Checked. Review summaries based on your own entries.

Document your repair process

Add dated repair steps, materials, and photos. Link an entry to a specific issue or the whole project. Review your records in a project timeline and compare before and after photos side by side.

Export a record of your work

Choose the issues and repair logs to include in summary images. Preview the result, choose whether to include photos, and save to Photos or share through the system share sheet. Export a local backup containing your projects and attached photos, then import it when needed.

Built for an offline workbench

RimCraft requires no account or internet connection for its core features. It includes an offline guide, millimeter and inch display options, light and dark appearance, and optional haptic feedback. There are no ads or analytics in the app.

RimCraft records your observations and manual review. It does not automatically detect defects, test vessels, or certify repair quality.

name: Walk Box: Arrow-Guided Walks
description:
Completely free. No ads, no sign-up.

When you don't know where to go, follow an arrow.

Walk Box won't tell you where you're headed. It picks a real place near you and gives you only an arrow, a distance, and a number. No map, no place name, no guide. Walk out — you'll find out when you get there.

・One box, one walk
Pick a distance — eight bands, from 500 m to 20 km. Draw one, then follow the arrow. There's no map on screen and no name. All you have is a direction and a number, and your own guess at how far off you are.

・You only find out when you arrive
Step within 10 to 50 m of the destination and stop. Then the name appears. All that guessing gets settled in that moment.

・See how you got here
Only after the reveal does the map show up, for the first time. Your route grows back segment by segment — where you hesitated, where you turned wrong, where you stopped to take a photo. That stretch is often better than the destination.

・A walk you never finished still counts
Quitting halfway, changing your mind — all of it stays, filed as "Somewhere." However far you got is how far you got. No judgment.

・Eight distances, four ways to walk
500 m — the walk to get coffee downstairs.
1 to 3 km — a wander after dinner.
5 to 8 km — a proper city walk.
10 to 20 km — take a train, get off somewhere you've never been.

・Every walk is kept
Route thumbnail, distance, date, the few lines you wrote, the photos you took — all in your records. Delete a single one, or export the whole thing as a backup.

Terms & Privacy Policy: https://w9m6l3v7m6.wangye.domolo.cn/p/walkbox

name: ZerosLoop
description:
Meet ZerosLoop — a retro-inspired audio playground that turns everyday sounds into something completely different.

Record your voice, a beat, a funny noise, or anything around you. ZerosLoop instantly turns your recording into a repeating loop that you can experiment with.

RECORD. LOOP. EXPERIMENT.

• One-touch recording — capture sounds with the big red Record button.

• Instant looping — your recording automatically plays back as a continuous loop.

• Pitch control — make sounds higher, deeper, or downright ridiculous.

• Speed control — slow things down or speed them up.

• Reverse playback — hear your recordings backward.

• Echo effect — add repeating echoes to your sound.

• Alien effect — transform your recording into something otherworldly.

• Robot effect — give your audio a futuristic robotic character.

• Live waveform — watch your recording as it loops.

SIMPLE CONTROLS. ENDLESS EXPERIMENTS.

No complicated music software. No accounts. No subscriptions. Just record something and see what happens.

ZerosLoop is completely free, with no ads or in-app purchases.

Made by Zero76 Studios LLC.

name: FocusBento
description:
Turn focus time into a feast.

FocusBento is an offline focus timer that rewards every completed session with a dish. Cook through Pomodoro, custom countdown, or count-up modes, then open the box to reveal what you earned. Collect a 50-item Food Dex, spend Foodie Dust in the Dust Pantry, plate freeform bentos in the studio, and watch your streaks and charts grow — all on your device.

FOCUS KITCHEN
• Pomodoro (configurable focus/break), custom countdown 5–180 minutes, and count-up up to 8 hours
• Wall-clock timer that stays accurate when the app is backgrounded
• Pause or give up with a friendly “burned dish” record
• Optional local notification when your dish is ready
• Ambient sound mixer with six real-time soundscapes and independent volumes

FOOD DEX & LOOT
• 50 dishes across four rarities (N / R / SR / SSR)
• Longer sessions improve rare drop odds, with pity rules for dry streaks
• Duplicates melt into Foodie Dust; redeem specific dishes and decorations in the Dust Pantry
• Story cards with collection history for every unlock

BENTO STUDIO
• Free-form platter: drag, pinch-scale, rotate, flip, sticky notes, and tray styles
• Export a high-resolution poster and share with the system share sheet
• Save to Photos only when you choose Save Image

FOCUS INSIGHTS & QUESTS
• KPI cards for total focus time, sessions, dex progress, and streaks
• Charts: day/week/month/year trends, tag distribution, 30-day heatmap, and drop chronicle
• Daily chef quests and a lifetime badge tree

BUILT FOR PRIVACY
• 100% local — no accounts, no cloud sync, no IAP, no ads, no tracking
• Themes, tags, haptics, reminders, and JSON backup/export live on your device

Cook one session. Collect one dish. Plate your focus.

name: Take On Sports
description:
Take On Sports turns your phone into a coach.

Film a golf drive, a tennis serve or a penalty kick. Take On Sports scores your form from 0 to 100, shows you the key positions frame by frame, and tells you the one or two things that will move your score the most.

- An instant AI score with a breakdown: setup, top, impact, finish, plus power and tempo.
- Your next 10 points: three small, specific fixes, each worth a few points.
- A slow-motion slide strip to study every frame of your swing.
- Progress over time against your own baseline.
- Rankings: see how you stack up against the average and the best.
- Challenges: send "Beat this" to a friend. Close calls go to human judges.
- Hands-free filming with voice or a Bluetooth remote.
- Penalty kicks: call your corner, and the coach checks where the ball really went.

Golf, tennis and soccer to start. For players 13 and up.

name: WeldPack
description:
WeldPack is the field QC app for welding and piping turnarounds, built by a Certified Welding Inspector. It takes a work package from first fit-up to a signed, client-ready turnover PDF, on an iPad at the job site, with or without a signal.

MAP WELDS ON THE ISO
• Drop the ISO PDF in and tap to place weld and flange bubbles. The weld log fills itself in.
• Rapid mapping numbers a run of welds tap after tap.
• Draw a simple ISO from scratch: pipe on the iso grid, weld neck flanges, valves with stem direction, check valves with flow arrows, reducers, olets, dimensions and revision clouds.

A WELD LOG THAT KEEPS UP
• Fit-up, VT, PT, RT, PAUT, UT, PMI, PWHT and pressure test type, pressure and date on every weld.
• Every result gets a date when you enter it, and you can change it if the inspection was another day.
• Welder qualification and continuity are checked against the WPQ as you go: process, thickness, diameter and position.
• Random NDE lots per line class and welder, with progressive selections after a reject.

TRACK THE WHOLE JOB
• One tracker across every package: welds, flanges, inch-dia, NDE pending, repairs and holds.
• NDE requests in two taps: batch the welds and send the NDE company a clean PDF. The request number goes into each weld's NDE report field.
• Rejects log with the repair trail, and welder performance by repair rate.
• Flange log with torque values from the chart, gasket and bolting, PMI and QC acceptance.

THE DAILY REPORT WRITES ITSELF
• Fit-ups, welds, VT, NDE results, PMI, rejects, flanges, pressure tests and punch items are pulled from the day's logs.
• Add weather, crew, notes and photos, sign it, and send the PDF or Excel.

TURNOVER PACKAGE IN ONE TAP
• Cover sheet, ITP, weld log, flange log, ISO weld maps, NDE reports, MTRs, WPS/PQR and WPQs, pressure test reports, punch list and sign-offs, in the order your client wants, as one PDF.
• Print settings saved per client. Send packages straight to SharePoint.
• Export everything to Excel, or one backup file for the whole job.

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
• Works fully offline. Your data is saved on the device as you go.
• Code references and acceptance criteria for B31.3, B31.1, ASME VIII, AWS D1.1, API 1104, API 570, API 650/653 and more.
• Voice entry: say "weld 12 visual accept".
• Search everything: welds, flanges, packages, welders, WPS and heats.

FOR THE WHOLE CREW (optional)
• Cloud sync for your company: owner, admins, lead inspectors, inspectors and read-only client viewers, each with the right access.
• Join with a code. Changes sync in the background.

Help is built in: tap ? Help to send a report with a screenshot, and the answer comes back inside the app.

name: Nuvior Prime
description:
Nuvior Prime is the field-sales companion for NUVIOR's authorized sales representatives in Canada. It is an internal business tool: accounts are created by a NUVIOR administrator, and there is no public sign-up.

WHAT REPS CAN DO
• Today's Route — see the day's planned stops on a map and in order, with directions between them.
• Check In / Check Out — confirm each visit at the location, so the team knows what was covered.
• Share Location — optionally share your live position with your manager during a shift, including while the phone is locked, so routes can be adjusted and support sent when needed.
• Plans and notes — review visit plans and keep notes and contacts for the clinics and businesses you serve.

FOR MANAGERS
• Live map of representatives on shift and their routes.
• Territory planning and visit history by province and city.

Location sharing is off by default and can be turned off at any time from the app header or iOS Settings. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

name: Arcade Jacket
description:
Arcade Jacket is the remote for a DIY LED jacket: addressable LED strips sewn along the front and down the sleeves, driven by a small Gledopto ESP32 LED controller running the free, open-source LEDLINK firmware. It finds the controller over Bluetooth by itself, no pairing. No jacket yet? The app runs a live on-screen preview, so you can try every look first.

ARCADE
LED effects from Pixelcade's arcade marquees: one for each of 45 classic consoles and 44 arcade-style games, A-Z, with a search.

THEMES AND HOLIDAYS
Light Cycle, Cyberpunk, Code Rain, Synthwave, Fire, Aurora, Ocean and more, plus Christmas, New Year fireworks, Valentine's, St Patrick's, July 4th, Halloween, Thanksgiving and Pride. Solid, Breathe, Sparkle and Comet in any colour you pick.

BIKE
Left, right and hazard turn signals that sweep down that side like a car's, a hold-to-brake button, and an automatic brake light that turns the jacket red when GPS says you're slowing down. Wear it as well as proper bike lights, never instead of them.

LIVE
A music visualizer from the iPhone's microphone (nothing is recorded), and a heartbeat that pulses at your heart rate, from a Bluetooth heart-rate sensor or the Apple Watch app.

SETTINGS
Tell the controller how your strips are laid out -- zones, which parts are lit and which stay dark -- and check it with test patterns.

Requires: a Gledopto ESP32 LED controller with the LEDLINK firmware (free; web installer and build guide at alinke.github.io/rogue-ai-costume) and WS2811/WS2812B LED strips. A controller running WLED won't connect.

name: Grow Island Retro
description:
Build an island with the power of engineering!

Grow Island Retro is a relaxing puzzle about order and cause-and-effect. Tap eight engineering panels – electrical, mechanical, civil, chemical, computing and more – and watch the island come to life. Every panel you place helps the island grow: roads appear, cars start driving, a rocket stands up, the volcano wakes…

THE PUZZLE
• Each turn, everything you have already built grows a little more.
• Panels placed early grow the most – so the order matters!
• Buildings affect each other: a road brings cars, power brings robots.
• Can you find the order that brings every field to MAX?

SECRETS TO DISCOVER
Different orders lead to different stories. Launch a rocket into space, explore a hidden tunnel, set sail, and maybe… meet a visitor from another world.

MADE FOR TOUCH
• Big, easy panels and simple controls
• Plays great on iPhone (landscape) and iPad
• Hand-drawn art and cheerful animations
• No account, no internet needed

A short, charming puzzle for kids and grown-ups who love to tinker.

name: Hawaii Moto Prep
description:
Prepare for Hawaii motorcycle knowledge questions with English-first practice and optional translations.

Hawaii Moto Prep includes 342 distinct practice questions, answer explanations and illustrations. Study the full bank, choose from 16 practice sets, review your mistakes or take a 25-question practice exam.

ENGLISH + YOUR LANGUAGE
Keep the English original visible and show or hide Russian, Ukrainian, Spanish, Japanese or Simplified Chinese translations of each question, answer and explanation. Choose the interface language separately, or let it follow your device.

PRACTICE YOUR WAY
Shuffle questions to avoid memorizing their order. Get immediate answer feedback in study mode. In practice exam mode, review answers after finishing. Resume an unfinished session and revisit questions you answered incorrectly.

READY OFFLINE
Questions, translations, explanations and illustrations are included in the app. No account, advertising or subscription is required. Learning progress is stored on your device.

Independent study aid. Not affiliated with any government agency. Practice questions do not guarantee the questions on an official examination. Translations are machine-generated study aids and may contain errors; the English original remains available. The official Hawaii Motorcycle Operator Manual is linked in Settings.

name: Ramp Check: Wheelchair Slope
description:
Is that ramp really usable in a wheelchair? Ramp Check tells you in seconds.

MEASURE
• Lay your phone on the ramp, long edge pointing up the slope
• See the slope as a grade (%), an angle (°) and a ratio (1:N) at the same time
• A drawing compares the ramp with the 1:12 reference line

INSTANT VERDICT
• Nearly flat · Gentle (flatter than 1:20) · Meets 1:12 · Too steep
• Colour-coded so you can read it at a glance

SAVE AND SHARE
• Hold a reading and save it with the place name
• Share your list with a building manager, council or advocacy group

KNOW THE GUIDELINES
• 1:12 (8.3%) — the common maximum for wheelchair ramps (Korean accessibility law, US ADA)
• 1:16 and 1:20 for comfort, plus width, landings, handrails and lips to check

ACCURATE AND PRIVATE
• Calibrate to 0° on a level surface
• Uses only your phone's motion sensor — no location, no account, no ads

Ramp Check is a reference tool. For official audits or construction, use professional equipment and current regulations.

name: Together Tonight
description:
Together Tonight is a private way for two people to find out what they both want tonight.

One of you opens a round. The app rolls a short mix of ideas, from sweet and simple to a little more adventurous, and you can add a few of your own. You each answer Yes, No or Maybe, one idea at a time, without seeing each other's answers. The app then shows only the ideas you both said Yes to, plus one Maybe if you like to stretch a little. Anything either of you said No to is never shown. Nobody has to ask out loud, and nobody is turned down to their face.

HOW IT WORKS

- Start a round and the app rolls 15 ideas, mixed so every round has something easy and something new
- Add up to five ideas of your own, written the way you want them done
- Answer one card at a time, so nobody can scan the list and back out early
- Swap who does what on any idea that works both ways
- Tweak any idea into your own words before you send it
- Pass the phone to your partner, or send the round as a picture in Messages
- Your partner answers the same ideas without seeing yours
- See your matches: pick one, or do both

ONLY WHAT YOU BOTH WANT

- Yes means tonight. Two Yes answers make a match
- Maybe means open to it. A Yes and a Maybe is offered as a maybe
- No means not tonight, not never. The other person never learns what you said No to
- Your individual answers are never shown to your partner, only the matches

PLENTY OF IDEAS

- Over 1,100 built-in ideas: romantic evenings, affection, massage, surprises, promises and more
- Explore More adds topics to talk over or look up together
- Your own ideas come back in later rounds and are answered like any other

AFTER THE ROUND

- Mark how it went: We Did It, Skipped or Again Sometime
- Remind Us sets a reminder for later tonight, tomorrow evening or this weekend
- Choose the picture that carries your round: the Yes/No/Maybe die, one of 23 romantic scenes, or your own photo
- History keeps every round, and Blast from the Past skips the answering and picks tonight from ideas you have already matched
- Rounds save as you go, so a phone call never loses your answers

FOR EVERY COUPLE

- Works for a man and a woman, two men or two women; ideas that clearly don't fit your couple are left out
- Gentle weekly nudges ("Maybe tonight?") if you want them, with nothing revealing on the lock screen

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

- No accounts, no logins, no servers
- No ads, no analytics, no tracking
- Everything stays on your devices
- Rounds sent as pictures are encoded with your shared couple password, so the contents can't be casually read

Works on iPhone and iPad, in portrait and landscape.

Together Tonight is for adult couples in a committed relationship and is rated 18+. Every idea is a suggestion, never an instruction, and a No is never revealed.

name: Sonar Strike
description:
Sink their fleet before they sink yours.

Sonar Strike is the classic naval battle game, rebuilt for your phone. Hide five ships on your grid, hunt down your opponent's fleet square by square, and be the first to send every enemy ship to the bottom.

FOUR WAYS TO PLAY
• Quick Match: get paired with another player online, matched by rank.
• Play a Friend: share a 6-character room code and battle instantly.
• Play Nearby: find players around you over Bluetooth and challenge them with a tap.
• vs Computer: practice offline against Easy, Normal, or Hard. No account needed.

TWO GAME MODES
• Classic: one shot per turn.
• Salvo: fire one shot for every ship you still have afloat. Lose a ship, lose firepower.

POWER-UPS
• Sonar: scan a 3×3 area to detect hidden ships.
• Airstrike: bomb an entire row at once.
• Decoy: plant a fake ship that fools your opponent into wasting shots.

DAILY CHALLENGE
A new hidden fleet every day, the same for everyone. Sink it in the fewest shots and climb the daily leaderboard.

RANKS & ACHIEVEMENTS
Earn XP in online battles and rise from Ensign to Admiral. Unlock achievements like Untouchable, Clean Sweep, and Smoke and Mirrors.

BUILT FOR FAIR PLAY
Every shot is checked by the game server, so nobody can peek at your fleet. iPhone and Android players battle each other.

Questions or feedback? Email dev@zyrixcode.com

name: 마이OX퀴즈
description:
“딸기는 베리류다.” 정말 O일까요?
식물학적 베리류(장과)를 기준으로 하면 딸기는 X, 바나나는 O!

생각이 엇갈리는 순간, 우리만의 OX 파티가 시작됩니다.
마이OX퀴즈는 직접 문제와 정답을 만들고, 기기 한 대로 함께 즐기는 OX 파티 게임입니다.

■ 문제도 정답도, 내 손으로
친구 취향, 가족의 추억, 오늘 배운 상식까지! 주제를 만들고 문제를 적은 뒤 정답을 O 또는 X로 정하세요. 주제별로 문제를 추가하고 수정하며 나만의 문제집을 만들 수 있어요.

■ 아리송한 예시 10문제로 시작
처음 시작하는 빈 문제집에는 ‘[샘플] 아리송한 OX’가 준비됩니다. 제작 날짜와 해설·출처가 있는 예시로 사용법을 익혀 보세요. 샘플도 자유롭게 수정하거나 삭제할 수 있습니다.

■ 기기 한 대로, 최대 10명이 함께
인원을 정하고 차례로 O 또는 X를 선택하세요. 캐릭터가 자리를 잡으면 한 판 시작! 마이퀴즈에서는 틀린 쪽 들판이 무너지고 정답이 공개됩니다.

■ 운에 맡기는 랜덤 O/X
문제 없이 가볍게 즐기고 싶다면 랜덤 모드를 선택하세요. 어느 쪽이 무너질지 모르는 긴장감, 살아남은 사람들과 한 번 더!
친구들과의 모임부터 가족 퀴즈 시간까지, 우리만 아는 문제로 더 재미있게 즐겨 보세요.

name: VivaBoard AI
description:
Prepare for your next viva with VivaBoard AI.

Practice interview questions in Bangla or English, listen to the examiner, and review your feedback and saved interview history. Build a preparation routine with question banks, quizzes, current affairs, job circulars and CV tools.

Sign in with your VivaBoard account to access the features available to your account.

VivaBoard is an independent preparation service, not a government agency or an official examination or scoring provider. AI responses can contain mistakes; verify important information using reliable sources.

name: Sakin: Calm Feed, No Reels
description:
Spend your Instagram time with the people you care about. Sakin turns Safari into a calm, simple space to catch up, then lets you get back to your day.

Open instagram.com in Safari with Sakin: see posts from the people you follow, browse stories at your own pace, and step away right on time.

HOW SAKIN FEELS

• A Simple Feed: Your home screen opens to posts and stories from the people you follow, and the whole page is theirs.
• People You Follow First: Your feed starts directly with the latest chronological posts from friends and creators you follow.
• 4-Column Stories Grid: Friends' stories sit side by side in an organized 4-column layout whenever you want a quick catch-up.
• Your Pace: A like goes out when you tap the heart, and the next person's story starts when you say so.
• Soft Visuals: An optional grayscale theme and clean navigation icons make for a comfortable reading experience.
• A Breath, A Balance: A 5-second "Take a breath" moment greets you as the page opens, and a gentle reminder invites you to wrap up when you reach your daily time goal.

READY IN 30 SECONDS
1. Open Sakin and pick your feed preferences.
2. Enable Sakin in iPhone Settings > Apps > Safari > Extensions.
3. Open instagram.com in Safari—your quiet feed is ready.

EVERYTHING STAYS ON YOUR IPHONE
• Sakin runs entirely in Safari on your iPhone and sends nothing to any server.
• Your preferences and daily timer live on this device.
• Open the app, pick your preferences, and you're set.

Note: Sakin is an independent Safari Web Extension for iPhone that personalizes how instagram.com looks in Safari. It is not affiliated with Instagram or Meta.

name: 2911 Jobs
description: 2911 Jobs connects people across Zambia with piece work and local jobs. Looking for work? Browse jobs near you in Lusaka, Kitwe, Ndola, Livingstone and across Zambia. Apply inside the app, chat with the poster, and get hired. Workers complete a short orientation and verify with a selfie, so posters know who is coming. Posting a job? Put it in front of thousands of members in minutes. Post the job, review applications, accept the right person, and talk inside the app. Phone numbers stay private until you accept an application. You can also buy and sell on the Marketplace, follow businesses, and get notified the moment someone applies, sends a message, or accepts your offer. 2911 Jobs is a product of 2911 IT Services. Same account as the website and Android app, no need to sign up again.

name: 3D 羽球戰術板
seller_name: Xuan-Hong International Technology Development Co., Ltd.
description:
一個簡易的羽球戰術板，讓你快速在手機上畫戰術、球路。

先選單打或雙打，在 2D 球場上用實線、虛線箭頭標出球路。完成後可以切到 3D 用可愛的人物模擬。

■主要功能

• 自由畫出球路軌跡（實線與虛線），可以選擇顏色，並可顯示編號
• 快速且安全的復原與重做每一次編輯
• 在 2D 編輯與 3D 播放之間切換
• 匯出、匯入戰術檔，或儲存成圖片分享
• 支援多種語言

name: 3Vallées — Couvin & Viroinval
description:
3Vallées rassemble la vie de Couvin et Viroinval dans une seule application : pour les habitants, les visiteurs et les indépendants de la région.

APPLICATION CITOYENNE, NON OFFICIELLE
3Vallées est une application citoyenne et communautaire, éditée par Atelier Cobalt et indépendante des communes de Couvin et de Viroinval, qui ne la financent pas. Les informations administratives proviennent des sites officiels des communes, qui font foi : www.couvin.be et www.viroinval.be

HABITANTS
• Les alertes du territoire, l'agenda des événements et les actualités locales, au même endroit.
• Un souci dans l'espace public ? Signalez-le en quelques secondes avec une photo et le lieu, puis suivez son traitement. Le signalement est anonyme.
• Logements à louer ou à vendre, offres d'emploi, événements : publiez votre annonce, relue par l'équipe avant sa mise en ligne.
• Urgences, CPAS, collectes, mobilité, emploi : les numéros et liens utiles toujours à portée de main.

VISITEURS
Que voir, que faire, où manger, où dormir : sites touristiques, balades et adresses de Couvin et Viroinval réunis sur une carte, avec l'itinéraire en un geste.

INDÉPENDANTS
Plus de 120 commerces ont déjà leur page gratuite : coordonnées, horaires, itinéraire. Les commerces qui le souhaitent peuvent l'enrichir (photos, réseaux sociaux, boutons Réserver, Commander, Prendre rendez-vous).

Les dernières informations consultées restent disponibles hors connexion. Choisissez votre commune au premier lancement (Couvin, Viroinval ou les deux), modifiable à tout moment.

name: 4Strokes by 4Tempos
description:
4Strokes is the companion app for 4Tempos — Motorsport Memories. 4Tempos crafts unique art pieces from genuine exotic car parts: a Ferrari V8 that becomes a coffee table, a Porsche flat-six under a dining table, a Mercedes-Benz biturbo on a pedestal. Each piece carries the story of the car it came from, and keeps telling it inside your home.

The app brings those pieces to life.

CONTROL PANEL
Talk to the 4Tempos engine controller over your own Wi-Fi: start the engine, fire the turbo, light the Strokes Stage LEDs and the TBI, set the RPM and program up to ten timed actions with the scheduler. Buttons follow the map saved on the controller, so every installation is different.

LIGHTING
Find the 4Tempos F1 lamps on the network and choose the circuit the lamp represents — Interlagos, Monza, Monaco, Spa and more. Pick a colour, a brightness or the race animation. Lamps that carry 4Tempos signature effects unlock them automatically, starting with Interlagos 1991: the last laps of Ayrton Senna's first home win, told lap by lap.

SOUND DECK
Real McLaren engine recordings — cold start, idle, rev blip, throttle revs — played through the iPad speaker or any Bluetooth or AirPlay speaker. The showroom speaker is picked automatically when it is paired and on.

SHOWROOM ON
One tap from the Dashboard (or "Hey Siri, showroom on in 4Strokes") fires the whole scene: engine, turbo, lighting stages, RPM at mid speed, the lamp cycling through its colours and the cold start followed by the idle loop. Showroom off puts everything back.

ABOUT 4TEMPOS
Our positioning, the four-stroke mantra — Celebration, Aspiration, Excitement — the manifesto and the collection with photos and films.

DEMO MODE
No 4Tempos hardware nearby? Switch on Demo mode in Settings and every screen works with simulated devices.

4Strokes talks only to devices on your local network. It collects no data, needs no account and shows no ads.

4Tempos — A passion for performance. www.4tempos.com

name: 8-Bit Impostor
description:
YOUR RETRO CONSOLE. YOUR CREATIVE PLAYGROUND.

Remember the thrill of firing up an 8-bit game? 8-Bit Impostor brings that magic to your phone or tablet—with a twist. This isn't just a place to play. It's a place to code, draw, experiment, and create.

PLAY THE CLASSICS—YOUR WAY

Import compatible .nes cartridge files or supported ZIP archives from Files. Build your own library, search and sort your collection, mark favorites, and jump back into recent games. Enjoy crisp pixel graphics, classic NES sound, and touch controls or compatible game controllers.

7 ORIGINAL CARTRIDGES INCLUDED

No imports needed to get started. Every included title runs as real NES cartridge software inside the emulator:

• ASTRO BLASTER — Pilot your ship, dodge rocks, and blast through arcade-style waves.
• BLOCKDROP — Stack, rotate, and clear lines in a fast-paced falling-block challenge.
• NES BASIC — Write, run, and save your own programs with strings, graphics, sprites, sound, and controller input.
• NES PAINT — Draw pixel sprites, explore classic colors, and preview animations.
• EDITOR — Write and save text documents, 8-bit style.
• CALCULATOR — Crunch numbers with a retro keypad.
• NES SHEETS — Build mini spreadsheets with cell references and formulas.

LEARN TO CODE IN 8-BIT

NES BASIC is a genuine programming environment running inside an emulated NES. Start with editable demos, create your own graphics and sprites, add sound, and save named projects. A built-in 66-page programming guide walks you through the language, with examples and references you can read offline.

MADE FOR PLAYING AND CREATING

On a phone, enjoy a nostalgic handheld-inspired design with six color skins. On a tablet, spread out with a roomy retro console workspace and optional touch controls. Compatible controllers bring physical buttons to the action, while hardware keyboard typing makes NES BASIC and the updated Editor even more fun to use.

SAVE YOUR PROGRESS

Keep supported cartridge saves, use five manual save-state slots per cartridge, and enable automatic resume for eligible games. Your imported cartridges and creative projects stay in local app storage.

NO ACCOUNT. NO DISTRACTIONS.

Play included software, work on your creations, and browse the programming guide offline. No account required, no ads, and no tracking.

PLAY. CODE. CREATE.

From arcade action to your first BASIC program, 8-Bit Impostor turns retro nostalgia into something you can make your own.

Import only cartridge files you have the right to use. Compatibility varies by cartridge. Commercial games are not included. 8-Bit Impostor is independent software and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Nintendo.

name: AB628Check
description:
California regulations are a bear. AB628Check makes them manageable.

Since January 1, 2026, California's AB 628 makes a working stove and refrigerator part of a habitable rental unit. A recalled appliance doesn't count as working, and landlords must repair or replace it within 30 days of notice. AB628Check watches every stove and fridge in your rentals so you never miss one.

RECALL TRACKING
• Snap the rating label. We read the brand, model and serial number for you.
• Every appliance is checked against published CPSC stove, range, oven and refrigerator recalls every day.
• The day a recall matches, you get an alert and your 30-day AB 628 countdown starts, with the manufacturer's remedy and contact info.
• Mark it repaired or replaced, or not affected, and it's recorded.

COMPLIANCE LOG
• A dated, printable record of every unit, every check and every fix, ready for a tenant dispute.

EMERGENCY RENT CAP CHECKER
• When an emergency is declared, California caps rent increases at 10%. Breaking it is a misdemeanor.
• Pick your county and enter the rents. See instantly whether an increase is allowed and the most you can charge, plus your AB 1482 limit.
• Paid plans alert you when a new emergency covers one of your counties.

AI COMPLIANCE ASSISTANT
• Ask about your units, recalls and deadlines in plain English.
• Get California rules explained with citations.
• Draft tenant notices for your review. It never sends anything on its own.

DISASTER MODE (SB 610)
• One place for evacuation rent credits, the remediation log, the Notice of Completion and each tenant's right to return.

LISTING CHECKER (AB 747)
• Paste a rental ad and we'll flag hidden fees and rewrite it with the full price clear.

PLANS
• Track one unit free.
• Paid plans cover more units, plus alerts and the AI assistant.

Recall data comes from the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC). AB628Check is not affiliated with CPSC or the State of California and does not provide legal advice. Always confirm the serial number or date code against the official recall notice.

Privacy: https://ab628check.com/privacy
Support: https://ab628check.com/support

name: Abell File Studio
description:
Dosyanla başla, gerisini Abell File Studio önersin.

Bir PDF ya da resim seç; uygulama o dosyayla yapabileceğin işleri karşına çıkarsın. Bütün işlemler cihazında yapılır: dosyaların hiçbir sunucuya yüklenmez, hesap ya da internet gerekmez.

PDF
• Birleştir: birden çok PDF'i tek dosyada topla
• Sayfaları düzenle: sırala, döndür, sil
• Sayfa çıkar ve böl: istediğin sayfaları ya da aralıkları ayır
• PDF küçült: taranmış PDF'lerin boyutunu düşür

Tarama
• Belge tara: kamerayla çek, temiz bir PDF al
• Belgeyi temizle: gölge ve lekeyi sil, kâğıdı beyazlat

Dönüştür
• Resimden PDF, PDF'ten resim
• PDF'ten Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx) ve düz metne

Resim
• Küçült ve boyutlandır, otomatik iyileştir, netleştir
