• Düz arka planı kaldır

Sonuçları kaydet ya da tek dokunuşla paylaş. Açık ve koyu tema, Türkçe ve İngilizce.

name: Accessible truck simulator
description:
Accessible Truck Sim is a truck-driving game you can play completely by sound. It's made for VoiceOver from the ground up by a blind developer, and sighted players can play it too.

You really drive. No menus pick a route while the truck drives itself. You start the engine, press the accelerator, brake, and steer.

DRIVE BY EAR
• A diesel engine that rises and falls with RPM and load, with an air hiss on every gear change
• Soft beeps in the ear you're drifting toward, faster and higher the further you leave the centre of your lane
• Rumble strips you hear and feel on the side you're drifting toward
• Curves announced ahead of time with a suggested speed, and a warning if you're too fast
• Speed called out as you accelerate, and a spoken dashboard on demand: speed, gear, RPM, fuel, engine temperature and turn signals
• Vibration that follows the engine and kicks hard on the rumble strip

YOUR WAY TO STEER
• Tilt the phone like a steering wheel, or use a one-finger joystick
• Bluetooth keyboards and game controllers supported
• Simple gestures that work with VoiceOver on: three-finger double tap to start the engine, two-finger double tap for the dashboard, two-finger swipes for turn signals and the horn

This is an early version with one truck and a practice road full of curves. Coming next: GPS routes, traffic, deliveries, better trucks, upgrades and your own trucking company.

name: Accrete: Micro Action Arc
description:
Small actions. Lasting growth.

Accrete: Micro Action Arc helps you build consistency through small, manageable daily actions. Read a few pages. Take a mindful walk. Write a little. Give each effort a place to grow.

MAKE SMALL YOUR STARTING POINT
Create a daily plan with one to five micro actions. Choose what matters to you, set a manageable amount, and mark each action complete as you go.

SEE YOUR GROWTH
Watch your accretion index take shape over time. Completing your daily actions adds up to 1% growth per day. A day without completed actions brings a small decline, with Gentle and Standard modes offering different levels of accountability.

KEEP WHAT YOU HAVE DONE
Your harvest records the pages, minutes, words, and other efforts you have completed. Your index may dip, but your accumulated effort stays in your ledger.

MAKE ROOM FOR REST
Use one Stasis day each calendar week to pause without index decay. Rest has a place in your routine.

LOOK AHEAD
Explore what completing your daily plan could add up to over 30 days or a year. Your horizon shows an ideal scenario to help make small actions feel tangible.

A LITTLE GRACE FOR YESTERDAY
Forgot to record an action? Review and correct yesterday's record. Adjust your future plan without rewriting today's commitments.

A QUIET SPACE OF YOUR OWN
Enjoy layouts designed for iPhone and iPad, with light and dark appearances. The app works offline without an account, and your records are stored locally on your device.

The accretion index is a motivational illustration of consistency, not a measure of ability or a promise of personal improvement.

Start with something small. Give it a little space each day.

name: Acuarela
description:
Convierte los pequeños momentos de tu vida en recuerdos pintados.

Acuarela es un espacio para hacer una pausa, jugar con el color y crear algo tuyo. No hace falta saber dibujar: empieza con una fotografía, una idea o un lienzo en blanco y pinta a tu ritmo.

TUS FOTOS, TU INSPIRACIÓN
Elige una fotografía o toma una con la cámara. Acuarela extrae sus colores y prepara una guía de formas para ayudarte a empezar. Puedes consultar la imagen, mostrarla como fondo u ocultar las ayudas cuando quieras. Cada pincelada la haces tú.

UNA GUÍA PARA DAR EL PRIMER PASO
Empieza por las manchas grandes, continúa con las formas principales y termina con unos pocos detalles. Tú decides cuánto pintar y cuándo tu recuerdo está terminado.

EXPERIMENTA CON EL AGUA
Añade gotas para expandir el pigmento y diluir el color. Repite sobre una zona para crear transiciones suaves y bordes difuminados. Inclina el dispositivo para explorar el movimiento de la pintura o utiliza los controles de balanceo.

ENCUENTRA TU TRAZO
Prueba los pinceles redondo, ancho y seco. Ajusta el tamaño y la cantidad de agua, mezcla colores y difumina con el dedo. Dibuja con el dedo o utiliza la sensibilidad a la presión y la inclinación del Apple Pencil en dispositivos compatibles.

GUARDA LO QUE QUIERES RECORDAR
Pon nombre a tus acuarelas, añade una fecha y escribe una frase sobre ese momento. Organízalas en cuadernos para reunir los colores de un viaje, tus rincones favoritos o pequeños instantes de cada día. Vuelve a hojearlos cuando te apetezca.

REGALA UNA POSTAL HECHA POR TI
Transforma tu dibujo en una postal animada que reproduce tus trazos. Añade una dedicatoria y compártela en formato GIF. La fotografía de referencia y las notas de tu cuaderno no se incluyen en la postal.

UN POCO DE INSPIRACIÓN
Si no sabes qué pintar, empieza con una de las propuestas de Acuarela: el cielo que has visto hoy, los colores de un paseo o algo pequeño que quieres recordar. También puedes explorar libremente sobre el lienzo.

Tus días, pintados por ti.

name: Adil Languages
description:
Learn English step by step, from your very first words to C2.

Adil Languages takes you on a journey through seven countries. Start in New Zealand if you're new to English, then travel through Australia, Scotland, England, Ireland, the USA and Canada, one level at a time (A1 to C2).

• Grammar lessons that help you discover the rules yourself: a short story, questions, then practice
• Learn, Practise and Check for every topic, with hints when you need them
• Real voices read every story and question
• A new Word of the Day, plus reviews so you remember your words
• Stars, picture cards, passport stamps and a certificate when you pass a level's final exam
• Points, streaks, weekly medals and leaderboards to keep you going
• Not sure where to start? Take the short level test

Free. No ads. Made by an English teacher.

name: AdPilot AI
description:
AdPilot AI is a workspace for targetologists and marketing teams that run Meta (Facebook and Instagram) lead-generation ads in Uzbekistan.

• Launch campaigns from a 5-step wizard: pick the ad account, upload videos, write the text, set the budget and the Instant Form. Campaigns are always created paused and start only when you activate them.
• Rule-based optimizer: every 6 hours it checks cost per lead, hook rate, frequency and spend, then suggests pausing weak ads or changing the budget. Every decision is logged, can require your approval and can be undone. Daily budget limits are always respected.
• Leads: Instant Form leads arrive in the app and can be forwarded automatically to CPA networks (100k.uz first) with delivery status and retries.
• Profit and loss per platform, campaign and creative, with alerts and daily reports.
• Team: invite staff with roles (owner, manager, viewer).

Connections (Meta account, CPA network, your own AI key) are made by each user from their profile. The interface is in Uzbek (Latin).

name: Aeca - Ambient Screensaver
description:
Aeca is a screensaver of abstract color and light, always drifting.
Every 45 seconds, the scene softly changes into the next.

ENJOY THE COLORS
- Let Aeca choose from a wide range of palettes
- Make colors from your favorite photos
- Create your own palette with the color picker
- Save the colors you love and bring them back anytime
- Press and hold to move to the next scene without waiting

KEEP THE SCENE
- Save the current scene as an image and use it as a wallpaper
- Share it right away

PLENTY OF OPTIONS
- Show the clock and status bar always, on tap, or not at all
- Keep the screen on always, only while charging, or never
- Works with Shortcuts. Use an automation to open Aeca automatically when you plug in
- Tilt your device and the pattern moves with it

IPHONE DUO
- Fully supports iPhone Duo
- Half-fold it and the lower half becomes a floor that reflects the scene

USE IT WITH PEACE OF MIND
No data collection, no ads, and no internet connection. No in-app purchases or subscriptions.

name: Aeneas: Mind Workbench
description:
Aeneas is a private personal system: capture, tasks and a planner, notes that link and tag themselves, reminders, quick logs, search, and an assistant with a memory, on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac.

Everything lives on a hub you run on your own computer (a Mac or a Linux machine). Your devices talk only to it. There is no account with us, no server of ours, no analytics and no tracking.

CAPTURE ANYTHING
Type, dictate or share into the inbox from any app or from your Watch. The assistant files each capture where it belongs and keeps a dated diary, so nothing needs sorting by hand.

PLAN AND REMEMBER
Tasks, a day planner, reminders on time on every device, renewals and subscriptions, and quick logs for anything you track.

NOTES THAT ORGANIZE THEMSELVES
Markdown notes with tags and links to related notes added for you, kept as plain files on your hub.

AN ASSISTANT THAT STAYS HOME
The assistant runs on a model on your own computer and remembers what you tell it. A cloud model is something you can choose, never the default. Web lookups are off until you turn them on, and then go only through Tor.

MODULES YOU CHOOSE
Turn on only what you use: homelab monitoring, projects, music sketches (hum a melody, get MIDI), wiki, health, pets, food, games and films, a calculator with your state's meals tax, and more. The app asks only for the permissions of the modules you chose.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- One key per device; remove a lost phone from any other device.
- Encrypted backups with a key only you hold.
- Your local copy stays out of iCloud Backup, Spotlight and the lock screen unless you turn them on.
- Free and open source (AGPL), so anyone can check what it does.

You need a computer that stays on to run the hub. Setup takes about 15 minutes plus a model download; the guide is at github.com/gnomecannon/aeneas.

name: Aerofusion Weather
description:
Aerofusion Weather reúne en una sola app lo que un piloto revisa antes de volar en Costa Rica.

• METAR y TAF de MRPV (Tobías Bolaños, Pavas), MROC (Juan Santamaría), MRLB (Liberia), MRLM (Limón) y más, en texto original y decodificados, con categoría VFR / MVFR / IFR por colores.
• Cámaras del Aeropuerto Internacional Tobías Bolaños (MRPV) con timelapse, cortesía de Stratos FBO.
• Radar meteorológico de Costa Rica.
• Tráfico ADS-B en vivo: llegadas y salidas de MRPV y MROC con la estela de cada aeronave.
• Briefing de vuelo: origen y destino, METAR, TAF, SIGMET, salida y puesta del sol y altitud densidad en verde, amarillo o rojo.
• Sigue hasta 4 matrículas y ve su destino y tiempo estimado de llegada.
• En español e inglés.

Pensada para pilotos, escuelas de vuelo, despachadores y operadores que vuelan en Costa Rica.

La información es solo de referencia y no sustituye las fuentes oficiales de aeronavegación ni la decisión del piloto al mando.

Desarrollada por Aerofusion OÜ · www.aerofusion.aero

name: AeroVeyra
description:
Your next horizon is waiting.

Take the controls of a colorful vintage aircraft and follow glowing wind rings through the skies of AeroVeyra. Find your line, ride the breeze, and touch down on a floating airfield in an original airplane adventure built around steering, timing, and graceful landings.

FLY YOUR OWN LINE
Drag to steer through numbered rings. Each ring gives you a burst of speed, while shifting winds challenge you to stay on course. Avoid turbulent storm clouds, recover missed rings, and reach the runway before time runs out. Hold the brake, align your wings, and bring your aircraft home.

TWENTY ROUTES, FOUR HORIZONS
Begin in the warm skies of Amber Dawn, explore Coral Passage, navigate Violet Tempest, and master the narrow approaches of Celestial Drift. Earn up to three stars on every route and replay your favorites to improve your score.

FOUR DISTINCT AIRCRAFT
Learn with the balanced Swift Finch, chase speed in the Copper Dart, steady your course with the Azure Glider, or turn sharply with the Ember Falcon. Earn stars to unlock aircraft with different speed, stability, turning, and acceleration.

YOUR PERSONAL PILOT LOGBOOK
Track flights, successful landings, best scores, perfect routes, flying distance, and recent results. Collect aviation badges as your skills grow.

MADE FOR THE JOURNEY
Original illustrated aircraft and skies. An interactive flight tutorial. Optional sound and haptics. Local progress saving. Fully offline play, with no account, advertising, in-app purchases, or third-party services.

Chase the breeze. Find your line. Welcome to AeroVeyra.

name: Agro AI Optic
description:
Agro AI Optic — your AI farming assistant

Agro AI Optic puts an AI agronomist in your pocket. Snap a photo of a leaf or soil and get an instant, easy-to-understand diagnosis — then clear, practical advice for your farm. From cassava, rice and maize to tomatoes, coffee and cocoa, Agro AI Optic helps farmers everywhere protect their crops, improve their soil and earn more from every harvest.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Pest & Disease Scan — Photograph an affected leaf and get an AI diagnosis with symptoms, treatment and prevention steps.

• Soil Analysis — Take a photo of your soil to identify the soil type, the best crops to grow on it, and how to improve it.

• Crop Advice — Enter your soil test and local climate, and let the AI recommend the best crops or assess any crop you choose.

• Market Prices — Get AI price estimates for common commodities in your local currency, plus tips on selling for a good price.

• Climate Risk — See a live 7-day weather forecast for your location and get advice on planting, spraying, irrigation and protecting crops.

• Ask AI — Chat with a friendly farming assistant about any crop, soil, pest, market or weather question, in simple language.

FOR EVERY FARMER

Agro AI Optic works for any crop, any soil and any country. Choose your location and currency, and the AI tailors its advice to your conditions — no agronomy knowledge needed. Proudly built by a Sierra Leonean tech team, with deep understanding of smallholder farming and strong support for crops and markets across West Africa and beyond.

SMART, SIMPLE, AND YOURS

• Powerful AI advice from a single photo.
• Save your pest, crop and soil checks to your history and revisit them anytime.
• Sign in securely with Google to keep your activity across devices.
• A clean, simple design that works on everyday Android and iOS phones.

Agro AI Optic is free to download. Start making smarter farming decisions today — spot problems early, grow the right crops, sell at better prices, and plan around the weather.

Smarter farming, in your pocket.

Agro AI Optic · Powered by TechMinds (SL) Ltd
agroaifeed.techmindssl.dev

name: AI Mahjong Scorer
description:
Point your camera at a winning Japanese (Riichi) mahjong hand, and the app calculates the yaku, fu, han and points automatically.

There is no shutter button. When the hand is recognized, the app locks onto it automatically, and a single tap on Ron or Tsumo completes the score. If a tile is misrecognized, tap it on the spot to correct it.

Yaku and fu judgment and score calculation run entirely on the device, so every feature works without a network connection. To improve recognition and scoring accuracy, the app may send anonymous usage statistics, which you can turn off at any time in Settings. Captured images are not sent by default and are sent only with your prior consent. See the privacy policy for details.

Supports iPhone and iPad.

name: AI Society at Baylor
description:
The member hub for AI Society at Baylor.

See upcoming events, get event reminders, RSVP when an event offers it, and scan a QR code to check in. Browse the society directory, contact your teammates, and keep up with projects. Submit applications and see their status.

Your AiS account works in the app and Member Hub website. Officers manage events, attendance, points, applications, and society finances. Project managers can update their own project details. Access follows your current society role.

An active society roster record is required. Deleting your app account removes your sign-in and saved sessions while keeping your society membership.

name: Aldurr Supplies
description: Al Durr Supplies is a wholesale store for pharmacies, hospitals, medical centers and drug stores in Iraq.

name: ALtools
description:
AL Tools connects to your own Linux servers over SSH and keeps the work where it belongs — on the server. Browse and transfer files with SFTP, including administrator access when you need it; open a persistent terminal that survives disconnects with tmux; and use the AI Workspace to drive the Codex or Claude Code command-line tools installed on your server, with streaming replies, saved conversations and file attachments.
Security first: host keys are verified on first use and pinned, passwords and SSH keys are stored only in the device Keychain behind Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode, and the app never sends your credentials or data anywhere except to the servers you configure. There are no accounts, no analytics and no servers of our own.
Requirements: a server you can reach over SSH with Python 3. The AI Workspace additionally requires the Codex or Claude Code CLI installed and signed in on that server under your own account; AL Tools does not include or provide access to any AI model.

name: AlumniPad by CodeShop GH
description:
AlumniPad brings your school's alumni association into your pocket.

- Alumni directory: find classmates by year group, city, profession or house
- World map: see where alumni live across the globe
- News and events: stay up to date and RSVP
- Jobs and marketplace: post and discover opportunities and alumni businesses
- Memories and gallery: share photos and stories
- Giving: pay dues and contribute to school projects and welfare schemes
- Private and secure: membership is approved by your association

Sign in with your School Key and your alumni account. Not a member yet? Register and your association will approve you.

name: Anarriê
description:
Anarri is the book of the marcador de quadrilha: the teacher, parent or community volunteer in Brazil who calls ("marca") the quadrilha junina at a school, church or neighbourhood arraia, with just four or five rehearsals to teach ten to thirty couples a routine before Santo Antonio, Sao Joao and Sao Pedro.

Build this year's roteiro from a bundled library of about 40 traditional calls -- Cumprimento, Anavantu, Anarrie, Balance, Caminho da roca, Olha a chuva!, Olha a cobra!, Tunel, Grande roda, Passeio dos namorados, Despedida and more -- with the counts and song for each block and the running time for the whole quadrilha. Every call comes with its French origin where it has one (anavantu from "en avant tous", anarrie from "en arriere", balance from "balancer"), a small animated top-down diagram of what the cavalheiros and damas do, and the answer the dancers shout back. Calls vary by region, so rename any call to how your group shouts it, or add your own from scratch.

Rehearse with the Ensaio prompter: full screen, today's call in huge type with the next one waiting below, a beat counter you tap to the song's own tempo, and a haptic cue a few counts before the change -- so you can call with your eyes on the couples, not the phone. Works in portrait or turned sideways across the yard.

Keep your roster in Pares: names, a photo from the camera or your library, who's absent today, a quick way to swap partners, and the full casamento caipira cast -- noivo, noiva, padre, delegado, pais da noiva, padrinhos -- with who plays which role and the order they enter.

After each rehearsal, score every call from one to three and jot a note. Ensaios keeps the whole log and floats the weakest calls to the top, so the next session starts exactly where it needs to. Twelve selos track your progress toward the festa.

Anarri does not play or bundle music: songs are named only, and the tempo is tapped by hand, so it works with any sound system you already have. There are no accounts, no competition judging, no shop and no social feed -- just the tools a marcador actually carries into the yard. Fully offline, Portuguese (Brazil) first.

name: Andoo
description:
Andoo es un diario de paseos que registra tus recorridos a pie y te permite conservarlos con mapas, fotos y notas. Úsala para recordar las calles que descubriste durante un viaje, guardar tus caminatas cotidianas y compartir una postal de cada experiencia.

Pulsa «Empezar un paseo», camina y, al terminar, guarda el recorrido. Después podrás consultarlo en «Mis paseos», añadir tus recuerdos y verlo junto a tus otras rutas en «Explorar».

• Registra tus paseos
Guarda tu recorrido mediante la ubicación del dispositivo y consulta la distancia aproximada y el tiempo activo. Elige entre el modo Detallado, que conserva más giros, y el modo Ahorro, que registra puntos más espaciados y solicita menos precisión.

• Pausa y continúa
Detén el registro manualmente cuando lo necesites o activa la pausa automática al detectar reposo. Las pausas y las interrupciones se representan como tramos separados en el mapa.

• Consulta el paseo con la pantalla bloqueada
El registro puede continuar en segundo plano durante un paseo activo. En dispositivos compatibles, las Actividades en directo muestran el tiempo, la distancia y el estado del paseo en la pantalla bloqueada y en la Dynamic Island.

• Revisa tu camino punto a punto
Explora el mapa y el listado de ubicaciones registradas. Consulta la hora, las coordenadas y la precisión aproximada de cada punto, localízalo en el mapa o solicita su dirección. También puedes revisar información sobre la calidad de la grabación.

• Guarda fotos y notas
Añade hasta 12 fotos a cada paseo, escribe lo que quieras recordar y asigna un viaje y una ciudad. Cambia el nombre de tus recorridos y elimina los que ya no quieras conservar.

• Organiza tu colección
Busca paseos por nombre, viaje o ciudad y agrúpalos para encontrarlos fácilmente. Consulta tus rutas juntas en un mapa y filtra por viaje o ciudad. Desde Inicio puedes ver el total de paseos personales y los kilómetros aproximados acumulados.

• Descubre nuevos rincones
El mapa de descubrimientos destaca las zonas nuevas de tu último paseo frente a los caminos que ya habías registrado. Las zonas se calculan de forma aproximada a partir de tus puntos GPS.

• Elige una pequeña aventura
Dale una idea a tu próximo paseo: encontrar un rincón tranquilo, descubrir algo amarillo, tomar un camino diferente o fijarte en un detalle. Son propuestas opcionales que tú puedes marcar como completadas.

• Crea postales de tus paseos
Personaliza una postal con el recorrido, el lugar, una frase y una foto del paseo. Incluye la distancia, el tiempo y, cuando estén disponibles, los pasos registrados por el iPhone. Compártela como imagen PNG o GIF con una animación ilustrativa del camino.

• Exporta tus recorridos
Guarda o comparte la ruta en formato GPX con sus tramos separados, o genera una imagen del mapa. Estas exportaciones no incluyen tus fotos ni tus notas.

• Vuelve a tus recuerdos
Redescubre paseos anteriores desde Inicio y abre de nuevo sus mapas, fotografías y anotaciones.

• Crea y restaura copias de seguridad
Exporta tus paseos terminados, rutas, notas y fotos a un archivo que puedes guardar en Archivos o en iCloud Drive. Restáuralo en otro dispositivo para recuperar los paseos que falten, sin duplicar los existentes. Las copias se gestionan manualmente.

• Aprende con ejemplos
Explora recorridos simulados y consulta la guía integrada para conocer las funciones antes de grabar tu primer paseo. Los ejemplos están identificados y no cuentan en tus estadísticas personales.

Los paseos y sus recuerdos se guardan en el dispositivo. Andoo solicita ubicación para registrar el recorrido y permiso de Movimiento para la pausa automática y la consulta de pasos. Los pasos disponibles incluyen los realizados durante las pausas.

La precisión del recorrido y la continuidad del registro dependen de la señal GPS y de iOS. Si la app se cierra a la fuerza, la grabación se interrumpe y el paseo se recupera en pausa al volver. La carga de mapas y de direcciones necesitan conexión.

name: Anka IPTV Player
description:
Anka IPTV Player, kendi IPTV kaynaklarını iPhone, iPad ve Apple TV üzerinde kullanman için geliştirilmiş native bir oynatıcıdır.

M3U/M3U8 bağlantısı veya dosyası ekle ya da kendi Xtream Codes hesabınla bağlan. Canlı TV, film ve dizilerini ayrı bölümlerde gez; kategorileri düzenle, arama yap ve favorilerini kaydet. Destekleyen kaynaklarda sezon ve bölüm seç, kaldığın yerden devam et.

XMLTV yayın rehberiyle şimdi ve sonra yayınlanacak programları takip et. Telefonla güvenli QR/kod kurulumu, birden fazla kaynak yönetimi, hesap bilgileri, yerel PIN kontrolü ve kalıcı afiş önbelleği sunar.

Telefon ve tablet için dokunmatik, Apple TV için kumandaya uygun arayüz. Ses ve altyazı seçimi ile görüntü oranını ayarla. Oynatma ve codec desteği cihazına ve kaynağına bağlıdır.

Anka IPTV Player kanal, film, dizi veya IPTV aboneliği sağlamaz ve satmaz. Kendi kaynağını eklemeli ve yalnız erişim yetkisine sahip olduğun içerikleri kullanmalısın. Anka hesabı gerekmez. Uygulamayı denemek için yapay test görüntülerinden oluşan örnek kütüphane bulunur.

Destek: hello@ankastudio.ltd
Gizlilik: https://ankaplayer.ankastudio.ltd/privacy
Kullanım şartları: https://ankaplayer.ankastudio.ltd/terms

name: Anti-Strobo
description:
En concert, les stroboscopes gâchent les vidéos : à chaque éclair, l'image devient blanche et l'iPhone se dérègle d'un flash à l'autre. Anti-Strobo filme le concert et te rend une vidéo où les éclairs ont disparu.

UN SEUL BOUTON
Ouvre l'app face à la scène : elle mesure la lumière entre les éclairs et affiche « Exposition prête ». Tu n'as plus qu'à filmer. Aucun réglage.

LES ÉCLAIRS RETIRÉS, LA VIDÉO FLUIDE
L'app filme à haute cadence et repère chaque image éclairée par un stroboscope, même une petite lampe dans un coin. Elle la retire, puis recrée les images manquantes pour que la vidéo reste fluide à 30 images par seconde. Le son est gardé tel quel, synchronisé.

LES SCÈNES SOMBRES ÉCLAIRCIES
Dans une salle sombre, la vidéo nettoyée est débruitée et éclaircie.

TON ORIGINAL TOUJOURS GARDÉ
Les deux vidéos vont dans ta pellicule : l'original et la version nettoyée. Le nettoyage continue si tu verrouilles ton iPhone.

RIEN NE QUITTE TON IPHONE
Tout le traitement se fait sur l'appareil. Pas de compte, pas de publicité, aucune donnée collectée.

OPEN SOURCE
Le code est public et ouvert aux contributions : github.com/deylac/anti-strobo

Bon à savoir : dans une salle presque noire avec un stroboscope très rapide, la vidéo nettoyée reste plus sombre que la vidéo habituelle de l'iPhone, qui garde les éclairs.

name: Apex Player Placement
description:
Balanced teams, without the spreadsheet.

Apex Player Placement is for the program director who builds the teams every season. Import your registered players, rank them, add your coaches, and place every player on a balanced team in one tap. It works for soccer, basketball, baseball, or any youth team sport.

IMPORT YOUR PLAYERS
• Read a roster or registration export as a PDF, Excel, or CSV file, including GotSport exports.
• When the file has age groups, brackets like U8 Boys or U10 Co-ed are created for you.
• Duplicate players are caught before they're added.

RANK THEM YOUR WAY
One tap per player. The default scale is 1 to 3 in half steps, and you can set your own. Filter to the players you haven't ranked yet.

BALANCED IN ONE TAP
• Each coach is one team in each bracket they coach. Add placeholder teams when a coach isn't found yet.
• Set a team size limit. Anyone who doesn't fit goes to an overflow list, and adding a team fixes it.
• Families who asked for a coach get that coach. Siblings and friends stay together.
• Every team gets a pick each round, starting with your strongest players, so team sizes and strength stay even.
• Teams that are stronger or weaker than the rest are flagged.

THEN MAKE IT YOURS
Move or swap players, lock the ones who must stay put, and re-balance the rest. On iPad, every team sits side by side.

GET THE ROSTERS OUT
• Copy any team's roster and paste it into your registration platform, a spreadsheet, or an email.
• Export the whole bracket to Excel, with a summary sheet and one sheet per team.
• Exports carry names only. Birth dates and gender stay on your device.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts. No server. No ads. No tracking. Player names never leave your device unless you share an export yourself.

One price. $9.99 buys the app. There's nothing inside it to unlock.

Made by Apex Digital Software, the studio behind Apex Soccer and Apex Match Day.

name: App Seeds - Problem Notes
description: Capture problems and inconveniences you find in daily life or online, then organize them as ideas for app development. Add a title and category quickly, then record the problem, context, desired improvement, source, tags, and related URL. Mark ideas as development candidates when they are worth exploring. Data is stored on your device and can be exported or imported as JSON. No account or cloud sync is required.

name: ArchiviOnline.it Mobile
description:
ArchiviOnline.it Mobile brings your organization's online archive to your iPhone and iPad.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• My files: browse folders and documents, preview PDFs, images and more, search, rename, move and download.
• Shared with me: instantly find the files and folders others have shared with you.
• Workspaces: work with your team in your organization's shared workspaces.
• Upload photos and documents: take a photo, pick from your library or from Files; uploads resume on their own if the connection drops.
• Share with a link, search across all your files and restore from the trash.
• Recent files and favorites at hand; Italian and English.

SECURITY
• Secure sign-in on your archive's web page, with two-step verification and passkeys where required.
• App lock with Face ID or the device passcode.
• Sign-in data is kept in the device keychain.
• Remote wipe of local data if an administrator disconnects the device.
• Your files stay in ArchiviOnline.it archives, hosted in Italian data centers.

WHO IT IS FOR
For ArchiviOnline.it customers, organizations and public administrations. An ArchiviOnline.it account, provided by your organization or already yours, is required.

Works on iPhone and iPad, in portrait and landscape.

name: AreaCalc: Land Area Measure
description:
Measure any plot on a live map. Walk the boundary, drop points, and see the area and perimeter as the outline takes shape.

AreaCalc is built for land, lots, and field work. Measure an area, a distance, a single marker, or a circle. Save the plot with a name and details, then open it again whenever you need it.

What you can do

• Measure area and see the perimeter update as you draw 
• Measure a distance, drop a marker, or mark a circle 
• Save every plot and open it again from Measurements 
• Open a saved place in Google Maps 
• Check your heading, with true north, coordinates, and altitude 
• See live GPS speed 
• Use a spirit level for pitch and roll 
• Check local weather 
• Switch between light, dark, and system appearance 
• Choose the units for area, distance, perimeter, and coordinates

AreaCalc uses your location to center the map, show your heading, measure speed, and show local weather. Measurements are saved on your iPhone.

name: AreaScope
description:
See integrals more clearly with AreaScope, an offline mathematics studio for exploring curves, understanding area, and building numerical intuition.

Start with a prepared experiment or shape your own function. Adjust the integration interval, change the number of subintervals, and watch the graph respond. All calculations and saved experiments stay on your device unless you choose to share a report.

Explore your curve

Work with polynomial functions up to degree three or sine functions combined with a linear term. Edit coefficients using sliders or numerical input. Drag the interval bounds and tap a numerical slice to inspect its samples, weights, and contribution.

Understand the area

Area Lens brings positive area, negative area magnitude, net integral, and total area into one clear view. Discover how regions can cancel in a signed integral while their total area remains positive.

Compare three methods

Calculate with the midpoint, trapezoid, and Simpson methods. Compare approximate values and absolute errors against reference results. Explore signed integrals or total area, then follow the error graph and table as the interval count increases from 4 to 128.

Build your intuition

Try eight short offline lessons. Predict the sign of an integral, estimate its value, or choose the closer method. Submit your answer, read an explanation, and continue the same experiment in Explore. Your attempts and completed lessons are saved locally.

Keep your discoveries

Save experiments in Notebook with titles and observations. Search by title, mark favorites, edit notes, and restore an experiment to keep exploring. Share a text report containing the function, parameters, calculation results, and notes whenever you choose.

A comfortable place to learn

Use layouts designed for iPhone and iPad, choose a light or dark appearance, and adjust the displayed decimal places. A field guide explains the mathematical ideas behind the graphs and methods.

AreaScope works offline without registration, advertising, or tracking SDKs. It does not require a subscription or in app purchases.

name: Arena Trampolim Virtual
description:
Os brinquedos da Arena Trampolim agora cabem no celular! Pule de trampolim em trampolim, desça o escorregador gigante, mergulhe na piscina de bolinhas e corra pelo labirinto laser.

O jogo do parque tem sete minigames curtos e coloridos para toda a família. Sem anúncios, sem compras dentro do app e sem cadastro.

OS BRINQUEDOS
• Piscina de Bolinhas: toque nas moedas que aparecem entre as bolinhas e cuidado com as bombas.
• Escorregador: desça pelo tubo gigante juntando moedas e desviando dos cubos vermelhos.
• Travessia: atravesse a plataforma suspensa deslizando o dedo para trocar de lado, pular e abaixar.
• Trampolins: escolha o próximo trampolim e aperte PULA na hora certa para saltar mais alto. Vá onde tem estrela e fuja da bomba!
• Bolas Neon – Agilidade: acerte os botões da parede neon assim que eles acenderem.
• Bolas Neon – Sequência: memorize as cores que piscam e repita na mesma ordem. A cada rodada, a sequência cresce.
• Labirinto Laser: corra pelo corredor neon, passe pelos lasers e pegue as joias antes que a parede vermelha alcance você.

COMO FUNCIONA
• Piscina de Bolinhas e Escorregador já começam liberados.
• Toda partida rende tickets, mesmo quando não dá certo. Com eles, você libera os outros brinquedos. Tickets só se ganham jogando.
• Partidas curtas, de 1 a 3 minutos, com até três estrelas no final.
• Controles por toque: tocar, arrastar e joystick na tela. Nas Bolas Neon, dá para mirar girando o celular ou usar o joystick.

PARA PAIS E RESPONSÁVEIS
• Sem anúncios e sem compras dentro do app.
• Sem cadastro, login ou chat.
• Disponível em português, inglês e espanhol.
• Música e efeitos sonoros podem ser desligados nos ajustes.

name: Arkhes Staff
description: Arkhes Staff, otel ekiplerinin günlük işini tek bir akışta toplayarak misafirin isteğini saniyeler içinde doğru kişiye ulaştırır; kimin üstlendiği, işin ne aşamada olduğu ve ne zaman tamamlandığı herkes için görünür olduğundan telefon trafiği, kâğıt notlar ve "bunu kim alıyordu?" sorusu geride kalır. Kat hizmetlerinden teknik servise, mutfaktan misafir ilişkilerine kadar her ekip yalnızca kendi işini görür, ekip içi iletişim de aynı yerde akar. Sade ve eğitim gerektirmeyen arayüzü sayesinde personel ilk gün kullanmaya başlar. Arkhes Staff, Arkhes kullanan otellerin personeli içindir; hesabınızı oteliniz açar.

name: Arkwright Mentoring
description:
Arkwright is the mentoring app for Arkwright Engineering Scholars and their mentors, run by The Smallpeice Trust.

Arkwright Engineering Scholars are matched with a mentor working in engineering. This app keeps that relationship in one safe place, whether you're a scholar planning your next steps or a mentor sharing what working in engineering is really like.

name: ARONIQ
description:
The ARONIQ app controls your ARONIQ Smart Car Diffuser. Pick a mood, say when, and your diffuser spreads just as much scent as you like, all day.

MOODS
Six moods, each with its own intensity and light colour: Deep Focus, Sleep, Meditation, Calm, Fresh start and Grounding. Pick one, set the times and days, and your diffuser follows that routine by itself, even when your phone isn't around.

YOUR WAY
• Five intensities, from subtle to room-filling
• Up to three time blocks a day (a commute, for example) and any days you like
• Spray now: 5, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, whenever you like
• On or off with one tap

LIGHT
One colour, a changing colour cycle or a light effect. Or simply no light.

OIL
The app keeps track of how much oil is left in your diffuser and roughly how many days it will last. Refilled? One tap, and pick which Signature Senses blend went in.

ON ALL YOUR PHONES
Your diffuser's name, colour, routine and oil level are the same on every phone you use with it, and come back when you reinstall the app.

NO ACCOUNT
The app works over Bluetooth. You don't need an account, and we don't ask for your name or email address. You can also delete your diffuser's data from within the app.

NO DIFFUSER AT HAND?
Tap "Try without a diffuser" on the start screen to explore the whole app with a simulated diffuser.

The app works with the ARONIQ Smart Car Diffuser. More at aroniq.nl.

name: Aroom - Couple D+Day
description:
Aroom is a D+Day app for two people counting their days together.
Enter the day you got together, invite your partner, and both phones show the same D+Day and anniversaries.

D+Day
Counts from your start date as Day 1, so you always know what day you are on.

Anniversaries
Works out 50, 100, 150, 200 and 300 days and every yearly anniversary for you. Your birthdays and seasonal days such as Christmas sit in the same list.

Your own days
Add a day that is just yours with a title, date and memo. Repeat it every year if you like. Your partner sees it too.

Reminders
Get a reminder on the day and an early reminder one day, three days or a week before. You choose the time.

Widgets
See your D+Day and what is coming up on your Home Screen and Lock Screen without opening the app.

Getting started
Aroom is made for two. Sign in with Apple, then one of you creates an 8-character invite code and the other enters it to connect.

Available in Korean, English and Japanese, with dark mode.

name: Arrivo: Destination Alerts
description:
Arrivo helps you remember a destination without continually watching the map.

CHOOSE YOUR PLACES
Search Apple Maps, choose a point on the map, or enter coordinates. Set an arrival area from 200 meters to 5 kilometers and save up to 10 alarms.

KEEP YOUR ALERTS ORGANIZED
Enable destinations independently. Search your saved alarms, edit an enabled alarm, or delete one without switching off the others. Arrival alerts are one-time: the place stays saved, ready to enable again when you need it.

SEE HOW FAR YOU ARE
Open an alarm to see its map, arrival area, and approximate straight-line distance. Distance updates run only while the details are visible in the foreground. Distance is not a driving route or travel-time estimate.

THOUGHTFUL ARRIVAL NOTIFICATIONS
Arrivals reported within five seconds can share one notification with their destination names. Stop acknowledges the included arrivals while other enabled alarms continue. If you enable an alert while already inside its area, Arrivo waits for you to leave and return.

NO ACCOUNT OR ADVERTISING
Your saved alarms stay in the app's on-device storage. Arrivo has no account, ads, analytics SDK, or in-app purchases. Apple provides map, search, location, and notification services.

IMPORTANT TO KNOW
Location detection can be delayed or missed. Notifications follow your Silent mode, Focus, notification settings, and device volume; they do not ring continuously. Always and Precise Location are needed for background arrival detection. Do not force-quit the app while monitoring, and reopen it after restarting your iPhone. Search and map tiles may need an internet connection. Do not rely on Arrivo for safety-critical reminders.

Privacy: https://www.wesaha.com/arrivo/privacy/
Support: madhu@wesaha.com

name: ArrowPuff
description:
A clear path. A perfect match. A satisfying pop.

Welcome to ArrowPuff, a colorful arrow puzzle adventure in a sky-high carnival. Study the board, match an arrow's color and direction to an open slot, then tap to send it sliding toward the balloons.

THINK BEFORE YOU TAP
Arrows follow their own winding paths as they leave the board. Find an unblocked route, make room for your next move, and complete each level's balloon targets before your moves or HP run out.

EXPLORE 132 LEVELS
Start with approachable boards and work your way into intricate arrow puzzles. Travel along a floating world map, earn coins, and aim for three stars by keeping extra launches to a minimum.

GET A LITTLE HELP
Choose from six boosters: Hint, Undo, Shuffle, Rocket, Color Clear, and Extra Slot. Find a valid move, rotate the board, bypass a blocker, or open the fifth queue slot when you need more room.

MAKE IT YOURS
Use earned coins to unlock arrow styles, balloon shapes, and board colors. Try striped Candy Cane arrows, glowing Neon arrows, heart or star balloons, and a bright Cloudscape board. Mix your favorite looks while keeping the same puzzle rules.

COME BACK FOR MORE
Collect daily check-in rewards and complete the daily balloon challenge for extra coins. Play offline, and return to your saved progress whenever you are ready for another puzzle.

name: Assist Glasses
description:
Assist is a hands-free voice assistant that works with the AI service you choose.

• Your choice of AI: xAI Grok, OpenAI, Google Gemini, or your own OpenClaw or Hermes server, with your own API key. Or use the free on-device Apple Intelligence model on supported iPhones. Assist has no account of its own.
• Hands-free with glasses: use your Bluetooth glasses' microphone and speakers to talk to your AI.
• Talk naturally: speak, hear the answer, and ask follow-ups.
• Get things done: timers, reminders, calendar, notes and clipboard by voice.
• Private by design: nothing is sent to an AI service until you approve that service in Settings, and location sharing is off until you turn it on.
• On-device options: local models and voices that run on your iPhone.

Cloud AI services bill your own account for API usage. Glasses are optional: any glasses that pair as a Bluetooth headset work for voice.

name: Assisteio
description:
Assisteio brings your assistant, your people and your day together.

YOUR ASSISTANT
Chat with your assistant by text or voice. She knows your calendar and tasks, finds a time that works for everyone, books meetings and sends you a short briefing every morning, at the time you choose.

CALLS AND VIDEO CALLS
Call the people you chat with, by voice or video. Incoming calls ring on your lock screen like a normal phone call.

MEETINGS
Plan group meetings with video and screen sharing, invite guests with a link, and let the assistants take notes. Afterwards everyone gets a summary and their own to-dos.

TASKS
Keep your tasks in one place, with a clear count of what is still open.

CONNECTED
Connect your calendar, email and the apps you use, so your assistant can help you there too, always asking before she changes anything.

Assisteio is invite only for now: ask someone who uses it for an invite link.

name: Astrompala
description:
The aliens fly wherever they like. So do you.

Pilot a small spaceship and keep a plasma ball in the air. Every alien you hit loses an eye, and when all its eyes are closed it leaves the sky. Clear the sky to reach the next level.

100 LEVELS
Every level has its own strangely coloured sky, from auroras and black holes to galaxies, comets and neon grids, and its own house music. The challenge grows level by level up to the final battle.

19 MONSTERS
Round, square, triangular, hexagonal. Some dive at your ship, some turn invisible, some teleport, some split in two or explode and take their neighbours with them. And every few levels comes Grom, the crowned boss who takes five hits.

GIFTS
Many monsters drop gifts when you hit them:
• Freeze: the aliens stop moving and break twice as fast
• Time stop: everything stands still and points count double
• Bomb: a blast wave hits every enemy
• Fireball: every hit blows up everyone nearby
• Triple ball, wide ship, shield, gems and extra lives

CONTROLS
Drag anywhere on the screen and your ship moves freely. Tap to launch the ball.

SCORE
Combos multiply your points, every 25,000 points earns a life, and the score table keeps your 10 best games. If you lose, carry on from the same level.

Play in English or Greek. No ads, no in-app purchases, no internet needed.

name: ATL Fluid Art
description:
ATL Fluid Art is the app for ATL Fluid Art, a hands-on art studio at Town Brookhaven in Atlanta, Georgia. Find an experience, pick a date and time, and book your visit, then come in and make something colorful.

Book an experience
• Fluid art paint pouring, resin, glass painting, mosaic, decoden, Splat Zone, patch art and the Dessert Slime Bar
• Browse by art type, or start from a date and see what's open
• Choose a time, tell us who's coming, and pay securely with Stripe

Events and parties
• See upcoming studio events and buy tickets
• Plan a kids' birthday party, date night, girls' night out, bachelorette, team building or private group event

Gift cards and promotions
• Buy a gift card to spend at the studio, and send it with a message
• See the studio's current promotions

Plan your visit
• Studio hours, closures and directions
• A gallery of pieces made in the studio, reviews, FAQs and the studio blog
• Send the studio a message from the app

You don't need an account to browse or book. If you have an atlfluidart.com account, you can sign in with your email and password, and you can delete your account from the app at any time.

The app has no ads and no tracking.

ATL Fluid Art is published by RuleCMS, LLC for ATL Fluid Art.

name: Aualiftney
description:
Turns speed into an act of weaving. Guide a luminous courier through twenty four handcrafted routes, threading moving windows while switching between amber and cyan phases. Every delivery introduces a distinct atmosphere, fresh geometry, and a sharper challenge.

Drag to steer, hold Focus to slow your approach, and unleash Surge when the route opens. Balance engine heat, gather silver seeds, and spend charge on a protective shield. Crosswinds, drifting windows, and restless thorns make every decision count.

Earn three stars, build clean chains, improve records, and unlock the next destination. A clear flight manual introduces every control, while adjustable sound, haptic feedback, and calmer backgrounds help you find your rhythm.

Play entirely offline without accounts, advertising, or tracking. Open the dedicated feedback studio, add an optional camera photo or library image, and share your thoughts through a simple feedback form. Your next perfect thread is waiting just beyond the horizon.

name: AURIX: треки и релизы
description:
AURIX — музыкальная студия с ИИ в твоём телефоне: от идеи до релиза на площадках.

СОЗДАВАЙ ТРЕКИ
• Опиши настроение или напиши текст — ИИ соберёт песню с вокалом, аранжировкой и сведением.
• Каждая генерация даёт две версии на выбор.
• Перерисуй свою демку в нужном жанре, продли трек, добавь вокал или инструменты.
• Исправь отдельную строку, не пересоздавая песню целиком.

СВОЙ ГОЛОС
• Голос-двойник: запиши образец — и пой треки похожим голосом.
• Студия: запиши живой вокал поверх трека прямо в приложении, выровняй и сведи.

ОБЛОЖКИ И ВИДЕО
• Обложки для релиза за минуту.
• Оживление обложки, клипы и вертикальные ролики под трек.

ВЫПУСК НА ПЛОЩАДКИ
• Отправь трек на Яндекс Музыку, VK Музыку, Звук, Spotify, Apple Music и ещё 200+ площадок.
• Смартлинк — одна ссылка на все площадки.
• Статистика и 100% роялти — AURIX не берёт процент с прослушиваний.

СЦЕНА
• Лента артистов: делись треками и демо, собирай реакции и комментарии, находи коллаборации.

AI-ПРОДЮСЕР
• Разбор трека: структура, сведение, сильные и слабые места.
• Чат с продюсером, который знает твои треки.

Музыка, которую ты создаёшь, — твоя.

name: Avati
description:
Avati je místo v srdci Prahy, kde se setkávají lidé, nápady a zajímavé akce. S touto aplikací máte Avati pořád po ruce.

Co v aplikaci najdete:

• Program – přehled všech nadcházejících akcí v Avati, seřazený po dnech. Stačí si vybrat a zapsat se.
• Dostupnost sálů – na první pohled uvidíte, kdy je který prostor volný, a můžete si ho hned rezervovat.
• Rezervace prostoru – vyberte sál, termín a čas, doplňte potřebné údaje a rezervaci odešlete. Stejné ceny a pravidla jako na webu avati.cz.
• Moje rezervace a vstupenky – vše, co jste si objednali, na jednom místě, včetně QR kódu pro vstup.
• Pro organizátory – přidání a úprava vlastních akcí, seznam přihlášených účastníků a podklady k vyúčtování.
• Profil a přihlášení – přihlaste se stejným účtem jako na webu, případně přes Apple nebo Google. Účet si můžete kdykoli smazat přímo v aplikaci.

Aplikace propojuje stejný systém jako web avati.cz, takže se vám rezervace a akce zobrazují všude stejně.

Máte nápad, co by v aplikaci chybělo? Napište nám na avati.cz.

name: Aviko Agro
description:
Aviko Agro is de app van Aviko Agro voor het werk in het veld. Registreer monsters door de barcode te scannen of in te typen, kies het ras, de teler en het perceel, en maak een foto. Ook zonder verbinding: wat je verstuurt, gaat vanzelf mee zodra je weer online bent. Je ziet wat je verstuurde en de laatste monsters in het systeem.

Beheerders zien in één overzicht hoe het werk van vandaag gaat, en nodigen hun collega's uit.

Je logt in met een passkey, zonder wachtwoord. Je kunt je account in de app verwijderen.

name: Avuno Score
description:
Keep game night scores in one place. Avuno Score helps one person track points for up to eight players on a single iPhone.

• Add or subtract points for each player.
• Choose a score step and undo the last score change.
• See the high score while player positions stay in place.
• End a night, review its results, and start again with the same players.

No account or internet connection is needed for scoring. Scores and player names are stored on this device. Uninstalling the app or losing or changing your device may result in lost history.

Avuno Score shows the highest score as the leader and winner. It does not apply game-specific rules or identify winners for games where the lowest score wins.

name: AwardSeason: Film & TV Awards
description:
AwardSeason follows the whole awards calendar for film and television: the Oscars, Golden Globes, BAFTA, Emmys, Gothams, Independent Spirit Awards, Critics Choice, the Actor Awards and more. Pick a show and a season, and every nominee is in one place.

See what you have seen. Each season has its own checklist, so you always know how many nominees you have watched and what is left. Check off a film or a TV season in one tap.

Plan what to watch next. Add titles to your queue and see where each one is streaming in your country, filtered to the services you have.

Bring your history with you. Import your watched films from Letterboxd and your TV from Serializd, and AwardSeason checks off every nominee you have already seen. Your Watched library keeps it all in one place.

Call the winners with friends. Start a prediction pool for any ceremony, share the invite link, and watch the standings move as winners are announced. If your group plays for a buy-in, the pool can track who has paid. No money moves through AwardSeason, and any settling up happens outside the app.

Play every day. Pathward is a daily puzzle that connects a nominee to a film through awards history. Quick Take is a daily quiz on nominees and winners, past and present.

See your numbers. Stats show how much of each season you have covered, your quiz and puzzle streaks, and how your viewing breaks down.

FEATURES
- Seen checklists for every season of every show we cover, film and TV
- A watch queue with streaming availability for your region and services
- A Watched library of everything you have checked off
- Letterboxd and Serializd import
- Prediction pools with friends, with live standings on ceremony night
- Pathward and Quick Take, new every day
- Stats for your checklists, quizzes and puzzles
- Pages for every film, show and person, with their nominations and wins
- Sign in with Apple, Google or email

AwardSeason is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any awards organization. Pools are for fun among friends: the app does not process payments or award prizes.

Questions or ideas? Use Contact in the app, or visit awardseason.fun.

name: Axessed
description: Axessed is your calm life OS. Bring together your notes, documents, voice memos, and reminders in one connected, private view. Organize your everyday life effortlessly with smart reminders, precision sync, and the Life Graph.

name: Backtext - Text Behind Image
description:
Put words behind anything.

Backtext lifts the subject out of your photo, right on your iPhone, so your text can slip behind people, pets, mountains and skylines. It's the layered, magazine-cover look you see everywhere, made in seconds.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick any photo from your library
• Backtext finds the subject automatically
• Type your words and drag them into place: they sit behind the subject
• Flip any text in front with one tap

MAKE IT YOURS
• 20+ fonts, from clean sans to elegant serif, in every weight
• Solid colors or 12 gradient presets
• Outlines, glows, shadows and highlight boxes
• Letter spacing, line height, alignment and opacity
• Pinch to resize, twist to rotate, with snapping guides to keep things centred
• Add as many text layers as you like, plus background blur
• Unlimited undo and redo

SAVE AND SHARE
• Save high-resolution images straight to Photos
• Share to Instagram, TikTok, Messages or anywhere else
• No watermark, ever

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything happens on your iPhone. Your photos are never uploaded
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no subscription

Not sure where to start? Tap one of the built-in examples to see how it's done, then try it on your own photos.

name: BaliOixDane
description:
Match words from around the world by tying coloured threads between them.

AT A GLANCE
• Tap a word on the left, then its match on the right
• A correct match ties a coloured thread
• A wrong match snaps the thread and costs 3 seconds
• Each board has 5 matches and a 40-second timer
• 5 boards make one tapestry

SIX PATTERNS TO MASTER
• Capitals: Kenya → Nairobi
• Currencies: Thailand → Baht
• Dishes: Paella → Spain
• Instruments: Sitar → India
• Landmarks: Petra → Jordan
• Languages: Ethiopia → Amharic

Play a mixed tapestry with all six, or choose one pattern and practise it until you know it well.

WHEN YOU FINISH
You see your tapestry woven in colour, with one stripe for every thread you tied. Your best score for each pattern is saved.

NIGHT MARKET
Choose a weaver tag (a nickname), and your best tapestry goes on the Night Market leaderboard. You can skip the tag, change it, or delete your data at any time.

• Over 110 matching pairs
• Easy to learn, quick to play
• Works offline. Only the leaderboard needs internet

name: BarakaTOP
description:
BarakaTOP — платформа для поиска работы и сотрудников в Узбекистане.

Ищете работу? Просматривайте свежие вакансии по категориям — IT, торговля, строительство, кулинария, образование, транспорт, медицина и другие. Фильтруйте по региону и зарплате, сохраняйте понравившиеся объявления и откликайтесь в один тап.

Ищете сотрудника? Разместите вакансию или найдите специалиста по его резюме и профилю.

Возможности:
• Лента вакансий и резюме с поиском и фильтрами
• Объявления по всем регионам Узбекистана
• Встроенный чат с работодателями и соискателями

name: Barroso Limo Operations
description:
Barroso Limo Operations is the driver workspace for participating limousine and transportation companies.

Use your company-issued account to review assigned trips and offers, search your trip history, follow trip stages, and read or reply to company messages. Manage your profile and vehicle photos, choose an authorized car, and control your on-duty status.

description:
Köprüüstü dümende, sen makinede. Gemi seninle yürür.

name: Bcloud: NAS Photo Backup
description:
Bcloud copies the photos and videos on your iPhone to your own NAS over your home network. No account, no subscription and no company server: your media goes only where you send it.

SORTED INTO FOLDERS
• Folders by day, week, month, quarter or year, or by named events with their own dates
• Limit folder sizes by gigabytes or number of files, keep photos and videos apart, and skip very large videos, so a slow NAS never gets one huge folder
• One folder per device, such as "iPhone 12 mini", named however you like

CHOOSE WHAT TO COPY
• Everything, a date range, one month, one year, or the items you pick by hand

SEARCHABLE GALLERY
• Objects and text in your pictures are recognized on your iPhone while they upload

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

name: Be Ready: Pantry & Essentials
description:
A little prepared. A lot less waste.

Be Ready brings your pantry, shopping list and household essentials together in one private account.

YOUR PANTRY AT A GLANCE
Keep track of food and quantities, record best-before and use-by dates, and save packaging and date-label photos. Search your supplies to find what you already have.

USE WHAT YOU HAVE
See which items need attention and plan what to use next. Check the original packaging and follow its storage and safety instructions.

A PRACTICAL SHOPPING LIST
Keep missing food and household supplies together. Add purchases to your pantry or Essentials when you bring them home.

MORE THAN FOOD

YOUR OWN PRIVATE ACCOUNT

OPTIONAL PHOTO READING

name: Bead&Balance
description:
Step into a quiet workshop where small adjustments make a difference. Bead and Balance is a hands-on bead crafting and assembly puzzle experience. Shape a design, test how it moves, and find a satisfying balance between smooth movement, a steady fit, and the right amount of rattle.

Explore 24 built-in blueprints across three themes. Bead Craft introduces bead size, bore size, and surface finish. Rail Assembly explores bead count, rail span, and frame tension. Balance Build brings these ideas together in challenges that ask you to consider several readings at once.

Tune each design with clear controls and a live visual preview. Choose a Bamboo, Maple, or Walnut appearance, then tap Test Run to watch the beads move along the rail. Read the results for Glide, Stability, and Rattle, with target zones and practical hints to guide your next adjustment. Higher readings are not always better. Each blueprint has its own balance to find.

Complete two blueprints in a theme to unlock the next one. Meet the target zones to complete a blueprint, then refine your work until every required reading reaches its ideal zone to earn Balanced status. Return to earlier blueprints whenever you want to try another approach.

Prefer to experiment without a target? Free Build is available from the start, with all six controls open. Try different combinations, run a test, and explore how each change affects the result.

Compare your two most recent tests side by side. See which parameters changed, review the readings, and restore the previous setup when you want to try again.

Save tested builds to your Journal with a name and an optional note. Mark favorites, rename your creations, update notes, or duplicate a saved build back to the Workbench for a fresh experiment. Local drafts let you return to unfinished work.

Everything works offline. No account is required, and the app includes no ads or analytics. Builds, drafts, progress, and preferences are saved locally. Sound, haptics, and Reduce Motion can be adjusted in Settings.

The workshop uses a consistent rule-based model for creative play. It is not a physical or engineering simulation.

name: Bedroom Arcade
description:
Four games. One arcade. A rivalry waiting to happen.

Aim for the perfect shot. Own the streets. Chase the championship. Outsmart a maze full of trouble. Then take on a friend ONLINE in Party Blast.

Bedroom Arcade brings pixel art, chiptune music and big boss battles to iPhone and iPad. An arcade made in a bedroom, ready to go wherever you play.

PARTY BLAST - TAKE IT ONLINE

One friend. Seven rapid-fire micro-games. Head-to-head online battles where every round counts. Invite a friend through Game Center, put your reflexes to the test and fight for the win.

Party Blast requires an internet connection and Game Center sign-in for both players.

FOUR GAMES. FOUR WAYS TO PLAY.

WIDE SHOT
Line up your shot and take out targets across five worlds. Face Kite, Switchman, Gull and Encore on the road to your showdown with Vesper.

STREET RACING
Weave through traffic, shake the police and race your way past Slick Vic, Crane, Sidewinder and Switchback. The King of the Streets is waiting. Take the crown.

SIMPLE FOOTBALL
Run the Road to the Ring. Score touchdowns and work your way through the Dirt Devils, Ironwood Bulldogs, Skyhawks and Metro Titans. Can you beat The Dynasty?

MR. SMILEY
Find your way through mazes, earn stars and face each world's boss: Grumble Gnome, Sulky Yeti, Mopebot, The Gloom and the Frown King.

HOURS OF ARCADE FUN

Each campaign offers about an hour of play. Going for 100% across all four games takes around 3-5 hours in total, depending on how you play. Party Blast online adds hours of head-to-head fun with friends.

MAKE EVERY RUN COUNT

- Keep your adventures in 20 save files.
- Discover treasure and unlock Memory Cards and Storyboards.
- Earn Game Center achievements and climb the leaderboards.
- Carry your saves between iPhone and iPad with iCloud.
- Play in landscape with haptic feedback on supported devices.

iCloud save syncing requires the same iCloud account on your devices.

SMALL BEGINNINGS. BIG ARCADE ENERGY.

The originals were created using Game Maker between 2009 and 2013, then remade in 2026. Bedroom Arcade brings Manny's bedroom-made games together for a fresh round of shots, races, touchdowns and boss battles.

No ads. No in-app purchases. No tracking.

Pick your game. Bring a friend. Make it a rivalry.

Dedicated to Leslie, Steven, Jesus, Anthony, and everyone who helped test and contribute, for helping me make these games when we were kids and for being part of this remake.

In loving memory of Leydi Diana Farías.

name: Blankbound
description:
Blankbound is a picture-book puzzle. You guide Pip, a little folded-paper character, across pages that change shape. Every page has a fixed amount of blank space. It never appears from nowhere, and it never disappears. Take it from one place and put it where it is needed: close a gap, widen a door, or unfold a drawer so the props will fit.

How to play

1. Read the page. A bridge marked with blank units has a gap, and Pip cannot cross until that gap is gone. A doorway shows its width. Pip is 2 units wide, so a door must be at least 2 units wide. Some pages offer two routes. Either complete route is enough.

2. Tap a marked region, choose how many units, then tap Take to pocket the blank. Tap another region and tap Put to place it.
· Into a bridge: the gap shrinks. At 0, the bridge is joined.
· Into a door: the opening gets wider.
· Out of a door that is already wide enough: the door narrows. Pip can still pass if 2 units remain.
· Into a drawer's columns or rows: the drawer unfolds. A longer ruler or a taller pencil can then fit inside.

3. The pocket has a limit. If it is full, place what you are holding before you take more. Early pages move a whole strip at once. Later pages let you split a strip and keep the spare units in your pocket.

4. Tap Preview before you commit. The page shows how the bridge, door, or drawer will change. Tap Apply to keep it. Undo and Redo are always available.

5. When a route is connected, tap Walk. Pip follows it to the next bookmark or to the end of the page. Rehearse plays the walk first. Hint starts with what is still blocking the path, then offers a more specific fold.

Blank has a direction. Horizontal blank closes bridges, widens doors, and adds drawer columns. Vertical blank adds drawer rows. In the final chapter you can turn pocketed blank: H→V makes it vertical, and V→H turns it back. The number of units stays the same.

The drawer is a packing puzzle. Spend blank to unfold it, then place the ruler, pencil, gift box, boot, key, or banner on a starting cell. Each prop occupies its own shape. Pieces cannot overlap or stick out of the drawer. Some bookmarks ask you to arrive with the props still packed. After that, you can lift a prop, fold its space back up, and spend that blank on the next door.

A bookmark is a safe stop. Once Pip reaches it, blank left behind can be taken out and used again. A door you widened to get this far is often the material for the doors ahead.

Forty pages, four chapters

· Paper Paths: learn gaps and doors, and move blank from a bridge into an opening.
· Room to Spare: a smaller pocket means more trips, and horizontal blank will not fit a vertical job.
· Drawer Theater: unfold the drawer, pack the props, and still leave a route Pip can walk.
· The Living Spread: turn blank, cross several bookmarks, and pass used space forward to the ending.

Each chapter has 8 pages: 32 story pages in all, plus 8 Extra Pages. Some shrink the pocket to one unit, some allow blank from only a marked source, and three stars ask for a very tight fold count.

Every page has a fold target. Finish within it for three doodle stars. Up to three extra folds earns two stars, and any longer clear earns one. You can replay a page and tidy it. Any legal route counts.

Play at your own pace

There is no timer. Pause whenever you like. An unfinished arrangement stays on this device. All 40 pages work offline, with no account, no purchases, and no ads. Music, sound effects, haptics, and motion can each be turned down.

• Trên iOS 18 trở lên, giọng chạy trên Neural Engine nên máy mát và đỡ tốn pin.
• Đọc đúng chữ viết tắt, số La Mã, ngày tháng. Ngắt nghỉ theo dấu câu, đoạn văn và tiêu đề.
• Từ nào đọc chưa đúng, bạn sửa cách đọc một lần là xong.
• Sách tiếng Anh dùng giọng Apple có sẵn trong máy.
• Chỉnh tốc độ tới 3×.

NGHE KHI ĐANG LÀM VIỆC KHÁC
• Khoá màn hình hay mở app khác thì app vẫn đọc. Điều khiển bằng tai nghe, màn hình khoá, AirPlay.
• Tự nhớ chỗ đang nghe. Nghe tiếp sau một lúc dừng, app đọc lại từ đầu câu cho khỏi hụt ý.
• Live Activity và Dynamic Island, widget màn hình chính, nút trong Trung tâm điều khiển (iOS 18 trở lên), nút Tác vụ.
• Siri và Phím tắt: nghe tiếp, nghe một cuốn theo tên, hẹn giờ, tạm dừng.
• Apple Watch: phát và dừng, tua, đổi tốc độ, chọn chương, hẹn giờ ngủ.

NGHE TRƯỚC KHI NGỦ
• Hẹn giờ 5 đến 60 phút hoặc đến hết chương. Giọng nhỏ dần rồi tắt.
• Lắc máy để nghe thêm 10 phút, không cần mở mắt.
• Lần sau mở app, Trang chủ hỏi bạn có muốn nghe lại từ lúc bắt đầu ngủ.
• 11 âm nền như mưa, sóng biển, lửa trại, tiếng ồn nâu, cùng radio trực tuyến và nhạc của bạn.

MUỐN VỪA NGHE VỪA XEM CHỮ
• Câu đang đọc được tô sáng. Chạm vào câu nào là nghe từ câu đó.
• Đánh dấu, ghi chú, tìm trong mọi cuốn sách (gõ không dấu cũng ra).
• Giao diện sáng, sepia, tối, đen OLED. Phông chữ đủ dấu tiếng Việt.

THÓI QUEN NGHE
• Số phút nghe hôm nay, chuỗi ngày nghe liên tiếp, biểu đồ 7 ngày.
• Nghe xong một cuốn, app chúc mừng và gợi ý cuốn tiếp theo trong thư viện của bạn.

CỦA BẠN, TRÊN MÁY BẠN
Sách, vị trí nghe, đánh dấu và thống kê chỉ lưu trên máy. Không tài khoản, không quảng cáo, không theo dõi. Mạng chỉ dùng khi bạn mở radio hoặc tải một trang web.

Book Reader không bán hay cung cấp sách: bạn nghe file và bài viết của chính bạn. App không mở được sách có DRM, ví dụ phần lớn sách mua trên Amazon. Chạy trên iPhone, iPad và Mac dùng chip Apple.

name: BooklyNest
description:
Her kitapsever kendi köşesini hak eder.

BooklyNest'te okuduğun her kitap, kendi 3D okuma odandaki rafa dizilir. Kitabını raftan çek, kapağına bak, alıntılarını sakla, okuma süreni tut. Okudukça jeton kazan, odanı istediğin gibi süsle.

KENDİ KİTAPLIĞIN
• Kitabının adını yaz, kapağı ve bilgileri gelsin
• Okuduğun, okumakta olduğun, okuyacağın kitaplar ayrı raflarda
• Raftaki kitabı eline al, kapağına yakından bak

OKUMA ALIŞKANLIĞI
• Sayaçla okuma oturumu başlat
• Günlük hedefini belirle
• Her gün değişen ayraç görevlerini tamamla

OKUMA AJANDAN
• Sayfaları gerçekten çevrilen okuma ajandası
• Okuduğun her gün renkli bir kare olur
• Aylık grafik, favori kitaplar, okuma listesi

ALINTI DEFTERİ
• Sayfanın fotoğrafını çek, yazı kendiliğinden okunsun
• En sevdiğin cümleler defterinde ve widget'ta

ODANI SÜSLE
• Kitaplıklar, koltuklar, halılar, pencereler, lambalar, fincanlar
• Eşyaları istediğin yere taşı
• Masa lambanı yak, oda loşlaşsın

Verilerin kendi iCloud hesabında yedeklenir. Reklam yok.

name: BoyfriendCam: Photo Coach
description:
She sent you the inspo pic. BoyfriendCam helps you actually nail it.

BoyfriendCam is a camera that coaches you while you shoot. It spots her in the frame, shows you where she should stand, and tells you how to hold the phone, so every photo looks like you know what you're doing.

LIVE FRAMING COACH • Rule-of-thirds grid that lights up the line she's closest to • Live tips: "Step closer", "Step back", "Nudge the phone left" • Turns green with a little buzz when the framing is right • Level indicator so the horizon is never crooked

MATCH ANY INSPO PIC • Pick a photo from your library and see it as a ghost overlay • Pose dots show where her head, body, hands, knees and feet go • A "Stand here" spot shows where her feet should land • Pose tips for her, and camera tips for you: phone height, tilt and framing

A REAL CAMERA • Photo and video, front and back camera • Tap to focus, pinch to zoom, flash and torch • Everything saves straight to your Photos library

PRIVATE BY DESIGN All the pose and framing analysis runs on your iPhone with Apple's on-device Vision framework. No accounts, no uploads, no tracking. Your photos never leave your phone.

Go take her best photo yet.

name: Breath Work: Daily Practice
description:
Make room for a comfortable breathing practice. Choose Unwind with 4–7–8 timing, Focus with four equal phases, or Balance with no breath holds. Adjust the number of cycles, follow the visual guide, and choose optional chimes and ambient sounds.

Set optional local reminders and explore your completed sessions, practice-day goals and streaks. Optional calm check-ins are self-reported reflections, not medical measurements. Your practice history stays on your device. No account, ads or subscriptions.

For general wellness, not diagnosis or treatment. Breathe comfortably and stop if you feel dizzy. Consult a healthcare professional before using breathing exercises for a medical condition.

name: Breathmoor: Anchor Yourself
description:
A quiet place to come back to your breath.
Breathe whenever you can, as long as you like. No streaks. No accounts. Just your breath.
Add the widget to your Home Screen or Lock Screen to keep a calm reminder close.
Progress stays on your device. Nothing is tracked.

name: BrewMaster
description: BrewMaster is a tool for managing craft beer recipes and batches. Every step—from calculating ingredient quantities and recording the mash and boil processes to tracking fermentation temperature, specific gravity, and pH—can be linked to a single batch. Once bottling is complete, you can also manage your inventory, analyze costs and yields, and export batch reports that include photos.

name: Browzo Player
description:
Browzo Player is a simple media player and browser for links you are authorised to access.

Paste an HLS, MPEG-DASH or direct media URL to start playback. The built-in browser can detect supported media, block known ads and trackers, switch website mode when compatibility is needed, and download supported streams for offline viewing.

Features:
• HLS, MPEG-DASH and direct media playback
• Automatic playback fallback
• Picture in Picture support
• Built-in browser with tracker blocking
• Android website mode for compatible sites
• Media detection and download progress
• Link and browsing history with swipe to delete
• Light and dark themes

Browzo Player does not include or provide media. Only play or download content you own or are authorised to access.

name: Bubblery
description:
Give every jar a story worth keeping.

Bubblery brings your home fermentation timers, recipes, and observations into one personal notebook. Follow a sourdough feeding, a jar of yogurt, or a batch of vegetables, then carry what you learn into your next attempt.

A TIMER FOR EVERY JAR
Run several batches together with independent countdown or elapsed timers. Pause, resume, and set local target-time or follow-up reminders. Enter ambient temperatures to view an adjusted time estimate. Planned check-ins follow active timer time, excluding pauses.

TWO JARS, ONE PLANNED CHANGE
Create a paired trial from a recipe version or an existing batch. Choose a difference in ambient temperature, one ingredient amount, or a process step. Record each jar at shared check-ins, compare saved pH and temperature readings, and keep their actual observation times in view. Add your conclusion and next step, or export the trial as CSV.

OBSERVATIONS THAT TELL THE STORY
Manually log temperature and pH, stirring, additions, appearance, unusual observations, and photographs. Review a batch timeline, browse progress photos, and chart your recorded pH. Reuse observation templates and add custom fields for the details you care about.

YOUR CULTURES AND RECIPE BOX
Keep culture sources, lots, activation and expiry dates, notes, and photos together. Record pantry ingredients and plan your own culture-care schedule. Save recipe versions, scale recognized ingredient quantities, calculate sourdough feeding weights, and start a batch from a saved version.

KEEP WHAT YOU LEARN
Review taste, acidity, personal scores, and ideas for next time. Save a lesson and try it in a new batch. Search by name, tag, or jar code, archive older batches, and explore statistics drawn from your own records.

YOUR NOTEBOOK, WITH YOU
Records stay on your device. Export a full backup with photos and manually choose Files or iCloud Drive as the destination. Inspect a backup, set a backup reminder, or export records as CSV. Recently Deleted helps you recover removed batches.

Temperature-adjusted times are approximate planning references. pH readings are entered manually. Food-safety and outcome judgments remain your responsibility; the app provides no safety assessment or outcome guarantee.

The app interface is in English. Requires iOS 15.0 or later.

name: Burbulución
description:
Todo empieza con una burbuja.

Sumérgete en Burbulución, una aventura de pixel art en la que pequeñas semillas se convierten en plantas y criaturas marinas. Explota burbujas, combina parejas y descubre hasta dónde puede llegar la vida de tu océano.

FUSIONA Y EVOLUCIONA
De las medusas a los delfines y las ballenas: cada descubrimiento abre una nueva posibilidad. Juega con toques o arrastra las criaturas para unirlas.

DESCUBRE OTROS MUNDOS
El océano es solo el principio. Encuentra sirenas, explora escenarios de fantasía y afronta los desafíos que te esperan más allá del agua.

UN MONTÓN DE SECRETOS POR DESCUBRIR
Explora a tu ritmo y déjate sorprender. Burbulución guarda muchas sorpresas que descubrirás jugando: la curiosidad también forma parte de la aventura.

CREA TU COLECCIÓN
Transforma la reserva de burbujas en materiales y diamantes del juego. Apadrina las especies descubiertas y reúne tu colección en el museo.

CUIDA A TUS COMPAÑEROS
Alimenta, juega y acompaña a tus criaturas. Haz crecer vuestro vínculo y descubre nuevos colores para tu compañero.

A TU RITMO
Tu partida se guarda automáticamente. Ajusta la música y los efectos por separado y utiliza la opción de reducir las animaciones.

Un universo de criaturas, música y sorpresas creado por Pentonúi Games.

Optimizado para iPhone Duo: la interfaz se adapta a sus pantallas exterior e interior para que puedas seguir jugando al abrirlo o cerrarlo.

name: Calendelle: Calendar
description:
Your everyday schedule, with the important things easy to find.

Browse your months, see the year ahead, or check what’s coming next. Highlight holidays, trips and milestones to bring them into your year plan. Tap an event for the details, and keep your plans close with Home Screen widgets.

Calendelle works with the calendars already on your phone. No extra account needed.

name: Caliber: Meeting Cost & ROI
description:
Meetings are the single largest unmonitored expenditure in modern professional teams. Caliber turns corporate time into an observable, accountable metric.

Whether you lead engineering sprints, cross-functional strategic reviews, or executive board meetings, Caliber equips you with an analog-grade precision meter to monitor financial burn, measure agenda entropy, and preserve organizational focus.

Core Capabilities:

Live Burn Rate Odometer: Real-time CoreAnimation speedometer calculating participant hourly burn down to the second ($/minute and $/hour).

Agenda Entropy Dial: Circular indicator measuring discussion discipline, flagging agenda drift, and warning against tangential digressions.

Pre-Flight Gate ("Could This Be An Email?"): Interactive 7-point decision matrix calculating the statistical justification index before sending an invitation.

Opportunity Cost Simulator: Instant calculation of projected capital expenditure across attendee tiers and planned timeboxes.

Executive ROI Analytics: Comprehensive 7-day burn velocity bar charts, meeting category expenditure breakdowns, and decision density metrics.

Master Decision Ledger: Searchable historical log of consensus decisions, action commitments, assignees, and post-session ROI grades.

Complete Local Privacy: Sandboxed on-device architecture. Zero cloud servers, zero audio recording, and zero account logins required.

name: CandidateFilings
description:
Search U.S. candidate filing records and keep up with the races you follow.

Search opens with the latest filings. Enter a candidate name or filter by state, office, election year and party. Open candidate and race details, check the filing source, and share a record.

Create a free account to follow races and read new filings from those races in one place. Your followed races sync with CandidateFilings on the web.

Existing CandidateFilings subscribers can manage their filing alerts and enable push notifications on each device. Legacy alert plans are supported. Following and public search do not require a paid plan.
