CandidateFilings is an independent service and is not affiliated with or endorsed by a government agency. Records come from public filing sources listed at https://www.candidatefilings.com/sources. Coverage varies by state and office. Filing records do not establish current ballot status.

Support: https://www.candidatefilings.com/contact
Privacy: https://www.candidatefilings.com/privacy#mobile-app

name: Cannon Hop: Sliding Puzzle
description:
Aim. Fire. Slide back.

In Cannon Hop, every shot produces recoil. Hit the first target in your path, then slide backward as far as the available space allows. A blocker, another target, or the edge can stop you. An empty shot can put you in exactly the right place.

Clear every target with limited ammo. See the bullet path and recoil landing before you commit, then try a different idea whenever you like.

• 48 puzzles, including the original six stages
• Arrow buttons in order ↑ ↓ ← →, with a separate Fire button below
• Unlimited undo and hints for the next direction
• Game sound effects with an in-game switch
• English and Simplified Chinese, with an in-game language switch
• Offline play with saved completion progress and replayable stages

No account, ads, or in-app purchases. Progress and settings are saved on this device.

name: CapSept
description:
CapSept prepares you for one thing: NCLC 7 or higher in all four skills on TEF Canada or TCF Canada, the French tests accepted for Canadian permanent residence. It is not a general French course. Everything in the app is built around your test, your exam date and the score you need.

Starting from zero? Apprendre begins with how French sounds, then teaches the words exam texts use most, a few at a time, and keeps you right at the edge of what you know.

Then scroll. Le Fil is a vertical feed where every card is an exam-format question: a listening clip played once, as on the real test, a reading document with its question, a vocabulary cloze, or a phrase to recall for the writing and speaking tasks. After each answer you see the correct choice, a one-line explanation and the transcript. Questions you miss come back until you get them right. Le Radar predicts your NCLC level in each skill on exam day and shows how far each one is from the line, and the feed spends your time on the skill that needs it most.

Les Gabarits reproduces each official writing and speaking task with its timer and word count. Record a spoken answer or write a text, and CapSept transcribes and scores it on your iPhone, then shows the corrections and phrases that would raise your level. Le Plan schedules your reviews and full mock exams so that what you learn is strongest on the day of the test.

On Apple Watch, CapSept taps once an hour during the day with a French word that is due for review. Recall the meaning, tap Check, then tell it whether you knew it. It takes about four seconds, right in the notification, and your answer updates your review schedule on iPhone. Turn it off in Settings at any time.

Your data stays yours. Answers, writing and recordings stay on your iPhone and in your private iCloud account. Feedback is produced on device. There are no accounts, ads, trackers or analytics.

KEY FEATURES:
• A beginner path from the sounds of French to the most useful words
• Exam-format listening and reading questions for TEF Canada and TCF Canada
• Predicted NCLC level per skill on your exam date
• Every official writing and speaking task, timed, with on-device feedback
• Speaking fluency measures: speech rate, pauses and filler words
• Reviews scheduled to your exam date, plus full timed mock exams
• Hourly word reviews on Apple Watch, answered in about four seconds
• Family Mode: shared streaks and one weekly goal for a household preparing together
• Home Screen widgets with your exam countdown and four-skill levels
• VoiceOver, Voice Control, Larger Text, Dark Mode and Reduced Motion support
• English or French interface

CapSept is free, with no ads and no in-app purchases. Writing and speaking scoring uses Apple Intelligence on supported iPhones; on other iPhones you compare your answer with model answers and rate it against the official criteria.

CapSept is an independent study aid and is not affiliated with or endorsed by IRCC, CCI Paris Île-de-France or France Éducation international. TEF Canada and TCF Canada are trademarks of their respective owners.

name: Card Sweep: Photo Culling
description:
Card Sweep is a photo culling app for iPad: cull a whole SD card at full size, fast, and send only the keepers to Photos.

Plug in your SD card reader and open the card. Card Sweep reads the previews straight off the card, so nothing is copied until you keep it. Swipe right to keep, swipe left to reject, and the next photo is already waiting. Undo anything with one tap or Command-Z.

Bursts stop being a chore. Frames shot in a quick run stack into one tile. Step through them with the arrow keys and keep the frame that's sharp.

On-device hints spot soft focus and closed eyes. A Likely rejects filter shows just those frames. The hints only point things out. Nothing is rejected or deleted for you.

RAW photo culling that fits how you shoot:
- CR2, CR3, NEF, ARW, RAF, ORF, RW2, DNG, PEF and more, plus JPEG and HEIC
- RAW+JPEG pairs count as one photo
- Zoom to 100%, with an EXIF overlay
- Stars from 1 to 5
- A full hardware keyboard map, and Apple Pencil double-tap to keep
- Filters for undecided, kept and rejected photos

When you are done, save the keepers to Photos, where Lightroom mobile, Darkroom and Photomator can find them. Or copy them to a folder for your desktop editor. Transfers resume if the card is unplugged, and running it again never makes duplicates.

A recap shows how fast you went: seconds per photo, bursts resolved, and the space you didn't import.

No card reader with you? Try the built-in sample card.

Card Sweep never writes to your card. It works offline with no account, and your photos never leave your iPad.

name: Care Note: Caregiver Log
description:
Care Note helps family caregivers stay organized — so you don't have to remember everything alone.

TODAY
• A timed checklist for the daily routine (medicines, meals, walks)
• See today's progress at a glance

LOG
• Quick entries for meals, sleep, mood, toilet and notes
• Each entry shows who wrote it

VISITS
• Doctor visits and care meetings with a days-left countdown

HANDOFF
• Send today's checklist and notes to siblings or a carer with one tap

Everything stays on your device and is shared only when you choose. No ads, no sign-in.

name: Cargo Switch: Crate Puzzle
description:
Make room for every delivery.

Cargo Switch is an offline sliding-block puzzle game. Slide horizontal crates left and right, move vertical crates up and down, and deliver each colored crate through its matching exit.

SHIFT THE GATE
Move the gate between two positions to open a different path. Decide which crate should go first, when to shift the gate, and when to move it back. Each shift costs one move; if its destination is blocked, the gate stays put and no move is used.

20 PUZZLES, 3 CHAPTERS
Start with simple deliveries, then take on shifting gates, shared paths, and deliveries in three colors. All 20 levels are unlocked from the start. Progress and your best unassisted move counts are saved on your device.

LEARN BY DOING
Optional step-by-step tutorials introduce the gate and explain why each move helps. Skip them to explore, or replay them whenever you like.

TAKE YOUR TIME
There is no timer. Drag crates directly, or select one and use the arrow buttons. Undo and retry are always free. Run out of moves? Switch to Practice for unlimited moves and free hints.

COINS AND TOKENS
Start with 300 game coins and earn 30 coins for your first clear of each level outside Practice. Use coins for next-move hints, extra moves, or tokens to keep for later. Tutorial and Practice hints are free. A hint already unlocked for the same board position can be viewed again for free during that attempt.

Coins have no cash value. They cannot be bought with real money, cashed out, or transferred.

No account. No internet connection required. No ads or in-app purchases.
ENGLISH AND SIMPLIFIED CHINESE
Tap “中文 / English” on the main screen, then choose your language in Settings. The change takes effect immediately and is saved for next time. Your progress, coins, and tokens are kept.

Designed for iPhone and iPad.

name: CarGo.GE
description:
CarGo is a car marketplace from Georgia for buyers across the region.

Every listing shows not only the price in Georgia, but the full cost of the car delivered to your city: customs duty, taxes, registration and shipping. Choose your country once and compare cars by the real final price.

FIND A CAR
• Cars, motorcycles, trucks and commercial vehicles
• Smart search: describe what you need in your own words, the filters set themselves
• Advanced filters: make, model, year, price, engine, body, color, features and more
• Photos and video in full screen with zoom
• Listings and messages translated into your language

KNOW THE REAL PRICE
• Delivered price for Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Azerbaijan, Uzbekistan, Armenia and Tajikistan
• Import calculator for any car, also from Kyrgyzstan to Russia
• Save estimates and see when the rules change

SELL YOUR CAR
• Free listing in a few minutes: fill in by VIN, add up to 20 photos and 2 videos
• Your listing reaches buyers in other countries
• Edit, renew, mark as sold or delete it at any time from your profile

TALK SAFELY
• Chat with sellers and buyers inside the app, with push notifications
• Call the seller in one tap
• Offer an exchange for your own car
• Report a listing or a person, block unwanted contacts

Sign in with Telegram, Apple, email or a Georgian phone number.

CarGo does not sell cars and does not take payment for them. Estimates are for guidance and are not an official customs quote.

name: Carry
description:
A Carry é uma camada adicional de atenção para viagens com crianças. Combina sinais de movimento, localização e destinos guardados para reconhecer possíveis viagens, paragens e chegadas, pedindo uma confirmação quando algo fica por concluir.

Funcionalidades:
• Mapa e percurso guardados localmente
• Destinos como casa, escola ou creche
• Deteção conservadora de arranque e paragem
• Aprendizagem local de rotinas após confirmações repetidas
• Alertas quando uma paragem infantil habitual não é observada
• Sem conta, publicidade ou analytics

A localização, o movimento e o áudio opcional são processados no iPhone. Os dados permanecem no dispositivo e podem ser apagados pelo utilizador.

A Carry não confirma a presença ou ausência de uma criança, não é um sistema certificado de deteção de ocupantes e não substitui a supervisão do cuidador.

name: Century Atlas
description:
Century Atlas is a beautiful atlas of everywhere you've been.

Tick off countries on a hand-drawn map, a 3D globe or a list, and work toward all 330 places of the Travelers' Century Club. Each country gets its own passport stamp, modeled on the real one at its border.

FIND YOUR TRAVELS IN YOUR PHOTOS
Century Atlas reads where and when your photos were taken and works out the countries you've visited, the year you first went, and how many days you spent in each. It runs entirely on your iPhone. No photo is uploaded, and photos taken from an airplane window are left out.

YOUR FLIGHTS
Log every flight by hand, from a spreadsheet, or by scanning a boarding pass. See your routes on the map and the globe, your busiest airports, your miles, and a time-lapse of your flying years.

GO DEEPER
• States, provinces and prefectures for the US, Japan, Brazil and more
• UNESCO World Heritage sites and US national parks
• Time abroad: every trip and every day, year by year
• Your year in travel, and "on this day" memories
• Share your atlas with a friend and compare

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your atlas lives on your phone and in your own iCloud.

name: Cercadura
description:
Cercadura is a field guide for the tiled facades that turn ordinary streets in Lisbon, Porto, Ovar, Aveiro and São Luís do Maranhão into open-air museums. It's built for the walker who stops mid-sidewalk to look up — locals who've walked past the same azulejos for years, and visitors from Germany, France and Spain trying to make sense of what they're seeing.

The core loop is simple: photograph a facade, answer a short five-question identification key (pattern or scene, flat or relief surface, stencilled or hand-painted, colours, and border), and file the result into a walk. Each verdict names a real style — hispano-mourisco, seventeenth-century padrão carpet tiles, blue-and-white figurative panels, pombalino, the great nineteenth-century factories (Viúva Lamego, Sacavém, Fábrica das Devesas, Aleluia), Porto relief tiles, arte nova, art déco and more — with a date range and the facts that explain why it looks the way it does.

Cercadura is a field guide and a logbook, not a map. There's no GPS, no routing, and no location tracking of any kind — you already know where you're standing. There's no buying, selling or valuing tiles, because azulejos on a building are not inventory. There's no social feed and no account to sign into; everything you log stays yours, kept on your device. What it does instead is let you build a record over time: log a facade once, revisit it a year later, and see its condition laid out visit by visit. If you spot tiles that are missing, damaged or plainly stolen, Cercadura links straight to SOS Azulejo's real reporting channel, because the right response to a gap in a facade is a report, not a souvenir.

Four tabs carry the app. Key, for identification. Walk, for photographing and filing facades as you go, with a missing-tile counter and fields for street and repeat size. Facades, your growing collection, browsable by city or style, searchable, with a condition-first detail page. Repeat, a small workbench where you draw a single tile and watch it multiply into a 2×2 or 4×4 pattern, with eight historic-inspired presets to start from. A stamp book marks progress as you log new styles and reach milestones.

Everything runs offline. The only network calls are the ones you choose to make, tapping "Read more" to open real pages from the Museu Nacional do Azulejo, SOS Azulejo, or Wikipedia inside an in-app reader.

name: CES DESIGN
description:
CES DESIGN, Sivas merkezli bağımsız bir tasarım ve reklam stüdyosudur. Bu uygulamayla işlerimizi yakından inceleyebilir, projen için doğrudan teklif isteyebilir ve talebinin hangi aşamada olduğunu takip edebilirsin.

KEŞFET
• San Josse Coffee başta olmak üzere gerçek markalar için yaptığımız kampanya, sosyal medya ve dijital çalışmalar
• Tam ekran galeride kaydırarak inceleme

İŞLER
• Marka marka portföy: San Josse Coffee, Pusula Cafe, Sahara Pizza, AVY PARK, Arslan İletişim, Metaş Perde Sistemleri
• Kamera arkası: mekân filmleri, reels ve drone çekimleri dikey, tam ekran video olarak

HİZMETLER
• Marka & Tasarım: logo, kurumsal kimlik, ambalaj, menü
• Sosyal Medya: içerik planı, tasarım, reels, dijital kampanya
• Fotoğraf & Prodüksiyon: ürün fotoğrafı, tanıtım ve reklam filmi
• Web & Dijital Deneyim: web sitesi, mobil arayüz, dijital sadakat
• 3D & Ürün Çözümleri: 3D baskı, tarama, modelleme

TEKLİF AL VE TAKİP ET
• Hizmet ve bütçeni seç, projeni anlat, tek dokunuşla gönder
• Takip numaranla talebinin durumunu gör: Alındı, İnceleniyor, Teklif hazır, Proje başladı
• Durum değişince anlık bildirim al
• WhatsApp, telefon, Instagram ve e-posta ile hızlı iletişim

Güzel görünmek yetmez. Fikrin ötesine birlikte geçelim.

name: Chair Fit: Seated Exercise
description:
Chair Fit offers gentle, voice-guided exercise you can do sitting in a chair — made for older adults and anyone who needs a safe, simple routine.

• Four routines: Morning wake-up, Leg strength, Fall prevention, Evening unwind
• Big pictures and text, spoken instructions
• Timed moves with short rests in between
• Pause or skip at any time
• Weekly check-ins and a streak to keep you going
• Clear safety tips before you start

Only the days you exercised are stored on your device. No ads, no sign-in. Not a substitute for medical advice.

name: Chaljub: Chatea y Conect
description:
Chaljub: Chatea y Conect brings drivers together in private communities organized by platform, state and community area.

Choose your Spanish or English community, submit a separate platform request with supporting evidence, and join rooms approved by the administration. Access is managed independently for each platform.

Share messages and photos with descriptions, react to conversations and report content that breaks the rules. View your requests, account notifications and community announcements. Drivers cannot send private messages to each other.

Manage your profile, read the legal documents specific to this app and access privacy options.

The app is free, with no paid memberships or in-app purchases. Chaljub: Chatea y Conect is an independent community and is not officially affiliated with the platforms mentioned. A platform listed in the catalog does not imply commercial availability in every area.

Support: support@chaljubinscol.app

name: Change Calc: Cash & Coins
description:
Make every cent count with Change Calc.

Cash change: enter your purchase total and cash paid to see change due, an exact payment, or the amount still owed. USD is the default, with common US bills and 25¢, 10¢, 5¢ and 1¢ coins. CNY is also available.
Calculator: add, subtract, multiply and divide with parentheses, decimals and percentages. Use your result as the purchase total.
History: keep up to 100 records on this device and select one to use it again.

Available in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Spanish. Follow your system language or switch in Settings. Language and currency are independent.

Works offline. No account, ads or analytics. Records and preferences stay on your device.

Amounts use up to two decimal places. Percent means divide by 100. Transferred totals are rounded to the nearest cent. Changing currency clears the current purchase amounts; saved records retain their original currency. No exchange conversion. Cash breakdowns are a guide; actual change depends on the cash available.

name: ChanLab: Structure Study
description: Study chart structure with 24 original lessons, knowledge checks and 12 synthetic annotation drills. Mark turning points, stroke endpoints and pivot time windows, then compare your work with explained reference answers. Reveal candles one at a time and test a virtual plan. Keep local notes, bookmarks and progress; revisit missed drills. Works offline without accounts, ads or tracking. Educational only. No live prices, real trading or investment advice.

name: Child Safe Card - Lost Kid ID
description:
Child Safe Card helps parents and caregivers act fast and calmly if a child gets lost.

PREPARE IN ADVANCE
• Keep each child's photo, height, features, allergies and guardian phone numbers in one place
• Snap "today's outfit" each morning in seconds — the detail police ask for first

IF A CHILD IS MISSING
• One tap to call emergency services
• A calm step-by-step checklist so nothing is forgotten
• Show or share the child's card with police, staff or people nearby

FOR YOUR CHILD
• A "I'm lost" card your child can show to a trusted adult, with a guardian phone number

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Photos and details are stored only on your device
• No ads, no sign-in, no tracking

This app does not replace an emergency call. If a child is missing, call your local emergency number right away.

name: Chip Chaser: Dealer Chips
description:
Chip Chaser keeps track of your collection of motorcycle dealership poker chips across the US and Canada.

Every Harley-Davidson® dealership sells its own collectible poker chip. Chip Chaser lists all 648 locations (dealerships, satellite stores and apparel shops, including Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico and Guam), so you always know which chips you have and which you still need.

• Mark chips in one tap. Tap the chip next to a dealer or swipe the row. Filter by All, Missing or Collected, search by name, city, state or ZIP, and sort by state, A to Z, or nearest to you.
• Map. Collected chips show in orange and missing ones in grey, so you can plan a ride around the chips you still need.
• Progress. See your overall percentage, progress in each state (with a seal when you finish one), recent finds and extras.
• Trading. Count how many of each chip you own, and share your missing list or your extras for trade with your collector group.
• Your own stores. Add a dealer that's new, closed or overseas.
• Choose what counts. Include or skip Canadian locations, satellite stores and apparel shops.
• Saved to your Apple ID. Your collection syncs through your own iCloud account to every iPhone signed in with the same Apple ID. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.
• Backup. Export your collection to a file and import it on any phone.

Chip Chaser is an independent collector's app. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Harley-Davidson. Harley-Davidson is a trademark of H-D U.S.A., LLC. Location data comes from Harley-Davidson's public dealer locator.

name: Chopped Games
description:
Chopped Games is a free party game night in your pocket.

HOST IN TWO TAPS
Pick a game and start. Friends join from any phone with a 4-letter code or a QR scan. No download or account needed for them.

TV OPTIONAL
Put the game on your TV with AirPlay, Chromecast or an HDMI adapter while your phone stays your controller. No TV? Everything shows up on everyone's phone.

YOUR GROUP IS THE CAST
Snap a selfie or pick an emoji, and your face shows up in the lobby, in every matchup and on the scoreboard.

GAMES
Quick-fire prompts, head-to-head showdowns, and more games on the way.
• Clapback: answer the prompt, go head to head with a friend's answer, and win the room's votes. Family-friendly mode is on by default.

CREWS
Play with the same people and Chopped Games spots your crew: leaderboards, rivalries, game-night history and bragging rights. Ping your crew when you start a game night.

PLAY OVER FACETIME
Start SharePlay in a FaceTime call and everyone with the app jumps into the room.

FUN FOR EVERYONE
Report or block any player, hosts can remove anyone, and family-friendly mode filters answers.

Free, no ads, no tracking.
Terms of Use: https://chopped.games/terms
Privacy Policy: https://chopped.games/privacy

name: Chord Lab: Chord Synth
description:
Seven keys, a joystick and room for your ideas. Chord Lab turns your iPhone and iPad into a chord instrument with 3D controls, expressive sounds and layers of accompaniment. Open it, choose a sound and start playing.

MAKE THE CHORDS YOURS
Play full chords, strums, arpeggios or drones. Choose your key and octave, customize each button or build a voicing note by note. Save your shapes and assign different chord variations to the joystick's eight directions.

EXPLORE 110 SOUNDS
Combine original synthesizer sounds with a library of sample-based instruments. Discover pads, plucks, organs, synths and more. Shape each sound with glide, envelopes, filter cutoff and resonance.

BUILD YOUR EFFECT CHAIN
Explore 15 effects, including Cloud and Shimmer reverbs, delays, chorus, vibrato, phaser, tremolo, vinyl and drive. Connect up to six modules in series, adjust their parameters and save your chains. Effects process the chord keys while beats, sustained pads and textures stay independent.

LO-FI, RHYTHMS AND ATMOSPHERES
Play along with 40 electronic rhythms, including lo-fi grooves and beats inspired by the 1980s. Add sustained pads in all 12 keys and textures made from real recordings: vinyl, rain, forest, coffee machine, city and night. Each layer has its own volume.

CONNECT AND CAPTURE
Use MIDI input and output, visual control mapping and compatible game controllers. Record your mix as a 24-bit stereo WAV, listen back and share your ideas. Save and import setups to recall your settings. Layers you start can keep playing in the background.

An AUv3 instrument extension brings the sounds and sound controls to compatible hosts. The seven-key interface, beats and backing pads belong to the standalone app.

GIVE YOUR INSTRUMENT ITS OWN LOOK
Choose hardware colors and animated backgrounds with a retro feel. Play in portrait or landscape on iPhone and iPad. The interface is available in English and Portuguese.

One purchase. No subscriptions or in-app purchases. Works offline, with no account required.

Support: contato@dedealbano.com
Privacy policy: https://dedealbano.com/politica-de-privacidade-chordlab/

name: Chromanex
description:
Chromanex is a CIE colorimetry bench for engineers, students, and imaging specialists who need precise space conversion and gamut insight—not filters or retouching tools.
CONVERT WITH A DECLARED WHITE POINT
• Linked XYZ, CIELAB, CIELUV, and xyY fields
• Catalog illuminants (D65, D50, D55, D75, A, C, F2, F7, F11, Equal Energy E) plus custom white xy
• CIE 1931 2° and CIE 1964 10° observer selection
• Approx. sRGB preview with out-of-gamut clipping notice
• Copy conversion reports and save specimens locally
CHROMATICITY & GAMUT
• CIE 1931 xy diagram with spectral locus and purple line
• Optional Planckian locus and wavelength labels
• Tap-to-probe chromaticity with u′ v′ readout
• Overlay and compare sRGB / Rec.709, Display P3, Adobe RGB (1998), and Rec.2020
• Triangle + RGB volume checks for a chosen stimulus
COLOR DIFFERENCE
• CIE76, CIE94, CIEDE2000, and CMC (2:1)
• ΔL*, ΔC*, ΔH* breakdown with plain-language interpretation
• Load pairs from your specimen vault for quick QA-style compares
METAMERISM LAB
• Educational smooth vs. jagged reflectance metamers
• Match under a reference illuminant, then evaluate under a stress lamp (e.g. A, F2, F11)
• ΔE under reference vs. test plus a simple metamerism index
• Reflectance plots and on-screen swatches for the test condition
SPECIMEN VAULT & REFERENCE
• On-device library of titled samples with notes and tags
• Share specimen summaries
• Built-in reference desk covering spaces, observers, white points, ΔE, and honest scope notes
PRIVACY & SCOPE
• No account, no analytics SDK, no network requirement
• Preferences and specimens stay on your device
• Display swatches are sRGB approximations; metamer SPDs are teaching models, not a substitute for measured spectra
Chromanex is for color science workflows: conversion, visualization, difference metrics, and illuminant stress tests—clearly not a photo editor.

name: Cinder Reach: Frontier
description:
Build a home on a world that remembers. Cinder Reach: Frontier is an original real-time strategy game for touch, mouse and keyboard. Gather alloy, build your colony, command specialized forces and decide what the frontier deserves to become.

THREE WAYS TO COMMAND
Lead the original Reach Coalition, the fast-regenerating Verdant Kin or the resilient crystal Chorus. Each faction has distinct unit and building artwork, battlefield forms and tactical tradeoffs.

A CAMPAIGN AT YOUR PACE
Play twelve story chapters across three worlds. Discover a war born from an emergency rescue, severed memories and choices nobody can fully undo. Short optional archives reveal what happened before the first shot. Earn insight for thirty campaign discoveries and reset your evolution choices freely. Pause and save solo battles instantly. Campaign and skirmishes work offline.

QUICK MATCHES AND SOLO OPERATIONS
Choose your faction, one to three AI opponents, difficulty and world for a fresh free-for-all. Six permanent Solo Operations offer distinct tactical challenges without daily timers or expiring rewards. Territorial Wardens guard the maps: defeat them for salvage, or weaken and bond one as an ally.

FAST ONLINE 1v1
Invite a friend using a temporary in-game callsign, find another available opponent, or share a private room code. Both players choose a faction and start with equal technology; campaign upgrades never affect multiplayer. Live battles require internet and cannot pause. No chat or personal account is required.

TACTICAL COMMAND
Combine infantry, armor, precision weapons, repair support, hovercraft and artillery. Use attack-move, retreat, focus fire, production rallies, queued orders, patrols, ten control groups and camera bookmarks. Capture signal sites and protect your economy.

AN ORIGINAL FRONTIER
Explore ash basins, frozen shelves and copper gardens with a cinematic score and distinct tactical effects. Choose adaptive graphics or battery saver, separate music, ambience and effect volumes, mono audio and reduced motion.

Pay once for this version. No ads, loot boxes, paid power, energy timers or in-app purchases. Solo progress stays on your device and can be exported as a backup.

name: Cinevyr
description:
Your Jellyfin library, ready for movie night.

Cinevyr brings your movies and TV shows into a cinematic native app for iPhone and iPad. Connect your server, discover something worth watching, and settle into full-screen playback.

FIND YOUR NEXT WATCH
Browse artwork-rich genres, explore your server libraries, or search movies, shows, and episodes. Combine filters for release year, community rating, watch status, and favorites. Sort your collection by recently added, title, year, rating, or runtime.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Continue watching from your Home screen, save favorites, read synopses, and explore a show's episodes. Connected playback reports your watch progress to Jellyfin.

WATCH YOUR WAY
Enjoy native Apple playback with direct streaming or transcoding from your Jellyfin server. Choose whether to fit the whole picture or fill the display. Cinevyr adapts to iPhone Duo's outer and inner displays and partially folded layouts.

TAKE YOUR LIBRARY WITH YOU
Download movies and individual episodes, with progress, pause, resume, retry, cancel, and delete controls. Manage your queue with background transfers and an optional Wi-Fi-only preference. Live Activities show download progress on supported devices.

Downloads keep the original server files. Offline playback requires a compatible format; downloading does not convert incompatible media. Background download scheduling is managed by the system.

GET THERE FASTER
Open your library from a Home Screen widget, or jump to Library and Downloads with Control Center shortcuts.

Requires your own Jellyfin server and account. No movies, TV shows, or server hosting are included. Playback depends on your media, server configuration, and device support. Cinevyr is an independent client and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Jellyfin.

name: circle by intro.pub
description:
circle is a group chat with you and two others, who are AIs.

You write, then they do. The two don't sound alike, and an answer can come right away or a while later; either one may skip a turn. In a new chat nobody has a name until they give one.

Start as many chats as you like. Each one brings two new AIs.

Turn on notifications to hear when someone writes back.

Every chat tells you the other two are AIs. If you write about suicide or hurting yourself, circle shows crisis lines.

Privacy: https://intro.pub/privacy

name: Citravale
description:
A tank changes quietly. A plant fills out. A reading moves. A familiar corner starts to look different.

Citravale gives those observations a place in the aquarium they belong to. Instead of treating every entry as an isolated number, it lets you connect care records to zones within a visual tank view: water, substrate, plants and other areas you define.

Open a tank and record a reading, a feeding, an equipment check or an observation. Keep water changes in their own log and build a photo timeline you can revisit with a manual comparison divider. The record becomes a picture of what you noticed and what you did, not just another list of reminders.

Charts and accessible tables help you review saved measurements. Your own ranges provide context, while the care timeline brings different kinds of entries together. Correct a reading, archive an old record or restore something you need again without starting a new journal.

For a wider view, create a care summary or export CSV and PDF records. JSON backup and staged import give you control over moving your local archive. Optional reminders can support the routine you choose.

Citravale does not diagnose livestock, prescribe chemistry ranges or declare an aquarium healthy or safe. It is a place for careful observation, organized care and a longer memory.

name: CiveLightKore
description:
It is night. The sea is dark. Twelve ships are coming in through the fog, and you are the only light on the coast.

You are the lighthouse keeper.

Every ship brings a question. Four answers sit around your lighthouse: north, east, south and west. Turn your beam to the answer you believe is true, then press Shine.

If you are right, the ship sails safely into the harbour.
If you are wrong, the ship is lost in the fog.
If your lamp oil runs out, the ship is lost too.

Lose three ships and the night is over.

WHAT THE QUESTIONS ARE ABOUT
The ocean and the creatures in it. The stars, the Moon and the planets. Famous sailors and explorers. Ships, compasses and how people found their way at sea.

AFTER EACH NIGHT
Your Keeper's Logbook shows every ship from that night. You can see which ones you saved, and read one short fact about each question.

THE HARBOR MASTERS
Choose a keeper nickname, and your best night is added to the Harbor Masters board. You can play without a name, change it later, or delete your data any time.

All questions are inside the app. No internet is needed to play.

name: Civis : votes des députés
description:
Civis vous aide à comprendre ce qui se décide à l’Assemblée nationale, sans jargon et sans parti pris.

• Tous les votes : le résultat officiel, le vote de chaque groupe et de chaque député.
• Votre député : retrouvez-le avec votre commune ou votre code postal, suivez ses votes.
• L’hémicycle interactif : zoomez, touchez un siège, filtrez par groupe.
• Les textes : où en est chaque projet ou proposition de loi.
• L’agenda : les séances et les commissions de la semaine.
• Mes suivis : des élus et des textes à suivre, avec un repère quand il y a du nouveau.
• Comprendre : des explications courtes sur le Parlement et le vote de la loi.
• Élections : les résultats des municipales 2026 et la présidentielle 2027, à partir des sources officielles.
• Qui vote comme moi ? : comparez vos positions aux votes des groupes, sans consigne de vote.
• Votre avis : pour ou contre sur une loi, de façon anonyme.

Sources : données publiques officielles de l’Assemblée nationale (https://data.assemblee-nationale.fr), mises à jour chaque nuit, et du ministère de l’Intérieur (https://www.data.gouv.fr). La source et la date de chaque information sont indiquées.

Civis est une application indépendante. Elle ne représente ni l’Assemblée nationale, ni le Gouvernement, ni aucun parti ou institution.
Sans publicité et utilisable sans compte. Le compte, facultatif, synchronise vos suivis entre vos appareils.

name: CJW II Chapter
description:
Stay connected with the Colonel James Wood II Chapter of the Sons of the American Revolution, serving Winchester and Virginia’s Northern Shenandoah Valley.

Explore upcoming chapter meetings, patriotic ceremonies, and community activities using events from the chapter website. Search events, save your favorites, share details, and add activities to your calendar.

Read The Colonel’s Dispatch in the built-in newsletter reader. Recently opened public newsletters remain available on your device.

Chapter members can open the chapter website’s protected resources using their existing website account and verification process. Member access depends on website permissions; no separate app account is required.

Public events, newsletters, and chapter information are available without signing in. Internet access is needed to refresh content and use member resources. Calendar entries are imported copies; check the chapter website for updates.

Patriotic. Historical. Educational.

name: Classroom Relay
description:
Classroom Relay hjälper lärare att hantera klasslistor, markera närvaro och dela in elever i grupper inför klassens aktiviteter. Välj vilka som är närvarande och hur många grupper du vill skapa. Justera indelningen, spara den och registrera elevernas deltagande under aktiviteten.

- Skapa klasser och lägg till eller redigera elevernas namn eller alias.
- Markera frånvaro och skapa grupper med så jämn storlek som möjligt.
- Byt plats på elever mellan grupper och spara indelningen för att se den senare.
- Registrera och ångra noteringar om deltagande i sparade grupper.
- Välj bland 12 förslag på samarbetsaktiviteter som kan anpassas till undervisningen.
- Växla mellan engelska och förenklad kinesiska samt ljust och mörkt utseende. Gränssnittet finns inte på svenska.

Inget konto eller någon internetanslutning behövs. Klasslistor och lektionsanteckningar sparas lokalt på enheten och laddas inte upp av appen. Beroende på enhetens inställningar kan uppgifterna ingå i systemets säkerhetskopior. Följ skolans rutiner för hantering av elevuppgifter; det går att använda alias.

name: Clean Pattern: Row Counter
description:
Clean Pattern is a row counter that reads your pattern with you. Share a free pattern page from Safari, open a PDF you bought, or paste the text, and get a clean reading view that keeps the materials, gauge and rows.

A large counter sits at the bottom of the screen, right under your thumb. Every tap moves a highlighter to the row you are working now, through sections, repeats and sizes. On "Rows 3–20: repeat Rows 1–2" it tells you which row to work. When a section ends, one tap starts the next one at the right row.

For PDFs, the original layout stays as the designer made it, and a band sits on the real line of your current step, even in two-column layouts with size grids.

Every pattern keeps its source line: the site, the designer and a link to the original, so the people who wrote it always get the credit.

What you get:
- Share from Safari, Files or Mail, or add a link, a PDF or pasted text
- A clean reading view with materials, gauge and rows, always credited to its source with a link to the original
- A big one-handed counter with undo, a target row and a screen that stays awake
- A highlighter that follows sections, repeats, open-ended repeats and your chosen size
- Knit or crochet, rows or rounds, US or UK terms, detected for you
- Two sample patterns to try it in seconds

No account. No AI patterns. Unlimited projects, free. Your patterns stay on your phone and work offline.

name: ClearDose: Med Reminders
description:
Your medicine cabinet, finally easy to see. In ClearDose every medication is a clear bottle, and the pills inside are the pills you have.

TAKE A DOSE, WATCH IT HAPPEN
Mark a dose taken and the cap lifts as that dose drops out of the bottle. Log a refill and the pills pour back in. The fill level always matches what's really in the bottle, and the label shows the exact count.

REMINDERS ON YOUR SCHEDULE

- A notification at every dose time, with Mark Taken and Skip right on it
- One follow-up 30 minutes later if a dose is still unmarked
- Schedules by time of day, by weekday, or every few hours, straight through midnight

KNOW WHEN TO REORDER
ClearDose works out how many days each medication will last. When it reaches your threshold (7 days unless you change it), the cap turns orange and ClearDose reminds you to reorder. Logging a refill clears it.

HOME SCREEN WIDGET
See your next dose and today's progress at a glance, and mark a dose taken without opening the app.

TODAY AND HISTORY
See today's doses in one ring, and every medication's history of taken, skipped and missed doses, with weekly and monthly adherence. Made a mistake? Undo it.

MADE FOR IPHONE
Tablets, capsules, ovals, liquids and injections, in your own colors. Full Dark Mode, Dynamic Type up to the largest sizes, and VoiceOver support.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads and no tracking. Everything stays on your iPhone, and ClearDose never connects to the internet.

ClearDose is a reminder and record-keeping tool. It doesn't give medical advice. Always follow your doctor's or pharmacist's instructions.

name: Clicklet
description:
Clicklet lets the Camera Control button on your iPhone start your Apple Shortcuts. Pick one shortcut to launch with a press, or turn on Menu mode and choose from a few favorites each time.

Clicklet opens Apple Shortcuts to run your workflow, so you'll see the usual Shortcuts screens, along with any permission prompts or app handoffs your shortcut needs.

To set up your library, install the included Connect Clicklet helper. It brings in your shortcut names and small icon images, which appear in your library, in the menu, and while a shortcut opens. You can also search for a shortcut or type its name. If you used an earlier version, replace the old helper with the new one and refresh to get icons.

From the menu, tap Configure to go back to setup. You can scroll the menu by dragging along its side margins.

Your shortcut names, icons and selections stay on your device. There's no account, advertising, analytics, subscription or in-app purchase. Camera access supports the Camera Control and lock-screen handoff and shows a live preview; Clicklet doesn't save photos or videos. Launching while your iPhone is locked requires authentication.

Requires iOS 18 or later and Apple's Shortcuts app. Launching from the button requires an iPhone with Camera Control; set Clicklet in Settings > Camera > Camera Control. Opening Clicklet on its own shows your setup without running a shortcut.

name: Clink — Clean Links
description:
Clink removes the tracking junk from the links you open in Safari: utm_source and the other campaign tags, Facebook's fbclid, Google's gclid, email trackers like mc_eid, Amazon's ref= and pd_rd_ tags, YouTube's si, and hundreds more. It also skips click-tracking redirects such as google.com/url and l.facebook.com, so you go straight to the page.

It's built to never break a link:

• Only known trackers are removed. Search terms, product options, timestamps, gift links and invite codes stay.
• Unsubscribe links, sign-in and checkout pages, signed download links and local sites are never touched.
• You stay in control: pause Clink on any site, choose which kinds of tags to remove, and keep affiliate codes for creators you support.

Clink works on links you tap or click, links you type or paste, links that open from other apps and email, and URLs you copy from a page. The Clink button in Safari shows what was removed on the current page.

Private by design: Clink runs entirely on your device. It has no account, no analytics and no ads, and it never sends your browsing anywhere.

To turn it on, open Settings → Apps → Safari → Extensions → Clink. On a Mac, open Safari → Settings → Extensions.

Free and open source under the GNU GPL v3: https://github.com/iacompa/Clink

name: ClubBout: Fencing Journal
description:
ClubBout is a practice journal for fencers. Record each bout as it happens and review your training between sessions.

• Log the score or just the result. Choose a 5-touch, 15-touch or custom format and add a takeaway or tags.
• Find previous bouts by date, opponent or format and review the scores and notes from your head-to-head history.
• Follow training activity, win rates and touch statistics.
• Export CSV for a spreadsheet or save a JSON backup you can restore in ClubBout.

The journal is stored on your iPhone and works offline without an account. Available in English, German and Simplified Chinese.

name: Collector's Private Archive
seller_name: Shanghai Dazhuo Information Technology Co., Ltd.
description:
Collector's Private Archive is a private catalogue for people who take their collections seriously.

No login, no internet, no subscription. Every record and photo stays on your device, and any piece can be exported as a one-page, auction-catalogue-style PDF for insurance files, consignment or sharing with fellow collectors.

Seven categories, with the fields that actually matter
- Watches: brand, model, movement, case diameter, material, serial number, warranty card, source, purchase price, current valuation
- Jewellery: gemstone, carat, clarity, certificate number, metal, and more
- Rare bags: style code, year, leather colour, hardware stamp, accessories, condition, and more
- Couture, collector cars, original art and fine wine each have their own professional fields
Pick a category and the right fields appear. Fill in only what you remember — everything can be left blank.

One piece, one volume
- Automatic archive numbers (0001, 0002 ...) that match the catalogue
- Multiple photos and a serif-typeset, cloth-bound detail page
- A timeline for acquisition, servicing, repair, revaluation and transfer
- A native two-column catalogue for foldables and iPad: list on the left, full archive on the right

Export and ownership
- A4 landscape, single-page fine-catalogue PDF, ready to print or share
- Records and PDFs are created and stored only on your device
- Works fully offline, requests no network access; no account, no ads, no subscription, no in-app purchases

Languages
Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, French and German, switchable in Settings. The built-in sample collection follows the selected language.

Collector's Private Archive V1.0 — paid upfront, complete from the first launch.

name: Color Tell: Color Blind Helper
description:
Color Tell helps people with color blindness name and tell apart colors in everyday life.

IDENTIFY
• Point the crosshair and see the color in plain words — "light blue", "dark green", "muted purple"
• Hear it read aloud
• Freeze the picture, use the light in dim rooms

SHOW ONLY THIS COLOR
• Keep only reds, greens, blues or yellows in color — everything else turns gray
• Great for ripe fruit, cables, charts and clothes

SAVED COLORS
• Save the colors of clothes and things, add a note, and match outfits later

Camera images are never stored or sent. No ads, no sign-in.

name: Commentville
description:
Commentville is a cozy little town that's alive right now. Move in, get a house with your name on the door, and start living next to real neighbours.

MAKE IT YOURS
Pick your look, paint the walls, choose the furniture and fix up your yard. Your house sits on a real street, and the people walking past can see it.

SOMETHING TO DO EVERY DAY
Open your daily letter, take a town job, cast a line at the pier, grow vegetables in the back garden and cook dinner. Keep your pets happy, take your car to the wash, and catch a film at the cinema.

A TOWN WITH NEIGHBOURS
See people walking and driving around you. Wave, ring a doorbell, leave flowers or knock on a door. Play tennis or volleyball at the Sports Park. Buy a restaurant, take a shift, sell at the Farmers' Market or put your house on the market.

THE TOWN DECIDES
Run for mayor, vote on Saturday, and help your street win Street of the Week. Fireworks, weather and the balloon are shared by everyone in town at the same moment.

EASY TO MOVE IN
Move in as a guest with no account at all. If you use Instagram you can claim your house with your own name, or get one by commenting on our posts. The game is free. Coins are earned by playing and are never sold.

There's no typed chat between players. You can report or block a neighbour from their house, and delete your account at any time from the Account screen.

Commentville is an independent fan-made game. It isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Instagram or Meta. An internet connection is required.

name: Competenze STEM
Concordância: Bíblia
description:
Um lugar calmo para ler a Bíblia em paz.

O Concordância reúne, num só app, o texto da Escritura e as ferramentas para examiná-lo, sem pressa e sem barulho: sem feed e sem anúncios. Você abre, lê, anota e segue.

LER
• Mais de 300 traduções em mais de 180 idiomas. Toda tradução tem a licença conferida e o crédito à vista.
• Compare traduções lado a lado e troque de uma para outra sem perder o lugar.
• Ouça o capítulo com a voz do aparelho.
• Cada versículo do seu jeito: marque com a cor que quiser, escreva uma nota e crie uma imagem em aquarela com o versículo para compartilhar. A referência e a tradução sempre acompanham o texto.
• Aparência clara ou escura e tamanho de letra ajustável.

EXAMINAR O TEXTO
• O original ao toque: toque numa palavra para ver o hebraico ou o grego, a glosa e o número Strong, nos 66 livros.
• Interlinear sob o texto, verbetes do léxico e as ocorrências de cada palavra do original.
• Seis comentários clássicos, em português, ao lado do texto.
• Mapas com rotas e viagens, e a régua de medir distâncias.
• Linha do tempo para situar cada livro e cada fato, e as pessoas de cada capítulo.

HOJE E PLANOS DE LEITURA
• O app abre no Hoje: o ponto onde você parou, a leitura do dia no seu plano e a última nota que escreveu.
• Planos de leitura prontos, como a Bíblia em um ano, ou monte o seu. Os lembretes só existem se você ligar.
• Acompanhe a sua constância com calma: os dias lidos, sem placar e sem cobrança.

ANOTAR E LER JUNTO
• Caderno com as suas notas e marcações, ligadas aos versículos e sincronizadas na sua conta entre os seus aparelhos.
• Grupos de leitura, por convite, para ler junto com a família, a célula ou os amigos.

IA PARA ENTENDER O TEXTO
• Pergunte sobre uma passagem e receba uma resposta curta, com os versículos citados. A IA fala da Bíblia, da fé cristã e do uso do app, e recusa com gentileza o que foge disso.
• As respostas são geradas por inteligência artificial e podem conter erros: confira sempre no texto bíblico. Se uma resposta for inadequada, use "Denunciar resposta" no menu dela.
• Antes da primeira pergunta, o app mostra o que será enviado, a quem e para quê, e só envia se você concordar. A IA é opcional: o resto do app funciona sem ela.

O QUE É GRÁTIS
Ler a Bíblia inteira, marcar versículos, fazer notas simples, ver o original ao toque e compartilhar a imagem do versículo é grátis e não expira. Outros recursos, como mapas, Caderno, planos de leitura, grupos, interlinear completo e a IA, dependem do plano da sua conta.

SUA PRIVACIDADE
• Sem anúncios, sem rastreamento e sem venda de dados.
• Você exclui a conta e todos os seus dados dentro do app, em Ajustes > Perfil e conta > Excluir minha conta.
• Entre com e-mail e senha, com o Google ou com a Apple.
• Política de privacidade: https://www.concordancia.com.br/site/privacidade
• Termos de uso: https://www.concordancia.com.br/site/termos

"Tua palavra é lâmpada para meus pés e luz para meu caminho." (Salmos 119.105)

Dúvidas e sugestões: concordancia@hiperplano.com

name: Conductra
description:
Conductra is a virtual electronics workbench for students and teachers who want to rehearse electrical experiments before the physical lab.

Build DC and AC circuits, explore electromagnetic devices, and watch live estimates for current, potential, and power as you drag parts on the canvas. When your layout is ready, convert it into a formal schematic for notebooks, lab check-in, or class demos.

WHY CONDUCTRA
• 100+ components: sources, passives, semiconductors, magnetics, sensors, indicators, protection, measurement, and logic
• Drag-and-drop Bench with grid snap, wiring tools, and on-device saving
• Live readouts for current, potential, power, and AC reactive notes
• Safety Guard clamps near-short conditions and blocks risky exports
• One-tap conversion from bench layout to standard circuit diagrams
• Guided Lab Prep modules for Ohm’s law, dividers, RC filters, electromagnets, and more
• Local meter log for prep measurements
• Offline-friendly storage with no account required

DESIGNED FOR PRE-LAB LEARNING
Conductra is an educational rehearsal tool. It does not energize phone hardware and does not connect to mains electricity. Use it to predict trends and plan safer lab work, while instructors and certified equipment remain the authority for physical safety.

FEATURES
Bench — assemble and probe virtual circuits
Catalog — browse parts with safety notes
Projects — manage saved benches and meter captures
Schematics — archive and share formal diagrams
Lab Prep — follow structured experiment warm-ups
Settings — tune display, frequency, and Safety Guard

Download Conductra and practice with confidence before your next electricity lab.

name: Connected Classroom Compass
description: Connected Classroom Compass helps educators reflect on classroom challenges, organize observations, and receive practical AI-assisted guidance.

name: Conquer Economics
description:
Conquer Economics turns microeconomics and macroeconomics into knowledge you can actually understand, remember, and use.

Across 18 parts, start with scarcity, opportunity cost, supply and demand, elasticity, production costs, market structures, and factor markets. Then move into GDP, inflation and unemployment, money and banking, monetary theory, aggregate supply and demand, monetary and fiscal policy, and international trade and finance.

Every knowledge point includes a clear definition, key points, worked examples, and original diagrams drawn by the app. Every part includes multiple-choice and free-response practice with full explanations.

• 303 knowledge points, 560 practice questions, 183 formulas, and 154 diagrams
• Microeconomics and macroeconomics clearly separated and ordered from foundations to advanced topics
• English, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese; the language setting follows your phone by default, with English as the fallback
• No login required; learning progress stays on your device
• Course content is delivered by the app backend, so it can improve without waiting for an app update
• No ads and no third-party tracking SDKs

All 18 parts are open in this version. No access code, account, or purchase is required.

name: Conquer Physics
description:
Turn physics from memorized formulas into ideas you can explain and problems you can solve.

Conquer Physics builds a complete mechanics and electromagnetism foundation in 16 chapters:

Mechanics
• Vectors, components, dot and cross products, dimensional analysis
• Kinematics: position, velocity, acceleration, motion graphs, projectiles, relative motion, circular motion
• Newton's laws: free-body diagrams, friction, inclines, tension, circular dynamics, terminal velocity
• Work, energy, and power: kinetic-energy theorem, potential energy, conservation, springs, power
• Momentum and center of mass: impulse, collisions, center-of-mass motion, variable mass
• Rotation I: angular kinematics, torque, moment of inertia, rotational energy
• Rotation II: parallel-axis theorem, angular momentum, rolling, rigid-body equilibrium
• Simple harmonic motion: phase, angular frequency, energy, pendulums
• Universal gravitation: field, potential energy, escape speed, Kepler's laws

Electromagnetism
• Electrostatics: Coulomb's law, electric field, potential, continuous charge
• Gauss's law: flux, symmetry, conductors, common distributions
• Capacitors: capacitance, series and parallel, dielectrics, stored energy
• Circuit analysis: current, resistance, Kirchhoff's laws, RC circuits, meters
• Magnetic fields: forces, charged-particle motion, fields from currents, Ampere's law
• Electromagnetic induction: Faraday's law, motional emf, Lenz's law, transformers, Maxwell's equations
• Inductors: self-inductance, magnetic energy, RL circuits, LC oscillations

Every concept includes an intuition-first summary, definition, key points, validity conditions, original worked examples, pitfalls, and a tip.
Practice mixes multiple-choice and free-response questions with full explanations, model answers, and self-assessment rubrics. Every figure is drawn natively by the app.

Trilingual interface: Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, with a Follow phone option.
No account, no ads, no third-party tracking SDKs. Learning progress stays on your device, and downloaded lessons work offline.

name: Control Tower
description:
Trancom Control Tower — мобільний супутник платформи Trancom з управління транспортом і безпекою (trancomexp.onl). Для працівників Trancom і партнерів проєктів, які отримали обліковий запис від Trancom.

Усе, що є у веб-версії, — тепер на iPhone, з віджетами та миттєвими сповіщеннями.

ОГЛЯД
• Транспорт, колектив, сервісні заявки та документи одним поглядом
• Критичні та прострочені пункти в одному списку
• Розподіл флоту: в рейсі / на базі
• Відлік до наступного дня безпеки

ТРАНСПОРТ
• Жива карта флоту: уся техніка на одній карті, кластери, фільтри за статусом, типом і проєктом
• Тягачі, легкові та причепи з фото, пробігом, водієм і зчепленням
• Статус документів та історія обслуговування кожної одиниці
• Реєстр зчеплень і групи причепів

ДОКУМЕНТИ ТА ТЕРМІНИ
• Прострочені, до 30 / 60 днів, без дати
• Транспорт, колектив і підрядники разом
• Відкриття оригінальних файлів

СЕРВІС І ТО
• Відкриті та прострочені сервісні заявки
• План ТО на найближчі дні

БЕЗПЕКА
• Дні безпеки з фото та звітами
• Офлайн-екран SDS: дії при контакті, розливі чи загорянні, дзвінок в одне натискання
• Дані про речовини
• Статус допуску підрядників

КОМАНДА
• Завдання: мої та призначені мною, виконання, створення нових
• Відпустки й лікарняні: залишок, нові заявки, погодження для менеджерів
• Довідник співробітників із дзвінком в одне натискання

ВІДЖЕТИ ТА СПОВІЩЕННЯ
• 9 віджетів: Мої завдання (виконання прямо з головного екрана), Сервісні заявки, План ТО, Критичне, Документи, Флот, День безпеки, Моя відпустка та лічильник на екрані блокування
• Push-сповіщення про завдання, рішення щодо відпусток, сервісні заявки, щоденний дайджест документів і нагадування про дні безпеки

Мови: українська, англійська, іспанська. Кожен користувач бачить лише ті розділи та проєкти, які дозволяє його обліковий запис.

Потрібен обліковий запис від Trancom; публічної реєстрації немає.

name: Coptic Data
description:
كوبتيك داتا: رفيقك في الصلاة والقراءة في الكنيسة القبطية الأرثوذكسية.

• الأجبية: صلوات ساعات النهار والليل، تظهر لك ساعة الصلاة الحالية فور فتح التطبيق.
• القداسات والقراءات والكتاب المقدس: نصوص بالعربية والقبطية والإنجليزية والقبطي المعرّب، تختار منها حتى ثلاث لغات في نفس الصفحة.
• السنكسار: قديسو اليوم حسب التقويم القبطي.
• تابع القراءة: يحفظ لك أماكن آخر القراءات، مع إمكانية تثبيت ما تريد.
• وضع القراءة المريح: تكبير النص، الوضع الليلي، وضع بروجكتور لعرض الصلوات على شاشة كبيرة بالسلايدات، وفهرس للتنقل السريع.
• الخدمات: لخدام مدارس الأحد المسجلين، شاشة لإدارة الفصول والحضور والافتقاد والإعلانات (تحتاج حسابًا من الكنيسة).

Coptic Data is a prayer and reading companion for the Coptic Orthodox Church: the Agpeya, liturgies, readings, the Bible and the Synaxarium in Arabic, Coptic and English, with a Sunday School services area for registered servants.

name: Copy to Translate
description:
Copy text, come back to this app, and the translation is already there. No need to paste into a translator.

Copy to Translate translates what you copied in another app the moment you return to it. Add it to Control Center or the Action button and one press after copying is enough. Translation runs on this device with Google ML Kit, so once a language pack is downloaded it works without an internet connection.

■ Features
• Translated when you return: copy something, come back, and the translation is ready.
• One press: add the Translate Clipboard control to Control Center, the Lock Screen or the Action button.
• Without leaving your app: set the Translate Text action from the Shortcuts app to Back Tap and see the result on top of the app you are in.
• iPad: keep the app open in Split View or Slide Over and anything you copy is translated right away.
• Automatic language detection: other languages become your language, and text in your language becomes the other language you picked. If detection is wrong, you can choose the source language yourself.
• Offline translation: each language pack is about 30 MB. Once downloaded, it translates even in airplane mode. Delete the packs you no longer need.
• Keeps line breaks: lists and multi-line text are translated with their lines in the same order.
• Skips what does not need translating: when the app reads the clipboard on opening, phone numbers, links, email addresses and verification codes are left alone, and so are items that a password manager marks as concealed.
• Recent translations: stored on this device only. Clear them or turn saving off at any time.

■ Privacy
• No sign-up and no login.
• Copied text is translated on this device, and this app never uploads it.
• No ads.
• Language models are downloaded from Google. Google ML Kit, the translation engine, sends Google diagnostics such as device information, the languages used and text length; text content is not among the data Google lists.

■ Good to know
• iOS does not let apps read the clipboard in the background, so the translation happens when you return to this app or press the control, not at the moment you copy.
• iOS asks whether to allow pasting from other apps. Set Paste from Other Apps to Allow in Settings to stop the question.
• Downloading a language pack for the first time needs an internet connection. You can choose in Settings whether to download over mobile data.
• Translations are machine translations and may not be accurate.

name: Corner Capsule
description:
Corner Capsule turns any walk into a blind box.

Pick 15, 30 or 60 minutes and draw a destination. Corner Capsule picks a real place nearby, like a park, a café, a bakery or a quiet corner, and keeps it sealed. All you get is an arrow and a distance. No map, no street names. Walk whichever way you like; the arrow keeps pointing.

When you get there, the capsule opens and the place is revealed.

FIND
• Real places nearby, chosen at random
• One arrow and one number while you walk
• A gentle tap when you're close, and a reveal when you arrive

KEEP
• Save each place to your journal with a photo and a few words
• See your route on a map afterwards
• Collect 21 kinds of places, from parks to piers

SHARE
• Leave an anonymous note for the next person a capsule brings there
• See notes left by people who came before you, and get notified when someone new leaves one
• Invite a friend with a six-character code to walk to the same secret place

ALSO
• Hold a capsule for another day
• Walk or cycle
• Apple Watch: follow the arrow from your wrist and feel a tap when you arrive

Private by design. Your location and route never leave your device. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

name: Corner Office: Pixel Empire
description:
Start with an empty office and build your company, floor by floor.

Corner Office is a pixel-art tower tycoon: pick an industry, hire people and keep your building running — elevators, restrooms, coffee, research and your team's mood. Every day ends with a budget: what came in, what went out and what comes next.

BUILD YOUR TOWER
• Offices, support rooms, decorations and new floors.
• Elevators, slides and tubes to connect the floors.
• Happiness matters: trash, broken computers and queues affect production.

PICK YOUR INDUSTRY
• Software: manage development, QA and IT staff through commits and releases.
• Education: manage teachers, enrolments and graduations.
• Each industry has its own rooms, research and challenges.

BUILD YOUR TEAM
Hire, promote and manage seven jobs with four levels each. Balance wages, upkeep and growth to keep your finances healthy.

RESEARCH AND GOALS
Unlock research and work through 32 goals that reward your company's growth.

JOIN THE CITY
Found your company in São Paulo, see neighbouring towers and visit other companies. Reach the twenty-person team goal and confirm your day to compete in the average daily profit rankings.

PLAY AT YOUR PACE
Speed up the workday, review the daily budget and get a summary when you return. The server checks each day's accounts and keeps your tower in the cloud.

• Free, with no ads and no in-app purchases in this first release.
• Guest mode; optional Sign in with Apple to take your tower to another device.
• Delete your account from inside the app.

Internet is required to open your company and sync progress.
Questions and ideas: support@cornerofficegame.dev

name: Cosmophy
description:
Reactiona is a hands-on chemistry practice app for secondary and introductory college learners. Build molecules by dragging atoms, balance equations with live scoring, explore pH and flame-color benches, walk through oxygen preparation, and study atomic structure, bonding, organics, acids–bases–salts, and metal activity—then watch SceneKit particle stages show how microscopic pieces rearrange.

LAB
• Molecule Builder — drag H, C, N, O, Na, Cl and match target formulas such as H2O, CO2, NH3, NaCl, and CH4.
• Equation Balance — tune coefficients until atoms are conserved; common mistakes are shown beside each puzzle.
• pH Bench — slide a meter, review reference samples, and quiz yourself against real-world values.
• Flame Colors — identify Na, K, Ca, Cu, Li, and Ba emission colors in a safe digital simulation.
• Oxygen Prep — step through water-displacement collection with scoring for procedure slips.

LEARN
• Atomic structure, chemical bonds, organic chemistry, acids/bases/salts, and the metal activity series—with diagrams and mark-complete progress.

ANIMATE
• 3D-style microscopic scenes for water formation, ionic dissolve, and methane combustion sketches. Pinch and orbit the stage; replay motion anytime.

NOTES
• Equation bank with exam pitfalls and star favorites.
• Deduction points that mirror typical mark losses.
• Personal mistake notes auto-filled from lab checks and editable by you.

STUDIO
• Local score, completed labs/modules, flame discoveries, English/Finnish interface language, privacy policy, and about pages.
• Progress is saved on device only—no account, no ads, no tracking SDKs.

Reactiona is an educational simulation. It does not replace supervised laboratory instruction or safety training.

name: coTravel: Travel Together
description:
Travel together, even when you are in different vehicles. coTravel helps your group share a route, coordinate stops, and see participating members on the map.

PLAN TOGETHER
Create a travel group and share its invitation link through WhatsApp or your phone's share menu. Join with a display name, search for places, and choose a start, destination, and stops. View the shared route and written directions on the map.

KEEP THE GROUP IN SYNC
Group members can add or remove shared stops. Request route cancellation and let another member approve it; a sole member can cancel immediately. Recreate the last saved route inputs when you want to travel that route again.

SHARE LOCATION BY CHOICE
Enable location sharing to show your latest position to members of your travel group, including in the background when the required permissions are granted. You can stop sharing from the app. Background location sharing may increase battery use.

USE ENGLISH OR TURKISH
Choose English or Turkish in the app.

An internet connection is required for shared routes, search, group updates, and location sharing. Location availability depends on your device permissions, network connection, and operating system settings.

name: CourtTap Padel
description:
CourtTap Padel helps you score and manage padel matches from your phone or tablet. Core scoring works without an account or internet connection.

CHOOSE YOUR FORMAT
Standard padel, Quick tournament, Americano, Mexicano, Target points, Timed match and custom settings. Configure games, sets, tie-breaks, Advantage, Golden Point and Star Point.

RUN YOUR MATCH
Add or correct points, follow the service order, pause play and switch to a full-screen scoreboard. Americano and Mexicano include participant rotations and individual standings for single-court sessions.

PLAYER PROFILES
Set names and player photos from the camera or gallery. Photo filters run locally on your device. Choose Indonesian or English, with score announcements using device text-to-speech. An offline voice for the selected language must be installed; voice characteristics depend on your device.

CLICKERS AND LED DISPLAYS
Connect compatible Bluetooth BLE clickers to help control the score. Send the scoreboard to an LED receiver over your local Wi-Fi/LAN using QR pairing. Colorlight receivers and clickers are separate hardware and are not included. Clicker compatibility depends on the device protocol.

OPTIONAL ACCOUNT
Register with WhatsApp verification to use an account and cloud sync. Matches and history upload only after you enable synchronization. Accounts and cloud require internet; local scoring remains available offline.

Delete your account and cloud data in Account & sync or on the account deletion webpage.

Support: multicamplanner@gmail.com
Privacy: https://livegear.id/courttap/privacy?lang=en

name: CraterIndex
description:
Crater Index is a field companion to the IAU Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature — the official record, maintained by USGS Astrogeology, of every name approved for a feature on the Moon, the planets and their moons.

Look through a telescope and the Moon turns into a map: dark plains, bright rays, a walled plain closing on the terminator. Crater Index lets you put a name to what you are seeing, and then tells you what that name remembers — a Polish astronomer, a nineteenth-century novelist, a river god from a myth you half recall. The whole catalogue travels with you, so nothing has to be downloaded while you are standing at the eyepiece.

The atlas is the heart of the app. The Moon is drawn as a plate you can turn with a finger, and the approved names rise over it as labels. Drag the globe until the crater you are looking at comes round, tap its label, and the record opens: where it lies, how wide it is, the year the IAU adopted the name, and the note that explains it. Set another hour and watch the terminator move across the same ground.

Beyond the atlas, the chronicle lays a century of approvals along a year axis, so you can see how quickly a world was named once a spacecraft finally returned pictures of it, and the namesake search finds the people whose names were given to more than one world. Everything is quiet, typographic and made to be read in the dark.

Data comes from the public gazetteer published by the U.S. Geological Survey on behalf of the International Astronomical Union. Crater Index is an independent reader of that catalogue.

name: Crook for Herdr
description:
Crook lets you watch and steer the AI coding agents running in Herdr on your Mac — from your iPhone or iPad.

EVERY AGENT AT A GLANCE
Agents that need you come first: waiting for input, done, working, idle. The same marks as Herdr and the same tab names (1:claude).

THE REAL TERMINAL
Open any pane to see the live, colored terminal. A row of extra keys gives you esc, tab, arrows, ctrl and ^C.

ANSWER PROMPTS
When an agent asks for permission, tap the choice it offers — Yes, Allow once, and so on — right from the list.

SEND INSTRUCTIONS
Type or dictate (speech is turned into text on the device), attach photos, pick files with @ and run / commands. Start a new workspace with Claude Code or Codex.

NOTIFICATIONS
While Crook is open, it tells you when an agent is waiting for you or has finished. Quiet hours and per-workspace mute.

USAGE AND MODELS
See context, tokens, 5-hour and weekly limits and cost, and switch models and effort for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode.

IPAD
Spaces and agents on the left, the session on the right — like Herdr on the Mac. Keyboard and Stage Manager friendly.

CONNECTS ONLY TO YOUR MAC
Crook tries Tailscale, then the same Wi‑Fi, then an encrypted relay. On Wi‑Fi and the relay, everything is end‑to‑end encrypted with your Mac's key. No account, no analytics, no ads.

WHAT YOU NEED
• A Mac running Herdr 0.9 or later and Node.js 23.6 or later
• The free Crook plugin on the Mac: herdr plugin install algorist-dev/crook-herdr (github.com/algorist-dev/crook-herdr)
Then press prefix+m in Herdr and scan the QR code.

Supported agents: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and GitHub Copilot CLI, plus any terminal pane.

Crook is made by Algorist and is not affiliated with the Herdr project.
Questions: support@algorist.jp

name: CubeLike: Chain Burst
description:
CubeLike is a chain-reaction puzzle on a living cube.

THE BOARD
Fifty-four tiles wrap around the six faces of a 3D cube. Every tile holds up to three arrows.

ONE TAP, ONE CASCADE
Tap a tile to add an arrow. At three, it bursts and fires in four directions, charging its neighbors. Fill a neighbor and it bursts too — a cascade that crosses edges and rolls around the whole cube. Score grows with chain depth: one deep cascade beats a dozen scattered taps.

PLAY YOUR PLAN
- Levels with clear goals: reach the target score before your moves run out
- Fewer moves, higher targets and more blocked tiles as you climb — and the levels never run out
- Finish with moves to spare for a 3-star rating; replay any level to perfect it
- Every level is dealt from a fixed pattern: same level, same board, so you can plan the perfect chain

MADE TO FEEL GOOD
- A crisp 3D board, haptic taps and handcrafted sounds
- Clean, warm visuals; nothing to learn beyond one tap
- Progress saves on your device automatically

NO STRINGS
No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, no internet. CubeLike works fully offline and collects no data.

Four languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese.

name: Cull Sheet
description:
Cull Sheet is for anyone who has to hand in a set number of photographs: class assignments, event coverage, portrait proofs. It keeps the marks, the order and the count on the phone, and exports a numbered contact sheet of the photos you kept.

MAKE A ROUND
Name the shoot and type the number of photos you promised. Add a client and a due date if you have them. Photos you pick from the library are copied into Cull Sheet. The originals are not changed.

CULL THE SET
Go through the photos one by one. Keep, Maybe and Cut sit at the bottom. Only Keep is numbered. The count at the top shows how many you still owe, or how many you have over the number you promised. Undo takes back the last mark.

PUT KEEPS IN ORDER
The numbers on the sheet follow the order you drag. Add a short caption if the recipient needs a name under the frame.

EXPORT THE SHEET

name: D1 Shortcuts
description:
D1 Shortcuts brings ten focused, on-device AI actions to Apple Shortcuts. Connect an instruction, text or a photo, then pass structured results to the next step in your workflow.

DECIDE AND CHOOSE
Ask yes/no questions, choose one or several options, and score a result against an ordered list of labels.

EXTRACT AND ESTIMATE
Extract text, numbers and dates from supplied text. Estimate a number within a range you define, with a median and uncertainty interval.

FIND OBJECTS
Find one or several objects in a photo. Use normalized box coordinates and confidence values in later shortcut steps.

LOCAL PROCESSING
After a one-time model download of about 2.24 GB, inference works offline on your iPhone using MLX GPU. No cloud inference account or API key is required. D1 returns results inside Shortcuts without opening its app during an action.

IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS AND LIMITS
Requires iOS 27 or later and hardware supporting background GPU execution. The system can decline GPU resources. There is no CPU, cloud or foreground fallback. The app guides you through model setup before your first shortcut.

Text, number and date extraction require text input. For a photo, use Apple Shortcuts' Extract Text from Image action first and pass its text to D1. Object-finding requires one still image. Requests exceeding the documented input limits are rejected rather than silently shortened.

Results, probabilities and found scores are model predictions, not guarantees. Review consequential outputs and test examples representative of your own workflow.

Built using LiquidAI's D1 model. This app is not presented as an official LiquidAI product.

name: Day Storage
description:
ToDoは、ToDoのまま。やる作業は、時間で積み上げる。

Day Storage は、「何を達成するか」と「今日なにをやるか」を分けて持てる、作業の積み上げ帳です。実験や調査の結果しだいで次の作業が変わる、研究者のような働き方のために作りました。

ToDoリストに「論文を書く」と書いても、今日どの作業に何時間使うかは決まりません。カレンダーに予定を入れても、実際にかかった時間は残りません。Day Storage は、ToDoと作業と時間を別々に持ち、あとから自由に紐づけます。

【3つに分けて、あとから紐づける】
・ToDo：達成すべきこと。期限やピン留めをつけて並べ、達成したら自分でチェックします。
・作業：実際に手を動かすこと。カテゴリの色で見分けられ、1つのToDoに複数の作業をぶら下げられます。
・ブロック：作業をした時間。1つのブロックが「予定」と「実績」の両方を持ち、予定のない飛び込みの作業も記録できます。
ToDoと作業の紐づけは、あとから何度でも付け替えられます。

【週表示：1週間の作業を色で積み上げる】
作業は時刻ではなく「その日に何時間使ったか」で積み上がります。7日分を並べれば、どこに時間を使ったかが色で分かります。下には未完了のToDoが並びます。

【日表示：予定と実績の差がひと目で分かる】
予定は点線、実績は塗り。予定より長引いた作業も、早く終わった作業も、その差がそのまま形に残ります。同じ時間に並行していた作業は横に並べられ、その日に残っている余白の時間も表示されます。

【振り返り：作業時間と体調を並べて見る】
1週間ぶんの予定と実績、カテゴリごとの作業時間をグラフで表示します。疲労・気分・体調を1日1回、5段階で残しておけば、同じ画面に並びます。予定はあるのに実績が未記録の日も分かります。

【ウィジェット：今日やることをホーム画面に】
ToDoごとに、その日の作業と時間をまとめて表示します。小・中サイズは今日の分、大サイズは今日から1週間分を確認できます。

【iPhone・iPad・Mac で同じ記録を】
iCloud で同期するので、外ではiPhone、机ではMacやiPadと、手元の端末で続きを記録できます。iPadではToDoの一覧を横に置いたまま選んだ日を広く表示、Macではマウスで操作できる週表示とツールバーを使えます。

【1日の使い方】
1. 思いついたら、タイトルとカテゴリだけで作業やToDoを登録
2. 前日や朝に、作業を日ごとに置く
3. 終わったら、かかった時間を記録
4. 夜に振り返り、結果に合わせて次の作業を置き直す
タイマーで計る必要はありません。記録の粒度は自由で、仕事だけでも、生活まで含めても使えます。

【アカウント登録なし。記録はあなたの手元に】
登録やログインは不要です。記録は端末の中と、ご自身の iCloud にだけ保存されます。開発者のサーバーはなく、広告や行動の追跡もありません。iCloud 同期は設定でオフにでき、その場合は端末の中だけに保存します。

name: Daycue: Widget Cues

Write a cue for each part of your day: a morning intention, a focus line for work, a wind-down note for the evening. Choose the days and the time window, and the widget shows the right one.

KEEP IT FRESH
• Give a cue several lines and the widget shows a different one each day or each hour

WIDGETS YOUR WAY
• Small and medium Home Screen widgets, plus Lock Screen widgets
• Keep one cue on a widget all day, or let it follow your schedule
