Good to know: iOS decides exactly when widgets refresh, so a change can appear a little after the time you set. Daycue is a visual cue, not an alarm, and does not send notifications.

name: Daylit: A Planner That Learns
description:
Tell Daylit what matters. It helps you figure out the plan, so you can focus on doing the work. 

CAPTURE IN YOUR OWN WORDS
Type or say it the way you'd tell a friend: "Finish the proposal by Friday, about two hours." Daylit reads the deadline, the length, and the reminder, and shows you how it read them before anything is saved.

A REALISTIC PLAN, NOT A LONGER LIST
Daylit proposes when work could happen, around your calendar, working hours, and focus time. Nothing moves until you tap Apply, and you can undo it.

WHEN THE DAY CHANGES
A meeting runs long or a session slips? Today shows what changed and a new suggestion. Keep your schedule or take the new one. It's your call.

SAY HOW THE DAY WENT
"Finished the report, skipped the gym, spent half an hour on Spanish." Daylit matches it to your plan, shows every change before applying it, and never treats silence as skipped. Over time it learns when things tend to happen and how long they take, shows its evidence, and asks before changing how you plan. See and reset everything in What Daylit knows.

GOALS THAT MOVE
Break a goal into milestones and first steps, and give it a weekly rhythm. Start from everyday starters (exercise, reading, a work project) or your own.

A CALM WEEKLY LOOK
Insights shows what moved and what slipped, built only from what you did. No streaks, no scores.

EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
The Lightline shows your day at a glance. Widgets, Live Activities, Siri and Shortcuts, Apple Watch, iPad, and Mac.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
With Apple Intelligence, understanding and planning happen on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac. Your data stays on your device and in your private iCloud. No ads, no tracking. What Daylit learns stays on your devices and syncs only through your private iCloud. Everything works on any supported device; with Apple Intelligence, Daylit also understands longer, looser sentences and writes your weekly story.

Made for everyone: VoiceOver, Voice Control, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, and Assistive Access. Available in 9 languages.

DAYLIT PREMIUM
Capture, Today, goals, the Planner, and lists are free. Premium adds unlimited planning proposals, goal coaching, the weekly review, and deeper insights. Try planning, goal coaching, and the weekly review for free first. Subscriptions are monthly or yearly, and the yearly plan has a free week. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage them in your Apple Account settings. One day review a day is free; Premium adds unlimited reviews and hands-free review.

name: Dead Boulevard: Horde Defense
description:
Command a tactical survivor squad down the infected highway in Dead Boulevard — a 3D squad-based action & horde defense game built with real-time formation tactics, custom color grading, and four distinct atmospheric combat zones.

KEY FEATURES:
• Real-Time Squad Formations (Wedge, Phalanx, Skirmish): Switch formations on the fly during combat. Wedge focuses forward firepower (+12% damage, tight spread), Phalanx creates a heavily armored shield wall (-22% incoming hazard damage), and Skirmish widens your flanking arc (+10% movement speed & wide-angle fire).
• Active Doctrines & EMP Overdrive: Trigger your recharging Overdrive ability to unleash an electromagnetic shockwave that slows incoming infected, boosts squad fire rate by +35%, and turns the tide against elite bosses.
• 4 Hand-Crafted 3D Biomes: Battle through City Highway (urban quarantine blocks & streetlamps), Deadwood Forest (dense pine woodland & timber), Rust Canyon (arid desert mesas & rocky outcrops), and Arctic Outpost (frozen research structures & ice spires).

• 100% Offline & Privacy-First: Play anywhere with zero ads, zero paywalls, and no account required.

name: Decidora
description:
Big decisions deserve more than a gut feeling and a pros and cons list. Decidora turns a difficult choice into something you can see.

BUILD A DECISION
• Start from a template or a blank page
• Add every alternative, with costs, benefits, drawbacks and custom details
• Define the criteria that matter and how much each one counts
• Stop any time and pick up where you left off

SEE HOW IT ADDS UP
• Score each option from 1 to 10 or 1 to 5
• Weighted scores out of 100, calculated on your iPhone and shown step by step
• Side-by-side comparison, rankings and charts
• Works offline

UNDERSTAND THE RISKS
• Rate probability and impact on a visual risk matrix
• Record mitigation plans
• Track short-term, long-term, financial, personal and custom impacts

TEST WHAT-IFS
• Change a weight, score, cost or risk and watch the ranking respond
• Your real data stays exactly as it is

GET AN AI SECOND OPINION
• Analysis of trade-offs, blind spots and missing criteria
• A 15-part decision report, exportable as a PDF
• Follow-up questions about your specific decision
AI runs only when you ask and shows what will be sent. It never changes your scores. AI output is decision support: it can be wrong, doesn't guarantee any outcome, and isn't financial, legal or medical advice.

STAY ON TRACK
• Deadlines, milestones and optional reminders
• A history of completed decisions and reports

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your decisions stay on your iPhone

name: DeciScope: Decision Matrix
description:
Make high-stakes decisions with mathematical clarity and cognitive rigor.

DeciScope is a sovereign strategic decision laboratory designed for founders, executives, engineers, and independent thinkers who refuse to rely on gut feelings alone. Built on proven mental models from decision science, Bayesian probability, and risk analysis, DeciScope helps you eliminate blind spots and calculate true expected utility before committing irreversible resources.

FIVE COMPREHENSIVE STRATEGIC MODULES:

1. DECISION FORGE
- Dynamic Bayesian Probability Slider: Adjust prior odds and observe real-time posterior confidence shifts.
- Multi-Criteria Scoring (MCDA): Weight competing paths across expected ROI, downside risk, and execution friction.
- Second-Order Ripple Horizons: Map out 30-day, 6-month, and multi-year systemic consequences before pulling the trigger.

2. COGNITIVE BIAS SHIELD
- 12-Vector Bias Audit: Systematically stress-test your thinking against Sunk Cost Fallacy, Confirmation Bias, Survivorship Bias, Anchoring, and Planning Fallacy.
- Devil's Advocate Counter-Inquiries: Confront direct questions engineered to expose flawed assumptions.
- Heuristic Antidote Rules: Implement battle-tested cognitive guardrails.

3. FAILURE PRE-MORTEM (Gary Klein Method)
- Fast-Forward Catastrophe Simulation: Assume total ruin in advance to unearth lethal vulnerabilities before they manifest.
- 4-Quadrant Failure Vectors: Categorize vulnerabilities by Execution Collapse, Flawed Premises, and Systemic Black Swans.
- Objective Circuit Breakers: Pre-commit to clear, measurable metrics that trigger strategic pauses without emotional friction.

4. DECISION LEDGER & BRIER CALIBRATION
- Empirical Accuracy Ledger: Review historical predictions side-by-side with actual real-world outcomes.
- Brier Score Calibration: Track your mathematical forecasting error over time and systematically improve calibration.
- Multi-Factor Filtering: Organize decisions across Venture, Tech Architecture, Career, Strategy, and Life Priority.

5. ANALYTICS & STUDIO
- Rich Vector Visualizations: Handcrafted charts showing accuracy trajectories, bias detection frequency, and risk appetite distribution.
- Sovereign Data Export: Export your complete decision portfolio as a structured JSON file at any time.
- Sovereign On-Device Execution: All mathematical evaluations, Bayesian updates, and local matrix files remain strictly within your device boundary.

Upgrade your decision hygiene with DeciScope. Think in probabilities, anticipate failure vectors, and master the art of disciplined execution.

name: Deckwren: Kings in the Corner
description:
Kings in the Corner is a traditional card game for two to four players, and this is Deckwren's version of it, with our own cards, rules text and computer opponents. Deckwren is not affiliated with or endorsed by Goliath, which sells a Kings in the Corner board game.

HOW DECKWREN'S KINGS IN THE CORNER IS DIFFERENT
• The computer players see only their own cards, as you see only yours. They never peek at your hand.
• After every hand, Show the hands lists how each card was dealt, so you can check the deal for yourself, and Play this deal again gives you the same cards from the next seat.
• The computer plays one move at a time, at the speed you choose (slow, normal or fast), and a line of words says what it just did.
• Your house rules: draw at the start of your turn instead of the end, play kings to the corners at once, and play one hand or to 25 or 50 points.

Play against one, two or three computer players. Lay your cards down the four piles beside the deck in falling order and alternating colors, put each king in a corner, and move a whole pile to open up a space. The first player to empty their hand wins the hand.

Pick your opponent: Easy plays the first card that fits and is the place to start, Normal plans its turn and moves whole piles, and Hard thinks a few moves ahead.

New to the game? Your first hand is a guided one that shows you each move, and How to play explains every rule in plain words.

Tap a card and then the place it goes, or drag it there. Undo your last move within your turn. Tap any pile to see every card in it; whose turn it is and who went first are always on the screen. Your game is saved after every move, so a phone call never costs you a hand, and Statistics keep your games, wins and streaks.

Easy on the eyes: big, clear cards on a calm, dark green table, with a Large cards setting and a Left-handed layout. Every card and pile has a label for VoiceOver, and the computer's moves are read out. Sounds and vibration can be turned off, and the cards stop sliding when Reduce Motion is on in your iPhone's settings.

It plays offline, with no account and no sign-in, and it collects nothing about you.

Kings in the Corner is also known as Kings Corner or King's Corners. Unlike the solitaire games that share the name, it is played against opponents: a quick card game to learn if you like rummy or crazy eights.

Questions, or a house rule you would like to see? Write to hello@deckwren.com.

• A weekly plan you can add to your tasks

• Ask any organizing question
AI only runs when you tap a button, you always see what will be sent, and photos are never sent.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

AI suggestions can be wrong. They're labelled AI-generated, and nothing changes until you choose to apply them.

name: DeepDarkShare: Secure P2P
description:
DeepDarkShare lets you send photos, videos, documents and other files directly from one phone to another over the Tor network. No account, no phone number, and no central file-sharing server - just private, and end-to-end encrypted transfers between devices.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Open Receive to generate a temporary QR code and connection details.
2. On the sending device, select your photos, videos or files and scan the QR code, paste the connection link or enter the short code.
3. Review the incoming transfer, check the sender and file details, then tap Accept.
4. Your files are transferred directly between devices and verified before being saved.

PRIVATE CONNECTIONS THROUGH TOR
• Temporary .onion addresses: Every receiving session generates a fresh Tor address that exists only while the Receive screen is active.
• End-to-end encryption: Tor encryption is combined with ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption using a key shared through the connection code.
• IP address protection: Your IP address is not exposed to the other participating device through the transfer connection.
• File integrity verification: File sizes and SHA-256 checksums are verified to detect incomplete or altered transfers.
• Live Tor relay map: Follow the route of your connection through Tor relays, displayed country by country.

YOU ARE ALWAYS IN CONTROL
• Manual acceptance: Review the sender's name, selected files and file sizes before accepting a transfer.
• Safety verification: A four-emoji safety code appears on both devices to help confirm that you are connected to the intended recipient.
• Protected invitations: Connections without the correct encryption key are rejected.
• One active transfer: Only one incoming transfer is handled at a time.

DESIGNED FOR EVERYDAY FILE SHARING
• Share almost anything: Send photos, videos, documents, music, archives and other file types.
• Original quality: Share photos and videos without intentionally reducing their quality.
• Bulk transfers: Select and send up to 500 files at once.
• No proximity requirement: Share across different Wi-Fi networks, mobile data connections and countries.
• Multiple connection methods: Connect using a QR code, a shareable link or a short code with typo detection.
• Local file access: Received files are available through the Files app.
• On-device history: Transfer history stays on your device and can be deleted whenever you want.
• Anonymous display name: Start with a randomly generated name, such as Violet Fox 27, or choose your own.
• Comfortable interface: Enjoy a minimal dark interface with an optional light theme.

PRIVACY BY DESIGN
DeepDarkShare is designed to minimise the information involved in sharing files.
• No accounts, registration or sign-in.
• No central DeepDarkShare file-hosting server.
• No advertisements, tracking or analytics.
• No requirement to provide your phone number.
• No public file listings or open sharing feeds.
• No automatic acceptance of incoming transfers.
• Temporary connection addresses are discarded when the receiving session ends.
• Interrupted transfer data is cleaned up according to the app's transfer handling.

UNDERSTANDING TOR AND TRANSFER SPEED
Tor provides an additional layer of network privacy, but it is not designed for high-speed file transfers.
• Initial connections may take some time while Tor establishes its circuit.
• Transfer speeds depend on network conditions and the Tor relays involved. Speeds may be lower than conventional local-network sharing.
• Both devices must have DeepDarkShare installed and an active internet connection.
• An active receiving session is required to accept incoming transfers.


Use Tor responsibly and follow the laws applicable in your location. Tor is a trademark of The Tor Project, Inc. DeepDarkShare is not affiliated with or endorsed by The Tor Project.

name: DentalQC
description:
DentalQC is the companion app for dentalqc.com, the quality-check service for dental laboratories.

name: Desk Sneak: Classroom Stealth
description:

Free to play, with no ads, in-app purchases or account required. Play offline; progress stays on your device.

The classroom keeps its Turkish school identity in every language. This is a fictional game scenario.

name: DewMix
description:
Keep the formula, the batch and what happened next together.

DewMix is a private notebook for hands-on cream and lotion experiments. Work out HLB blends, keep each formula version, record your process and follow samples over time. Turn one batch’s observations into a clear question for the next.

• Work out your blend
View oil required HLB separately from emulsifier blend HLB. Enter grams or percentages, solve a two-emulsifier ratio, save calculation snapshots and turn them into formula records.

• Keep a history of your formulas
Build a material library with INCI names, reference values, lots, expiry dates and handling notes. Organize ingredients by phase and addition stage, save versions and compare changes.

• Record the making process
Save batch weights, process steps and temperature targets. Run parallel or sequential timers, enter measured temperatures and net weights, link material lots and keep process logs. Enable local reminders when needed.

• Follow samples as they age
Plan day 7, 14 and 30 checks or choose your own schedule. Give different containers and storage conditions their own records. Add photos, texture notes, layer-height measurements, measured pH and hot/cold cycle observations, then compare time points.

• Explore one change at a time
Design trials around HLB, emulsifier percentage, oil loading, mixing time or temperature. Save a question, repeat count and comparison criteria before making batches. Compare readings at the same planned age, record a review and link a follow-up round.

• Investigate what changed
Keep separation and emulsion-breakdown notes with pinned observations and photos. Record possible causes and connect the next trial. Organize material stock, equipment checks, filling plans and measured recovery alongside your notebook.

• Keep your records close
Core features work offline without an account. Export CSV tables and save or restore complete local backup folders with photos.

The app interface is in English. Available for iPhone and iPad with iOS 15.0 or later. Temperature, pH and other physical measurements are entered manually.

HLB calculations are theoretical references and do not guarantee emulsification. DewMix is for personal formula and experiment records. Observations do not establish preservation, microbial safety or skincare efficacy. It is not a commercial cosmetic manufacturing guide.

name: Dice & Dungeons: Roll & Fight
description:
Roll the dice and fight your way to the dragon.

Dice & Dungeons is a quick, tabletop-style adventure inspired by classic fantasy role-playing games. Roll a d6 to move across the dungeon board. Land on a monster and the fight is on: roll a d20 to hit, roll damage, and pray for a natural 20.

• Three heroes: the tough Warrior, the lucky Rogue and the explosive Mage
• Real tabletop dice rules: armour class, critical hits, saving throws
• Treasure, traps, healing fountains, a travelling merchant and random events
• Three floors, three bosses and an Ancient Dragon
• Every run earns soul shards for permanent upgrades
• Runs take 10 to 15 minutes, perfect for the bus or the sofa
• No ads. No energy. No pay-to-win. Plays fully offline.

name: Dictator
description:
用紙、筆和 iPad 練習學校默書。可輸入或貼上詞語表，亦可掃描工作紙，核對辨識結果後再儲存。支援廣東話、普通話及英文朗讀，可選擇一個或多個章節一同練習。

提供五種朗讀速度，包括「很慢」和「極慢」。可自行設定重讀次數和書寫時間，亦可在默書後快速重讀。完成後顯示答案，將較難的詞語標記起來再練習，或在田字格查看繁體中文字形。

可為每位學習者建立獨立的學習檔案、章節及練習清單。相片辨識及朗讀均在 iPad 上進行。需要時，可從田字格開啟網上筆順參考。

name: Diff Rally
description:
Remember the oil, the setup, and what happened on track. Diff Rally connects differential tuning, track observations, A/B comparisons, and workshop records for RC car enthusiasts.

BUILD YOUR SETUP HISTORY
Keep separate chassis files with drivetrain details, fitted differential positions, factory settings, and modifications. Save front, center, and rear oils alongside shocks, springs, anti-roll bars, and tires. Create numbered setup versions, inspect parameter changes, and duplicate a setup for your next idea.

CAPTURE GRIP AND SLIP
Record carpet, asphalt, grass, gravel, and tile surfaces with grip level, temperature, humidity, and repeatable track sections. Log front push, rear slide, center slip, and launch wheelspin with their triggers. Add handling ratings, driver notes, and local photos to preserve the context.

COMPARE A AND B
Choose two versions on the same chassis, write a hypothesis, and define controls, maneuvers, and a primary metric. Log repeated runs for each version, inspect matched evidence and exclusion reasons, then save your conclusion and next action. Keep a selected setup in the track playbook or create a linked follow-up experiment.

REVIEW YOUR LAPS
Use the manual stopwatch or enter recorded lap times. Flag laps affected by traffic, recovery, or timing errors and inspect which laps contribute to the statistics. Review run medians and consistency alongside the exact setup snapshot and driver feel.

KEEP PHYSICAL OIL RECIPES
Record two to six source oils, measured input volumes, volume fractions, transfer loss, and a bottle identifier. Saving a batch records ingredient consumption and adds the prepared oil to inventory. Track brand, grade, viscosity scale, remaining stock, and the oil source used at each differential position.

TAKE REBUILDS FROM BENCH TO RECORD
Save work orders across inspection, measurement, fill, and verification. Record shim stacks, target and measured endplay, gear wear, seal condition, and actual fill amounts. Completed rebuilds link to service history. Review in-app reminders based on recorded running time and service dates.

PLAN THE NEXT TRACK VISIT
Six field routines cover corner entry, powered exit, launches, linked transitions, coasting and braking, and mixed grip. Revisit completed observations, explore the surface-by-grip matrix, and search your own records by chassis, oil grade, or slip issue.

BRING YOUR NOTES TO THE PIT BENCH
Create English setup-card, bottle-recipe, and rebuild PDFs. Export module data as CSV or save a full backup with records and photos for later restoration. Add custom text fields for the measurements and details you follow.

name: Dilverse
seller_name: DILVERSE EGITIM DANISMANLIK YAYINCILIK HIZMETLERI SANAYI VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Dilverse is the official app for students of Dilverse Language Schools. Everything you need to prepare for class, book your lessons and improve your English a little every day is in your pocket.

MY LESSONS
• Pre-class: a short interactive warm-up before each lesson, with listening, reading, video, vocabulary, grammar and speaking practice.
• Pronunciation: say the sentence and AI scores your pronunciation.
• Main lesson and post-class materials in one place.
• Questions you get wrong come back smartly until you learn them.

BOOK A LESSON
• See open lesson times, book or cancel.
• Tell your coach which days and hours you are free, so lessons are planned around you.
• Get notifications for class reminders and changes.

ONLINE LESSONS
• Join your online lessons with one tap: video, audio, screen sharing, a shared whiteboard and lesson slides that follow your teacher.

PRACTICE
• Daily review: short questions from your last lessons, done in two minutes.
• Vocabulary builder: review the words from your lessons regularly.
• My mistakes: fix your errors one by one.

SPEAKING AND FEEDBACK
• Send short speaking recordings and see your teacher's stars and comments in the app.

MOTIVATION
• XP, daily streaks, a weekly league and quest chests keep you studying a little every day.

PROFILE
• See your contract, payment plan and progress.
• Manage your privacy settings and request deletion of your account if you wish.

A Dilverse student account is required. Your account is created by the school when you enrol. More information: dilverse.tr

name: Dingus by Tamaki
description:
Dingus is a climbing card game for four to eight players. Empty your hand first and you become President. Empty it last and you are the Dingus.

Lead one to four cards of the same rank. Follow with the same number at an equal or higher rank, or pass. Match the pile and the next player is skipped. Play 2s to clear the pile and lead again.

Play on this device with bots in the empty seats, or host a room and send a six-character code to friends. Race to 15, 25, or 40 points, play 7, 11, or 15 rounds, or keep going until the snacks run out.

No accounts. No ads. No in-app purchases. Local play stays on your device.

name: Dinner Regulars: Meal Rotation
description:
Dinner Regulars is a meal rotation for the dinners your household actually makes. Add your regulars by name, and every dinner shows how long ago you had it, so tonight's answer is one tap away.

Not a recipe app. No ingredients to import and no shopping lists to work through. Just your house menu and a memory of when you last had each dinner.

WHAT IT DOES
• Add a dinner by typing its name. Effort and how often you like it come prefilled.
• Start fast: pick from common dinners like tacos, chili and curry, and set roughly when you last had them.
• See freshness at a glance: "Tacos · 16 days", with a bar that fills as a dinner comes due.
• Tonight's pick: the dinner you haven't had for the longest time. Tap Another idea for a different one.
• Log in one tap: We had this tonight. Out or leftovers counts too.
• Catch up missed nights: planned dinners from the last week wait in one card until you confirm, change or skip them.
• Draft my week: fills open nights from the dinners you haven't had in a while, without repeats until every dinner has had a turn.
• Busy nights: mark the weekdays when only quick dinners will do.
• Home-screen widget: tonight's dinner every day of the week without opening the app.
• Share this week: send the week's dinners as plain text to whoever cooks.
• Optional weekly reminder to plan the week, at the day and time you choose.
• Backup to a file whenever you like.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. Your house menu and history stay on your phone.

Made by Kiwi Lab.

name: dish. Recipe Vault
description:
Your saved recipe videos deserve better than a forgotten folder.

dish. turns public cooking videos into practical recipes you can actually use. Import a link from TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube, then review the extracted ingredients, steps, timing, servings, and tags before saving.

SAVE FROM THE SHARE SHEET
Choose "Save to dish." from a supported app's Share sheet. The link goes straight into your recipe vault, ready to review the next time you open the app.

FIND RECIPES FAST
Search by ingredient, dish name, or everyday language like "quick high-protein dinner." Filter with clear tags for meal, time, diet, flavor, cuisine, macros, and cooking method.

COOK FROM A REAL RECIPE
Use structured ingredients and step-by-step instructions instead of replaying a video at the stove. Recipes you've opened stay available for offline reading.

STAY IN CONTROL
Keep recipes private, share individual recipes or collections when you choose, export your recipes, or delete your account directly in Settings.

This App Store edition includes five automated imports and has no in-app purchases. Recipe extraction is automated, so always check ingredients, allergens, temperatures, and food-safety instructions before cooking.

name: Diva Magic
description:
Diva Magic – وجهتكِ لمنتجات التجميل والعناية الفاخرة.

• منتجات أصلية مختارة بعناية من وكلاء ومصادر موثوقة
• أقسام متنوعة: العناية بالبشرة والجسم والشعر، المكياج، الشعر المستعار، الصحة والرشاقة
• دفع آمن بالبطاقة وتمارا، والتقسيط مع تابي
• تتبع طلباتكِ خطوة بخطوة
• برنامج نقاط وعضوية مع كوبونات وهدايا حصرية
• إمكانية إرسال طلبكِ كهدية مع بطاقة أنيقة
• واجهة بالعربية والإنجليزية وعملات متعددة

حمّلي التطبيق واكتشفي سحر الجمال مع Diva Magic.

name: Divine Drive Showroom
description:
Divine Drive Showroom is private company software. It is the mobile companion to the showroom management system (ERP) used internally by Divine Drive Automobiles Pvt. Ltd., a pre-owned car dealership in Kerala, India. It is not a consumer app: only the company's staff and business partners can sign in, using accounts issued by the company's administrator. There is no public sign-up.

With the app, showroom staff can:
- See the day's dashboard: stock, bookings, sales, hot leads and follow-ups due
- Browse and search inventory, view vehicle details and add photos
- Manage leads: call or WhatsApp customers, log activity, move stages and schedule test drives
- Record bookings and new sales with a live tax quote, and record payments
- Schedule deliveries and view invoices and handover documents
- Follow workshop jobs, customers, P&L and investor summaries, depending on their role
- Open every other module of the company's ERP, with the same menu and permissions as the web system

What each person can see and do is controlled by their role in the company's system. All data stays on the company's own server.

Software developed and maintained for Divine Drive Automobiles by Abrar Future Tech LLP.

name: Documenta – Word Processor
description:
Documenta brings a real word processor to iPhone and iPad: open, edit and save the Word, OpenDocument and RTF documents you receive, on paginated pages that look like paper.

YOUR FORMATS, NO CONVERSION
• Word documents (.docx), OpenDocument (.odt), RTF and plain text; older .doc files open as a new Word document.
• Styles, lists, tables, images, notes, headers, fields, comments and tracked changes all stay in place.
• Export to PDF, Word, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, web page, Markdown and plain text; share with AirDrop, Mail or Files, and print with the system panel.

GET STARTED RIGHT AWAY
• Ten ready-made templates: letter, report, thesis, notes, minutes, manuscript, résumé, quote, self-declaration or a blank page.
• New documents in the Documenta folder in iCloud Drive or on your device, as Word, OpenDocument or RTF, with the paper, margins and font you choose; open the rest from the Files app.

PAGES OR FREE-FLOWING TEXT
• Real pages with margins that you pinch to zoom, or pageless text as wide as the screen, handy on a phone.
• A4, Letter and other paper sizes, orientation, margins and up to three columns.
• Page and section breaks; your documents' headers, footers, notes and watermarks show on the page.
• A light page, a dark page for the evening, or one that follows the system; measurements in inches, centimeters or points.

ON IPAD, LIKE A COMPUTER
• Heading outline on the left, pages in the middle, inspector on the right.
• Menu bar and keyboard shortcuts with a keyboard.
• Apple Pencil: handwrite into the text with Scribble and add pencil drawings.

SCAN AND RECOGNIZE
• Scan paper sheets with the camera: the text becomes editable text, or the pages go in as images.
• Grab the text from a photo in your library.

BUILT FOR LONG DOCUMENTS
• Numbered headings, a table of contents and a table of figures.
• Numbered captions, cross-references, footnotes and endnotes, bookmarks and links.
• Comments with replies and track changes like in Word: record your edits, accept or reject everyone else's.

TABLES AND OBJECTS
• Tables with merged cells, borders and shading, ready-made styles, a header row repeated on every page and sortable rows.
• Text boxes, shapes and images on the page with text wrapping around: move, rotate, group and align them.

COMPLETE FORMATTING
• A bar above the keyboard with style, bold, italic, underline, alignment and lists.
• Paragraph and character styles, color and highlight, superscript and subscript, small caps.
• Line spacing, paragraph spacing, indents, tab stops with dot leaders, paragraph borders and shading, drop caps.
• Find and replace, by formatting too and with regular expressions.
• Spell checking in the language of each part of the text, a personal dictionary, text replacements and links as you type, and read aloud in the voice you prefer.
• Words, characters, reading time, a word goal and a readability score.

WITH YOUR MAC, IN PRIVATE
• With iCloud Drive and Handoff, pick up on your Mac the document you're writing, and back again.
• No account and no data collected: your documents stay on your device or in your iCloud Drive.
• VoiceOver, dark mode, and an interface in English and Italian.

name: DoorReady: Packing Checklist
description:
Leave with a clearer head. DoorReady turns your everyday routines into reusable packing checklists, so you can check what matters before leaving and before returning.
Combine routines for your day, pack your items, and perform a final door check. Keep a history of completed checks and add forgotten items back to a routine for next time.
• Create and edit routines with quantities, locations and notes.
• Combine routines into a single checklist.
• Follow packing, door-check and return-check stages.
• Review history and export a PDF check record.
• Export and import JSON backups.
• Use light or dark appearance.
Your routines stay on your device. No account, advertising, tracking SDKs or in-app purchases. DoorReady is a manual checklist, not an automatic item detector.

name: Doorward: ADHD Visual Timer
description:
Doorward is a visual timer for ADHD mornings: it plans your routine back from the time you need to leave, then counts down every step.

Make a routine like Morning: leave at 8:30, then Shower 10 min, Breakfast 15, Make bed 5 (optional), Dress 8. Doorward tells you to start by 7:52. Start it, and each step gets its own countdown ring.

While you go, a drift meter compares where you are with where you need to be: "On track", "4 min behind", "1 min ahead", and the time you will actually be out the door. When you fall behind, it offers a fix: skip the optional steps, or shrink the rest to fit. Your saved routine never changes unless you change it.

A step-end notification arrives when a step's time is up, so you can put the phone down.

It suits anyone who loses track of time getting ready.

Free, with no limits and no ads:
- Unlimited routines and steps
- Leave-by plan with a start-by time
- A countdown for every step
- Step notifications
- Drift meter and fixes in the app
- Your finished runs, with when you left
- Backup to a file and restore
- Works offline. No account. Nothing leaves your phone.

name: DotCave
description:
Tap to bounce through the cave. One hit, and it's over.

Before each stage, lines are plotted and rocks are painted. The wait is part of the game.

Change how it draws in the settings. No ads.

name: dotstream
description:
Most radio apps hand you sixty thousand stations and a search bar. dotstream hands you a few good ones.

Pick a band (Jazz, Ambient, Electronic, Indie, and more) and you get a small set of hand-picked live stations from around the world. Tap a preset. When you've had enough, tap another. That's the whole app.

No personalization. No endless scroll. No feed deciding what you hear next. Just live radio, made by people, playing right now in a city that isn't yours.

Tune in, don't browse.
A handful of presets per band, not a catalogue to dig through. The curation is the point: the first few seconds of a band should feel like arriving somewhere.

Switching is the gesture.
Punch between stations by hand, the way you'd hit the preset buttons in a car when an ad comes on. A short burst of static, a moment of retuning, and you're somewhere new.

Built to be looked at once.
A dot-matrix display shows the station, where it's broadcasting, and its local time. Nothing else. The static is the loading screen. The whole thing fits on one face.

A little foreign, on purpose.
Hear breakfast radio in Tokyo at midnight, or a Vienna indie station on your morning commute. Not translated, not tailored — just live, and slightly elsewhere.

Save your favourites to the MY band. Hit RANDOM to let it throw you anywhere. Then put your phone down and listen.

dotstream is small on purpose.

name: Douay Rheims Swipe
description: Read the Douay-Rheims Bible one verse at a time with a simple swipe. Jump to any passage by typing a reference like "John 3:16" or "Psalm 23", or search by word. Bookmark favorite verses, adjust the text size, and pick up right where you left off. No ads, no account, and no data collected.

name: Draift
description:
Draift opens to a note, ready for whatever is on your mind. Capture first, then find and connect your thoughts.

Write your way
• Use Markdown headings, bullets, numbered lists, quotes and code.
• Tap checklist boxes to complete them, highlight text and add strikethrough.
• Switch to the visual Format Keyboard for one-tap styling, lists, links and indentation.
• Keep typing with smart list continuation, contextual headings and optional haptic feedback.
• Notes save on your device automatically, with a visible warning if a save fails.

Private writing assistance
• Enable AI Grammar Check for suggestions you can apply or ignore.
• Enable AI Sentence Completion for subtle inline suggestions; tap, swipe right or press Tab to accept.
• Writing assistance runs on your device. Apple's on-device language model enhances suggestions when available; basic local suggestions remain available without it.
• Both writing-assistance switches are off by default. Model availability depends on your device, language and Apple Intelligence settings.

Speak or scan
• Tap the waveform to dictate into a note, with continuous input across pauses and support for spoken corrections.
• Choose a language or let Auto compare your selected languages.
• Keep verbatim transcription or use local cleanup and punctuation.
• Speech requires on-device support; unavailable languages never fall back to server recognition.
• Scan printed text with the camera on supported devices.

Connect and organize
• Type [[ to link notes. Add tags, find backlinks and explore Related Notes.
• Search notes and tags, or pin what matters.
• AI Sort suggests tags and connections without rewriting your notes.
• Inspect the last sort summary and undo it. Nightly Sort runs when iOS allows it; its displayed schedule is an estimate.

Start comfortably
• Explore an interactive welcome walkthrough and optionally load ten linked sample notes.
• Start with an empty Inbox instead, or remove sample notes later from Settings without deleting your own notes.
• Choose from ten interface tones and ten app icons, with light and dark appearance and adaptive iPhone/iPad layouts.

Your notes, your choice
• Capture works offline with no Draift account, advertising, analytics or tracking.
• Optionally sync through your private iCloud Drive on devices using the same Apple Account.
• Import and export Markdown, recover Recently Deleted notes and restore earlier versions.
• Lock notes with device authentication inside Draift. This lock does not separately encrypt exported or synced files.

Draift 1.2 is free, with no active in-app purchases. iCloud delivery requires iCloud Drive and an internet connection; local editing remains available offline.

name: DrawPulse
description:
DrawPulse shows which numbers have come up most in New York Quick Draw, Take 5 and NY Lotto, using results published by New York State.

CHOOSE HOW MANY NUMBERS
Pick how many numbers you play, and DrawPulse lists the ones drawn most often, with their counts.

CHOOSE HOW FAR BACK TO LOOK
Slide from the latest draw back to a full year, or use the plus and minus buttons to move 5 draws at a time. For Quick Draw, a year is about 128,000 draws.

HOW HOT OR COLD?
Type or tap any number or combination to see how often it came up and how that compares with what chance alone would produce over the same draws.

SEE EVERY NUMBER
A color-coded board shows at a glance which numbers came up more or less often.

GOOD TO KNOW
DrawPulse shows past results, not predictions. Every draw is random, so it can't improve your odds of winning. New York usually posts results overnight, so the latest draws may not appear yet. Always confirm results with the official New York Lottery.

DrawPulse is independent and isn't affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by the New York Lottery or the New York State Gaming Commission. It doesn't sell tickets or take bets. You must be of legal age to play.

Gambling causing problems? In New York, call 1-877-8-HOPENY (467369) or text HOPENY (467369) for free, confidential help.

name: Dreammaker023's Dream Scape
description:
Twenty-three worlds, and no map of how deep it goes.

Dream Scape is somewhere to disappear to at two in the morning — a deck of twenty-three cards that each open onto somewhere else. Paint a nebula. Bowl a frame. Cut your own photograph into four hundred pieces. Write down a dream and watch it become a star.

Nothing here asks you to sign in. Nothing here needs a connection. It is yours, on phone and tablet, in airplane mode, for good.

— THE CAMERA —
Fifty-six looks with a darkroom bench behind them: Neon Nights, 1985, Deep Noir, Silver Gelatin, Laserdisc, Phosphor, Amber Tube. Grade any photograph you own, dial the strength to taste, and when you like what you see, cut it into a jigsaw.

— THE SOUND ENGINE —
One hundred and thirty-nine layers, created in real time on your phone rather than played back from a file, so no two nights sound alike. Rain and far-off thunder. Projector hum and tape hiss. Twenty binaural programmes beneath them, from deep theta to lucid dreaming. Layer them, mix them with your thumb, keep the ones that work — or open one of a hundred and twenty-three mixes already made, across twelve boards. All of it runs in airplane mode.

— THINGS TO SOLVE —
Dream Fragments — jigsaws cut from twenty-six visions, nine pieces up to four hundred. Or cut from your own work: any photograph you take, any painting you make, at any of those sizes.
Reverie — sudoku in six shapes, from the classic nine to irregular regions with no straight edges.
Dream Lattice — mahjong, 144 tiles, twenty layouts: the Turtle, the Orrery, the Observatory.
Dream Ciphers — crosswords that are properly hard, seventeen tiers of them, from Drift to Nightmare.
The Field — word searches adrift in deep space, across twenty-two themed fields.
The Slide and The Fold — sliding tiles, and mazes with no outside.

— THINGS TO MAKE —
Cosmic Paint — seventy-three brushes in seven families, pressure and tilt aware, from a plain pen to a supernova. Narrate a painting aloud while you work on it.
The Peg Light — a lamp behind a dark board, and coloured pegs to push into it.
The Furnace — Venetian glass, gathered and blown on the end of a pipe.
The Gallery — a room with walls, where everything you make hangs.

— THINGS TO KEEP —
The Dream Journal holds dreams, nightmares and inspiration, on your device and nowhere else.

The Dream Atlas turns each one into a star. When a symbol appears in three of your dreams, those stars draw themselves into a constellation and the Atlas gives it a name. A sky built out of your own nights, that nobody else could have.

Also inside: Cosmic Bowl with real hook physics over ten frames, The Still, Night Signs, Dream Echoes, the brass typewriter in The Writing Room, and a few things better found than listed.

NO ACCOUNT. NO ADS. NO SUBSCRIPTION. NO NETWORK.
100% offline. Everything you write, paint, photograph or record stays on your device. Dream Scape makes no connection of any kind, and works the same in airplane mode as it does anywhere else.

Phone and tablet.

name: Drippy - Drip Bag Coffee
description:
Drippy is a brewing guide made only for drip bag coffee, the single-serve filter bag that hangs on your cup.

Tear, hang, pour. Drippy takes care of the numbers: how much water, how many pours, how long to wait, and when your cup is done.

A RECIPE FOR THE BAG IN YOUR HAND
• Pick the drip bag you are brewing and where your hot water comes from: just boiled, a dispenser or a thermos.
• Drippy builds the recipe: a bloom, then the pours, with the total water and time worked out for you.
• Cooler water? The amounts stay the same. Drippy gives the coffee more time instead.
• Want a say in the taste? Switch to Complex and choose stronger, balanced, lighter or sweeter.
• Tips for pouring well without a gooseneck kettle.

POURING ASSIST
• One clear countdown for each step, with how much water to add and how long to keep pouring.
• A visual cue for every stage, so you can follow the coffee and not only the clock.
• Haptic taps on iPhone mark each new step and pace your pour.
• Leave the app mid-brew and a "Your cup is ready" notification tells you when to come back.

YOUR DRIP BAGS, COUNTED
• Add the bags you own in a few seconds.
• No grams on the packet? Enter the water it prints and Drippy estimates the dose.
• Your stock goes down by itself each time you finish a cup.
• See at a glance which bags are running low or nearing their best-before date.
• Search by name or tasting note.

A CALM LOOK AT YOUR CAFFEINE
• Every finished cup is logged for you.
• See an estimate of the caffeine still in your body, today's total against your daily limit, and roughly when the effect eases off.
• A weekly chart and a history of every cup.
• Set your own daily limit, or let Drippy suggest one from your body weight.

ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
• Follow the running brew in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen, with the step and its countdown.
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show the caffeine still in your body and when it fades.

APPLE HEALTH, IF YOU LIKE
• Turn it on and every cup you finish is saved to the Health app as dietary caffeine.
• Drippy only writes to Health; it never reads your health data. Delete a cup and it leaves Health too.

MADE TO FIT YOUR DAY
• An optional daily reminder to brew, with a Focus filter so you decide which Focus it can reach.
• A soft tone and a haptic tap at each new step, so your eyes can stay on the cup.
• English, Indonesian and Japanese.
• iPhone and iPad, light and dark appearance, and your text size settings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics. Everything you enter stays on your device, and Drippy works without an internet connection.

Caffeine figures are estimates based on typical drip bag doses. They are not medical advice; ask your doctor if you are pregnant, take medication or have a health condition.

Terms of Service: https://drippy-coffee.vercel.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://drippy-coffee.vercel.app/privacy

name: DriveRoad: California DMV Test
description:
Study for the California DMV Class C written knowledge test with a learning journey you can pick up whenever you have a few minutes.

DriveRoad includes 567 original practice exercises across 189 rule groups. Switch between English and Simplified Chinese, learn at your own pace, and return to the questions you missed.

KEEP YOUR PLACE
Learn in five-question lessons. Complete each lesson to unlock the next, replay completed lessons, and continue from your saved place. Daily check-in and course learning share progress; keep going without a daily question limit.

PRACTICE, THEN CHECK YOUR UNDERSTANDING
Explore eight topics, from traffic signs and right-of-way to parking and safe driving. Try 10-, 36-, or 46-question practice exams, then review your answers and explanations. Practice papers are learning tools, not official DMV exams.

BUILD A STUDY HABIT
Earn XP as you finish lessons, keep a check-in streak, and use the optional reminder that resets to 24 hours after your last app opening.

OFFLINE AND PRIVATE
Study without an account, advertising, or tracking. Your learning progress stays on your device. DriveRoad is free to use.

HELP IMPROVE A QUESTION
Report an issue beside any question. Reports stay on your device until you choose to email them to support@driveroad.net. The question ID and content version help us trace and correct the issue.

DriveRoad is an independent study aid and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the California DMV. Exercises are independently authored using referenced rules; they are not the official exam question pool. This bank does not cover every handbook detail or guarantee a passing result. Consult the current official California Driver's Handbook for authoritative guidance.

Privacy: https://driveroad.net/privacy/
Support: https://driveroad.net/support/

name: Dry Day Heroes
description:
Record your days. Grow a little team of heroes.

Dry Day Heroes combines an alcohol and dry-day journal with a small pixel-art RPG. Days recorded, declared dry days, skipped drinks, planning and reflection add to your four heroes’ strength for the week.

RECORD IN A MOMENT
• Log a usual drink with one tap
• Save your own drink volumes, ABV and mixed-drink recipes
• See calculated pure alcohol amounts and weekly charts
• Enter past days, correct actual volume or undo an entry
• See a hero’s response and the exact growth change after saving

FOUR HEROES, FOUR ROLES
Cucumber tackles. Matcha interrupts fire or strikes an armor opening. Clam blocks a flame completely. Bubbles heals, clears embers and forms a protective shield from unused healing. All four can join even in a week with no records. Try the 30-second practice, then defend the stall in Saturday or Sunday’s battle. Play manually or turn on automatic summoning.

EQUIPMENT THAT STAYS
Battle materials are cumulative and never spent. Unlock equipment and market displays through eight milestones up to 24 materials, with new hero looks and lines. After your first weekend victory, replay the optional Challenge on any day. Collect independent titles and track your fastest victory and highest stall HP.

AT YOUR OWN PACE
Personal targets are optional. Permanent equipment is earned through battle results. Your weekly hand is fixed when you begin that weekend’s first battle, so later journal corrections and newly unlocked equipment do not alter that hand.

Free, with no ads, in-app purchases or account. Journal and game progress stay on your device. Japanese and English are supported. The journal and game work offline; external support pages use an internet connection.

For adults who want to record and reflect. This app is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat a condition.

name: DTS Dive Planner
description:
DTS Dive Planner is a technical dive planner for open-circuit and closed-circuit rebreather (CCR) divers. This app is the free companion to your DTS account: sign in with the account you already have and your plans, gases and settings are with you on the boat, on the dive site and in the classroom.

An existing DTS account is required. The app signs in only and does not create accounts.

Plan the dive
- Decompression schedules on Bühlmann ZHL-16C with configurable gradient factors, ascent strategy, o2 tracking and gas switching techniques
- Open circuit and CCR as full dive modes, with easy setpoint and diluent selection.
- Multi-level and repetitive dives across a day or a trip
- Trimix, travel, stage and deco gases, with every gas switch shown on the schedule
- CCR bailout planned as its own schedule, from the depth you choose
- Max bottom time, lost-gas analysis and plans re-run deeper or shallower, longer or shorter
- Altitude and water type taken into every pressure figure

Know your gas
- Gas requirements per cylinder, turn pressures and min gas
- CNS and OTU oxygen exposure, with air breaks
- Gas density, END and MOD on every mix, and isobaric counterdiffusion (IBCD) screening on gas switches
- Warnings stated in words beside the figure they belong to

Gas tools
- Best Mix, Gas Check, Density and SCR calculators
- An enhanced Gas Mixer that works out blends and problem solves. Definable helium and 02 purity with the ability to account for custom nitrox and trimix banked gasses
- A Mix Library of your own working mixes, synced to your account. Set up your personal or agency's standards gasses.

Log and team
- A dive log with dive sites and maps
- Team plans: send a plan to your team, and each diver then approves against their own cylinder volumes and SAC rates.
- Print, save or share the plan sheet from your phone

Made for the water
- Works offline after your first sign-in
- Your dive log, plans and settings sync end-to-end encrypted, so we cannot read them
- Metric or imperial, in eight languages: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Russian, Indonesian and Japanese
- No ads and no tracking

Built and tested by technical divers at Black Water Tek.

Safety
DTS is a planning aid only and carries no guarantee. It is for divers trained in mixed-gas decompression by a recognised agency, and it is not a substitute for that training. A decompression model is based on an average, not your personal physiology. Cross-check every plan as per your training, follow your dive computer in the water, and plan within your certification. You dive it at your own risk.

name: DuaPass
description:
Tus entradas digitales seguras siempre contigo. Accede a eventos y festivales con código QR dinámico antifraude, transfiere tickets y vive la experiencia DuaPass.

Características principales:
• Entradas con QR Dinámico Antifraude: Tus códigos QR se actualizan automáticamente cada 30 segundos con validación criptográfica, protegiendo tu entrada contra capturas de pantalla, copias o falsificaciones.
• Funcionamiento Offline: Una vez cargadas tus entradas en la app, tu código QR dinámico sigue funcionando en la puerta del evento incluso si te quedas sin señal o datos móviles.
• Transferencia Segura de Entradas: Envía entradas a tus amigos de forma instantánea y segura directamente desde la aplicación.
• Conversión a QR Seguro: Si compraste una entrada con QR tradicional, puedes blindarla y convertirla en QR Dinámico con un solo toque.
• Cartelera de Eventos: Descubre los próximos eventos, fechas, recintos y disponibilidad en tiempo real.
• Mi Cuenta y Membresías VIP: Gestiona tu perfil, tu código QR de identificación personal, tus pedidos de merchandising/pickup, cupones de descuento y preferencias musicales.

name: Duck Club
description:
Log every hunt, share the ones you want, and keep your best spots to yourself.

Duck Club is the hunting log and community built for waterfowl hunters. Snap photos, count your bag by species, and build a season record that is all yours. Share with fellow hunters when you choose and keep private what should stay private.

LOG EVERY HUNT
Capture the morning with the in-app camera, then record your bag species by species. Mallards, teal, wood ducks, geese and more. Add a caption about the weather, the birds working, or your decoy spread, and every hunt is saved by date.

YOUR SPOTS STAY YOURS
Exact hunt locations are visible only to you. On the public map, shared hunts appear as generalized pins covering roughly a 15 km area, so the community sees where birds are moving without anyone finding your blind or your marsh.

PUBLIC OR PRIVATE, YOUR CALL
Mark any hunt private and it stays in your personal log. Make it public and it goes to the community feed for other hunters to see, like, and comment on.

A COMMUNITY OF HUNTERS
Browse the feed, trade stories, and celebrate limits with hunters across the country. Report and block tools help keep the community clean and respectful.

SEASON HISTORY AND STATS
See your season at a glance with totals by species and hunt counts, and filter by season and species to compare your years. Watch your record grow every time you head out.

HUNTER PROFILES
Set your avatar, show off your hunt history, and share your profile with friends.

SIGN IN YOUR WAY
Get started in seconds with Sign in with Apple or email.

Built for duck and waterfowl hunters.

name: Duo Theme
description:
Make a little world for your Lock Screen.

Mix original character stickers, ribbons, flowers, paper tape and textured backgrounds. Move, resize, rotate and layer each sticker, add your own words, then save a wallpaper image.

CREATE YOUR OWN COMPOSITION
• Start with a ready-made style or make it your own
• Combine bunny, teddy, kitty and decorative stickers
• Drag, pinch and rotate stickers
• Duplicate, reorder or delete layers, with undo and redo
• Choose a background and add text
• Save multiple themes on your device

PREVIEW AND SAVE
Preview closed and unfolded iPhone Duo compositions in light and dimmed modes. Export an image for the selected screen, then use the iOS share sheet to save or share it. Add a separate Lock Screen widget for your saved theme's symbol and message.

English and Korean are supported. No account is required.

SETUP AND DEVICE SUPPORT
Apply wallpapers and add widgets manually through iOS customization. Stickers are flattened into the wallpaper image; they are not live overlays on the system Lock Screen. Device frames and clock guides are preview elements and are not included in exported images. Check both displays when applying a wallpaper because iOS controls cropping and layout.

Always On Display requires a supported device and is controlled by iOS. Duo Theme does not keep a display permanently on or automatically install widgets.

Themes stay on your device and are shared with the app's widget through an App Group. No advertising or analytics SDKs are included.

name: DuoSnake Nitro
description:
Reinventing the legendary arcade classic with an electrifying dual-screen twist!

DuoSnake Nitro merges nostalgic retro-arcade snake mechanics with high-stakes puzzle strategy across two connected displays. Guide your cyber viper through the upper arena to hunt target emojis, dodge hazards, and cross the pulsating magnetic hinge into the lower docking bay to complete your win matrix.

Every move demands precision, lightning-fast reflexes, and tactical planning.

DUAL-SCREEN ARCADE EVOLUTION
- Top Screen (Hunt Arena): Pilot your snake, chomp objective emojis, dodge traps, and charge your core power.
- Bottom Screen (Docking Matrix): Cross the magnetic cyber hinge to drop emojis into designated Win Zones. Stack blocks, lock in points, and keep the lose zone empty!

5 EVOLVING WORLDS & 21 HANDCRAFTED LEVELS
Journey through 5 stunning visual themes with unique companion mascots:
1. Cyber Viper (Levels 1-5): Electric cyan neon grid and high-speed chases.
2. Neon Coral (Levels 6-10): Pink candy reef and juicy snack feasts.
3. Solar Dragon (Levels 11-15): Solar gold radiance and intense dual-core ceilings.
4. Cosmic Ghost (Levels 16-20): Deep bioluminescent void and phantom obstacles.
5. Crystal King (Level 21): The ultimate Diamond Ice Peak test featuring the Tri-Core matrix.

HIGHLIGHT FEATURES:
- Strategic Docking Mechanics: It is not just about surviving. Dock the right emojis into the right zones before time expires.
- Retro DMG-89 Vintage Skin: Switch between vibrant cyberpunk neon and 1989 monochrome handheld LCD nostalgia.
- Dynamic Visuals and Articulated Physics: Expressive snake animations, ravenous fangs, glowing particle trails, and tactile haptic feedback.
- Tactical Power-Ups: Snip your tail with precision scissors, activate speed boosts, and outsmart tricky hazard traps.
- Pure Arcade Experience: 100% offline play, silky-smooth 60/120 FPS performance, and intuitive touch controls designed for iPhone.

Can you conquer both screens and become the ultimate Cyber King?

Download DuoSnake Nitro today and experience the dual-screen arcade revolution!

name: Dust Bunny: Eat & Grow
description:
A tiny dust bunny under the sofa is getting hungry.

Eat anything smaller than you and dodge anything bigger. The more you eat, the bigger you get, the wider the view becomes, and that scary vacuum cleaner turns into a snack.

• 10 places to grow through
Under the sofa → living room → kitchen → backyard → neighborhood → downtown → riverside park → harbor city → continent → space.
Start with crumbs and hair, end with cars, skyscrapers, islands and finally the Earth. Sizes follow real-world scale, and a tape measure shows exactly how many centimeters or kilometers you are.

• Surprise events
Blackouts, rain showers, gusts of wind and golden dust time. Robot vacuums, blimps, typhoons and a space cleaner chase you, but grow big enough and you can swallow them too.

• Evolve your bunny
Baby → Sprout → Beanie → Crown → Cosmic dust.
Spend collected dust on speed, suction, head start and toughness, and pick a new fluff color.

No ads · No in-app purchases · Works offline · No data collected
All music and sound effects were made for this game.

name: Dutch – Card Game with Friends
description:
Dutch is the friendly card game you play around the table — now beautifully dealt on your phone.

Each player gets four face-down cards and peeks at two of them. On your turn, draw from the deck or the discard pile, swap the card with one of yours or discard it. Your goal: the lowest total. When you think you're ahead, call “Dutch!” — everyone plays one last turn, then all cards are revealed.

SIMPLE TO LEARN, HARD TO PUT DOWN
• Two quick peeks, then it's all memory and nerve
• The Queen lets you look at any card, the Jack blindly swaps two cards
• Red kings are worth zero, black kings are a trap
• Throw a matching card on the discard pile — if you dare

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Offline against the table, anytime, anywhere
• Online with friends: create a table and share a code or a link
• Or join a public table in one tap
• Friends can join or leave between rounds, up to 8 players
• 30-second turns keep the game flowing

A CARD ROOM IN YOUR POCKET
• Elegant hand-painted kings, queens and jacks
• Real card sounds, smooth 3D card animations
• Gentle guidance at every step, plus an optional memory aid
• Fully in English and French

Free, no ads, no gambling and no account: just pick a nickname and play.

name: DwellLedger: Home Inventory
description:
Keep a small record of the things you own—and keep it up to date. DwellLedger gives each household item a place, a quantity, and a simple history.

START WITH ONE ITEM
Record a name, room and category. Add an optional photo, purchase date, warranty end date and notes for model numbers, serial numbers or care instructions. Add rooms that match your home.

KEEP RECORDING
Open an item and tap Record a change. Save its current quantity with a dated note when you restock, use something up, lend it out or repair it. Quantity can be zero. Detail edits and changes remain in the item’s history.

FIND WHAT YOU NEED
Search names, rooms, categories and notes. Filter by room, used-up items, or warranties ending within 60 days. Recent updates appear first.

KEEP YOUR OWN BACKUP
Export a complete JSON backup with all items, photos, rooms and history to Files or a destination you choose. Restore it on another device when needed. Restore replaces the current inventory after confirmation.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account, ads, subscription, tracking or developer cloud service. The paid download includes all current features. Your inventory stays on your device unless you choose to export it. Device backups follow your Apple settings.

English and Simplified Chinese. A clearly labelled fictional sample inventory helps you explore the workflow. Selected photos are stored as optimized copies with a maximum edge of 1200 pixels. Warranty dates are for in-app reference; the app does not send system notifications.

name: Ear Light: Sound Alerts
description:
Ear Light turns the sounds around you into something you can see and feel. Made for deaf and hard-of-hearing people, and anyone who can't hear what's happening at home.

KNOWS 15 EVERYDAY SOUNDS
Smoke alarm · Siren · Doorbell · Knocking · Baby crying · Phone ringing · Alarm clock · Appliance beeps · Running water · Glass breaking · Shouting · Dog barking · Cat meowing · Car horn · Someone talking

ALERTS YOU CAN'T MISS
• The whole screen flashes in a colour for that sound, with a big icon and words
• Strong vibration pattern — longer for urgent sounds
• Optional torch flashing
• VoiceOver announcement

URGENT SOUNDS FIRST
Smoke alarms, sirens, breaking glass and shouting alert more readily and for longer.

TUNE IT TO YOUR HOME
• Choose which sounds to watch for
• Adjust sensitivity between Precise and Sensitive
• See a history of what was heard and when

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Sound is analysed on your device with Apple's built-in sound recognition. Nothing is recorded, stored or sent. No ads, no account.

Ear Light listens while it is open on screen (you can keep the screen on). It is an aid and does not replace smoke alarms or other safety devices.

name: Easy Read: Dyslexia Reader
description:
Easy Read makes letters, labels and notices comfortable to read for people with dyslexia, low vision or reading difficulties.

GET THE TEXT
• Snap a page with the camera, pick a photo, or paste text
• Text recognition runs on your device

READ YOUR WAY
• Adjust text size, line spacing and letter spacing
• Rounded font option
• Cream, white, blue, green or dark backgrounds
• Reading ruler: highlight one line and dim the rest

LISTEN
• Read aloud with the current word highlighted
• Adjust the reading speed, pause and resume

Your documents stay on your device. No ads, no sign-in.

name: EasyKeys: Live Keys & Pads
description:
EasyKeys turns your keyboard into a stage rig. Play your own pianos, pads and ambient drones, layered and split, with the lowest delay your iPhone, iPad or Mac can give.

EVERY SONG, ITS OWN SOUND
Each song keeps its layers: a piano, a pad, a lead, an arp and a drone, each with its own level, tone and effects. Step to the next song and every sound changes with it.

A DRONE THAT FOLLOWS THE KEY
Set the drone once for the whole setlist. It moves to each song's key on its own, major, minor or neutral.

CHORDS THAT KEEP TIME
Charts with chords over the lyrics move with the click, bar by bar. Jump to any section, change the key, and make the text bigger for the stage.

YOUR SOUNDS, OR OURS
Import SFZ, SF2 and WAV instruments, or download sounds from the free EasyKeys Library. Your library and setlists follow you through iCloud to your other devices.

BUILT FOR THE STAGE
• A click with its own output, so it can go to your in-ears and stay out of the room
• Send each sound to outputs 1–2 or 3–4 of your audio interface
• MIDI keyboards over USB or Bluetooth, with a sustain pedal and a mod wheel
• Learn any pedal or button to step through the setlist
• Loops: record a few bars from your keyboard and play over them
• No account, no ads, no tracking

Connect a Sunday Chords account to open its setlists and lead your band's charts from EasyKeys.

name: Ecosmart
description:
Ecosmart Price puts your electricity price where you'll actually see it.

If you're on a wholesale-priced plan, the price changes every half-hour. Ecosmart Price shows you what it is right now, where it's heading, and when it'll be cheapest — so you can run the dishwasher, charge the car or heat the water when power costs the least.

PRICE NOW
• The live 5-minute wholesale price for your connection
• Low, typical or high at a glance, using the same bands as your Ecosmart account
• What you'll actually pay per kWh once lines, metering, levies, the retailer fee and GST are added — set from your own bill

PLAN AHEAD
• 48-hour price forecast with average and peak for the next 24 hours
• The cheapest two hours in the forecast, with a countdown
• The last 24 hours of prices, so you can see the pattern
• Drag across the chart to see the price at any time

ALERTS
• Get a notification before power gets cheap or a price spike arrives
• Choose your own limits and how far ahead to be told
• Alerts are worked out on your phone from the latest forecast — nothing extra to sign up for

WIDGETS, LOCK SCREEN AND DYNAMIC ISLAND
• Home Screen widgets: price now and next, 12- and 48-hour forecasts, price status, and cheapest time
• Lock Screen widgets for a quick look
• Live price in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen, with an arrow showing whether it's going up or down next
• Light and dark mode

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account with us, no ads, no tracking, no analytics
• Your API key is kept in your iPhone's Keychain and only ever sent to Ecosmart
• Prices come straight from Ecosmart's public price API

GETTING STARTED
Add your Ecosmart API key (in the Ecosmart app: More → Settings → Advanced → API keys). No key yet? Tap "Try with sample data" to explore the app, widgets and alerts with a typical day's prices.

Wholesale prices exclude GST unless shown as "delivered". Forecasts come from the electricity market and can change.

name: EdgeNotes
description:
EdgeNotes is a quiet notes app that helps you find things fast.

Your notes are plain Markdown files. They are not locked inside the app, so you can open them from other apps and from your computer.

WRITE WHAT YOU SEE
Headings, bold text, lists and checkboxes take shape as you type. The Markdown symbols only show on the line you are editing.
Formulas (LaTeX) and diagrams (Mermaid) appear right in the note. Choose the colours and text size of diagrams in Settings.

FIND IT FAST
Organise with folders and colours. Pin notes, see them grouped by date, filter by #tags and search every note at once. Sort by modified date, created date or name.

A NUDGE WHEN IT'S TIME
Attach reminders to notes, with daily, weekly, monthly or yearly repeats. Notifications are created on your device.

AND MORE
- Stored in iCloud Drive (shared with the Mac version)
- Insert photos into notes
- Three-column layout on iPad
- Light and Dark mode, and your preferred text size
- Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese and Korean

No account. No ads. No analytics.

name: Edgewide
description:
MORE PAGE. YOUR WAY.

Give your iPhone Duo’s outer display room to breathe. Edgewide lets supported webpages stretch beneath Safari’s side controls, while adjusting links and buttons to keep them within reach.

YOUR SITES. YOUR SETTINGS.

Wide with Blur on one website. The original layout on another. Site Profiles let you save Wide/Off, Blur, and control-side preferences for each site, so your saved choices return when you visit again.

Start with shared default settings, then make exceptions that suit the way you browse. Delete one profile or clear them all from Edgewide’s Safari popup.

TRY A CHANGE. CHOOSE WHAT STAYS.

Adjust a saved site’s settings and see the change immediately on supported pages. Then choose:

• Save for future visits — remember the new settings for that site.
• Use only this visit — try the change without overwriting your saved profile. It ends when you reload or leave the page.

Prefer automatic saving? Select “Don’t ask again for this site.” You can turn save prompts back on later.

SAVED ON YOUR PHONE. NOT SENT TO US.

No account. No ads. No analytics. No extension network requests.

Site Profiles store only the website’s hostname and your selected settings locally on your device. They do not store full URLs, page titles, search terms, or a browsing-history log. Temporary choices stay in the current webpage’s memory. Edgewide does not send your profiles, browsing history, or webpage contents to us, and does not sync profiles to a cloud service.

MORE ROOM IN THE DETAILS

• Choose Wide or Off from Safari’s page menu.
• Add optional blur beneath Safari’s side controls.
• Let automatic side detection follow screen rotation, or choose Left or Right yourself.
• Browse at your preferred size with Safari Page Zoom support.
• Leave an individual site unchanged whenever its original layout works better.

GET STARTED

1. Enable Edgewide in Settings → Apps → Safari → Extensions.
2. Allow access to the websites you want to use.
3. In Safari’s page menu, open Edgewide and choose Wide. Open Site Profiles to save settings for the current website.

Designed for the iPhone Duo outer display. 

Support: https://www.edgewideapp.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.edgewideapp.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Eightysix Ride
description:
Eightysix makes it simple to book a van with a local driver in Thailand — for airport transfers, city rides or multi-day trips.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Tell us where and when: airport pickup (BKK or DMK) with your flight number, a hotel transfer, or a multi-day tour with the places you want to visit.
2. Eightysix sends you a price. Tours can come with a suggested day-by-day itinerary.
3. Accept the price to confirm your booking. Nothing is booked until you agree.
4. See your driver's name, photo, languages and vehicle plate before the trip, and get notified when your driver arrives.

WHY EIGHTYSIX
• Local drivers only — every driver is registered through the app.
• Know the price first — pay only the price agreed in the app.
• Chat with our team during every trip, including photos.
• Share a booking link so family or friends can see your trip and driver.
• Change or cancel up to 12 hours before pickup.
• English and Thai.

ACCOUNTS
New accounts are reviewed before the first booking. After signing up, let your driver know so they can confirm your registration.

Eightysix arranges the booking; the ride is provided by your independent local driver. See our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy at eightysix-prod.web.app.

name: Elden Ele - Eşya Paylaş
description:
Elden Ele, arkadaş, komşu ve aile grupları için kapalı bir eşya paylaşım uygulamasıdır. Evdeki ihtiyaç fazlası eşyaları ücretsiz, ücretli, takas ya da ödünç olarak paylaş; ihtiyacın olanı grubuna sor.

İHTİYACIM YOK
Kullanmadığın eşyayı fotoğraf (10'a kadar) ve kısa videoyla paylaş.

İHTİYACIM VAR
Aradığını yaz, "Bende var!" diyen arkadaşın sana ulaşsın.

SADECE GRUBUN
• Her grubun kendi giriş kodu vardır; gruba yönetici onayıyla girilir.
• İlanlar yönetici onayından sonra yayınlanır.
• Uygunsuz içerik otomatik engellenir; her ilanda şikayet butonu vardır.

KOLAY BULUŞMA
• "İlgileniyorum" de, ilan sahibi seni seçsin; WhatsApp'tan tek dokunuşla yaz.
• Elden teslim, gelip alma, kapıya bırakma ya da kargo seçenekleri.

DAHA FAZLASI
• Favoriler, teşekkür mesajları ve rozetler
• Durum, tarih, fiyat, semt filtreleri ve sıralama
• Karanlık mod

GİZLİLİK
Reklam yok. Verilerin satılmaz, reklam için kullanılmaz. Numaran sadece grubundaki üyelere görünür. Hesabını ve tüm verilerini uygulamadan silebilirsin.

name: Elevai Tech
seller_name: ELEVAI TECH INTELIGENCIA DE NEGOCIOS CONSULTORIA EM TECNOLOGIA DA INFORMACAO LTDA
description:
O Elevai Tech é o aplicativo dos técnicos de manutenção de elevadores que trabalham com a plataforma Elevai. Ele leva para o celular todo o fluxo do atendimento em campo, da chegada ao equipamento até o relatório técnico.

ORDENS DE SERVIÇO NA PALMA DA MÃO
• Veja as ordens de serviço corretivas e preventivas atribuídas a você
• Acompanhe os atendimentos no mapa e encontre o próximo chamado
• Abra novas ordens de serviço quando necessário

ATENDIMENTO COMPLETO EM CAMPO
• Inicie o atendimento lendo o QR Code do equipamento
• Preencha checklists e registre os eventos do serviço
• Tire fotos e faça anotações sobre elas
• Colete a assinatura do responsável no local
• Gere o relatório técnico ao finalizar

FUNCIONA MESMO SEM INTERNET
Registre o atendimento em locais sem sinal, como casas de máquinas e poços. Os dados são sincronizados automaticamente quando a conexão voltar.

SEMPRE ATUALIZADO
Receba notificações de novos chamados e mudanças nas suas ordens de serviço.

HISTÓRICO
Consulte os atendimentos anteriores de cada equipamento.

O acesso é exclusivo para técnicos cadastrados por empresas clientes da Elevai. Para saber mais, acesse elevai-tech.com.

name: Elvira Performance
description:
Elvira Performance brings weight and balance and runway performance planning together on your iPhone.

Prepare your aircraft loading
• Select an installed aircraft or add a registration for a supported aircraft type.
• Enter occupants, baggage and fuel, and review takeoff and landing weights against the installed weight and balance limits.
• Save aircraft-specific loading and runway inputs for reuse.

Review runway performance
• Find airports by name or ICAO code, or enter airfield conditions manually.
• Calculate a selected runway, compare all runways, or use automatic selection based on wind.
• Review departure and destination conditions, runway surface, slope, weather and additional takeoff and landing margins.
• Use the same airport for departure and return landing when planning local flights.

Keep your planning report
• Save, share or print a PDF report.
• Import aircraft packages and export aircraft setup templates.
• Access in-app guidance and references for Swedish UL-B and Part-NCO planning.

Works offline
Calculations and installed aircraft and airport data work without an internet connection. Aircraft profiles, loading, runway inputs and settings are stored locally. No account or login is required. The app has no advertising, analytics or tracking.

Elvira Performance is a planning aid. Always verify supplied and imported data against the current approved AFM/POH, the individual aircraft weighing report and current aeronautical information. Check all inputs, units, aircraft configuration, weather, runway conditions and results. Generic runway corrections are planning assumptions and may not represent aircraft-specific data. The Pilot in Command remains responsible for flight preparation and the decision to operate safely.

Airport data: openAIP (openaip.net), CC BY-NC 4.0.

name: Ember Outpost
description:
Ember Outpost

Build a home. Brave the wilds. Keep the fire alive.

Lead a small band of survivors into a mysterious wilderness, where daylight brings opportunity and darkness brings danger. Gather supplies, strengthen your camp, and defend its glowing heart against creatures emerging from the forest.

Explore by Day
Travel through woodland clearings, mist-covered forests, and forgotten mines. Collect timber, ore, and food, and find survivors who bring new abilities to your growing outpost.

Build Your Defenses
Construct arrow towers, reinforce palisade walls, and establish medical tents. Arrange your buildings to cover vulnerable approaches and prepare for attacks from every direction.

Fight Through the Night
Move freely across the battlefield, strike nearby enemies, chain takedowns, and unleash Ember Nova. Support your defenses with healing pulses while protecting both your hero and the campfire.

Grow Stronger Together
Rescue a blacksmith to unlock the weapon forge, craft stronger equipment, and recruit companions whose skills help your camp endure. Each victory earns supplies and embers, opening the way to more dangerous regions.

Featuring a richly illustrated forest setting, warm firelight, responsive joystick controls, and animated combat effects, Ember Outpost blends exploration, camp building, and survival defense.

Play offline with progress saved on your device. All resources are earned through gameplay—there are no real-money purchases.

The wilderness is waiting. Give your survivors a reason to hope.

name: EmergencyVigil
description:
EmergencyVigil helps you get actually prepared for an emergency — not by handing you an overwhelming checklist and hoping you make it through, but by scaling a real preparedness list to your household and tracking the one thing checklists usually miss: expiry dates.

HOME KIT & GO-BAG
Two separate kits for two different situations — what you need to shelter in place at home, and what you need ready to grab and leave fast. Each covers Water, Food, Lighting & Electricity, Medical & Hygiene, Warmth & Shelter, and Communication & Documents.

SCALED TO YOUR HOUSEHOLD
Tell EmergencyVigil how many adults and children are in your household, and every quantity — how many litres of water, how many tins of food — scales automatically to match real preparedness guidance.

BROWSE, DON'T GET OVERWHELMED
Nobody needs every item on a generic checklist. Browse the full template and hand-pick only what's relevant to your household into your own list. Track progress with a simple checkbox — no fiddly counters.

NEVER LET FOOD EXPIRE UNNOTICED
Packaged food needs a different kind of tracking. Log your actual stocked items with their expiry dates in the Expiry tab, and get a reminder a month before anything runs out — plenty of time to restock.

SHARE YOUR KIT WITH FRIENDS AND FAMILY
Send what you've actually got to a friend via AirDrop, Messages, or Mail. They review it in their own Imported tab and hand-pick what's useful to add to their kit — nothing merges automatically, and nothing is ever uploaded anywhere.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no sign-up, no cloud. Everything you track stays on your device; sharing happens directly between phones.

Built for a stressful moment — calm, legible, and genuinely useful, with full support for Light and Dark mode.

name: EmlakOS
