mypaste remembers what you copy, so you can find it again and paste it anywhere: on your computer, your other computer, or your iPhone.

EVERYTHING, IN YOUR POCKET
What you copied on your computers is on your iPhone, newest first. Copy an address on your laptop, and it's on your phone a moment later.

TAP TO COPY
See something you need? Tap it, and it's on your clipboard, ready to paste in any app.

FIND ANYTHING
Type a word you remember. That address from last week is right there. Pin what you need often, and name a few clips together as a group.

BEAM FROM YOUR PHONE
Send a link or a note straight to a computer next to you, or to a friend's device. Whoever receives it sees who it's from and what it is first, and chooses Accept or Decline.

PHOTOS AND FILES, TOO
Copy a photo or a file on your iPhone, open mypaste, and it reaches your computers.

ADD YOUR PHONE IN A MINUTE
Open Devices, choose Enter a code, and type the code your computer shows. On the same Wi-Fi, that's all.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no cloud. Your devices talk to each other directly, encrypted, so only they can read what you copied. There is no mypaste server holding your clips.

WORKS WITH
mypaste for Mac, Windows and Linux, from getmypaste.com.

GOOD TO KNOW
iPhone only lets apps read the clipboard while they are open, so mypaste adds what you copied on your phone when you open it. The widget and the Share sheet get it there in one tap.

name: Gide Reversi
description:
Gide Reversi is the classic disc-flipping game made for easy reading and calm play.

BIG, CLEAR DISCS
Ivory and onyx discs with a gold rim on a rich velvet board, easy to count at a glance on your phone or tablet.

TAP A GOLD DOT
Gold dots show every square where you can play. Tap one and the discs you trap turn over. The message line tells you how many flipped and whose turn it is, and explains when someone has to pass.

A KIND OPPONENT
Relaxed makes friendly mistakes, Steady plays a solid game, and Sharp is a real challenge. Or choose Two players and pass the phone to play a friend or a grandchild.

HELP WHEN YOU WANT IT
Hint lights up the strongest move. Undo takes back your move as often as you like. No timer, ever.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Purple or red velvet board
• Show or hide the move dots
• Plays in portrait or landscape, on iPhone and iPad

NOTHING TO COLLECT
No ads, no account, no tracking. Your game is saved only on your device, and it works without an internet connection.

Gide Reversi is part of the Gide app family.

name: GitGallery
description:
GitGallery backs up your photos and videos to a private GitHub repository that you own. No subscription and nothing in between: on your iPhone, the app talks to GitHub directly.

WHY GITGALLERY
• Your library lives in your own private repository, under your GitHub account
• No subscription and no storage plan to buy from us
• Open source, so you can see exactly what it does
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking

A GALLERY THAT FEELS FAMILIAR
• A timeline grouped by day and month
• Albums and favourites
• Full-screen viewer that swipes between photos
• Video playback, including large videos
• Light and dark themes

BACKUP THAT KEEPS GOING
• Back up everything, or only the albums you choose
• Automatic backup when you open the app
• Uploads pick up where they left off if the app is closed halfway
• Choose the upload quality: original, high quality, balanced or space saver
• Large videos are stored as release files in your repository, so they don't bloat it

TRY IT FIRST
Tap "Try the demo" on the welcome screen to browse a sample library without signing in.

WHAT YOU NEED
A free GitHub account. GitGallery creates a private repository for your library the first time you sign in.

GitGallery is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by GitHub, Inc.

name: GlassTraxx Fleet Services
description:
Manage your company's glass service with GlassTraxx Fleet Services.

Fleet customers can request glass service for vehicles and heavy equipment, add damage photos and service details, follow job progress, and review invoices.

Authorized GlassTraxx staff can review incoming requests, coordinate assigned jobs, manage service records, and receive optional alerts for new job and quote requests. Available features depend on your account and role.

An approved GlassTraxx Fleet account is required. The app is free to download. Glass repair, replacement, and other physical services are billed separately by GlassTraxx.

Need an account or help with a request? Visit fleet.glasstraxx.com or contact GlassTraxx.

name: Glide Odyssey
description:
Pick a board sport, choose a real spot on the world map, set the wind and the swell, and go.

Glide Odyssey is a free 3D board sports game: wingfoil, kitesurf, windsurf, parawing, surf foil and bodyboard, on eight spots built from real terrain and coastline data.

SIX SPORTS
• Wingfoil: take off on the foil, charge your jump at the top of the wave, chain 360s, frontloops and backloops.
• Kitesurf: the game flies the kite in its wind window; you dig the edge, send it to the zenith and enjoy the hang time.
• Windsurf: planing, jibes, wave riding, backloop, frontloop, push loop and cheese roll.
• Parawing: a soft wing with a bar. Fly, jump, or stow the wing and glide hands-free on the swell.
• Surf foil: paddle, catch the wave and pump to stay on the foil.
• Bodyboard: kick into the wave and race all the way into the tube.

EIGHT REAL SPOTS
L'Almanarre, Lake Monteynard and Capbreton (France), Kanaha and Ho'okipa (Maui, Hawaii), Lake Garda – Torbole (Italy), Pozo Izquierdo (Gran Canaria) and Big Bay (South Africa). Wind from 5 to 40 knots, swell from 0 to 3 m: the sea follows the wind and the shape of the coast.

FOUR WAYS TO PLAY
• Free ride: explore at your own pace and try all the gear.
• Challenges: goals for each spot and sport, a combo multiplier up to ×5, badges and a logbook of records.
• Race: buoy courses with set conditions and a timer, in wingfoil, windsurf and kitesurf.
• School: guided lessons for beginners in wingfoil, kitesurf and windsurf.

LIVING WAVES, REAL WIPEOUTS
The swell steepens and breaks: ride the face and use the lip as a ramp. Start a trick too late and you splash down. No points lost: climb back on and go again.

MADE FOR iPHONE AND iPAD
Landscape touch controls designed for your thumbs, PS4 and Xbox controllers supported, and it plays offline. Customise your rider and the colours of your gear.

FREE, FOR GOOD
No ads, no in-app purchases. Play straight away as a guest. A free account is optional: it backs up your progress and lets you add friends and compare race times.

Terrain: Mapzen Terrain Tiles (AWS Open Data). Coastlines and land cover: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

name: Global Plus
description:
Global Plus es la app de tu equipo de trabajo. Reúne en un solo lugar el entrenamiento, el trabajo en la calle y la comunidad del equipo.

• Universidad: caminos de lecciones en video con preguntas, repasos y certificados.
• Escuela: entrenamientos en video y audio para ver o escuchar en cualquier lado.
• Tu día: compromiso diario, actividad, racha y puntos.
• Calle: jornada, rutas, citas, prospectos y ventas, con el mapa del equipo.
• Comunidad: muro, historias, eventos y chat con tu equipo.
• Métricas y paneles para líderes y managers.

Para entrar necesitas una invitación de tu organización o que tu manager apruebe tu registro.

name: Globalscores
description:
Globalscores is the app for amateur leagues and tournaments. Players, referees, team managers and scouts have everything on their phone.

PLAYERS
• Create your profile with photo, number, nickname, position and sizes.
• Digital player card with a QR code that changes every 15 seconds — screenshots don’t work, so nobody plays in your place.
• Your card works offline at the field.
• Say whether you’re playing each tournament and see your upcoming matches, results and stats.

REFEREES
• All your assigned matches in one place.
• Digital match sheet: take attendance by scanning each player’s card and log goals, cards and notes.
• Capture the match live and the score updates instantly.

TEAM MANAGERS
• Build your roster and invite your players with a link.
• Accept tournament invitations and see who’s playing each one.
• Take attendance from your phone, by ticking or scanning cards.
• Check the rival team’s players with photos before the match.

SCOUTS
• Find players by position, age, goals and city.

LIVE
• Follow the scores of matches being played.

You can report inappropriate photos or profiles, block users and delete your account or some of your data from the app.

name: Goblin Defense
description:
Goblins are flooding the arena and they want one thing: the crystal! Take up your knight's sword and guard the crystal against wave after wave of the goblin horde.

- FIVE MAPS, FIVE BOSSES
Start in the Forest, then push on through the Desert, the Snow, the Sea and the Lava Mine. Each map has five waves, and its boss comes with the last one: the Goblin King, the Desert Sultan, the Frost King, the Pirate Captain and the Lava Lord. Win a map to open the next.

- NEW ENEMIES EVERY WAVE
Quick goblin runts, archers shooting from afar, shamans hurling spells, bombers racing to blow up next to the crystal, brutes and yetis that knock your knight back. Every enemy fights its own way, so plan your own.

- SMOOTH COMBAT
• Your sword turns to the nearest goblin by itself
• Roll out of harm's way
• Charge your ultimate with every hit and slam your sword into the ground to throw back every goblin around you
• Shoot from range with the crossbow, throw bombs, drink health potions and mend the crystal with crystal shards

- POWER UP YOUR KNIGHT
Collect the gold goblins drop and spend it in the shop: sharpen your sword, toughen your armor, run faster in light boots, shield the crystal. Buy the crossbow and level it up.

- MADE FOR TOUCH
A virtual joystick and big buttons for comfortable controls, on iPhone and iPad alike. No ads, no in-app purchases.

If the crystal falls, it's all over. Can you stop the goblin horde?

name: GOOD CHOICE Map
description:
Explore Myanmar with GOOD CHOICE Map.

Search for places, streets, shops and local services with Burmese map labels and an interface in English or Burmese.

PLAN YOUR JOURNEY
Compare driving, walking and cycling routes. View Yangon bus and train options, including stops and walking connections. See GC Taxi fare estimates where available.

BURMESE VOICE GUIDANCE
Follow turn-by-turn directions with recorded Burmese voice prompts. During navigation you start, guidance can continue with the screen locked. Background location updates stop when navigation ends.

ASK GOGO
Discover nearby places and suggestions for where to go with the local map assistant.

OFFLINE MAP AREAS
Download an area in advance for offline map browsing. Online search and route calculation require an internet connection.

SAVE AND SHARE
Save Home and Work, revisit recent destinations and share places as links.

No account is needed to browse the map, search or view routes. Sign in optionally to contribute road reports and missing places. Account deletion is available from the account menu.

Public transport planning currently covers Yangon. Map detail, routes and service availability vary by area. Follow road signs and current conditions.

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
Map rendering: MapLibre.

Support: goodchoiceinnovation@gmail.com

name: Got Game Basketball Tracker
description:
Got Game is the basketball team hub built for coaches. Stop juggling spreadsheets, group chats, and paper playbooks — run your whole team from one app.

• Rosters — keep every player, position, and contact in one place
• Game-day stats — track points, rebounds, assists, and more live from the bench
• Practice planning — build sessions and drills that actually stick
• Play design — draw up plays and share them with your team
• Team Share — invite assistants and keep everyone on the same page
• Offline use — the gym's Wi-Fi won't slow you down
• Export — send stats and rosters as CSV or PDF

Built for basketball coaches at every level. One app, one place, your whole team.

Built by Bailey II Studios.

Privacy Policy: https://baileyiistudios.com/privacy-policy/

name: Grainveil
description:
Grainveil is a pocket pixel hourglass for quiet sits. Choose a ritual, start the glass, and watch amber grains fall one cell at a time. While a sit runs, tabs and buttons fade so only sand remains — tap once to peek controls.

Glass — Load the active ritual and press START. Sand pace matches remaining time. PAUSE, RESUME, RESET, or END early (partial sits over 20 seconds write a journal row). Keep-awake can hold the screen on while grains fall.

Rituals — House lengths from one minute to forty-five, plus custom rituals you add on device. Make Active loads that glass immediately.

Journal — Review completed and partial sits with planned vs actual time. Clear anytime. Nothing syncs to a server.

Skins — Eight sand skins (Harbor Amber, Oxide Dust, Moss Tray, Ink Meal, Pearl Meal, Ember Mix, Slate Mill, Glass Teal) retint grains, glass, and frame using bundled grit packs.

Desk — Haptics, keep-awake, field guide, fifteen technique notes, restore house rituals, optional example journal rows, clear journal, and the bundled privacy policy.

Grainveil does not require an account and does not need a network connection after install.

Grainveil is a general focus timer. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat any condition.

name: GSound RTA
description:
GSound RTA is a sound analyzer for sound engineers and karaoke system owners.

FEEDBACK FINDER
Raise the mic volume slowly and the app catches the frequency that starts to ring, then tells you what to do: "31-band EQ: pull the 2.5k slider down 6 dB. PEQ: 2480 Hz, Q 8–10, cut 6 dB". Every feedback frequency is listed so you can EQ them one by one. It tells feedback apart from fans, mains hum, speech and sung notes, so background noise rarely triggers false alarms.

MEASUREMENT
• RTA in 1/1, 1/3 (matches a 31-band EQ), 1/6 and 1/12 octave bands with peak hold.
• High-resolution FFT up to 32768 points, 4 windows, frequency cursor.
• Waterfall (spectrogram): feedback shows as a bright horizontal line.
• dB meter with A / C / Z weighting, LAeq, LAmax, clip warning. dB SPL calibration against a reference meter.
• Full-screen graphs and freeze to read values.

SIGNAL GENERATOR
Pink noise, white noise and sine 20 Hz – 20 kHz for system EQ, rattle hunting and subwoofer checks.

MICROPHONE
Uses the iOS Measurement mode: no automatic gain, noise reduction or voice filtering. Choose the bottom, front or back iPhone mic. Works with USB measurement mics (miniDSP UMIK-1…) via USB-C or a Lightning to USB 3 camera adapter.

No ads, no account, no internet needed. Audio is processed on the phone only and never recorded. Vietnamese and English.

name: Guess me: Tiếng Anh bình dân
description:
Guess me giúp bạn học tiếng Anh theo cách "bình dân": nhìn nghĩa tiếng Việt, đoán từ tiếng Anh, nghe giọng đọc thật và tự đọc theo. Dành cho người mới bắt đầu, người đi làm bận rộn và cả người lớn tuổi.

ĐOÁN TỪ – NHỚ LÂU
• Mỗi thẻ hiện nghĩa tiếng Việt và chữ cái đầu, bạn có vài giây để đoán từ tiếng Anh.
• Mỗi lượt trộn từ dễ, vừa và khó, đủ loại danh từ, động từ, tính từ… để không nhàm chán.
• Ôn tập ngắt quãng: từ bạn chưa thuộc sẽ quay lại đúng lúc sắp quên.

PHIÊN ÂM KIỂU VIỆT – ĐỌC LÀ RA
• Bên cạnh phiên âm quốc tế (IPA), mỗi từ có phiên âm viết bằng chữ Việt, âm nhấn viết HOA: water → OÁ-đờr, computer → kờm-PÍU-đờr.
• Có cả giọng Mỹ và giọng Anh, chọn một chạm.

GIỌNG ĐỌC THẬT, CHẤM PHÁT ÂM
• Giọng đọc thu sẵn tự nhiên: nam/nữ, Mỹ/Anh, đọc cả câu ví dụ và nghĩa tiếng Việt.
• Bật "Đọc đáp án" để nói từ tiếng Anh, ứng dụng chấm điểm và chỉ ra âm còn sai, ngay trên điện thoại.

NỘI DUNG
• Từ vựng nền tảng: 1.023 từ cho người mới bắt đầu.
• Từ vựng thông dụng: 1.178 từ hay gặp hằng ngày.
• Từ vựng giao tiếp: 2.016 từ để nói chuyện tự tin hơn.
• Câu giao tiếp hằng ngày: 203 câu ngắn dùng ngay (chào hỏi, mua sắm, ăn uống, gọi điện, công việc…).
• Mỗi từ có câu ví dụ Anh – Việt.

GỌN NHẸ, RIÊNG TƯ
• Không cần tài khoản, không quảng cáo.
• Học được cả khi không có mạng sau khi tải giọng đọc.
• Tiến độ học lưu trên máy của bạn, không thu thập dữ liệu cá nhân.
• Giao diện sáng/tối, chữ to dễ đọc.

Góp ý hoặc báo lỗi: httamst@gmail.com

name: Gulf Tide Guest Portal
description:
Booked a Gulf Tide stay? This is your trip, all in one spot.

• Sign your rental agreement and finish check-in
• Find your home's address and directions
• Pull up the home guidebook
• See your door code right when check-in time hits
• Invite the rest of your crew to see the trip
• See your payments and print or save a receipt
• Report a maintenance issue in a few taps
• Call or text our local team any time

Sign in with the mobile number or confirmation number on your reservation. Stay signed in and the app is ready for your next trip too. See y'all at the beach!

name: GullyHeroes
description:
GullyHeroes is the fastest way to keep score in your street, gully, backyard or club cricket match. Big, simple buttons let you record every ball in a single tap, and the app does all the maths for you.

SCORE BALL BY BALL
• Runs 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 on the main keypad, plus rare 5, 7, 8 and 9
• Wides and no-balls with extra runs, including wide + stumped
• Wickets: caught, bowled, stumped, run out (with runs), hit wicket and more
• One-tap undo for mistakes, even after starting the second innings

ALWAYS KNOW THE GAME SITUATION
• Live score, overs and current run rate
• Chase target, runs needed, balls left and required run rate
• Over-by-over timeline with runs and wickets for every over
• Automatic end of innings when overs or wickets run out
• Clear result: who won, and by how many runs or wickets

BUILT FOR REAL MATCHES
• Name your teams and choose 1–100 overs and 2–20 players per side
• Quick presets: 5 overs, 10 overs, T20 and ODI
• Change overs, players or the target mid-match
• Keeps the screen awake while you score
• Saves automatically, so you can close the app and carry on later
• Match history of every finished game

SHARE THE RESULT
• Detailed over-by-over match summary
• Share it as a clean scorecard image or as text to your group chat

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Works offline. Your matches stay on your iPhone.

Light and dark mode, sounds and haptics included. Game on!

name: HabitHabitat
description:
HabitHabitat helps you focus on two small tasks each day, rather than overwhelming goals.

2 SMALL TASKS A DAY
In the morning, write down two small tasks you’d like to accomplish—for example, "a 10-minute walk" or "reading 10 pages of a book." As you complete them throughout the day, mark them off. Once both are finished, a small reward awaits you.

THE MONTHLY CIRCLE
Each day of the month is represented as a slice of a circle. If both tasks are completed, the slice turns green; if one is finished, it becomes half-green. If neither is done, the ground dries up. As the month progresses, you can watch your circle turn green. You can also tap on past days to review the tasks you set for those dates.

A GROWING FOREST AND CHANGING WEATHER
At the center of the circle lies your forest. Green days help your forest grow, while consecutive dry days cause the trees to wither. The weather also shifts based on your recent progress—ranging from sunshine, light rain, and wind to drought or even storms. In the winter months, it snows.

THE DAY COMES TO A CLOSE
Each day ends at midnight, and past entries cannot be altered. This encourages you to focus on the present rather than dwelling on the past.

GENTLE REMINDERS
You can opt for reminders: one in the morning at 8:00 AM to plan your tasks, and another in the evening at 9:00 PM to mark them off. The evening reminder only triggers if your tasks for the day remain incomplete. Notifications are generated locally on your device; no external servers are involved.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
There is no need to create an account or log in. All your tasks and your forest are stored exclusively on your phone. No data is collected, and the app functions perfectly without an internet connection. There are no advertisements or tracking. SIMPLE AND ACCESSIBLE
If the "Reduce Motion" setting is enabled, animations are simplified.

name: hall – Room Reverb
description:
hall captures the sound of a real room with your iPhone and turns it into reverb you can play through.

Put your iPhone down in a room that sounds good: a stairwell, a tiled bathroom, a church, an empty garage. Tap Capture. hall plays a short tone, listens to how the room answers, and keeps that answer. Ten seconds later, the room is yours.

USE IT IN YOUR MUSIC APP
• hall is an Audio Unit: add it as a plug-in in GarageBand and other music apps
• Every room you capture shows up there by itself, no files to move
• Mix and Length, nothing else to learn
• Saved with your song: open it again and the room is still there

CAPTURE
• One button: hall plays a tone and listens
• Or clap once, for big rooms and when you can't play a tone
• Corrects for the iPhone speaker and microphone, so the room sounds like the room
• Plug in a USB-C microphone and a speaker for studio-grade rooms, the way sampling reverbs were once made in the studio
• Stereo reverb, with a decay curve that shows how the room dies away

ROOMS
• Name them, keep as many as you like
• Five rooms to start with, from a small room to a church
• Share a room by AirDrop or Messages, as a standard WAV file
• Import reverb files (WAV, AIFF) from anywhere

Light and dark mode, seven accent colors. No account, no subscription, no ads, no tracking. hall works completely offline; the microphone only ever hears the room, and nothing leaves your iPhone.

From the makers of kasten, the sampler, and takt, the metronome you can feel.

name: Hán Thông
description:
Hán Thông giúp bạn đọc hiểu văn bản tiếng Trung: mỗi chữ có pinyin, chú âm Bopomofo và âm Hán-Việt, chạm vào một từ là thấy nghĩa tiếng Việt.

CHÚ ÂM TỪNG CHỮ
Pinyin (có biến điệu của 一 và 不, đọc kiểu Đài Loan nếu muốn), chú âm và âm Hán-Việt ngay trên, bên cạnh hoặc dưới mỗi chữ, màu theo thanh điệu. Bật tắt từng loại riêng cho văn bản và cho cửa sổ tra từ: tắt chú âm để tập đọc, vẫn xem được khi tra.

TÁCH TỪ, CHỌN ÂM ĐÚNG
Câu được tách thành từ theo từ điển và tần suất; chữ đa âm được chọn âm theo ngữ cảnh. Sai thì sửa cách tách hoặc âm đọc, Hán Thông nhớ cho lần sau.

TRA TỪ TRUNG–VIỆT
Chạm vào một từ để xem nghĩa tiếng Việt, âm Hán-Việt, chữ chính thể hoặc giản thể, rồi từng chữ với đủ pinyin, chú âm và nghĩa. Từ điển hơn 120.000 từ có nghĩa tiếng Việt, nằm sẵn trong ứng dụng, tra không cần mạng.

THƯ VIỆN CỦA BẠN
Dán văn bản, mở tệp .txt (UTF-8, GB18030, Big5) hoặc nhập từ link một trang web: Hán Thông lấy phần văn bản chính và tự chia chương theo tiêu đề. Sách, phần, chương sắp xếp như cây thư mục; ứng dụng nhớ chỗ bạn đọc dở.

SỔ TỪ VỰNG
Lưu từ cùng câu đã gặp nó, thêm ghi chú, quay lại đúng chỗ trong sách. Xuất ra tệp để ôn bằng Anki.

RIÊNG TƯ
Không tài khoản, không quảng cáo, không theo dõi. Dữ liệu nằm trên máy, mỗi hồ sơ được mã hoá bằng mật khẩu riêng; nhiều người dùng chung một máy vẫn tách biệt. Sao lưu hồ sơ ra tệp .htbackup để chuyển sang máy khác, kể cả bản Windows, macOS, Linux và Android. Ứng dụng chỉ dùng mạng khi bạn nhập từ link.

name: Hanmadi: Korean Life Phrases
description:
Hanmadi ("one word" in Korean) helps you say what you need in Korea — at the hospital, the pharmacy, your child's school, a public office or at work.

40+ EVERYDAY PHRASES IN 7 SITUATIONS
Emergency · Hospital · Pharmacy · School · Public office · Work · Shopping & transport

SHOW IT OR PLAY IT
• Play any phrase in natural Korean speech
• Show Big fills the screen so staff can read it at a glance
• See the meaning in English, Vietnamese or Chinese — and hear it in your language too

SAVE YOUR PHRASES
Star the ones you use most for quick access.

HELP IN YOUR LANGUAGE
• 1345 Immigration Contact Center — 20 languages
• 1577-1366 Danuri Call Center — for multicultural families and migrant women, 24 hours
• 119 fire & ambulance, 112 police

Works offline. No ads, no sign-in, no data collection.

Phrases are short everyday expressions; for important matters, ask for an interpreter.

name: Harmoth
description:
Harmoth is an on-device audio console for musicians, students, and curious listeners. See what you hear, generate clean test signals, and explore pitch with practical studio-style tools.
LIVE SPECTRUM
• Real-time frequency spectrum from the microphone
• Time-domain waveform view
• Peak frequency and RMS readouts
• Adjustable smoothing and meter sensitivity
TONE BENCH
• Pure tones with sine, triangle, square, and saw waveforms
• Precise frequency control with quick pitch presets
• Amplitude control for comfortable listening levels
• Save favorite tones as local patches
CHORD PAD
• Build major, minor, diminished, augmented, sus, and seventh voicings
• Octave shift and clear frequency listing for each partial
• Ideal for ear training and harmonic experiments
SWEEP LAB
• Linear and logarithmic frequency sweeps
• Useful for room checks and listening tests
• Save sweep setups for quick recall
TUNER
• Pitch detection with note name and cents offset
• Calibrate A4 reference (e.g. 432 / 440 / 442 Hz)
• Instant A3 / A4 / A5 reference tones
PATCHES & PRIMER
• Store tones, chords, and sweeps locally on your device
• Illustrated Field Primer articles on waveforms, spectrum reading, harmonics, chords, sweeps, and hearing care
PRIVACY BY DESIGN
• Microphone audio is processed on this device only
• No account required
• No cloud sync in this build
• Tone, chord, and sweep generators work even if microphone access is declined
Harmoth is a learning and practice instrument—not a medical device and not a certified calibration tool. Keep volumes moderate and enjoy exploring sound.

name: healroot - 힐루트
description:
외부 클라우드 서비스의 비싼 월 구독료와 용량 압박에서 벗어나세요.
healroot(힐루트)는 집이나 사무실의 PC를 안전한 전용 클라우드 노드로 전환하여, 스마트폰의 사진과 동영상을 무제한으로 백업하고 공유할 수 있는 프라이빗 가족 클라우드 솔루션입니다.

[주요 기능]
• 0원 프라이빗 가족 클라우드: 구글 드라이브나 아이클라우드 구독료 없이, 집의 PC 용량만큼 자유롭게 사용하는 가족 전용 스토리지.
• 원터치 갤러리 백업 & 스마트폰 용량 비우기: 소중한 사진과 4K 영상을 홈 PC로 안전하게 백업하고, 스마트폰 저장 공간을 즉시 확보하세요.
• 초고속 하이브리드 통신: 가정 내 Wi-Fi에서는 1Gbps 초고속 다이렉트 통신으로 빠르게 전송하고, 외부(LTE/5G)에서는 안전한 암호화 터널로 접속합니다.
• 가족 공용 & 개인 폴더 완벽 분리: 가족 모두가 함께 보는 공용 앨범과 나만 볼 수 있는 프라이빗 보관함을 안전하게 격리합니다.
• 간편한 원클릭 초대: 복잡한 설정 없이 초대 링크 하나로 온 가족 기기를 손쉽게 연결할 수 있습니다.

name: Hear I am - 히얼아이엠
description:
Hear I am은 시각장애 예술인이 무대 위에서 스스로 움직일 수 있도록 돕는 음성 동선 안내 앱입니다.

조력자가 무대를 스캔하고 동선을 정해 두면, 아티스트는 음성과 비프음 안내를 따라 출발점에서 도착점까지 이동할 수 있습니다.

• 아티스트와 조력자 모드
- 아티스트: 음성 안내와 음성 명령을 중심으로 사용합니다.
- 조력자 : 무대를 스캔하고 공연별 동선을 준비하고 관리합니다.

• 무대 스캔
- LiDAR로 실제 무대와 연습 공간을 3D로 저장합니다.
- 스캔하면서 현장 사진을 남겨 두고 나중에 다시 확인할 수 있습니다.

•동선 지정과 3D 동선 보기
- 스캔한 무대 위에 출발점, 경유 지점, 도착점을 직접 찍어 동선을 만듭니다.
- 3D 화면에서 무대를 돌려 보며 동선과 장애물을 확인합니다.

• 공연별 동선 관리
- 공연마다 공연 및 연습 공간과 장면별 기본 동선을 정리합니다.
- 공간 이름이나 주소로 공연장을 찾아 추가할 수 있습니다.

• 음성 안내
- 다음 지점의 방향과 남은 거리를 음성과 비프음으로 알려 줍니다.
- 도착하면 소리로 알려 줍니다.

• 음성으로 조작
-"Hear I am"이라고 부르고 연습할 공연을 말하면 안내를 시작합니다.
- Siri와 단축어로도 안내를 시작할 수 있습니다.

• 연습 및 실전 기록
- 연습과 공연에서 움직인 경로와 시간을 기록하고 다시 볼 수 있습니다.

• 개인정보
- 회원가입 없이 사용할 수 있습니다.
- 스캔, 사진, 기록은 기기 안에만 저장되며 운영자 서버로 보내지 않습니다.

• 사용 환경
- 무대 스캔과 위치 안내는 LiDAR 센서가 있는 iPhone(Pro, Pro Max 모델)에서 사용할 수 있습니다.
- 안내를 들을 때는 이어폰 사용을 권장합니다.

name: Hearth: Calm Bible App
description:
Hearth is a calm, gentle Bible app, made with love and shared with everyone. It is free, with no ads, no accounts and no subscriptions. Nothing is locked, now or ever.

READ YOUR WAY
Choose your text, font and size, and your own colours. Page tints and a reading ruler help if words tend to swim or jump around. Hearth was built so that learning about faith never has to cost anything, including for people with reading difficulties.

UNDERSTAND AS YOU GO
Tap a word to see what it means. Save verses and write your own notes. Everything you write stays on your phone.

PEACE AND COMFORT
Find verses for hard days, short devotions, stories, and a sleep timer with a gentle "still there?" check.

BUILD A HABIT
Follow reading plans, set a daily reminder, memorise verses, and learn about the people of the Bible.

YOUR PRIVACY
Hearth does not collect your name, email or any personal information. There is nothing to sign up for.

Hearth began as a gift for someone I love. I hope it helps you too.

name: Hearthkeep
description:
Hearthkeep keeps the care of your house in one calm, organized place. Register the appliances and systems you own, from the furnace and water heater to the roof, gutters, sump pump and smoke alarms, and Hearthkeep turns them into a clear plan for the week ahead.

The Today screen answers the question every homeowner asks on a Saturday morning: what does the house need right now? Overdue tasks rise to the top, followed by everything due this week and a short look at the next thirty days. A home health summary shows which systems are on track and which need attention, so you can see at a glance whether safety, water, heating or the exterior needs a check.

Every item has a complete record. Save the brand, model number, serial number, install date and purchase price, note where it lives in the house, and keep the owner's manual, receipt and warranty card alongside it. When a technician asks for the model of your water heater, the answer is a few taps away.

Recurring upkeep is simple to set up. Choose an interval such as every month, every 90 days or once a year, add the steps you follow, and set a reminder for the morning it is due. When you mark a task done, log the date, the cost and a short note, and Hearthkeep schedules the next one automatically.

Service history builds a timeline of repairs, installs and inspections with costs broken into parts and labor and the contractor who did the work. Warranties are sorted by end date, with a heads-up before coverage runs out. Seasonal checklists walk you through fall freeze prep, winter checks, spring cleanup and summer cooling tasks. A contractor list keeps phone numbers, license numbers and your own notes, and links each pro to the jobs they have done for you.

The Spending view shows what upkeep has cost this year by month and by system, plus estimates for the next scheduled visit of your upkeep tasks over the coming twelve months, helping you prepare for regular home care.

Hearthkeep works in light and dark appearance and keeps your records on your iPhone.

name: HemCare
description:
What does the mark under a wash tub mean? Open the symbol guide and browse the instructions one care category at a time.

For a garment you wash often, save a card with its name and the symbols printed on its label. You can add a photo to tell similar garments apart. Find the card again under My garments when laundry day comes around.

Choose the symbols yourself and follow the manufacturer’s label. The guide works offline; it does not scan or automatically identify labels.

name: Heroes Owner: Rental Income
description:
Your property, in your pocket.

Heroes Owner is the owner space of agencies and condo managers that use Heroes. See how your property is doing, any time, without waiting for the monthly email.

• Occupancy, rent collected and arrears at a glance
• Income month by month: received, expected, agency fees and net
• Monthly statements to read or download
• Bookings, leases and viewings on one calendar
• Contracts, statements and documents in one place
• Message your agency, with photos and files
• Repair, question or document requests, with live status
• Listing insights: views, contacts and viewings
• Your condo too: charges, announcements and meetings

Sign in in seconds
Scan your agency's QR code, type the 6-digit code it gives you, or open the link it sends you. No password to remember.

Heroes Owner needs an invitation from your agency or condo manager.

name: Hey You: Nearby Conversations
description:
Hey You makes it easy to start a conversation with someone nearby.

SAY HEY
Turn on Nearby and say hey to everyone around you, or to one person. When someone answers, you're in a private chat. Nearby runs over Bluetooth, so it works even where there's no signal.

KEEP TALKING
After you've met, your chat carries on over the internet when you're apart: up to 1,000 messages a day, and messages sent nearby don't count. One tick means sent, two mean delivered.

OPEN SIGNAL
Put your phone on the table and start Open Signal. A red light travels around the edge of your screen so people nearby can see you're on Hey You.

YOUR PROFILE, YOUR CALL
Pick a name, a short intro and a photo if you like. No phone number, email address or password. Add your socials and share them only with the people you choose. You decide whether your profile shows up nearby.

SAFETY BUILT IN
Block or report anyone. When you report, you choose exactly which messages to include. Turn on end-to-end encryption in any chat when you both agree. Support is right inside the app.

name: HeyDing – Order Ready
description:
Your food. Your cue.

Ding helps you follow your food order at participating restaurants. Open your restaurant’s order link or scan its QR code, enter the number from your receipt when needed, and see when your order is Preparing, Ready or Collected.

YOUR RESTAURANT, YOUR EXPERIENCE
See the restaurant’s branding, collection instructions and promotional banners while you wait. Where enabled by the restaurant, enjoy four quick waiting games. Your order continues to be tracked while you play.

A CLEAR CUE TO COLLECT
Enable phone alerts to receive an order-ready notification. Notifications depend on permission, network availability and your device’s sound and Focus settings.

A LITTLE LESS WAITING
No customer account, email address or phone number is required to track an order. Participating restaurants provide the service. After collection, you can choose to open the restaurant’s Google review page.

Available in English and Arabic.

name: Hiwra
description:
Hiwra is a place to share ideas, discover new perspectives and stay close to the people and communities that matter to you.

SHARE YOUR WORLD
Start a conversation with a text post, share photos and videos, and respond through comments, replies and reactions. Follow people you enjoy and explore their latest updates.

DISCOVER STORIES AND REELS
Share moments through stories that leave ordinary viewing after 24 hours, and explore short videos in a dedicated reels viewer.

KEEP THE CONVERSATION GOING
Chat privately, send photos, videos and voice messages, reply to individual messages and make voice or video calls. Read states and notifications help you keep up at your own pace.

FIND YOUR COMMUNITY
Discover pages and groups around shared interests. Build your profile, choose what to share and follow conversations that interest you.

YOUR EXPERIENCE, YOUR CHOICES
Choose English or Arabic, switch between light, dark and system appearance, and manage account privacy, follow requests, notifications and active sessions from settings.

SAFETY AND SUPPORT
Report inappropriate content, block unwanted accounts and contact support from inside the app. Hiwra is for people aged 13 and above, subject to any higher minimum age required where they live.

Privacy Policy: https://hiwra.com/info/privacy
Terms of Use: https://hiwra.com/info/terms
Support: https://hiwra.com/support

name: Hola B2
description:
Hola B2 — курс іспанської для тих, хто хоче вчити мову системно, а не фразами для туристів. Пояснення українською і російською, іспанська — така, як говорять в Іспанії.

КУРС ЯК ПІДРУЧНИК
• Шлях від A1 до B2: юніти й уроки йдуть по порядку, нічого не пропускається.
• Кожен урок: коротка теорія з таблицями, слова з озвученням, вправи й контрольна.
• Знаєш тему? Напиши контрольну одразу — 9 з 10, і урок зараховано.
• Увесь курс від A1 до B2 уже в застосунку: 288 уроків.

ВПРАВИ, ЯКІ НЕ ПОВТОРЮЮТЬСЯ
• Десятки питань на кожен урок: вибір відповіді, введення слова, складання речення.
• Спершу йдуть нові питання. Помилки повертаються, доки не засвоїш.
• Одруківку в одну літеру зараховано, а граматичну помилку в закінченні — ні.

СЛОВА, ЯКІ ЗАПАМ'ЯТОВУЮТЬСЯ
• Слова з пройдених уроків повертаються на повторення через 1, 2, 4, 8 днів і далі.
• Торкнися будь-якого іспанського слова — прозвучить вимова.

МЕТА І ЩОДЕННИЙ МІНІМУМ
• Постав мету — наприклад, B2 до кінця року — і щоденний мінімум у хвилинах.
• Застосунок рахує лише активний час і показує тиждень, прогрес і дату, коли за твого темпу дійдеш до мети.
• Щоденне нагадування — якщо мінімум уже виконано, того дня не турбує.

НІЧОГО ЗАЙВОГО
• Без реклами, скринь, костюмів і відволікаючої анімації.
• Без реєстрації. Жодних даних не збираємо: прогрес зберігається лише на твоєму телефоні.
• Працює без інтернету. Резервна копія — у файл, куди зручно.

name: Hollow Wise
description:
Hollow Wise turns a big cleaning job into small steps. No shame, no endless list.

Start with Quick Clean. Pick Kitchen, Bathroom, Bedroom or Living room and get a fixed, no-setup routine for the room in front of you. It is free forever and needs no account.

A QUIETER WAY TO BEGIN
- No shame. A lived-in home is not a personal failure.
- No endless list. One manageable action and a stopping point.
- No perfect routine. Begin with what feels manageable today.
- Your home. Your choices. You decide what fits, what to skip, and when you are done.

WITH A FREE ACCOUNT
- Your rooms and routines are saved, so they are there next time on any device.
- Build routines from a few questions about your home.
- Make a cleaning caddy, check your supplies, and keep a shopping list for the store.
- Get a routine for when company is coming, sized to the time you have.
- Turn on trash day and laundry day reminders if you want them.
- Share steps with someone else, or share your home with another adult.
- Add a kid and send them a simple routine by link. Kids never need an account.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. We do not sell your information. Nothing in the app uses AI: fixed rules read your answers. You can delete your account yourself, any time, from inside the app.

Hollow Wise is run by Hollow Wise LLC, a Texas company. It is not emergency, crisis, medical, poison-control or repair help. If someone is in immediate danger, contact your local emergency service.

name: Honeyhand Hive
description:
Turn a five-card meadow into a living hive. Each turn, choose one card from the flower field and let the rest drift onward, then place your pick into one of five purpose-built comb cells. Gather nectar, brew honey, raise new workers, guard the hive, and store the season's harvest.

Every standard playing card carries two jobs: its rank sets working strength, while its suit decides which flower grows around it. Link neighboring cards into Pollen Paths, balance hive health with production, and shape a renewable loop instead of chasing one lucky suit.

Explore five flower regions through a 40-season Hive Story, take on fixed-layout Hive Puzzles, return for a fresh Daily Bloom, or settle into an Endless Season. Honeyworks and Meadow Atlas let you grow a collection of workers, flowers, comb rooms and small hive decorations.

Honeyhand Hive is designed for quiet offline sessions on iPhone and iPad. There are no ads, purchases, energy timers, loot boxes or account requirements. Draft with care, build a resilient comb, and see how many seasons your hive can keep blooming.

name: HoofFitGauge
description: HoofFitGauge muuntaa kavion pituuden, leveyden ja kulman varastoraudan kooksi sekä tyypilliseksi naulamääräksi US-, millimetri- ja EU-taulukoilla. Pidä hevoskohtainen trimmihistorialle ja paikallinen erääntymisjono. Sovellus ei arvioi kavion terveyttä, ontumista eikä trimmin syvyyttä. Mittaukset varastovälin ulkopuolella jätetään muuntamatta — vahvista tallissa.

name: Hour Hand: Crew Time Clock
description:
A simple time clock for a small crew. Your workers clock in and out on their own phones, and you get the timesheet when each pay period ends.

Hour Hand is made for crews of a few people: lawn care, cleaning, odd jobs, family businesses and small contractors. Your crew never makes an account. You add them, send an invite, and they're set.

FOR YOUR CREW
• Join from a one-use invite link, or scan the QR code on the crew lead's phone
• Stay signed in on that phone. A new phone just needs a new invite
• Clock in and out with one big button
• Pick the job and add a note to the shift
• See the time running, plus today's hours and this pay period's hours
• Works with no signal: taps are saved on the phone and sent when it's back online
• A "Still on the clock?" reminder after a long shift or late in the evening
• See your own shifts for this pay period and the last one

FOR YOU, THE CREW LEAD
• See who's on the clock right now, since when, and on which job
• Clock anyone in or out from your phone
• Add a missed shift, fix a start or end time, change the job or note, or delete a shift
• Every change is kept in the shift's history, with your reason
• Long shifts stand out on the board
• Add, rename and archive jobs
• Sign out a lost phone, or archive a worker and keep their shifts

TIMESHEETS FOR PAYROLL
• Pay periods repeat from the start date you pick, so they line up with your payroll
• When a period ends, the timesheet arrives by email as two CSV files: every shift, and each worker's weekly totals
• Email now sends the current period or any past one, whenever you want it
• Share or save both CSVs straight from the app
• Send them to your own email, or to another address once it's confirmed
• The files open in any spreadsheet and import into a Notion database or your payroll tool
• Shifts you changed are marked as edited, so the timesheet stays honest

SIMPLE ON PURPOSE
• Free, with no ads
• Hour Hand never asks for anyone's location
• Workers see only their own hours
• No breaks, overtime rules or scheduling to set up. Just the clock and the timesheet

SIGN IN
Crew leads sign in with a Bravely Account using Apple, Google, or an email and password. Workers never need an account.

SUPPORT
Questions or feedback: support@bravely.dev, or text (316) 333-5345.
Privacy: https://bravely.dev/privacy/hourhand
Terms: https://bravely.dev/terms/hourhand

name: HP Telecom Quản trị
description:
HP Telecom Quản trị giúp người dùng được phân quyền quản lý công việc và báo cáo trên hệ thống HP Telecom bằng iPhone hoặc iPad.

• Xem và quản lý báo cáo tuần tuyến, sự cố và di dời.
• Theo dõi tuyến cáp, điểm công việc và thông tin báo cáo trên bản đồ.
• Chọn tháng, tìm tuyến và giao nhiều tuyến cho đội, thành viên theo quyền tài khoản.
• Nhập danh sách Excel, tệp KML/KMZ và ảnh từ ứng dụng Tệp vào các biểu mẫu được hỗ trợ.
• Xem ảnh báo cáo, chỉnh sửa thông tin và lưu hoặc chia sẻ tệp xuất từ hệ thống.
• Xem nhật ký hoạt động, trạng thái đồng bộ và thông tin tài khoản theo quyền được cấp.

Dữ liệu được lưu trên máy chủ HP Telecom và sử dụng chung với hệ thống quản trị trên máy tính. Phiên đăng nhập được lưu an toàn trên thiết bị.

Ứng dụng cần kết nối Internet và tài khoản HP Telecom được cấp quyền. Các chức năng và dữ liệu hiển thị phụ thuộc vào quyền của tài khoản và phiên bản máy chủ.

name: Http Game
description:
Want to play games together without making everyone download an app?

Game Host turns your iPhone into a local game server. Friends join from any browser — iPhone, Android, tablet or laptop — just by connecting to the same Wi-Fi (or your Personal Hotspot) and scanning a QR code.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Open the app and start the server
2. Friends scan the QR code or type the address
3. Pick a game, open a room, and play
As the host, you play right inside the app.

26 BUILT-IN GAMES
• Cards: Big Two, Mahjong, Color Cards, Solitaire Race, Old Maid, Sevens, Blackjack
• Board: Xiangqi (Chinese Chess), Chess, Shogi, Go, Gomoku, Reversi, Connect Four, Chinese Checkers, Ludo
• Dice: Liar's Dice, Cee-lo, Yacht, Pig
• Action: 3D Pool, Sky Ace (co-op shooter), Tug of War
• Co-op: Sudoku, Pipes, Draw Together

FEATURES
• No install for guests — everyone plays in a web browser
• No account, no internet — a shared Wi-Fi or hotspot is all you need
• Computer players fill empty seats, so you can also play solo
• Auto-reconnect puts players back in their seat after a dropout
• Available in English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean

PRIVACY
No sign-up and no data collection. Games run between your phone and your friends' devices on your local network — nothing goes through an outside server.

TIPS
• Allow Local Network access on first launch so friends can connect
• Keep the app open while hosting; the screen stays on automatically

name: Huanchaco Swell
description:
Huanchaco Swell is an arcade game about the caballitos de totora, the reed boats that fishermen on Peru's north coast still paddle out through the surf, just as the Moche did.

The game opens on the sea at Huanchaco at dawn. Your caballito leaves the line of boats standing upright on the sand. Kneel at the stern and paddle with two buttons, left and right. Keep the rhythm and she picks up speed. When a wave breaks in front of you, swipe up to punch through. Mistime it and the sea throws you back toward the sand.

Past the surf line the pelicans show you where the fish are. Paddle over the shoal, swipe down to drop the net and haul it up before the sea lion gets there. Then swing the bow toward shore, press and hold as the swell lifts your stern, and ride the wave in standing tall. Lean against every wobble. Swell and wind change each day, so no two mornings ride the same.

A reed boat drinks seawater and only lasts a few weeks. In the wachaque, the totora ponds behind the beach, you cut reed, dry it in the sun and bind a new caballito while Don Teodoro grumbles about loose knots. Senora Rosa buys your corvina, lenguado and cachema at her cevicheria on the malecon and pays more when the fish is fresh. Milagros, who rides standing up, sets a new distance dare every day.

Work your way up the coast: Huanchaco, Huanchaquito, Pimentel, Santa Rosa and finally Chicama's long left, each with its own sand, light, crowd and swell. Make a postcard of your finest rides with your own photo on the front and send it to friends.

For anyone who has seen the boats standing on Huanchaco beach and eaten ceviche on the malecon afterwards, and for surf travellers who came north for Chicama.

No accounts, no ads, no purchases. Everything stays on your device.

name: HueTwin: Color Blind Camera
description:
Explore color blindness simulation with your original image always in view.

HueTwin places an original camera image or photo beside your adjusted view, so you can compare changes as you make them. Start with the built-in example, choose a photo, or open the camera. All features are included for free.

COMPARE ORIGINAL AND ADJUSTED VIEWS
Move the split-screen divider or switch to side-by-side and stacked layouts. Freeze a camera frame when you want more time to compare. Your original image stays unchanged.

EXPLORE COLOR VISION SIMULATION
Try Protan, Deutan and Tritan presets, or adjust the simulation axes separately. Compare each effect against the original rather than relying on memory.

FINE-TUNE YOUR COLORS
Open the bottom panel to adjust hue and intensity across six color families: red, yellow, green, cyan, blue and magenta. Use the RGB channel mixer for further adjustments. Enter exact values or make changes in 0.1 steps, then save a settings profile on your device.

CREATE A STORY OR POST
Turn your comparison into a share card showing the image and your selected settings. Choose Story (1080 x 1920) or Post (1080 x 1350), add an optional name, and save or share the result using your device's controls. Example images are clearly labelled.

FREE, WITH ON-DEVICE PROCESSING
No ads, subscriptions, paid unlocks or required account. Camera frames and selected photos are processed on your device. The app does not upload comparison images to the developer. Sharing happens only when you choose a destination.

UNDERSTAND THE LIMITS
HueTwin is a visual exploration tool, not a color vision test, diagnosis, treatment, or correction of color blindness. Single-axis simulations use the Machado-Oliveira-Fernandes model. Combined axes and additional color edits are experimental visual approximations, not measurements of anyone's eyesight. Ask an observer with normal color vision to interpret the comparison. Do not use these effects for medical or safety-critical decisions.

name: Hungry Smoothie
description:
A little garden. A little fruit. A little happiness.

Hungry Smoothie brings a butterfly garden to your table or floor using augmented reality. Find a clear space, plant your garden, and start picking.

PICK YOUR BLEND
Tap bananas, mangoes, strawberries, and blueberries growing in the landscape. A butterfly swoops in, carries each piece, and drops it into your blender. The fruit grows back, so you can keep experimenting.

WATCH IT BLEND
Eight deliveries fill the pitcher and start the blender. Try banana sunshine, blueberry bliss, or a colorful mixed-fruit smoothie.

TIP TO POUR
Tilt your iPhone sideways or forward to pour your smoothie. Watch the liquid drain and stream toward the edge of the screen with playful pouring sounds. Return to your starting hold to pause.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
There are no timers to beat. Make another smoothie, try a new fruit combination, or move your garden to a different spot.

One purchase includes the whole game. No ads, subscriptions, accounts, or in-app purchases. The game runs offline, and camera images and motion readings stay on your iPhone.

Requires an ARKit-compatible iPhone with iOS 18 or later. Use a clear, well-lit table or floor, stay aware of your surroundings, and keep hold of your phone while tipping it.

name: Hushwake: Headphone Alarm
description:
Wake up without waking anyone else.

Hushwake plays your alarm through your headphones or earbuds — and only through them. If your earbuds disconnect in the night, Hushwake goes silent and wakes you with vibration instead. It never switches to the speaker.

• ONLY YOU HEAR IT — Hushwake checks where sound is going before you start, and again the moment the alarm rings. Wired, Bluetooth and USB headphones are all recognised by name.
• WAKE AT A TIME, OR NAP FOR A WHILE — set a clock time like 6:40, or tap a power-nap preset: 10, 20, 26, 45 or 90 minutes. Save your favourites by name.
• STOP IT FROM YOUR EARS — squeeze your earbuds or press the headphone button to stop. Snooze and stop from the lock screen without unlocking.
• WORKS WITH THE SCREEN LOCKED — lock your phone and sleep. Keep listening to music or a podcast while you drift off; it pauses when the alarm rings.
• WAKE GENTLY — soft chimes that rise slowly, with an optional wind-down sound (brown noise, rain, fan) to fall asleep to.
• TEST IN YOUR EARS — hear the real alarm before you sleep, so you know it will work.

Made for partners who wake at different times, dorms and shared rooms, power naps at work or the library, flights, trains and night shifts.

No ads. No subscriptions. No accounts. No tracking. Hushwake doesn't use the network at all.

Buy it once, and sleep on your own schedule.

name: I'm OK Today: Daily Check-in
description:
I'm OK Today is a gentle daily check-in for people who live alone — older adults, people living on their own, or anyone going through a hard time.

ONE BIG BUTTON
• Tap "I'm OK today" once a day and choose how you feel: Good, Okay or Not great
• Optionally tick that you ate, took your medicine and slept okay

GENTLE REMINDERS
• Pick a time and you'll get a reminder each day
• Forgot? You'll be reminded again after 1 hour and 3 hours
• Once you've checked in, today's reminders stop

PEOPLE YOU TRUST
• Add up to 3 trusted contacts from your Contacts or by number
• Call or text them in one tap from the Get help screen
• Send a quick "I'm okay today" text after checking in
• Texts are only sent after you review them — nothing is sent automatically

WHEN TODAY IS HARD
• Choosing "Not great" opens the help screen: your contacts plus local help lines (in Korea: 119, 109 suicide prevention, 1577-0199 mental health crisis, 129 welfare; in the US: 911 and 988)

SEE HOW YOU'VE BEEN
• Last two weeks at a glance, plus your streak

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
• Large, clear buttons and an optional larger-text mode, VoiceOver friendly
• Korean and English
• No ads, no sign-in, no tracking. Everything stays on your device.

I'm OK Today does not contact anyone automatically and is not an emergency service. If you are in danger, call your local emergency number.

name: Iamb: Rhyming Dictionary
description:
Iamb is a rhyming dictionary that also hears the rhythm of your writing.

Search any word and Iamb shows perfect rhymes and near rhymes, grouped by syllables and sorted by how common they are. Every word carries its stress marks, so you can see at a glance which rhymes fit your line. Turn on Same Stress to keep only words with the same beat as yours.

Then write. Switch a poem or lyric to Scan and Iamb marks each syllable as a beat or an off-beat, counts the syllables, names the meter of every line (iambic pentameter, anapestic trimeter and more) and labels the rhyme scheme in color: ABAB, AABBA, whatever you wrote.

RHYMES
- Perfect rhymes and near (slant) rhymes
- Grouped by syllable count, most common words first
- Stress marks on every result
- Filter by length or by matching stress
- Hear any word read aloud, look it up in your device's dictionary, or save it for later

METER
- Stress marks over every syllable of every line
- Syllable count and meter for each line
- Rhyme scheme letters, including near rhymes and eye rhymes
- Tap any word in your poem to see rhymes that keep the beat, and swap it in with one tap

FORMS
Choose a form and Iamb checks your lines against it:
- Sonnet (14 lines, iambic pentameter, ABAB CDCD EFEF GG)
- Limerick (AABBA, anapestic)
- Haiku (5, 7, 5 syllables)
- Ballad stanza (alternating 4 and 3 beats)
- Heroic couplets
- Free verse

Lines that drift from the form are flagged, so you know where to look.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
The whole dictionary lives on your device. Iamb works in airplane mode, has no account and no ads, and nothing you write is ever uploaded.

Made for poets, songwriters, rappers, students of poetry and anyone who wants their lines to land.

Pronunciations come from the CMU Pronouncing Dictionary. Word frequencies are derived from the Google Books Ngram dataset.

name: iCatZone: Cat Health Tracker
description:
Every jab, vet visit and meal, remembered.

iCatZone keeps your cats' vaccinations, vet visits, food and weight in one place, and reminds everyone at home before anything is due. Start straight away, no sign-up needed.

LESS TO KEEP IN YOUR HEAD
Write it down once. iCatZone works out what comes next and tells you in good time.

• Vaccinations: record each dose and iCatZone works out the next one from the booster schedule, or the date your vet gave. You're reminded 30 and 7 days before, then weekly if it slips.
• Vet visits: book the visit and get reminded a week, a day and a few hours before. Afterwards, note what the vet said and the weight. Missed one? Write it down from its papers.
• Food: tell it how much each cat eats a day and it knows when the bag is running low, before the last scoop.
• Weight: a chart for every cat, and a gentle warning if one loses 10% or more in three months.
• Photos and papers: their photos, and a copy of each vaccination card and prescription, kept with their records.
• Clinics nearby: pick from real clinics near you, with directions on the day. Not listed? Suggest yours with a photo and its pin.

SNAP IT, ICATZONE AI FILLS IT IN
No more typing from a crumpled vaccination card. Take one photo of a vaccination card, a prescription or vet bill, or your cat. iCatZone AI reads each dose and its next due date, the medicines and how often to give them, the clinic, even which cat it is about. Nothing is saved until you check it, and you can keep a copy of the papers with the records.

THE WHOLE HOUSEHOLD, ON THE SAME PAGE
Invite family or housemates by email. Everyone sees the same cats and gets the same reminders, as a notification on their phone and by email, so the vet visit is never one person's job to remember.
• Accept an invitation right in the app
• More than one home? Switch between households in a tap
• Visits and due dates in your phone's calendar, too

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, and we never sell your data. Photos are private to your household and never on a public link. Photos you scan are read only to fill in your records, never to train AI.

Start without an account. Add your email whenever you like, to keep your cats if you change phones and to invite others. Nothing you added is lost.

Questions or ideas? We'd love to hear from you at icatzone.com/support

name: IceMelt: Drive Salt Bags
description:
IceMelt turns a driveway or walkway into an ice-melt bag count before the freeze.

Pick Drive or Walk, set length and width, slide salt coverage from light glaze to heavy ice, and read bags to buy on the same screen. Save the plan, track bags on hand, and open past jobs when you restock.

Built for homeowners and small facilities crews who stage salt before a storm — not a weather forecast, not a generic calculator.

• Surface — segmented Drive / Walk, area inputs, coverage slider, live bag total
• Bags — on-hand stock plus saved melt plans with detail
• More — default bag size, privacy, support

Works fully offline. No accounts, ads, or subscriptions.

name: IM. SCAN: LiDAR 3D Scanner
description:
IM. SCAN turns an iPhone or iPad with a LiDAR sensor into a tool for site measurement and as-built surveys. Scan a room, a structure or a site and get a true-scale 3D model with photo textures, measurements, a drawing, a PDF report and files for CAD.

Built for contractors, site inspectors, surveyors, designers and anyone who needs accurate dimensions without a tape measure or repeat site visits.

• Photo-textured 3D model, levelled to true horizontal using gravity
• Live coverage highlighting while scanning: see what is captured and where to point the camera next
• Large-area capture and merging of several scans of one site into a single model using targets
• Georeferencing to project coordinates
• Automatic floor plan: walls, doors, windows, openings, furniture
• Chain dimensions, area, perimeter, ceiling height
• 3D room model with cut-away walls for an overhead view
• Floor plan export to DXF, room model to IFC and STEP
• Length, height, height above floor, area
• Surface flatness check using the 2-metre straightedge method

• Import a design model in IFC, DXF, OBJ, STL or PLY
• Align it with the scan and get a colour deviation map, as-built vs design, in millimetres
• Results for every element: wall, slab, column

REPORTS
• PDF report with a photo sheet: you choose the views for the figures
• Measurements drawn right on the figures, numbered to match the table
• Title page with site, author and company

EXPORT
• DXF: opens in desktop CAD software
• IFC, STEP: for BIM and solid modelling
• OBJ and USDZ with photo textures, STL, coloured PLY point cloud
• Move projects to another device with AirDrop or the Files app

CONVENIENCE
• Demo projects: explore the features before your first scan
• View and measure finished models on devices without LiDAR
• Metric and imperial units, English and Russian interface
• Projects are stored on your device
• No ads

REQUIREMENTS
Scanning requires an iPhone Pro or iPad Pro with a LiDAR sensor. Viewing, measuring and exporting finished projects also work on other devices.

IMPORTANT
Model accuracy depends on scanning conditions: lighting, distance and surface materials. IM. SCAN is not a certified measuring instrument; use calibrated instruments for acceptance inspections.

All other names used in the app belong to their respective owners. IM. SCAN is not affiliated with these companies.

name: Imap Mail
description:
ImapMail is a simple, private email app that connects directly to your mailbox.

There is no ImapMail server in between: your messages travel straight from your mail provider to your device over an encrypted TLS connection. We don't collect, store or see your email, your password or your contacts.

WORKS WITH YOUR MAILBOX
• Any IMAP/SMTP account — popular providers or your own domain
• Server settings are detected automatically from your address
• Manual settings for custom servers and ports
• Multiple accounts, switch with one tap

A CLEAN, FAST INBOX
• Unread, flagged and folder views at a glance
• Search the messages you've loaded
• Inbox, Sent, Drafts, Archive, Junk, Trash and your own folders
• Light and Dark Mode

READ AND WRITE
• Rich HTML and plain-text messages
• Remote images blocked by default to protect your privacy — show them when you choose
• Reply, reply all and forward
• Attach files and save attachments

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Direct, encrypted connection to your provider
• Your password stays in the iOS Keychain
• No analytics, no ads, no tracking

ImapMail is also available for Mac.

name: İmsakiye+
description:
Ramazan Rehberi: İmsakiye, Kıble ve Oruç Takibi

Ramazan ayının manevi huzurunu hayatınıza taşımak ve ibadetlerinizi en düzenli şekilde takip etmek için tasarlanmış en kapsamlı Ramazan uygulaması ile tanışın! Modern arayüzü, zengin içeriği ve tamamen kişiselleştirilebilir yapısıyla bu mübarek ay boyunca en büyük yardımcınız olacak.

ÖNE ÇIKAN ÖZELLİKLERİMİZ:

• Kişiselleştirilebilir Temalar: Uygulamayı ilk açtığınız andan itibaren kendi tarzınızı yansıtın! Seçtiğiniz temaya göre tüm sayfaların arka planları değişir, size özel bir görsel deneyim sunar.
• Geri Sayım Sayacı (Ana Sayfa): İftar ve sahur vakitlerine ne kadar zaman kaldığını anlık olarak ana ekranınızdan takip edin.
• Günün Hadis ve Ayeti: Her güne özel olarak seçilen ayet ve hadislerle manevi dünyanızı zenginleştirin, tefekkür edin.
• Özel Nostaljik Bildirim Sesleri: İftar ve sahur vakitlerini sıradan seslerle değil; Ramazan topu, Ramazan davulu veya ezan sesi gibi geleneksel seslerle haber alın. İstemediğiniz bildirimleri ayarlardan kolayca kapatın.
• Akıllı Dini Günler Hatırlatıcısı: Yıllara göre güncellenen dini günleri inceleyin. Kadir Gecesi gibi mübarek zamanlardan 1 gün önce özel bildirimler alarak hazırlığınızı yapın.
• Detaylı İmsakiye: Yaşadığınız yılın tüm Ramazan takvimini, imsak ve iftar vakitlerini tek bir ekranda, imsakiye formatında net bir şekilde görüntüleyin.
• Gelişmiş Oruç Takibi: Ramazan boyunca tuttuğunuz oruçları gün gün kaydedin, geriye dönük takibinizi kolayca yapın.
• Hassas Kıble Pusulası: Bulunduğunuz konuma göre Kabe'nin yönünü kesin olarak tespit edin, seyahatte bile kıblenizi güvenle bulun.
• Gelişmiş Ayarlar Menüsü: Tüm fonksiyonları, sesleri ve bildirim zamanlarını kendi ibadet rutininize göre tamamen özelleştirin.

Ramazan ayını daha organize, huzurlu ve bilinçli geçirmek için uygulamayı hemen indirin.

Hayırlı Ramazanlar dileriz!

name: InGate Captain
description:
inGate Captain هو التطبيق الخاص بالكباتن في خدمة inGate لتوصيل الرحلات والطلبات داخل الكمبوند وحوله.

مع التطبيق تقدر:
• تستقبل طلبات الرحلات والتوصيل القريبة منك لحظة بلحظة
• تقبل الرحلة وتتابع مسارها من نقطة الانطلاق حتى الوصول
• تستقبل إشعارات فورية بأي طلب جديد
• تتابع رحلاتك السابقة وتفاصيل كل رحلة
• تعرف أرباحك ومستحقات الشركة من محفظتك داخل التطبيق
• تدير بياناتك الشخصية وبيانات مركبتك بسهولة

كيف تبدأ؟
سجّل حسابك وارفع المستندات المطلوبة وصورة المركبة. بعد مراجعة بياناتك وتفعيل حسابك من فريقنا تقدر تبدأ باستقبال الطلبات.

خصوصيتك مهمة: يمكنك حذف حسابك في أي وقت من داخل التطبيق.

للدعم والاستفسارات: https://ingateapp.tech/support

name: InkTick
description:
InkTick 是兼容墨水屏终端的管理与维护工具。通过 iPhone 或 iPad 连接设备，完成 Wi-Fi 配置、连接维护、屏幕方向与本地文字设置。

账号设备管理
使用用户名或邮箱与密码登录。首次注册及忘记密码时可用邮箱验证码验证身份。一个账号可管理多台设备，每台设备分别保存显示设置。

后台扩展显示内容
在用户中心为设备选择管理员已发布的界面、行情品种、数量与刷新规则。界面和内容目录可由后台持续扩充，兼容能力以设备固件为准。云端位图界面和安全实体认领需要对应固件；旧设备可经管理员核实后迁移，并继续使用兼容显示方式。

本地连接与维护
核心蓝牙配网与文字功能无需登录。Wi-Fi 密码经加密蓝牙交给设备，不通过账号服务上传。深度休眠中的设备需要等唤醒后才能连接或应用云端设置。

需要使用本项目适配固件的兼容 ESP32 墨水屏硬件。支持设备及使用说明请访问帮助网站。行情供信息展示，来源时间和可用情况以对应数据服务为准。

name: Inky - E-Ink NFC Designer
description:
Say hello to Inky, your new e-ink sidekick!

Inky puts your photos, cartoons and little messages on battery-free NFC e-ink tags, straight from your iPhone. Pick a picture, make it yours, then hold your iPhone to the tag. It powers up, draws the picture and keeps showing it with no battery at all.

PICK SOMETHING
• Any photo from your library chosen with Apple's private photo picker, or choose from stock photos, cartoon pals or ready-made designs: name badges, pixel art and patterns

MAKE IT YOURS
• See your original and the finished tag side by side as you edit
• Zoom, move, rotate, brighten and add contrast
• Ink Tag redraws photos in black, white, yellow and red, using fine dots to keep the detail
• Remix the colours: swap any ink in a design for another in a tap

TAP TO SEND
• Hold the top of your iPhone against the tag and keep still for a few seconds
• No battery, no charging, no pairing and no cables
• The picture stays on the tag until you send a new one

MADE FOR YOUR TAG
• Reads the tag's screen size and colours automatically
• Works with four-colour (black, white, yellow and red) and black and white tags, such as popular 1.54 inch 200 by 200 pixel NFC e-ink tags
• Tag tools show screen details and a log if anything needs troubleshooting

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Ink Tag collects no data at all. There are no accounts, no ads, no analytics and no tracking. The app never connects to the internet. Your photos are converted on your iPhone and sent only to your tag.

Inky needs an NFC e-ink tag, sold separately. Inky is an independent app and is not affiliated with any tag manufacturer.

Support URL: https://inky-app.site/support
Privacy Policy URL: https://inky-app.site/privacy

name: Instadriv
description:
Instadriv: everything that matters in the world of cars.
Find your next car among new and used cars, including ones available in installments, list your car for sale, and follow daily market prices and the latest news.

* FEATURES *

- Follow the latest car news in Egypt.
- Find your car with filters for brand, model, year, price, mileage, city, body type, transmission, fuel and color.
- Browse new and used cars for sale, and see which ones are available in installments.
- Check used-car market prices by brand, model and year, updated daily.

- Save the cars you like to Favorites.
- Share cars with your friends.

Toyota, Hyundai, Kia, Nissan, Chevrolet, Renault, Peugeot, Opel, Skoda, MG, Chery, Jetour, Geely, BYD, Mercedes, BMW and more than 90 brands.

Instadriv is available in Egypt.

Like the app? Rate us on the store.
