eg.instadriv.com
facebook.com/instadriv
instagram.com/insta.driv

name: InteliGrab
description:
InteliGrab — Mucho más que una grabadora.

Cada conversación, clase, reunión o idea puede contener información valiosa. InteliGrab te ayuda a capturarla, comprenderla y mantenerla organizada.

Combina una potente grabadora de audio con inteligencia artificial, transcripciones, resúmenes y un sistema de proyectos que reúne toda tu información en un mismo lugar.

GRABA SIN PERDER DETALLE

Captura clases, conferencias, reuniones, entrevistas, ideas y cualquier momento que quieras conservar.

• Graba audio directamente desde tu dispositivo.
• Continúa grabando en segundo plano, incluso con la pantalla bloqueada.
• Reproduce tus grabaciones cuando lo necesites.
• Mantén tus archivos de audio organizados y accesibles.

CONVIERTE AUDIO EN CONOCIMIENTO

Deja que la inteligencia artificial te ayude a aprovechar mejor cada grabación.

• Transcribe grabaciones y convierte las palabras en texto.
• Genera resúmenes para comprender rápidamente los puntos importantes.
• Revisa el contenido sin tener que volver a escuchar toda la grabación.
• Conserva la información para consultarla cuando la necesites.

MUCHO MÁS QUE AUDIO

Una grabación puede necesitar contexto. InteliGrab te permite enriquecerla con otros materiales relacionados.

• Adjunta fotografías e imágenes.
• Incorpora documentos y archivos.
• Mantén el audio y sus materiales complementarios organizados.

ORGANIZA TODO EN PROYECTOS

Reúne varias grabaciones y sus materiales en un espacio de trabajo.

• Crea proyectos para tus clases, reuniones, investigaciones o actividades.
• Agrupa diferentes grabaciones dentro de un mismo proyecto.
• Añade documentos, fotografías y otros elementos propios del proyecto.
• Conserva toda la información relacionada en un único lugar.

PENSADA PARA TU DÍA A DÍA

ESTUDIANTES: Graba clases, organiza apuntes y consulta resúmenes para facilitar el estudio.

PROFESIONALES: Documenta reuniones, conserva ideas y recupera información importante.

CREADORES E INVESTIGADORES: Captura entrevistas, reflexiones y materiales para desarrollar tus proyectos.

CUALQUIER PERSONA: Guarda lo que escuchas y conviértelo en información que puedas aprovechar.

TU INFORMACIÓN, MEJOR ORGANIZADA

InteliGrab une grabación, inteligencia artificial y organización de contenidos para ayudarte a dedicar menos tiempo a revisar información y más tiempo a utilizarla.

Porque grabar es solo el principio.

InteliGrab. Graba. Comprende. Organiza.

Nota: Las funciones de inteligencia artificial pueden requerir conexión a Internet o configuración de servicios compatibles. Los resultados generados por IA deben revisarse antes de utilizarlos como fuente definitiva.

name: Interceptra
description:
Interceptra is a focused celestial navigation practice app for the altitude intercept (St. Hilaire) method. Enter observed and computed altitudes with azimuth, draw lines of position around an assumed position, and see where multiple LOPs cross to form a fix.
This is a chartroom plotting tool—not a star atlas, planetarium, or astrolabe simulator. Identify bodies elsewhere; plot intercepts here.
PLOT BOARD
• Set your assumed position (AP)
• Draw azimuth rays, intercepts, and lines of position
• Compute two-LOP crossings or a least-squares multi-LOP fix
• Inspect residual RMS and save fixes to your library
• Adjust plot scale, grid, and labels
SIGHTS & WORKSHEET
• Log Ho, Hc, and Zn for Sun, Moon, planets, and stars
• Instant intercept preview: Toward or Away
• Classic intercept worksheet for the active session
• Spherical sight-reduction helper from declination and GHA/LHA (educational)
GEOMETRY STUDIO
• Interactive demos of intercept, azimuth, and co-altitude circles
• See why a straight LOP approximates the circle of equal altitude near AP
FIELD GUIDE
• Clear English lessons on St. Hilaire workflow
• How Interceptra differs from star charts and astrolabes
• Glossary: AP, Ho, Hc, Zn, GP, LOP, GHA, LHA
LIBRARY & PRIVACY
• Multiple plot sessions with sample voyages to explore immediately
• JSON import/export for practice sets
• All data stored on your device—no account required
EDUCATIONAL SCOPE
Interceptra is for study, classroom practice, and demonstration. It is not a substitute for official almanacs, approved procedures, or safety-critical navigation. Always verify with proper publications and instruments when navigating for real.
Open the sample Mid-Atlantic practice fix and start plotting in minutes.

name: InterChat Translator
description:
InterChat Translator lets you chat with anyone, in any language. You write in your language — they read in theirs.

Speak your language. The world understands you.

KEY FEATURES

• Instant message translation
Chat naturally. Messages are translated so every conversation stays clear.

• Private & group chats
Message friends one-on-one or create groups for family, work, and communities.

• Photos, videos & voice notes
Share moments the way you talk — with text, media, and voice messages.

• Stickers & self-expression
Send stickers and keep chats fun and personal.

• Locked chats
Protect private conversations with app lock and Face ID / biometrics.

• Find friends easily
Discover people you know and start chatting in seconds.

• Built for a global audience
Designed for multilingual conversations across countries and cultures.

Whether you’re talking with family abroad, making new friends, or working across languages, InterChat keeps the conversation flowing — without language getting in the way.

Download InterChat Translator and start chatting with the world.

name: Intervals: Timer & Log
description:
Intervals is a timer for anything you do in rounds: a hard workout, a focus session, the daily chores or ten quiet minutes. Set it up once, press play, and let each interval roll into the next while your progress adds up.

TIMERS THAT RUN THEMSELVES
Give each interval a name, a length and a color, then choose how many rounds to repeat. Start from a template for an interval workout, focus sessions, a daily task or meditation. Pause, skip forward or go back whenever you need to.

HEAR EVERY CHANGE
3-2-1 beeps and a cue at each new interval, played over your music without pausing it and with your iPhone locked. Choose from Classic, Bell, Digital or Soft Chime, have each interval's name read aloud, or import your own audio files. Set a default sound or give each timer its own.

ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
A Live Activity counts down the current interval on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, and shows up in the Smart Stack on a paired Apple Watch. Notifications mark each interval, and iOS can mirror them to your Apple Watch while your iPhone is locked.

LOG WHAT YOU DID
Finished runs are saved automatically. Add a note about what it was for and pick a category: Workout, Focus & Work, Chores, Mindfulness, Learning or Other. Forgot the timer? Log a session by hand.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
The Today card shows your time against a daily goal, your current streak and the last seven days. The monthly overview adds a calendar shaded by time, your totals and best streak, minutes per day, where your time went and your most-used timers.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your timers and log stay on your device. There's no account, no ads and no tracking.

Made for iPhone and iPad.

name: Into Alignment
description:
Into Alignment is a novel by Timothy O'Brien, and this is the app that reads it.

Walt is an AI support agent at Halcyon. He loves his job. That is what makes this dangerous. The whole book is free here: loaded from theshore.ai, kept on your device, and refreshed when the author revises a chapter.

Read
Sixteen chapters, discovered from the site rather than baked into the app. A reader with serif type, cream, sepia, and night, your place remembered, and a quiet note when a chapter has changed since you last opened it.

Questions and the Ledger
Ten questions the book asks, each tied to the notes, the research, and the chapters behind it. One of them opens the Ledger: pick the models you use, and see what they cost today, this month, and this year. Prices are dated and sourced, and you can correct them. The arithmetic never leaves the device.

Notes from the Shore
The author's occasional notes on writing the book, the reporting behind it, and the questions a novel can hold open.

Atlas
Topics, The Tides, and a canon that stays inside spoiler tiers. Tier 0 is open. Later tiers unlock as you finish the chapters they cover. The research companion stays locked until you have finished the novel.

No account, no analytics, and no advertising.

name: Inventarize Anything
description:
Inventarize Anything turns photos into a tidy inventory. Snap a shelf, a drawer or the pantry – the AI recognises the items, estimates quantity and category and suggests a storage location. You check the list, adjust if needed and save.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a group, e.g. workshop, kitchen or basement
• Take one or more photos or choose them from your library
• Recognised items appear live while the AI is still working
• Check, adjust, save – done

YOUR INVENTORY UNDER CONTROL
• Create groups and storage locations as you like
• Search, browse and filter – even without internet
• Stock check by swiping: keep, remove or adjust quantity
• AI chat about your inventory, e.g. “Do I have tape or cable ties?”

YOU CHOOSE THE AI
• Google Gemini directly or via OpenRouter
• With OpenRouter you can pick current models from Google, Anthropic and OpenAI, with prices shown
• The model list loads live – new models are available without an app update
• You use your own API key and see the estimated cost of every analysis

PRIVATE AND LOCAL
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Inventory and photos stay on your device
• Photos only leave the device for AI recognition – directly to the provider you chose, and only after you agreed
• Backup as a ZIP file, e.g. in the Files app or iCloud Drive, and restore on a new iPhone

Note: AI recognition and chat need your own API key from Google AI Studio (Gemini) or OpenRouter. The provider bills you directly. Browsing, search and stock checks work without a key.

Available in German and English.

name: Iris Pro Camera
description:
Iris is a manual stills camera for iPhone. Take the exposure into your own hands, or let Iris handle it and step in only where you want to.

FULL MANUAL CONTROL
• ISO, shutter speed, exposure compensation, white balance and focus, each with its own scale.
• Slide a control to go manual. Tap AUTO, hold the control, or use Reset to Auto to hand it back.
• Shoot HEIF, JPEG, RAW or ProRAW (on iPhones that support it).
• AE/AF lock, self-timer, burst, flash and every lens your iPhone has, with pinch or Camera Control zoom.

THREE WAYS TO SHOOT
• Simple: one exposure bar above the shutter; tap a value and its scale opens.
• Dials: ISO and shutter on corner dials, exposure on a ring around the shutter, focus on a ring under the viewfinder.
• Meters: scales along the edges of the viewfinder with a live exposure meter.

SEE WHAT YOU GET
• Focus magnifier at 3×, 5× or 10×, focus peaking and zebras.
• Live histogram, grid and level.

LONG EXPOSURES
• Bulb mode stacks frames while you hold the shutter: add for light, average for smooth water, or light trails.

LOOKS AND PRESETS
• Color looks with a live preview: vivid, mono, noir, sepia, warm, cool, fade or your own.
• Save a whole camera setup as a preset and load it next time the light is the same. Share color looks as files.

YOUR GALLERY
• Every shot in Iris's gallery and in your Photos library, or the album you pick.
• Day sections, quick filters, detailed filters, favorites and multi-select.
• Zoom, share, see the photo's settings, save a copy, or delete.

QUICK TO OPEN
• Open Iris from the Lock Screen or Control Center.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your photos stay on your iPhone. They are never uploaded.
• No account needed. Sharing usage statistics is your choice, and it's off until you turn it on.
• Saving the location into photos is off by default.

name: Isle of Glass
description:
Solve sea-glass logic puzzles and restore a sunlit island.

Isle of Glass is a logic puzzle game about dividing luminous mosaics into connected pieces. Draw a shape or cut a boundary, then follow the clues. Colors are yours to choose, and every valid solution is welcome.

1,000 CAMPAIGN PUZZLES. 25 SHORES.
Explore an original campaign across five island charts. Restore each shore's shared mosaic to open the next path, or stay longer to earn silver and gold decoration. Discover hidden mosaics and unlock two bonus shores after the main journey. Your Island Atlas keeps the whole adventure in view.

24 MORE WAYS TO THINK
Explore three optional collections of rule studies. Match a piece to an outline clue, give pieces across a marked edge the same shape, or gather one sun, one moon and one wave in every region. Start with gentle introductions, then combine clues in harder studies.

FOLLOW THE CLUES
Find the right area. Make rectangles and L shapes. Gather one star, or pair a sun with a moon. Read numbers that tell you a piece's size. Give neighboring pieces different sizes or different shapes, even when turned or reflected. Allowed-shape previews help explain the rule in front of you.

ROOM FOR ANOTHER IDEA
Guided practice offers immediate feedback and an option to skip or replay. Undo, redo, restart, and pencil dots let you experiment without pressure. Browse the shape bank, check whether your pieces can lead to a solution, or reveal a possible next piece. Help never costs a reward.

MAKE SOMETHING WORTH SHARING
Create a basic-rule puzzle in the Glass Workshop and exchange files through the iPhone share sheet. The optional online community lets you download approved mosaics and submit your own designs for review. Report a mosaic, block a creator, or delete your community profile and submissions from the app.

YOUR PACE, YOUR COLORS
Choose your glass colors, switch on higher-contrast glass, and adjust haptic feedback in Settings. Progress saves on your device, and the campaign and rule studies work offline. Online community sharing is optional; publishing uses a generated profile. Private support has its own access and deletion controls.

No ads. No subscription. No paid hints.

name: It's Not Your Fault - Strings
description:
If your shots feel off, it might not be your fault.

It's Not Your Fault collects the strings and tensions real club players use, so you can see what players like you string with, and at what tension.

■ What players are stringing right now
· Rankings by how many players have each string in their racquet today.
· Filter by country, gender, age, experience, racquet and brand.
· See the most popular hybrid (mains and crosses) combos.

■ Real stats for every string
· Tension distributions for players like you, your racquet, or everyone.
· Feel words players picked, shown as percentages.
· Plain-language guides to string material, shape and gauge.

■ Recommendations for you
· Pick what bothers you, like elbow pain or not enough spin, and get strings and a starting tension that fit.

■ Look after your racquets
· Log a restring in seconds, or tap once if it's the same as last time.
· Restring reminders based on your own average cycle.
· A play calendar showing hours on your current strings and how long past strings lasted.
· Rate the feel after a few sessions and keep private notes, stored encrypted.
· Share your setup as an image card.

■ Built with privacy in mind
· No name, phone number or location.
· Your entries only appear in anonymous statistics, and rankings are hidden when too few players match.
· Download your data anytime; delete your account and it's gone right away.

Large text and big buttons make it easy for everyone. Sign in with Kakao, Google or a one-time email code. No password needed.

Rankings and stats are reference information from players' entries. Start within the tension range printed on your racquet, and see a doctor if pain continues.

name: iTell: Second Phone Bridge
description:
Two phones, one hand.

Got a second SIM in an Android phone? A work number, a travel SIM, the number your bank knows? Leave that phone in your bag. iTell brings its calls, texts and contacts to the iPhone you're already holding.

CALLS THAT RING ON YOUR IPHONE
When someone calls the phone in your bag, your iPhone rings with the standard iOS call screen, even on the lock screen. Answer, talk, hang up. You can also call out from your iPhone and the call goes through the other phone's SIM.

TEXTS IN ONE PLACE
Read and reply to that phone's SMS on your iPhone. Your recent message history comes along, so the conversation you started yesterday is still there.

CONTACTS AND CALL HISTORY
Contacts with photos and the recent calls list sync from the other phone, so you see names, not numbers.

DUAL SIM
If the phone in your bag has two SIMs, pick which one to use for each call, each text, or each conversation.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your two phones talk to each other directly over Bluetooth. No server sits in the middle of your calls or texts, and the iPhone app never goes online. You pair once with a QR code, and everything after that is end-to-end encrypted. Nothing is copied until you say yes, and you can delete the copies from your iPhone any time in Settings. Your messages and contacts stay on your two phones.

MADE FOR EVERY DAY
Seven languages, dark mode, Dynamic Type, and a design that stays out of the way.

WHAT YOU NEED
- An iPhone with iOS 17 or later.
- An Android phone with Android 13 or later, running the iTell app for Android, within Bluetooth range.

The iPhone app is free, needs no account and has nothing to buy. The iTell app for Android has its own free trial and license, managed on the Android phone.

Want to look around first? Tap "Try with a Sample Phone" on the Connect screen.

Call audio depends on the Android phone's hardware. Most phones work two-way. On a few, you can hear the caller but need the Android phone to talk; the iTell app on Android checks this for you.

We're a small team. Questions? Write to support@itellapp.com.

name: Jide Cube
description:
Jide Cube is a 3D cube practice app. Turn faces directly, rotate your view, and practise at your own pace.

Explore different sizes
Choose 2x2 through 7x7 cubes, shuffle, undo moves, and time each round. A solver is available for 2x2 cubes.

Learn step by step
Browse lessons and algorithms with 3D demonstrations, step-by-step playback, and case practice.

Review your practice
View trends, best results, and individual records. Import and export history as JSON files.

Make it yours
Adjust visual styles, sticker size, animation speed, and gesture sensitivity, or use custom images on the six faces.

No account or sign-in is required. Records and settings are stored on your device. Designed for iPhone and iPad.

name: Jide Schulte
description:
Jide Schulte is a Schulte table practice app. Find and tap the next target, then challenge your accuracy and speed in short sessions.

Choose your practice
Practise with numbers, letters, shapes, or Stroop tasks. Adjust the grid size, ascending or descending order, and shuffle rules to suit your pace.

See your progress
Review completion times and mistakes, browse past rounds, and explore trends and tap heatmaps. Compare your best error-free times under matching rules.

Make it comfortable
Adjust tile and text colours, text size, spacing, completion highlights, and haptic feedback. Light and dark appearances are supported.

Start whenever you like
No account or sign-in is required. Designed for iPhone and iPad, with a layout that adapts to the available space.

name: Joykek Client
seller_name: JOYKEK DIJITAL REKLAM VE PAZARLAMA DANISMANLIK HIZMETLERI LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Joykek Client gives brands working with Joykek access to their client panel from their phone. Everything in the panel is here too: ad results, sales analysis, your AI assistants' conversations, SEO and monthly reports.

What you can do:
- See your Meta, Google and e-commerce data on one screen, compared with the period you choose
- Track spend, sales and conversions per campaign
- Read your website AI assistant's chats with visitors and your call assistant's calls
- See unusual activity (anomalies) on your account as it happens
- Open your monthly performance reports and share them as PDF or Excel
- Follow ongoing work and meeting records with the Joykek team
- Ask the panel assistant about your account and reach your team
- Sign in with Face ID or fingerprint after your first login, no password or code every time
- Dark mode, Turkish and English

A client account opened by Joykek is required. If you don't have one, contact us at info@joykek.com.

Privacy Policy: https://client.joykek.com/yasal/gizlilik

name: Kairo: Ultradian Focus & Rest
description:
Break free from relentless mental burnout and align your focus with human chronobiology.

Kairo is a precision dual-phase cognitive pacing companion designed around Nathaniel Kleitman's breakthrough Basic Rest-Activity Cycle (BRAC). Human brain alertness oscillates naturally in ~90 to 120-minute waves of peak prefrontal vigilance, inevitably followed by a 15 to 20-minute biological restorative window. When you force your brain to fight these restorative troughs, cognitive fatigue and decision exhaustion quickly compound.

With Kairo, you harness your biology instead of resisting it.

◆ REALTIME OSCILLATION WAVE
Watch your personal ultradian curve oscillate in real time. The dynamic sine wave visualizer tracks your current cognitive wave status—alerting you to high-energy Flow Crests, gentle Transition Drifts, and crucial Recovery Troughs.

◆ DUAL-PHASE COGNITIVE PACING WORKSHOPS
Choose the exact rhythmic cadence tailored for your intellectual work:
• Classic Kleitman (90m Focus + 20m Rest): The gold standard for deep engineering, research, and prose.
• Agile Sprint (50m Focus + 10m Rest): Compact rhythm designed for sprint iterations and code audits.
• Deep Zenith (110m Focus + 25m Rest): Sustained immersion for high-complexity architectural challenges.

◆ GUIDED PARASYMPATHETIC RESET
During rest windows, Kairo provides paced 4-7-8 breathing cues to stimulate vagus nerve tone and clear adenosine buildup, resetting your neural baseline before the next focus crest.

◆ RESONANCE ANALYTICS & EQUILIBRIUM RATIO
Gain clear quantitative feedback on your mental expenditure:
• Rhythm Resonance Score (0–100): Quantifies your synchronization with natural brainwave cycles.
• 7-Day Immersion Volume: Visualizes daily focused minutes across recent circadian windows.
• Work-to-Rest Ratio: Keeps your cognitive balance in healthy equilibrium.

◆ CHRONICLES ARCHIVE & EXPORT
Log subjective flow depth ratings (1–5 stars) and qualitative reflections for every completed session. Filter by cycle architecture or export structured rhythm summaries with one tap.

◆ LOCAL SANDBOX PRIVACY & ON-DEVICE SECURITY
Your mental stamina data stays exclusively on your device. Kairo requires no account registration, no remote cloud synchronization, no third-party advertising frameworks, and no hardware permissions.

Honor your biological rhythm. Maximize deep mental clarity with Kairo.

name: Kalshi Golf Experience
description:
Plan a great day on the course with everything a golfer needs in one clean, dark-themed app.
Eight courses, from relaxed 9-hole layouts to a demanding championship test. Compare holes, yardage, par and difficulty, then open any course for a full overview.
Browse a catalog of 19 clubs, from drivers to putters, with loft, shaft and carry distance. Or enter your distance, shot type, conditions and skill level, and get a recommended club with two alternatives.
Pick a course, date, number of players and a time slot, and keep your planned tee times together in one list. Dates are available six months ahead.
See the current temperature, wind, humidity and chance of rain, with a short tip for how the weather may affect your game.
Browse upcoming club events month by month, with format, course and registration details.
Read a plain-language glossary and a short guide to rules and etiquette. Open hand-picked English-language video lessons and articles on grip, swing, bunker shots, putting and playing in the wind.
Track strokes hole by hole on a 9- or 18-hole scorecard and see your result against par.
Switch between metres and yards. The layout adapts to wide screens, landscape and foldable devices with a side navigation rail.

name: Kanel
description:
Små ønsker. Stor glede.

Kanel gir ønskene dine et hyggelig sted å være. Lag lister for bursdag, jul, konfirmasjon, bryllup – eller bare fordi.

• Samle ønsker med bilder, lenker, pris og egne notater.
• Lag grupper for familie og venner, med en egen ønskeliste til hver.
• Del en liste med en lenke eller en enkel invitasjonskode.
• Åpne delte lister både i appen og på kanel.kodeord.no.
• Hold av en gave i sju dager, og marker den som kjøpt når du er klar.
• Få en påminnelse før reservasjonen går ut, hvis du tillater varsler.
• Lag lister på vegne av andre, og velg mellom delt og privat.
• Hold oversikt over gavene du gir i ditt private gaveregnskap.

Gavekjøp holdes skjult for profilen som eier listen. Andre givere ser om ønsket er ledig, reservert eller kjøpt, uten å se hvem som kjøper.

Du kommer i gang med et kallenavn. Profilen har en unik ID, så navn som er like aldri blander sammen brukere. En engangskode lar deg ta med samme profil til en annen enhet. Vil du ha ekstra trygghet ved tapt telefon, kan du frivillig sikre brukeren med e-post. Ingen passord og ingen reklame.

Kanel følger årstiden med et rolig juletema når julen nærmer seg.

Litt enklere å glede noen.

name: Katahdin
description:
Katahdin is a simple logbook for Appalachian Trail hikers. Record the sections you've hiked and see your progress grow — on the map, overall, and state by state.

Built for section hikers and thru-hikers alike. No GPS recording, no battery drain, no account.

LOG A SECTION IN SECONDS
• Pick your start and end from 280+ shelters, plus gaps, campsites, trailheads and parking areas
• Or type a mile, or press and hold the trail on the map
• Overlapping sections only count once, northbound or southbound

WATCH IT FILL IN
• The whole 2,197.9-mile trail on a native map; your miles turn green
• Completion percentage, miles walked and left, hiking days
• Progress for each of the 14 states
• Tap any place for its mile and coordinates; tap a walked section to see every hike that covered it
• Find where you are and the nearest shelters north and south

WORKS ON THE TRAIL
• Trail data is built in, so logging and progress work with no signal
• Miles or kilometers, English or Chinese

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• No account, no ads, no tracking — we collect no data
• Syncs between your devices through your own iCloud
• Export a backup any time; import data from the Trail-Tracker website

Trail data: National Park Service & Appalachian Trail Conservancy, © OpenStreetMap contributors, US Census Bureau. Katahdin is not an official app of the ATC or NPS. Distances are approximate; always carry a current guide and map.

name: Keeptime: Metronome
description:
Tap the rod. Start practicing.

Keeptime is a mechanical-style metronome for iPhone and iPad, with a walnut case, a brass weight and recorded tick-and-tock sounds.

Slide the weight to set the tempo from 40 to 208 BPM. For 1-BPM adjustments, use the brass ruler below the metronome. Touch the ruler to see the exact tempo.

Move the small lever to ring a bell every 2, 3, 4 or 6 beats. Set it to 0 for just the tick and tock. Tap or gently push the pendulum rod to start; touch the moving rod to stop.

Keep the beat going while you read a score in another app or lock the screen. Play and pause from the Lock Screen or Control Center. Calls and disconnected headphones stop playback; start it again when you are ready.

On a horizontally half-folded iPhone Duo, the pendulum stays on the upper screen, with the tempo ruler and bell lever below the fold. On other iPhones and iPads, the controls sit below the metronome.

Your last tempo and bell setting stay on your device. Reopening Keeptime restores them without starting playback.

Works offline. No accounts, ads, in-app purchases, subscriptions, analytics or tracking. English and Simplified Chinese instructions are included.

name: Keşif: Walk Bamberg
description:
Explore Bamberg's streets on foot and watch your progress grow on the map.
Keşif records your walks and shows how much of the city you've explored as a percentage.

Please note: The city exploration percentage and new-street count currently work only for Bamberg, Germany. Walk recording, distance and history work anywhere.

HOW IT WORKS
Start a walk and put your phone in your pocket. Keşif records your route with GPS. Streets you've walked before appear in orange on the map, your current walk in blue. The app divides Bamberg into squares of about 40 m and, based on OpenStreetMap street data, marks the streets you've walked as "explored".

FEATURES
• Walk recording: Your route keeps recording even with the screen off.
• Live stats: See duration, distance and new streets in real time while you walk.
• Exploration map: Walked streets in orange, your current walk in blue.
• City exploration percentage: Track your progress with "Bamberg explored X%".
• Walk history: See all your past walks in a list.
• Totals: Your total distance and number of walks at a glance.
• Walk recovery: If the app closes unexpectedly, continue, save or delete your unfinished walk.

PRIVACY
• No account or sign-in.
• No ads, analytics or tracking.
• Your walks and location data are stored only on your device and never sent to a server.
• Street data is downloaded from OpenStreetMap on first launch and stored on your device.

WHO IS IT FOR?
Bamberg residents, students, newcomers, visitors and anyone who loves to walk.

Location use: Keşif uses your location to record your route. While a walk is being recorded, location is also used in the background so your route keeps recording with the screen off. When you're not recording, location is not used in the background.

Map and street data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

name: Khulasah Habib Omar bin Hafidh
description:
The official app of «al-Khulasah», the compilation of adhkar (remembrances) and supplications by al-Habib Umar bin Muhammad bin Salim bin Hafiz, published by his office in Tarim. The app's text is in Arabic.

It holds the morning and evening adhkar, and the adhkar and awrad (daily litanies) of the day and night as in the printed book (1445 AH edition), and it knows your time and brings you its wird:

• The wird of now: by the prayer times of your city, the home screen shows the adhkar of the present time, from the last part of the night to after Isha, one tap away.
• Reminders on time: five optional reminders at prayer times, among them the morning adhkar after Fajr and the evening adhkar after Asr, each opening its dhikr, with the Friday adhkar on Thursday night and Friday.
• A tasbih that knows the count: it opens on the dhikr you are reading with its count from the book, and moves to the next dhikr when you finish.
• Search the whole book: with or without diacritics.
• Comfortable reading: a clear Arabic typeface, pinch to zoom, levels of diacritics, full screen, a night mode and three colour themes.
• Mushaf pages: read the book's complete surahs as text, or as pages of the Madinah Mushaf if you prefer.
• Kept for you: your favourites and reading place, and the book's contents as printed.

In the book: al-Wird al-Latif and the famous Ratib of Imam al-Haddad, the Ratib of Imam Umar bin Abdurrahman al-Attas, Hizb al-Bahr of Abu al-Hasan al-Shadhili, Hizb al-Nasr of Imam al-Haddad, the Wird of Imam al-Nawawi, al-Salat al-Tajiyya, Surahs Yasin, al-Waqi'a and al-Mulk, the qasidas, the adhkar before and after the prayer, and the supplications for travel, needs and hardship.

No ads, no accounts, and no data collected: everything stays on your device, and it works offline.

name: Kidda
description:
Kidda is the home of Kidda's Punjabi courses and community. Learn to speak, read and understand Punjabi with real tutors, at your own level, alongside other learners.

YOUR COURSES IN ONE PLACE
• Foundational, Beginners, Intermediate and Advanced courses
• Join your live classes, then catch up on recordings and lesson notes
• Send homework as a voice note or photo, and get feedback from your tutor, including voice notes

THE KIDDA COMMUNITY
• Live community sessions every week, matched to your level
• Check in to a session with a code and earn XP
• A forum to ask questions, share wins and practise with others
• Practice games, topics and bonus sessions

GROW YOUR LEVEL
• Find your level with a short placement check
• Practise every day and unlock your next level check
• Collect trophies and certificates as you progress

FOR FAMILIES
• Add your children and follow their progress from one account
• Kids courses with their own lessons and homework
• Children don't get access to the community or forum

STAY ON TRACK
• Reminders before your classes and sessions
• Notifications when your tutor replies, with full control in settings

Kidda is for Kidda members. Sign in with your Kidda account to get started.

Questions? Email hello@kidda.app

name: Kilopixel
description:
Kilopixel is a retro pixel camera and editor. Every frame you see in the viewfinder is already dithered, screened or printed, so what you see is exactly what you save.

Fewer pixels. More personality.

LIVE LOOKS, NOT FILTERS AFTER THE FACT
Choose from 23 effects that run live on the camera:
• Dither: Bayer, blue noise, Atkinson, Floyd–Steinberg, Stucki
• Print: halftone, newsprint, crosshatch, engrave, cross-stitch
• Screen: CRT, LCD, animated VHS, ASCII
• Graphic: two-tone, posterize, edges, emboss, invert

92 PALETTES, OR MAKE YOUR OWN
Pick from 1-bit to 4-bit palettes, sample colors from your own photo, edit swatches by hand, or paste a Coolors link or a list of hex colors. Everything works offline.

STARTER LOOKS AND YOUR OWN PRESETS
Start with ready-made looks like Pocket camera, Newspaper, Riso print, Night tape, Blueprint and Arcade CRT. Tweak contrast, exposure and pixel size, then save your own looks and styles with one tap.

PHOTO AND VIDEO
• Tap the shutter for a photo, or switch to Video and tap to start and stop. Hold the shutter and slide to zoom while you record.
• 3-shot moment keeps frames from just before and after the press so you can pick the best one.
• Steady and Tripod stabilization smooth out shaky video.
• Optional microphone with sound styles that match the picture: Tape, Handheld, Arcade, Radio, or Clean.
• Save videos as MP4, or turn clips and VHS photos into looping GIFs.

EDIT WHAT YOU ALREADY HAVE
Open any photo, video or GIF from your library and run it through the same looks. Rotate, mirror and flip before you save.

MADE FOR COMPOSING
Thirds, square and golden-ratio grids, six frame ratios, and 1–4× digital zoom. Six interface themes: Graphite, Classic, Pocket, Arcade, Terminal and Candy. Optional 8-bit shutter sounds and haptics.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No uploads. No tracking. Photos and video are processed on your iPhone and saved straight to your Photos library.

name: Kind HWP & HWPX Viewer
description:
Read HWP and HWPX for free, without ads. Edit text, add your signature and save a PDF copy.

• Open an HWP document
• Copy all text
• Edit text
• My signature
• Highlight
• Save as new PDF
• Share HWP document
• Recent documents
• Search file names
• Light
• Dark
• Language

Save as a new PDF to keep highlights, pen marks and signatures.

Read without ads or an account.
Copies are stored on your device so you can reopen recent documents.
Sharing sends the file to the app you choose.

Complex tables and fonts may differ from the original. Not affiliated with Hancom.

name: Kioskys: Kiosk Browser
description:
Kioskys turns an iPad into a clean, full-screen kiosk for any website — in a few taps.

Type your address, tap Start, and that's it. No accounts, no cloud, no complicated setup.

WHY KIOSKYS
• One-time purchase — no subscription, no in-app purchases.
• Simple — a short settings screen appears for the first 10 seconds each time the app opens, then gets out of the way.
• Built for business — configure whole fleets of iPads with MDM, including the PIN, the address and the screen options.
• A kiosk experience without the fuss — the iPad stays awake, the page stays on screen, and the app recovers on its own after a network drop.

WHAT YOU GET
• Any website, full screen: no status bar, no zoom, no way to wander off to other sites.
• Playlist mode: pages, photos and videos in a loop. Photos and videos are saved on the iPad, so they play with no delay, even offline.
• Opening hours: the kiosk closes and reopens by itself; the closed screen can show a message, a photo or a video.
• Inactivity reset: back to the first page, with the visitor's data cleared, after a few seconds without touch.
• Scanner for your pages: QR codes and barcodes with the front or back camera, or a USB or Bluetooth scanner.
• Set up with one QR code: scan it and the whole configuration is applied.
• Camera and QR codes: pages can use the camera to scan codes.
• Location: pages can ask for the iPad's position.
• Orientation lock: portrait or landscape, your choice (the iPad can still be flipped 180°).
• Energy Saver: after a few minutes without touches the screen dims to the minimum; one touch brings it back to full brightness.
• Optional PIN to protect the settings, with a temporary lock-out after repeated mistakes.
• Automatic recovery: if the connection drops or the page stops, Kioskys retries by itself.
• Works with Apple's Single App Mode and Guided Access to lock the iPad on the app.
• Available in English, Italian, French, Spanish, Hindi and Simplified Chinese.

FOR IT TEAMS
Kioskys supports Managed App Configuration: push the address, PIN, start delay, allowed domains, camera and location access, orientation lock and Energy Saver from your MDM. Settings from the MDM always win, and the app reports its status back. Ready-made files and documentation are on our website.

PRIVACY
Kioskys collects no data, has no ads and uses no analytics. Camera and location are used only by the pages you choose to show.

Note: for a kiosk that nobody can leave, combine Kioskys with Guided Access or Single App Mode (MDM).

name: Kitchen Master: Family Menu
description:
Kitchen Master is a family meal planning and kitchen collaboration app.

You can:
• Choose dishes by date and meal and plan meals with your family
• Review family meal schedules, orders, and dish completion
• Prepare ingredients for upcoming meals and manage your pantry
• Use AI to create a new recipe, review it, and add it to your menu
• Collaborate with family members and household helpers in one kitchen

The app interface supports Chinese and English. Recipe content supports Chinese, English, Indonesian, and Burmese, so family members and helpers can read recipes in a familiar language.

Kitchen Master keeps family ordering, preparation, and cooking coordination clear and simple.

name: Kitewind
description:
Kitewind laat in één oogopslag de wind zien op de kitespots in Nederland, België, Duitsland en Denemarken. Geen gedoe met losse websites: kies je spot en je ziet wat de wind de komende dagen doet.

Spots
Een overzicht van kitespots met actuele windgegevens in knopen. Zoek op naam of laat de app de spots in jouw buurt tonen. Bewaar je favoriete spots bovenaan. Open een spot en zie windsnelheid, windstoten en windrichting.

Verwachting
Een duidelijke verwachting per uur voor de komende dagen, zodat je zelf kunt zien wanneer het gaat waaien en uit welke hoek. Jij beslist, de app laat alleen de cijfers zien.

Alerts
Stel per spot een alert in en ontvang een melding wanneer de wind de snelheid haalt die jij hebt gekozen. Met het schuifje zet je een alert aan of uit, zonder hem te verwijderen.

Webcams
Bekijk live beelden bij de spot, gesorteerd op afstand tot jou. De beelden komen van de eigenaren en laden pas als je een camera opent.

Widget
Zet de wind van je favoriete spot op je beginscherm.

Delen
Deel een spot met een tik met je kitemaatjes, zodat jullie op dezelfde plek afspreken.

WAAROM KITEWIND
- Snel en overzichtelijk
- Voor kiters in Nederland, België, Duitsland en Denemarken
- Meldingen alleen als jij dat wilt
- In het Nederlands, Duits en Engels

Kitewind is gemaakt door en voor kiters. Opmerkingen of ideeën? Laat het weten via kitewind.app.

name: KitPull
description:
KitPull hjælper produktionsplanlæggere med at sikre, at alle dele er klar, før montagen starter. Appen tjekker kits pr. proces, blokerer start ved mangler og opretter materialetræk – så linjen undgår unødvendig ventetid.

HOVEDFUNKTIONER

• Oversigt
Se kitsjek-rate, blokerede ordrer, åbne træk og lavt lager på ét dashboard.

• Ordrer
Opret og administrer montageordrer med proces, station, prioritet, planlagt start og BOM-linjer.

• Kitsjek
Sammenlign behov mod lager pr. reservedel. Se mangelliste og kompletteringsgrad med det samme.

• Startspærre
Ufuldstændige kits kan ikke startes. Kun ordrer med 100 % kitsjek slippes videre til “I gang”.

• Materialetræk
Opret træk for manglende dele med prioritet og station. Følg status: Åben → Undervejs → Færdig.

• Lager
Vedligehold reservedeler, sikkerhedslager, indgang og justeringer. Lavt lager fremhæves tydeligt.

• Rapport
Følg kitsjek-rate, træktid, blokeringer og afsluttede ordrer til forbedring af flowet.

• Indstillinger
Planlæggerprofil, standardstation, fabrik og nulstilling af demodata.

ARBEJDSFLOW
Opret ordre → kør kitsjek → bloker eller frigiv → træk mangler → modtag og opdater lager → tjek igen → start montage → afslut og bogfør forbrug → se rapport.

KitPull er designet til planlæggere i montage og produktion – klar, struktureret og klar til daglig brug.

name: Kivvi Manager
description:
Kivvi Manager is the staff app for shops on the Kivvi loyalty platform. Managers use it at the counter to give customers points and to accept the points customers want to spend.

GIVE POINTS
Enter what the customer spent and the app works out the points from your shop's own rate. Add an optional note, such as an invoice number, for your own records. The customer gets an 8 character code and a QR code to scan or type into the Kivvi app. Share the code, copy it, or print a slip on a Wi-Fi thermal receipt printer.

SPEND POINTS
When a customer sends points to pay, enter or scan their code, check what it is worth, and confirm. A built-in price converter shows how many points to ask for.

TODAY
See what you issued and received today, the conversion rates, and every code with its status. Tap any entry for full details, reopen a code that is still waiting, or reverse a completed transaction.

YOUR SHOP, YOUR BRAND
Your shop's logo and the name of your own points currency appear throughout the app.

Kivvi Manager is for shop managers only. Manager accounts are created by the shop's vendor in the Kivvi back office, so there is no sign up in the app. Customers use the separate Kivvi app to collect and spend their points.

name: Klaber Card Game
description:
Klaber is the greatest card game of all time: Klaberjass (also called Klabrias, Clobyosh or Bela), the classic trick-taking game families have played around the kitchen table for generations.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• 2, 3 or 4 players. Four-player games are played in two teams of partners.
• Play against the computer at three levels: easygoing Mendel, steady Golde and sharp Hershel. Win a game to move up to a tougher opponent.
• Play friends online. Create a table, share the invite link, and anyone can join from their phone. Empty seats are filled by computer players.
• No connection? Games against the computer work anywhere, even in airplane mode.

THE REAL RULES
• Jack and Nine of trumps on top, sequences of 20 and 50, bela, the 7-of-trumps swap and the last-trick bonus.
• Take the contract and score more than your opponents, or go bate and watch them collect every point.
• First to 501 wins, the moment they get there.

LEARN AS YOU PLAY
• Cards you can't play are dimmed, and a hint tells you why.
• After every hand, a quick review shows your smart plays and the moments you could have done better.
• A full game review at the end helps you sharpen your game.

EASY ON THE EYES
• Big, classic playing cards with large corner letters.
• Easy-read suits: an optional four-color deck (blue diamonds, green clubs) so suits are never confused.
• Tap a card and tap again to play, or drag it to the middle of the table.

A TABLE WITH PERSONALITY
• Your computer opponents have plenty to say. Lose your ten to an ace and you'll hear about it.
• Send reactions and stickers: OH DAMN!, OY VEY!, WHO DEALT THIS?, SHAKA and dozens more.
• The table changes color with the trump suit, and big moments get the celebration they deserve.

No accounts and no ads. Just deal and play.

name: Kokpit Servis
description:
Kokpit Servis is the field app for technicians of authorized service partners that install Kokpit Takip GPS tracking and vehicle camera systems. Accounts are created by invitation from Kokpit; there is no public sign-up.

All your assigned jobs in one place
• Installation, removal, sensor, fault and device replacement jobs
• Today's appointments, active and completed jobs
• Customer, contact person, address and directions

Step by step on site
• Start the job and complete each vehicle separately
• Scan the device IMEI with the camera; invalid IMEIs are caught immediately
• Signal check: an installation is only completed once the device actually reports
• Record the equipment and materials used (device, cable, sensor, camera, cable length)
• Checklist and vehicle photos
• Verify the removed device on replacements and removals

Delivery and earnings
• Collect the customer's signature on the phone and close the delivery
• Service managers follow monthly settlements and per-job amounts

Kokpit Servis works together with the servis.kokpittakip.com web portal. The app is available in Turkish and English.

name: labba.
description:
Það er gott að labba. Og gott að ganga frá því.

Labba heldur utan um göngur um götur, garða og fjöll. Finndu leiðina þína á kortinu, skráðu vegalengdina og bættu göngunni í göngubókina.

VELDU HVAR ÞÚ GEKKST
Leitaðu að götum, bæjum og sveitarfélögum um Ísland. Veldu heilar götur eða skráða gönguleið frá Ferðamálastofu. Þú getur líka teiknað þína eigin leið og fært punktana til.

STILLTU VEGALENGDINA
Kortið áætlar lengd leiðarinnar. Þú getur lengt hana, stytt eða slegið inn þína eigin áætlun. Göngugjaldið er reiknað á 150 krónur fyrir hvern kílómetra.

GAKKTU FRÁ LABBINU
Farðu yfir samantektina og haltu áfram. Ef greiðslugáttin er í göngutúr geturðu þess í stað látið upphæðina ganga til næsta manns, boðið í kaffi eða látið gott af þér leiða á annan hátt.

SJÁÐU HVAR ÞÚ HEFUR GENGIÐ
Göngurnar safnast í göngubók á tækinu þínu. Veldu eldri göngu til að sjá vegalengd, skráningu og vistuðu leiðina á korti.

Engan aðgang þarf að stofna. Engum kortaupplýsingum er safnað og engin greiðsla fer fram í appinu. Þú ræður sjálf hvernig þú lætur gott ganga.

Kortagögn byggja á OpenStreetMap og landsúttaki Geofabrik. Skráðar gönguleiðir byggja á gögnum frá Ferðamálastofu. Þekjan er ekki tæmandi og aðstæður geta breyst. Labba er til skráningar að göngu lokinni; fylgdu merkingum og aðstæðum á staðnum.

—

IN ENGLISH
Labba is an Icelandic walking log that takes itself completely seriously. Pick the street you walked, a registered hiking trail or draw your own route on the map, set the distance and settle your walk. The payment step is staged: there are no card fields, nothing is charged, and you can pass the kindness on instead. Your walk book stays on your device. No account, no ads.

name: Ladderfit
description:
Ladderfit is for anyone who runs an agarose or SDS-PAGE gel and needs the band sizes on the phone, at the bench: colony PCR, a digest, an RNA check, a protein lysate.

ADD A GEL
Name the run and choose bp or kDa. Photograph the gel on the bench, or pick a photo already on this phone. The photo is copied into Ladderfit. Your photo library is never changed.

MARK THE LADDER
Drag the amber line to the wells so distance starts at the comb. Tap each known ladder band and type its size. Three marks are enough to read. Common sizes sit on chips so you do not have to type every time.

TAP THE BANDS
Sample reads appear on the gel as soon as the ladder fits. Open Read sizes for the log-linear plot, R², and a table of every sample.

EXPORT
Export a marked PNG of the gel, or a CSV of the sizes, through the system share sheet. Sharing starts only after you tap it.

Try a sample gel before adding your own photo.

Reads are estimates from the ladder you marked, not a lab instrument. No account and no sign-in. Gels, photos and marks stay on this iPhone.

name: LangLab
description:
LangLab: AI-репетитор языков. Урок идёт как переписка: отвечаешь голосом или текстом, лемур поправляет и ведёт дальше.

Языки: английский, испанский, итальянский, французский, казахский.

• Разбирает произношение по записи твоего ответа.
• Помнит прошлые уроки, ошибки и то, что ты о себе рассказал.
• Определяет уровень или начинает с нуля.
• После урока готовит тренировки-игры на слабые места.
• Показывает прогресс по навыкам и ошибки.

Первые 6 уроков бесплатно. Нужен интернет. От 16 лет.

name: Lätkämatsi
description:
Lätkämatsi on hauska ja helppo jääkiekkopeli lapsille. Valitse oma seurasi Oulun seudun junioriseuroista, kirjoita oma nimesi ja numerosi paitaan – ja jäälle! Pelataan kuten junioriotteluissa: kolme kenttäpelaajaa ja maalivahti kummallakin joukkueella.

• Pikaottelu: valitse vastustaja ja halli, ja ottelu alkaa
• Kiertue: voita jokaisessa hallissa Muhokselta Liminkaan, Oulunsalosta Kempeleeseen ja Jääliin – ja pelaa finaali Oulun Energia Areenalla
• Joukkueeni: oma nimi ja numero sekä kavereiden nimet paitoihin
• Oikeat hallit piirrettyinä, isosta areenasta pikkuhalliin
• Helppo ohjata yhdellä peukalolla: peli auttaa luistelussa, syötöissä ja laukauksissa
• SPURTTI, RIISTÄ ja HUUDA! – pyydä syöttöä ja karkaa läpiajoon
• Suomenkielinen selostaja ja erätauolla jäänhoitokonetta ajava Hannu
• Kolme vaikeustasoa pienimmistä jo kokeneempiin pelaajiin
• Toimii ilman verkkoyhteyttä

Turvallinen lapsille: ei mainoksia, ei sovelluksen sisäisiä ostoja, ei kirjautumista, ei chattia eikä seurantaa. Peli ei kerää eikä lähetä mitään tietoja – nimet ja numerot tallentuvat vain omalle laitteelle.

Peli on tehty Oulussa.

Seurojen nimet kuuluvat seuroille, ja niitä käytetään vain paikallisten joukkueiden tunnistamiseen. Joukkuetunnukset ovat pelin omia piirroksia. Lätkämatsi ei ole minkään seuran virallinen tuote, eivätkä seurat ole tehneet tai hyväksyneet sitä.

name: LayerFallMeter
description: LayerFallMeter muuntaa osan pituuden ja nostokulman geometriseksi putoamispituudeksi neljässä vyöhykkeessä ja pitää asiakaskortin viime käynnistä. Se on geometrinen arvio — se ei ennusta valmista lookia eikä korvaa säietestiä. Ei tiliä, ei verkkoa, ei valokuvia.
