name: LensFog - Camera Fog Forecast
description:
The first thing on the screen is one word for whether your lens will fog when you walk outside: Fog, Close call or Clear. Under it is a line on what to do about it, like "Set the zipped bag outside 50 minutes before you head out."

Glass fogs when it's colder than the dew point of the air around it. So each verdict comes from two figures: how cold your gear is, and the dew point from Apple Weather. You'll see the gap between them with the verdict, like "Gear 8°F below the dew point."

There are two trips. Going out is gear carried outside from an AC room (70°F), an AC car (64°F) or a temperature you set. Coming in is cold gear carried back into a quiet room or a crowded one. A packed reception with a dance floor has wetter air, so cold gear fogs more easily there. Whichever trip is more likely to fog is on top.

On a Fog verdict, the advice is a head start: how long to leave the zipped bag in the new air before you open it. It's timed for the slowest lens you carry, and you pick which of Primes, Zooms and Telephotos are in your bag. If a lens fogs anyway, there's a line for how long it should take to clear: "Already fogged? 4–23 minutes to clear."

Close call covers gear from just below the dew point to about 4°F (2°C) above it, because forecast dew points run a degree or two low near water, over lawns and at dusk.

Further down are the next 24 hours for both trips as two ribbons, and the air temperature, humidity and dew point right now.

The planner is for a shoot somewhere else or later in the week. Search for a venue, town or address and pick a day and start time up to 9 days ahead to get the forecast for that hour at the venue. Times are on the venue's clock, and the head start becomes a clock time: "Set the zipped bag outside by 4:35 PM." Recent venues are saved.

Widgets for the Home Screen and Lock Screen show the verdict where you are. The medium one has the advice line too.

In Settings you can pick °F or °C (or Auto, to follow your iPhone) and a light or dark theme. There's also a How It Works page on the physics behind the verdicts and the times.

Location is optional; without it, you can still search for any place in the planner. There's no account, and I don't collect any of your data. Your location goes only to Apple Weather for the forecast and to Apple Maps for the town name, and your settings and plans stay on your iPhone.

I'm a wedding filmmaker, and I made LensFog on my own. If a verdict ever doesn't match what your lens did, I'd love to hear about it.

Privacy Policy: https://silicroncode.com/lensfog-privacy

name: Let's Practice
description:
Let's Practice met en relation les gens qui veulent faire du sport ensemble, près de chez eux.

TROUVE UN MATCH AUTOUR DE TOI
La carte affiche les événements sportifs organisés à proximité, filtrés par sport et par niveau. Demande à participer, ou crée ton propre événement : sport, lieu, horaire, nombre de places. Tu valides qui rejoint.

ORGANISEZ-VOUS ENSEMBLE
Chaque événement a sa conversation : les participants s'y coordonnent avant de se retrouver.

LES CHALLENGES
• Foot : compose ton équipe, place tes joueurs et dessine ta tactique.
• CrossFit : organise ou rejoins un WOD.
• Territoire : cours une boucle, elle devient ta zone sur la carte. Défends-la, ou attaque celles des autres.
Chaque challenge a son guide « Comment ça marche ? ».

TA MONTRE CONNECTÉE
Relie l'app Santé pour voir tes pas, ta distance et tes séances du jour. Lecture seule : ces données restent sur ton téléphone.

Tu peux aussi regarder sans compte, en mode visiteur. L'app est disponible en 6 langues.

name: LetTAP Driver
description:
Manage your tour driving work with LetTAP Driver.

Browse available trips, send proposals, and keep your assignments and schedule organized in one place. Review trip details before you travel and share updates with your operations team throughout the journey.

With LetTAP Driver, you can:
• Browse available trips and review pickup locations, destinations, and schedules.
• Submit proposals and follow their status.
• View assigned trips and manage your work calendar.
• Respond to trip changes.
• Share trip updates with photos and notes.
• Review earnings and payout records.
• Manage your driver profile.

name: Letterlight: Word Puzzle
description:
Words carry light.

Letterlight is a word puzzle printed on paper. Little suns glow at the edge of the board. Start a word on a glowing tile, drag through the letters, and the word prints its ink onto every tile it touches. Reach a lamp with the right color and it lights up.

Then the fun begins: colors mix. Pink and yellow make orange, yellow and blue make mint, pink and blue make violet, all three make white. Each lamp asks for its own recipe, so every word is a small plan: which word, from which tile, to which lamp?

• 600 hand-checked levels per language, in 30 themed packs, from gentle 4×4 boards to big 6×6 puzzles with holes, three suns and white lamps.
• Learn a word every level: finish a board and its featured word appears on a card with a short definition, an example and a translation. Every word you learn goes into your Lexicon.
• Print your posters: every solved level is stamped as a small riso print, and every finished pack becomes a big poster in your Gallery.
• Daily Poster: one fresh, bigger board every day. Fewer words and a faster time give a better score. Keep your streak and compare on Game Center.
• Rush: 120 seconds, all suns charged. Print as much as you can, light every lamp and a new board slides in with extra time.
• English and Turkish: pick the app language and the word language separately. Play Turkish words with an English interface, or the other way round.
• Light and dark: a warm paper look by day, glowing inks on dark paper by night, or follow your phone.
• No timers in Journey, no lives, no energy. Hints are earned by playing: find bonus words to fill your light bulb.
• Bonus words count: any real word helps, even when it carries no ink.
• Game Center leaderboards and achievements, entirely optional.
• Plays offline. Your progress stays on your device.

Calm when you want it, quick when you need it. Pick a pack, follow the light, and watch the paper fill with color.

name: Lexicist: Rare English Words
description:
Lexicist gives you three rare English words a day. Each comes with its meaning, an example, its pronunciation and the story of where it came from: manumit is Latin for "send out from one's hand", the way a Roman master freed a slave.

Every word also shows how many Americans know it. The figures come from a Ghent University study that tested hundreds of thousands of people, so "known by 21%" means roughly one American in five.

Start with a short quiz. It estimates how many English words you know and places you among people tested in the same study. Then the daily words begin. If they feel too easy, pick a harder word level in Settings. Tap "I know it" on two of the day's words and the next day's words get harder on their own.

Every word you keep goes on a shelf: Remembered, Learning or Fading. Get it right in practice and it moves up a shelf; forget it and it slips to Fading until you get it right. Your shelves also show a map of where your words came from.

Practice
- 9 games: Guess the word, Fill the gap, Meaning match, Pairs, Flash cards, Synonyms, Where from, Spell it, Shuffle
- 3 challenges: Rush (60 seconds), Flawless, Sprint
- practice by topic, by language of origin, or by how well known a word is
- add words you met in a book and practise them with the rest

On your iPhone
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with today's words, in the color and font you pick
- a daily reminder at the time you choose
- Lock Screen wallpapers made from your words
- today's words stay readable without a connection

The library holds 4,387 words in 26 topics, among them law, war, food, money and the sea.

No email needed: you join with a name for the board. You can delete your account in Settings at any time.

name: Liberry: Your Home Library
description:
You already own your next favorite book. It's on your shelf, somewhere in the pile you keep meaning to get to. Liberry helps you find it.

SCAN YOUR SHELVES
Point your camera at a barcode and the book is in your library. Scan a whole stack in one go, check it, and add it all at once. No barcode? Search by title or author, or type it in.
  
LET THE SHELF CHOOSE
Can't decide? Spin the shelf. Liberry picks from the books you haven't read yet, tells you why, and gets out of the way so you can start reading. Narrow it down by genre or mood when you want to.

KEEP TRACK, GENTLY
Mark what you're reading, what you finished and what you set aside. Stopping a book isn't failing: you can say why, add a note, or skip it.

DISCOVER, WITHOUT THE PRESSURE
Browse this week's bestseller lists, keep a Want to read list, follow the authors you love, and find bookstores near you. When you want a book you don't have, find it at an independent bookstore or your local library.
  
NO ACCOUNT. NO ADS.
No sign-up, no password, no ads. Your library and notes live on your phone. Delete my data erases everything, on your phone and on our server, any time.

Liberry isn't built to keep you in the app. It's built to send you back to your books.

name: Little-Talks
description:
Little questions. Big conversations.

Get to know what your child thinks, feels, and cares about. Little-Talks offers short conversation cards for parents and children ages 5–11, with a follow-up question when you want to keep talking.

Choose a topic: family, feelings, imagination, confidence, or everyday life. Read a question together, listen to the answer, and go wherever the conversation takes you. Skip any card that does not fit the moment.

• Hundreds of questions, updated weekly
• Questions for ages 5–6, 7–8, and 9–11
• Follow-up questions and short tips for parents
• Saved cards shared with your account on little-talks.com
• Four sample questions per age group before you sign up
• A quiet, optional card sound and support for reduced motion
• Layouts that adapt to iPhone and iPad

Parents and caregivers create the account. Your child does not need one. We use their first name or nickname and birth month and year to personalize the cards and choose an age group. Your child's answers are never recorded or uploaded.

name: Live Photo Studio: Lively
description:
Turn a favorite video moment into a Live Photo, or give the Live Photos you already have a new look and sound.

Lively is a Live Photo editor for iPhone. Choose a photo or video, keep the part you want, adjust the picture, and add a soundtrack. Preview your edits while the clip plays, then save a new Live Photo or export an MP4 video to share.

VIDEO TO LIVE PHOTO
• Pick a segment from a video instead of keeping the entire clip.
• Choose the frame that appears as the still image.
• Open the converted Live Photo in the editor to continue with color, sound, and timing.

FIND YOUR LOOK
• Explore 12 presets, including Original, with adjustable filter intensity.
• Fine-tune 12 controls: exposure, highlights, shadows, brightness, contrast, saturation, vibrance, warmth, tint, fade, vignette, and sharpness.
• Crop to Original, square, 4:5, 16:9, or 9:16 proportions.
• Rotate or flip the picture and see changes as the clip plays.

MAKE THE SOUND PART OF THE MOMENT
• Import an audio file or record a voiceover.
• Use the waveform to choose the part of the recording you want.
• Adjust when the soundtrack starts, its volume, and its fade-in and fade-out.
• Mix it with the original sound or mute the original audio.

TRIM, PREVIEW, AND SAVE
Use the filmstrip timeline to set the start and end of your clip. Press and hold to preview the edited Live Photo before saving.

Save a new Live Photo to your photo library, with its still image and moving clip paired together. Your original stays unchanged. Or share an MP4 with your filters, crop, trim, and audio mix included.

From a small expression to a scene from your latest trip, keep the movement and sound that make a moment yours.

Requires iOS 17 or later.

name: Live Translate V3
description:
Live Translate V3 lets you talk with anyone, face to face.

• Two-way conversation on one screen: your half at the bottom, the other half flipped for the person opposite. Each person taps and speaks their own language.
• Live translation while you speak; when you pause, the sentence is finalized and read aloud in the other language.
• 26 languages: English, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Vietnamese, Korean, Japanese, Thai, Indonesian, Malay, Hindi, Arabic, Russian, Ukrainian, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, Hebrew.
• Choose any pair — "my language" and "their language" — and swap with one tap.
• Subtitles mode: keep the iPhone near a speaker in meetings or on TV for continuous subtitles.
• On-device AI polishing for natural, grammatical sentences with the right tone — friendly for small talk, formal for business.
• Built-in steel-trade terminology (hot-rolled coil, sheet pile, H-beam, L/C, bill of lading, MTC…).
• App interface in English, Vietnamese, Chinese, Korean and Japanese.

Private by design: speech recognition, translation and polishing run on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no data collection. After the first language download, it works offline.

Requires iOS 26. Sentence polishing requires an Apple Intelligence–capable iPhone.

name: LiveRec Stream Studio
description:
LiveRec Stream Studio lets you record, live-stream and edit gameplay and presentation videos with nothing but your iPad or iPhone.

CONNECT A CONSOLE OR PC (iPad)
• Bring the HDMI output of a Nintendo Switch (TV mode in the dock) or a PC into a USB-C iPad through a UVC capture device
• Use a capture device or hub with USB PD pass-through to keep your iPad charging during long streams
• See connection diagrams and recommended gear right in the app

PRESENTATIONS AND PRODUCT DEMOS FROM A PC
• Bring in PowerPoint slides or a product or app demo, and add yourself in a camera window
• Add on-screen text and captions to record or stream product videos, webinars and internal briefings

CAMERA WINDOW AND PERSON CUTOUT
• Place the front camera anywhere, at any size and shape
• Virtual backgrounds: keep only the person, blur the background, or replace it with an image or color
• With ISO recording on, you can change the background and camera window after the stream

ANIMATED ON-SCREEN TEXT
• 52 templates in 8 categories: gaming, variety, cute, explainer/news, retro, horror, seasonal, and announcements
• Fine-tune entrance, while-shown and exit motion with easing
• Show or hide with one tap

LIVE STREAMING AND RECORDING
• Stream to YouTube Live over RTMP (1080p, 30/60 fps)
• Live captions put what you say on screen in real time

EDITING
• Cut, split and reorder on the timeline
• 12 transitions and keyframe animation
• Text and captions shown while recording become editable clips

CAPTIONS WITH APPLE INTELLIGENCE
• On-device transcription creates timed captions (audio never leaves your device)
• Fixes recognition errors, removes fillers, and suggests a YouTube title and description
• Export SRT files or burn captions into the video

EASY TO START
• Animated tutorial on first launch
• Tap ? next to tricky settings for an illustrated explanation

NOTES
• External input (capture devices) works on USB-C iPads with iPadOS 17 or later. On iPhone, record and stream with the front camera.
• Apple Intelligence features require a supported device and language.
• Nintendo Switch is a trademark of Nintendo. PowerPoint is a trademark of Microsoft Corporation.

name: Liverpool Social
description:
Liverpool Social er poengtavlen for kortkvelden. Glem papir og blyant – før poengene i appen, og alle rundt bordet følger stillingen live på sin egen telefon.

SLIK FUNGERER DET
• Lag en vennegruppe og start et spill med 2–10 spillere
• Registrer poeng for alle etter hver runde – skriv inn tallet eller trykk på kortene som er igjen
• Se rundens oppdrag, stillingen og hvem som leder underveis
• Rett feil i ettertid – alle endringer loggføres

STATISTIKK OG MORO
• Leaderboard for gruppen med seire, snitt og beste spill
• Hall of Fame med rekorder og utmerkelser
• Rivaler: se hvem som vinner mest når dere møtes
• Sesonger, slik at alle får en ny sjanse
• Del resultatet som et bilde etter spillet

OGSÅ MED
• Spilleregler og en sjekker som avgjør om en tress eller serie er gyldig
• Egne regelsett hvis dere spiller på deres måte
• Profilbilde og gjestespillere for dem som ikke har appen

Ingen reklame. Ingen sporing.

name: Loada
description:
Loada connects truckies with builders who need tipper trucks. See jobs near you, choose the days that suit you, and get booked and paid without the phone tag.

Find work
• Browse jobs posted by builders, with the site, dates, material and rate up front
• Apply for one day or several, and see straight away which days are already filled

Get booked
• Get an alert the moment a builder books your truck
• See your booked shifts, with today's shift marked
• Message the builder in the app about the job

Get paid
• Mark the work complete when you're done
• The builder approves your hours and you're paid through Stripe
• Rate the builder after each job so other truckies know who's good to work with

Your business, your trucks
• Add your trucks, capacity and rates
• Manage your profile, ABN and notifications

Builders: post jobs and book truckies on the Loada web app at loada.com.au.

name: Lobbio – Hotel Booking & PMS
description:
Lobbio is one app for travellers and for the hotels they stay at.

FOR GUESTS
• Browse Lobbio hotels and book directly with the hotel — no middleman.
• Pick your dates, guests and room, and see live availability and prices.
• Sign in with a one-time code sent to your email — no password to remember.
• See all your stays across Lobbio hotels in one place, and call the hotel in one tap.
• Delete your account any time from the app.

FOR HOTEL TEAMS
Lobbio is a complete property management system for independent hotels in India. Staff sign in with the account their hotel administrator creates for them.
• Dashboard: occupancy, arrivals, departures, in-house guests and revenue at a glance.
• Bookings and front desk: reservations, check-in, check-out, folios and GST invoices.
• Room position: day-by-day availability and room-type-wise sold rooms for the weeks ahead.
• Rooms and housekeeping: live room status — vacant clean, occupied, dirty, out of order.
• Restaurant and KOT: take dine-in, room-service and takeaway orders and send them to the kitchen.
• Banquets: event bookings, advances and invoices.
• Reports: today, month-to-date, OTA, cashier and outstanding — plus a nightly summary on your phone.
• Notifications: day-closed and morning brief alerts for owners and managers.

Lobbio is made in India by Saskey Innovations. Learn more at lobbio.in.

name: Loomlight
description:
Loomlight is a handcrafted card-weaving game set in a sunlit workshop above the clouds.

Each card is a thread and a decision. Place cards across three warp rows and three weft columns, then read the Weave Nodes created at every crossing. Suit chooses dye and texture; rank sets thread length and density. Flip a card to change its row priority without losing the readable corner index.

Balance Dye, Loom Tension, woven edges, and breathing room while you shape cloth for the weavers of four sky workshops. Discover original customers, looms, thread materials, and pattern stories as the world grows.

- Loom Story: hand-tuned orders across four floating textile regions.
- Daily Pattern: one fixed loom, deck, and cloth challenge each day.
- Swatch Puzzles: compact pattern studies built around exact crossings.
- Endless Weave: keep a long cloth from tightening past its limits.
- Loom Atelier: collect looms, threads, dyes, and workshop details.
- Textile Atlas: revisit fabrics, patterns, customers, and the worlds that inspired them.

Thimble, the little thread-mouse, reacts at the edge of the loom without changing the rules. Loomlight plays offline, with no ads, no purchases, and no timers.

name: LoopCapture
description:
LoopCapture is the lead capture app for exhibitors at trade shows and expos. Your team scans the visitor's badge QR code, taps an NFC badge on supported phones, or photographs a business card. Rate the lead hot, warm or cold, and move on. Nothing is lost to paper and pockets.

What your team gets
• Scan a badge QR or tap an NFC badge, or snap a visiting card and let the app read the text for you to check
• Rate every lead hot, warm or cold in one tap, with a reminder an hour after a hot lead
• Send your catalogue from your own WhatsApp in one tap
• Works without signal in the hall: leads are saved on the phone and sync by themselves when the signal returns
• Kiosk mode: let visitors type their own details on a tablet, with their consent, and leave only with your staff PIN
• A clear 7-day contact deadline after the show: only a real call, email or meeting counts
• Every lead carries the visitor's consent
• Works in English and Arabic (Arabic is in beta)

Getting started
Your first exhibition is a free pilot with every feature. You need a LoopCapture company account. Your admin sets it up in the Exhibitor Panel at app.loopcapture.in and invites you; then you sign in with your email or mobile number and your password or PIN, or with a 6-digit code on WhatsApp.

Your leads belong to your company. Privacy policy: www.loopcapture.in/privacy. Delete your account: www.loopcapture.in/account-deletion.

LoopCapture, a LoopCare Technologies product. A brand of Purple Global Ventures LLP.

name: Lou's Library E-Reader
description:
Lou's Library is a simple, private reader for the EPUB and PDF books you already own.

READ YOUR WAY
• Choose from 12 fonts, plus text size, line spacing, margins, justification, indents and paragraph spacing
• Reading themes to suit the light or dark mode
• Page numbers through the whole book, and your exact place kept when you change settings

KEEP WHAT MATTERS
• Highlight passages in EPUBs and PDFs, in several colors
• Add notes to any highlight
• Bookmark pages and jump back from the contents

ORGANIZE YOUR LIBRARY
• Import books from Files or share them from other apps
• Group books into shelves and filter the library by shelf
• Edit titles, authors and covers

BUILD A READING HABIT
• A daily reading goal with a ring that keeps going past the goal
• Streaks, a goal calendar and weekly reading charts
• Per-book stats showing your sessions and time spent

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Your books and reading data stay on your device.

EARLY ALPHA
This is an early release. Expect rough edges, and keep your own copies of your books. Reading data could be lost in a future update, so please don't rely on the app as your only record of highlights and notes.

Questions or bug reports: support@louslibraryereader.com

name: Loyanta Merchant
description:
Loyanta Merchant is the in-store app for businesses that run a Loyanta membership card.

Sign in with the staff account for your store. Look up a member, scan the code on their card, award a stamp, and redeem a reward when the card is full. The same phone shows who joined, what was stamped today, and which coupons are still open.

What you can do

• Sign in and reset a forgotten password
• Search members by name, email, phone, or membership code
• Scan a membership barcode with the camera
• Award stamps and redeem rewards or coupons
• See stamps, subscribers, and transactions for the store
• Share a join link for the card
• Send a message to members at the stores you choose
• Keep a private support note if something fails at the till

Loyanta Staff is for store teams. Customers collect stamps on their own card. They do not need this app.

A Loyanta business account is required. Create it at https://loyanta.cloud before you sign in.

The camera is used only to read the membership code. Loyanta does not sell anything inside this app.

name: Lubi: Your Friends on the Map
description:
Lubi is your crew's map. Open the app and instantly see where your friends are, who's at home, who's on the move and who's right around the corner.

YOUR FRIENDS, LIVE
• Their location updates in real time, even when the app is closed
• Distance, battery, "At home", "On the move": everything at a glance
• Online or offline, always clear
• Friends hanging out together are grouped on the map

KEEP YOUR CREW ALIVE
• Bump: shake your phones side by side to become friends instantly
• Streaks: see each other every day to grow your streak
• Emoji bombs: make hearts or laughs rain on a friend's screen
• "Where are you?": ask a friend to refresh their location
• Messages: chat right from their card

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
• Share your location only with friends you accept
• Ghost mode: precise, blurred, frozen or hidden, for everyone or friend by friend
• Block or report anyone in two taps
• Delete your account and all your data anytime, right in the app
• No ads, no selling your data

Lubi uses your location in the background so your friends see you up to date even when the app is closed. You can turn this off anytime in Settings.

Terms: https://orbit-xt4m.onrender.com/terms
Privacy: https://orbit-xt4m.onrender.com/privacy

name: Ludo Fighters: Battle Board
description:
Roll the dice. Lead your squad. Own the battlefield.

Ludo Fighters is the board game everyone already knows, played with walking, talking cartoon soldiers. The rules are classic Ludo: roll a 6 to deploy, race your squad around the board and bring everyone home. The difference is what happens when you land on an enemy. It becomes a quick cartoon gun fight, and the loser goes back to base in a puff of smoke.

EVERY CAPTURE IS A FIGHT
• Pistol duels, rifle bursts, shotgun blasts, long-range sniper shots and grenades lobbed on an arc.
• The weapon depends on the distance, so fights keep changing.
• Shield stars are safe: shots bounce off a blue shield.
• Cartoon knock-outs only: X eyes, a fall and a puff of smoke. No blood.

SEE YOUR TARGETS
• On your turn, enemies within range get a red crosshair ring.
• After the roll, the enemies you can hit exactly get a pulsing TARGET lock, so you never miss a capture by accident.

SOLDIERS THAT FEEL ALIVE
• Soldiers walk square to square instead of hopping like plastic pawns.
• They talk: 39 recorded voice lines with speech bubbles, from "Go, go, go!" to "Watch your six!" and "Enemy down!".
• They get nervous when an enemy is close, salute when picked and cheer when they make it home.

FOUR BATTLEFIELDS
• Jungle, Desert, Snowfield and Night Ops, each with its own board art and ambience: fireflies, drifting sand, falling snow, a night searchlight.
• Bases are sandbag bunkers, safe squares are shield bunkers and the centre is the headquarters, flag and all.

YOUR BATTLE, YOUR SIZE
• 2 to 6 squads, on a 4-house board or a 6-house board.
• 1 to 6 soldiers per squad: one soldier for a quick sprint, six for a long tactical battle.
• House rules: six to leave base, extra turns, three sixes, exact roll home, shield stars and more.

LUMI AI
• Play against Lumi AI with five personalities: Rookie, Aggressor, Guardian, Strategist and Commander.
• Lumi AI rolls the same dice and sees the same board as you. It never cheats.

PASS AND PLAY
• Friends and family on one phone, with dice on both sides of the table so nobody has to reach across.

ONLINE SQUADS
• Quick battle: find a match for 2, 4 or 6 players. If nobody turns up, Lumi AI fills the empty seats.
• Private rooms: make a room and send the 6-letter code to your friends.
• Rejoin a battle if your connection drops.
• No typed chat with strangers: fixed callouts only. Report or block any player from the battle.
• No sign-up: you only pick a callsign.

SOUND YOU CAN TUNE
• Recorded gun, step and battlefield sounds, battle stings and a lobby march.
• Separate volume sliders for music, game sounds and squad voices, plus vibration and reduce motion settings.

No ads. No purchases. Offline play keeps everything on your phone.

Ludo Fighters is made by Lacspace Corporation Pvt Ltd.

Privacy: ludofighters.com/privacy
Terms: ludofighters.com/terms
Help: ludofighters.com/contact

name: Lycian Way Guide
seller_name: TALYA BILISIM TICARET VE SANAYI LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Lycian Way Guide helps you plan, walk and safely complete the Lycian Way, the long-distance trail from Fethiye to Antalya. 56 stages, more than 300 points of interest and a map that keeps working where there is no signal, all in one app.

STAGES
The trail, more than 600 km long, is divided into 13 sections and 56 stages. See the distance, walking time and difficulty of every stage at a glance. Ratings for stamina, technique, experience and scenery help you pick the stage that suits you. Start and end points, public transport and car access, parking, safety notes and tips are on every stage page.

OFFLINE MAP
Download the Lycian Way region once before you set off. When the connection drops, the downloaded map is used automatically, so you can still see the trail and your position in the valleys without coverage.

POINTS OF INTEREST
38 ancient cities, campsites, water sources, accommodation and more. Filter by type and stage, see the points closest to you first and get directions with one tap.

TRACK YOUR WALK
Once you start a stage, the home screen shows the time elapsed and the distance done and remaining. If you stray from the trail, the app tells you. If you choose, your location is shared with the Lycian Way team until you finish, which makes it easier for us to find you if you get stuck.

EMERGENCY
The Emergency screen calls 112 with one tap, shows your coordinates so you can read them to the operator and lets you share your location with someone you trust. For non-urgent situations, such as losing the path, send the team a help request with your location. Without signal, the request is sent automatically once you are back online.

BEFORE YOU GO
Guides and frequently asked questions on waymarks, water, accommodation, seasons and safety. Current trail alerts appear on the home screen, and announcements from the team arrive as notifications.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Stages, the map, points of interest and emergency help all work as a guest. To share your location during a walk, sign in with a code sent to your email address. No password required.

TURKISH AND ENGLISH
The app is available in English and Turkish.

PRIVACY
Your location is shared only while you have a walk in progress, and only with the Lycian Way team. Records are deleted after 30 days. There are no ads. You can delete your account at any time from the Profile screen.

The app is designed to make your walk easier. Always give priority to the waymarks on the ground, the weather and your own judgement. Continued use of location in the background can reduce battery life.

Questions and suggestions: destek@likyayolu.app

name: Mahj Edge: Beginner Game Play
description:
Learn American Mah Jongg from the very first tile.

Mahj Edge: Beginner Game Play is a friendly, step-by-step course for brand-new players. Short lessons with animated table diagrams show exactly what happens at the table, and quick checks help it stick.

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN
• The object of the game and what the NMJL Card is for
• Every tile: Bams, Craks, Dots, Winds, Dragons, Flowers and Jokers
• Building the wall, rolling the dice and breaking the wall
• Selecting tiles, with live counts until East has 14 and everyone else 13
• The Charleston: every pass in order, which parts are optional, the blind pass and the Courtesy Pass
• Turn order, discarding and naming tiles, claiming, Joker rules and Joker exchanges
• Winning on your own pick or a discard, wall games and who is East next

PRACTICE AND REVIEW
A replayable guided practice runs through setup, a sample deal, the Charleston and a few turns, asking "who goes next?" along the way. A plain-language glossary keeps every term handy.

THOUGHTFUL BY DESIGN
• One idea per screen, at your own pace, with no timers or scores
• Resume where you left off, or revisit any lesson
• Works offline, with no account, ads or tracking

Ready for strategy? Mahj Edge, our strategy trainer, picks up where this course ends.

Mahj Edge isn't affiliated with or endorsed by the National Mah Jongg League or the American Mah Jongg Association. You'll need the current NMJL Card to play.

name: Mallowrift
description:
Catch enemy spells in a teacup and grow them into storms. In Mallowrift: Pocket Tempest, every spell you catch makes your cup heavier, so you’ll need to decide when to keep moving and when to plant a cloud. As your clouds grow and drift, overlap them to form Cloud Chords or mix their colors into Prism Chords, then make them bloom in a burst of magic.

Battle across three illustrated floating gardens, take on whimsical bosses, and see how long you can last in the Unending Sky. Play entirely offline, with no ads or in-app purchases.

name: Manuka UMF Validation
description:
Is your Mānuka honey really what the label says?

Manuka UMF Validation reads the batch number printed on your jar and checks it against the public certification register of the UMF™ Honey Association (UMFHA) in New Zealand. In seconds you see the official laboratory results for that exact batch:

• UMF™ grade measured by the lab
• MGO (methylglyoxal) – potency
• Leptosperin – authenticity
• DHA – shelf life
• HMF – freshness

The app compares each value with the official UMFHA minimums and with the grade printed on your label, and checks the best-before date.

How it works
1. Point your camera at the barcode and the batch number ("BT", "Batch" or "Lot"), or pick a photo, or type the batch number.
2. The batch is looked up in the public UMFHA certification register.
3. Read the result and open the official certificate.

Private by design: the label is read on your iPhone. No photo leaves your device, and no account is needed.

Developed by Manuka Europe Distribution, importer of UMF™ certified Mānuka honey in Europe – manuka.eu.com.

Manuka UMF Validation is an independent tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the UMF™ Honey Association. UMF™ is a registered trademark of the UMF Honey Association.

name: mastercount
description:
ひとつ数えて、次へ進もう。
mastercountは、自由に使えるカウンターとプライベートブラウザがひとつになったアプリです。

■ カウントする
大きなボタンをタップして記録。今日・今年・累計のカウントとグラフで、自分のペースを確認できます。通信できないときも端末に記録し、接続が戻ると同期します。

■ みんなのランキング
Appleでサインインし、表示名を決めて参加。全員のカウントを今年・今月・累計で比較できます。表示名とカウント回数は他の利用者に公開されます。

■ ブラウザを、ひと区切り
カウントモードとブラウザを、裏表のように切り替え。ブラウザでもカウントすると、開いていたURLをアプリ内の履歴に保存して、すべてのタブを閉じます。通常の閲覧履歴やWebサイトのログイン情報は、次のブラウザセッションに引き継ぎません。

■ 親指ひとつでタブ操作
画面下のタブ帯を左右になぞって切り替え、上に払って閉じる。閉じた直後は取り消してURLを開き直せます。タブ一覧と新規タブのボタンも下部にまとめました。最初の案内で、実際の操作を練習できます。

■ 自分に合う検索
Googleに加え、好きなサイトの検索方法を登録。キーワードで検索先を切り替えられます。サイトで「mastercount」と検索した結果から、検索URLを取り込むこともできます。

■ 広告ブロックとプラグイン
広告・トラッカーの通信をブロック。ページの要素を選んで非表示にし、設定からいつでも解除できます。検索方法や非表示・通信ブロックのルールをプラグインとして公開し、ほかの人のルールも追加できます。サイトによってブロックの効果は異なります。

■ 保存するものを選ぶ
ブックマークとカウント時のURL履歴を保存。ブラウザや履歴を開くときの本人認証も設定できます。履歴・ブックマーク・ブラウザ設定のクラウド同期は初期状態でオフ。必要なものだけ有効にできます。CookieやWebサイトのログイン情報は同期しません。

name: MathSense: Math Tutor AI
description:
Stuck on a math problem? Take a photo of the problem and your own work. MathSense Tutor reads your steps, checks the arithmetic and algebra, and points to the exact line where things went wrong, then helps you fix it yourself.

STARTS FROM YOUR WORK, NOT FROM THE ANSWER
Hints get stronger only when you ask. You can see the full solution, but you decide when.

EVERY STEP CHECKED
A math engine verifies each line before the tutor speaks, so you know which steps are right.

PRACTICE THAT STICKS
After you solve a problem, try one like it.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Your photos and work are yours. No advertising trackers, and MathSense never uses your work to train AI models. Sessions are deleted automatically after 90 days, and you can export or delete your data yourself at any time from My data.

FREE
No purchases in the app. Weekly limits are shown in the app.

For students 13 and older. Algebra, equations, fractions, functions and more. Photo or typed problems; works with handwriting.

Questions: info@mathsense.ai
Privacy policy: https://mathsense.ai/legal/tutor-privacy
Terms of service: https://mathsense.ai/legal/tutor-terms

name: MatiMitra
description:
MatiMitra हे बाल्कनीत किंवा घरात रोपे वाढवणाऱ्यांसाठी कुंडीतील माती आणि लागवड मिश्रणाच्या नोंदी ठेवणारे अॅप आहे. समस्या लक्षात आल्यापासून उपाय, निरीक्षण आणि पुनर्वापराच्या निर्णयापर्यंतचा प्रवास एकाच ठिकाणी जतन करा.

• **एका वेळी एका समस्येवर लक्ष द्या.** माती घट्ट होणे, क्षार साचणे, pH बदल, जुनी माती पुन्हा वापरणे, कोकोपीट धुणे आणि निचरा तपासणे अशा कामांसाठी १४ स्वतंत्र साधने निवडा.

• **मिश्रण आणि साहित्याची नोंद ठेवा.** घटक, वजन किंवा घनफळावर आधारित प्रमाण, साहित्याचा स्रोत आणि प्रत्येक बॅचची माहिती जतन करा. अपेक्षित एकूण प्रमाणानुसार घटकांचे प्रमाण मोजा आणि मिश्रणाच्या जुन्या आवृत्त्या पाहा. गणनेचे सूत्र आणि सहा प्रोग्रामिंग भाषांतील उदाहरणेही उपलब्ध आहेत.

• **उपायांपूर्वी आणि नंतरची स्थिती तपासा.** EC, pH आणि ओलाव्याची मोजमापे, एकके, पद्धत, वेळ, वापरलेले साहित्य आणि फोटो नोंदवा. पुनर्तपासणीनंतर काम पूर्ण, निरीक्षण सुरू, पुढील प्रक्रिया किंवा विल्हेवाट अशी स्थिती निवडा.

• **प्रयोगातील कुंड्यांची तुलना करा.** बदललेला घटक आणि समान ठेवलेल्या अटी नोंदवा. आधीच्या व नंतरच्या निरीक्षणांचा आढावा घ्या आणि स्वतः ठरवलेल्या उद्दिष्टांशी मोजमापांची तुलना करा. आवश्यक माहिती अपुरी असल्यास मूल्यमापनाची स्थिती स्पष्ट दिसते.

MatiMitra ऑफलाइन वापरता येते. नोंदी, मसुदे आणि फोटो तुमच्या उपकरणावर जतन होतात. पुनर्तपासणीसाठी स्मरणपत्रे ठेवा, जुन्या नोंदी शोधा आणि शेअर करण्यापूर्वी माहितीचे पूर्वावलोकन करा. CSV स्वरूपात नोंदी निर्यात करा आणि फोटो व त्यांची सूची स्वतंत्रपणे शेअर करा.

name: MealCatch: Food Photo Log
description:
MealCatch saves what you eat with a single photo.
Press the shutter and you're done. It goes into that day's breakfast, lunch, or dinner by the time you took it.

Later, one look at the photos tells you what you ate.

SNAP
• Take a photo from the button on your Lock Screen or in Control Center, without unlocking. Snap as many dishes in a row as you like
• You can also add a photo from your library

SORTED
• Photos go into breakfast, lunch, or dinner by the time you took them. For a snack, open the meal and pick Snack
• Set your own times for breakfast, lunch, and dinner
• If something's off, touch and hold to change the date or meal. Add a note by typing or by voice

LOOK BACK
• The last day you took photos sits at the top, in big photos
• Earlier days follow below, only the days you took photos
• Switch to Photo Grid to see just your photos, three across
• Works in both Light and Dark Mode

THE PHOTO SAYS IT ALL
• No calories, no scores. No charts, no streaks

NO NAGGING
• No reminders to log your meals
• Forgot to take a photo? No problem. If you remember, add a text note later. If you don't, that's that

ON YOUR IPHONE
• Your photos stay inside MealCatch, so they don't pile up in your Photos library
• MealCatch doesn't send your photos or meals anywhere. No ads
• Your meals are included in your iPhone backup, so they come with you to a new iPhone

PRICING
• One purchase gets you every feature. No in-app purchases

The first time you open MealCatch, you'll see sample meals. Take your first photo, and the samples go away. Your meals begin.

name: Meme Mutants
description:
SAMMELN. VERSCHMELZEN. MUTIEREN. KÄMPFEN. ENTDECKEN.

In einem geheimen Labor ist etwas schiefgelaufen: Bananen machen Liegestütze, Tauben gründen eine Mafia und der Kühlschrank öffnet sich um 3 Uhr nachts von selbst. Willkommen bei Meme Mutants!

• VERSCHMELZEN: Zieh gleiche Mutanten aufeinander und sieh zu, wie sie sich weiterentwickeln – vom Bananardo bis zur kosmischen Banane. Seltene Formen reifen in Kokons heran.
• 85 MUTANTEN: absurde Familien in 5 Entwicklungsstufen, mächtige Mythicals mit Spezialangriffen, dazu seltene Mutationen wie Feuer, Diamanthaut oder Glitch.
• 6 WELTEN: vom Mutanten-Labor über Stadtpark, Mitternachtsküche, Kanalisation und Serverraum bis zur Mondbasis.
• MUTANT CHESS: Taktische Kämpfe auf dem Spielbrett! Jeder Mutant zieht wie eine Schachfigur, du spielst Karten mit Mana, und wenn Zwillinge aufeinandertreffen, entwickeln sie sich mitten im Kampf.
• 48 LEVEL & 6 BOSSE: Hamsterzilla, der Duke of Quack, der Rattenkönig und mehr – mit Gegnern, die immer klüger werden.
• ONLINE-DUELLE: Quick Match gegen Live-Spieler, Ranked Battles gegen die Decks anderer Spieler, Duelle mit Freunden per Code – und eine weltweite Rangliste.
• ENDLOS-TURM & WOCHENBOSS: Wie hoch kommst du?
• TRUHEN, QUESTS, MUTANT PASS & TÄGLICHE BELOHNUNGEN: Jeden Tag gibt es etwas Neues.
• GEHEIMNISSE: Manche Mutanten findest du nur, wenn du sehr seltsame Dinge tust…
• Dein Labor arbeitet auch, wenn du offline bist. Dein Spielstand wird in der Cloud gesichert.

Keine Werbung. Kampfkraft ist nicht käuflich: Im Shop gibt es Skins, den Mutant Pass und Beschleuniger.

name: Memext
description:
Memext is a simple personal memory extension for the things you want to remember without turning your life into a task list.

Save something once, remember an important date, or create a recurring memory. Memext keeps everything organized by when it matters: Now, Soon, or Saved.

With Memext you can:

• Create one-time memories for a specific date and time
• Save something for the future
• Remember important dates
• Create weekly, monthly, and yearly recurring memories
• Receive local notifications when something becomes relevant
• Mark recurring memories as done and automatically move them to the next occurrence
• Archive memories and restore them later

Memext is designed to stay simple. There are no accounts, feeds, ads, or unnecessary features.

Your memories are stored locally on your device. Memext does not operate a server-side database containing your memories and does not use advertising or analytics SDKs.

Remember it once. Let Memext handle the rest.

New in version 1.2:
• Browse memories in a monthly calendar with event icons
• Categorize one-time reminders and set notification lead times for each type
• Export and restore your memories using a JSON backup

name: Memory Note: Day & Family Aid
description:
Memory Note is a gentle everyday helper for people living with memory loss — and the families who care for them.

TODAY, AT A GLANCE
• Morning, afternoon, evening or night — with a big day of the week, date and time
• Tap to hear it read aloud
• Your own name and home address, always on the first screen

TODAY'S LIST
• Medicine, meals, water, a walk… tick them off; the list starts fresh every day
• Family can edit the list to fit the routine

MY PEOPLE
• Photo cards with name, relationship and something to remember ("Visits every Saturday")
• Tap a card to hear "This is Emma, your granddaughter"

NOTES FOR THE QUESTIONS THAT COME UP
• "Where are my glasses?" → "Top drawer by the bed"
• Tap to hear the answer

DESIGNED TO BE EASY
• Large text everywhere, simple tabs, warm colours
• Korean and English
• Photos and notes stay on this device. No ads, no sign-in, no tracking.

Memory Note is a daily-life aid and not a medical device.

name: Mening Tamalim
description:
Mening Tamalim — приложение для выбора квартиры в новостройках строительных компаний на платформе Tamal CRM и для покупателей этих квартир.

БЕЗ РЕГИСТРАЦИИ
• Каталог проектов: фото, расположение, удобства, условия оплаты.
• Планировки квартир и поэтажные планы, с увеличением.
• Шахматка: какие квартиры свободны, забронированы или проданы.
• Заявка на свободную квартиру в одно касание — отдел продаж перезвонит.

ДЛЯ ПОКУПАТЕЛЕЙ (вход по номеру телефона и SMS-коду)
• Договор: сумма, оплачено, остаток.
• График платежей: дата и сумма следующего платежа, просрочки.
• История платежей и квитанции; проверка подлинности квитанции по QR-коду.

ПОСЛЕ ПЕРЕДАЧИ КЛЮЧЕЙ
• Плата за обслуживание и коммунальные счета, показания счётчиков.
• Заявки, объявления дома и опросы.
• Добавление членов семьи.
(Раздел открывается после передачи ключей.)

Личный кабинет — для покупателей квартир компании: ваш номер телефона должен быть в базе компании.

О платформе: https://tamalcrm.uz

name: Meshtrix
description:
Meshtrix is an educational workbench for involute spur gears. Enter module, tooth count, and pressure angle to generate accurate tooth profiles, then watch two gears mesh with a visible line of action.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Gear Studio — Build involute profiles with live pitch, base, tip, and root metrics
• Mesh Bench — Link a pinion and wheel, play or scrub rotation, and inspect contact ratio
• Undercut Lab — See when low tooth counts undercut the fillet—and rescue gears with profile shift
• Shift Compare — Place two shift coefficients side by side and read tip, root, and thickness deltas
• Library — Save and reopen designs stored only on your iPhone
• Learn — Short illustrated primers on involutes, meshing, undercutting, and profile shift
BUILT FOR LEARNING
Ideal for students, instructors, and designers who want geometric intuition before CAM or shop drawings. Results are precise educational models—not manufacturing exports.
PRIVACY-FIRST
No accounts. No tracking. Designs and preferences stay on device.
Open Meshtrix, craft a gear, and see conjugate action clearly.

name: MicroRockets
description:
You're the boss of a tiny rocket company. Right now that's one little rocket on a dirt pad, five thousand dollars and a job out to the test range. Let's get it off the ground.

Pick a job, fill the hold and launch. Flights run on a real clock, so you can put your phone down and your rockets will land without you. Come back, collect what they've earned, and send them off again.

FROM A DIRT PAD TO A FLEET
• Thirteen rockets to fly, from the little one-stage Minnow to the Anglerfish
• Twelve ships for the long runs between worlds, from the Wasp to the Horizon
• A launch pad that grows from bare dirt into a full complex, gantry, crawler and all

FILL THE HOLD
• Every place has people and cargo waiting for a ride
• Fill a rocket or a ship for one place and the whole load pays 15% more
• Tourists, work crews, surveyors and priority crates, all with somewhere to be

BUILD IT, THEN GO PAST IT
• Build Low Orbit Station, then Moon Base, Mars Colony and on out to Neptune
• Fit out every place you open with berths, shuttles and modules
• Find the Fold, cross it, and meet the peoples waiting on the other side

A COMPANY WITH A STORY
• 60 projects in the LAB, and crew who sign on, train up and fly with us
• Story jobs from people with something on their minds, and choices to make when a trip doesn't go to plan
• 32 firsts to set, and at the very end, the Ark

MADE FOR CHECKING IN
• Short flights you can watch over a coffee, long voyages that land while you're busy
• A notification when something lands, only if you want one
• Pixel art, paid once, no ads, no account, and nothing collected about you

It all starts with one small rocket.

name: MilkLark
description:
When was the last bottle, and which side did you nurse on? MilkLark keeps one baby’s feeds in a day-by-day journal on your iPhone.

Record nursing time and side, bottle volume in milliliters and milk type, or the name of a solid food. Each entry can include a time and a short note. The daily page shows the latest feed, feed count, total bottle volume and nursing minutes.

Open the calendar to review or add an earlier entry. Tap a saved feed to correct or delete it. The journal is for caregivers’ observations and does not prescribe feeding targets.

name: MIND Team: Body + Soul Fitness
description:
MIND Team is the app for the Body + Soul Fitness team. It works with MIND, our club system, and you sign in with your MIND email and password. It is for current Body + Soul Fitness team members only: your manager sets up your account, and there is no sign-up in the app.

Answer the front door
• The club doorbell rings on your phone and on the club iPad, even when the screen is locked.
• See who is there on live video, talk to them and open the door.
• Take a look at the front door without anyone ringing.
• Turn "Ring me for the doorbell" off while you are with a client.
• If the club's internet goes down, phones on the club Wi-Fi can still answer the doorbell and open the door.

Your shifts
• See today's shift and the week ahead.
• Swipe to check in and check out.
• Get a manager's approval for a missed or changed check-in.

Your schedule
• See your appointments and your team's schedule, day by day.
• Book, change, repeat and cancel appointments.
• Sign off sessions and record last-minute cancellations.
• Add appointments to your calendar, or sync them with Google Calendar, Outlook or your iPhone calendar.
• Get reminders before your sessions and shifts.

Club cameras
• Live pictures, door photos and replay from the club cameras, for team members whose role includes them.

Safe and simple
• Sign in with Face ID instead of your password.
• You see and do what your role in MIND allows, at your own clubs.
• The app signs you out automatically when your time with Body + Soul Fitness ends.

name: Mini Computer: Retro Desktop
description:
A tiny retro PC in your phone.

Mini Computer is a little retro desktop for iPhone and iPad with 32 programs: games, pixel art, code, notes and more. Open the lid, then work in movable windows with an on-screen keyboard and a virtual trackpad. The native iOS app adapts to your screen, including iPhone Duo.

TAKE A RETRO BREAK
Play Mines and Cards, try the arcade demos and watch patterns grow in LifeLab.

DRAW A SPRITE, ANIMATE IT
Draw 16 × 16 pixel art in SpriteLab, build four frames, watch the live preview and export a PNG. You can also sketch simple vector shapes and lay out a small page or slide.

CODE ON IT
Run small JavaScript experiments in DevLab and see the output. Try a shell-like terminal, selected SQL queries, regex testing, function graphs, and JSON and Base64 tools. They are compact tools for learning and experimenting, with supported commands and formats.

WINDOWS, KEYS AND A TRACKPAD
Drag, resize, minimize and restore windows. Type on the computer's own keys or use its trackpad. Switch between laptop, full-trackpad and fullscreen views, and pick a look: Tide, Ivory, Ember, BlackBox, Phosphor or Studio.

WRITE IT, PLAN IT
Write and save notes, work out numbers with spreadsheet formulas and move tasks from To Do to Done on the task board.

YOUR FILES, OFFLINE
Your work is kept as local virtual files. Import, export and back up through the Files app. Local programs work offline; live web reading and HTTP requests need an internet connection.

NOTHING IN THE WAY
No ads, no account and no in-app purchases.

GOOD TO KNOW
The app interface is in English. Mini Computer is a desktop simulation inside an app. It does not replace the Home Screen, install Linux, run native PC applications or connect to a remote PC. The terminal and SQL support selected commands. The arcade and video timeline tools include demos, and WirePeek is a clearly labelled network simulation. Some creative tools keep their state only for the session, so save or export what you want to keep. Deleting the app can erase its local files.

By Better Brain Lab LLC
Support: support@betterbrainlab.com

name: Ministry Radio
description:
The Ministry Radio network gives churches a way to connect with you through radio. As churches join, you’ll be able to discover their stations and hear the music, messages, and live programming they share. Tune in today to our flagship station for worship music and instrumentals from Summerfield, Florida.

Browse the public station directory, search by name or description, and save your favorites. In Top Artists, see which stations have played an artist in the past seven days, then tap a station to tune in.

Keep listening with your iPhone locked, control playback from the Lock Screen, or send audio to an AirPlay speaker. Listening requires no account.

name: MN Welding
description:
La app oficial para alumnos de MN Welding Academy.

MIS CURSOS
• Consulta tu curso, tu progreso y el estado de tus pagos.
• Revisa el calendario de tus próximas clases.
• Cambia el día o el turno de una clase según la disponibilidad del taller.
• Descarga tu certificado cuando esté disponible.

HERRAMIENTAS
• Nivel: en plano y de pie, usando el móvil.
• Conversor de unidades: pulgadas, psi, cfh, °F, libras…
• Trigonometría: cotas y ángulos del triángulo para cortes y biseles.
• Ajuste de amperaje: punto de partida según proceso, espesor, junta y posición, con vista 3D de la sección.
• Ajuste de gas: tipo de gas y caudal recomendado.
• Diagnóstico de problemas: qué falla en el cordón y cómo corregirlo.

TUTORIALES
• Posiciones de soldadura en 3D: de 1F a 4F y de 1G a 6G, con antorcha MIG o TIG, soldadura animada y la técnica de cada posición.
• Partes de la antorcha: TIG y MIG/MAG despiezadas en 3D, pieza a pieza, con consejos de mantenimiento.

ACCESO SIN CONTRASEÑAS
Entra con el mismo email con el que reservaste tu curso: te enviamos un código de 6 cifras y listo.

name: MNU – Denné menu
description:
MNU ti ukáže dnešné obedové menu reštaurácií, ktoré máš rád, na jednom mieste. Žiadne hľadanie po weboch a Facebooku.

• Dnes – menu všetkých odoberaných reštaurácií na jednej obrazovke, s cenami, gramážou a alergénmi.
• Celý týždeň – pozri si, čo sa bude variť zajtra alebo v piatok.
• Reštaurácie v okolí – zoznam zoradený od najbližšej, vyhľadávanie podľa názvu a mesta.
• Ranné pripomenutie – každý deň o 10:00 ti pripomenieme dnešné menu.
• Otváracia doba a kontakt – adresa, mapa, telefón aj čas výdaja obedov.
• Zdieľanie – pošli menu kolegom jedným ťuknutím.

Máš reštauráciu? Pridaj ju do MNU a zadávaj týždenné menu svojim zákazníkom. Menu môžeš nahrať aj z fotky alebo dokumentu.

Prihlásenie je jednoduché – bez hesla, len e-mailom a kódom.

name: Mochi cam
description:
Mochi is an instant camera in your pocket.

Every pack has ten shots. There's no delete and no retake — a shot taken is a shot spent, so every photo counts. Frame it, press the big shutter, feel the click, and watch your print slide out of the camera.

THEN YOU WAIT
Prints develop slowly, just like real instant film. The image fades up from a pale blank over about a minute and a half. Impatient? Give your phone a shake — it really does help it develop faster.

FIVE FILMS
Pick a film from the strip above the camera and the viewfinder changes to match:
• Classic — punchy mid-tones, creamy highlights, cool teal shadows
• Golden — late-afternoon warmth and honey skin tones
• Mono — black and white with cool blue-grey blacks
• Sepia — warm brown, like an old print kept in a drawer
• Faded — expired-film colors with a yellow-green cast

A REAL CAMERA FEEL
• A small viewfinder that sits off the lens — frame a little left
• Twist the lens: Off, On, or Close-up for details 30–50 cm away
• The flash always fires
• Soft grain, gentle vignette and a little lens softness on every print
• Satisfying haptics and mechanical sounds

YOUR TINY ALBUM
• Every pack becomes its own little collection of ten
• Write a caption on the white border in handwriting
• Save your favorite prints to Photos or share them with friends
• Choose your camera color: mint, peach, sky or lilac

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No sign-up. No ads. No tracking. Mochi never connects to the internet — your photos stay on your iPhone.

Mochi is a camera app. No physical camera or film is included

name: Moji mazlíčci
description:
Moji mazlíčci je přehledná aplikace pro každodenní péči o vaše kočičky a pejsky. Pomůže vám mít na jednom místě jídelníček, podávání léků a vitamínů, termíny očkování, vývoj váhy i zdravotní deníček.

Hlavní funkce aplikace:
• Profily kočiček a pejsků: Uložte si datum narození, rasu, vlastní fotografii nebo kreslenou ilustraci plemene a údaje o pojištění. Aplikace automaticky přepočítává věk zvířátka na lidské roky podle druhu a velikosti rasy.
• Graf vývoje váhy a kondice: Sledujte křivku vážení v čase, změny hmotnosti, denní náladu, chuť k jídlu, pitný režim i stav srsti.
• Jídelníček a zásoby krmiva: Přehled ranního i večerního krmení, odškrtávání podaných porcí a hlídání zbývajících zásob kapsiček či granulí.
• Léky, vitamíny a veterina: Nastavte si časy podávání léků nebo vitamínů a plánujte preventivní prohlídky či očkování u veterináře včetně upozornění v telefonu.
• Rodinná synchronizace: Všechna data fungují okamžitě přímo v telefonu bez nutnosti registrace. Pokud chcete přehled sdílet v rodině nebo zálohovat při výměně telefonu, stačí v nastavení zadat společný rodinný účet a PIN.
• Světlý a tmavý režim: Vzhled aplikace se automaticky přizpůsobuje dennímu a nočnímu režimu vašeho telefonu.

name: Moltory Journal
description:
Keep the story of each reptile, from everyday care to the next generation.

Moltory Journal is a personal reptile journal built around individual animals and their enclosures. Organize feeding, shedding, weight, environmental measurements and breeding records, then return to the details when you need them.

DAILY RECORDS WITH LESS REPEATED TYPING
Log feeding quantities and outcomes, weight, shedding stages, behavior and other observations. Reuse recent entries and familiar details to prepare a new record. Batch feeding creates an individual entry for each animal, with its own quantity and status.

FIND THE HISTORY YOU NEED
Browse the care calendar or search and filter logs by animal, enclosure, date and activity. Revisit an original entry, follow a feeding batch, or review completed care plans and their next scheduled dates.

ENCLOSURE READINGS IN CONTEXT
Enter temperature and humidity manually. Record a single reading or inspect 2-8 named spots in one round. View readings by spot and date, with single readings and inspections shown separately. Keep cleaning, substrate changes, water, lighting and enclosure moves alongside your other records.

FROM PAIRING TO HATCHLING
Connect pairings, egg clutches, incubation measurements and hatch outcomes. Create hatchling profiles from recorded outcomes and retain their links to the source clutch and recorded parents.

YOUR OWN CARE ROUTINE
Set recurring plans at intervals you choose, with optional local notifications. Record what actually happened and choose which plan a care entry completes.

PHOTOS AND OBSERVATIONS OVER TIME
Compare photos side by side or with a slider. Gather related entries into observation projects, preserve your reflections, and save or export weekly and monthly reviews.

A JOURNAL ON YOUR DEVICE
No account is required. Records and photos are stored on your device, and core recording features work offline. There are no ads or third-party tracking SDKs.

Export a JSON backup of your record space and photos, or export care logs as CSV. JSON restore replaces the current record space. Local snapshots and recently deleted care logs provide additional recovery options. Export backups regularly and keep a copy outside the app.

Generate enclosure QR cards and scan them to open the matching enclosure records already stored on the same device.

App interface: English. Local notifications require system permission and may be affected by your device settings.

Moltory Journal is for personal record keeping. It does not provide medical diagnoses, treatment guidance, breeding recommendations or health predictions.

name: Morphovus
description:
Morphovus is an educational morphology companion for pathology learners and early surgical trainees. Study didactic 3D specimen models that pair normal tissue with common pathologic patterns, then reinforce spatial understanding with CT/MRI-style teaching slices and optional AR overlays.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Browse a specimen library spanning digestive lesions, bone and joint injury patterns, cardiac scar morphology, pulmonary consolidation, and neurologic edema cues
• Open paired normal-versus-pathologic boards with blend emphasis and professional annotation pins
• Step through didactic CT and MRI slice stacks linked to each teaching model
• Launch AR Lab to place a simplified educational mesh on a detected surface for orientation practice
• Bookmark specimens, keep personal study notes, track viewing progress, and run a morphology quiz—all stored on device

BUILT FOR LEARNING
Morphovus emphasizes visual comparison: intact mucosa beside ulcer beds, congruent joints beside depressed plateau fractures, aerated lung beside consolidation, and more. Each record includes clinical teaching notes, morphologic cues, and source-modality context so you can connect gross form with imaging language used in foundational courses.

IMPORTANT
Morphovus is for education only. Models and slices are didactic reconstructions, not diagnostic tools, and must not guide clinical decisions, triage, or patient care. Camera access is used solely for on-device AR placement; study data stays on your iPhone.

name: MortarRun: Brick Mortar Bags
description:
MortarRun turns brick courses into mortar bag counts for masonry walls.

Pin the result first: the Courses tab keeps bags, brick totals, and cubic feet on a brick-red banner above the course ladder. Adjust courses high and bricks per course with steppers, pick joint width and bag size, then save the wall run to Jobs.

What you get
• Courses — result-on-top mortar bags from courses × bricks/course
• Mix — Type N / S / M, waste allowance, yard stock remaining
• Jobs — saved wall runs with one-tap reload onto Courses
• More — support and privacy

Built for masons and remodelers who buy bags before the mixer starts. Estimates only — confirm against the coverage chart printed on your mortar bags.

Free. No accounts, ads, or in-app purchases. Works offline on device.

name: Mossnote
description:
Mossnote is a quiet place for one small thought a day.

Open the app, write a sentence or two, and you are done. It takes about a minute, and there is nothing to set up.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Write in seconds. The editor opens ready for you, and a sentence is enough.
- Add a mood if you like. Skip it if you do not.
- Look back on a calendar or in a simple list, with a gentle view of the days you showed up.
- Find any entry with search.
- Revisit an entry from about a week, a month or a year ago.
- Set a daily reminder, only if you want one. It never shows what you wrote.
- Lock Mossnote with Face ID or your passcode.
- Export your entries to a place you choose.
- Choose light, dark or follow your device.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your entries stay on your device. Mossnote has no account, no ads and no tracking, and it does not send what you write anywhere.

GENTLE, ALWAYS
No pressure and no guilt. If you take a few days away, Mossnote just says welcome back.

Muatmd Sales & Marketing on your phone — the same platform at sales.muatmd.sa, in your pocket.

For sales and marketing teams of businesses subscribed to Muatmd Sales: sign in with your account and keep working wherever you are.

Sales

• Her vakit için ayrı ezan, bildirim ya da sessiz seçeneği; vakitten önce hatırlatma

BUGÜN EKRANI VE WIDGET'LAR

HATİM HALKASI

GİZLİLİK

• İsteğe bağlı “Yakındaki camiler” listesi açılırsa yaklaşık (1 km’ye yuvarlanmış) konumunuz ve IP adresiniz OpenStreetMap Overpass sunucularına gönderilir; tam GPS konumunuz gönderilmez. Liste ayarlardan kapatılabilir
• Uygulamayı geliştirmek için anonim kullanım istatistikleri toplanır (hangi ekranların kullanıldığı, uygulama sürümü, telefon modeli, seçtiğiniz şehir ve hata kayıtları). Bunlar kimliğinizle ilişkilendirilmez ve Ayarlar > Gizlilik'ten kapatılabilir

Mumin App, DODO İLERİ TEKNOLOJİ VE TİCARET A.Ş. ürünüdür. Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı ile resmî bir bağlantısı yoktur.

name: Mushii Mossmarket
description:
Mushii Mossmarket is a calm little shop game set on top of a toadstool in a watercolour wood.

Forest creatures wander up to your stall with picture orders. Tap a visitor, then tap the jars they want. Berries, honey and dew go into their basket in order. Fill the basket before their patience leaf wilts and they pay you in acorns.

A wrong jar spills the basket, so keep a steady paw. Each wilted order costs one of your three sprouts. When the last sprout dries, the stall closes and you get a receipt of the day's takings.

Features
- Endless days that start gently, grow busier, then settle into a steady pace
- Quick tap play that suits a few spare minutes
- Streaks and speedy service earn extra acorns
- A ledger of your best day, best streak and lifetime takings
- Hand-painted watercolour fox, hedgehog, rabbit, mouse, owl and badger
- Soft woodland music and sounds, each with its own toggle

name: My Marine Boat
seller_name: DINAMIK TEKNOLOJI HIZMETLERI TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
My Marine Boat, özel tekne ve yat sahipleri için hazırlanmış bir yönetim uygulamasıdır. Teknelerinizi, bakım kayıtlarınızı, belgelerinizi ve tekne ilanlarını tek bir yerden takip edersiniz.

KAPTAN PANELİ
Uygulamayı açtığınızda filonuzun durumunu görürsünüz: gecikmiş bakımlar, yaklaşan işler, süresi dolmak üzere olan belgeler ve son eklenen dosyalar. Tek dokunuşla bakım kaydı ekleyebilir veya belge yükleyebilirsiniz.

TEKNELERİM
• Tekne, boy, en, motor, yakıt, kapasite, bağlama limanı ve kütük bilgilerini kaydedin
• Teknenize fotoğraf ekleyin, kapak fotoğrafını seçin
• Her teknenin "Denize Hazır" veya "Bakım Bekliyor" durumunu görün
• Motor yattan yelkenliye, guletten şişme bota kadar farklı tekne tiplerini yönetin

BAKIM TAKVİMİ
• Bakımları aylık veya haftalık takvimde görün
• Tekneye göre filtreleyin
• Servis firması, yer, tarih ve notları kaydedin
• Yapılan işleri "Tamamlandı" olarak işaretleyin
• Servis firmasını tek dokunuşla arayın

BELGE KASASI
• Ruhsat, sigorta, sözleşme ve faturalarınızı saklayın
• PDF, fotoğraf, Word ve Excel dosyaları yükleyin
• Bitiş tarihi girin, süresi yaklaşan belgeleri uygulamada görün
• Belgeleri uygulama içinde önizleyin, paylaşın veya cihazınıza kaydedin

PAZAR YERİ
• Satılık tekne, yat ve tekne parçası ilanlarına bakın
• Teknenizi veya kullanmadığınız parçaları ücretsiz ilan edin
• Kategori, fiyat, il ve teslim yoluna göre filtreleyin
• Satıcıya uygulama içinden mesaj yazın, satıcı kartını ve puanını inceleyin
• Uygunsuz ilan ve mesajları şikayet edin, kullanıcıları engelleyin

Ödeme uygulama üzerinden yapılmaz: satış, ödeme ve teslim alıcı ile satıcı arasında gerçekleşir.

VERİLERİNİZ SİZİN
• Her kullanıcı sadece kendi kayıtlarını görür
• Bağlantılar şifrelidir
• Giriş yapılan cihazları görebilir, istediğiniz oturumu kapatabilirsiniz
• Hesabınızı ve tüm verilerinizi uygulama içinden kalıcı olarak silebilirsiniz
• Verileriniz satılmaz ve reklam amacıyla kullanılmaz

Hatırlatmalar yalnızca sizin girdiğiniz kayıtlara dayanır ve uygulamayı açtığınızda görünür. Ruhsat, sigorta ve muayene sürelerinin takibi ile yasal yükümlülükler kullanıcının sorumluluğundadır.

• Live Highlights – watch clips from our Facebook Live sessions and shop the dress straight from the video
• Watch & Shop – full-screen dress videos, swipe to see the next one
• New arrivals first – the newest collections always at the top
• Quick filters – shop by color, size and category
• Secure checkout – pay safely with our Shopify checkout
• Chat with us – ask about sizes and stock on Messenger

Lawn, chikankari, sharara, palazzo and party wear from brands like Gulljee, Bin Saeed, Adan's Libas and more.

name: MyGallery: Car Dealer Game
description:
Small showroom. Big deals.

In MyGallery you start with a little cash and a tiny office. The goal is simple: turn your corner lot into the city's most famous car dealership. No character to steer. It's one-thumb play, and all you need is your nose for a good deal.

HUNT THE LISTINGS
New cars land on the MyRide listings every day. Check the mileage, the defects, the seller's story. Order an inspection, catch the hidden fault, talk the price down.

HAGGLE LIKE A PRO
Every customer has their own temper. The one in a rush, the penny-pincher, the one who hates everything... Make your offer, play your card, and shake hands at the right moment.

GROW YOUR BUSINESS
Move to bigger offices, add parking bays, reach for luxury cars. Take a bank loan, just don't miss the payments!

LEGENDS IN THE JUNKYARD
Forgotten legends rust in the junk dealer's yard. Rescue one, restore it and make a fortune.

LIFE ON THE BLOCK
The tea guy brings your morning cup, the local gazette spreads gossip, your phone never stops buzzing. And when night falls, keep your lot safe.

EVERY SALE IS A MEMORY
Each car you sell lands in your album as a snapshot. Post it on Dealstagram and collect the likes.

• No ads, no tracking
• Plays fully offline
• English and Turkish
• Multiple save slots

Enjoy the ride!

name: MyGathers: Who's In
description:
MyGathers is the simplest way to get friends or family together. Start a Gather, say where and when, and invite people by phone number. Each guest gets one text with a link. They open it, see the plan, and answer in or out. No account to create, nothing to install.

For hosts
• Create a Gather in under a minute: title, place, time, and an optional cost.
• Invite from your contacts or paste numbers. Guests get one text, in your name.
• See who's in, who's out, and who hasn't answered, at a glance.
• Change the time or place and tell everyone with one tap.
• Comments keep the chatter in one place.

For guests
• Answer from the text. No app, no password.
• Get a text only when the plan changes.
• Add it to your calendar with one tap.

What MyGathers is not
• No ads, ever.
• No selling your number or your friends' numbers.
• No texts to anyone a host didn't invite. Reply STOP to any text to opt out for good.

Made in Ottawa by Loransia Consulting Inc.

name: MyLoc Owner
description:
MyLoc Owner est l'application des propriétaires dont les logements sont confiés à MyLocTravel. Vous suivez votre activité depuis votre iPhone ou votre iPad, au même endroit que sur votre espace propriétaire.

VOS SÉJOURS ET VOS REVENUS
• Séjours à venir, en cours et terminés, avec la provenance de chaque réservation
• Revenus par mois, nuits vendues et prochain virement

VOTRE CALENDRIER

ÉCHANGEZ AVEC L'AGENCE

VOS DOCUMENTS

VOTRE ACCÈS, EN SÉCURITÉ

L'application est réservée aux propriétaires dont l'agence a ouvert l'espace propriétaire MyLocTravel.

name: mySolat
description:
mySolat shows the official JAKIM prayer times for your zone, reminds you before each solat, and helps you keep count of your rakaat. Simple, black and white, and private: no account, no ads, no tracking.

PRAYER TIMES
• Official JAKIM (e-solat) times for every zone in Malaysia
• Find your zone from your location, or search for a place
• Outside Malaysia, times are calculated on your phone with each country's method
• Imsak, Syuruk and Dhuha, Hijri date, and a live countdown to the next solat
• At least 30 days saved, so it works offline
• Save other locations, such as family in another state or country

REMINDERS
• A heads-up before each solat, so you have time for wudhu
• At solat time: a notification, a full-screen alarm, or nothing
• A short chime, no azan
• Choose which solat to be reminded for

WIDGETS
• Home screen widgets in three sizes, solid or transparent, light or dark
• Lock screen widgets with the next solat or all of today's times
• Choose up to six times to show

RAKAAT COUNTER
• Lay the phone on the sejadah: the front camera notices each sujud and counts your rakaat
• For the five fardu prayers, sunat prayers and tarawih (8 or 20)
• Nothing is recorded or saved, and the camera only runs while you pray

KIBLAT
• A line on the map from where you are to the Kaabah, with the direction from north
• No compass needed, so metal or magnets nearby can't throw it off

SURAH AL-MULK
• The full surah in the Madinah Mushaf script, with adjustable text size

Also: English and Bahasa Melayu, and light and dark mode.

mySolat is an independent app, not affiliated with JAKIM or any government agency. Malaysian prayer times come from JAKIM's e-solat (www.e-solat.gov.my) through the free api.waktusolat.app service.

name: Mythara
description: Compare versions of a myth by putting events in the order you choose and recording what each source says. Add references, describe the roles and connections of characters, and note the symbols and questions you want to revisit. Three editable examples cover Persephone, Orpheus and Eurydice, and the flood of Deucalion and Pyrrha. Create your own research and prepare a text sheet to save or share. Your archive stays on your device, and the app works offline. The interface is in English.

name: NAJID
description:
NAJID helps Hajj and Umrah pilgrims stay connected with their agency and guides when they lose their group.

REQUEST ASSISTANCE
Send a help request from the app so your agency can respond and coordinate assistance.

SHARE YOUR CURRENT LOCATION
With your permission, share your GPS position when requesting help so your agency and guides can assist you.

FIND YOUR WAY AND YOUR GROUP
Use maps of Mecca and Medina and group meeting points to help you find your bearings and reconnect with your group.

KEEP COMMUNICATION TOGETHER
Use alerts and messaging to exchange information with your agency and guides and follow assistance requests through to resolution.

FOR PILGRIMS, AGENCIES AND GUIDES
NAJID supports coordination between pilgrims and the teams accompanying them throughout Hajj and Umrah.

Available in English, French, Arabic and Turkish.

Learn more: https://najidgroup.com
Contact: contact@najidgroup.com

name: Namira
description:
Namira（ナミラ）は、PC 並みのブラウザと本格的なファイル管理をひとつにまとめた iPhone アプリです。Web を見る・ダウンロードする・整理する・プレビューする・共有する、までをアプリの中で完結できます。

■ ブラウザ
・複数タブ（横スクロールのタブバー、タブ一覧）
・PC 表示モード：1920×1080 のデスクトップレイアウトでページを表示。横向きにすると全画面に
・URL バーをタップすると、URL のコピー、最近のサイト、お気に入り、最近のダウンロード、各種コントロールをまとめて表示
・URL バーは下・上を選べ、ページに重ねるかどうかも切り替え可能
・URL バー左のボタンは好きな操作に割り当て可能
・ページ内検索、文字サイズ調整、ダウンロード管理
・Chrome から書き出したブックマーク（HTML）の読み込み・書き出し

■ ファイル管理
・フォルダの作成、名前の変更、移動、削除、並べ替え
・写真・動画のギャラリー表示
・ZIP / TAR / GZIP の展開（日本語ファイル名にも対応）
・「ファイル」App の「この iPhone 内 › Namira」からも同じファイルにアクセス

■ プレビューと編集
・Markdown（Mermaid 図にも対応）、コード（シンタックスハイライト）、SVG、画像、PDF など
・Mermaid と SVG はその場で編集してプレビュー
・テキストファイルの作成・編集

■ メディアプレーヤー
・動画・音声の再生、ピクチャ・イン・ピクチャ、バックグラウンド再生、再生速度、ジェスチャー操作

■ 共有
・他のアプリの共有メニューから、写真・ファイル・リンク・テキストを Namira に保存
・Namira のファイルを他のアプリへ共有

■ デザイン
・Liquid Glass 風の浮かぶ URL バーとタブバー
・ダークモード、アクセントカラー、テーマの切り替え
・日本語、英語、中国語（簡体・繁体）、韓国語、スペイン語、フランス語、ドイツ語に対応

データはすべて端末内に保存され、開発者が収集することはありません。

name: Naut: Cosmic Audio Player
description:
Sometimes listening to music is better when your eyes have somewhere calm to rest.

Naut pairs your music with a smooth, real-time 3D neon tunnel that moves and bends in sync with the beat. Whether you are winding down late at night with headphones on, keeping a visual companion on your desk while you work, or simply listening to your favorite mixes from a new perspective, Naut gives you a quiet, distraction-free space to drift.

Key Features:

- Audio-Reactive 3D Tunnel
The tunnel's rings and movement respond naturally to bass and rhythm. Cruise at the default 20x speed, or open the speed panel anytime to adjust smoothly between a gentle 1x drift and a 60x rush.

- Three Ways to Play Your Music
1. Online Discovery: Browse and stream tracks from the built-in online library for free.
2. Local Files: Import your own MP3, FLAC, WAV, or M4A audio files directly from the iPhone Files app.
3. Google Drive Import: Paste a shared Google Drive link to download your personal audio tracks for offline playback.

- Gyro Steering & AirPods Head Tracking
Let auto-cruise guide you around every turn, or press and hold the steering button to tilt your phone and pilot through the tunnel yourself. If you use compatible AirPods, you can also enable head tracking so the camera angle shifts naturally as you move.

- Designed for Late-Night Comfort
Built with dark OLED-friendly tones and clean controls that stay out of your way. Whenever you want to slow things down, tap the warm sanctuary button in the corner to gently dim the visuals and soften the audio.

Version 1.0 is completely free to use, with no ads.

name: Nav SLOp
description:
O Nav SLOp é um navegador para paraquedistas em navegação de velame aberto. Carregue o arquivo KMZ da missão e o app guia você até o alvo usando o GPS do iPhone.

NAVEGAÇÃO
• Seta para o destino com cores: verde (no rumo), amarelo (ajuste leve) e vermelho (corrija o rumo), com a instrução de virada no centro: EM FRENTE, DIREITA, ESQUERDA ou VOLTE.
• Distância até o alvo ou o PA, azimute magnético, rumo e velocidade no solo.
• Altura sobre a zona de lançamento, razão de descida e tempo até o solo.
• Taxa de deslizamento necessária comparada com a atual, e aviso CHEGA / NÃO CHEGA com a altura que sobra ou falta.
• Vento e linha de voo da missão desenhados sobre imagem de satélite.

FUNCIONA NO SALTO
• Avisos por voz com distância, posição do destino em horas de relógio e altura que sobra.
• Continua funcionando com a tela bloqueada.
• Mapas offline: baixe a área no solo e use sem sinal nenhum.
• Tela em pé ou deitada.

REGISTRO DE SALTOS
• Cada navegação é registrada sozinha, com data, hora, tempo de velame, altura de abertura e distância do pouso ao alvo.
• Veja a trajetória no mapa e exporte em GPX para analisar em outros programas.

PRIVACIDADE
Sem cadastro, sem anúncios e sem rastreamento. A localização e os saltos ficam só no seu iPhone.

Aviso: o Nav SLOp é uma ferramenta de apoio e não substitui o treinamento, o briefing, o altímetro nem o julgamento do paraquedista.

name: Nearmind: Place Reminders
description:
Some errands don't have a date, only a place. Pick up the parcel when you're near the post office. Buy picture hooks next time you pass the hardware store. Nearmind remembers the place for you and reminds you the moment you get close.

PIN ANY PLACE
Tap a shop on the map, search for it, long-press anywhere or pin where you stand. Add a note like "Sunday bread for the brunch".

YOU CHOOSE HOW CLOSE
From 10 m at the door to 10 km away, on a slider that makes both easy, with presets in metres or feet. Remind once, or every time you pass by.

ON TIME, LIGHT ON BATTERY
With your permission, iOS watches the area around each place for Nearmind and wakes it when you get there, even after you've closed it. This is gentle on the battery: precise GPS runs only for a few minutes when you approach a small place. Reminders are time-sensitive, so they can come through a Focus if you allow it.

ALREADY THERE?
Save a place you're standing in and Nearmind asks whether to remind you right now or only when you come back.

MADE FOR THE IPHONE DUO
Folded, it's a map with a sheet. Half open like a book: your places on the left page, the map on the right. Half open like a laptop: the map stands up, the controls lie flat. Fully open: one big map with a side panel. Folding never loses what you were doing. It works on every other iPhone too.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your places and your location stay on your iPhone. No account, no servers, no ads, no analytics. The map, search and addresses come from Apple Maps.

From the reminder you can get directions, stop reminding, or be reminded again next time.

name: Nibble Book
description:
The first taste of peanut butter is a big moment. It can also be a nervous couple of hours.

Nibble Book keeps track of that time for you. Log a new allergen, start a watch, and keep your eyes on your baby instead of the clock. A countdown stays on your Lock Screen. When time is up, the app asks if you noticed anything, and your answer goes into your baby's record.

WATCH A NEW ALLERGEN
- Choose 1, 2, or 4 hours, based on what your pediatrician recommends
- See the countdown on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
