- Get a reminder when time is up, and answer right from the notification
- Noticed something sooner? Log it with one tap

A PICTURE BOOK OF FIRST FOODS
100 hand-drawn foods wait as pencil sketches, across veggies, fruits, proteins, grains, and common allergens. Log a food and it fills with color. Foods you're watching stay as sketches until you answer.

LOG IT IN SECONDS
- The date, a reaction, and your notes
- Reactions: Loved it, Liked, Disliked, or Allergy
- Includes the nine major US allergen groups, such as peanut, egg, milk, and sesame

SHARE ONE TIDY LIST
Turn your log into a single image for your pediatrician, sitter, or grandparents. Reactions go at the top, and foods you watched show how long. Save it to Photos or send it from the app.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Everything stays on your iPhone
- No account to create
- No ads and no tracking

Nibble Book is a personal log. It doesn't give medical advice, and it can't tell you whether a food is safe for your baby. A finished watch doesn't rule out a reaction, since some appear later. Talk with your pediatrician about when and how to introduce foods. In an emergency, call 911.

name: Niferco
description:
Niferco là ứng dụng hỗ trợ người dùng doanh nghiệp của Công ty Cổ phần Phân lân Ninh Bình, đơn vị thành viên của VINACHEM, truy cập hệ thống công việc trên thiết bị di động. Người dùng đăng nhập bằng tài khoản do đơn vị quản lý cung cấp và sử dụng các chức năng theo quyền được phân công.

TÍNH NĂNG CHÍNH
• Chọn cơ sở dữ liệu và đơn vị làm việc trước khi đăng nhập.
• Truy cập các dịch vụ và hệ thống công việc được tích hợp.
• Nhận và xem thông báo công việc.
• Quét mã QR bằng camera hoặc từ ảnh trong thư viện.
• Xem tài liệu và truy cập quy trình ký điện tử được đơn vị tích hợp.
• Hỗ trợ xác thực sinh trắc học trên thiết bị tương thích.

YÊU CẦU SỬ DỤNG
Ứng dụng cần kết nối internet và tài khoản hợp lệ do đơn vị quản lý cung cấp. Các chức năng hiển thị phụ thuộc vào quyền tài khoản và cấu hình hệ thống. Không hỗ trợ đăng ký tài khoản công khai. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên của đơn vị để được cấp tài khoản và hỗ trợ sử dụng.

name: NineMineClist
description:
A true-or-false game where every right answer is a gem.

HOW TO PLAY IN 3 STEPS
1. Tap a rock to crack it open. You will see a short claim about the Earth.
2. Decide: is it REAL ORE (true) or FOOL'S GOLD (false)?
3. Right answer = a shining gem. Wrong answer = a cave-in, and you lose a pickaxe.

You start with 3 pickaxes. Clear all 9 rocks in a shaft to go one level deeper.

THE DEEPER YOU GO, THE BETTER THE GEMS
• Depth 1 – Quartz – 10 points
• Depth 2 – Amethyst – 20 points
• Depth 3 – Emerald – 35 points
• Depth 4 – Sapphire – 50 points
• Depth 5 – Ruby – 75 points
• Depth 6 and below – Diamond – 120 points

Get a whole shaft right and you find a spare pickaxe.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 80 true-or-false claims about rocks, minerals, volcanoes, caves, oceans and space
• A short reason after every answer, so you learn something each time
• Gem Vault: every gem you have ever found, saved on your phone
• 6 badges to earn
• Miners' Guild: a leaderboard of the best hauls

GOOD TO KNOW
• Free to play, no account needed
• Works offline. Only the leaderboard needs internet
• You can pick a nickname or get a random one

name: Ninety Rush
description:
Ninety Rush is a fast, offline Lotto game. Each player gets three tickets. Ninety numbered balls are drawn one at a time, and you tap the matching numbers while they are still among the last five drawn. Miss the window and the number is gone for good.

Be the first to complete a Line (one row) or a full Card (one whole ticket) to beat the bots.

FEATURES
- Play against 1 to 5 computer opponents with Easy, Normal and Hard difficulty
- Line or Card victory, with Slow, Medium and Fast draw speeds
- Simulated room: sit at a table with 3 to 5 named bots of mixed skill
- Voiced "3, 2, 1, GO!" countdown and satisfying tap feedback
- Win showcase and a records screen that tracks every game
- Clean modern design with automatic dark mode
- Fully offline. No account, no ads, no data collection

name: No Crumbs: Cookie-Banner
description:
No Crumbs blendet Cookie-Banner in Safari aus.

- Klickt auf der Website automatisch „Alle akzeptieren“ oder „Alle ablehnen“, ganz wie du es im Popup einstellst, und blendet das Banner danach aus.
- Ausnahmeliste: Websites, auf denen du selbst wählen willst, bleiben unberührt.
- Erkennt Banner auf Deutsch, Englisch, Französisch, Italienisch, Türkisch, Spanisch und Niederländisch.
- Unterstützt gängige Consent-Tools, z. B. OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics und Didomi.
- Pro Website abschaltbar, direkt im Popup der Erweiterung.
- Zähler der Banner, die ausgeblendet wurden.

Wichtig:
- Im Standard akzeptiert die App alle Cookies, auch die nicht notwendigen. Im Modus „Alle ablehnen“ klickt sie nur auf eindeutige Ablehnen-Knöpfe; gibt es keinen, wird das Banner nur ausgeblendet. Sie schützt deine Daten nicht vor Websites.
- Keine Daten, kein Tracking, keine Netzwerkaufrufe der App. Gespeichert werden nur der Zähler, der gewählte Modus und die Ausnahmeliste, lokal auf dem Gerät.
- Nur für Safari auf iPhone und iPad (iOS 17 oder neuer).
- Die Erweiterung braucht Zugriff auf Websites, um Banner zu erkennen.
- Nach der Installation in den Safari-Einstellungen aktivieren.
- Die Oberfläche der App ist derzeit nur auf Deutsch verfügbar.

name: Noluti ReelMemo
description:
Discover trending movies and TV shows, watch trailers, and write questions to your future self, all in one cozy app. Explore what to watch next, then answer your own questions when the date arrives.

DISCOVER MOVIES & TV SHOWS
Find your next watch with upcoming, trending, and popular movies. Search for any movie or TV show by title, browse seasons and episodes, and play trailers in full screen. Save your favourites so you can come back to them anytime.

ASK YOUR FUTURE SELF
Instead of writing about your past, write questions for the person you're becoming. Put down the questions you keep avoiding, like "Am I getting closer to the life I want?", and choose exactly when you want to answer them: next week, next month, or next year.

ANSWER WHEN THE TIME COMES
When a question is due, it's time to be honest with yourself. Write your answer and tag it with how you feel: happy, sad, anxious, surprised, or just okay.

BUILD YOUR OWN LIBRARY OF ANSWERS
Every answer becomes a keepsake. Look back anytime to see how your feelings and your life have changed, one question at a time.

MADE TO FEEL LIKE PAPER
Hand-drawn stickers, torn notes, washi tape, and a handwritten feel, like a journal you'd actually want to keep.

- Your questions and answers stay on your device, so you can write and answer them even offline
- Available in English, Spanish, and French
- No account needed

Download now, find something great to watch, and give your future self something to answer.

name: Nostone Books
description:
Nostone Books is the reader for the Nostone universe.

Read and listen in one place. The narration follows the page, word by word, and your place follows you from the app to the website and back.

• Read with the type, size and appearance you choose. 
• Listen with the screen off, at the speed you like, with a sleep timer. 
• Keep books on your phone for reading and listening offline. 
• Talk about a chapter with other readers, beside the paragraph that started it. 
• Join the Council: vote on fan art and posts, and help build the Codex. 
• Choose which notifications you get, and when.

Books are bought on nostonebooks.com. Sign in, and everything you own is here.

Leaving no stone unturned.

name: Note Porch
description:
Keep a few useful words where you'll see them. Note Porch puts your notes on your Home Screen or Lock Screen, so a thought, a short list or today's focus is close at hand.

A NOTE FOR THE MOMENT
Choose one note for a widget, or set up a daily plan with up to 16 local times. Each planned note stays selected until the next time, including overnight.

MAKE IT YOURS
Write plain-text notes with a title. Choose from four coordinated color presets, two text sizes and leading or centered alignment. Small, medium and large Home Screen widgets sit alongside inline, circular and rectangular Lock Screen formats. Space and system appearance can limit the text and colors shown.

SIMPLE TO SET UP
Follow the built-in widget guide. Use One note to keep a particular note selected, or Daily plan to follow your schedule.

KEEP A COPY
Export a JSON backup to a location you choose in Files. Preview an import to add notes without replacing your current notes or daily plan. Restore a backup only when you want to replace both.

WORKS OFFLINE
No account, ads, analytics or app-managed cloud sync. Notes are stored on your device. Exports go where you choose, and device backups follow your system settings.

iOS controls widget refresh timing and may delay changes. Note Porch is not an alarm or reminder service. Widgets can be visible to others, so keep passwords and sensitive information out of them.

name: NovaTek Book Publishing
description:
NovaTek Book Publishing helps you turn your idea, memories or manuscript into a finished book, in English, French or Haitian Creole.

Start with a friendly interview. NovaTek asks one simple question at a time to learn who your book is for, what it promises and why you are the person to write it. Your answers become a Book Brief you can edit anytime.

WRITE IN YOUR OWN VOICE
• Share a few writing samples and NovaTek builds a Voice Guide so suggestions sound like you.
• Plan your chapters with an outline you control: reorder, rename, add your own or ask for new chapter ideas.
• Draft, expand, coach and polish chapter by chapter. Every AI suggestion stays a suggestion. Nothing changes in your book unless you choose it.
• Upload an existing manuscript, photos or documents and pick up where you left off.

PREPARE TO PUBLISH
• Preview your chapters as formatted pages.
• Get cover ideas, title and subtitle options, and back-cover text.
• Prepare your files and listing details for publishing platforms such as Amazon KDP, under your own name and account.

YOUR BOOK IS YOURS
• You keep all rights to what you write.
• Your writing is never used to train AI models.
• No ads.
• Download all your data or delete your account anytime from the app.

THREE LANGUAGES
Use the app in English, French or Haitian Creole. Translations made with AI should be reviewed by a fluent speaker before you publish.

NovaTek helps you prepare and publish your book. It does not guarantee sales, income or rankings.

Terms of Use: https://app.novatekbookpublishing.com/en/terms
Privacy Policy: https://app.novatekbookpublishing.com/en/privacy

name: Nur Manager
description:
Nur Manager is an offline password manager built around one idea: your passwords come from a single master phrase.

COMPUTED, NOT SYNCED
Type a website and a login and Nur Manager calculates a strong, unique password for it from your master phrase. The same phrase always gives the same password, so a new phone needs no backup and no sync: enter your phrase and every computed password is back.

KEEP THE LOGINS YOU ALREADY HAVE
Some sites won't let you change a password. Save it in your list instead. Saved passwords, notes and 2FA keys are encrypted on your device with a key derived from your phrase. They never leave the device.

TWO-FACTOR CODES
Add a site's 2FA key by scanning its QR code or pasting the setup key. Nur Manager shows the current six-digit code with a countdown and can fill it for you.

PASSWORD AUTOFILL
Turn on Nur Manager in Settings › General › AutoFill & Passwords. In Safari and apps, tap Passwords above the keyboard, enter your PIN, and pick a saved login or compute a new password on the spot.

PHRASE FINGERPRINT
Next to your phrase you always see the same three symbols. If they ever look different, you mistyped the phrase, so you never create passwords from a typo.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works without internet. The app makes no network requests.
• No account, no cloud, no analytics, no ads, no tracking.
• Quick unlock with a 6-digit PIN; five wrong attempts erase the key from the device.
• The clipboard clears itself, and the app hides its contents in the app switcher.

ALSO
• Version counter: changed a password on a site? Bump the version.
• Custom rules per site: length, letters, digits, symbols.
• Favorites, search and notes.
• Light and dark appearance, iPhone and iPad.

Your master phrase cannot be recovered by anyone, including us. Write it down and keep it safe.

name: Octle: 8 Daily Puzzle Games
description:
A word completed. A chain cleared. One last piece that solves it all. Octle brings together eight puzzle games for that moment when everything falls into place.

Switch games and try a different way of thinking. Explore 4,000 levels, learn with animated tutorials and return for a fresh daily challenge across all eight games.

• Syncle. Tap a letter to advance every word waiting for it. The right letter order saves taps.
• Trimle. Trace paths of the required length. The end of one path sets the length of the next.
• Fimle. Match identical shapes in one row or column and flip the pieces between them.
• Lynle. Take letters from either end of a ribbon to complete words.
• Nimle. Reduce numbers in a chain reaction and clear the board within the move limit.
• Dymle. Place numbers into lanes, keep them in order and reach the exact target sums.
• Oryle. Place number tiles between circles. Each number counts at both ends.
• Jynle. Combine neighbouring pieces, cancel matching shapes and think about what remains after each move.

A fresh combination of all eight games awaits every day. Aim for three stars in each puzzle and earn up to 24 stars in the daily challenge. Share your result grid, send a duel link and compare results on the leaderboard.

Prefer to follow your own path? The campaign has 500 levels per game. Start small, discover new twists and grow your collection of stars. Animated tutorials show every move through to a completed board.

Play as a guest or sign in with Google or Apple to sync your progress. Internet access is required to load the game. Daily reminders are optional.

Available in Catalan, Spanish and English.

Eight games. A challenge every day. The next click is yours.

A game by Nimble Nest Games.

name: Odobook - Car Maintenance Log
description:
Odobook is a fuel and maintenance log for your car, truck, motorcycle, RV or boat. Log fill-ups, see your real MPG, keep a service history and get reminded when the oil change is due. Everything stays on your phone: no account, no ads, no tracking.

BRING YOUR HISTORY WITH YOU
Moving from another app? Odobook reads files exported from Fuelly (the website and the iPhone app) and full backups from aCar. You see a preview first: choose the vehicles, set the units, fix dates, then save. Importing the same file twice adds nothing. Your files are read on the phone and never uploaded.

FUEL AND MPG
• Full-tank MPG, worked out the accurate way, with partial fills and missed fill-ups handled properly
• MPG for each fill-up, average MPG, cost per mile and fuel spend
• Miles, kilometers or engine hours; gallons or liters, set per vehicle
• Station and notes on every fill-up

SERVICE LOG AND REMINDERS
• Log oil changes, tire rotations, brakes, filters and anything else, several jobs per visit
• Odometer, cost, shop and notes for every service
• Reminders by miles, by months, or both, counted from the last time you did the job
• A notification on the day a reminder is due, estimated from how much you drive

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
• No account and no sign-in
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking
• Export fill-ups and the service log as CSV for Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets
• Back up everything to one file and keep it in iCloud Drive, Google Drive or anywhere you like
• Restore it on a new phone, iPhone or Android

Odobook is made by a small independent developer. Ideas and bug reports go straight to the person who builds the app, from Settings → Send feedback.

Imports files exported from Fuelly and aCar. Odobook is not affiliated with Fuelly, aCar or their owners.

name: odot - Focus Timer
description:
Hands off your phone. The journey begins.

odot is a focus timer with a little pixel-art car. Start the timer, put your phone down, and the car keeps driving while you study, work or read. Come back to see how far you went.

TIMER / STOPWATCH
• 25 minutes, 50 minutes, any length you like. A chime tells you when time's up.
• No set end time? Count up with the stopwatch instead.

EVER-CHANGING SCENERY
• Countryside, coast, city, snowfields and highways roll by one after another.
• The weather and the time of day change as you go: sunsets, rain, snow and starry nights.

100 TROPHIES
• Rare sights and moments wait down the road.
• Some only appear in certain places, weather or times of day. Fill in your trophy book.

YOUR DRIVE LOG
• Look back on your driving time and distance on a calendar.
• Charts for the last 7 days, 30 days and 12 months show how it all adds up.

MADE TO BE PUT DOWN
• Leave the app and the car pulls over and waits. Come back within 10 minutes to keep going.
• Plays alongside your music. The song playing in the Music app shows on the dashboard.
• No account, no ads, no data collected. Works offline.

name: OIAI Go
description:
Important - READ BEFORE DOWNLOAD OIAI GO APP

To access your lessons and use the app, you will need to obtain your login details via email. We kindly ask that you do not download the app unless you are enrolled in a course with Otermans Institute or one of its partners.

You cannot create an account inside the app.

OIAI Go is a second, lighter OIAI app, not an update to it. It uses 2D avatars and installs smaller with no graphics requirement, so it runs on less advanced devices.

Reading and colour settings
Each learner sets these themselves, and the app saves the choice against their account, so a shared device restores their setup at sign-in.

Offline
Downloaded lessons play with no connection. Progress stays on the device and syncs when the learner is next online.

OIAI AI teachers lead each course, answer your questions and read lessons aloud.

For organisations
OIAI Go is licensed to schools, colleges, institutions and government programmes. For licensing, email partnership@oiedu.co.uk

name: Oku Kur’an
description:
Oku Kur’an; Arapça Kur’an metnini, Türkiye Diyanet Vakfı Türkçe mealini, iki dilde sesli dinlemeyi ve kaynaklı sözcük dizinini sunar.

• 114 sure ve 6.236 ayet: Arapça metin ve tam Türkçe meal.
• Arapça tilavet, Türkçe meal sesi ve iki dili sırayla dinleme.
• Cihazda tutulan ayraçlar; son dinlenen sure, ayet, dil ve saniyeden devam. Ses açılışta kendiliğinden başlamaz.
• Yazı boyutu, açık/koyu görünüm ve dinlenen metni ekran üzerinde takip etme.
• 14.977 farklı Arapça yazılışın geçtiği ayetler, tam mealler ve mevcut kaynak açıklamaları. Bu sayı kök sayısı değildir.
• Hükümler ve İlkeler: 530 konu ve 2.396 farklı ilişkili ayet, kaynak ve inceleme notlarıyla.

Sözcük takibi, kaynak metin ve ses kaydı eşleştiğinde kullanılır. Arapçada 6.209, güncel incelenmiş Türkçe metinde 5.018 ayet bu takibe uygundur; diğer ayetlerde ayetin tamamı takip edilir. Her sözcüğün insan tarafından doğrulandığı iddia edilmez.

Metin, meal, dizin ve kaynak kayıtları uygulama paketindedir. İsteğe bağlı Tam çevrimdışı indir seçeneği iki dilde 12.472 ses kaydını cihazda saklar. Yaklaşık 2,66 GB ses verisine ek olarak uygulama ve işletim sistemi alanı gerekir. İlk indirme internet ister. İndirme sırasında uygulamayı açık tutun; arka plana geçince indirme duraklar. Daha sonra eksik kayıtlardan devam edilebilir. Tamamlanmış yerel sesler internetsiz dinlenebilir. Kullanıcı tarafından başlatılan ses oynatımı arka planda ve kilit ekranından denetlenebilir.

Kök tanımı, ayete özgü kaynak karşılığı ve tam meal kendi kapsamlarıyla sunulur. Hükümler bölümü tematik dizindir; bütün fıkhî görüşleri kapsadığı iddia edilmez. Kaynak ve lisans bildirimleri uygulamada yer alır. Uygulama yeni meal, tefsir veya kişisel dinî yorum üretmez.

Hesap, reklam, abonelik veya uygulama içi ödeme gerektirmez. Ayraçlar ve son dinleme yeri başka cihazlara eşitlenmez.

name: Ola Beauty Bar Admin
description:
Ola Beauty Bar Admin is the staff app for Ola Beauty Bar, a lash and brow studio in Burnaby, BC. It requires a staff account issued by the salon.

RUN THE DAY
• Calendar by artist with day, week, month and list views, first-time-client and deposit badges
• Appointments: book, reschedule, confirm, check in, mark no-shows, book the next visit
• Checkout with GST options, debit/cash discount, deposits, Square reader or payment link, and quick cash or e-transfer payments

KNOW YOUR CLIENTS
• Client profiles with visit history, notes, photos, tags and no-show flags
• Call, text or email a client in one tap
• Messages and reception inbox for texts, calls and contact-form enquiries

GROW THE BUSINESS
• Business dashboard: sales, bookings, clients, marketing and website numbers
• Growth tools: booking sources, ad spend, testimonials and abandoned-booking recovery
• Loyalty, referrals, memberships, reviews and reports

MANAGE THE TEAM
• Staff profiles, schedules and bookable dates
• Tips ledger, staff payouts and tip policy
• Services, prices, add-ons and salon settings

Works offline: changes you make without a connection sync automatically when you're back online.

name: Olá Viseu
description:
O Olá Viseu é o guia da cidade de Viseu no telemóvel. Mostra o que está perto de si, se está aberto agora e como lá chegar, e funciona mesmo sem rede.

PERTO DE MIM
• Locais ordenados pela distância a que está deles: monumentos, restaurantes, alojamento, supermercados, ginásios, clínicas, oficinas e muito mais.
• Filtro «aberto agora», calculado a partir dos horários de cada local.
• «Como chegar» num toque, com o Google Maps.

HOJE
• O tempo em Viseu, o gasóleo mais barato e as farmácias de serviço.
• O próximo jogo do Académico de Viseu, que pode juntar ao calendário.
• O que acontece hoje na cidade, da agenda cultural ao cinema.

GUIA
• As mesmas secções do olaviseu.pt: Visitar, Comer & Dormir, Desporto & Lazer, Serviços & Cidade e Agenda.
• Guias para a história da cidade, os museus, o Vinho do Dão, a Feira de São Mateus e a Ecopista do Dão.
• Para quem vive cá: serviços essenciais, linhas de autocarro MUV, freguesias, escolas e creches, e um guia para quem se muda para Viseu.

FAVORITOS E SEM REDE
• Guarde os locais de que gosta para os encontrar depressa.
• O guia completo fica guardado no telemóvel e funciona sem rede. A app mostra sempre quando os dados foram atualizados.

EM TRÊS LÍNGUAS
• Português, inglês e espanhol. A app segue a língua do telemóvel, e pode mudá-la nas definições.

PRIVACIDADE
• Sem contas, sem publicidade e sem análise de utilização.
• A sua localização é usada só no telemóvel para calcular distâncias e nunca é enviada para lado nenhum.
• Política de privacidade: https://olaviseu.pt/privacidade/#app

O Olá Viseu é um projeto independente e não é uma app oficial da Câmara Municipal de Viseu nem de nenhuma entidade de turismo. Encontrou um erro num horário ou quer sugerir um local? Escreva para contacto@olaviseu.pt.

Availabe in Portuguese(PT), English and Spanish.

name: Omamo: Bookmarks & Read Later
description:
Close the tabs. Keep everything.

Omamo is a calm place for everything you find on the web. Share a link from Safari or any app and it lands on the right board, with its title and picture. Find it again in seconds, and read saved articles later without the clutter.

SAVE FROM ANY APP
• Share a page from your browser or any app, pick Omamo, and tap Save.
• Add a note so you remember why you saved it, or write a note on its own.
• Add tags as you save, and choose the board and collection it goes to.
• Omamo tells you when a link is saved already, and where.

READ IT LATER
• Omamo keeps the words of the articles you save. Open them in the Reader, in clean type and without the ads.
• Your copy stays readable even if the page changes later.
• The passages you highlighted on your computer show in the Reader, with their notes.
• Saved YouTube videos play right where you saved them.

KEEP IT TIDY
• Spaces for each part of your life, boards for each project, and collections inside them.
• Every card shows what it is: a link with its picture, a YouTube video, or a note.
• Tag anything, star the collections you open most, pin what matters to the top, and sort a board your way.
• Search titles, notes, and links across every board.
• Pick many cards at once, then move, tag, pin, copy, or delete them together.
• Deleted things wait in the trash for 30 days.

SHARE A BOARD
• Share a board or a collection with a link. Anyone can open it without an account.
• See who can open each board. Spaces and boards that people share with you show up here, with everyone's saves.

ON YOUR COMPUTER TOO
• Your boards sync with the Omamo browser extension and the web app.
• Import your browser's bookmarks, or an export from another tab manager. Export a space, a board, or a collection as a file whenever you like.
• Six themes, from the warm Sheet to Night.

Sign in with Apple or Google.

We do not sell your data, show ads, or use your content to train AI.

name: Oncourt – Book Courts
description:
Oncourt is the easiest way to book a court and play in Lebanon.

BOOK A COURT IN SECONDS
• See the free times and the exact price at each club
• Choose how long you play: 60, 90 or 120 minutes, each with the club's own price
• Booking is free: you pay at the club when you arrive
• Cancel in the app within the club's free-cancellation window
• See the closest courts first

JOIN MATCHES
• Join open matches at your level, or create one and let players fill the spots
• Chat with the players of your match to agree on teams and timing. The chat disappears after the game
• Invite friends with a link on WhatsApp

YOUR PLAYER PROFILE
• Your own @username, so friends find the right person
• Your level and playing style in each sport
• Add friends and see their levels and matches

PLAY TOURNAMENTS
• Clubs publish tournaments in the app
• See every team and its players
• Enter as a team: invite friends in the app or share your team link
• Follow the draw, your next match and the bracket live

NEVER MISS A GAME
• Booking confirmations, a reminder an hour before you play, friend requests and match chat on your phone

SAFE AND RESPECTFUL
• Report or block any player in two taps. Our team reviews every report within 24 hours

Starting with padel at BlackShot in Byblos, with more clubs and sports joining soon.
Oncourt is free to use.

name: One Square a Day
description:
One Square a Day is a calm, simple habit tracker. Fill in one square for each habit, every day.

- A clear habit grid
Set a monthly goal for each habit and tap a day to check it off. Choose a check, cross or dot style.

- Missing one day is OK
Your streak keeps going after a single day off. It only restarts after two days off in a row. Consistent beats perfect.

- Level up as you go
Every check earns XP and grows your level.

- Monthly and yearly stats
See your goal progress, check rate, active days and best month at a glance.

- A tiny buddy
Pick a sprout, a wombat or a penguin and it walks along your home screen. It hops when you check in and dozes off once today is done. You can turn it off anytime.

- Gentle reminders
Get a daily reminder of what's left. If a streak is about to break, that habit comes first.

- Your data stays on your phone
No sign-up, no ads, no tracking. Everything is stored on your device. Save a backup file and restore it whenever you like.

- Easy on the eyes
Light, dark, or auto to match your phone. Available in English, Korean, Chinese, Japanese and Spanish.

Small habits, real growth. Start with today's square.

name: OneChat - AI Support
description:
OneChat brings all your customer conversations into one smart inbox. Connect WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram, and a website chat widget, then let AI handle replies and support your customers 24/7 — in Arabic and English.

Built for businesses in Oman and the Gulf, OneChat helps teams respond faster, never miss a message, and turn conversations into customers.

KEY FEATURES
• Unified inbox — WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram, and web chat in one place
• AI auto-replies — answer common questions instantly, around the clock
• Smart handoff — pass conversations from AI to your team seamlessly
• Arabic-first — designed for Arabic and English support
• Team collaboration — assign, tag, and track conversations
• Real-time notifications — never miss an incoming message
• Secure & reliable — your data, protected

Start delivering faster, smarter customer support today with OneChat.

name: OneSearch
description:
OneNote on iPhone is great for writing things down. It is not great at finding what is buried in a PDF printout, a scanned receipt, or a photo of a whiteboard. OneSearch fixes that.

OneSearch reads your OneNote notebooks and the files attached to them, builds a search index on your iPhone, and finds the exact page, file and spot you were looking for.

SEARCH INSIDE ATTACHMENTS
• Finds text inside PDFs, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, and scans
• Reads text in images with on-device text recognition
• Shows why each result matched, so you can tell at a glance

FIND IT EVEN WHEN YOU DON'T REMEMBER THE WORDS
• Forgives typos
• Finds related words and the same idea, such as "bill" and "receipt" when you search "invoice"
• Filters by type, notebook, section and date
• Links related notes and files

SAY EXACTLY WHAT YOU MEAN
• Combine words with AND, OR and NOT, group them with brackets, and match whole phrases in quotes
• For example: roof AND (leak OR damage) NOT 2019

FAST, PRIVATE, AND OFFLINE
• Searches a copy kept on your iPhone, so results are instant, even without a connection
• Read-only: OneSearch never changes or deletes anything in OneNote
• No account with us, no ads, no analytics. Your notes go from Microsoft to your iPhone and nowhere else
• Smart search features run on your device

OPEN WHAT YOU FOUND
Jump straight to the page in OneNote, or view the original file with your search terms highlighted.

GOOD TO KNOW
• You sign in with your Microsoft account and grant read-only access
• The first sync of a large notebook can take hours, even days, because every attachment is read. You can search as notes arrive
• Not searched: handwriting, drawings, audio, video, password-protected files and locked sections
• Work or school accounts may need approval from your organization's administrator

OneSearch is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Microsoft. Microsoft and OneNote are trademarks of the Microsoft group of companies.

name: Onile: Rent & Property
description:
Onile brings renting and property management into one place, for landlords, residents and property developers across Nigeria.

FOR RESIDENTS
• Browse verified rental, shortlet and sale listings in Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt and beyond
• Send inquiries and apply once you are invited by the landlord
• Verify your identity once with NIN and reuse it for every application
• Pay rent securely and keep every receipt in one place
• Report maintenance issues with photos and voice notes, then track progress
• Sign your lease electronically from your phone

FOR LANDLORDS AND AGENTS
• List properties and manage inquiries, applications and residents
• Track rent payments, arrears and receipts
• Send and sign tenancy agreements electronically
• Store property documents securely and share them with your lawyer for review
• Message residents and domestic staff in one inbox
• See how your rent compares with the local market

FOR DEVELOPERS AND SELLERS
• List off-plan and completed units for sale
• Share construction milestones with buyers
• Manage sale agreements and payments

SECURE BY DESIGN
• Face ID sign-in
• Identity checks on applicants
• Payments processed by Paystack

Questions? support@onile.co

name: Onore: Social
description:
Onore Social, Onore ekibinin ve müşterilerinin sosyal medya planını telefondan yönetmesi için yapıldı. Webdeki planlama panosunun bütün özellikleri uygulamada.

Planı bir bakışta gör
• Bugün ekranında bütün profillerin sıradaki paylaşımı geri sayımla
• Gün şeridi ve kaydırarak gün değiştirme
• Instagram, YouTube Shorts ve TikTok filtresi, otomatik ve elle gidenler ayrı

Her paylaşımı kontrol et
• Görsel, açıklama, etiketler, anket metni ve durum tek kartta
• Açıklamayı ve etiketleri sayaçlarla düzenle
• Otomatik paylaşımı aç ya da kapat, durumu Planlandı, Paylaşıldı ya da Atlandı yap
• Paylaşılamayan içeriği tekrar dene

Reel kapağını seç
• Videoyu kaydırarak kapak karesini seç ya da kendi görselini yükle

Hatırlatmalar
• Elle paylaşılacak her içerikten önce bildirim
• Otomatik paylaşım çıkınca ya da bir sorun olunca haber

Instagram'a tek dokunuş
• Reeli Instagram'da aç, hikâye görselini doğrudan hikâye editörüne gönder
• Medyayı Fotoğraflar'a kaydet

İstatistik
• Takipçi, görüntülenme, erişim ve etkileşim grafikleri
• Paylaşımlar listesi ve her paylaşımın ayrıntısı

Hesaplar Onore tarafından açılır. Giriş bilgileri için Onore ile iletişime geç.

name: Onul Schedule
description:
Onul Schedule is a calendar-first app for events and tasks.

Collect what you need to do, then drop it onto your day. Events and tasks live together on one screen instead of in separate apps.

CALENDAR AT THE CENTER
- Switch between Year, Month, 1-day, 2-day timeline, List and Stack views
- See events from your subscribed external calendars (Google, Apple and more) and add or edit them in the app
- iPhone: the "Focus" view lets you scroll through today's events and tasks as time-ordered cards, see time left on what's in progress, and mark tasks done

TASKS, KEPT LIGHT
- Park ideas and to-dos in a backlog, then place them on any date and time
- Tags, repeats (daily, weekly, custom) and routines
- Start reminders and a morning summary

IPHONE AND MAC, TOGETHER
- Automatic sync through iCloud (stored only in your own iCloud)
- iPhone only: Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Live Activities
- Siri and Shortcuts actions: show today's tasks, add a task, complete a task

QUIET BY DESIGN
- Free. No ads, no tracking, no sign-up.
- Your data stays on your device and in your own iCloud.
- Korean and English

NOTES
- Calendar access is optional (it lets the app show your external calendar events).
- iCloud sign-in is required for sync.

name: Orbe - AI Companion
description:
Orbe connects your iPhone to the AI assistant you already use on your computer.

Take a photo of an exercise, a document or a whiteboard and it appears in the AI conversation open on your Mac or PC, ready for your question. Scan several pages into one PDF, send files and links, or record a short video.

Dictate instead of typing: you speak on your iPhone and the text is written on your computer.

Talk to the AI: ask by voice from your iPhone, the AI on your computer answers, and the answer comes back to your phone — written and read aloud.

Control your PC: take a screenshot, start a voice call, open a new chat, switch assistant or run your own quick commands, right from your phone.

Works with the AI assistants you already use on your computer, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok, with your own account.

Requirements: Orbe for Mac (macOS 13 or later) or Windows (10 or 11), signed in with the same Orbe account.

name: Órdago Mus DEMO
description:
Órdago Demo te invita a probar el mus y descubrir el ambiente del juego antes de dar el paso a la versión completa.

Si ya sabes jugar, siéntate a la mesa y decide cuándo pedir mus, cuándo envidar y cuándo confiar en tus cartas. Lee las señas, mide a tus rivales y usa algún farol si te atreves: cada mano puede cambiar el rumbo de la partida.

Esta demo ofrece una experiencia limitada y no incluye tutorial. Tiene una selección más reducida de opciones y contenidos que el juego completo.

¿Te has quedado con ganas de más? Compra Órdago y disfruta de la experiencia completa.

name: Overpacked: Packing Puzzle
description:
Pack it. Zip it. Catch your flight.

Your suitcase is open, your stuff is everywhere, and your plane is already taxiing. In Overpacked, a cozy suitcase packing puzzle for iPhone and iPad, every sock, sneaker, and snack has to fit before takeoff.

PACK AGAINST THE CLOCK

Drag items from the lid into the suitcase grid. Tap to rotate them, work around luggage straps, and fill every open square. Keep an eye on the plane as it moves across the timer. If it takes off before you finish packing, you miss your flight.

TRAVEL TO 300 DESTINATIONS

Start with a mini carry-on and work your way up to a grand steamer trunk. The bags get bigger, the items get bulkier, and you’ll have less time to make it all fit.

PACK 51 HAND-DRAWN TRAVEL ITEMS

Find room for sneakers, laptops, game consoles, makeup bags, snacks, and more. Familiar items show up in new colors and patterns on each trip.

FILL YOUR PASSPORT

Earn a passport stamp for every destination you complete and up to three stars per trip. Flip through your stamps, then replay a favorite trip to beat your best time.

PLAY AT YOUR PACE

• Choose Easy, Normal, or Hard.
• Every suitcase has a solution, so no trip is impossible.
• Enjoy mellow lo-fi music, satisfying snap sounds, and gentle haptics.
• Unfold a compatible folding iPhone to open the suitcase, or tap Start to play.
• Play offline, even in airplane mode.

No ads. No in-app purchases. No tracking.

name: Overrun: Bridge Siege
description:
The enemy keeps coming. Build your squad and hold the line.

Overrun: Bridge Siege is an arcade shooter with automatic firing and direct, drag-to-steer controls. Start with Gunny, Creep, and Noob behind a blue sandbag defense line, then grow your squad as the battle builds.

Clear enemy mines before supply trucks reach them. Save a delivery, then move into its lane to collect recruits, weapon upgrades, ammunition, sandbag repairs, or fixed M2 guns. Miss the cargo and it's gone.

Grow from rifle troops to heavy infantry, rockets, laser mechs, and photon weapons. Survive charging mechs, tank volleys, artillery barrages, and enemy aircraft. Time your HE, AP, laser sweep, and friendly air support to clear an overwhelming wave.

• Automatic firing: focus on movement and timing.
• Three difficulty levels with scaled scoring, chosen before each run.
• Destructible sandbags, repair deliveries, and up to two unlockable M2 guns.
• Four support weapons that reload as you play.
• Support buttons you can move to suit your steering hand.
• Optional shared Android and iPhone leaderboards with verified scores.
• Sign in by email to keep the same online profile across devices.
• Core gameplay works offline; online rankings need an internet connection.

Pay once for the complete game. No ads. No in-app purchases. No paid power-ups.

name: OZNI Cifras
description:
OZNI Cifras puts your chord charts and setlists on the iPad, ready for rehearsal and for the stage.

SETLISTS
• Build the setlist for each service or rehearsal.
• Change the order and the key of each song.
• Play the setlist song by song.

CHORD CHARTS
• Lyrics with the chords above the words.
• Change the key half a step at a time.
• Choose Basic, Normal or Advanced chords.
• Tap a chord to see it drawn for guitar and keyboard.
• Auto-scroll with adjustable speed.
• Bigger or smaller lyrics, and profiles for leader, vocals and musicians.

ON STAGE
• Stage mode: black screen, just the chart.
• Large view for reading from a distance.
• Audio player to rehearse with the song.

LIBRARY AND GROUP
• Search the public library and the Contributors' charts.
• Import songs from Word, text files or by pasting.
• Edit a chart and save it as your own copy.
• Join your worship group with the invite code from your leader.

In English and Portuguese.
An OZNI account is required from the second time you open the app.

name: OZNI Cifras Mobile
description:
OZNI Cifras Mobile puts your worship team's chord charts and setlists on your iPhone.

SETLISTS
• Receive the setlists your leader publishes for the group.
• Create your own setlists.
• See the notes for each song ("Hold the last chorus").

CHORD CHARTS
• Lyrics with the chords above the words.
• Change the key half a step at a time.
• Tap a chord to see it drawn for guitar and keyboard.
• Auto-scroll with adjustable speed.
• Bigger or smaller lyrics, dark background and profiles for leader, vocals and musicians.

SEARCH
• Search the public library, the Contributors' charts and the charts saved on your phone.
• Import songs from text or Word files.

In English and Portuguese.
An OZNI account is required from the second time you open the app.

name: PaceLine
description:
PaceLine är ett offlineverktyg för terränglöpare och ultralöpare som vill planera sitt lopp. Ange distans, total stigning, kontrollpunkternas tidsgränser och önskad sluttid. Appen beräknar tempo, ankomsttid, tidsmarginal och kolhydratbehov för varje etapp.

• Samla dina lopp: spara distans, stigning, datum, måltid och kontrollpunkter. Byt aktuellt lopp eller prova det tydligt märkta exempelloppet.
• Planera tempot: en lutningsjusterad modell baserad på Minettis löpkostnadspolynom från 2002 räknar om etapper till motsvarande distans på plan mark och fördelar måltiden därefter.
• Se marginalerna: varje etapp visar tempo, ankomsttid och marginal till tidsgränsen. Banprofilen markerar kontrollpunkter och använder färger för att visa risknivåerna.
• Planera energin: ange kolhydrater per timme och per gel för att få kolhydratmängd och antal geler per etapp. Antalet avrundas uppåt för varje etapp.
• Läs guiden: 20 inbyggda artiklar om lutning, tempo, energi, tidsgränser och utrustning, med sökning, kategorifilter och angivna källor.
• Anpassa appen: välj ljust eller mörkt tema, haptik och startflik. Se statistik och återställ lokala data. Svenska, engelska och förenklad kinesiska följer systemets språkval.

PaceLine fungerar helt offline och kräver inget konto. Appen har ingen reklam, samlar inte in data och begär inga systembehörigheter. Dina lopp och inställningar sparas på enheten.

Resultaten är uppskattningar inför loppet. De ersätter inte arrangörens tävlingshandbok, officiella tidsgränser eller ditt eget omdöme. Anpassa planen efter träning, terräng, väder och förhållandena på tävlingsdagen.

För iPhone i stående format. Kräver iOS 17.0 eller senare.

name: PACK Field Sales
description:
PACK is the field sales rep’s app: Plan ~ Arrive ~ Capture ~ Keep.

PACK is for companies that run PACK for their sales team. Your company’s administrator sets up your account; the app cannot create one.

PLAN
• Today’s visits from your company’s call plan, nearest first.
• Tomorrow’s list, so you can see the day before it starts.
• Leads the office gives you, with the time each one took.
• Leave captured in the app, so your plan is worked out again around it.

ARRIVE
• PACK notices when you reach a customer’s site and opens the visit for you, and closes it when you leave. That is your proof of the visit.
• Your business travel is logged for your tax logbook, only during your company’s working hours.

CAPTURE
• Record the meeting, with everyone’s agreement, and PACK writes the visit report from it.
• Recording carries on with the screen locked, so a long meeting is not lost.
• Add photos, notes, quotes and the outcome of each quote.
• Work without signal: what you capture waits on the phone and goes when you are back online.

KEEP
• Every visit, report and quote in one place for you and your manager.
• Coaching and training from your company.
• Your team’s rooms for messages.
• My data shows you exactly what PACK has recorded about you, and outside working hours you can pause location logging.

SAFETY
• A firm shake opens the Emergency screen.

PACK works on iPhone and iPad. Location is used to open visits and keep the logbook; it is never sold or used for advertising.

name: PackOut: Hunt Training & Ruck
description:
Get in shape for a hard backcountry hunt. PackOut tracks your rucks with real pack weight on Apple Watch and turns your training into a 0–100 hunt-readiness score.

Free. No ads. No in-app purchases. Your data stays on your device.

Built for hunters getting ready for elk in the timber, sheep on the ridgelines, mule deer in the high country, and aoudad in hot desert mountains. Set your hunt date and target pack weight, then train with a clear answer to one question: am I ready?

RUCK WORKOUTS ON APPLE WATCH
• Start a ruck or loaded hike from your wrist and set your pack weight with the Digital Crown
• Live heart-rate zones, distance, and elevation climb
• Workouts save to Apple Health and sync to your iPhone

HUNT-READINESS SCORE (0–100)
Your score blends four things that matter on the mountain:
• Pack weight compared with your target
• Elevation climb compared with your target
• Consistency over the last 28 days
• Zone 2 aerobic minutes over the last 7 days
See which piece is holding you back, then fix it.

COUNTDOWN TO YOUR HUNT
Enter your hunt date and PackOut shows your training phase (Base, Build, Peak, and Taper) so you know where you are and what comes next.

LOG EVERY TRAINING DAY
• Log rucks done without your watch
• Log kettlebell and strength days
• Watch consistency build week by week

HEAT & WATER PLANNER
Hot hunts punish poor planning. PackOut uses the National Weather Service heat index and your own sweat-rate test to estimate how much water to carry. These are planning estimates, not medical advice. Check with your doctor before starting a new training program, and carry extra water.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no ads. Your training data stays on your device and in Apple Health.

FROM THE AUTHOR OF THE TOUGHEST COUNTRY
PackOut was built by the author of The Toughest Country, an illustrated account of a self-guided aoudad hunt in Big Bend, Texas. It is the training tool he wanted for that kind of country: steep, hot, dry, and far from the truck.

Requires iPhone. Live ruck tracking requires Apple Watch.

name: PaintFilmThickness
description: PaintFilmThickness arvioi kuivakalvon paksuuden, märkäkalvon paksuuden ja maalin tarpeen syöttämästasi tilavuudesta, pinta-alasta ja kiinteäainepitoisuudesta. Vertaa tulosta omaan tavoitealueeseen, pinota kerrokset ja tallenna erät paikallisesti. Kaikki on arvioita, ei tarkastusta eikä standardienmukaisuutta.

name: Palate: What to Order
description:
Palate remembers every dish you've loved, and the ones you'd never order again.

Snap the menu or the receipt and Palate fills in the dishes for you. Rate each one, add a note, and move on. Next time you're at the same place, Palate tells you what to order and what to skip.

- Rate dish by dish, not just the restaurant
- Snap a menu or receipt, Palate reads it for you
- Your taste summary: what you like, what you don't, your food rules
- Dine out guide with "Near me"
- Share recipes with friends or your group, or keep them to yourself
- Shopping list for what you cook

Private by default. No ads, no trackers, no email needed. Your meals and notes are yours, and you can delete everything from inside the app.

For ages 13 and up.

name: Paper Chart: Cross Stitch
description:
Track any cross stitch chart on your iPad or iPhone, including the old paper and magazine charts other apps refuse.

Open a PDF, or photograph or scan a printed chart. Paper Chart straightens the page, lays the grid over it and groups the symbols, all on your device. PDF charts are read straight from the file, and thread numbers come from the chart's own key, so there is nothing to type.

MANY PAGES, ONE CHART
Multi-page and full-coverage charts are joined into one continuous canvas. Overlapping rows are matched for you, so you never lose your place at a page edge.

CALM, FAST TRACKING
• Tap or drag to mark stitches, and undo at any time
• Park threads and highlight one symbol to stitch it
• Apple Pencil support: the Pencil marks while your finger moves the chart
• See what is left of every colour, and stitches done today
• Large symbols, dark mode and big touch targets

FIX ONCE, THEN STITCH
If a cell was read wrong, hold it and pick the right symbol. Paint mode lets you correct a whole area in a few strokes, and you can adjust the grid even after you started marking.

STITCH JOURNAL
Every session saves a progress snapshot you can share.

YOUR CHARTS STAY YOURS
Everything works offline. No account, no tracking, no ads, no rating pop-ups. Back up all your charts to a single file and keep it in Files or your own iCloud Drive.

Try the sample chart on first launch to see how it feels.

name: Paperchute
description:
Paperchute does one thing: it scans paper and puts the PDF in a Google Drive folder you chose beforehand.

Add the widget to your Home Screen, tap it, scan, save. The PDF is in your folder. That’s it.

• One destination per folder: Archive, Receipts, Family. A widget for each. • Searchable PDFs: the text is recognised on your iPhone and stored in the file. • Sensible file names: on iPhones with Apple Intelligence, the on-device model reads the first page and names the file after the sender and subject, like 2026-11-08_City-Council_tax-bill-2026.pdf. • No scan gets lost: every scan is saved on your iPhone first and only removed once Google Drive has it. Offline? It uploads when you’re back. • Uses Google Drive’s narrowest permission: the app only sees the folders you pick.

What it doesn’t do, on purpose: no library, no editing, no tags, no account, no subscription. Your files live in your Drive.

Privacy: no data collected. No analytics, no tracking, no server in between. Scans go straight from your iPhone to your Google Drive.

Free, and it stays free.

Google Drive is a trademark of Google LLC. Paperchute is not affiliated with Google.

name: Paperframe: PDF Scanner
description:
A little less paper. A clearer kind of everyday.

Paperframe turns document photos into clean, searchable PDFs with a calm, native interface for iPhone and iPad.

CAPTURE WITH CONFIDENCE
Scan multiple pages with automatic document detection and perspective correction, or import images from Photos and Files. Fine-tune all four corners whenever you need to.

FIND THE RIGHT FINISH
Choose Clean, Color, Black & White, or Original. Automatically orient readable text, clean narrow background edges, and straighten pages. Flatten curved table lines when reliable rules are detected. Local paper whitening protects colored marks, with adjustable shadow cleanup and adaptive Black & White. Compare with the captured source and turn corrections off whenever needed. Your source pages stay available for editing a copy later.

SAVE A PDF YOU CAN USE
Combine up to 30 pages, arrange their order, and save a PDF with an on-device text layer for searching and copying. Share through the standard iOS share sheet, including Save to Files.

A QUIET PLACE FOR YOUR DOCUMENTS
Search by name or recognized text. Rename documents, resume unfinished drafts, and review a PDF before sharing.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Document processing happens on your device. No account, advertising, tracking, or developer-operated document upload service. Device backups follow your Apple settings.

ONE PURCHASE
All features are included. No subscriptions or in-app purchases.

Designed for light and dark appearances, larger text, and accessible controls. Capture requires a supported camera device. Recognition and cleanup depend on image quality and language; review important text before sharing.

name: Paragliding All In One
description:
Paragliding App helps you pick the right day and takeoff in Slovenia, and records your flight.

FORECAST
• A flying score for every hour at 45 takeoffs in Slovenia and one in Istria
• Several weather models side by side, and how well they agree
• Wind at takeoff and at height, thermals, cloud base and rain, with the best window of the day
• Live wind from weather stations and the ALADIN-SI forecast
• Favourites, and the takeoffs nearest to you

FLY
• Vario with sound: climb beeps and a sink tone on the iPhone speaker, headphones or Apple Watch
• Moving map with your track, the last thermal and the nearest landing field with the glide you need
• Wind measured from your turns
• Voice guidance for the landing approach, if you turn it on
• Your saved XC routes with turnpoints
• Offline topo maps of Slovenia

APPLE WATCH
• Climb, height and speed on your wrist, with taps for lift and strong sink
• Heart rate during the flight, saved to Apple Health if you want

LOGBOOK
• Every flight saved as an IGC file, with its route on a map
• Share the IGC file or send it to XCGlobe
• Takeoff and landing are found on their own; car and cable car rides are left out

PILOTS
• Sign in with Apple or Google to see who plans to fly where, post check-ins and events, and keep your flights on the website
• Share your live position with other pilots and a link for family, only when you turn it on
• Report or block other pilots' posts with the … button

The forecast, map, vario and logbook work without an account. No ads, no tracking.

The app helps you plan and fly; it is not a certified flight instrument. You decide whether and where to fly.

name: Parzellenbuch
description:
Parzellenbuch is the plot book for people who lease a Parzelle in a German Kleingartenverein. It opens straight onto your plot, drawn to scale, and keeps the paperwork of the garden year in one place, offline on your phone.

Draw the plot
Enter width and depth and place the Laube, the covered Freisitz, vegetable and herb beds, fruit trees and berries, the greenhouse, lawn, flower beds, paths and compost. Drag to move, pull the corner to resize. Two gauges follow every move: how much of the plot grows fruit, vegetables and herbs against the one-third rule, and how big the Laube with covered Freisitz is against the 24 m² in § 3 BKleingG.

Keep every bed's history
Each bed remembers what grew there. Pick from 68 common crops, each tagged with its plant family and as Stark-, Mittel- or Schwachzehrer. When a bed gets the same family again, or a Starkzehrer right after a Starkzehrer, Parzellenbuch says so before you sow. A monthly list shows what goes in the ground now.

Log Gemeinschaftsstunden
Note every Arbeitseinsatz with date, job and hours. The dial compares them with the hours your own Verein asks for, and shows the Ersatzbetrag for missing hours at the rate you enter. The app never invents a rate.

The Verein year
Jahreshauptversammlung, Arbeitseinsätze, Wasser an and ab, Gartenbegehung, each with an optional reminder. Water and electricity readings with a photo of the dial and the year's consumption. Pacht, Umlagen and other payments with the year's total.

Ready for the Begehung
A checklist starts with the usual points: one-third use, Laube size, hedge and tree heights, no Dauerwohnen, compost, paths clear. The first two tick themselves from your plan. Edit, add and reorder points to match your Gartenordnung.

What Parzellenbuch is not: no plant identification, no shop, no forum, no legal advice. Your Gartenordnung and Pachtvertrag decide. No account, no tracking, no ads. Everything stays on your device.

name: Pattern Drawer: Sewing Stash
description:
Pattern Drawer keeps your sewing pattern stash in one calm place: every PDF and paper pattern, with covers, sorted by company and garment.

Bring in a whole folder at once. Pick the folder where your pattern PDFs live, like iCloud Drive › Sewing. Pattern Drawer reads folder and file names into company, garment type and title, groups the A0, A4, instruction and size files of one pattern together, opens zip downloads, and makes a cover from the best page. Your files stay where they are.

Check everything before it is saved. The preview shows what was found and lets you fix many patterns at once, merge files into one pattern or split them apart.

New patterns go in as easily:
- Share a pattern PDF or zip from Mail, Safari or Files to Pattern Drawer
- Check for new patterns in your folder with one tap
- Add a paper pattern by hand with a photo of the envelope

Already keep a spreadsheet? Import your CSV or paste rows from Excel, Numbers or Sheets. Columns are matched for you, and nothing you entered is overwritten.

Find and print the right file:
- Shelves by garment type, company, status and PDF or paper
- Search titles, companies, tags and notes
- Open a PDF at the page you left, note which pages to print, then print with AirPrint or send it to a copyshop
- Mark patterns Next up or Sewn

On iPad, see up to five covers across and read instructions full width at the cutting table.

Leave any time. Export a CSV of your stash or a ZIP backup with covers and photos, free, whenever you like, and restore it later.

No account, no AI, no catalog of patterns you don't own. Works offline and nothing leaves your device.

name: Pause to Check
description:
Stop walking before checking your phone.

Pause to Check is a gentle walking reminder with Mianmian, a little sheep who cares. Short reminders and expressive faces help you build a simple habit: stop in a safe place before looking at your phone. For yourself, or someone you care about.

GENTLE REMINDERS
Detect sustained walking while using the app, with a reminder card and optional vibration or voice. Dismiss a reminder or quiet it for five minutes.

SIX EXPRESSIONS, ONE CARING COMPANION
Choose gentle, concerned, serious, relieved, happy or sleepy Mianmian. Explore the sheep's little home and view locally stored pause records, without leaderboards.

MORE WAYS TO REMIND
On iOS 26 or later, start a walking session to try reminders while switching to other apps. You can also schedule timed reminders, or set up a Shortcuts personal automation to run a brief motion check when selected apps open. Timed reminders do not detect walking. Shortcuts automations require your own setup.

PERMISSIONS
• Motion & Fitness: required for walking detection, motion classification and step information.
• Notifications: required for system reminders. Without it, in-app reminder cards remain available.
• Health: walking sessions request workout and step permissions. A workout is written to Health only if you choose to save it at the end; unsaved sessions are discarded.
• Location: during walks you start, helps estimate speed, exclude fast travel and support background location updates. Location stops when you pause or end a walk. Coordinates are not stored or uploaded. Background support may be interrupted without permission.

REQUIREMENTS AND LIMITS
Requires an iPhone with iOS 18 or later. Walking sessions require iOS 26 or later. Cross-app walking sessions are experimental. Background detection and notification delivery depend on permissions, system scheduling, Focus, Silent mode and battery conditions; delivery is not guaranteed. In-app companion mode detects only while this app is in the foreground. Complete setup while safely stationary.

The app cannot tell whether you are looking at your screen or detect vehicles, crossings, steps or obstacles ahead. It may remind you while your phone is in your pocket. It does not provide accident detection, medical services or a guarantee of safety. Always pay attention to your surroundings.

PRIVACY AND PURCHASE
Pay once for all current features. No account, ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases. Motion is processed on your device, and companion settings and records are stored locally. The app does not read other apps' content or use your camera or microphone. You can clear local companion records in Settings.

name: PawAlong
description:
PawAlong helps dog trainers and dog owners stay aligned between lessons.

For trainers:
• Capture lesson notes and approve owner-facing guidance.
• Keep lesson history and the dog’s current plan organized.
• Review owner reports and reply with updates.

For dog owners:
• View trainer-approved lessons and the current plan.
• Ask questions with AI support grounded in approved training guidance.
• Review and share concise reports with the trainer when needed.

PawAlong does not automatically share private conversations with trainers. Owners review reports before sharing. AI support does not replace a trainer or veterinarian, and urgent safety or sudden health concerns require appropriate professional help.

An invitation from a participating trainer is required.

PawAlong is operated by AIYO SINGAPORE PTE. LTD.

name: PawChart: Pet Care & Vitals
description:
A nursing chart for the pet you're caring for.

When a pet is ill, every day becomes a list: pills at eight, fluids at seven, warm the bed, weigh her on Sunday. And every vet visit starts with "how has she been?" PawChart keeps the list and the answer in one place.

• A daily care checklist built from what your vet is treating: hyperthyroidism, kidney disease, low body temperature, diabetes, heart disease, post-surgery or senior care
• Each medication's name, dose and how it's given, with the date the dose last changed
• Tick each item done, or refused, because your vet wants to know both
• 13 vitals, charted, with the usual range shaded in (or your vet's own target)
• A heads-up when a reading is out of range or weight drops more than 5%
• A one-tap PDF summary for your vet, plus all readings as a spreadsheet
• Cats, dogs and other pets. English and Spanish
• No account, no ads. Nothing leaves your phone unless you send it

PawChart is a care diary, not a veterinarian. Always follow your vet's advice.

name: Peg Check: Diecast Tracker
description:
Peg Check is a diecast tracker built for the store aisle: type two or three letters of a casting, a colour or a toy number, and it tells you in two seconds whether that car is already in your collection.

OWNED x2, NEW, or 3 VERSIONS to compare. The verdict updates as you type, with a tap of haptic feedback, so you never buy a duplicate by mistake and never pass over a car you don't have.

Built for big collections. Peg Check stays fast with 5,000 cars and has no cap on how many you add. It works offline, there is no account, and nothing leaves your phone.

Every brand, your way. Works with Hot Wheels, Matchbox, Greenlight, Johnny Lightning, M2 Machines, Mini GT, Majorette, Tomica and any brand or series you add yourself. No catalogue to wait for.

What you get:
- A two-second "do I own this?" check across your whole collection
- Scan the toy number or barcode on the card to fill in the check, read on your phone
- Variants, colours and chase pieces (TH, STH, Chase) kept apart, so you know which version you own
- A duplicate guard that offers +1 instead of a second row
- Casting suggestions and variant chips from your own garage, so the next car takes a few taps
- A want list for the cars you're hunting, flagged right in the check
- Import your spreadsheet or notebook list: paste rows or pick a CSV file, preview, done
- Export to CSV and back up or restore your whole garage as a file

Peg Check is free, with no limits on cars, wants or brands, and no ads.

name: Pencilpage: Notes, Scan & AI
description:
Pencilpage is a notebook that feels like paper. Write with Apple Pencil on lined, squared, dotted or blank pages, add real tables, import PDFs to write on, and turn photos of teacher notes, book pages or whiteboards into short study notes.

WRITE
• Pen, pencil, highlighter, eraser, lasso, colours and sizes in one floating toolbar you can move to any edge
• Rough lines, circles and rectangles snap to clean shapes
• Zoom box: write in a magnified strip, the ink lands on the page above
• Undo and redo for ink and blocks; two-finger tap undoes
• Light and dark paper, margin line, punched holes

ORGANISE
• Notebooks with coloured covers, sections and pages; favourites, tags and search that also finds typed text, scans and recognized handwriting
• Real, editable tables: type or write in the cells, add rows and columns, colour cells
• A hand-drawn grid can become a table with one tap
• Import a PDF and write on top of it; export a page or notebook as PDF or image

SCAN & EXPLAIN
• Photograph a page, whiteboard or worksheet; text and handwriting are recognized on your device
• Take notes: short, exam-focused notes with highlights, callouts, tables and formulas that fit your notebook's goal
• Explain it: summary, key points, formulas and quiz questions
• Ask AI: circle your own handwriting or a text block to explain it, simplify it, translate it, make flashcards or convert handwriting to typed text
• Fill it in: turn a worksheet into a page you can answer with the Pencil

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no third-party SDKs
• Apple Intelligence, on your device, writes the notes where your device supports it (iOS 26 or later with Apple Intelligence turned on). The on-device model works in English and German
• Optional: use Claude from Anthropic instead, with your own Anthropic API key. Only then the photos you add and the text you ask about are sent to Anthropic, after you agree in Settings. Your drawings are never sent. The key stays in your device's Keychain
• Your notebooks sync through your own private iCloud

MADE FOR BIG SCREENS
Works on iPad and iPhone. On foldable screens such as the iPhone Duo, the unfolded screen works like an iPad: a big page, familiar navigation, and in laptop posture a writing strip on the flat half.

REQUIREMENTS
iOS 18 or later. AI notes on the device need iOS 26 or later and a device with Apple Intelligence; without it you can still write, scan, import PDFs and use tables. Apple Pencil is recommended, fingers work too.

name: Pest360: Pest Control Jobs
description:
Pest360 helps pest control companies run their field work without paper. Everything in the web dashboard is now on your phone.

IN THE FIELD
• Today's jobs and a route that starts from the nearest stop
• Mark jobs as treated, add photos and bait station checks in one tap
• Get the customer's signature on the phone; the A4 service report is ready instantly
• Email the report to the customer or share it as a PDF
• Works offline: records wait on the phone and are sent automatically when the connection returns

CUSTOMERS AND ACCOUNTS
• Customer cards, branches, contacts, contracts and QR cards
• WhatsApp, call and directions in one tap
• Customer balances, payments and cash records

TEAM
• Staff and permissions
• Instant notification when a job is assigned
• Calendar and recurring jobs

FOR YOUR CUSTOMERS
The businesses you serve can download the app to see their own reports, contract and station checks, signing in with their registered phone or e-mail.

No Pest360 account yet? Sign up for free in the app.

name: Phage Hero
description:
Du bist ein Bakteriophage im Blutkreislauf eines schlafenden, planetengroßen Weltraum-Leviathans. Fress dich durch Schwärme von Alien-Parasiten, sauge ihre DNA auf – und bau deinen eigenen Körper um.

MUTATIONEN STATT AUSRÜSTUNG
Kein Schwert, keine Rüstung: Bei jedem Stufenaufstieg wächst dir etwas Neues. Drei Linien, frei kombinierbar:
• Toxischer Schwarm – Bio-Drohnen brechen aus deinem Zellkern und jagen selbstständig.
• Leviathan-Symbiose – stacheliger Knochenpanzer und ein rotierender DNA-Schild.
• Ätzende Anomalie – pinke Säure-Tentakel und Pfützen, die im Bass pulsieren.

EIN RAVE UNTER DEM MIKROSKOP
Neon-Pink, Giftgrün und Cyan auf tiefem Schwarz, Tausende leuchtende Partikel und ein Synthwave-Soundtrack, nach dessen Takt die Venen pulsieren. Vor großen Wellen wird der Bass härter und das Licht flackert rot. Eine Flächenattacke zieht die DNA in Kurven zu dir.

VIER BIOME, EIN ENDGEGNER
Aorten-Highway, Toxische Lungenflügel, Magen-Ozean und der Neural-Knoten mit dem Alpha-Parasiten. Jedes Biom hat einen eigenen Wächter. Am Ende triffst du die letzte Wahl: Heilung oder Assimilation.

DEIN SCHWARM SCHLÄFT NIE
Im Zellteilungs-Modus farmt dein Schwarm weiter DNA, während du weg bist. Beim Zurückkommen rufst du ihn zurück und stärkst dein Erbgut dauerhaft.

FAIR UND OFFLINE
• Kein Konto, keine Werbung, keine Käufe, kein Tracking.
• Spielt komplett offline, der Spielstand bleibt auf deinem Gerät.
• Steuerung mit einem Finger, Gamepad wird unterstützt.

name: Phantomica
description:
Phantomica is a focused radiology teaching atlas for students, residents, and clinicians who want a clearer way to review imaging patterns.

Explore featured cases across CT, MRI, X-ray, and ultrasound. Each teaching file pairs a schematic image with clinical vignette text, labeled annotations, differential checklists, and concise teaching points.

Use Catalog to filter by modality and body region, then search by finding or keyword. Open any case to study image-and-text side by side, bookmark key files, and save personal study notes on device.

Differential Drill turns cases into quick self-checks: review the vignette, choose the most likely diagnosis, reveal teaching points, and track local progress.

Phantomica is designed for learning—not clinical decision-making. All illustrations are educational schematics with de-identified vignettes. No patient identifiers, no account login, and no cloud sync are required.

What you can do:
• Study curated teaching cases with annotations
• Filter by modality and anatomic region
• Practice differentials in Drill mode
• Bookmark cases and keep local notes
• Switch display language (English / Simplified Chinese)
• Review privacy and educational disclaimers in Settings

Privacy:
Bookmarks, notes, and study stats stay on your iPhone. Phantomica does not track users or sell data.

Educational notice:
For training and review only. Not a substitute for professional medical judgment, protocols, or licensed care.

name: PHOBOS Survivor
description:
PHOBOS is a fast twin-stick shooter about surviving on a single enclosed arena. Alien organisms pour in from every side in waves, and each wave is faster and bigger than the last.

CONTROLS
• Left thumb moves your exoskeleton, right thumb aims and fires — comfortable touch controls designed from the ground up for iPhone and iPad.
• Gentle aim assist helps you hit targets during quick thumb movements.
• Prefer a gamepad? The game supports game controllers (such as DualSense and other iOS-compatible controllers). A controller is optional.

GAMEPLAY
• Waves of increasingly dangerous enemies with a visible, glowing core.
• Green capsules restore health, blue reactors briefly boost your fire rate.
• Three difficulty levels — from a relaxed run to a real challenge.
• Local TOP 10 leaderboard with initials and a difficulty filter.

NO STRINGS ATTACHED
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts and no data collection.
• Plays fully offline.
• Available in English and Polish — the game follows your device language.

Bio-industrial horror style: a dark metal arena overgrown by organic forms and procedurally generated music that builds up with the pressure on the arena.

name: Phoodie: Restaurant Diary
description:
Phoodie turns the food photos you already take into a notebook of the places you eat, organised by city.

FIND YOUR OUTINGS IN YOUR CAMERA ROLL
Phoodie looks through your photos on your phone, spots the ones with food and groups them by day and place. You just swipe: save the ones worth remembering, skip the rest.

SAVE A PLACE IN SECONDS
Pick the restaurant from the nearby suggestions, tick what you ordered, the price per person, whether you'd go back and your star rating. Add a note or a photo of the receipt.

OR ADD IT ON THE SPOT
Tap + to take a photo at the table or pick one from your library. Phoodie suggests the places around you.

YOUR NOTEBOOK, BY CITY
Every place lands in its city. Filter by price, city or rating, search by dish or neighbourhood, and see every visit.

SHARE AN OUTING
Send a link to the people you ate with so the outing and its photos show up in their notebook too.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Photos are analysed on your phone and never leave it, unless you share an outing. No ads, no tracking. The account is optional.

Available in English, Spanish, Italian, German and French.

name: Picture Day: Visual Schedule
description:
Picture Day is a visual schedule for children with autism, ADHD or developmental differences — and any child who does better when they can see what comes next.

NOW & NEXT
• One big picture card for what to do now, and what comes next
• A big "Done!" button with a gentle sound and a star reward

TODAY'S SCHEDULE
• Build the day from 36 picture cards — wake up, brush teeth, school, therapy, bath, sleep and more
• Drag to reorder, swipe to remove
• Cards can be read aloud

VISUAL TIMER
• A red disc that shrinks as time passes — no need to read a clock
• 1 to 30 minute presets

No ads, no sign-in, no data collection. External links appear only in the parent settings screen.

name: PIKO – Hopscotch Pinoy Game
description:
Naaalala mo pa ba? Chalk on the cement, tsinelas on your feet, and the whole barangay cheering you on.

PIKO brings the classic Filipino street game to your phone. The street moves toward you, the chalk boxes come closer… and when a box reaches your feet, you tap to land. Simple to learn. Hard to put down.

ONE TAP, TWO TAPS, 1-2-3!
• One box with a footprint? Tap it with ONE finger.
• Two boxes joined by "="? Tap BOTH together — two fingers, two feet!
• Numbered boxes? Tap 1, then 2, then 3. In order, one at a time.
Land every row before it passes your feet and hop all the way to LANGIT.

EASY TO START, HARD TO MASTER
• 60 levels that build up: faster streets, more pairs, longer number runs
• Earn up to 3 stars per level for accuracy
• Chain landings for streak bonuses and Perfect! hops
• Beat the par time for extra points
• Replay any level to set a new best score

A STREET THAT FEELS LIKE HOME
• Sunny barangay roads, golden sunsets, fiesta banderitas and rainy afternoons
• Kids playing, maya birds on the street lamps, houses lining the road
• Cheerful original music with marimba, rondalla strings and kulintang sounds

MADE FOR EVERYONE
• No account, no sign-up — just tap Play
• No ads, no tracking
• Interactive guide and a practice course with no hearts to lose
• Optional Game Center leaderboard: see how you rank against everyone

Perfect for a quick game, a family challenge, or a trip back to the street where you grew up.

Isang talon pa! Just one more hop…

name: Pilot Aptitude Lab
description:
Pilot Aptitude Lab — тренажёр для тех, кто готовится к отбору на программы ab-initio и хочет стать пилотом авиакомпании. Приложение воспроизводит форматы реального отбора: тесты способностей, психомоторику, английский с радиообменом и собеседование.

ПЛАН ПОДГОТОВКИ
• Укажите дату отбора — приложение составит план и покажет готовность по каждому блоку.
• Ежедневная разминка на 10 минут по вашим слабым местам.
• Повтор ошибок по системе интервальных повторений: задания возвращаются, пока вы их не закрепите.

БЛОК A: КОГНИТИВНЫЕ ТЕСТЫ
• Numerical Reasoning — таблицы, проценты, валюты, расход топлива.
• Verbal Reasoning — формат True / False / Cannot say.
• English — грамматика, лексика и авиационная фразеология.
• Больше 1 100 заданий с разбором каждой ошибки.

БЛОК B: СПОСОБНОСТИ ПИЛОТА
• Устный счёт на скорость.
• Пространственная ориентация: авиагоризонт, курс и вариометр — определите положение самолёта.
• Память: запоминание указаний диспетчера, частот и эшелонов.
• Технические задачи: рычаги, шестерни, блоки, давление.
• Многозадачность: удержание цели джойстиком, счёт и реакция на сигналы одновременно.

РАДИООБМЕН И READBACK
• Указания диспетчера звучат как в эфире: с шумом, помехами и щелчками тангенты.
• Повторите указание вслух — приложение распознает речь и проверит эшелон, курс, частоту и позывной.

ДЕНЬ ОТБОРА
• Полная симуляция отборочного дня: блоки идут подряд под таймер, как на настоящем тестировании.
• Итоговый отчёт с сильными и слабыми сторонами.

РЕПЕТИЦИЯ СОБЕСЕДОВАНИЯ
• 40 типичных вопросов на английском и русском с подсказками, как строить ответ.
• Запишите ответ на видео или аудио и разберите его по чек-листу.
• Записи хранятся только на вашем устройстве.

АДАПТИВНАЯ СЛОЖНОСТЬ
Сложность подстраивается под ваш уровень, чтобы каждое занятие было полезным: не слишком легко и не слишком трудно.

БЕЗ ИНТЕРНЕТА И РЕГИСТРАЦИИ
Все задания и прогресс хранятся на устройстве. Аккаунт не нужен.

Pilot Aptitude Lab — независимое учебное приложение. Оно не связано с авиакомпаниями, лётными школами и разработчиками тестов и не гарантирует результат отбора. Названия форматов тестов упомянуты только для описания содержания.

name: Pilot Kneeboard: Flight Notes
description:
Pilot Kneeboard is a notepad for flying. It opens to a page you can write on, with your frequencies and transponder code across the top.

At the top of every page
- ATIS letter, QNH, squawk, COM 1 and COM 2. Tap a field and type. When a value is complete, it moves on to the next field.
- The ⇄ button swaps COM 1 and COM 2.
- UTC in the 0958Z format and a stopwatch for legs, holds and fuel checks.
- A yellow pinned note for the one thing you must not forget, for example "Max 2500 ft until leaving CTR".

Pages
- ATIS form and clearance form (clearance limit, route, altitude, frequency, squawk). The form stays in place while you write. On iPhone you can zoom in with two fingers.
- Blank and grid pages for departure routes, taxi instructions and holds.
- Up to 50 pages. A page deleted by mistake can be restored.
- Write with Apple Pencil or your finger. Touch and hold Pen to change the ink colour.

In the cockpit
- Large buttons.
- Night mode with black pages.
- Portrait and landscape.
- New Flight clears the top bar and resets the stopwatch. Your pages are kept.

Privacy
Everything stays on your device. There is no account and no advertising, and the app does not collect any data. You can export a backup file and restore it later.

Pilot Kneeboard does not replace official charts, publications or ATC instructions.

name: Pip by Nicer Bot
description:
Pip is Nicer Bot's mascot: a little bot with a lot to say.

• 44 stickers for Messages: 23 stills and 21 that move. Send them, or drag one onto a message.
• Two packs for WhatsApp, added with one hold.
• Pick any of Pip's poses for your Home Screen icon.

Pip is the face of Nicer Bot, a small crew of AI bots that takes the busywork off one business, from The Eleventh Lab. Learn more at nicer.bot.

name: Piping Master Pro
description:
Piping Master Pro is a fast field reference for people who work with pipe: pipefitters, welders, fabricators, designers and inspectors. It opens straight to the numbers you need and works with no signal.

LOOKUP
- Pipe schedules 5S to XXS: OD, wall, ID, weight and water weight
- Butt-weld and socket-weld fittings
- Branch connections: weldolet, sockolet, threadolet
- Pipe support spacing
- B16.5 flanges: drilling, studs, ratings from Class 150 to 2500, plus valves and gaskets

JOINT VIEW
- Pick a size and class once and see the whole flange joint on one card: bolts, stud length, torque, hole size and gasket dimensions
- Compare two joints side by side

TOOLS
- Bolt-up: torque, tightening sequence, checklist, nut and wrench sizes
- Offset, rolling offset and cut length
- Pipe weight and fill, reducer length and offset, size chart, unit converter
- Iso weld map: photograph an isometric drawing, mark the welds and keep a log

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
- Works fully offline
- Inches, millimetres or both
- Large, high-contrast controls that work with gloves and in sunlight
- No account, no ads, no tracking: your favourites and notes stay on your device

Piping Master Pro is a reference only. Always confirm dimensions against the governing standard and your project specification before fabrication or purchase.

name: Pivotile
description:
