Pivotile is a calm block-placement puzzle with one twist: you can turn pieces, once you've earned it.

Drag pieces onto a 9 × 9 board. Fill a row or a column and it clears. Clear lines one after another to build a streak for extra points. When no piece fits anymore, the run is over.

PIVOTS
You start with one pivot. Earn more by clearing two or more lines with one piece, or by clearing three times in a row. Hold up to three and spend one to turn a waiting piece when it would otherwise be stuck.

FAIR PIECES
Every new set has at least one piece that fits somewhere on the board. Otherwise pieces are random; nothing is held back to end your run.

COMFORTABLE TO PLAY
• Drag to place, or tap a piece, tap the board to preview, then tap again to place
• The preview shows which rows and columns will clear
• Your run is saved and continues where you left off
• Turn off celebration details for a calmer board
• VoiceOver with a cell-by-cell board, Dynamic Type and dark mode
• Every tile color also has its own mark, so color is never the only cue
• iPhone and iPad, portrait and landscape

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account, no ads, no tracking and no in-app purchases. Your game and records stay on your device.

name: PK Travel Myanmar
description:
PK Travel Myanmar is your all-in-one transportation and travel companion in Myanmar. Easily book highway bus tickets, charter private vehicles, and manage parcel deliveries right from your mobile device.

Key Features:
• Bus Ticket Booking: Browse available routes, select preferred seat layouts, and book tickets instantly for top highway routes (Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyitaw, Bagan, Taunggyi, and more).

name: Plate Chase: 50 States + DC
description:
Plate Chase turns every drive into a game. Spot a license plate, tap it, and watch your collection grow until you've found all 50 states and Washington, DC.

PLAY WITH THE WHOLE CAR

• Colored dots on each plate show who has spotted it

PLAY WITH FRIENDS ON THEIR OWN PHONES

EASY TO PLAY

• Filter by Needed, Spotted, or All, or search for a state
• See exactly when each plate was spotted
• Start a new road trip any time; everyone keeps their name

No ads, no accounts, no tracking. Just you, the open road, and that one Delaware plate you can never find.

name: Plato: Learn Ancient History
description:
Plato teaches history in short lessons you can finish in five minutes.

The first course covers Rome, from its founding in 753 BC to the fall of the West in 476 AD. There are 8 units and 40 lessons: the kings, the Republic, the wars with Carthage, Caesar, Augustus, the emperors, the crisis of the third century, and the end of the Western Empire.

LEARN FIRST, THEN CHECK
Every lesson teaches before it tests. Stories are told a line at a time. You guess what happened before you find out. You tap a map to see who lived where, and open cards to meet the people involved. Then short exercises check what you remember.

ILLUSTRATED THROUGHOUT
Every lesson comes with its own illustrations, from the she-wolf on the Palatine to Hannibal's elephants in the Alps.

MANY KINDS OF EXERCISE
- Multiple choice
- Match the pairs
- Put events in order on a timeline
- Find places on a map

KEEP IT GOING
- Set a daily goal and build a streak
- Earn XP and climb the Roman ranks, from Plebeian to Imperator
- Practice what you got wrong, without losing hearts
- An optional daily reminder at the time you choose

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no ads. Your progress stays on your iPhone, and Plato collects no data about you.

Privacy Policy: https://platohistory.app/privacy

name: PlayClock Football

PlayClock is the football team app built for coaches, players, and fans.

STATS WITHOUT THE PAPERWORK

PRACTICE AND PLAYBOOK

name: Poca: Photocard Tracker
description:
Poca is the photocard tracker built on the templates you already save. Paste or pick a fan-made photocard template, and Poca finds every card and turns it into a tappable checklist on your phone, offline and in seconds.

No database to wait for: a new album is supported the moment someone posts its template.

CUT ANY TEMPLATE INTO CARDS
- Paste from the clipboard, choose from Photos or take a photo
- On-device card detection finds the grid for you
- Not quite right? Set rows and columns with a stepper, drag the corners, or tap to fix single cards
- Zoom and pan everywhere

MARK WITH STICKERS, NOT SCRIBBLES
- Pick a brush: Have, Want or On the way
- One tap marks a card, and Undo is always there
- Clear stickers: check, heart and truck
- Copies, labels and notes per card

ORGANIZE BY ERA AND MEMBER
- Collections, eras and templates, all renamable
- Assign members a whole row at a time

TRADE MODE

SHARE YOUR LF

- Or a progress grid for your binder updates

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
- No account, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking

Poca ships no card images. You import your own templates. Made by Kiwi Lab.

name: Pocket for DSH
description:
DSH Pocket brings DeepSeek Harness (DSH) running on your own computer to your iPhone.

Install the dsh-pocket plugin on your Mac, scan its QR code, and continue your coding sessions from your phone:
• Browse every session with the same history as your desktop
• Receive assistant replies and tool activity live (commands, images, file edits)
• Send messages, photos, or camera captures from your phone
• Works over your LAN or a public tunnel, so you can keep your AI agent working while away

Privacy: the app runs no server and collects no data. Connections go directly to your own computer, and your access PIN is never stored.

Requires the free dsh-pocket plugin on the computer (available in the DeepSeek Harness plugin market). No computer at hand? Use Demo mode on the connect screen.

name: Pocket Paddock.
description:
Pocket Paddock is a clean, fast, and minimalist app designed specifically for toy car enthusiasts, model collectors, and resellers. Easily catalogue your entire collection, keep track of duplicates, log model details, and monitor your items—all from one place.

No complex setup, no forced account creation, and zero ads. Just a pure local database to manage your personal garage of mini vehicles!

Key Features:

Detailed Vehicle Profiles: Log brand, scale, model name, color, condition, and custom notes.

Smart Search & Filter: Quickly find specific cars in your collection by scale or brand.

Local Database: All collection records are saved securely on your device for fast offline access.

Minimalist Interface: Designed for quick entry, seamless browsing, and zero distraction.

Download Pocket Paddock today and take full control of your toy car inventory!

name: Pocket Pounce
description:
Pocket Pounce puts a little family of cartoon cats on your iPhone.

Take a screenshot of your Home Screen and the cats move in: they sit on your app icons, hop between rows, nap on the Dock and stroll along your widgets. No screenshot? They have a cozy room of their own with shelves, a cat tree and a bed.

PLAY WITH THEM
• Drag a laser dot and watch them stalk and pounce
• Toss a ball of yarn and they'll get tangled in it
• Stroke a cat and it purrs, with hearts to prove it
• Turn on the Zoomies for five minutes of chaos

THEY HAVE PERSONALITIES
• Each cat does its own thing: groom, nap, explore, play

MAKE IT YOURS
• Choose coats, sizes and how many cats
• Add cloud ledges and move the cat tree and bed
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show what your cat is up to

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your screenshot never leaves your phone. Pocket Pounce collects no data, has no ads and no accounts.

name: Pocket Railway
description:
Pocket Railway
Little tracks. Big adventures.

Build a thriving railway in a charming miniature world. Connect quiet towns, golden farms and mountain mines, then bring your network to life with trains carrying timber, grain, ore and passengers.

Draw tracks across the landscape, build bridges and give every locomotive a purpose. Plan departures, manage signals and keep busy routes moving. When traffic builds up, pause the action, adjust your network and get back on track.

Every delivery helps your railway grow. Earn game coins, complete transport contracts, upgrade your engines and stations, and open new connections. Watch a small town become a bustling destination, one successful journey at a time.

• Draw railway routes between stations.
• Configure locomotives and choose their cargo.
• Control signals, departure spacing and service speed.
• Earn delivery combos and collect contract rewards.
• Upgrade stations and unlock new regions.
• Enjoy colorful scenery, animated trains and celebratory effects.
• Keep your progress with automatic local saves.

All coins are fictional game resources. Pocket Railway has no real-money purchases or cash rewards.

Your next great journey starts with a little track.

name: Poker Calculator: Odds & Outs
description:
Poker Calculator shows your chance to win a Texas Hold'em hand, whether a call is worth it, and which cards could help you. Pick your cards and the answers appear instantly. No sign-up and nothing to set up.

WIN CHANCE (EQUITY)
Choose your two cards, add the flop, turn and river as they come, and set how many opponents you face (1 to 9). Poker Calculator plays the hand out 20,000 times and shows your chance to win, tie or lose. It updates by itself every time you change a card or a player.

CALL OR FOLD (POT ODDS)
Type in the pot and the bet you face. See the percentage you need to win to break even, the pot odds, and whether your current hand clears the bar. Quick buttons fill in common bet sizes.

HELPFUL CARDS (OUTS)
On the flop or turn, Poker Calculator finds every card that would improve your hand, grouped by what it makes: a pair, a straight, a flush and more. It also shows your chance of hitting on the next card and by the last card.

PLAIN ENGLISH OR POKER TERMS
New to the game? Everything is explained in simple words by default. Switch on Advanced to see equity, pot odds, outs, flop, turn and river.

BUILT TO STAY OUT OF THE WAY
- Works offline, all the maths happens on your device
- No account, no ads, no tracking
- Fast and clear, great for studying hands

Poker Calculator is a learning and analysis tool. It is not a gambling app: there is no real-money play and no prizes. Results are estimates from random simulation.

name: Pond Pop
description:
From one reading to a whole pond season, keep the details you want to remember in Pond Pop.

Made for aquaculture hobbyists and personal pond recordkeeping, Pond Pop brings water readings, feeding observations, equipment history and photo notes into a cheerful field notebook.

OXYGEN AND TEMPERATURE, TOGETHER
Save dissolved oxygen and water temperature in one entry with its time and sampling location. Add optional pH, nitrite, ammonia nitrogen, weather and air pressure. Record surfacing observations and attach photos of the water or meter. Revisit the readings you saved on historical charts.

RETURN TO THE SAME SPOT
Name fixed sampling stations, place pins on your own pond sketch and keep landmarks and sampling depths. Create a sampling round and save a paired reading at each stop. Link instruments to readings and keep your own calibration and probe notes.

KEEP THE FEEDING CONTEXT
Record feed brand, specification, weight, stock size and time. Add leftover feed, disappearance time and feeding response. Reuse feed templates and manually attach an earlier oxygen and temperature reading from the same pond.

FOLLOW EQUIPMENT HISTORY
Log actual aerator start and stop times, runtime and your reason for starting a session. Keep maintenance and inspection notes alongside equipment details. Track spare parts and supplies with opening balances, receipts and use records.

NOTICE WATERLINES AND FAMILIAR VIEWS
Record water levels against your own reference, top-ups, exchanges, drainage and entered volumes. Create a fixed photo viewpoint with dated frames, weather and captions. Compare two photos side by side or with a swipe divider.

BRING A SEASON TOGETHER
Keep separate profiles for multiple ponds and organize observations by stocking batch. Review recorded feed totals, aerator hours and measurement distributions. Add harvest details, losses and personal reflections. Compare two batches and carry your own plan into the next one.

BUILD A NOTEBOOK OVER TIME
Use recording routines, calendar pages and milestones to revisit your entries. Create follow-ups, add dated updates and linked evidence, then write your own outcome. Search and filter saved records or share a PDF sheet for one pond on one day.

KEEP YOUR OWN COPY
Daily records are stored locally, with no app account required. Export CSV tables for viewing or make a full JSON backup with photos for restoration. Recently Deleted and local recovery snapshots help you manage saved history.

Pond Pop is a personal recordkeeping tool. Measurements, reference ranges and conclusions are entered by you. It does not provide aquaculture diagnosis, disease alerts, production guidance or survival guarantees.

The app interface is in English. Available for iPhone and iPad running iOS 15.0 or later.

name: PoolShock: Shock Due Queue
description:
PoolShock is for pool and spa owners who need to remember when the next chlorine shock is due — unlike a generic calendar or bare calculator, it turns each marked treatment into a rolled next-due date and a dose ledger.

TODAY
Open the due queue. Overdue and due-today pools sit at the top with a suggested ounce amount for your shelf chem. Tap Mark shock done — the next due date advances by that pool’s interval and a dose row is saved.

CHEM
Browse the shock chemistry shelf (cal-hypo, dichlor, liquid chlorine, lithium). Each card shows form, ounces per 10k gallons, and which pools use it.

DOSES
See completed shocks with amount, chem, and time. Useful when you want to confirm last week’s storm reset was already logged.

MORE
Privacy link, support email, and restore sample pools. Works fully offline. No accounts, ads, or subscriptions.

PoolShock does not diagnose water chemistry or replace a test kit — it only schedules and records shock treatments you choose to mark done.

name: Post by Zach Highley
description:
Post is one place to write what you put on X.

Put posts on a calendar. Pick a day and time, and Post publishes them to your X account then. Move things around when plans change.

Paste to your website. Articles copy out cleanly, so the same piece can go on your own site too.

Read your YouTube numbers next to your writing, so you can see what is working.

No AI. Nothing here writes for you. Every word is yours.

name: Pretend Piano: Air Instruments
description:
Requires an iPhone running iOS 18 or later, paired with Apple Watch running watchOS 11 or later.

Turn wrist motion into music.

Pretend Piano lets you play music on Apple Watch with gestures. Strum for guitar, move your wrist like a bow for violin, or gently tap a tabletop to play piano.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Guitar: gently move your wrist up and down to strum chords.
• Violin: move your wrist side to side to play notes with bow-like gestures.
• Piano: gently tap a tabletop near your watch wrist to play the next note.

MAKE AND SEND SONGS
Use iPhone to enter numbered notation, arrange notes and chords, Check and edit the result, then send your song to Apple Watch.

PLAY ON YOUR WRIST
Motion processing and instrument sounds run locally on Apple Watch. No account is required. Your iPhone does not need to be nearby while you play.

Use gentle movements and taps, and keep a steady rhythm.

name: Primary Word Sort
description:
Word Sort is an iPad (and iPhone) app that turns a word-sort activity into a drag-and-drop game for Grades 1–3. Students move word cards into columns by sound, spelling pattern, or meaning, and the app reads each word aloud and shows what is right.

Teachers can start from 28 ready-made sorts written for each grade, or build their own from a photo of a worksheet, an image, a CSV file, or from scratch. Any sort can be played with answers, without answers, or as an open sort where students make their own groups.

What's in the App
The app pairs 28 ready-made sorts with tools for making your own. Everything runs on the device, and read-aloud works offline.

Grade 1 - includes 6 word sorts & 3 picture sorts 
Topics: Short/long vowels, digraphs, blends, word families

Grade 2 - includes 8 word sorts 
Topics: Vowel patterns, word families, syllables, spelling patterns, blends/digraphs

Grade 3 - includes 11 word sorts 
Topics: Multisyllable vowels, silent letters, -tch/-dge, oa/ow, un-/re-, -ful/-less

There are four ways to create a sort:
Take a photo of a worksheet. The app reads the text and turns it into draggable cards.
Choose an image from Photos or Files.
Import a CSV file with column titles in row 1 and words below.
Build from scratch, typing words and adding pictures.
Each sort runs in one of three modes:

Assign Answers: the teacher sets each word's column, and students get Check and Retry Wrong.
Ungraded: students sort with no answers stored and nothing marked.
Open Sort: students make and name their own groups, up to 8.
Picture cards use an emoji or a photo from the library or camera. A card can hide its word, and tapping it still reads the word aloud.

Feedback is gentle and easy to see: sounds, haptics, confetti, and a check or X badge on every card. Settings offer three card sizes and four fonts, including an Easy-Read option.

Running a Sort in Class:
Choose a sort from the Grade-Level library, or make one from a worksheet photo.
Pick a mode: Assign Answers for practice with feedback, Ungraded for discovery, Open Sort for student-made categories.
Students drag each word into a column, or tap a word and then tap a column.
They tap a word to hear it, or tap a column heading to hear every word in that column.
In Assign Answers mode, they tap Check, then Retry Wrong to fix misses.
For small groups, start with Ungraded or Open Sort so students talk about why a word belongs. Move to Assign Answers once the pattern is familiar.

Students, Progress, and Sharing:
The app works for one learner or a whole class, and the choice can change at any time. The first launch asks who is using the app, and switching modes never deletes data.

In One Person mode, you can enter a name that is saved with results. In Class Roster mode, you build a list of students and pick who is playing from the bar above the sort. Add students by typing names, importing a CSV file, or pasting a list. Names already on the roster are skipped.

Each graded or finished sort is recorded with the score, try number, time, and the words missed. Each student's page shows average and best score, practice time, a score-over-time chart, and "Words to Practice" for the words they miss most. Open sorts record the groups a student made.

Results can be exported as a CSV file for a spreadsheet or gradebook. Everything is stored on the device only, and recording can be turned off in Settings. "Clear Roster" removes all students and results, which suits a new school year.

Teachers can also share sorts. Any sort can be sent as a file by AirDrop, Messages, Mail, or Files, and the other teacher imports it from the + menu.

Getting Started:
Choose One Person or Class Roster, and import your students if you use a roster.
Open the Grade-Level Sorts library and start a sort that matches your current phonics focus.
Make your first custom sort by photographing a worksheet, then check the review screen before you start.

name: PRISMATTICE: Optical Array
description:
Light is your instrument. Set the optics, fire the beam, and watch your idea travel across the bench.

PRISMATTICE: Optical Array is a landscape puzzle game set in a precision optics workshop. Start with one mirror and one detector. Across 13 handcrafted arrays, split white light into red, green, and blue, focus it through a lens, trigger sensor shutters, and recombine the spectrum. The final arrays ask you to plan around linked mounts and limited adjustments.

SET THE OPTICS
Tap a mount to select it, then rotate it, change its filter, or slide a lens along its marked rail. Activate the array when you are ready. Follow the beam and use the detector readout to see what needs attention. Undo an adjustment or reset the array to try a different approach.

REFINE YOUR ALIGNMENT
Every valid solution unlocks the next array. Return to a solved board to improve your best Alignment score by using fewer adjustments and routing light more efficiently. There is no countdown.

PLAY OFFLINE
All  arrays are included. Progress and preferences stay on your device. Play on iPhone or iPad with optional beam labels, Reduce Motion, haptics, and separate music and sound effect controls.

name: pro-maintenance-auto

Pro Maintenance Auto е приложение за управление на автосервиз, създадено да улесни ежедневната работа.

name: ProCaller: Business Phone
description:

• Team and numbers — invite teammates, manage your numbers, and see who answered.
• Notifications — incoming calls, missed calls, voicemails and texts reach you even when the app is closed.
• Face ID lock — keep your calls and messages private.

ProCaller works with a ProCaller business account. Sign in with yours, or tap "Look around the demo workspace" to try it with sample data.

name: ProChatDesk Mail

• Clean, fast inbox with conversations, Today/Yesterday groups and quick filters

name: ProChatDesk NMS

ProChatDesk NMS brings the network monitoring of your Pro Chat Desk portal to your phone, tablet and Mac.
• Dashboard: devices online, ports, BGP / OSPF, active alerts and outages in the last 24 hours
• Devices down now and routing down now, with how long they have been down
• Device list with search, status and group filters
• Device detail: bandwidth, ping and CPU / memory graphs, port grid and SFP optics
• Port traffic graph, one-tap Ping (10 probes) and Poll now
• Outage history for 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days

• Down alerts as notifications while the app is open and in the background
• Face ID / fingerprint app lock and two-step verification
Sign in with your Pro Chat Desk (ispapp.prochatdesk.in) account with network monitoring enabled.

name: Prof. Siyam: YDS & YÖKDİL
description:
Sınav salonunda saatle yarışırken tereddüde yer yok! YDS, e-YDS ve YÖKDİL'de hedeflediğiniz akademik puana (70+, 80+, 90+) şansa bırakmadan, cerrahi reflekslerle ulaşın.

Prof. Siyam; akademik İngilizce sınavlarının soru tuzaklarını, mantığını ve çeldirici kurgularını deşifre eden yeni nesil bir Akıllı Sınav & Refleks Koçudur. Sağlık Bilimleri, Sosyal Bilimler ve Fen Bilimleri dahil tüm alanlarda gerçek sınav ağırlığında bir zihinsel antrenman sunar.

NEDEN PROF. SİYAM?
Geleneksel kuru ezber yöntemlerini unutun. Prof. Siyam, sadece doğru cevabı vermekle kalmaz; soru yazarlarının çeldiricileri nasıl kurguladığını ve diğer şıkların neden yanlış olduğunu adım adım öğreterek kalıcı bir soru çözme refleksi kazandırır.

ÖNE ÇIKAN AKILLI ÖZELLİKLER:

[1] Birebir Resmi Format ve Akademik Sınav Simülasyonu
- ÖSYM & YÖK soru standartlarına, zorluk derecelerine ve pedagojik dağılımına birebir uyumlu gerçekçi sınav atmosferi.
- Geri sayımlı resmi süre yönetimi ile zaman baskısını refleks haline getirin.

[2] Cerrahi Soru & Çeldirici Analizleri
- Sıradan cevap anahtarlarına veda edin! Her soruda A'dan E'ye tüm şıkların detaylı analizi.
- "Neden A değil de B?" sorusunun yanıtını veren Türkçe açıklamalar ve stratejik çözüm ipuçları.

[3] Akıllı Metin Sözlüğü & İnteraktif Kelime Defteri
- Okuma parçaları ve Cloze Test metinlerindeki tüm akademik sözcüklere tek dokunuşla ulaşın.
- Eş anlamlılar (Synonyms), zıt anlamlılar (Antonyms) ve bağlamsal kullanımlarla kendi kelime defterinizi oluşturun, Flashcard moduyla hafızanıza kazıyın.

[4] Prof. Siyam Arenası: Mikro-Öğrenme & Refleks Merkezi
- Edat Mıknatısı (Preposition Magnet) ve Phrasal Verb Hafiyesi gibi oyunlaştırılmış mini kamplar.
- Gün içindeki küçük boşluklarda akademik İngilizce reflekslerinizi zinde tutun.

[5] Yapay Zeka Teşhis & Zayıf Konu Koçluğu
- Çözdüğünüz her sorudan sonra puan kaybettiğiniz konu açıklarını anında tespit eden dinamik başarı radarı.
- "Bugün Kelime Bilgisine odaklanmalısın" diyen ve size özel günlük reçeteler yazan yapay zeka mentörlüğü.

[6] %100 Çevrimdışı Çalışma Özgürlüğü
- İnternet bağlantınız olmasa bile metroda, otobüste veya seyahatte kesintisiz çalışma imkanı.

KAPSAM VE BRANŞLAR:
- YDS & e-YDS (Tüm Akademik Seviyeler)
- YÖKDİL Sağlık Bilimleri (Tıp, Diş Hekimliği, Eczacılık, Hemşirelik, Sağlık Bilimleri)
- YÖKDİL Sosyal Bilimler (Hukuk, İktisat, İlahiyat, Sosyoloji, Edebiyat, Tarih)
- YÖKDİL Fen Bilimleri (Mühendislik, Mimarlık, Temel Bilimler, Doğa Bilimleri)
- TIPDİL, TUS ve DUS hazırlığı için akademik İngilizce altyapısı

HUKUKİ VE PEDAGOJİK BİLGİLENDİRME:
Uygulama içerisindeki tüm soru havuzu, okuma metinleri ve açıklamalar; ÖSYM ve YÖK akademik sınav formatı, konu ağırlıkları ve soru tipleri baz alınarak Clean-Room (özgün pedagojik üretim) prensipleriyle telif hakkı ihlali içermeyecek şekilde sıfırdan üretilmiştir. ÖSYM veya YÖK ile doğrudan bir bağı bulunmamakta olup, sınav formatı, mantığı ve akademik soru tarzıyla %100 uyumludur.

name: PulsarClock
description:
PulsarClock is a small instrument for the oldest clocks we know of. It carries the complete ATNF Pulsar Catalogue — 4,503 neutron stars, each with its measured rotation — and lays them out along one logarithmic axis, from a star that turns 716 times a second to a slow rotator that takes almost a minute and a half to come round once.

The catalogue stops being a table here. You drag a finger along the spectrum and watch the population pass underneath: the dense island of recycled millisecond pulsars on the left, the long quiet stretch where almost nothing spins, and the crowd of ordinary young rotators on the right. Touch a name and the star opens into a profile with its magnetic field, characteristic age, spin-down power and place in the Galaxy, all computed from the two numbers the radio telescopes actually measured.

Then there is the part that makes the abstract claim land. Type in any beat you like — a heartbeat, a footstep, a metronome at 120 — and the app answers in rotations, showing one beat of yours against the pulse train of a star that fits 174 turns inside it. Put several pulsars on the same stability chart with a wristwatch and a caesium fountain and you can see for yourself where a spinning neutron star sits among the clocks in your life.

Everything is included, so the app works with no signal at all: a dark-sky site, a train tunnel, a plane. No account, no advertising, no tracking, no permissions. Just a very large, very quiet archive, made readable.

name: Pusula IK
description:
Pusula İK is the mobile app that makes clocking in and out simple for your company's employees.

• QR clock-in/out: Scan the QR code shown on your workplace terminal and your record is created instantly.
• Location check: Clock-ins count when made inside the area your company defines. Your location is used only at the moment you scan the QR code, and there is no background tracking.
• My records: See your daily clock-in and clock-out history, lateness and overtime.
• Announcements: Follow your company's announcements in one place.
• Secure device pairing: Your account is linked to a single device, so nobody else can sign in as you.

To use the app you need the business code and sign-in details provided by your company. Accounts are created by your company administrator.

Learn more: pusulaik.com

name: Pusulamoto
description:
Pusulamoto, Türkiye'de satılan motosikletleri tek yerde toplayan bir rehber ve motorcu forumu. Sana uygun motoru bulmak, modelleri karşılaştırmak ve motorunun bakımını takip etmek için gereken her şey burada.

SANA UYGUN MOTORU BUL
• "Bana uygun motor hangisi?" testi: 12 soruda zevkine, kullanımına, ehliyetine, bütçene ve boyuna göre öneri; her önerinin gerekçesi ve uyum yüzdesi yanında
• Ehliyetine (B ile 125 cc, A1, A2, A), bütçene ve tarzına göre hazır listeler

MOTORLAR
• 700'den fazla model: scooter, naked, sport, adventure, touring, enduro, cruiser, klasik
• Güncel liste fiyatı, motor hacmi, güç, tork, ağırlık, sele yüksekliği, depo ve tüketim
• Ehliyet sınıfına (A1, A2, A, B), segmente, bütçeye ve markaya göre filtrele
• Güç/ağırlık oranı ve benzer modeller
• İnternet yokken de çalışır: model listesi cihazında saklanır

KARŞILAŞTIR
• İki modeli yan yana koy; hangisinin kaç kategoride önde olduğunu gör
• Çok karşılaştırılan çiftlerle tek dokunuşta başla
• Her satırda en iyi değer öne çıkar; fiyat, güç, ağırlık ve tüketim farkını tek ekranda gör

GARAJIM
• Sahip olduğun motoru plakasıyla ekle; trafik sigortası, kasko ve muayene bitişini gir, süresi dolmadan hatırlatalım
• Favorindeki motorun liste fiyatı artınca ya da düşünce bildirim al
• Yağ değişimi, zincir, lastik, fren, akü, muayene ve sigorta için hatırlatıcı kur
• Zamanı gelince bildirim al; "Yapıldı" dediğinde bir sonraki tarih kendiliğinden ayarlanır
• Garajın ve hatırlatıcıların yalnızca senin cihazında durur

FORUM
• Teknik soru, arıza ve bakım, satın alma tavsiyesi, ekipman, gezi ve rota, sohbet
• Konunu aç, motor modelini etiketle; konuna cevap gelince bildirim al
• Uygunsuz içeriği bildir, istemediğin üyeyi engelle
• Hesabını istediğin an uygulamanın içinden silebilirsin

KEŞFET
• 70'ten fazla rehber: satın alma, bakım, sürüş, ehliyet ve mevzuat
• Bayi haritası: markaya göre sana en yakın yetkili satış ve servis noktaları, tek dokunuşla arama ve yol tarifi
• Yıllık masraf hesaplayıcı: yakıt, MTV, trafik sigortası, kasko ve bakım
• Ekipman rehberi: kask, mont, eldiven ve bot için fiyat aralıkları ve öneriler
• Kask ve eldiven bedeni: baş ve el çevrene göre beden
• Türkiye'nin motosiklet rotaları, yeni modeller ve haberler

Fiyatlar distribütörlerin açıkladığı liste fiyatlarıdır ve bilgilendirme amaçlıdır; satın almadan önce bayiyle doğrula.

Web sitesi: pusulamoto.com

name: Puzzles by Jo Clegg
description:
Eight puzzle games in one app, with a fresh daily puzzle in every game, no ads and no tracking.

THE GAMES
• Sudoku – classic and killer, from fast 6×6 grids to fiendish 9×9s
• Kakuro – crossword-style sums with the digits 1 to 9
• Solitaire – Klondike with winnable deals, draw one or draw three
• Two Tone – fill the grid red and blue, following three simple rules
• Sightlines – place blue dots so every number sees exactly the right count
• Slide Out – slide the blocks aside and free the piece in the fewest moves
• Five Letters – guess the hidden five-letter word in six tries
• Word Wheel – find every word in the wheel, and earn bonus words along the way

DAILY PUZZLES
Every game has a daily puzzle, the same for everyone. Play it on the day for a medal: bronze, silver or gold. Keep track in each game's calendar, and aim for gold in every game.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Works fully offline
• Several sizes and difficulty levels in every game
• Unlimited undo
• Optional hints and helpers, all off by default, so you choose how much help you get
• Stats, best times and a full history for every game
• Light and dark themes

SYNC, IF YOU WANT IT
There's no need for an account. If you'd like your games on more than one device, sign in with Google, Microsoft or your email address. Your saved games and settings then sync between Android, iPhone and the web at joclegg.github.io/puzzles-web.

PRIVACY
No ads, no analytics and no tracking. If you sign in, only your email address, saved games and settings are stored, and only for sync. You can delete your account and data at any time, in the app or on the web.

Privacy policy: https://joclegg.github.io/puzzles-web/#/privacy

name: Pvaunkread
description:
• Save a pot with wet width, wet height, and one shrinkage percent
• Fired size is the wet size times the fraction that remains
• Turn a wet measurement and a fired measurement into a percent
• Work backward from the finished inches to the wet size to throw
• Shrink a rectangular slab on both edges
• Weigh a slab from volume and a density you can change
• Estimate an open cylinder wall, without the floor
• Estimate coil length for a straight wall
• Erase the local file from the manual

name: Qilat: QR & Barcode Scanner
description:
Qilat reads QR codes and barcodes quickly and shows the result in a form you can use right away: open a link, join a Wi-Fi network, save a contact, or look up a product.

Before a link opens, Qilat checks the address first. Links never open automatically, so you always see where a link goes before you decide.

LINK SAFETY CHECK
• Warns about links that use the name of a bank, e-wallet, or online store but are not its official site
• Warns about links that would download an app file
• Detects look-alike characters, an @ that hides the real address, raw IP addresses, and shortened links
• The check runs on your device; scanned links are not sent to any Qilat server

SCAN EVERY KIND OF CODE
• QR Code, Data Matrix, Aztec, PDF417
• Product barcodes EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E
• Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, ITF, and Codabar
• Scan with the camera or from an image in Photos, including inverted QR codes
• When an image contains several codes, you choose the one to open
• Flashlight and zoom for small codes or dark rooms

RESULTS YOU CAN USE
• Links: open, copy, or share
• Wi-Fi: connect directly or copy the password
• Contacts: save to your address book
• Phone, SMS, and email: ready to send
• Locations: open in Maps
• Events: add to your calendar
• Product barcodes: look up product details and prices

HISTORY AND FAVORITES
• Every scan is saved on your device
• Mark important results as favorites
• Search older scans quickly
• History can be turned off in Settings
• A tip for seeing a Wi-Fi password saved on your device

CREATE YOUR OWN QR
• Create QR codes for links, text, or Wi-Fi
• Save to Photos or share directly

FREE AND PRIVATE
Every feature is free, with no subscription and no ads. No account and no sign-up. The camera is only used to read codes; images are never saved or sent anywhere.

name: Questions for Couples: StillUp
description:
Still Up is a card game of questions for couples, first dates and friends. One phone on the table: read a card out loud, answer or don't. Keep going until it gets light.

Done talking? Flick the card away. Not this one? Tap Another. Nobody has to answer, or explain why.

Three decks, over 600 questions:
Couple, for two people with some history.
First date, for two people still finding out.
Group, for people who've just met. Pass the phone left.

Four levels: Easy, Flirty, Honest, Deep. Pick where to start. It never goes back down. From Easy a night is 24 cards. Start later and it's 17, 10 or 6. Early on: “Who do you become in an airport?” Later: “Which of your days did I save without knowing?”

One game is one night. At night the clock starts at the real time, then moves with every card. Windows in the building opposite go out. At 5:40 AM it's dawn, and the game sends you to bed.

A sleepless moth hosts. It says it's only here for the lamp. Tap it and it says something. On heavy cards it goes quiet and falls asleep.

Forbidden topics: six switches for flirting, exes, family, bodies, money, and death and illness. Switch one on and those cards stay out.

Share a card as an image. In English and Russian. No account, no ads. Anonymous stats can be switched off in Settings.

Optional 18+: frank questions about sex come in only when someone turns on the 18+ switch and the whole table agrees.

Same time tomorrow?

name: QuevBruill
description:
• Save a tune with tempo, beats per bar, and a bar count
• One quarter note is 60 divided by the tempo
• Show eighth, sixteenth, dotted-quarter, and eighth-note triplet lengths
• Add beats and bars into one pass, in minutes and seconds
• Report how many percent faster or slower a new tempo is, on a four-bar phrase
• Turn a span of minutes into full bars
• Multiply a pass by repeats, with no gap between them
• See how many full passes fit in the minutes you have
• Erase the local file from the manual

name: quizdu
description:
Wie gut ist dein Allgemeinwissen wirklich?

Mit QuizDu testest du dein Wissen, forderst Freunde heraus und trittst gegen andere Spieler an. Ob eine schnelle Quizrunde zwischendurch oder ein spannendes Live-Duell – hier zählt, was du weißt!

**LIVE-DUELLE MIT FREUNDEN**

Erstelle ein Duell, teile den Einladungslink und spielt gleichzeitig gegeneinander. Beide erhalten dieselben Fragen und verfolgen ihren Punktestand in Echtzeit.

**GEGEN ZUFÄLLIGE GEGNER SPIELEN**

Du möchtest dich spontan mit jemandem messen? Starte die Gegnersuche und tritt in einem direkten Wissensduell an.

**TESTE DEIN ALLGEMEINWISSEN**

Entdecke Fragen aus verschiedenen Wissensgebieten:

- Geschichte
- Geografie
- Biologie
- Physik
- Chemie
- Allgemeinwissen

Wähle dein Thema, stelle den Schwierigkeitsgrad ein und beantworte abwechslungsreiche Multiple-Choice-Fragen.

**TÄGLICHE CHALLENGE**

Jeden Tag wartet eine neue Herausforderung auf dich. Beantworte die Fragen und vergleiche dein Ergebnis auf der Tagesrangliste.

**IMMER MEHR FRAGEN DURCH KI**

QuizDu nutzt künstliche Intelligenz, um den Fragenpool regelmäßig zu erweitern. So erwarten dich immer wieder neue Wissensfragen und interessante Fakten.

**SPIELE AUCH ZEITVERSETZT**

Deine Freunde haben gerade keine Zeit? Starte ein zeitversetztes Duell und vergleicht eure Ergebnisse, sobald beide gespielt haben.

**DEIN WISSEN. DEINE ERGEBNISSE.**

Verfolge deine Statistiken, sammle Erfahrungspunkte in unterstützten Spielmodi und verbessere deinen Wissensstand.

Starte direkt mit einem freien Quiz. Für bestimmte Wettbewerbsfunktionen kannst du kostenlos ein Benutzerkonto erstellen.

QuizDu – Fordere dein Wissen heraus!

name: Quizlet Gravity: Play & Learn
description:
Learn by playing games. Challenge friends on the leaderboard.

Flashcards turned into a space game: type the correct answers before the asteroids reach your planet.

FIND A GAME
Try the example game with one tap, or search and choose a shared game by title or creator.

PLAY & LEARN
Choose your difficulty and practise answering with terms, definitions or both. When you miss an answer, practise the correction before continuing. Watch out for red asteroids: missing one ends the game.

CREATE & IMPORT
Create your own game with terms, definitions and images. Copy and paste a public Quizlet set link to add and play it, or import and edit it to make your own version.

CHALLENGE FRIENDS
Share a game link and compete on its leaderboard. Play with a guest username or sign in to an account. Only your highest score for each game appears on its leaderboard.

An internet connection is required. Quizlet imports depend on the original set being public and accessible.

Quizlet Gravity is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Quizlet.

name: r3sist
description:
Take control of your habits with R3SIST — a privacy-focused, gamified habit tracker designed to help you break bad routines and build streak-driven discipline. 

Whether you want to quit smoking, reduce screen time, or stay consistent with daily goals, R3SIST makes progress engaging, rewarding, and 100% offline.

KEY FEATURES:

• Gamified Habit Tracking: Level up as you stay disciplined and maintain your streaks.
• 100% Private & Local-First: Your data stays strictly on your device. No cloud tracking, no accounts, no server sync.
• Interactive Widgets: Keep your progress front and center on your iOS Home Screen.
• Verification Code Patterns: Built-in focus and verification mechanics to help you stay accountable.
• Custom Audio Feedback: Immersive sounds to reinforce your achievements and level-ups.
• Clean & Distraction-Free: Completely ad-free and free to use with zero hidden costs.

Start resisting bad habits and level up your life today with R3SIST.

name: Raadkoord. Muziekspel
description:
Raadkoord. is een gratis muziekraadspel voor samen. Iemand laat een lied horen – via je eigen muziekdienst, een cd, of live met organist, band of koor – en de anderen raden de titel, de artiest of de psalm. Raadkoord. regelt de vragen, de antwoorden en de stand.

RAAD DE MUZIEK
• Kant-en-klare muzieksets: bekende christelijke liederen, Nederlandstalige worship, Opwekkingsliederen, liederen van Sela, psalmen, kerstliederen, internationale worship en kinderliederen.
• Kies hoe de muziek klinkt: bij elk lied een zoekknop voor Spotify of YouTube, je eigen afspeellijst of cd, of live muzikanten.
• Kies het niveau (kinderen, familie, kenners) en het aantal liederen, en start.

SAMEN SPELEN
• Raadkoord. Live: deelnemers scannen de QR-code of typen de code en antwoorden op hun eigen telefoon. Eén persoon bedient vier grote knoppen: volgende lied, start vraag, sluit antwoorden, toon uitslag. Punten tellen automatisch.
• Muziekbingo: liedtitels afstrepen op de telefoon. Bingokaarten printen kan via raadkoord.nl op een computer.
• Raadkoord. Kerst: de kerstmuziekquiz met ruim 350 kerstopnames.

MAAK JE EIGEN MUZIEKSPEL
• Typ of plak een liedlijst, open een CSV- of Excel-bestand, of maak een foto van een cd-hoes, liedlijst of programma. De tekst wordt op je iPhone herkend; de foto wordt niet geüpload.
• Psalmen met verzen en berijming, gezangen, bundels en uitvoerders worden herkend. Jij controleert alles voordat er een spel van wordt gemaakt.

GEEN MUZIEK BIJ DE HAND?
• Kennisquiz over psalmen en christelijke liederen, zonder muziek en zonder internet. Bij elk antwoord uitleg en een bron.
• Bibliotheek met alle 150 psalmen en ruim 150 liederen: waar gaat het over en wat betekent het? Met een link naar de Bijbeltekst.

GOED OM TE WETEN
Raadkoord. speelt zelf geen muziek af en heeft geen koppeling met muziekdiensten. Voor openbaar afspelen kunnen aparte rechten nodig zijn. Namen van artiesten, bundels en diensten staan er alleen ter beschrijving; Raadkoord. is daar niet aan verbonden.

PRIVACY
Geen account, geen reclame, geen tracking. Je lijsten blijven op je toestel. Bij samen spelen bewaart de tijdelijke spelkamer alleen een zelfgekozen spelnaam en de antwoorden, en wist alles 72 uur na de laatste activiteit.

name: RaceToWH
description:
Two candidates. 50 states. One White House.

Race to the White House turns the presidential election into a fast, head-to-head race. You and your rival each start in a random state. Win that state's challenge to claim its electoral votes, then fly to your next target before your rival gets there first. Be the first to 270 and the presidency is yours.

REAL MAP, REAL STAKES
• Play on a real map of the United States with all 50 states plus Washington D.C.
• Every state is worth its real electoral votes, 538 in total
• Small states are quick wins worth a few votes. Big ones like California and Texas are tough challenges worth a lot
• Swing states are harder than their size
• Lose a state and you can never go back. Your rival can still take it

14 MINI-GAMES
• Press Scrum: dodge the reporters chasing you for a quote
• Ballot Sorter: swipe every ballot into the right box
• Marching Band: keep the campaign band on beat
• Find the Fake: spot the badge that doesn't match

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Play vs the computer on Easy, Normal or Hard
• Quick Match: jump into an online race against a random opponent
• Private rooms: share a 4-letter code and race a friend
• Pick your candidate name and campaign color

Plan your route, pick your battles and win the race to 270.

Race to the White House is a game. It does not feature any real candidates or political parties.

name: RakeYard: Yard Leaf Bags
description:
RakeYard turns a quick yard sketch into a leaf-bag estimate.

Draw rectangular zones on the lot canvas — front lawn, drive strip, oak bed — set leaf depth for each patch, and see how many bags you need before you start raking. Switch bag sizes, track bags on hand, and save finished hauls as runs.

WHO IT'S FOR
Homeowners and weekend yard crews who want a visual bag count from the ground they actually have to clear — not a blank calculator.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Sketch leaf zones by dragging on the yard canvas
• Set Light / Medium / Heavy depth per zone
• Read total bags on the Zones hero in under a minute
• Match bag size (30 / 39 / 45 gal) and bags on hand
• Log rake runs with zone counts and bag totals

All data stays on your device. No accounts, ads, or subscriptions.

name: Ranchiva Vildora
description:
RED VILDE DYR HEM. BYG DIN RANCH. MEST PRÆRIEN.

er et prærieskydningsspil bygget omkring en enkel idé. Du rider ud i et åbent landskab, finder dyr der sidder fast i farer, og fører dem sikkert hjem til ranchen.

DU BESTEMMER VEJEN
Rid med fingeren. Tryk eller træk på skærmen, og hesten følger din rute. Dyrene løber i række bag dig og venter på, at du bringer dem ind på ranchen. For hvert dyr du leverer, får du stjerner. For hver stjerne får du ekstra point.

EN VERDEN I FEM LANDSKABER
Hver mission er et nyt landskab med eget vejr, egen vegetation og egne forhindringer. Du rejser gennem Ørkenranch, Kaktuskløft, Skovkant, Flodeng og Klippevold. Hvert område har sine regler. I floden kan du falde, i kløften står der kaktusser, og på heden holder prærieulve og kviksand dig tilbage. Kortene bliver genereret, så hver mission føles ny.

25 MISSIONER, DER ÅBNER SIG
Din ranch begynder med en enkelt mission, og hver gang du redder alle dyrene i en mission, åbner den næste. Rejs gennem alle 25 missioner, og hvert landskab får sin egen finale. Fortiden viser altid den næste mission, og din oversigt holder styr på stjerner, bedste tid og antal gennemførte forsøg for hver enkelt mission.

DU BESTEMMER VANSKELIGHEDEN
Du kommer aldrig for langt. Hver mission kan spilles i fire sværhedsgrader, der ændrer tidsgrænsen, antallet af forhindringer og belønningen. Vælg mellem en rolig begyndertur og en vild prærie, hvor dyrene, tiden og pointene alle bliver skarpere.

FIRE MÅL AT MESTE
Redning: bring alle dyrene hjem.
Støvjagt: saml alle støvkorn inden tiden er brugt.
Tidsrænse: red dyrene så hurtigt som muligt.
Spøgelsesridt: red alle dyrene uden at miste en due til et uheld.
Hver missionstype har sine egne stjernekrav, så den hurtigste løsning altid belønnes.

COMBO OG POINT
Lever flere dyr i træk uden at tabe farten, og comboen tæller op. Hver ekstra levering gør den næste belønning større, og den bedste combo gemmes i din profil.

BYG OG FORBEDR DIN RANCH
Brug støvkorn til at opgradere støvler, stopur, lassokasse, skjold og magnet. Brug poter til at bygge stald, kornsilo, brønd og indhegning. Hver opgradering og hvert byggeri giver en permanent fordel, som gælder i alle missioner.

DAGLIGE UDFORDRINGER OG PRÆSTATIONER
Hver dag stiller der en ny udfordring med sin egen sværhedsgrad og missionsform. Dertil kommer en lang række præstationer, der belønner alt fra den første redning til en perfekt gennemført prærie. Din stribe tæller dag for dag.

DINE FREMSKRIDT FØLGER DIG
Alt spil gemmes sikkert på din enhed, og fremskridt, præstationer og rangliste kan følge med dig til dine andre enheder. En rangliste og præstationer holder dig motiveret til at slå dine egne rekorder.

DU BESTEMMER HVORDAN DET SPILLES
Tænd eller sluk lyde og vibrationer, og lad navnet på ranchen være dit eget. Der er ingen køb i appen, og intet skal købes for at spille.

Red, byg, og red prærien. Prærien venter.

name: Rate it: KI bewertet alles
description:
Wie gut ist dein Frühstück wirklich? Dein Schreibtisch? Deine Pizza? Frag die Jury.

Rate it ist die Bewertungs-Show für deine Sachen. Fotografier ein Ding und die KI-Jury gibt dir eine ehrliche Note von 1,0 bis 10,0 – mit einem Roast, der wehtut (aber nur ein bisschen) und einem Tipp, wie es besser wird.

JEDEN TAG EIN NEUES THEMA
Heute Pizza, morgen Kühlschrank, übermorgen Gaming-Setup. Alle bewerten dasselbe – wer holt Platz 1, wer landet auf dem letzten Platz?

FAIR FÜR ALLE
Die Jury misst alle nach demselben Maßstab: drei Kriterien, feste Skala, keine Lieblinge. In die Rangliste kommen nur Fotos, die direkt in der App aufgenommen wurden – kein Schummeln mit Internet-Bildern.

TOP & FLOP
Die besten und die schlechtesten Noten des Tages, der Woche, aller Zeiten. Eine 10,0 ist extrem selten. Eine 1,0 auch. Viel Glück.

FEED, KOMMENTARE, FREUNDE
Wisch durch die Bewertungen der anderen, gib Feuer, kommentiere, merk dir deine Favoriten und folge Leuten. Wer sich gegenseitig folgt, ist befreundet.

TEILEN
Jede Bewertung wird zur Teilen-Karte für deine Story oder den Gruppenchat.

WICHTIG
• Rate it bewertet Dinge – niemals Menschen. Fotos von Personen lehnt die Jury ab.
• Jedes öffentliche Foto und jeder Kommentar wird automatisch geprüft. Melden und Blockieren geht mit einem Tipp.
• Die Bewertungen sind Unterhaltung, kein Fachurteil.
• Kostenlos, ohne Werbung. Ab 13 Jahren.

name: rdio
description:
rdio is the iPhone app for the open rdio radio: a small ESP32 board with a DRA818 or SA818 module that you build yourself. The radio streams its audio over Wi-Fi to your phone, so the phone becomes its speaker, microphone and display.

IMPORTANT: rdio needs the rdio radio hardware to do anything. The hardware design, the firmware installer and the build instructions are free at github.com/loopmasta/rdio. Transmitting requires an amateur radio licence and must follow the rules that apply to you.

LISTEN AND TALK
• Receive with a large frequency display, a signal meter and an audio level meter.
• Push to talk with a big shutter-style button. Your voice goes through a compressor and a level setting before it is transmitted.
• Receive and transmit stay inside the band you choose (VHF 134-174 MHz or UHF 400-480 MHz).
• Safety built in: the radio releases the transmitter when the connection drops, when no audio arrives, and after two minutes on the air.

CHANNELS AND REPEATERS
• Keep the frequencies you use in a list and tune with one tap.
• Simplex and duplex (repeater) channels with shift direction and offset, CTCSS tones for transmit and receive, and the 1750 Hz tone burst.
• Wide or narrow FM per channel. Reorder by dragging, swipe to edit or delete, duplicate from the menu.
• Type a frequency straight on the keypad.

APRS
• Decodes 1200 baud APRS packets (positions, Mic-E, messages, status) and shows them as a chat, with the distance to each station and a link to Maps.
• Send messages to a call sign or to CQ. Messages are repeated until the other station acknowledges them, and the app acknowledges the ones addressed to you.
• Optional position beacon at an interval you choose. Everything is sent only while the channel is clear.

SEVERAL RADIOS
• The app finds the radios on your Wi-Fi network by itself and lets you switch between them in Settings.

MADE FOR iPHONE
• Native look with system controls, Light and Dark Mode, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver and haptics.
• No account, no advertising, no analytics, no tracking. The app only talks to your own radio on your own network.

PRIVACY
• The microphone is used only while you hold push to talk. Your approximate location is used only while the app is open: for the distance to stations and, if you switch it on, for the APRS beacon. A beacon is a radio broadcast, so anyone with a receiver can read the position and call sign in it.
• Privacy policy: loopmasta.github.io/rdio/privacy/

The radio's firmware installs from your browser over USB and can be updated the same way.

name: Re_Volume
description:
Re_Volume measures the sound level from the iPhone microphone, in dB(A), and compares it with the thresholds set by Italian and European noise regulations.

MEASURE
• A-weighted level (IEC 61672) with the Slow time constant
• The circle is green up to the threshold, yellow up to 5 dB above it, red beyond
• Day (6-22) and night (22-6) thresholds

THRESHOLDS FROM THE REGULATIONS
• Homes: Italian DPCM 14/11/1997 art. 4, with windows closed and open
• Outdoors: noise classes I to VI, Italian DPCM 14/11/1997 table C
• Work: 80, 85 and 87 dB(A), Directive 2003/10/EC and Italian Legislative Decree 81/2008
• Europe: the mapping threshold of Directive 2002/49/EC
Under each threshold the app shows the regulation it comes from and how it applies.

SAMPLING
• Saves one value per minute, the Leq of that minute, even with the screen off
• Weekly profile: level by day and hour, with the chosen threshold
• Optional GPS position, read once when you ask for it

PRIVACY
No audio is ever recorded or stored: the sound is analysed in memory and discarded straight away. The samples stay on the phone. No account, no network connections.

CALIBRATION AND MEASUREMENT LIMITS
Every iPhone microphone has a different sensitivity: for reliable readings, set the calibration against a reference sound level meter. Re_Volume is not a certified instrument and its readings are indicative, with no legal value: the regulations use levels averaged over long periods (Leq, LEX,8h) and measured with class 1 or 2 instruments.

name: Reactiona
description:
Reactiona is a hands-on chemistry practice app for secondary and introductory college learners. Build molecules by dragging atoms, balance equations with live scoring, explore pH and flame-color benches, walk through oxygen preparation, and study atomic structure, bonding, organics, acids–bases–salts, and metal activity—then watch SceneKit particle stages show how microscopic pieces rearrange.

LAB
• Molecule Builder — drag H, C, N, O, Na, Cl and match target formulas such as H2O, CO2, NH3, NaCl, and CH4.
• Equation Balance — tune coefficients until atoms are conserved; common mistakes are shown beside each puzzle.
• pH Bench — slide a meter, review reference samples, and quiz yourself against real-world values.
• Flame Colors — identify Na, K, Ca, Cu, Li, and Ba emission colors in a safe digital simulation.
• Oxygen Prep — step through water-displacement collection with scoring for procedure slips.

LEARN
• Atomic structure, chemical bonds, organic chemistry, acids/bases/salts, and the metal activity series—with diagrams and mark-complete progress.

ANIMATE
• 3D-style microscopic scenes for water formation, ionic dissolve, and methane combustion sketches. Pinch and orbit the stage; replay motion anytime.

NOTES
• Equation bank with exam pitfalls and star favorites.
• Deduction points that mirror typical mark losses.
• Personal mistake notes auto-filled from lab checks and editable by you.

STUDIO
• Local score, completed labs/modules, flame discoveries, English/Finnish interface language, privacy policy, and about pages.
• Progress is saved on device only—no account, no ads, no tracking SDKs.

Reactiona is an educational simulation. It does not replace supervised laboratory instruction or safety training.

name: Ready Bag: Emergency Kit Plan
description:
Disasters don't wait. Ready Bag helps your household get prepared in an afternoon — and stay prepared.

GO-BAG CHECKLIST
• 30+ essentials in 7 groups: water & food, health, light & power, clothes & warmth, hygiene, documents & cash, and extras for babies, older relatives and pets
• Sized to your household — tell it how many people
• Swipe to skip what you don't need; a readiness ring shows your progress

EXPIRY REMINDERS
• Add expiry dates for water, food, medicines and batteries
• Get a reminder two weeks before they run out

FAMILY PLAN
• Where to meet near home and outside your area if you're separated
• Your nearest shelter and emergency contacts (include someone in another city)
• Share the whole plan with family in one tap

WHAT TO DO
• Clear, step-by-step guides for earthquakes, fires, floods & storms and heatwaves
• Works fully offline — when you need it most

No ads, no account, no tracking. Everything stays on your device. In an emergency, follow emergency services and official alerts.

name: RebarCage: Footing Cut List
description:
RebarCage turns footing dimensions into a practical rebar cut list.

For footing crews who need cage piece counts from length × width × depth — not a generic multi-trade calculator. Step through a short wizard, pick bar size and spacing, then save longitudinal, transverse, and stirrup/tie cuts with stock-stick notes.

HOW IT WORKS
• Cage tab: multi-step wizard — length → width → depth → bar/spacing → cut list
• Cuts tab: saved cages with check-off as you cut
• More: privacy and support

Field estimate only. Not a stamped engineering design. Works fully offline. No accounts, ads, or in-app purchases.

name: Rebooty: SSH & Server Monitor
description:
Rebooty puts your servers in your pocket. See at a glance which ones are up, open a real terminal, restart a stuck bot and read its logs — right from your iPhone.

ALL YOUR SERVERS AT A GLANCE
• A green or red dot for every server, with CPU, memory, disk and uptime
• Website checks next to them: status code and response time
• Home and lock screen widgets

LIVE SERVER SCREEN
• Charts for CPU, memory, network and disk I/O over the last minutes
• Warnings like "Disk / is 92% full" before things break
• Every disk with free space, swap, load, kernel and system

A REAL TERMINAL
• vim, htop, nano and every full-screen tool work
• Keys above the keyboard: Esc, Ctrl, Tab, arrows, |, / and ~
• Several tabs per server; with tmux they reattach after a dropped connection
• Your saved commands one tap away

PROCESSES AND LOGS
• pm2 processes, Docker containers and systemd services in one list
• Restart, stop or start with a tap
• Live logs with search and errors highlighted

QUICK ACTIONS
• Your own buttons: "Update bot" = git pull && pm2 restart bot
• Ask-first for dangerous ones, {{variables}} asked when you run them

FILES OVER SFTP
• Browse folders, edit .env and configs, upload and download files

TUNNELS AND JUMP HOSTS
• Open a server port on your iPhone, like an admin panel on 127.0.0.1
• Reach servers through a bastion

SECURE BY DESIGN
• Passwords and keys stay in the iPhone Keychain and never leave it
• Create Ed25519 keys in the app and copy the public part
• Host keys are checked on the first connection and you're warned if they change
• Optional Face ID lock
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Rebooty connects only to your own servers

Live stats work on any Linux server; the terminal, files and actions work with any SSH server.

name: Recipe Pocket: My Cookbook
description:
Your recipes, your way.

Create a personal cookbook with recipes from supported websites, pasted recipe text, or your own ideas. Edit ingredients, rearrange steps, add notes, and keep the version you love.

COOK AT YOUR OWN PACE
Follow one step at a time and swipe forward or back. Ingredient amounts appear in directions when clearly supported by the source. On iPad, wide layouts put your current step beside ingredient references.

KEEP YOUR COOKBOOK CLOSE
Saved recipes and cached photos work offline. Check off ingredients, choose a color theme, print with AirPrint, save or share a PDF, and export a cookbook backup.

OPTIONAL AI HELP
Connect your own Gemini, OpenAI, Claude or Grok API key for supported AI features. Read a written recipe from a photo, import public YouTube recipes using Gemini, or estimate nutrition when source information is missing. AI requests require your permission and internet access. Provider accounts, usage limits and charges are separate from Recipe Pocket; chat subscriptions do not include API access.

Supported website and text parsing runs first without AI. Some websites and videos cannot be imported. Check AI results and source instructions before cooking. Nutrition estimates are approximate. Internet access is needed for imports, AI and online services; your saved cookbook can be used offline.

name: Recipe2Grocery
description:
Recipe2Grocery connects two lists that belong together: your dishes and your shopping list. Pick what you want to cook this week – the ingredients land on the shopping list automatically. No account, no ads, no tracking.

HOW IT WORKS
• Create dishes: recipe, ingredients with amount and unit, category.
• Tap the dishes you want to cook – the checked ingredients move to the shopping list.
• Tick things off in the store. Identical items are merged ("2 × yoghurt 200 g", "400 g flour").

SORTED BY YOUR ROUTE
Recipe2Grocery learns the order in which you shop in your supermarket. Next time the list is sorted exactly the way you walk through the store – separately for each store. If you like, the app detects by location which store you are in and selects it automatically.

SHOP TOGETHER
• Share a household by code or QR code – no sign-up.
• Every device sees the same list; changes show up instantly.
• The whole family sees live who ticked off what.

ALSO INCLUDED
• All items at a glance, with search and suggestions while typing.
• Shopping history: what you bought when and how long it took.
• Categorise dishes, copy ingredients between dishes, long-press menus for quick editing.
• Optional: your own Alexa skill to add items by voice (English and German).
• Light and dark mode, English and German.

YOUR DATA
The app works offline. To share a household it syncs via a server in Germany – without an account, using only a random household code. Your location is only used while the app is open and only for the store suggestion. No ads, no analytics.

Plan your cooking, shop relaxed: Recipe2Grocery.

name: ReelTale
description:
Find your next story in ReelTale, a home for serialized audio fiction with vivid, manga-inspired artwork.

Listen to original novels in short episodes, explore genres from romance and fantasy to mystery and action, and continue where you left off. Save stories to your list and follow each chapter through illustrated scenes and narration.

ReelTale also brings selected public-domain books to life with chapter-by-chapter audio and artwork.

No account is required. Your saved stories and playback progress stay on your device.

Discover a new world, one episode at a time.

name: Rello Reef Match
description:
Take a quiet puzzle break beneath the waves. Swap neighboring sea treasures to clear matches, break through sea grass, and complete each board's collection goals. Four in a line creates a beam, five creates a prism, and crossing matches create a nova. Charge the tide to clear a row.

Explore 60 Voyage levels across five regions, try the Daily Drift, or take your time on a Quiet Tide board with no move limit. Return to an unfinished board whenever you want. Earn pearls through play and use them to restore six parts of the reef.

Turn your reef into a journal card with a palette and a short note. Add a photo or a voice note if you like, and save or share the finished image. Gameplay works offline, and journal media is kept on the device.

name: RemboTane
description:
RemboTane helps you care for houseplants on a steady rhythm—not by guessing when you last watered.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Add plants with pot size, kind, nickname, and a custom watering interval
• Greenhouse: overview dryness ring and quick “Tend” for the selected pot
• Plants: your staggered shelf list; open any pot for history and dryness
• Thirsty: plants ranked by estimated dryness so you know who needs water first
• Log tending: water, mist, fertilize, repot, rotate, and notes

name: Replay Station
description:
Replay Station è il simulatore di allenamento per i video match official, usato dai settori arbitrali delle federazioni calcistiche.

Razione settimanale di clip reali, preparate dagli istruttori VAR della federazione
Il protocollo VAR completo a voce: check, raccomandazione, on-field review con loop, normal speed, point of contact e zoom
Flash video quiz e clip di allenamento con decisione di campo
KPI per ogni prova e debrief AI che spiega cosa è andato bene e cosa migliorare
Guida per gli ufficiali su replay-station.net/guide

Si entra con il codice della federazione, l'email e il PIN personale rilasciati dalla federazione. L'app è per gli ufficiali di gara e gli istruttori delle federazioni che usano VAR Manager; non vende nulla al suo interno.

name: Resdirekt.se - Billiga flyg
description:
Resdirekt.se jämför flygpriser från flygbolag och resebyråer på ett ställe. Sök en resa, se alla priser i en lista och boka direkt hos den säljare du väljer. Du betalar aldrig något till oss.

SÖK OCH JÄMFÖR
• Tur och retur, enkel resa eller flera städer
• Bäst, billigast och snabbast med ett tryck
• Snabbfilter för direktflyg, antal byten, incheckad väska och självtransfer
• Se bagage, byten och restid på varje resa innan du väljer

HITTA BILLIGA DAGAR
• Priskalendern visar lägsta priset för varje dag
• Billigt från din flygplats: helg, direktflyg, sista minuten och resor under 1 000 kr
• Sista minuten med avresa inom en vecka upp till två månader

BEVAKA PRISET
• Bevaka en resa och få mejl när priset sjunker
• Samma konto i appen och på resdirekt.se
• Logga in med Apple, Google eller e-post

RESEGUIDER
• Guider till hundratals resmål med lägsta priser per månad, väder, fakta och tips
• Länder, städer och flygplatser med priser från din avreseort

Resdirekt.se jämför och länkar vidare. Vi är inte en resebyrå och tar inte betalt för resan. Priser och villkor sätts av säljaren, och priset hos säljaren gäller.

name: Reservation RS
description:
Reservation is the app for salons and anyone who works by appointment: hairdressers, barbers, beauticians, nail salons, massage therapists and trainers.

Clients book on their own, 24/7, through your link (Instagram, Viber, a QR code on the door). In the app you see your schedule, accept requests and know who is coming next.

WHAT YOU GET
• Day and week schedule for the whole team, with no double bookings
• Booking requests arrive instantly, with a notification on your iPhone
• Quick entry by typing or voice: "Ana tomorrow 10am haircut"
• SMS confirmation and a reminder the day before
• Clients with visit history, birthdays and notes
• Reports: revenue by day and service, monthly goal
• Waitlist when the day is full
• Client ratings after each visit
• Sign in with a PIN or Face ID

EXTRAS (switch on only what you need)
Loyalty Club, gift cards, bookings and loyalty card in Apple Wallet, an AI booking assistant, client file, end-of-day totals, staff commissions, visit confirmation, flash offers, birthday wishes and more.

The app is for salon owners and their staff. Salon accounts are set up at reservation.rs. The same account works on iPhone, Android and computer.

Support: info@ress.rs · WhatsApp +381 69 328 3376

name: Resurf: Recurring Reminders
description:
Recurring reminders for everything you forget: the chores with no fixed day, the clothes you never wear, the friends you keep meaning to call.

Most to-do apps give you an endless list. Resurf gives you 3 cards a day. It quietly tracks how long it's been since you last did each thing and brings back what's drifting out of mind. Tap done, and it comes back when it's due.

Built for ADHD brains, forgetful minds and busy lives. No due dates, no red badges, no guilt.

HOW IT WORKS
• Add anything in seconds: a name, an optional photo and how often it matters
• Every morning, Resurf picks the 3 things that need you most
• Tap "Done" or snooze it. That's it.
• Not in the mood? Snooze without shame. Feeling good? Pull one more card.

SIX AREAS OF LIFE
• Wardrobe & belongings: wear the clothes and use the things you already own
• Home & car: wash sheets, clean filters, water plants, check tyre pressure, home maintenance
• People: keep in touch with friends and family before it's been "too long"
• Health & self-care: haircuts, dentist check-ups, a new toothbrush, a long walk
• Life admin: review subscriptions, back up your phone, check your passport
• Anything else that keeps slipping your mind

MADE FOR HOW YOUR BRAIN WORKS
• Only 3 cards a day, so it never feels overwhelming
• Flexible schedules: every few days, weekly, monthly, yearly or custom
• Photos help you recognise items at a glance
• Starter packs let you set up in a minute with zero typing
• A gentle morning reminder, at the hour you choose

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No cloud. No tracking. Everything, including your photos, stays on your phone. Photo location data is removed, and you can hide item names on the lock screen.

EARLY ACCESS
Resurf is new and free in Early Access. Your feedback shapes what comes next: Settings → Send feedback.

Out of sight shouldn't mean out of mind.

name: Rezerva Partners
description:
Rezerva Partners is the app for tourism businesses listed on rezerva.tl, the travel marketplace for Timor-Leste. Guesthouses, tour and boat operators, dive shops, trek guides and car rental businesses use it to handle the work that arrives from the marketplace, from a phone.

An account is required, and Rezerva approves it before you can start work. You can create one in the app, or Rezerva can send you an invitation. If you are already listed and would rather we set it up for you, message Rezerva on WhatsApp at +670 7404 2888.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

Enquiries and bookings
Every enquiry and booking from rezerva.tl arrives in one list. Answer a price question, accept or decline a request, and mark a job done when it is finished. Search your whole booking book by guest name or reference, or step through it day by day.

Messages
Reply to guests in a simple chat. Rezerva passes your answer on, so the guest hears back without you giving out your own number.

Rooms, tours, prices and photos
Keep rooms, tours, prices and photos up to date, and close the dates you cannot take. A boat or vehicle charter keeps one price for the whole group. What you change here is what travellers see on rezerva.tl.

Car rental
Rental businesses can edit their rental classes and the extras that go with them.

Walk-ins
Log a guest who arrives at the door, so your own book stays complete.

Check-in
Photograph a guest's passport and the app reads the two machine readable lines on the phone itself, so the passport number, nationality and expiry go onto the booking without typing.

YOUR LANGUAGE

The app speaks Tetun first, and also English, Portuguese and Indonesian.

BUILT FOR REAL CONDITIONS

Screens are light on data, forms forgive mistakes, and work you have already saved stays on the phone when the connection drops.

Rezerva Partners is operated by REZERVA OTA, LDA., Timor Plaza Central, Loja 150, Rua 20 de Setembro, Dili, Timor-Leste.

name: RF Ludo
description:
Roll the dice, race your pawns home, and play Ludo your way.

Play offline against bots or share one device with friends. For online play, create a private room and share its code with friends. Play solo with two to four players or team up for a two-versus-two match.

Choose an avatar, roll 3D dice, and watch each pawn hop across the board.

name: Ria Call
description:
Ria phones the restaurant. In their language.

Travelling and want a table at that little place in Tokyo, Hong Kong, Paris or Bangkok that only takes bookings by phone? Tell Ria the restaurant, the date, the time and how many. She calls them, speaks Japanese, Cantonese, Korean, Thai, French, Italian, Spanish, German, Portuguese or whatever they answer in, asks for the table under your name, and brings back the result with the full transcript.

HOW IT WORKS
• Enter the restaurant, its country and phone number, the date, time, party size and the name for the booking.
• See the exact price for that call before you dial.
• Ria introduces herself as an AI assistant calling on your behalf, spells your name, and handles a different time if yours is full.
• Watch the transcript live and get the result: booked, alternative offered, fully booked, or "book online" — with the restaurant's exact words.

HONEST PRICING
• Every call is priced before you place it, from the real cost of phoning that number: from $1.49 for a landline in the United States, $1.99 in Japan. Mobiles and some countries cost more; the app always shows the number first.
• You only pay if someone picks up. Voicemail is half price. No answer, busy, or a failure on our side costs nothing.
• Prepaid credit in $5, $10 and $25 packs; credit never expires.
• Your first demo call (an AI plays the restaurant) is free, so you can hear Ria before spending anything.

WHAT RIA WILL NOT DO
• Agree to deposits, card details or cancellation fees on your behalf. If a restaurant needs one, she tells you.
• Claim a booking that was not clearly confirmed.

Forty countries at launch across Asia, Europe, the Americas and Oceania. No account, no password: the app creates a private identifier on your device.

name: Roadmap Golf
description:
Plan a junior golf season with Roadmap Golf. Built for parents, guardians, and coaches, the app brings tournament discovery, scheduling, and results into one place.

• Find tournaments with PathFinder recommendations and filter by location, tour, or competitive fit.
• Build a season plan and track saved, registered, waitlisted, and played events.
• Keep registration deadlines in view with reminders, calendar export, and a next-event Home Screen widget.
• Record tournament results and explore season projections for players with linked results.

Sign in with your roadmap.golf account to access your players and season plan.

name: RoomFlow
description: hotel housekeeping for staff. Live room status, assignments, inspections, and maintenance.

name: RotaRibbons
description:
See where your next day off falls without counting through the rotation by hand. Choose the day the cycle begins, then arrange Day, Evening, Night and Off in the order you work.

Browse the resulting monthly calendar. Its colors and initials distinguish shifts at a glance. Select a date to change that day while the rest of the rotation stays in place.

Export a picture of a month when someone needs your roster. You choose the destination in the system share sheet. Your schedule is kept on your iPhone.

name: RPG Drag Match
description:
RPG Drag Match is a happy matching game from RolyPolyGo! for anyone who loves a puzzle. Every picture has a match waiting on the board: drag it there, or tap the picture and then its match.

SO MANY WAYS TO MATCH
Twins, colours, shadows, halves, outlines, counting, letters, big and small letters, colour and shape, and first letters (A is for apple!). Then things that go together: cow and milk, rain and umbrella, cat and fish.

100 LEVELS IN 10 WORLDS
Start gently in Leafy Garden, then play through Fruit Market, Busy Town, Jungle Friends, Starry Night, Seaside, Toy Shop, Snowy Hills, Busy Farm and Rainbow Castle. Every world brings something new: look-alike pictures, turned shadows, baskets to sort into, close-ups, memory spots that hide, mixed rules and spots that move.

EARN STARS
Match everything without a wrong drop for three stars. Show me lights up the next match whenever you need a hand, and there's a big party after the last level.

FOR EVERYONE
• No ads and no accounts
• Works offline
• Gentle music and sounds, each with its own switch
• Big, simple controls

Made by RolyPolyGo!, makers of play-and-learn games in 40+ languages.

name: Rummy Room
description:
Rummy Room is the classic rummy game played with numbered tiles: numbers 1 to 13 in four colors, plus two jokers. Now on your phone — with your friends, wherever you are.

PLAY ONLINE WITH FRIENDS
• Tables for 2–4 players: send a link and your friend sits down with one tap, even without an account yet
• Public tables in the lobby, or private ones by invitation only
• Optional turn timer, rated or casual games
• Chat and voice chat at the table
• Watch games in progress

RATING AND TOURNAMENTS
• Elo rating, leaderboard and player profiles
• Multi-round tournaments where strong players meet strong players

NO INTERNET? NO PROBLEM
• Pass & play: 2–4 players share one phone, and the screen is covered between turns
• Nearby: several phones at one table over Bluetooth — the host shows a QR code, everyone else scans it

THE RULES YOU KNOW
• Groups (7 7 7 in different colors) and runs (4 5 6 in one color), jokers
• A 30-point initial meld — set up the way your table likes it
• Rearrange the table freely: the first player to get rid of all their tiles wins

FRIENDLY BY DESIGN
• Profanity filter, reporting and blocking
• Delete your account at any time from your profile

Rummy Room is free, with no ads and no in-app purchases. Available in English, Spanish and Russian.

name: Rumor Spreader
description:
Whisper to one person. The rumor does the rest.

Everyone who hears it chats to the people nearby, who chat to the people near them. One tap becomes a chain reaction that paints the screen pink, and the rumor gets bigger with every hop:
"They say Max was late today" → "They say Max and the principal are best friends" → "They say Max is moving the school into space"

■ 10 STAGES, CLASSROOM TO WORLD
Start with 30 classmates and spread through the hallway, cram school street, apartments, office, subway, social feed, TV station, the whole country and finally 5,000 people around the world.

■ 9 KINDS OF PEOPLE
Chatterboxes, earbud wearers, grannies, group chats, skeptics, influencers, reporters and fact-checkers who try to stop you. Who you tell first is the whole game.

■ PICK YOUR BUILD
Every time the rumor trends, pick 1 of 3 rumor cards. Combine two to unlock an evolved card. When the chain fades, fan the flames to restart it.

■ REBIRTH
Clear stage 10 and be reborn: student, office worker, granny, celebrity, alien. Each life brings a new rumor theme and new rules, and past-life memories buy traits that stay forever.

■ DAILY RUMOR
Everyone gets the same board each day. Compete on the Game Center leaderboard.

All rumors are made up and only ever silly or nice.
No ads · No in-app purchases · Plays offline · No data collected

name: RunFun: Together We Run
description:
RunFun is the app for running together.

Start a lobby, share the 6-digit code, and everyone in your group appears on one live map, with their distance and pace. Whether you run side by side or spread across the park, you always know where your crew is.

RUN TOGETHER
- Create or join a lobby with a 6-digit code
- See every runner live on the map
- Live distance and pace for everyone in the lobby

TALK TO YOUR GROUP
- Lobby chat to plan the meet-up
- Voice notes when typing is too slow
- Report or block anyone, any time

LOBBY AWARDS
After each run, see who was fastest, who had the fastest km, who went furthest and who finished strongest.

DETAILED STATS
- Pace graph, elevation and per-km splits for every run
- Weekly and monthly totals
- Streaks and personal progress

Accurate GPS tracking filters out jumps and drift, and auto-pauses when you stop.

Sign in with Apple, Google or email. You can delete your account and all your data at any time from your profile.

name: Salah
description:
Salah hilft dir, die fünf täglichen Gebete im Blick zu behalten und verpasste Gebete (Qada) Schritt für Schritt nachzuholen.

TAG
• Fünf Kästchen pro Tag: Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha
• Grün gebetet, blau nachgeholt, rot verpasst
• Gebetszeiten nach deinem Standort, berechnet wie Diyanet (Hanafi, Asr-i evvel), weitere Methoden wählbar
• Countdown bis zum nächsten Gebet, während Fajr bis Sonnenaufgang
• Islamische Mitternacht, letztes Drittel der Nacht, Makruh-Zeiten
• Hijri-Datum, Freitag mit Jumu'a, Ramadan-Karte mit Suhur und Iftar

NACHHOLEN
• Liste aller offenen Gebete, dazu Witr und Fasten
• Nachhol-Plan: wie viele pro Tag, mit Fortschritt und Enddatum
• Qada-Rechner für Jahre, Monate und Tage

QIBLA UND MOSCHEEN
• Kompass zur Kaaba mit Vibration bei richtiger Richtung
• Moscheen in der Nähe mit Route in Apple Karten

MEHR
• Erinnerung mit Ton zur Gebetszeit, vor Ablauf der Zeit und vor Jumu'a
• Verlauf mit Kalender
• Tasbih nach dem Gebet
• Siri: "Dhuhr in Salah abhaken"

DATENSCHUTZ
Kein Konto, keine Werbung, kein Tracking. Alles bleibt auf deinem iPhone.

name: Salmo e Sono
description:
Reze o terço e adormeça em paz.

O Salmo e Sono é um app católico feito para a oração da noite. Toque na chama da vela, diga o que precisa e ela reza com você numa voz calma.
