O QUE VOCÊ ENCONTRA
• Terço para dormir: o mistério do dia é escolhido sozinho, em três durações (curto, completo ou para adormecer), com silêncio em cada mistério e a voz baixando no final.
• Os 150 salmos na Tradução Brasileira de 1917, para ler ou ouvir, com filtros por necessidade: medo à noite, ansiedade, tristeza, culpa e madrugada.
• Orações da noite para a ansiedade, o luto, um doente, a família, os filhos, o trabalho, a solidão e a gratidão.
• A vela que reza com você: peça "salmo 23", "terço para dormir" ou "não estou bem hoje". Se preferir, escreva em vez de falar.
• Duas vozes para escolher, uma feminina e uma masculina. Você ouve antes de escolher.
• Visual de vitral ao sol durante o dia e ao entardecer à noite, com letras grandes e botões fáceis de tocar.

FEITO COM RESPEITO
• Sem anúncios, sempre.
• Não guardamos o que você fala.
• Você baixa seus dados e exclui a conta pelo próprio app.

Oração não substitui ajuda médica ou psicológica. Em sofrimento intenso, procure alguém de confiança ou ligue para o CVV no 188, de graça, 24 horas por dia.

Salmos: Tradução Brasileira (1917), domínio público.

name: Samesay: Talk in Any Language
description:
Samesay lets two people who don't share a language talk as if they do. You write or speak in your language. They read and hear it in theirs, spoken in your own voice.

Chats
Send a message in your language and it arrives translated. Your original words stay underneath, so nothing gets lost.

Voice and video calls
Talk normally. The other person hears what you said in their language, in your voice, with live captions on screen. Turn translation off when you both want to hear each other directly.

Your own voice
Record about 30 seconds of yourself reading a short text. Samesay makes a copy of your voice, so translations sound like you, not like a robot. You can only record your own voice, and you can remove it any time.

Invite anyone
Share a call link. The other person can join from their phone or computer browser, even without the app.

Languages
English and Uzbek (O'zbekcha) today, with more on the way.

Privacy
No ads, no tracking, and your data is never sold. Calls aren't recorded. You can block or report anyone, and delete your account, messages and voice from the app at any time.

name: SAMVARO Tour
description:
SAMVARO Tour bringt die Stimme des Guides direkt auf die Handys der Gruppe. Der Guide spricht in ein Headset an seinem Handy, die Gäste hören über die eigenen Kopfhörer zu. Niemand braucht Funkempfänger, Einwegkopfhörer oder ein Konto.

So funktioniert es für Gäste
Code vom Guide eingeben oder den QR Code scannen, Kopfhörer rein, zuhören. Hinweise des Guides erscheinen auf dem Bildschirm. Nach der Tour kannst du Sterne und ein paar Worte hinterlassen, anonym und freiwillig.

So funktioniert es für Guides
Du planst deine Tour auf samvaro.de und bekommst einen Guide Link. Öffnest du ihn in dieser App, geht die Tour live. Du siehst den Beitrittscode für deine Gruppe, wie viele Personen zuhören, einen Stummschalter und ein Feld für Hinweise an alle.

Gemacht für draußen
Die Übertragung läuft in Echtzeit über das Mobilfunknetz und einen Audioserver in Deutschland. Es gibt keine Reichweitengrenze, Gäste dürfen sich verteilen und hören weiter zu. Das Handy bleibt in der Tasche, die Kopfhörer im Ohr. Reißt das Netz kurz ab, verbindet sich die App von selbst wieder. Der Datenverbrauch liegt bei etwa 15 bis 25 Megabyte je Stunde.

Datenschutz
Gäste bleiben anonym. Es wird nichts aufgezeichnet und nichts über die Zuhörenden gespeichert, nur wie viele Personen dabei waren. Bewertungen sind anonym.

SAMVARO Tour ist ein Produkt der adebar GmbH aus Hamburg. Die App ist kostenlos und enthält keine Werbung und keine In App Käufe.

name: Sân Chơi Tuổi Thơ 8x
description:
Play childhood again — and pass it on.

Sân Chơi Tuổi Thơ ("Childhood Playground") is a small Vietnamese neighbourhood courtyard from the late 1980s and early 1990s: a tropical almond tree, a whitewashed wall, power lines overhead, street vendors passing by. No quests, no leaderboards, no purchases. Just step into the courtyard and play.

IN THE COURTYARD
• Draw with chalk and charcoal on walls and paving
• Blow soap bubbles, play tag with the neighbourhood kids
• Sit anywhere: steps, wall tops, under the tree
• Slingshot fruit picking: 15 Vietnamese fruits for your basket
• A little creature of your own that grows day by day
• Make your own kid, and a dress-up corner

TRADITIONAL GAMES
• Ô Ăn Quan — sow pebbles, capture the mandarins
• Cò Sủn — Vietnamese hopscotch, with a solo high-score mode
• Bắn Bi Lỗ and Bi Mo — marbles: into the hole, out of the triangle
• Chọi Thú — toss your animal closest to the line
Each game has "How to play outdoors" and "Rules & variations" pages, so families can play it for real.

PLAY TOGETHER (OPTIONAL)
By default the game runs entirely on the device and sends nothing. When a parent turns on "Play together", children see each other in a shared courtyard: preset emotes only, no text chat. Typed names are checked automatically by the server; drawings are reviewed by an adult before others see them. Block and report are always there.

FOR PARENTS
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, no tracking
• A grown-up question before online play or any link out
• A rest reminder every 30 minutes
• Text size, read-aloud voice, reduced motion
• "Keep my things": a 5-picture code to move to another device, locked on the device before it is sent

The in-game voice is computer-generated.

name: SangoPage
description:
SangoPage crée le site web de votre entreprise en deux minutes, depuis votre téléphone, et vous apporte les demandes de vos clients. L'application est faite pour les artisans, prestataires, commerces et entreprises d'Afrique francophone : Abidjan, Dakar, Douala, Yaoundé, Bamako, Cotonou et bien d'autres villes.

CE QUE FAIT L'APPLICATION

• Vos demandes clients au même endroit : chaque demande envoyée depuis votre site arrive dans l'application avec le nom, le numéro et le message du client. Vous appelez ou répondez sur WhatsApp en un geste et vous suivez l'état de chaque demande (nouvelle, contactée, gagnée, perdue).
• Une notification à chaque nouvelle demande, pour répondre vite.
• Vos chiffres : visites de votre site, demandes reçues, clics sur WhatsApp et sur votre numéro, sur 7 et 30 jours.
• Partage facile : envoyez le lien de votre site sur WhatsApp, publiez-le en statut, et suivez la check-list pour apparaître sur Google.
• Votre site, modifié dans l'application : textes, services et prix, produits, horaires, photos prises avec l'appareil photo ou choisies dans la galerie, couleurs, adresse et textes pour Google. Un aperçu avant de publier, puis votre site est en ligne en un geste.
• Réglages : nom de l'entreprise, ville, numéro de téléphone et WhatsApp, enregistrés avec un seul bouton.

COMMENT ÇA MARCHE

1. Connectez-vous avec votre adresse e-mail : un code vous est envoyé, sans mot de passe à retenir.
2. Répondez à six questions (votre activité, votre nom, votre ville, votre contact, une description, vos photos) : votre site est prêt, vous le relisez et le publiez.
3. Recevez vos demandes clients et répondez-y depuis votre téléphone.

POURQUOI SANGOPAGE

• Gratuit pour commencer, 0 % de commission sur vos ventes.
• Numéro vérifié affiché sur votre site, pour rassurer vos clients.
• Léger et rapide, pensé pour les connexions mobiles.
• Prix en FCFA, interface en français.

Support : sangopage.com — Politique de confidentialité : sangopage.com/confidentialite

name: Say It Cards: AAC Talk Board
description:
Say It Cards gives you a voice when speaking is hard — after a stroke, with aphasia, autism, a tracheostomy, voice surgery, or any moment you can't speak.

TAP A CARD, IT SPEAKS
• 96 ready cards in 7 colour-coded groups: Quick replies, Needs, Feelings, Body & pain, People, Places and Questions
• Each tap speaks out loud and adds the words to a sentence strip
• Press Speak to say the whole sentence at once

SAY WHERE IT HURTS
• Pick the body part and a 0–10 pain level, and the app says exactly that: "My stomach hurts. The pain is 7 out of 10."

TYPE TO SPEAK
• Write anything and have it read aloud
• Show Big fills the screen with huge, high-contrast text — flip it 180° for the person sitting opposite you
• Recent phrases are one tap away

EMERGENCY INFO CARD
• Name, conditions, allergies, medicines, blood type and an emergency contact
• Show it to paramedics or have it read aloud; call your contact with one tap

MADE FOR YOU
• Make your own cards with symbols
• Adjust speaking speed, voice pitch, card size and cards per row
• Korean and English, VoiceOver and Dynamic Type friendly, iPhone and iPad

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no account, no tracking, no internet needed. Everything stays on your device.

Say It Cards is a communication aid, not a medical device. In an emergency, call your local emergency number first.

name: ScanDoc
description:
Trasforma il tuo iPhone o iPad in uno scanner documentale semplice, pratico e veloce!

Con ScanDoc puoi acquisire documenti tramite fotocamera o importare immagini dalla galleria, rilevare automaticamente i bordi, correggere la prospettiva e creare scansioni chiare e ordinate.

FUNZIONALITÀ PRINCIPALI

• Acquisizione di documenti tramite fotocamera o galleria fotografica
• Rilevamento automatico dei bordi
• Regolazione manuale del ritaglio
• Correzione della prospettiva e rotazione
• Esportazione in formato PDF, JPEG o PNG
• Condivisione tramite le app installate sul dispositivo
• Archivio locale per gestire i documenti
• Interfaccia disponibile in italiano, inglese, spagnolo, portoghese brasiliano, francese e tedesco

VERSIONE GRATUITA

ScanDoc offre gratuitamente:
• Fino a 3 scansioni al giorno
• 1 pagina per documento
• Archivio interno fino a 3 documenti

Quando l'archivio è pieno puoi eliminare un documento esistente per liberare spazio. Puoi comunque continuare a esportare direttamente le scansioni, nel rispetto del limite giornaliero.

SCOPRI SCANDOC PRO

Hai bisogno di scansioni illimitate, documenti multipagina e un archivio senza questi limiti?

Scopri ScanDoc PRO, disponibile come applicazione separata sull'App Store, direttamente dal pulsante presente nell'app.

PRIVACY E SEMPLICITÀ

I documenti vengono elaborati localmente sul dispositivo. Non è necessario creare un account.

Scarica ScanDoc e digitalizza i tuoi documenti in pochi passaggi!

name: Scroll the Epics: The Odyssey
description:
The Odyssey is one of the oldest stories we have: a man trying to get home. Now you can read it the way you read everything else, one card at a time.

Scroll the Epics retells all 24 Books of Homer's poem in modern English. Every card is read aloud, so you can read, listen, or do both.

THE WHOLE STORY
Follow Telemachus as he searches for news of his father, then Odysseus himself: Calypso's island, the Cyclops, Circe, the land of the dead, the Sirens, and the long road back to Ithaca. Choose the main story, or the full story with its side tales.

IN HOMER'S OWN WORDS
The famous lines appear in the original Greek, with a plain English meaning beside them. Explain notes open up names, places and ideas.

MADE FOR READING
• A family tree that grows as you meet people, without spoilers
• My Journey, a map of your progress through the 24 Books
• Saved cards and progress through every episode
• Speed, music and colour settings, with a clean screen at a tap
• Every card's narration is in the app, so it all works offline

START FREE
Read free until Poseidon's storm. Then unlock everything with a single payment. No subscription.

Scroll the Epics is an adaptation, not a translation.

name: SE TruckBook
description:
SE TruckBook works out a load before you take it. Enter the pay, the miles and your costs, and the app shows the fuel cost, the total cost, the driver share and what stays for the company, in plain profit or loss.

Fuel prices for the United States come fresh from AAA and the US Energy Information Administration, with the date of each price shown. Fuel prices for Afghanistan are written by hand and always carry their date.

The app covers the United States and Afghanistan. In Afghanistan it works in kilometres and afghani, with the vehicles Afghan drivers use, from the semi truck and box truck to the Mazda Titan, TownAce, Tourismo, Corolla Fielder, Saracha and Baipor.

Keep your load book in the app, with week, month and all time totals. Use the truck aware map to check a lane before you roll.

No account is needed. Everything you enter stays on your phone.

The app speaks Pashto and English.

name: Seamcode
description:
Every sample library hides a question: where does the sound end so it can begin again? Every printed code hides another: will this still scan when part of it is gone? Seamcode answers both with numbers.
Audit the seam
Import-style seeds or build a fresh pad, then drag the loop region on a real waveform. Seamcode measures the seam the way your ears do, but with better memory:
- Seam K — how many "normal sample steps" the jump at the seam is worth. Under 2, you will never hear it.
- Wrap — the loudness step when the loop wraps around, in dB. A crossfade can hide a click; nothing hides a 6 dB jump.
- Period correlation — is your loop a whole number of cycles, or is it drifting?
- Snap — one tap moves the loop end to the cleanest same-slope zero crossing within your tolerance, and tells you exactly how far it moved.
Each loop gets a verdict — PASS, WARN, or FAIL — with a reason code like `preFadeClick` (the raw seam clicks, but your crossfade erases it on export) or `levelStepHard` (fade cannot fix loudness). Tail-gated drum loops are measured with the wrap check waived, honestly labelled in the report.
Export the looped region as WAV with the equal-power crossfade baked in, plus markers JSON, waveform SVG, and a plain-text seam report.
Audit the symbol
Encode EAN-13 with full L/G/R pattern tables and check-digit validation, or QR codes up to version 4 with all four error-correction levels. Under the hood Seamcode runs real Reed–Solomon over GF(256): every symbol it builds is verified by decoding it back — syndromes must vanish and the payload must return intact before the verdict says PASS.
- Capacity bar shows bytes used against the version ceiling before you type the last character.
- Mask selection follows the standard penalty rules (runs, blocks, finder look-alikes, dark ratio) — or lock any of the eight masks by hand.
- Live preview always renders black on white, the way the printed symbol will look, with a configurable quiet zone.
- Export SVG, PNG, module matrix TXT, and a report listing version, codewords, spare bytes, and penalty scores.
One idea, two domains
Loop points and error-correcting codes are the same story told twice: discrete data that must survive a cut. The Audit tab puts them side by side — every clip and every symbol with its metrics, verdict, and reason code — and writes the whole ledger out as one report. Nothing is scored by vibes; every PASS has a number behind it.
Samples included
Seamcode ships with three synthesised loops — a clean 120 BPM pad, a drum loop dragged deliberately out of phase, and a fading wash whose wrap betrays it — plus an EAN-13 reference and two QR tags. Together they demonstrate all three verdicts on first launch, so the app teaches its own thresholds before you touch anything.
Private by construction
No network access. No analytics. No account. Your audio and your codes never leave the device, and the privacy manifest declares exactly that: no tracking, no collected data.
For sample-pack builders, live performers, label printers, and anyone who believes "it sounds fine" is not a measurement.

name: Secret Crush・告白氣球
description:
你喜歡的那個人，會不會也在偷偷喜歡你？

有些喜歡，藏在心裡好久，卻不知道該不該說出口。
如果有一顆氣球，能替你偷偷傳達心意呢？

在 Secret Crush・告白氣球，寄出一顆告白氣球，讓喜歡飄向那個人。也可以分享自己的連結，收下來自別人的心動。

有些喜歡，不必先說出口。只有剛好喜歡彼此，秘密才會被發現。

怎麼玩

告白氣球｜去找你喜歡的人
• 只能透過對方本人的專屬連結或 QR Code 寄出。
• 同一時間只能寄出一顆，晚上 9 點送達。
• 如果你們剛好互相寄出告白氣球，就會成功配對！
• 配對成功後，就能在 App 裡即時聊天，還能分享專屬配對限動卡。

心動氣球｜讓別人找到你
• 分享自己的專屬連結到限動、自介或聊天中，讓別人找到你。
• 每個人每天可以寄出 3 顆心動氣球。
• 心動氣球會在幾分鐘內飄到，不必等到晚上 9 點，也不會配對。
• 還能分享心動限動卡，讓大家看看你這週收到了幾顆。

心動排行榜｜今天，誰最讓人心動？
• 自願參加，看看今天或本週誰收到最多心動。
• 每個榜單都有前 20 名。
• 可以自由選擇是否顯示 IG，讓欣賞你的人有機會認識你。

安心的設計
• 沒有照片功能，也沒有搜尋功能。
• 沒有人會收到「被拒絕」的通知。
• 只有成功配對後，才能開始聊天，訊息可以檢舉。
• 隨時都能封鎖、檢舉或刪除帳號。

僅限 18 歲以上使用。

name: Sectato: Live Captions & Notes
description:
Sectato turns what you hear into live captions, translates them, and writes the meeting notes for you, using the AI already inside your Mac and iPhone. Nothing has to leave your device.

On-device AI with Apple Intelligence
• Translation, summaries, meeting minutes and Q&A run on Apple Intelligence, the local model built into macOS 26 and iOS 26. No account, no API key, no cloud.
• Speech recognition is Apple's on-device engine, or a fully offline local model with automatic language detection.
• Works on a plane, in a basement, or anywhere you would rather not upload a meeting.

Private by design
• No accounts, no servers, no analytics. Audio never leaves the device.
• Captions, notes and your knowledge base stay in the app's own folder and can be deleted any time.

Easy on the battery
• Built natively in Swift and Rust. The microphone is released the moment you switch recognition off, and the interface is tuned to keep the CPU idle, so an all-day meeting will not drain your phone.

What you get
• Live captions with the original line under the translation, like bilingual subtitles
• Meeting notes that build up while you listen and become structured minutes at the end
• Q&A: questions raised in the meeting are picked up and answered from your knowledge base
• Knowledge base: drop documents into projects; meeting records are filed automatically and cited in answers
• Captions in the Dynamic Island on iPhone; on the Mac a translucent always-on-top caption window with a notes panel that docks beside it

Bring your own AI (optional)
Prefer a bigger model? Add your own API key for OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Alibaba Model Studio, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, Azure or a local LM Studio server. Sectato falls back to Apple Intelligence whenever that service is unreachable.

Requires macOS 26 / iOS 26 on Apple silicon; Apple Intelligence must be turned on for on-device AI. To caption meeting apps or videos on the Mac, install a virtual audio device such as BlackHole.

name: SeedTray: Seed Cell Planner
description:
SeedTray turns a physical seed-starting tray into a working crop plan.

Tap any cell on the Grid to assign basil, tomato, pepper, lettuce, and more. The fill meter and tray-plan snapshot update immediately so you can see what you started and what still needs sowing. Crops lists sprout and transplant windows. Plan lines up transplant dates from each cell’s sown day.

Unlike a garden journal or generic calculator, SeedTray’s home screen is the tray itself—a greenhouse cell grid you fill by tapping, not a form of numbers.

• 48-cell starter tray with color-coded crops
• Tap to fill, long-press to clear
• Transplant queue derived from sown dates
• Sample nursery ready on first launch
• Works fully offline — no accounts or ads

Business model: Free. No in-app purchases, subscriptions, ads, or accounts.

name: Seedule
description:
Getting friends together shouldn't take 40 texts. Seedule turns "we should hang out sometime" into a date on everyone's calendar.

START A PLAN
Taco night, a birthday dinner, a lake weekend or a big trip. Add a few dates that work for you, pick how many people need to be there, and share the link in your group chat.

FRIENDS VOTE FROM A TEXT
Your friends open the link and answer each date: Can go, Maybe or Can't. No app download or account needed to answer, just a name.

IT LOCKS IN BY ITSELF
Seedule shows who can make each date. The moment enough people can go, the date locks in and everyone who said yes is in. As the organizer you can also lock in a date yourself, or reopen voting.

NOBODY GETS LEFT BEHIND
See who hasn't answered and send them a reminder in one tap. If no date works before the deadline, try a new set of dates with the same group.

SPLIT COSTS AND SUPPLIES
Add what the plan needs. Claim the firewood or the snacks so nothing gets doubled, and split costs like a cabin rental evenly among everyone going. Mark your share paid and see who's settled up.

AFTER THE PLAN
Share photos with the group, see a recap, settle up, and repeat the plan with the same people whenever you want.

BUILT FOR GROUP CHATS
Every friend has their own color, plans read like a chat, and it all works the same on iPhone and in the browser, so nobody is left out.

Private by design: your plans are visible only to the people in them. No ads, and we never sell your data.

name: selfCRM
seller_name: 8BIT GRUP BILISIM DANISMANLIK YAZILIM LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
selfCRM, satış ekibinizin aday, müşteri ve teklif takibini web paneliyle aynı veriler üzerinden cebinize taşır. Uygulama, firmanızın selfCRM hesabıyla çalışır; hesabınız yoksa selfcrm.tr adresinden deneme başlatabilirsiniz.

ADAYLAR VE MÜŞTERİLER
• Aday ve müşteri kartları, birden çok yetkili, kaynak ve etiket
• Liste ve Kanban görünümü, sürükle bırak ile durum değiştirme
• Görüşme ve temas kaydı, sonraki takip hatırlatması
• Adayı tek dokunuşla teklife ve müşteriye dönüştürme
• CSV dışa ve içe aktarım

TEKLİFLER
• Kalemli teklif: miktar, birim fiyat, iskonto ve KDV ile otomatik toplam
• Revizyon ve teklif dosyası
• Kurumsal PDF teklif oluşturma ve paylaşma
• Kazanılan ve kaybedilen teklifler, kayıp nedeni

SANTRAL VE TELEFON
• Firmanızın santraline bağlı uygulama içi telefon: arama, cevaplama, bekletme, aktarma
• Gelen aramada arayanın CRM kaydı
• Çağrı geçmişi, ses kaydı dinleme ve görüşme notu
• Yapay zekâ ile görüşme analizi

İLETİŞİM
• Ekip içi sohbet ve dosya paylaşımı
• Müşteriye SMS ve WhatsApp Business mesajı
• KVKK onamı (selfOnam) ve İYS izin sorgusu
• Sohbet, WhatsApp ve cevapsız arama bildirimleri

YÖNETİM
• Özet ekranı, satış hunisi ve temsilci performans raporları

name: Sell The Flip: Crosslister
description:
Sell The Flip is the fast way to list your items from your phone.

Take photos, let AI fill in the title, description, brand, condition and category, then review and post. Your listings, photos and inventory stay in sync with selltheflip.com.

LIST IN MINUTES
- Take photos with the built-in camera or pick from your library
- AI fills in the details so you only review and adjust
- Edit photos with brightness, contrast, saturation, rotate, crop and flip
- Set shipping weight, package size and price
- Save a draft and finish later, even offline

POST FROM YOUR PHONE
- Post to eBay and Etsy straight from the app
- See where each listing is live
- Delist from a marketplace without leaving the app
- More marketplaces are coming to the app soon. Today you can post to Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Facebook Marketplace, Whatnot and others from selltheflip.com with the Sell The Flip browser extension.

STAY ORGANIZED
- Search, sort and filter your inventory by marketplace, status, label, category and price
- Add labels to group listings the way you work
- Reorder photos and choose the cover image
- Edit any listing and see its status at a glance

BUILT FOR RESELLERS
Sell The Flip is made for people who sell online every day, from side-hustle flippers to full-time resellers. List once, then sell everywhere.

A free Sell The Flip account is required. Create one in the app and start with 25 free marketplace postings. No credit card needed.

Questions? Contact support@selltheflip.com.

name: Sendavie
description:
Sendavie is a journal of the places in your life: the cities you have lived in, the trips you have taken, the restaurants and spots you want to remember.

• Your map: every place with its dates, the people who were there, a rating out of five, a review and up to 10 photos.

• Your wishlist: places you want to go, saved to a notebook and marked as visited when the day comes.

• Notebooks to gather a trip, a city or a selection to share.

• A feed with the places of the people you follow, their reviews, likes and comments. Your circle, to see only your closest friends.

• Tag your friends on a place, mention them in a comment, and get a notification when they reply.

• Your statistics: countries, years, categories, people, favourite places.

You choose who sees each place: only you, your followers or all members. Your home is never shown precisely to others.

Your data is yours: CSV and JSON export, import, and account deletion from the app. No ads, no trackers.

Sign-up requires an invitation code.

name: SEO Backlinks – Guest Posts
description:
SEO Backlinks is a free app for people who have something worth sharing: a how-to, a story, a useful page, an idea. Choose one of the websites in the network, write an original post with a link to your site, and it goes live in seconds after automatic spam checks.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Browse the network's websites and see what each one is looking for (topics, length, posting rules).
• Write your post in the app with a clear form: title, summary, body, a link if you have one, topic and tags.
• Save drafts on your phone (encrypted) and finish later, even offline.
• Publish in one tap and follow every post in My Submissions: live, draft, or returned with exactly what to fix.
• Edit and resubmit a post, withdraw a published post, or delete a draft.
• Manage your account and signed-in devices; delete your account at any time.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Create a free account with your email, or sign in.
2. Pick a website that fits your topic.
3. Write something original (copies and spun text are refused).
4. It is checked automatically for spam and copied text and goes live in seconds, with a link you can share.

WHAT IT IS NOT
SEO Backlinks is a publishing network, not a link-selling service. There is no payment, no ranking promises and no guaranteed placement. Links in posts are marked as user-generated content (nofollow). Posts that break the content rules are refused by the automatic checks, and published posts that are reported are reviewed by our team and removed if they break the rules. Every post page has a Report link.

PRIVACY
We store only what the service needs: your email, your display name, your posts and basic device information for security. No ads, no tracking, no selling of data. Full policy: https://www.seobacklinks.app/privacy

You must be 18 or older to use SEO Backlinks.

Questions or problems: worldranklist@gmail.com

name: sfMate
description:
sfMate is an AI advisor for Saint Francis High School students. Ask a question the way you'd text a friend, and get a clear answer drawn from the school's own information, with sources you can check.

WHAT YOU CAN ASK
• The calendar: Is there school Friday? What day type is it (G1, B2, L1...)? When's the next holiday, finals, or liturgy?
• Lunch: What's at the Lancer Cafe today or later this week, and what does it cost?
• Clubs and activities: What clubs are there, who moderates them, and how do you join?
• Classes: Course descriptions, prerequisites, honors and AP, and graduation requirements.
• School rules: Dress code, phones, attendance, and more, straight from the Student-Parent Handbook.
• Everything else: Small talk, a study break, or a good spot to grab coffee nearby.
• Daily Announcements (with your @sfhs.com school email): "What's in today's announcements?" sfMate summarizes each morning's email, covering only the topics you pick, plus that day's lunch. These are the school's own emails, so only @sfhs.com accounts get them. Everything else comes from public sources.

MADE FOR YOU
• Tell sfMate your grade, hobbies, and favorite food (all optional), and it tailors answers to you.
• Get a reminder the evening before liturgy and activity days.
• Switch to another app while an answer is being written, and it's waiting for you when you come back.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics.
• sfMate asks your permission before sending any question to its AI provider, and you can withdraw it any time.
• Conversations aren't saved to your account.
• Delete your account any time, right in the app.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Sign up with any email (we send you a code to confirm it). Use your @sfhs.com school email to also get the Daily Announcements.
• Accounts can send up to 40 messages a day with an @sfhs.com email, or 15 with any other email.
• sfMate uses AI and can make mistakes. Check important information with the school or the Student-Parent Handbook.
• sfMate is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or run by Saint Francis High School.

name: Shape Away
seller_name: FUNDORA YAZILIM PAZARLAMA VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Shape Away is a colorful 3D puzzle game about arrows, shapes, and finding the right order.

Every piece on the board has an arrow showing the only direction it can move. Tap a shape and it slides away, unless another piece is blocking its path. Study the board, plan your moves, and clear every shape to win the level. 

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a shape to slide it in its arrow's direction
• Blocked pieces can't move. Free the way first
• Find the correct order to clear the whole board
• Stuck? Use a hint

FEATURES
• Simple one-tap controls
• Bright, chunky 3D shapes: blocks, triangles, L-pieces and more
• Handcrafted levels that get trickier as you go
• Quick, satisfying levels you can play anytime
• Relaxing gameplay with no timers

It starts with a few pieces, but soon dozens of shapes lock together and every tap matters.

Can you clear them all?

name: Shatterstar
description:
Shatterstar is a fast, glowing brick breaker set in deep space.

Drag anywhere to fly your ship and bounce the ball into walls of neon bricks. But watch the purple ones: raider ships are docked inside, and they shake loose, weave down the screen and fire at you. While they're flying, your ship fires lasers back automatically.

FEATURES
• One-finger controls: drag to fly, lift to launch
• Raider ships that break free and attack
• Steel bricks that crack before they shatter
• Power-ups: multiball, wide wings, shield bar, rapid twin lasers and extra ships
• Combo multiplier up to 5x for chaining hits between paddle touches
• Warp-speed jumps between sectors, with more armor, more raiders and faster play each time
• Five rotating sector layouts and a saved best score
• Haptics and retro sound effects
• No ads, no accounts, no in-app purchases, no data collected

name: Shelfora
description:
Every collection has a story. Shelfora keeps yours organized, photographed and easy to find.

COLLECTIONS AND GALLERIES
• Create unlimited collections with cover photos, tags and notes
• Add items with several photos, condition, quantity, storage spot and your own values
• Gallery grid or detailed list, with search, filters and sorting

MADE FOR WHAT YOU COLLECT
• Books and magazines: author, ISBN, publisher, year, genre, reading status, ratings and issue numbers
• Board games: players, play time, game type, expansions and when you last played
• Collectibles: trading cards, coins, stamps, figurines, art, watches and antiques, with edition, rarity and provenance notes
• Your own categories for anything else

LENDING WITHOUT WORRY
• Record who borrowed what and when it's due back
• Active, due soon, overdue and returned at a glance
• Optional reminders before items are due

STORAGE MAP
• Shelves, cabinets, boxes and drawers
• See everything in a location and find items without a home

INSIGHTS FROM YOUR OWN RECORDS
• Growth over time, categories, lending statistics and the values you've entered
• Items missing photos or storage locations, and possible duplicates

SHELFORA AI STUDIO (OPTIONAL)
• Collection analysis, organization ideas, growth report and storage suggestions
• A personal roadmap that adapts to your records
• Ask questions about your collection
AI runs only when you ask, shows what it will send, and never sends photos, notes, prices or borrower details. Suggestions are not appraisals or authentication.

YOURS, ON YOUR IPHONE
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Works offline; AI is the only feature that needs the internet
• CSV export and PDF collection summary with photos
• Light and dark mode

name: ShiftMeIn Kiosk
description:
ShiftMeIn Kiosk turns an iPad at your workplace entrance into a shared time clock for your team.

How it works
• An employee enters their personal code on the kiosk.
• A quick face check confirms it is really them, so nobody clocks in for a colleague.
• The kiosk greets them and records the clock-in or clock-out in ShiftMeIn instantly.

Built for the door, not the desk
• Big, clear screens in English or Macedonian.
• Keeps working without internet: check-ins are stored on the iPad and sent when the connection returns.
• Dims itself when nobody is around and wakes on the first touch.
• Three modes, set from the ShiftMeIn dashboard: code and face, face only, or code only with no camera.

Privacy first
• Before the first photo, every employee sees on the kiosk what is captured, where it is kept and how to withdraw, and decides.
• Face data is used only to confirm the employee at the kiosk. It is never used for anything else and never shared.
• The manager can delete an employee's face data at any time; check-in photos are deleted automatically after 60 days.
• Data is stored on ShiftMeIn's servers in Germany (EU).

Requirements
ShiftMeIn Kiosk is for companies that use ShiftMeIn. An administrator pairs the iPad with an 8-digit code from the ShiftMeIn dashboard. To lock the iPad to the kiosk, use Guided Access or Single App Mode.

name: ShimGap: Door Shim Sizer
description:
ShimGap is for finish carpenters and handymen who need to turn visible door jamb openings into a rip list of standard shim thicknesses — unlike a generic calculator, because you tap gap marks on a door elevation and get the stack on the same screen.

HOW IT WORKS
• Map — tap hinge, strike, head, or sill marks on the door sketch. Slide the measured opening and see the shim stack (1/32" through 1/4") instantly.
• Cuts — rolled-up rip list by thickness, plus per-zone breakdown and saved door jobs.
• More — door label, swing, optional metric hint, privacy link.

Designed for on-site hanging: seed sample doors load on first launch, everything stays on-device, and there are no accounts or subscriptions.

Business model: Free. No in-app purchases, ads, or accounts.

name: ShipIt Courier Network
description:
Find independent couriers and share what you need to send with ShipIt Courier Network.

For customers:
- Search courier listings by location, service, vehicle or route.
- Explore service areas on the map.
- Sign in and describe your cargo, pickup and drop-off locations, timing and contact details.
- View the requests sent from your account.

For couriers:
- Create a listing with your services, vehicle and areas served.
- Submit your profile for review and keep your availability up to date.
- View requests matched to your listing and contact customers to discuss delivery.

ShipIt helps customers discover couriers. Sending a request does not book a delivery. Customers and independent couriers agree delivery details directly. Profiles marked as samples are examples, not available providers.

name: Shotcaller Espresso
description:
Shotcaller stops your espresso shot at the weight you want.

Pull the paddle as usual. Shotcaller reads your scale, watches the flow, predicts the moment to stop, and puts the machine into standby so the shot lands on your target. Then it wakes the machine again, ready for the next one.

Works with the La Marzocco Linea Micra and a Bookoo Themis Mini scale. Experimental: the Linea Mini R, and the Bookoo Themis Ultra, Acaia Lunar, Pyxis and Umbra, Varia Aku and Eureka Precisa scales.

BREW BY WEIGHT
- Set a target in grams and pull the paddle: the app only stops shots it saw start.
- The stop point is predicted from the live flow and corrected by a stop delay the app learns from your own confirmed shots.
- Shotcaller only reads the scale. It never tares it or runs its timer, so your scale behaves exactly as it does without the app.
- Every stop is confirmed by the machine before the app says so.

WORKS WITH YOUR PHONE LOCKED
- While your scale is on, Shotcaller stays connected to the machine and scale in the background, so a shot is stopped even when the phone is in your pocket or locked.
- A Live Activity shows weight, time and target on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
- A notification tells you how the shot finished.

A HOME FOR YOUR MACHINE
- Home shows a small 3D coffee corner, lit by the time of day, with your machine in the colour you choose.
- A clear line says whether brew by weight is ready, and what to do if it isn't (wake the scale, check the token, reconnect).
- Machine controls: power, steam on or off, steam level and brew temperature.
- Shot history with the final weight, time and how close it came to the target.

DEVICES
- Link one machine and one scale from the Devices page. Shotcaller connects straight from your phone; no hub or extra hardware.
- Signing in with your La Marzocco account is optional. It fetches your machine's token once, then signs out; your password isn't kept.

PRIVACY
Shotcaller collects no data. There are no accounts with us, no analytics and no ads. Your shots and settings stay on your iPhone.

Shotcaller works with your own machine. It stops a shot with the same standby command as the manufacturer's app, and it doesn't modify the machine or its firmware. Use it at your own risk.

Shotcaller is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by La Marzocco S.r.l., Bookoo, Acaia, Varia or Eureka. La Marzocco, Linea Micra, Linea Mini and Linea Mini R are trademarks of La Marzocco S.r.l.; Bookoo, Acaia, Varia, Eureka and their scale names are trademarks of their owners. They are used only to say which machines and scales Shotcaller works with.

name: ShouFro
description:
• Save a book with sheet size, folds, signatures, paper thickness, overhang, and turn-in
• One fold is 4 pages, two folds are 8, and three folds are 16
• Each fold halves the longer side of the sheet
• Turn a wanted page count into whole signatures and the blank slots left over
• Spine thickness is the sheet count times the thickness of one sheet
• Board width adds the overhang once; board height adds it at the head and the tail
• Case cloth covers two boards, the spine, and a turn-in on every side
• Round a waste percent up to the sheets you should buy
• Erase the local file from the manual

name: ShowFloor: Card Shows
description:
ShowFloor is the directory for sports card and trading card shows, listed by the people who run them.

COLLECTORS
• Browse upcoming shows by date, state and category: baseball, football, basketball, Pokémon, Magic, One Piece and more
• See dates, hours, admission, table counts and which vendors are confirmed
• Rate the shows you attend so the best ones rise to the top

ORGANIZERS
• List your show in five quick steps and upload your flyer
• Invite vendors with a link and approve table requests
• Build a reputation with collector ratings

VENDORS
• Request tables at upcoming shows and get listed as a confirmed vendor

ShowFloor is free. Report any review or listing from the ••• menu, and block users you don't want to see.

name: Signora
description:
A signature is a small piece of personal style. Signora is a calm, beautiful studio for designing yours.

CREATE
• Enter your name and choose a style, slant, stroke and flourish
• AI suggests a set of distinct concepts, and your iPhone draws each one from real typography
• Compare variations and keep your favorites

REFINE
• Change font, size, spacing, slant, stroke, baseline and width with live previews
• Drag, pinch and rotate on the canvas, with undo and redo
• Add vector flourishes: underlines, loops and finishing strokes
• Choose ink and background

PRACTICE
• Draw with a finger or Apple Pencil
• Trace a faint reference of your own design at any opacity
• Baseline, center, height and slant guides
• See your size, slant and stroke consistency over time

EXPORT
• PNG, transparent PNG, JPG and PDF
• Custom dimensions, padding and backgrounds
• Files are made only when you ask

AI STUDIO
• An advisor that knows the design in front of you, with suggestions you can apply in a tap
• Written design reports
AI runs only when you ask and suggests directions. Your iPhone does all the drawing.

YOURS, PRIVATELY
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Editing, practice and exports work offline

Signora creates creative designs. It does not authenticate signatures or establish legal identity. Please design only your own signature, or one you have permission to create.

name: Silent Night Sneak: Santa 3D
description:
It's Christmas Eve, the house is quiet... and Santa has a job to do!

Silent Night Sneak is a cozy 3D stealth puzzle where you guide Santa through sleeping homes to leave gifts under the tree – without waking anyone up. One wrong step and a dog barks, a cat meows or someone wakes up – and the Christmas surprise is ruined!

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag the joystick to sneak Santa from room to room.
• Plan your path past sleeping grown-ups, dogs and cats – every move counts.
• Stuck? Undo a move, rotate the camera or use a hint.
• Reach the Christmas tree, drop the presents and tiptoe out!

FEATURES
• 36 levels: 30 cozy houses plus 6 big multi-room houses
• December advent calendar – a new bonus level unlocks every day until Christmas
• Easy one-thumb joystick controls, made for one-handed portrait play
• Bite-sized levels – earn stars by solving each one in the fewest moves
• Charming 3D Christmas world with snow, lights and decorations
• Brain-teasing stealth puzzles that get trickier as you go
• Family friendly – fun for kids and grown-ups
• Play offline – no Wi-Fi needed

Can you deliver every present and keep the magic of Christmas alive? Put on the red suit and start sneaking!

Merry Christmas from a solo indie developer – thank you for playing!

name: SillSketch
description:
A measurement is easier to use when you can see exactly where it belongs. Start a drawing from a photo and enter measurements you have taken with a tape or another suitable tool.

Give the drawing a name, add a dimension such as 146 cm and drag the endpoints onto the corresponding edges. Keep several labels on one drawing and reopen it when you need the details again.

Prepare a marked image to share through iOS. Try the included window drawing before adding your own photo. SillSketch records values you enter; it does not calculate distances from a picture.

name: Sinoastra
description:
Sinoastra is an educational guide to Chinese sky culture—distinct from Western constellation atlases.

Discover the Three Enclosures (Purple Forbidden, Supreme Palace, Heavenly Market) and the Four Symbols (Azure Dragon, Vermilion Bird, White Tiger, Black Tortoise). Then explore all twenty-eight lunar mansions with bilingual names, classical citations, myth context, and calendar links.

FEATURES
• Atlas — browse enclosures and directional guardians with searchable entries
• Lodges — filter all 28 mansions by east, south, west, and north
• Almanac — connect selected solar terms to linked mansions
• Lore — read myths and classical treatise introductions
• Studio — favorites, study notes, reading progress, practice quiz, and language switch (English / 简体中文)

LEARNING FOCUS
Each entry combines a modern explanation with a classical note and source label, plus short myth and calendar sections. Visual glyphs and a night-sky interface help you remember directional groups.

PRIVACY & SCOPE
Favorites, notes, progress, quiz score, and language preference are stored only on your device. No account is required. Sinoastra is for cultural astronomy literacy—not fortune-telling, medical advice, or live sky tracking.

Whether you study East Asian history, enjoy rare cultural topics, or want a clearer map of China’s traditional sky, Sinoastra brings astronomy, myth, and calendar together in one reference app.

name: SiteAlbum: Photo Reports
description:
Turn site photos into a clear, branded handover report. SiteAlbum helps independent tradespeople, maintenance teams and small studios document their work and deliver a polished PDF from iPhone or iPad.

CAPTURE AND ORGANIZE
Create projects with client, address and summary details. Take photos or choose up to 20 images at a time. Group each record by area and before, progress, after or issue stage. Add captions and reversible freehand marks.

SHOW THE RESULT
Pair before and after images and prepare a handover checklist. Keep completed items and outstanding issues together so your report tells the whole story.

PUT YOUR BRAND ON EVERY PAGE
Add a company logo, name, contact details, accent color and footer. Generate paginated A4 or US Letter PDFs with photos, comparisons and checklist information, then share them or save to Files. Each saved report is a snapshot that stays unchanged when you edit a project later.

WORK OFFLINE
No account, ads, subscription, tracking or AI service. Export and restore a complete .sitealbum backup, including photos and saved reports. One paid download includes all current features.

English and Simplified Chinese interfaces. The illustrated sample project lets you explore the workflow before adding your own photos.

Imported image copies are optimized to a maximum dimension of 2400 pixels. Photo record dates show when they were added. SiteAlbum is a documentation tool; verify report details before handing them over.

name: SitterSheets
description:
Give your pet sitter the instructions you use at home. SitterSheet brings each pet’s food, portion sizes, feeding times and familiar routines onto one care sheet.

Keep separate profiles for your pets. Add a portrait, a photo of the food, where to find supplies, and the owner or veterinary contact you want a sitter to have.

When it is time to hand over care, choose the first and last day of the stay. Prepare a PDF and use the iPhone share sheet to save a copy or send it to the sitter you choose. Edit the profile for the next stay and generate a fresh sheet.

Profiles are kept on your iPhone. No account is required.

name: SMART EGLISE
description:
SMART EGLISE est la plateforme moderne tout-en-un pour l'administration et le suivi pastoral des églises, assemblées et communautés chrétiennes.

Fonctionnalités principales :
• Registre complet des fidèles : Gestion détaillée des membres, familles, départements et suivi des baptêmes.
• Pointage et cultes : Enregistrement rapide des présences lors des cultes et réunions, suivi statistique de l'affluence en temps réel.
• Gestion financière & projets : Suivi rigoureux et transparent des dîmes, offrandes, dépenses et cotisations de projets communautaires.
• Cartes de membre officielles : Génération et impression de cartes d'identification sécurisées avec QR Code.
• Annuaire & contacts : Communication fluide avec vos membres par appel direct et messagerie.

Accessible sur mobile et synchronisé en continu avec votre espace web sécurisé.

name: Smart Taxi
description:
Smart Taxi to aplikacja dla kierowcy taksówki, który przyjmuje zamówienia przez kod QR.

Klient skanuje kod w aucie, w recepcji pensjonatu albo na wizytówce, widzi Twoje wolne godziny i zamawia kurs. Ty dostajesz powiadomienie na telefon — razem z numerem klienta, miejscem odbioru i celem — i przyjmujesz kurs jednym dotknięciem.

CO ROBI APLIKACJA

• Nowe zamówienia — imię, telefon, skąd i dokąd, liczba osób, uwagi. Przyjmujesz albo odrzucasz.
• Powiadomienia o nowych kursach, także przy zamkniętej aplikacji.
• „Zajęty do" — przy przyjęciu wpisujesz, do której godziny jesteś zajęty. Te godziny znikają z wyboru u kolejnych klientów, więc dwa kursy nie nałożą się na siebie.
• Kalendarz dnia — wolne godziny, kursy przyjęte i blokady w jednej siatce. Dotknięciem wpisujesz kurs z telefonu albo blokujesz czas.
• Kurs zamówiony telefonicznie — wpisujesz go jednym przyciskiem i od razu blokuje kalendarz.
• Koniec pracy i przerwa — jednym przyciskiem przestajesz przyjmować zamówienia: do jutra, do wybranej godziny albo do odwołania.
• Cennik stałych tras — „Jarosławiec → lotnisko Gdańsk 350 zł". Klient widzi cenę, zanim zamówi, i rzadziej dzwoni z pytaniem.
• Historia kursów z przychodem według wpisanych cen.
• Kod QR do druku — generujesz go sam z panelu.

DLA KOGO

Dla kierowców i małych firm przewozowych, które mają system Smart Taxi. Login i hasło dostajesz przy uruchomieniu systemu — aplikacja nie zakłada kont i nie służy pasażerom do zamawiania przejazdów.

Pasażer niczego nie instaluje: skanuje kod QR i zamawia w przeglądarce, po polsku, angielsku albo niemiecku.

BEZ NIESPODZIANEK

Bez reklam, bez zakupów w aplikacji, bez śledzenia. Aplikacja nie prosi o dostęp do lokalizacji, kontaktów ani aparatu — jedyne uprawnienie to powiadomienia.

Pytania: kontakt@ujarek.com

name: Śmieci Raszyn
description:
When do the bins go out? Śmieci Raszyn shows the waste pickup schedule for your address in gmina Raszyn, Poland, and reminds you the evening before.

• All 15 schedules in the gmina: regions 1–11, 7A, 7B and three schedules for apartment buildings.
• Region by location: the app finds your street and you save your address once. From then on the schedule is always for home, even when you are at work.
• Reminders at 18:00 the day before each pickup, and two days before bulky pickups, because MZO only takes bookings until 12:00 the day before. They work offline.
• What goes where? A search covering 46 items, from batteries and medicines to polystyrene, rubble and Christmas trees.
• The PSZOK drop-off site in Nadarzyn: opening hours, limits, what to bring and how to get the resident card.
• Bottle deposits, the waste fee with the next due date, and drop-off points for batteries and medicines.

Schedules come from Gmina Raszyn's PDFs; if anything differs, the gmina's schedule applies. The app is not run by Gmina Raszyn or MZO Pruszków.

The app is in Polish and English, with no ads, no account and no tracking, and your saved address never leaves your phone.

name: Smoochie: Pet for Couples
description:
make a tiny pet for your person. they make one for you. only love keeps it glowing.

Smoochie is a pet for two. You design a little creature for your partner in secret: its name, its colour, its ears, a few little extras, and squeaks in your own voice. It lands on their phone as an egg to untie and crack.

Then it lives with them: on the Home Screen, on the Lock Screen, in StandBy and in the Dynamic Island. But only you can keep it glowing.

TEN WAYS TO SAY HI
Poke, smooch, flowers, head pat, squeeze, good morning, a love note with a photo, a balloon, hiii, and nighty night. One tap and it lands on their pet.

IGNORED? IT GETS GROSS
Radiant, happy, meh, scruffy… gremlin. Flies. Drool. A mushroom on its head. It never dies. It just gets gross, right there on their Lock Screen, until you send some love.

PLAY TOGETHER
• Rallies: answer within 10 seconds to stack up combos
• Squeeze together, live
• Daily wishes only you can grant
• A couple streak and a couple level
• Mystery eggs with surprise outfits

GROWING UP CUTE
Eggy, Bitty, Squish, Floof, Sparklefloof. Your pet grows with your love, and how you love shapes who it becomes.

TREATS AND OUTFITS
Earn sprinkles by sending love and spend them in the treat shop. No real-money purchases.

A SCRAPBOOK OF YOU TWO
Notes, photos, firsts and record rallies, kept in one place.

LOVE IN ONE PRESS
Send love from a widget, the Action Button or Control Center without opening the app. No signal? It sends when you're back.

JUST FOR THE TWO OF YOU
Sign in with Apple. No ads. No tracking. Notes, photos, voice squeaks, names and pet designs are end-to-end encrypted: only your two phones can open them, not even us. Download or delete everything any time.

Smoochie is for two iPhones: one for you, one for your person.

name: Smooth Talk: Stutter Practice
description:
Smooth Talk helps people who stutter practice comfortable, fluent speech.

DELAYED AUDITORY FEEDBACK (DAF)
• Hear your own voice in your headphones with a 25–250 ms delay
• Optional pitch shift
• Live voice level ring

PACING
• Read along as each syllable lights up
• Adjust syllables per minute

TECHNIQUES
• Breathing, easy onset, light contact, stretch and slide, pausing

PROGRESS
• See your practice minutes this week

Microphone audio is played back in real time only — never recorded, stored or sent. Headphones required for DAF. A practice aid, not a substitute for speech therapy. No ads, no sign-in.

name: SMPTESwitch Live
description:
SMPTESwitch Live puts your show in every crew member's hand. It connects over Wi-Fi to SMPTESwitch on the Mac — the timecode-driven camera switcher for Blackmagic ATEM — and shows each person exactly what they need, live.

CAMERA OPS
• Pick your camera from every input on the switcher
• One clear screen: black on standby, green in preview, red when you're live
• Big countdowns to your next shot, to going live, and to the cut away
• The director's note for every shot, so you know what to frame
• The next cuts in the shot list, with LIVE, PVW and YOUR SHOT tags
• Vibrates when you go into preview and when you go live

LIGHTING, AUDIO, SFX / PYRO
• Large, easy-to-read timecode, with rolling or stopped status
• The current song, time left, and what's next in the set
• Request a Show Stop with a 3-second hold — it goes straight to the Stage Manager

STAGE MANAGER
• Timecode, current song and next song
• Approve or decline Show Stop requests the moment they come in
• Call a Show Stop directly, and clear it when you're ready

SHOW STOP
When a Show Stop is called, SMPTESwitch fades the ATEM to black, blacks out the visuals, and stops audio and timecode — and every phone flashes red with "Show Stop. Please stand by." Clear it from the Stage Manager's phone, the Mac or a Stream Deck.

BUILT FOR THE ROAD
• Finds the Mac on the show Wi-Fi by itself, or connect by IP address
• Reconnects on its own if the Wi-Fi drops, and warns you while it does
• Keeps the screen awake for the whole show
• Works on iPhone and iPad

Requires SMPTESwitch running on a Mac on the same network.

Support: www.hazeproductions.com.au/smpteswitch-live

By HAZE Productions.

name: Snorkle: Snore Tracker
description:
Do you snore? How much, and when? Snorkle finds out while you sleep, completely free and completely private.

Tap Start Sleep, lock your iPhone and put it on the nightstand. In the morning you get a clear report: your Snore Score, how long and how loudly you snored, a timeline of the night and short clips you can listen back to.

FREE
No account. No ads. No subscriptions or in-app purchases. Every feature is included.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Sound is analyzed on your iPhone using Apple's on-device sound recognition. Nothing is uploaded, ever. No sign-in, no tracking, no analytics.

LIGHT ON BATTERY AND STORAGE
Snorkle only wakes its detector when the room gets louder, and keeps just a few seconds of each snore. A whole night of data takes a few kilobytes.

FIND WHAT HELPS
Tag your nights with factors such as alcohol, a late meal, congestion, sleeping on your back, nasal strips or mouth tape. Insights show which ones change your score.

BUILT FOR THE LATEST iOS
• Live Activity and Dynamic Island while you sleep, stop right from the Lock Screen
• Control Center button and Siri: "Good night Snorkle"
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with last night's score
• Optional fall-asleep delay and adjustable sensitivity
• Gentle bedtime and wake-up chimes

Snorkle is not a medical device and does not diagnose sleep apnea or any other condition. If you are worried about loud snoring or pauses in breathing, please talk to a doctor.

name: Song Pairs
description:
Song Pairs is a pairs game for your ears. Instead of pictures you flip short song snippets – and have to remember which hit hides behind which card. Whoever finds the most pairs wins.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a card, listen to the snippet, find its partner
• If both snippets belong to the same song, the pair is yours
• For 2 to 8 players or teams on one iPhone – perfect for parties, family evenings and game nights

ONLINE 1 VS 1
• Play against friends on their own phone – wherever they are
• Create a game, show the QR code or send the 6-character code – done
• Both of you hear every snippet, you take turns flipping cards
• Then go straight into the rematch

REAL HITS, NOT STOCK MUSIC
• Ready-made song packs: classics mix, 80s, 90s, 2000s and German hits
• Your own lists: search songs, add them and choose the snippet yourself
• Music plays as 30-second previews from Deezer or Apple Music – free, no account, no subscription
• After each round, “Songs in this round” takes you to the full song on the music service

NO LOADING BREAKS
When a game starts, Song Pairs preloads every snippet. No waiting during the game.

SHARE AND SUGGEST LISTS
Share your list with friends via a code. Our server only stores titles, artists and service IDs, never audio files. Especially good lists can be suggested as a song pack for everyone – we review every suggestion.

FAIR AND PRIVATE
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your lists stay on your device
• Online games are deleted from the server after 24 hours at the latest

Song Pairs is an independent project and is not affiliated with Deezer or Apple.

name: SOS Field
description:
SOS Field is the work app for the field crews of SOS Restoration, a water and fire damage restoration company in Los Angeles. It is only for SOS Restoration employees: the office gives each worker a sign-in.

- Time clock: clock in and out at the job. The clock works at the company's job sites, recent leads and warehouses, so hours are recorded where the work happens.
- Your hours: the week's worked time, breaks and every punch.
- Job photos: take photos and videos and file them to the right job, even without signal. Each photo is stamped with where it was taken.
- Shift GPS: while you are clocked in, the office sees your work route. It pauses on breaks and stops at clock-out.
- Customer calls: answer the company's calls on your phone.
- English and Spanish.

name: Sosa · Creator Space
description:
Sosa is the private workspace for creators managed by SoSa Consulting.

By invitation from your agency, everything is in one place:

• Contract: read it and sign it online in one minute. Your signed copy stays in your space.
• Earnings: your revenue and commissions, month by month.
• Weekly plan: the content to shoot this week and the scripts prepared by the agency, with clear deadlines.
• Secure delivery: send your photos and videos to your agency straight from your library or camera.
• Feedback: see what is approved and what to redo.
• Content limits: set what you are comfortable with, and change it anytime.
• Notifications: know right away when your agency needs you.

Your space is protected: encrypted password, Face ID and a personal Sosa code. You can delete your account anytime from the app.

Access is limited to creators managed by SoSa Consulting.

name: SP Car Remote
description:
SP Remote puts your car's screens and controls on your phone.

Set the cabin before you get in, warm the seats for your passengers, close a window you
left open, or pick the music from the back seat. SP Remote talks to your car over its own
Wi-Fi when you are close, and over the internet when you are not.

PAIR ONCE
On the centre screen, open the Dashcam panel, turn on Share to phone and Phone remote, and
scan the code. That is the whole setup — no account, no sign-up, no password. The car asks
once whether to allow your phone.

CLIMATE AND CABIN, THE WAY THE CAR SHOWS THEM
Temperature, fan, A/C, auto, fast cool and fast heat sit at the top; open the card for
defrost, airflow, air intake, purifier and the rest. Seat heating, ventilation and massage
are set by tapping the seats on a picture of your own car, and the steering wheel heats
the same way. Windows, doors, mirrors, trunk and charging port are there too, with a
question before anything opens.

THE CAR'S SCREENS, ON YOURS
See the centre screen, the strip and the rear screen live, and tap or swipe on them as if
you were in the car. Turn the phone sideways for the full screen.

MUSIC, VOLUME AND WHERE TO GO
Play, pause and skip, drag the volume, and open the car's apps. Type a place or paste a
map link and the car starts the route.

SIRI
"Hey Siri, SP Remote front defrost." "Hey Siri, tell SP Remote" — then say what you want in
your own words. "Hey Siri, SP Remote car status" reads the climate, seats and lights back
to you. Your favourite commands can go on the Home Screen as shortcuts.

PRIVACY
There is no account and no server of ours. Your phone talks to your car and to nothing
else. No analytics, no crash reporting, no advertising, no tracking, and no third-party
SDKs.

SAFETY
SP Remote is for passengers, and for when the car is parked. The driver should never use
a phone while driving.

REQUIREMENTS
• An Avatr or Deepal vehicle with a Huawei HarmonyOS cockpit.
• SP Avatr Kit on the centre screen, with Phone remote turned on — that is what answers
  this app. Setup is at the support page below.
• Which controls work depends on the car's software; the app shows only what your car
  accepts and greys out the rest.

This app is an independent companion for the vehicle. It is not produced, endorsed or
supported by Avatr, Changan, Huawei, or any vehicle manufacturer. All trademarks belong to
their owners.

Support: https://dsokpheang.github.io/sp_avatr_support/support/remote/

name: SPACED U
description:
SPACED — Smarter Campus Parking

Finding parking on campus shouldn't be the hardest part of your day.

SPACED helps University of Rhode Island students make smarter parking decisions by bringing campus destinations, estimated parking conditions, and travel times together in one easy-to-use app.

FIND YOUR BEST PARKING OPTION

Choose where you're headed on campus and explore recommended parking lots based on your destination, parking access, estimated demand, and travel time.

PLAN AHEAD WITH SPACED METERS

Explore how parking demand typically changes throughout the day. Compare estimated conditions across campus lots, starting at 6 AM, to help plan when and where to park.

COMPARE CAMPUS PARKING LOTS

View multiple parking options with estimated parking chances, occupancy ranges, and travel times, so you can make informed decisions before arriving.

NAVIGATE TO YOUR DESTINATION

Find popular URI buildings, choose your destination, and view parking options that fit your plans.

BUILT WITH STUDENTS IN MIND

SPACED is designed to make campus parking easier to understand, helping you spend less time circling and more time getting where you need to go.

Parking conditions and travel times are estimates and may change. Always follow posted parking signs, university regulations, and permit restrictions.

SPACED is an independent app and is not officially affiliated with or endorsed by the University of Rhode Island.

name: SpeakFlow
description:
SpeakFlow is a personal rehearsal studio for speakers, students, teachers, and video creators.
Organize and favorite scripts, or import TXT, RTF, and text-based PDF files. Start with included samples. Rehearse with adjustable text, automatic scrolling, mirror mode, and on-device voice follow. Practice reading aloud with estimated text matching and pace feedback. Record audio or video takes, review them, and export using the iOS share sheet. Prompts stay out of saved videos. Review practice history, compare sessions, and set goals.

name: Speed Shop
description:
Speed Shop هو تطبيقك للطلب والتوصيل السريع من أفضل المطاعم والأسواق والمتاجر في مدينتك، كلها في مكان واحد.

سواء كنت جائعاً وتريد وجبة ساخنة، أو تحتاج أغراض البيت من الماركت، أو منتجات العناية والكوزمتك، أو مستلزمات القرطاسية، يوصلها لك Speed Shop إلى باب بيتك.

ماذا يمكنك أن تفعل مع Speed Shop؟

• تصفح عشرات المتاجر: مطاعم، ماركت، تسوق، عناية وكوزمتك، ومكتبات وقرطاسية.
• ابحث بسهولة عن أي منتج أو وجبة أو متجر.
• شاهد الأسعار بالدينار العراقي بوضوح، مع العروض والخصومات المتوفرة.
• أضف ما تريد إلى السلة من متجر واحد واطلب بضغطة زر.
• حدد موقعك بدقة عبر GPS ليصل المندوب إلى عنوانك مباشرة.
• احفظ عناوينك لتطلب أسرع في المرة القادمة.
• تابع حالة طلبك من لحظة تأكيده حتى وصوله.

لماذا Speed Shop؟

• توصيل سريع: نعمل مع متاجر قريبة منك لنختصر وقت الانتظار.
• كل شيء في تطبيق واحد: لا حاجة للاتصال بكل متجر على حدة.
• واجهة عربية بسيطة: مصممة لتكون سهلة الاستخدام للجميع.
• خصوصيتك محفوظة: نستخدم موقعك فقط لتحديد عنوان التوصيل وحساب المسافة، ولا نشارك بياناتك لأغراض إعلانية.

ابدأ الآن:
1. حمّل التطبيق وأدخل اسمك ورقم هاتفك.
2. حدد موقع التوصيل.
3. اختر المتجر والمنتجات وأرسل طلبك.

Speed Shop، أسرع خدمة في منطقتك.

name: Spinel POS Pager
description:
Spinel POS Pager هو جهاز النداء الذكي لمطاعم Spinel POS.

بدل جهاز النداء التقليدي، امسح رمز QR المطبوع على فاتورتك، وتابع طلبك مباشرةً على شاشة القفل وفي الـ Dynamic Island.

• بدون تنزيل وبدون تسجيل: يفتح فورًا من الكاميرا
• حالة الطلب لحظة بلحظة: تم الطلب، قيد التحضير، جاهز
• عدّاد تنازلي للوقت المتوقع وعدد الطلبات قبلك
• عندما يجهز طلبك: يضيء جوالك ويرنّ ويهتز حتى لو كان مقفلًا
• يدعم العربية والإنجليزية

اجلس براحتك، وسننبّهك فور جاهزية طلبك.

name: SpotKeep-Find your things
description:
Know what you own. Remember where it belongs.

SpotKeep helps you keep a clear record of the things around your home. From everyday essentials to items you only need once in a while, give your belongings a familiar place and find them again with less searching.

BUILD YOUR COLLECTION

Add an item with just a name, then include a photo, category, location, and notes whenever you need them. Choose a built-in icon when a photo is not needed. Create your own categories and favorite the things you want close at hand.

ORGANIZE YOUR SPACES

Create rooms and the storage spots inside them, including drawers, shelves, cabinets, and boxes. Add photos and location notes to help you recognize the right place. Leave an item unassigned until you decide where it belongs.

FIND WHAT YOU NEED

Search item names, notes, categories, locations, and current borrowers. Filter your collection by room, category, favorites, loan status, or unassigned location. Sort by name, recently added, or recently updated.

REMEMBER WHAT MOVED

Move one item or select several items to move together. SpotKeep keeps a location history so you can see where each item has been and when its place changed.

KEEP TRACK OF WHAT YOU LEND

Record who borrowed an item, add an optional expected return date, and keep a note of anything worth remembering. Mark the item as returned and confirm where it belongs. Past loans remain available in its history.

LOOK AFTER YOUR BELONGINGS

Set a maintenance date for cleaning, servicing, or replacing a part. Choose a one-time plan or repeat it monthly, every three months, every six months, or yearly. Record completed care and let repeating plans calculate the next date from the completion date.

Due dates and overdue items appear inside the app. SpotKeep does not send notifications.

KEEP YOUR COLLECTION LOCAL

No account, ads, analytics, or built-in cloud sync. Your collection is stored on your device, and the inventory features work offline. Export a backup with your photos and histories, then restore it when needed. Restoring replaces the current collection, so keep a backup before making that change or uninstalling the app.

Start with an empty collection or explore clearly labeled sample items. Make a little room for order with SpotKeep.

name: sqsl Shuffler
description:
sqsl Shuffler plays the audio files in a folder in random order. Choose a folder with audio samples, field recordings, or textures, and it keeps drawing from it. Each file plays to its end, then the next one starts.

It works as an AUv3 instrument in your host app (also as a standalone app).

HOW IT PLAYS
• Every file plays once before the folder is reshuffled.
• Up to five playheads play files in parallel and overlap freely.
• Lowering the playhead count lets the current files finish; raising it starts new ones right away.
• Playback follows the host's transport: press play and new files start; stop and they stop.

PARAMETERS
• PITCH: varispeed from two octaves down to one octave up (octave up is not available in "stream from disk" mode).
• DENSITY: the chance that a file is heard. Files that miss play silently for their full length, leaving gaps that follow the material.
• REPEAT: the chance that the same file plays again right away.
• HEADS: how many files play at the same time, from 1 to 5.
• REVERSE: the chance that a file plays backwards (memory mode only).

LOAD TO MEMORY OR STREAM FROM DISK
• Memory mode decodes files for instant starts, reverse playback and the full pitch range. Set a maximum file length (1, 3 or 10 minutes) to leave long files out.
• Stream mode plays long recordings straight from disk. Pitch then ranges from the original speed down to two octaves below.

FILES AND PRESETS
• Reads WAV, AIFF, CAF, MP3, AAC/M4A, FLAC and more.
• Works with folders in Files, on external drives and in iCloud Drive.
• Presets store the folder, controls and the loading settings.

STANDALONE APP
Plays right away without a transport and keeps playing in the background. Its presets are separate from the plugin's.

name: Stamp Bud
description:
Tap the Stamp Bud sticker or scan the QR code on your table and the café opens on your phone: no app to download, no account to make.

• See the menu, with prices, photos and what is sold out today
• Get the guest Wi-Fi password and copy it in one tap
• Tell the owner how your visit went: stars, a few highlights and a comment that goes straight to them
• Join the café's stamp card and collect stamps toward free treats, and add the card to Apple Wallet
• Find the way there or call, and see whether it is open right now

Stamp Bud speaks English and Nepali, and every café looks like itself, in its own colours.

On iPhone, tapping a Stamp Bud sticker opens the Stamp Bud App Clip instantly. Install the full app to keep the places you visit and open them by the code printed under the QR.

Your feedback is private to the owner. If you would also like to post on Google, every rating gets the same optional button, and no reward is ever tied to a review.

Stamp Bud is made in Bhaktapur, Nepal, by Antbytelabs.

name: Star – AR Sky Viewer
description:
Discover the sky around you with Star – AR Sky Viewer.

Point your iPhone or iPad toward the sky and explore stars, constellations, the Sun, the Moon and planets in augmented reality. Move your device to look around, with celestial objects placed in the world around you.

EXPLORE THE SKY
See constellation lines and star names, follow the daily paths of the Sun, Moon and planets, and explore how the sky changes through the seasons.

CHOOSE YOUR TIME AND PLACE
View the sky from your current location or enter coordinates manually. Select a different date and time to explore past and future skies.

MAKE IT YOURS
Adjust line thickness and text size independently. Choose which sky layers to display and add dark backgrounds behind labels for easier reading.

LOOK BEYOND THE VIEW
Check direction, altitude, rise and set times in the numerical view. Compare the Sun's summer and winter solstice paths and explore an Earth and time-zone visualization.

CAPTURE YOUR DISCOVERIES
Save a photo of your AR sky view, or switch off the camera background to explore against a dark sky.

No account required.

Augmented reality requires a compatible iPhone or iPad and camera access. Use location access for automatic positioning, or set your observing location manually.

name: Station Talk
description:
Station Talk helps travellers and railway station staff understand each other at the ticket counter, at the gate or on the platform.

• Hold to talk: speak, release, and the translation appears in large text. Replay reads it aloud.
• Common phrases for toilets, platforms, train times, tickets, fares, exits, refunds, sleeper berths and lost items translate instantly, even without internet.
• Type a message when the station is too noisy to speak.
• Staff side in Thai, with directions, numbers and quick replies.
• Emergency sheet with Ambulance 1669 and Police 191 call buttons and ready-made requests to station staff.
• Two iPads: pair a traveller iPad with a staff iPad directly over Bluetooth and peer-to-peer Wi-Fi. Encrypted, no router needed.
• One iPad: use one iPad together, with the traveller and staff panels side by side.
• Report a message or block a device at any time.

Languages: Thai, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Hindi, Russian, French and German.

For iPad only. No account or sign-in. Speech and typed-message translation need an internet connection; built-in phrases do not.

Machine translation can be wrong. For urgent or medical matters, ask staff in person or call emergency services. Station Talk is not an emergency service.

Privacy: speech and text are sent to Voyiro's own servers only to translate them. Audio samples are off by default. No ads, no tracking.

name: Statuette: Movie Awards
description:
Explore every Oscar winner and nominee since 1929, test your knowledge with quizzes and play fun game modes with friends.

EVERY CEREMONY, EVERY WINNER
Explore all 98 ceremonies from 1929 to today. See the winners and nominees of every major category, from Best Picture and the acting awards to screenplay, music and visual effects. Open any film to see all of its nominations and wins, or tap an actor or director to see their full awards story. Search by film, person or year to find anything in seconds.

A TIMELINE OF FILM HISTORY
Move through the decades on the ceremony timeline and stop on any year to see what won, which film led the night and how many awards it took home.

QUIZZES FOR EVERY FAN
Play the daily quiz: five new questions every day, the same for everyone. Keep your daily streak alive and see how far you can go.
Choose a quiz mode: Best Picture, Directors, Leading Roles or Guess the Year.
Try Winning Streak: no clock, just keep answering until your first mistake.
Every answer comes with a short fact about the film, so you learn something new each round.

GUESS THE WINNERS
Pick a past ceremony, choose who you think won in each category, then open the envelopes one by one to see how many you got right.

PLAY WITH A FRIEND
Two players, one phone, no internet needed. Pass the phone and play with a friend: guess the actor or director from clues in Who Am I?, build your own dream ceremony and compare it with the real night, or bid a virtual budget on nominees in the auction. No real money is involved. Perfect for a watch party, a road trip or a night in. Prefer to play along while you watch? Fill in an awards night bingo card.

YOUR BEST PICTURE COLLECTION
Tick off every Best Picture winner you have watched and watch your progress grow. Save the whole list as an image or share your progress card with friends.

YOUR TOP 5
Pick your five favourite films from the winners or from every film ever nominated, put them in order and share them as a beautiful card for your story.

MAKE AN AWARD
Put a name under the statuette, choose a category like Best Friend of the Year and share a card made just for someone special.

LEVELS AND BADGES
Earn experience with every quiz, climb from Newcomer to Legend and unlock badges as you play and watch.

RECORDS AND STATS
See the most awarded and most nominated films and people of all time, and follow your own quiz stats.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
No account and no sign up. Everything works offline and stays on your phone.

Statuette: Movie Awards is an independent fan app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences. Oscar and Academy Awards are trademarks of the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, used here only to describe the historical facts in the app.

name: Stay Gate
seller_name: CLIENT CARE SOLUTIONS FOR TOURISM MANAGEMENT AND MARKETING
description:
StayGate is the easy way to book a day out or a place to work.

Day use
Spend a full day at a hotel, resort or club pool, on the beach, in a day room or at the spa. Choose the day, the time and the number of adults and children, and see the full price before you book.

Coworking
Book a desk, a shared space or a meeting room by the hour, day, week or month. See which hours are free and book what suits you.

Also on StayGate
Chalets and furnished apartments by the night, week, month or year, and apartments for monthly rent with a free viewing.

How it works
1. Search by country, city, date or what is near you, and sort by price.
2. Pick your date in the calendar, which shows free and booked days.
3. Confirm your booking with a code we send you.
4. Get your booking number and arrival code, then pay at the place.

Why StayGate
• No online payment: you pay at the place.
• The price is clear before you book.
• Follow your bookings under My bookings and rate your visit afterwards.
• In Arabic and English, in light and dark mode.

name: Step-Free Seoul – Lift Exits
description:
Want to get in and out of the Seoul subway without stairs? Step-Free Seoul shows you which exits have elevators and escalators.
Useful with a wheelchair or stroller, heavy luggage, or when stairs are hard on your knees.

name: StillFlow
description:
Make room for a quiet moment. StillFlow guides short breathing practices with a clear animated rhythm, optional sound cues and haptics.
Choose a duration, breathing pattern and everyday moment, or create a rhythm of your own. Record how you feel afterward, add a note, and review your practice in Journal and Insights.
Your records stay on your device. No account or login is required, and core features work offline. Export a JSON backup, restore your records, create a PDF report or delete local data in Settings.
Clearly marked sample entries help you explore the app and can be removed. Designed for everyday relaxation and personal reflection; not for medical diagnosis or treatment. Breathe comfortably and stop if you feel dizzy or uncomfortable.

name: STILLSHOT: Urban Sniper
description:
Take the rooftop. Read the wind. Make the shot count.

STILLSHOT is a story-driven sniper game set in a living city. Watch the crowd, find your target in the scope, hold your breath and squeeze. Miss, and they run.

STORY - 12 chapters across three acts. Afternoon streets, a harbor at dusk, a rain-soaked city at night. Every target has a dossier: study it, then find them in the crowd.

CONTRACTS - open maps with four targets, five challenges each, and multiple perches. Move between rooftops and plan your route.

OPS - Bounty hunts, Last Stand waves, a new Daily target every day, and a firing Range.

FEEL EVERY SHOT
- Real bullet drop and wind
- Hold-breath steadying and variable zoom
- Slow-motion bullet cam on the finishing shot
- Thermal sight on night missions
- Panicking crowds and fleeing targets

THE ARMORY
Three rifles and five upgrades: stability, breath control, fast bolt, ballistic computer and suppressor.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Touch controls, plus keyboard and mouse, and gamepad support.

Fully offline. No account. No data collected.

name: StockRuta — Pedidos y rutas
description:
StockRuta es el sistema de un negocio que vende y reparte: pulperías, distribuidoras, restaurantes y locales de mostrador.

TOMÁ EL PEDIDO DONDE ESTÉS.
· El dueño lo carga desde el panel y el repartidor en la puerta del cliente.
· Tu catálogo público queda en un enlace: el cliente arma su pedido sin instalar nada.

ARMÁ LA RUTA Y SEGÚILA
