· Agrupá los pedidos del día, asígnalos a una camioneta y mira el avance parada por parada.
· El repartidor marca la entrega con firma y foto, y lo que no se entregó vuelve a bodega.

COBRÁ Y FACTURÁ COMO MANDA EL SAR.
· Factura con CAI, correlativo y rango, con el aviso cuando se están por acabar los números.
· Proforma para el cliente que no pide factura.
· El saldo de cada cliente, lo que debe y desde cuándo.

LA BODEGA CUADRADA
· Existencias por bodega y por camioneta, con lo apartado de cada pedido.
· Fecha de vencimiento con aviso de lo que está por vencer.
· Carga la lista de productos desde una planilla y actualízala igual.

MOSTRADOR Y RESTAURANTE
· Caja con arqueo de turno, lector de códigos de barras y balanza.
· Mesas, comanda a la cocina y la cuenta que se cobra en el salón.

LAS CUENTAS DEL DÍA, EXPLICADAS
· Qué se vendió, qué deja ganancia, a quién hay que cobrarle y qué hay que reponer.

Todo en lempiras y en español de Honduras.

Las cuentas las entrega StockRuta al dar de alta el negocio; el dueño crea las de su equipo.

name: Stoppy: Rolling Ball Puzzle
description:
Stoppy is a rolling ball puzzle game: swipe, and he rolls until something stops him. He has no brakes, so the walls are your brakes. Plan each roll and get him to the finish.

It's the rule of the classic ice-sliding puzzles, with paint, stairs and crates added. Each world brings new pieces:
• Paint Yard: roll through paint to take its color. Jelly gates only let their own color through, and water washes the paint off. Red is heavy: a red ball smashes cracked blocks.
• Bounce Street: blue is bouncy, so a blue ball hops over hurdles. Red and blue make purple, which does both.
• Uptown: the boards rise in platforms. Stairs are the only way up, and rolling off an edge drops him a floor.
• The Docks: grab the glove to shove wooden crates. A crate slides until something stops it, and one pushed into a pothole fills it.
• Prickle Park: spiky Prickles roll around on their own. Touch one and you lose a life, so wait for a gap.

Mind the potholes. Each fall costs a life, and you have three per level.

50 puzzles in five worlds
Every board is a small logic puzzle with no dead ends: wherever you've rolled, you can still win. Finish in the fewest moves for three stars. On the first level, dots show where each swipe will take him.

A fresh daily puzzle
Every player gets the same daily puzzle. Mondays are gentle and Sundays are tough: a quick brain teaser at the start of the week, a proper logic puzzle by the end. Keep your streak going and share how you did.

Challenges
Random boards from the worlds you've finished, against the clock and with no hints.

Awards and a wardrobe
Collect 25 awards and unlock hats, glasses and trails for Stoppy as you play. Nothing is for sale.

Stuck? You earn points as you play, and points pay for hints that show your next move. You get three undos a game, and if you'd rather tap than swipe, turn on the arrow buttons in the game's settings.

Stoppy plays offline, so you don't need Wi-Fi. There are no ads, no in-app purchases and no sign-in, and your progress stays on your iPhone or iPad.

Questions or ideas? Write to support@propereleven.com

name: Story: A Sound Journal
description:
I’ve been making recordings on my travels for years. Story is a personal travel journal you can listen to. These six recordings are the first selection from that collection. I’ll continue adding new recordings and illustrations in future updates.

This first collection includes a river in Western Australia, rain in Changsha and an afternoon in a Singapore classroom. Each recording has a location, a year and an animated illustration. The recording from Changsha contains fifty minutes of rain.

Choose a recording and let it loop, even with the screen locked. Set a sleep timer for 25, 45 or 60 minutes, or keep listening without a limit. Pause and the timer waits for you. The last ten seconds gently fade into silence. The current scene appears on your Lock Screen.

On iPhone Duo, rest the phone in landscape to watch the waveform on the cover display. Open it for a full-screen player or a playlist beside your recording. Rotate the open phone to put the playlist below the scene.

All six recordings are included. Listen offline, without an account or ads. Choose English or Simplified Chinese in Settings.

name: StoryGram: Rate & Get Rated
description:
StoryGram is where your stories get scored. Post a photo or video, and friends rate it from 1 to 100. No guessing what people think – you'll see it.

RATE ANY STORY, 1 TO 100
Swipe the dial, lock in your score, and see the average update live.

SEE HOW PEOPLE RATE YOU
Your score card shows your average, total ratings and how you're trending this week.

REELS WITH REAL SCORES
Watch reels, rate them and find what's actually hot, not just what's loud.

CLIMB THE WEEKLY TOP 10
The best-rated reels win the week. New week, new chance.

LEVEL UP FROM ROOKIE TO LEGEND
Every rating you earn counts toward your creator level.

MAKE STORIES INTERACTIVE
Add polls, questions, sliders and countdowns.

KNOW WHO LOVED YOUR STORY
Ratings, likes, comments and new followers, all in one place.

CHAT WITH FRIENDS
Send messages, photos and voice notes, and reply to stories.

YOUR PROFILE, YOUR WAY
Add a bio, up to 3 links and a grid of your best-rated moments.

SAFE BY DESIGN
Report or block anyone in two taps. Private accounts. Reports are reviewed by our team.

Sign in with Apple or Google in seconds.

Questions? support@storygramapp.com
Terms: https://storygramapp.com/terms
Privacy: https://storygramapp.com/privacy

name: StoryStitch
description:
StoryStitch turns your photos into a collage made for a 9:16 Story.

Pick up to 8 photos, and StoryStitch finds the faces and subjects in them, suggests layouts that suit your photos, and crops each one so the important part stays in frame. Your collage is ready in seconds, and you can change as much or as little as you like.

MADE FOR STORIES
• Layouts for 1 to 8 photos: grids, mosaics, diagonal splits, filmstrips, scattered prints, Polaroids, arches, circles, hearts and stars
• Smart cropping that keeps faces and subjects in view
• Every collage exports at full Story size, 1080 × 1920
• Share straight from your phone, or save to Photos

MAKE IT YOURS
• Drag to swap photos, and pinch to zoom
• Choose colors, spacing and rounded corners
• Edit any layout: move lines, split cells, reshape them or move photos freely

YOUR PHOTOS STAY ON YOUR PHONE
Finding subjects and making your collage all happen on your device. Your photos are never uploaded.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
You can make, edit and share collages without signing up. A free account is optional, and only keeps your own layouts for next time.

name: Stream24
description:
Stream24 brings your Studio camera companion and nearby file sharing together on iPhone.

CAMERA FOR STREAM24 STUDIO
Find your Studio Mac on the local network, choose it, and use your iPhone as a camera. Switch cameras, adjust zoom and focus, and mute audio from the live view. Camera quality and connected-phone limits depend on your Stream24 plan and supported hardware, with up to 4K on eligible plans.

SHARE NEARBY
Send photos and videos to another device running Stream24 Share on your local network. Transfers travel directly between devices using encrypted connections, without uploading your files to Stream24's servers. See nearby devices, track transfers, and browse what you have received.

ONE APP, ONE ACCOUNT
Move between Home, File Sharing, Camera and Profile from one menu. Sign in with your Stream24 account using password, Google or Apple. File sharing is free on every Stream24 plan, including Free. A Stream24 account is required.

WHAT YOU NEED
An iPhone running iOS 17 or later. Nearby sharing requires another compatible device running Stream24 Share and local-network access. Camera Mode requires Stream24 Studio on a compatible Mac. Photos, camera and microphone permissions are requested when needed.

This iPhone app does not provide standalone multistreaming.

name: StretchPulse
description:
StretchPulse keeps stretch diagrams and breath pacing on your iPhone — no account and no cloud required.

WHAT YOU GET
- Static diagrams and frame-by-frame demos for desk, neck, shoulders, spine, hips, legs, and full-body mobility
- A breath lamp that helps you keep an even inhale/exhale tempo while you stretch
- Custom stretch plans with optional local reminders at a fixed time you choose
- A Studio home with an on-device clock and today’s local session counts
- Favorites, session log, and streak counters stored only on device
- Bundled offline SPST archive powering cue tables, breath timing LUTs, and diagram metadata

HOW TO USE
1. Open Atlas and pick a stretch, or start a plan from Studio / Plans
2. Follow the diagram animation and the breath lamp
3. Optionally enable a reminder on a plan (permission is requested only then)

IMPORTANT
StretchPulse provides general educational fitness content for healthy adults. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent disease. Stop if you feel pain and consult a clinician when needed.

name: Sudoku Atlas
description:
숫자에 집중하는 시간, Sudoku Atlas

차분한 화면에서 스도쿠를 풀고, 전 세계 플레이어와 기록과 이야기를 나누세요.

• 네 단계의 난이도
쉬움·보통·어려움·전문가 퍼즐을 플레이하세요. 메모, 힌트, 되돌리기, 지우기, 일시정지와 이어하기를 지원합니다. 혼자 하는 퍼즐은 인터넷 연결 없이도 즐길 수 있습니다.

• 글로벌·국가별 랭킹
계정으로 로그인해 온라인 랭킹 퍼즐에 도전하세요. 완료한 퍼즐의 결과를 서버에서 검증하며, 전체 플레이어 또는 선택한 국가의 순위를 볼 수 있습니다. 국가는 가입 시 직접 선택합니다.

• 함께하는 커뮤니티
자유 이야기, 질문, 풀이 팁, 오늘의 성취를 공유하세요. 게시글에 사진을 최대 10장 첨부하고, 수정할 때 사진을 추가하거나 삭제할 수 있습니다. 댓글과 공감, 검색도 지원합니다.

• 글로벌·국가별 라운지
같은 관심사를 가진 플레이어와 대화하세요. 게시글·댓글·메시지 신고와 사용자 차단 기능을 제공합니다.

한국어와 영어를 지원합니다. 온라인 랭킹·커뮤니티·채팅에는 계정과 인터넷 연결이 필요합니다. 계정과 서버 기록은 앱의 나 탭에서 삭제할 수 있습니다.

name: Sum-O
description:
Sum-O is a flash anzan game set on a sumo dohyo. Numbers appear for a moment. Add them in your head, then enter the total. Answer quickly and your wrestler pushes forward. Hesitate, and the match slips away.

Flash anzan is mental arithmetic trained with a Japanese abacus. Sum-O keeps that practice short, visual, and easy to repeat.

SOLO TRAINING
Pick 1 to 4 digits and a round of 3, 5, or 7 numbers. Play at your own pace and build speed one bout at a time.

GHOST MATCH
Win a round and save it under your name. Later, race that saved run. The ghost plays back the pace of a real attempt stored on this device, so you can chase your own record or a record left by someone else who played here.

LEARN THE ABACUS
New to the abacus or to flash anzan? Three illustrated lessons cover the beads, carrying numbers, and how a match works. A guided practice round walks you through the controls before you step onto the dohyo.

Sum-O stays on your device. There is no account, and saved ghost records are not uploaded.

name: Swapfume
description:
Swapfume is a small, friendly community for swapping perfume. Trade samples, decants and full bottles with fellow fragrance lovers in the United States. No money, ever: just generosity and good packing.

HOW IT WORKS
• List what you own and mark what you'd trade.
• Add the perfumes you're hoping to find to your wishlist.
• Swapfume finds two-way matches: people who have what you want and want what you have.
• Propose a swap. Offer several samples for one rarer decant if you like.
• Ship by mail, or meet in person if you're within 20 miles of each other.
• Confirm when your package arrives, then review each other.

A CATALOG MADE FOR PERFUME LOVERS
• Thousands of perfumes from designer, niche, Middle Eastern and classic houses.
• Top, heart and base notes, perfumers and scent families.
• Member reviews: stars, longevity, sillage, best seasons and time of day.
• Suggest a missing perfume or a correction, and add bottle photos.

SHARE YOUR SWAP SHELF
Make a beautiful picture of what you're trading, in a style that matches your taste (floral, woody, amber & oud, fresh, gourmand and more), with ready-made text for Facebook, Instagram or Reddit.

GIFTS
Feeling generous? Give a perfume to another member with nothing asked in return.

PRIVATE AND SAFE
• Your address is shared only with your swap partner, and only after you both accept.
• Your ZIP code is never shown. Members see only a rounded distance and a blurred map of your general area.
• Reviews and completed-swap counts help you swap with confidence.
• Report or block anyone, any time.
• For adults 18 and over.

Swapfume is run by Octopup Studio. Questions? hello@swapfume.com

name: Sweep Sign Alarm: Move My Car
description:
Move my car before street cleaning, every time. Sweep Sign Alarm reads the parking sign where you parked and sets a real alarm that rings through Silent and Focus before the sweeper comes.

City schedules in other apps are often wrong. The sign at the curb is always right for that spot. So you take a photo of it, the app reads the times on your phone, and you confirm the rule with simple pickers: the days, the hours, which weeks of the month, and the season. No photo handy? Enter the times yourself.

Then it takes care of the rest:
- A real alarm before every sweep, with "I moved it" right on the alarm
- A final call 5 minutes before the start, unless you said you moved
- An optional reminder the night before
- A countdown widget for your Home Screen and Lock Screen
- A clear "Move your car now" screen if you park while the street is being cleaned

Made for real signs:
- Every-week signs get an alarm that repeats every week
- 1st & 3rd or 2nd & 4th week rules, like most signs in San Francisco, LA and Oakland: alarms are queued weeks ahead and topped up each time you open the app, and it tells you before the queue runs short
- Seasonal signs (April to November) and signs with two cleaning times
- Signs with several panels: two-hour parking, permits and tow-away rules are shown but never used as the cleaning time
- Alternate side signs in New York City: the app asks before it uses a plain No Parking time

Save the spots you use most, like Home or Work, and park again with one tap. Moved for this week? Tap "I moved my car" and the alarm for that sweep is gone, while next week's stays set. The moved screen offers "Parked at" your other saved signs, so the next alarm is one tap away. Holiday? Skip one sweep.

Works in any US city, because it reads the sign, not a city database. It works offline. No account, no ads, and no data collected: your photos and location never leave your phone.

Needs iOS 26 or later.

name: Sweetfang
description:
Mochi is the sweetest little fox-bunny in the meadow... but deep down lives FANG.

Sweetfang is a sweet-and-sour 3D platformer. Run, jump, glide and wall-jump across eighteen floating lands, from glowing meadows and a clockwork carnival to a glass glacier and a haunted graveyard. Collect Sugar Stars to fill your Sour Meter, and when it's full, turn into FANG MOCHI, a cute little monster who dashes through critters, belly-flops through cracked floors and shreds anything in the way. Then the world goes dark until the sweetness comes back.

EXPLORE
Eighteen hand-built lands, hidden paths, secret rooms and nineteen flasks of Ember Oil to find. Rest at lanterns to save your journey and travel between the lands you've lit.

MEET THE GANG
Salina, Addie, Panda, Alessi, Stella, Kodak and Regina all have something to say, with fully voiced conversations where you choose what Mochi asks.

FIGHT THE BOSSES
Face the creatures guarding the lairs, each with its own tricks to learn and beat.

PLAY THE SUGAR LOCKS
Sugar Locks hide treasure behind seven mini-games: match-3, bubble pop, mahjong pairs, lantern lights, oil pipes, memory and an echo game.

MAKE MOCHI YOURS
Spend Sugar on new moves, hats, glasses and fur colors at the lantern wardrobe.

Made for touch with an on-screen stick and buttons. PlayStation and Xbox controllers work too.

No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts and no data collected. Just the game.

name: TabiBiyori 旅日和
description:
Make room for a little journey with TabiBiyori.

Explore a growing collection of Japan itineraries, from one-day escapes to 14-day holidays. Read at your own pace and find a route that suits your next trip.

• Follow thoughtful daily routes with hotel departure and return points, places to visit and transport information.
• Discover real location photography with image credits and source links.
• Compare public transport and driving options, open maps and find car rentals for your departure city.
• See relevant hotel, ticket, experience, dining and rental booking links beside the places in your itinerary. Selected offers show provider-supplied starting prices.
• Search destinations, explore by trip length, save favorite articles and share ideas with your travel companions.
• Choose whether to receive a notification when a new article is published, and open the article from the notification.
• Read in Traditional Chinese, Japanese or English, with additional interface languages available.

No account is required. Previously loaded articles remain available offline; maps, fresh content, bookings and notifications need an internet connection.

Travel content is prepared with AI assistance and includes original and official sources. Opening hours, transport, prices and availability can change. Confirm dates, party details, rental vehicles, coverage and final prices with the relevant provider. Some links are affiliate links; we may earn a commission at no additional cost to you.

name: TabiMoji
description:
Make Japanese practice part of your day with TabiMoji.
Draw a fortune and practise writing the Japanese characters and sentences you discover. Listen to pronunciation examples as you learn, and revisit characters that need more practice.
Getting ready for a trip? Explore practical phrases for common travel situations and practise the ones you may need. Collect postcards as you complete your daily practice and follow your journey across Japan.
The app interface is available in English and Traditional Chinese.

name: Tabla: Kampüs Yemek Menüsü
description:
Tabla, kampüsteki herkes için günün yemekhane menüsünü tek bakışta gösterir.

BUGÜN NE VAR?
• Merkezi yemekhanenin öğle, KYK yurdunun kahvaltı ve akşam menüsü
• Kahvaltıda gramajlar ve yanına alabileceğin "Al Götür" ürünü
• Her yemeğin kalorisi, proteini, malzemeleri ve alerjen bilgisi (yemekhane paylaştıysa)
• Günün toplam kalorisi ve proteini
• Gün çubuğuyla haftanın menüsüne göz at, tek dokunuşla bugüne dön

KAMPÜS NE DİYOR?
• Hesap açmadan yemeğe 1–5 yıldız ver
• Yemekhanenin sakin mi kalabalık mı olduğunu bildir, başkalarının bildirdiğini gör
• Her cihaz bir günü bir kez oylar; puanlar adil kalır

SEVDİĞİN YEMEK GERİ GELİYOR
• Sevdiğin yemeklere kalp at
• 4–5 yıldız verdiğin günlere benzeyen bir menü çıkınca o sabah haber al (hesap gerekir)
• Hesabınla sevdiklerin telefon değiştirsen de kaybolmaz

SAĞLIK UYGULAMASIYLA UYUMLU
• Yediğin günün kalori ve protein değerlerini tek dokunuşla Apple Sağlık'a ekle

WIDGET'LAR VE APPLE WATCH
• Ana ekranda günün menüsü: küçük, orta, büyük ve iPad için ekstra büyük
• Kilit ekranında günün ana yemeği
• Apple Watch'ta günün menüsü ve komplikasyonlar

GaMed hesabın varsa Tabla'ya aynı hesapla girebilirsin.

{ ÖNEMLİ: Tabla bağımsız bir öğrenci projesidir. Hiçbir resmi kurum ya da kuruluşla bağlantısı yoktur; Gaziantep Üniversitesi, KYK ya da başka bir kamu kurumu tarafından geliştirilmemiş, desteklenmemiş veya onaylanmamıştır. }

Menüler yemekhanelerin herkese açık listelerinden alınır; son anda değişiklik olabilir.

name: TachoReader
seller_name: Gray Swan Intelligence Korlatolt Felelossegu Tarsasag
description:
NEW IN VERSION 1.1.0
• Refreshed graphics and a zoomable daily chart.
• An illustrated welcome guide explains how to connect the reader, insert the card and start reading.
• Support for nine languages.

TachoReader reads and analyses EU Gen2 (smart) tachograph driver cards on iPhone and iPad – for professional drivers and transport companies.

READING
• Full, digitally signed download with a USB-C-connected (CCID) smart card reader
• Saves standard .ddd files (Regulation (EU) 2016/799)
• Opens earlier .ddd downloads and merges several downloads into one history
• Never writes to the card

VISUAL ANALYSIS
• 24-hour activity timeline per day (driving, work, availability, rest)
• Weekly and fortnightly driving time against the 56 h and 90 h limits
• Daily driving time against the 9 h and 10 h limits
• Indicative Regulation (EC) 561/2006 check: breaks, daily and weekly rests, extended days – infringing periods highlighted
• An explanation for every infringement with your own numbers: what happened, how it would have complied, what you can do
• Working time analysis under Directive 2002/15/EC (60/48 hours per week, breaks, night work)
• Next shift planning: earliest restart, driving time left this week, weekly rest deadline
• Rules handbook with examples – also without a card
• Notes and infringement justifications (e.g. traffic jam – Article 12)
• Map: places of begin/end of work, GNSS positions every 3 hours, border crossings, loading operations (Gen2 v2)
• Vehicles with registration, VIN and odometer; events, faults and roadside controls
• PDF report and Excel-compatible CSV export

ARCHIVE AND PRIVACY
Every download is saved automatically to an archive on your own iPhone or iPad (folder of your choice), so your history remains available beyond the card’s storage period. The default archive is also accessible in the Files app (On My iPhone/iPad › TachoReader › Archívum). No account, no tracking.

LANGUAGES: Hungarian, English, German, Spanish, French, Slovak, Czech, Polish and Croatian.

DEMO MODE
Try the app without a card using the built-in sample data.

Requirements: iOS/iPadOS 18 or later; to read a card, a USB-C-equipped iPhone or iPad, a CCID-compatible USB-C-connected smart card reader and a Gen2 tachograph driver card.
TachoReader is an independent app and is not affiliated with the European Union or a public authority.
The analysis is indicative and does not replace the official control software in proceedings.

name: Tactico Lab
description:
Tuesday's session, start to finish.

Sunday night you open a half pitch, drop eight markers and four cones, draw the passing lanes for a rondo and the run for the overlap. You started from a template and changed three things. You add a line of instructions and save it next to last week's layouts. Then you build the plan: warm-up, rondo, overlap drill, small-sided game — in that order, each with its minutes.

Tuesday afternoon the packing checklist tells you what to put in the car: 12 cones, 2 goals, 8 balls, bibs. The quantities came from the plan; you bump the cones to 14 because one is always missing.

At 6 pm you press start. The countdown runs the first drill. A player turns up late, you pause. The rondo is going well, you add a minute. The overlap drill falls apart, you move on early. The timer notices none of your pauses and none of the time after a drill runs out, so the numbers it keeps are honest.

Wednesday morning the session is in Progress: when it started, when it finished, which drills were completed, how it adds up for the week and the month, how many days you've been on the grass. Export any diagram as an image and send it to the players before next time.

That's Tactico Lab: a pitch to draw on, a plan built from what you drew, a clock to run it, and a record of what happened. Full or half pitch, player markers, cones, goals, balls, movement and passing routes, built-in templates. Layouts, plans and history live on your phone. Haptics, optional practice reminders and a guided tutorial in Settings. No account, no internet, no purchases.

Built for coaches who plan on paper and lose the paper.

name: Tadaa: Gift Lists
description:
You make the gift list. Family picks from it. You never see what is taken or by whom.

Lists for birthdays, Christmas, weddings and new babies. Add what you would love: paste a link from any shop and Tadaa fills in the name, picture and price. Share one link with family and friends. Each person picks a gift in the app, and the list shows it as taken for everyone else, so nobody buys the same thing twice.

Made for families:
• Lists for children, organised by two people. Neither of them sees the surprises.
• A countdown to every date, and one tap to add it to Calendar.
• "Remind me to buy it" puts the gift you chose in Reminders, a week before the day.
• Add gifts from Safari or any shop app with the Share button.

Secret Santa for work, friends or family: make a group, share one link and draw names. Each person sees only who they give to. People with Android join in the browser.

Free, with no ads and no tracking. No email or password: just your first name.

name: Takas - Swap with Neighbors
description:
Don't let unused things gather dust. With Takas, swap with people nearby without spending a penny: turn your records into a camera, or your lamp into a new plant.

How it works
1. Create a listing: add photos and say what you'd like in return.
2. Discover nearby: browse listings around you in the feed or on the map.
3. Make an offer: offer up to three of your own items. The owner can accept or send a counteroffer.
4. Chat and plan the meetup: once an offer is accepted, a chat opens. Pick a place and time together.
5. Swap and rate: meet up, make the exchange, and rate your experience.

Swap safely
• Safe meeting spots: we suggest busy public places such as police stations, transit stations, ferry terminals, malls and squares.
• Ratings and reviews: see someone's swap history before you meet.
• Block and report: block anyone who bothers you in one tap, and report inappropriate listings.
• Phone number sign-in: helps keep fake accounts out.

Why Takas?
• Completely free, no ads.
• Reuse instead of throwing away, and cut down on waste.
• Get to know your neighborhood.
• Get notified about offers, messages and meetup reminders.

Declutter your home and get what you need without money. Download Takas and give your things a second life!

name: Talk Splits
description:
Talk Splits is for anyone who has to finish a talk on time: a board update, a thesis defense, a wedding toast, a speech club slot. It times every section of your rehearsal, tells you where to cut, and lets you hear just the part that ran long.

PLAN THE SECTIONS
Give the talk a time limit and break it into up to 12 sections, each with a target time and a few lines of notes. A bar shows whether the sections add up to the limit, or how far over or under they are.

REHEARSE OUT LOUD
Tap the round button, wait for the count-in and start speaking. Tap anywhere on the screen each time you move on. A ring counts down the current section, turns amber near the end and red when it runs over, while your notes stay on screen. Undo takes back a tap, Pause stops the clock, and calls or alarms pause the run for you.

SEE WHERE IT RUNS LONG
After each run every section sits next to its target: red is over, green is on target, blue is short. The total says how far over or under the limit you landed.

KNOW WHAT TO CUT
When a run is over the limit, the Cut plan splits the overrun across the sections that ran long, in 5-second steps, so the cuts add up to exactly what you need to take out.

REPLAY ONE SECTION
Tap a section to hear only that part of the recording, at 1×, 1.25× or 1.5×. Touch and hold to share that section as an audio file.

COMPARE EVERY RUN
See all your rehearsals of a talk side by side, section by section, with the run closest to your limit marked and each section's trend from first run to latest.

The microphone is optional. Choose Time only and Talk Splits still times every section.

Try a sample talk before planning your own.

No account and no sign-in. Your talks and recordings stay on this iPhone.

name: TalkTU
description:
TalkTU – Connect, Match & Chat.

เปิดโลกการทำความรู้จักคนใหม่ ๆ กับ TalkTU พื้นที่ที่ช่วยเชื่อมต่อผู้คน ค้นหาความสนใจที่ตรงกัน และเริ่มต้นความสัมพันธ์ในแบบของคุณ

ไม่ว่าคุณกำลังมองหาเพื่อนใหม่ คนคุย หรือใครสักคนที่มีความสนใจคล้ายกัน TalkTU ช่วยให้ทุกการเชื่อมต่อเป็นเรื่องง่ายและสนุกยิ่งขึ้น

- Swipe & Match: ค้นหาคนที่ถูกใจ แสดงความสนใจ และจับคู่เมื่อใจตรงกัน
- Chat: เริ่มต้นบทสนทนากับคนที่ Match เพื่อทำความรู้จักกันมากขึ้น
- Feed: แชร์เรื่องราว ความคิดเห็น และโมเมนต์ต่าง ๆ กับชุมชน
- Profile: สร้างและปรับแต่งโปรไฟล์ เพื่อแสดงตัวตนและความสนใจของคุณ

ทุกความสัมพันธ์เริ่มต้นจากการทำความรู้จัก

ค้นพบผู้คนใหม่ ๆ สร้างบทสนทนา และเปิดโอกาสให้ความสัมพันธ์ดี ๆ เกิดขึ้นได้ในทุกวัน

name: Tally Table: Game Score Keeper
description:
Tally Table is the score pad for game night. Pick a game, choose who is playing, and let the app add things up while you play.

SKULL KING
A dedicated scorekeeper for the Skull King base card game, for 2–8 players over ten rounds.
• Enter each player's bid and tricks won; the round score is worked out for you
• Bonus points for captured cards, with the base-game rules built in
• Live leaderboard and a full round-by-round scoreboard
• Shows who deals each round; reorder seats any time

SCORE COUNTER: FOR ANY GAME
Counts points for anything, from card games to darts, for up to 12 players.
• Tap or drag around the ring to add points with one gesture
• Ready-made rules for Flip 7 (first to 200), Hearts, Golf and Darts 501
• Set your own steps, starting score and target, or play with no end
• Lowest-score-wins games are supported
• Full history with undo

FIVE DICE
A Yahtzee-style scorecard for 1–8 players, everyone in one table.
• Thirteen boxes with the score for each roll shown as you choose
• Upper-section bonus and five-of-a-kind bonuses counted for you

ALSO
• Save your regular players once, with names, colours and avatars
• Several games can be in progress at once; pick up where you left off
• Stats: wins and win rate per player and per game
• The screen stays awake during a game
• Works on iPhone and iPad, in light and dark mode

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your players and scores are saved only on your device and never leave it.

Tally Table is an unofficial companion app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the publishers of the games it scores. Skull King is a trademark of Grandpa Beck’s Games. Flip 7 is a trademark of its owner. All other game names belong to their respective owners.

name: Talqeen: Memorize the Quran
description:
Talqeen helps you memorise the Quran one passage at a time, with a reciter to learn from and an AI that listens while you recite.

Pick the ayat you want to learn and a Qari plays them part by part. You listen, recite along, then recite on your own, and the parts join up until you can recite the whole passage from the start. When it's your turn the app waits for you, so there's no rush.

As you recite, Talqeen follows you word by word on the mushaf page and marks a word only when it's sure you missed it or said it wrong. Your mistakes are saved so you can go back over them, and finished lessons come back for review on later days so what you've memorised stays with you.

You can also open Practice on any page, recite from memory and see where you slipped.

Talqeen checks the words you recite. It doesn't grade tajweed and it doesn't replace a teacher, but it's a patient partner for the hours of repetition hifz needs.

The app works in English and Arabic. It needs an internet connection and the microphone, and it has no ads.

name: Tamga
description:
Tamga, işyerine giriş ve çıkışını kendi telefonundan kaydetmeni sağlar. Kart, parmak izi ya da sıraya girmek yok: kapıdaki tablette dönen QR kodunu okutursun ya da telefonunu kapının yanındaki NFC etiketine dokundurursun.
  
  NASIL ÇALIŞIR
  • Kapıdaki kiosk ekranında sürekli yenilenen bir QR kodu görünür.
  • Uygulamada "QR okut"a basıp kodu kameraya tutarsın; ya da NFC etiketine dokundurursun.
  • Giriş mi çıkış mı olduğuna sistem karar verir, sen bir şey seçmezsin.
  
  KONUM DOĞRULAMASI
  Okutma yalnız işyeri sınırları içinde kabul edilir. Konumun her okutmada alınır ve kapının tanımlı noktasıyla karşılaştırılır. Okutmadan önce "Konum" satırından yakında olup olmadığını görebilirsin.
  
  İNTERNET YOKKEN
  Bağlantı yoksa okutman telefonunda tutulur ve İnternet gelince kendiliğinden gönderilir. Saati, okuttuğun an olarak işlenir; geç gitmesi puantajını bozmaz.
  
  BUGÜN ÖZETİN
  Giriş saatin, çıkış saatin ve haftalık çalışma süren ana ekranda görünür.
  
  GÜVENLİK
  Telefonun hesabına bağlanır. Başka bir telefondan okutma yapılırsa kayıt amir onayına düşer. QR kodu kısa ömürlüdür ve imzalıdır, ekran görüntüsü alınıp sonra kullanılamaz.
  
  KURUMSAL KULLANIM
  Tamga, işvereninin kurduğu bir Tamga sunucusuyla çalışır. İlk açılışta kapıdaki kiosk ekranının QR kodunu okutursun, uygulama kurumunun adresini oradan öğrenir. Sicil numaran ve PIN'in işvereninden gelir.

name: TamSahibi - Seri İlan
description:
Tam Sahibi, Türkiye'nin yeni ilan sitesi. Emlak, vasıta ve ikinci el alışveriş ilanlarını tek uygulamada keşfet; kendi ilanını dakikalar içinde ücretsiz yayınla.

ÜCRETSİZ İLAN VER
Satılık ya da kiralık evini, arsanı, aracını veya kullanmadığın eşyalarını birkaç adımda ilana koy. Fotoğraflarını ekle, konumunu işaretle, ilanın hemen yayında.

ARADIĞINI HIZLA BUL
• Kelime, ilan numarası veya ilçeye göre arama
• Sahibinden ya da emlak ofisinden ilanları ayrı ayrı listeleme
• Gelişmiş filtreleme ve sıralama seçenekleri
• Liste ve galeri görünümü arasında tek dokunuşla geçiş
• Vitrin ilanları ve son 48 saatte eklenen yeni ilanlar

DOĞRULANMIŞ İLANLAR
Doğrulanmış ilan rozeti sayesinde güvendiğin ilanlara odaklan. Her ilanda geniş fotoğraf galerisi, harita üzerinde konum ve tüm detaylar bir arada.

HER DETAY ELİNİN ALTINDA
Arsa ve konut ilanlarında altyapı ve konum özelliklerini tek bakışta gör: elektrik, su, doğalgaz, kanalizasyon, yol durumu, ana yola yakınlık, denize sıfır, havaalanına yakın ve daha fazlası.

TÜM KATEGORİLER
• Emlak: Konut, Arsa, Bina, İşyeri, Devremülk, Turistik Tesis
• Vasıta: Otomobil, Motosiklet, Ticari Araçlar, Hasarlı Araçlar, Elektrikli Araçlar, Deniz Araçları
• İkinci El ve Sıfır Alışveriş: Spor, Antika, Cep Telefonu, Bilgisayar, Elektrikli Ev Aletleri, Giyim & Aksesuar

FAVORİLER, MESAJLAR VE BİLDİRİMLER
Beğendiğin ilanları favorilerine ekle, satıcılarla uygulama içinden mesajlaş, ilanlarla ilgili gelişmelerden bildirimlerle anında haberdar ol. İlanları arkadaşlarınla kolayca paylaş.

KURUMSAL ÜYELİK VE MAĞAZA
Emlak ofisleri ve galeriler için kurumsal üyelik ve mağaza seçenekleriyle tüm ilanlarını tek yerden yönet.

Tam Sahibi ile al, sat, kirala. Hemen indir, ilk ilanını ücretsiz ver!

name: Tape & Tile: 2D Room Planner
description:
Tape & Tile is a simple 2D room planner for iPhone, built around your tape measure. Measure the room, add the furniture you own, and see whether it fits before you lift anything.

Enter the walls with tape-measure wheels in feet and inches or metres and centimetres. Add doors, windows, open passages and corner cut-outs for closets and L-shaped rooms. Then add your furniture once to My Stuff: pick a starting size like Sofa, Bed or Desk and change it to your own measurements. Your pieces follow you into every room you plan.

Drag pieces on graph paper and they snap to the walls. Nudge them an inch at a time, push them flush to a wall or rotate them. A clearance ruler shows the gap on every side of the selected piece and marks tight walkways.

The app checks the things that actually go wrong:
- Pieces that overlap
- Pieces that stick out past a wall
- Furniture that blocks a door's swing or the space in front of it
- A dresser or sofa that may not fit through the door
When nothing is wrong, it says All clear. Rugs sit under everything and never count as obstacles.

Thinking about a bigger sofa? Tap Try a variant to test a copy in one room while your original plan stays as it was.

Export a dimensioned PDF or PNG with the room size, every piece labelled, door swings, a scale bar and a piece list, ready to send to movers, a landlord or a roommate.

What you get:
- Two rooms at a time, saved automatically
- Unlimited furniture in My Stuff
- Every check and the clearance ruler
- PDF and PNG export
- Back up to a file and restore it

Tape & Tile is free, with no ads. It works offline, there is no account, and nothing leaves your phone.

name: TapWeek
description:
Turn small daily actions into a clearer picture of your week.
TapWeek uses editable cards to track water, reading, study and work. Record an action with a tap and spend less time entering the same details.
• Accumulate quantities, complete tasks or track a goal.
• Organize cards across Food, Study and Work with recurring schedules.
• Review weekly activity and daily details, and edit past entries.
• Export a weekly PDF receipt and import or export local backups.
• Start without an account. Records stay on your device; sharing starts only when you choose it.
Food values are editable personal tracking inputs, not a nutrition database or medical advice.
Keywords: habit,tracker,weekly,daily,goals,routine,water,study,focus,tasks,journal,productivity
Promotional text: Record your daily actions with a tap. Review your week, export a PDF receipt and keep local backups. No account required.
What's New: Initial release with editable tracking cards, recurring schedules, weekly summaries, PDF receipts and local backups.

name: TarCycle: Seal Coat Calendar
description:
TarCycle is for driveway and small-lot owners who need to remember when asphalt seal coats expire — unlike a generic calendar, each Mark resealed action rolls the next due date by that surface’s cycle months and keeps a reseal log.

DUE
Open the seal expiry calendar. Amber dots mark days with coats due. Tap a day to see the surfaces, then Mark resealed — the next coat date advances by the patch’s cycle (12–30 months) and a reseal row is saved.

PATCHES
Browse every sealed surface (driveway, parking pad, walk path, apron, lot strip). Each card shows square footage, product, cycle length, and next due.

MORE
Privacy link, support email, recent reseals, and restore sample patches. Works fully offline. No accounts, ads, or subscriptions.

TarCycle does not prescribe sealant chemistry or replace a contractor inspection — it only schedules and records reseals you choose to mark done.

name: TastyRows
description:
TastyRows is an engaging culinary logic challenge centered on visual observation, systematic organization, and multi-layered pattern matching in a vibrant kitchen setting.

THE CORE DISH ALIGNMENT PRINCIPLE

Every column is guided by an overarching Target Order situated along the top counter. Each target dish features a designated culinary classification (Burger, Pizza, Donut, Ice Cream, Soup, Coffee, Cupcake, Taco, Sushi) coated in a distinctive chromatic glaze (Red, Orange, Yellow, Pink, Purple, Blue, White).

Players manipulate individual vertical columns by swiping up or down, shifting the sequence of plated entrees within the column. To achieve order fulfillment, every plated item across the board must satisfy the dual-condition requirement governed strictly by its horizontal row index:

• ODD-NUMBERED ROWS (Rows 1, 3, 5, 7, 9) — Chromatic Glaze Alignment:
Dishes positioned in these tiers must correspond to the exact COLOR and flavor hue of their column's Target Order, irrespective of the underlying entree type.

• EVEN-NUMBERED ROWS (Rows 2, 4, 6, 8, 10) — Entree Classification Alignment:
Dishes resting in these tiers must match the exact CULINARY TYPE of their column's Target Order, regardless of plate hue or glaze coloration.

DYNAMIC BOARD SCALING & STRATEGIC PROGRESSION

The playing field retains a clean, accessible layout fixed at a maximum of four columns, while advancing stages steadily scale the vertical depth:
- Foundational Stages: 2-row boards crafted to establish swift mental mapping and sequential column displacement.
- Intermediate Boards: 4-row and 6-row multi-tiered layouts requiring forward-thinking maneuvers and tactical sorting.
- Master Orders: Expansive 8-row and 10-row configurations encompassing up to 40 synchronized dish positions, offering deep analytical engagement.

PRECISION TIMING & SCORING PERFORMANCE

Each service round operates under a calibrated countdown timer tailored to the dimensions of the active board. Successfully aligning all rows triggers a precision bonus based on the remaining time, rewarding methodical foresight and rapid cognitive agility.

name: TatvaOS School
description:
TatvaOS School is the official app for schools that use TatvaOS. Students, parents and teachers see everything about school in one place, in English, Hindi, Bengali or Punjabi.

You need a login from your school. Find your school by name, school code or QR code, then sign in with the username and password your school gave you, or with a one-time code sent to your mobile.

FOR STUDENTS AND PARENTS
• Today at a glance: attendance, homework due and fees due
• Attendance by day and month, and leave requests
• Homework and assignments, with photo and file attachments
• Fees: what is due, paid receipts as PDF, and secure online payment where your school allows it
• Notices, calendar and events from the school
• Results, timetable, library and hostel details
• School bus: set your child's pick-up point and follow the bus during a trip
• More than one child? Add each child's login and switch between them
• Notifications for attendance, notices, homework and fee reminders

FOR TEACHERS AND STAFF
• Take attendance for your sections
• Set homework, including voice notes, and check submitted answers
• Enter marks, send notices and approve leave
• Your own timetable, lessons and leave
• Bus drivers can share the bus location with the school while a trip is on

PRIVACY
The app talks only to your own school's TatvaOS server. Your location is used only when you set a pick-up point, or by a driver while a trip is on; sharing stops when the trip ends. The camera is used only to scan your school's QR code or take a photo you choose to attach.

TatvaOS School is made by Techvein IT Solutions Private Limited.

name: Tauchring
description:
Tauchring is the swim-badge record for parents whose children are learning to swim in Germany. Your child goes to a DLRG or Schwimmverein course, works towards the Seepferdchen and then the Deutsches Schwimmabzeichen Bronze (Freischwimmer), Silber and Gold. After each lesson or Saturday at the Hallenbad you open Tauchring and note what happened.

KINDER
Every child in the family gets a card with their age, the badge they already hold, the badge they are working on and that badge's checklist. Tap an item the moment your child manages it. A "focus for the next lesson" line tells you what to practise next, and when every item is ticked Tauchring suggests asking the course leader about the next test date.

ABZEICHEN
All requirements from Seepferdchen to Gold, taken from the published Deutsches Schwimmabzeichen rules, with the German wording, a plain-English explanation and a practice tip. Each item is ticked per child with the date it was practised, and the date can be changed afterwards.

TRAINING
A logbook of pool visits: date, pool, the longest swim without stopping, total distance, objects fetched from the bottom, deepest dive, jumps, strokes, time in the water and a note. A chart plots the longest swim over time with a dashed line for the distance the next badge asks for.

BADEREGELN
The fourteen DLRG bathing rules as illustrated cards to work through with your child. Turn a card over for the German original, an explanation and a question to ask together, then mark it as talked through. Star the rules you want to repeat before every visit.

URKUNDEN
A record of every badge passed, with date, pool and examiner, plus a photo of the badge or certificate taken with the camera or picked from your photo library.

DIVE RINGS
Sixteen family rewards for turning up and practising: the first splash, a full lane, 200 m in one go, a kilometre as a family, all fourteen rules talked through and more.

Only an authorised examiner at the pool can award a Schwimmabzeichen. Tauchring tracks practice and records badges already passed. It never certifies anything and makes no safety or medical claims.

Everything stays on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking, and it works fully offline.

name: Taxi Simulator: Real Paris 3D
description:
Drive a taxi through the real streets of Paris, at your own pace or against the clock. Pick a fare on the taxi phone, take your passenger past the Champs-Élysées, the Arc de Triomphe and the Concorde, and earn tips for a smooth ride. Most rides take a few minutes, and driving aids make your first ones easy.

The whole 8th arrondissement is rebuilt from the city's open map data: every avenue, one-way street and roundabout, with real street names, and speed limits of 50 km/h in the streets and 70 on the avenues. Every ride is a small job with its own rules, and good driving pays.

A PASSENGER FOR EVERY KIND OF RIDE
• Standard: get them there. The fare runs by the kilometre and a smooth ride earns the tip.
• Rush: a train to catch. Beat the timer for a time bonus.
• Strict: speed limits, red lights, give-way and indicators. Three infractions and they get out.
• Tourist: pass the monuments they ask for and slow down for the photo. Tourists tip a taxi driver the most.
• Premium: no harsh braking, not a scratch. The highest bonus a taxi driver can earn.

DRIVE THE REAL PARIS
• Lanes, traffic lights and give-way rules on every street of the 8th arrondissement.
• The Arc de Triomphe, Place de la Concorde, the Grand Palais, the Madeleine, Saint-Lazare and Parc Monceau, inspired by the real places.
• City traffic that follows Paris road counts for the hour and day you play.
• Day and night follow your phone's clock. Rain changes the grip, the light and the crowds.
• Pedestrians, cyclists, traffic lights, speed cameras and filling stations.

BUILD YOUR TAXI CAREER
• A range of taxis to unlock, from a thrifty city hybrid to a seven-seat people carrier. Each one suits different rides.
• Taxi parts that take damage and change how the car drives. Repair at the garage, take a roadside quick fix or claim on your insurance.
• Level up, keep your passenger rating high and your licence points intact. Speed camera fines reach your taxi phone a little later.
• Taxi driver levels to climb, objectives to complete and every named street of the district to drive for the full tally.
• A paint shop for your colours.

MADE FOR PHONES
• Steer your taxi with the on-screen wheel or by tilting your phone, with pedals, a handbrake and a horn.
• Driving aids from Full to Simulation, for a relaxed cruise or a real driving challenge.
• Graphics that adapt to your phone.
• Play in English or French.

No sign-up: you start driving your taxi straight away. Paris downloads once, at the first launch, then you can drive offline.

Every price in the game is paid with money you earn by driving: nothing is sold for real money. Sharing anonymous crash reports and play statistics is your choice, asked once, and never includes your name or where you are.

Your taxi is waiting at the Étoile.

Monuments are inspired by the real places, not exact copies. The game is not affiliated with any company or public body.

name: TCG Tu Mesa: Contador de vidas
description:
TCG: Tu Mesa es el contador de vidas para tu mesa de juegos de cartas coleccionables, pensado para jugar en español.

CONTADOR DE VIDAS
• De 2 a 6 jugadores, cada quien con su color y su lado de la mesa.
• Toca para restar o sumar 1 y mantén presionado para restar o sumar 10.
• Daño de comandante: toca el botón de espadas y suma el daño en el panel de quien te pegó; tu vida baja sola.
• Contadores de veneno, energía, experiencia y radiación.
• Monarca, día y noche, dado de 20 caras y moneda.
• Bitácora con todo lo que pasó en la partida.

MESA SINCRONIZADA
• Cada quien lleva su vida en su propio teléfono; nadie presta el suyo.
• Entre iPhones funciona sin internet. iPhone y Android juegan en la misma mesa si están en la misma red Wi-Fi.
• Si el anfitrión se va, la mesa pasa sola a otro jugador.

ESCÁNER TRADUCTOR
• Apunta la cámara al nombre de una carta y mira su texto oficial en español.
• Funciona con cartas en inglés, español y japonés.
• Si una carta no tiene versión oficial en español, te mostramos una traducción con IA.
• Guarda tus cartas en Mi colección, tu wishlist o carpetas propias.

Todo es gratis y sin cuentas.

name: Techtonic KS
description:
Techtonic – Tek Ju Tani!

Gjithçka që të duhet, në një vend.

Mirë se vjen në Techtonic, destinacionin tënd për teknologji, elektronikë dhe blerje online në Kosovë.

Me Techtonic, blerja online bëhet më e thjeshtë, më praktike dhe më e këndshme.

GJITHÇKA QË KËRKON, NË NJË APLIKACION

• Telefona, Tabletë & Orë Inteligjente – Pajisje moderne dhe aksesorë për përditshmërinë tënde.

• Outdoor & Lifestyle – Produkte për aktivitete në natyrë, veshje, çanta dhe aksesorë.

BLERJE TË THJESHTA DHE TË SHPEJTA

Eksploro kategoritë, kërko produktet që të interesojnë dhe krahaso alternativat për të gjetur zgjedhjen e duhur.

Shiko fotografitë, përshkrimet, çmimet dhe ofertat e produkteve. Shto produktet në shportë dhe përfundo blerjen përmes një procesi praktik dhe intuitiv.

NJË PËRVOJË MODERNE BLERJESH
