TECHTONIC – TEK JU TANI!

Teknologjia, shtëpia, argëtimi dhe përditshmëria bashkohen në një aplikacion.

Shkarko Techtonic dhe zbulo një mënyrë më të lehtë për të blerë online në Kosovë.

name: Teigle: Rising Dough Puzzle
description:
Dough that rises.

Toss little doughs into the baking tin. Two matching ones merge into the next bake – from Küchle and Brezel all the way to the Riesenlaib, the giant loaf. But watch out: it’s yeast dough. Over time every dough rises and pushes upwards. When it gets tight, only a fist will help.

HOW TO BAKE
• Pull from the dough at the top and let go – the further you pull, the harder the throw.
• Two matching doughs become the next bake. The bakery has eleven of them.
• Yeast dough rises! Tap a dough to punch it down. Every four merges earn you a new fist.
• If a dough rests above the rim for too long, the tin overflows.

TWO WAYS TO BAKE
• Bake – for as long as the dough fits the tin. Chase your best score.
• Daily Dough – the same dough for everyone each day, 30 throws. Share your result and keep your streak alive.

ELEVEN BAKES FROM SWABIA
Teigle, Küchle, Weckle, Seele, Brezel, Dinnete, Hefezopf, Gugelhupf, Bauernbrot, Laible and Riesenlaib – traditional bakes from southern Germany, each with its own face and its typical top. Collect them all in your recipe book, with a little story and your stats.

MADE WITH LOVE FOR DETAIL
• Soft, squishy doughs that wobble, giggle and cheer when they merge
• A bakery that feels alive: the window shows the sky at the real time of day, the clock keeps time and the guild sign sways above the counter
• Its own music – a calm night-shift tune after dark – and gentle haptics
• Little surprises for early risers, on holidays and for anyone who likes to poke
• English, German and Spanish

FAIR AND PRIVATE
No ads. No tracking. No account. Your progress stays on your device, and you don’t need internet to play.

Baked with love in Stuttgart, Germany.

name: Temple Mount הר הבית
description:
האפליקציה תשתמש במיקום הנייד שלך כדי להדריך אותך במסלול המותר סביב הר הבית כולל ההכנות הנדרשות לעלייה להר כהלכה.
This app will use your GPS location to guide you on the allowed path around the Temple Mount

name: TempoRung
description: Every musician knows the advice: slow it down, then speed it up a little at a time. TempoRung does the bookkeeping for you. It sets the click, counts your clean takes and moves the tempo up or down by a rule, so you always practise just below the speed where things fall apart.

name: Tentive
description:
Tentive is a small, quiet place for the people you actually want to follow.

BACK UP TO TEN PEOPLE
You have ten seats. Fill them with the people whose everyday posts you care about: a friend learning to draw, a runner training for a first marathon, someone shooting one roll of film a month.

BACK EARLY, SEE MORE
When you back someone, you see everything they post from that moment on. Not before. The earlier you arrive, the more of their story you get to be part of.

EVERY BACKER GETS A NUMBER
Your first backer is #1, forever. Numbers are never handed to someone else, so being early always means something.

A SHOWCASE FOR EVERYONE ELSE
Each person picks up to three posts that anyone can see. It's how new people find you before deciding to back you.

DISCOVER WITHOUT POPULARITY
Discover never ranks people by likes or followers. It shows people who back you first, then people backed by your ten, then whoever is new.

SAFE BY DESIGN
Report any post or person, block anyone in one tap, and delete your account and everything in it from Settings whenever you want.

No likes. No follower race. Just your ten.

name: The CAP Group
description:
Selling or buying a home with Christian Perez? The CAP Group puts your whole deal in one place, on your iPhone and your Mac.

You should never have to guess what happens next in the biggest sale of your life. Most sellers and buyers wait on calls and dig through email threads to find out where things stand. The CAP Group shows you the moment it changes.

What you see:
• Where your deal stands today, and the next step
• Every showing and the feedback from it
• An alert on your phone when an offer comes in, a showing is booked or a document is ready to sign
• Your timeline from the first call to closing day

How it works:
1. Christian sends you a personal login link.
2. Tap it and you're in. Every seller on a deal gets their own login, with the same access.
3. Open the app any time to see where your deal stands.

Only you see your deal. Each person has their own login, and our server checks every request, so no one else can open your home's details.

The CAP Group is part of The Show-Ready-Seller® System, the 5-step process Christian has used to sell $50M+ in homes in Burbank and the San Fernando Valley since 2015: Discovery, Preparation, Marketing, Offer Negotiation and Escrow.

Christian's team logs in to the same app for their training and tools.

Not working with Christian yet? Book A Free Discovery Call at WWW.SELLWITHCAP.COM.

Christian Perez | DRE #01992184 | Equity Union | DRE #01811831

name: The Condition Set
description:
A trilogy about what happens when AI reshapes who works, who decides, and who matters.

Redundant asks who gets cut.
Contingent asks who gets used.
Essential asks what must remain human.

The three books are in the app. You read them here, chapter by chapter, and your place stays on this device. The journal from theconditionset.com opens here too. The last copy of an essay you read stays with you.

There is no account and no paywall.

Timothy O'Brien
Published by Discursive

name: The Sixth Signal
description:
Turn your iPhone into a retro field receiver and follow Nora into an island mystery.

The Sixth Signal is an outdoor adventure on Daniel Island, South Carolina. Follow the map to physical stations, scan their markings, reveal fragments in augmented reality, and piece together the mystery.

YOUR FIELD RECEIVER
• Follow directions to the next station.
• Use the proximity radar to search the area on foot.
• Scan station and fragment artwork with your camera.
• Inspect collected fragments and follow your current mission.
• Receive messages from Nora and request assistance.
• Pause your adventure and return when you are ready.

The outdoor game requires access to the designated physical stations on Daniel Island and an internet connection. Camera access enables AR scanning. Location access supports navigation and station proximity. Bluetooth connects to supported station locks. Notifications are optional.

Stop safely before scanning or interacting with a station. Stay on public paths and follow local access rules.

Created by Outer Games.

name: Throne & Banner
description:
Build a kingdom. Raise an army. Claim the throne.

Throne & Banner is a real-time strategy game made for your phone. Gather food, wood, gold and stone, grow your town through four ages, and lead your soldiers into battle with simple taps.

THE CAMPAIGN
Follow the Warden across twelve chapters on a painted map: rebuild a fallen valley, hunt relics, ride with a hero king, hold walls under siege and face a six-kingdom finale. Earn up to three stars in every chapter. The first two chapters guide you step by step.

THREE CIVILISATIONS
• Kingdoms of the West: stout castles and royal guards
• Sultanates of the Middle: camel riders and mamluks
• Dynasties of the East: war elephants and swift archers
Each has its own buildings, troops, strengths and voices.

SKIRMISH
Finish chapter 4 to unlock skirmish: battle up to five computer kingdoms on grassland, desert, snow or island maps, alone or with allies, at the difficulty you choose.

WORLD BUILDER
Paint your own land: rivers, forests, mountains, gold and towns. Then play on it.

MADE FOR TOUCH
• Tap to select, tap to order, drag to box-select, pinch to zoom
• Formations, stances, control groups and garrisons
• Upgrades for every unit, from the Bronze Age to the Gold Age
• No account, no ads, no internet needed

name: Tidemori
description:
Tidemori 帮你照顾日常里的小事。

• 记录每一杯水，设置每日目标、杯量和提醒时段，支持撤销。
• 按具体时间安排用药提醒，分别记录已服、跳过与延后。
• 安排用餐、休息与运动计划，查看每日节奏与完成记录。
• 经你授权后，读取 Apple 健康中的 HRV、静息心率和睡眠，查看身体状态与趋势；没有数据时如实显示空状态。
• 在 Apple Watch、iPhone 主屏幕和锁屏小组件快速查看与记录。

支持 iPhone（iOS 17 或更新版本）与 Apple Watch（watchOS 10 或更新版本）。部分交互组件需要 watchOS 11；药物读取与可选系统用药闹钟需要 iOS 26。

提醒受系统通知权限、专注模式、设备状态和后台调度影响；请定期打开应用补排。停止系统用药闹钟不会自动记为已服。应用内服药日志独立于 Apple 健康中的服药日志。

Tidemori 用于日常健康记录与参考，不提供医疗诊断或治疗建议。请按医嘱用药，不要依赖本应用处理紧急医疗情况。

name: Tidy Tides: Color Sort Puzzle
description:
Sort by color, clean the beach, and rebuild a seaside town.

A storm has left Kelpford Bay covered in trash. Tap a crate, then tap where its color goes. Fill every crate with one color to solve the puzzle, and each puzzle you solve rebuilds a piece of town: the boardwalk, beach huts, the lighthouse and more. Watch the beach come back to life as you sort.

DAILY TIDE
Everyone gets the same color sort puzzle each day. Solve it in as few moves as you can, share your result with friends, and earn shells to unlock new crate styles. Keep a streak going for bonus shells.

HOLIDAY TIDES
Seasonal events bring a themed beach and special Daily Tide keepsakes to collect.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• No lives and no timers. Play as long as you like.
• Unlimited free undo.
• Hints show a move that leads to a solution.
• Every puzzle is checked by a solver, so each one can be solved.
• Plays offline. Your progress is backed up automatically, with no sign-up.
• Calm sounds and gentle haptics, with a sound switch.
• No ads.

Tidy Tides is a relaxing logic game and daily puzzle for anyone who likes color sort puzzles.

name: TileBound: Local Word Game
description:
TileBound is a calm, ad-free word game for one player, two players on one device, or two nearby devices on the same Wi-Fi. AS CLOSE AS YOU CAN GET TO THE ORIGINAL BOARD GAME!

Place tiles on a classic 15 x 15 board, connect words, use premium squares, and race to finish the bag. Play at your own pace with no accounts, ads, analytics, or internet word checks. The complete word list and scoring rules work offline.

Features:
- Pass-and-play with two players on one device
- Local multiplayer over Wi-Fi
- Three computer opponent difficulties
- Private tile racks and host-authoritative game state
- Automatic save and resume for local games
- Sound and haptic controls
- No ads, accounts, tracking, or cloud services

name: Tiny Chaos
description:
Tiny Chaos'a hoş geldin: sevimli, renkli ve tamamen kaotik bir parti yarışı!

30 yarışmacıyla aynı parkura çık, engelleri aş, düşme ve eleme turlarını geç. Her turda sadece en hızlılar devam eder; finalde ilk bitiren tacı kazanır!

HER TUR YEPYENİ BİR PARKUR
Haritalar her turda sıfırdan rastgele oluşturulur, aynı parkuru iki kez göremezsin! Her turun başında dünya ruleti döner ve bu turda hangi dünyada yarışacağını seçer.

ÖZELLİKLER
• 30 kişilik yarışlar: 4 eleme turu, tek şampiyon
• 8 farklı dünya: Şeker Diyarı, Çekiç Tepeleri, Buzul Vadisi, Lav Zirvesi, Yeşil Orman, Uzay Üssü, Çöl Vahası ve Kaos Kulesi
• Fizik tabanlı engeller: dev sallanan çekiçler, dönen süpürgeler, yıkım topları, zıplatma yastıkları, çöken zeminler, itici pistonlar, rüzgâr fanları, kaygan buz ve daha fazlası
• Akıllı rakipler: her rakibin kendi karakteri var; kimi temkinli, kimi atak, kimi de seni itmeye bayılıyor
• 15 sevimli kostüm: taç, viking miğferi, tavşan kulakları, pervaneli şapka, tekboynuz…
• Karakterini özelleştir: rengini seç, kostümünü giy, adını yaz
• Kolay dokunmatik kontroller: joystick, zıplama butonu ve serbest kamera
• İnternetsiz oyna: hesap gerekmez, her yerde oyna

Oyun ücretsizdir ve internete bağlıyken reklam içerir.

Hazır mısın? Kaos başlasın!

name: To Do PM
description:
To Do PM is a personal project manager that combines proven planning tools in one private, offline app.

PROJECTS AND TASKS
• Organize work into projects with categories, statuses and priorities
• Track tasks as Pending, Started, In Process, Paused or Completed
• Add your own custom fields to projects and tasks
• Attach photos and videos, or take a photo right from a task

TIMELINE
• See projects and tasks on a Gantt-style timeline
• Plan by day, week or month and spot overlaps at a glance

EISENHOWER MATRIX
• Sort tasks by urgency and importance
• Focus on what matters: do, schedule, delegate or drop

SKILL / WILL MATRIX
• Map the people you work with by skill and motivation
• Decide when to direct, guide, excite or delegate

WHEEL OF LIFE
• Score the areas of your life and see your balance at a glance
• Choose the season you are in (Push, Hold, Park, Building, Recovering and more) and rescore over time

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking, and no data collected.

name: Toilix - Toilet Finder
description:
Find a public toilet nearby or search for one before you travel. Browse toilets on the map or in a list, then use walking or driving directions inside Toilix.

• Check available details such as fees, opening hours and wheelchair access.
• Save favourites and download toilet listings for offline access. The map and directions require an internet connection.
• Report inaccurate information or suggest a new toilet or photo for review.

Coverage and facility details vary by area. Browsing and favourites work without an account.

name: Tonari-Ban: Shogi & Chess
description:
Play board games face to face with someone nearby, each on your own iPhone. Four games: shogi, chess, reversi and gomoku.

OPEN THE APP AND IT CONNECTS
- When both of you open the app, the iPhones find each other automatically
- Just have Wi-Fi or Bluetooth on. No internet, no account
- Pick a game and send an invitation; when your friend accepts, the game begins

YOUR OWN BOARD, FACING EACH OTHER
- Your pieces are always at the bottom of your screen, like sitting across a real board
- Your opponent's move appears on your board instantly, with the last move marked
- If the connection drops or the app is closed, the game picks up where it left off when you reconnect

FOUR GAMES
- Shogi: pieces in hand, promotion, and the standard rules for illegal drops and repetition
- Chess: castling, en passant, promotion; draws by threefold repetition, the 50-move rule and insufficient material
- Reversi: legal moves shown, automatic passes, live disc count
- Gomoku: 15x15 board; tap twice to place so you never misplace a stone

DURING A GAME
- Ask to take back a move (your opponent decides), offer a draw, or resign
- "Play again" swaps who goes first

ONE IPHONE, TWO PLAYERS
- No second iPhone? Take turns on one device. The board turns to whoever is moving

ALSO
- No ads, no purchases, no data collected
- Japanese interface

name: TractProof
description:
TractProof checks property surveys, legal descriptions, plats and deeds before they go into a contract, a permit or a County  eRecording package. It's built for engineers, surveyors, contract managers and right-of-way professionals who need to know that the paperwork agrees before anyone signs.

A clear, guided workflow walks you through six steps, and it tells you exactly what to do next.

IMPORT ANY DOCUMENT
• Bring in PDFs, scans and images, as many as you need at once.
• Scanned pages are read with on-device text recognition.
• Everything is kept in your Document Library, ready to use in any step.

READ THE LEGAL DESCRIPTION
• TractProof splits the metes and bounds at every THENCE and reads each bearing, distance and curve.
• Commencing tie calls are separated from the boundary automatically.
• Distances in feet or Texas varas are supported.

CHECK CLOSURE, AREA AND CURVES
• See misclosure, the closing course and the precision ratio, with Pass, Review or Flag against your own minimum.
• The area is computed with curve segments included and compared with the stated acreage.
• Radius, delta, arc, chord and tangent are solved and cross-checked for every curve.

COMPARE AND SEE THE FINDINGS
• Match every call to the plat's line and curve tables.
• Or compare the survey to a deed's description, even if the deed starts at a different corner or runs the other way.
• Findings list only what doesn't match: what each document says, and by how much.

REVIEW ONE DEED OR MANY
• Pulls out the grantor, grantee, dates, county, instrument numbers and volume/page references.
• Checks the owner shown on the survey against the newest deed.
• Follows the chain of title from deed to deed and flags gaps.
• Lists easements, rights-of-way and restrictions that appear in some deeds but not others.

REPORT AND SAVE
• Generate a PDF QC report with every check, the calls reviewed, deed facts, the chain of title and an open-items list for execution and eRecording.
• Share it to Files, Mail or AirDrop.
• Complete each project to keep it in Saved Projects, then start the next one with a clean slate.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no login, no camera, no tracking. Your documents are read on your device and never uploaded.

Works on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

TractProof is a quality-control aid. It does not replace the judgment, field work or seal of a Registered Professional Land Surveyor, a title commitment, or legal review.

Published by The MainSite Group Corporation (KM).

name: TradeFlow OS
description:
You were under a sink. They called someone else.

TradeFlow answers your business line whenever you can't: on a job, after hours, or while you're already on another call. It talks to the customer, finds out what they need and where, and books the job straight into your schedule. You get a text with the details before you've put your tools down.

The TradeFlow OS app is where you run it from your phone.

EVERY CALL, IN ONE PLACE
- See each caller's name, number, address and what the problem is
- Read the call summary or tap to call them back
- Filter by New, Called, Booked, Follow Up or Lost and update a lead in one tap

KNOW THE MOMENT WORK COMES IN
- Push notifications for every new lead and every booked job
- Urgent calls (no heat, burst pipe, no power) can be put straight through to your mobile

SET IT UP YOUR WAY
- Keep your existing business number: forward missed calls (or all calls) to your AI line
- Step-by-step forwarding codes for your carrier
- Choose when the AI answers and who urgent calls go to
- Works in English, French and Spanish

SEE WHAT IT'S WORTH
- Calls answered, leads captured and jobs booked, week by week
- A live view while a call is in progress

Built in Alberta for plumbers, HVAC techs, electricians and other trades.

A TradeFlow account is required. Your calls, leads and settings stay private to your business; you can delete your account and all its data at any time from Settings in the app.

name: TrailStow
description:
Plan what goes in your vehicle and what comes out first. TrailStow is a camping gear planner for road trips, campsite weekends, and overnight getaways.

Build your kit from presets or add your own gear. Enter each item's weight and drag it into one of six cargo zones. Use the floor and upper layers to plan stacked gear, then check the total gear weight and the difference between the left and right sides.

Use Arrival Flow to decide what you need as soon as you park, what comes out during camp setup, and what can wait. TrailStow shows which items may be in the way so you can rearrange the cargo before you leave.

Follow Load Mode while packing the vehicle and Unload Mode when you reach camp. Check off each item as you go. Save your plan or copy it for your next trip with fresh checklists.

Add your measured vehicle data to estimate front and rear axle loads. View weights in pounds or kilograms. Your trips are saved on your device, and you can plan offline without an account.

name: Translate Conversation
description:
Translate Conversation — live conversation translation for iPhone and Apple Watch.

Speak your language. See and hear the reply in theirs. Hold, speak, release — no clutter.

APPLE WATCH
• Dictate or type a phrase from your wrist
• Translation runs on the paired iPhone and returns to the Watch
• Swap languages and replay speech on Watch
• Keep the iPhone nearby with the app open — required because Translation isn’t available natively on watchOS

ON IPHONE
• Hold-to-talk: press the center control or a language pill and speak
• Two languages in one conversation — built for face-to-face dialogue
• Apple Translation online plus optional offline language packs
• Conversation history, replay, and copy
• Quick language setup and pack downloads in Settings

WHO IT’S FOR
Travel, meetings, study, everyday chats — whenever you need fast translation without juggling apps.

REQUIREMENTS
iPhone on iOS 18 or later. Watch companion needs a paired Apple Watch and a nearby iPhone. Microphone and speech recognition are used for dictation and conversation translation.

Support: use the Support URL on this App Store page.

name: Tree AI
description:
Tree turns everything your course gives you (lectures, notes, slides, and decks) into a Space: a place to study where each kind of material opens in the app made for it.

READ AND LISTEN
• Study guides and outlines, with your place kept on every device
• Narrated audio guides that keep playing with the screen locked
• Talk back: answer a guide's questions out loud and hear how you did

PRACTICE
• Flashcards with spaced repetition, and decks you bring from Anki
• Practice questions, with every answer kept
• A dashboard of what you've studied and what's due

ASK
• An agent that has read your Space: ask about a lecture, a passage, or a card, and it answers from your material
• Highlight a passage to comment on it or ask about it

SHARE
• Share a Space with your class by invite link or email

Sign in with Apple, Google, or email. Your reading, reviews, and notes follow you between iPhone, iPad, the Mac and Windows apps, and treespace.ai.

name: TreeCalc
description:
TreeCalc is a calculator that shows the expression tree behind the result.

Type an expression, press equals, and open the tree. The same calculation appears in postfix (Reverse Polish) notation. Play walks the tokens and highlights the matching branch. Tap a token to jump to that step. On iPhone, swipe between the calculator and the tree. On iPad, both stay on screen.

Addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and integer powers stay exact fractions. 1 ÷ 3 is 0.(3). 1 ÷ 6 is 0.1(6). 1 ÷ 7 is 0.(142857). 1 ÷ 8 is 0.125. Roots, trigonometry, and logarithms stay rounded, because they are not repeating rationals.

Bases 2, 8, 10, and 16 rewrite the number you are typing, the current result, and every number already in the expression. A radix point works in every base. Decimal 0.5 is hexadecimal 0.8 and binary 0.1.

Sine, cosine, and tangent use degrees or radians. Memory, parentheses, powers, factorial, and bitwise operations are on the keypad. Tst types a nested sample so the tree has something to show.

English and Hungarian follow the language of the device. The theme is automatic, light, or dark. The decimal mark is always a dot.

TreeCalc runs on the device. There is no account, no advertising, and no tracking. The only saved setting is the theme.

name: Trinkets: Trip Collages
description:
Life moves fast. Trinkets helps you slow down and collect the little moments.

Make a trip, add your photos, and Trinkets does the rest. It cuts out the people, pets and little things in each photo, right on your iPhone, and arranges them into one collage for the whole trip. No fiddly editing, no templates.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Drag, pinch and twist any piece, like stickers on a story
• Press and hold a piece to rotate it, move it up or down a layer, or remove it
• Add more photos whenever you like, from the camera or your library

KEEP AND SHARE
• Save a collage to your Photos
• Publish it to Discover for other people to enjoy
• Swipe through collages from people around the world, and double-tap to like

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your trips and photos stay on your phone
• Cut-outs are made on your iPhone, never uploaded
• Only collages you choose to publish leave your phone
• Sign in with Apple; no passwords, no ads, no tracking

Trinkets is free. Cut-outs need iOS 17 or later.

Questions or ideas? Email hello@gettrinkets.app

name: TrioGyalt
description:
• Save a board with thickness, width, length in feet, and a count
• Compute nominal board feet as thickness × width × length / 12
• Dress common whole-inch softwood sizes, such as 2 by 6 to about 1.5 by 5.5
• Count plywood sheets from two rectangles, without nesting offcuts
• Count equal sticks needed to cover a run
• Turn faces and coats into a fraction of a can
• Multiply board feet by a waste factor
• Erase the local file from the manual

name: Tripkin: Trip & Memories
description:
Tripkin is where friends and family plan a trip together and keep its memories on a map.

PLAN TOGETHER
• Start a trip and invite the people going, by email or with a link.
• Drop ideas for places to see. When you go, give an idea a date and it moves into the day-by-day timeline.
• Everyone can add to the trip: pages, photos, notes and comments.

FLIGHTS, TRAINS AND BUSES
• Add every journey between places: flight, train, bus, car or ferry.
• Keep the PNR or booking reference, times, seats and who's travelling in one place, ready to copy at the counter.
• See at a glance what's booked and what still isn't.
• Overnight train? Arrivals the next day show "+1".

REMEMBER IT ON A MAP
• Every moment is a page with its photos, place, time, notes and who was there.
• Photos fill in the date and place for you.
• Your trips, places and journeys are drawn on the map, so the whole route is easy to relive.
• Pin a spot on the map and Tripkin names the place for you.

SHARED, BUT PRIVATE
• Trips are private by default: only the people you invite can see them.
• Make a trip public when you want to share the dated pages with anyone who has the link. Ideas, comments and the member list always stay private.
• Roles for owners, admins, editors and viewers.
• Hearts and comments for the moments you loved.

STAY IN THE LOOP
• Notifications when someone adds photos, comments, a page or a journey.
• Turn push notifications off any time in your profile.

SAFE BY DESIGN
• Report anything inappropriate and block people from any note, comment or member row. Every report is reviewed within 24 hours.
• Photo location data is removed from files before they're uploaded.
• Delete your account at any time from your profile.

Tripkin is free. Plan the next trip, and never lose the last one.

Terms: https://tripkin.in/terms
Privacy: https://tripkin.in/privacy

name: TTAETTAE: Routine & Reminders
description:
TTAETTAE helps you remember the things you need to take care of on a regular schedule.
Add jobs like replacing the A/C filter, cleaning the washing machine, changing the water filter, an engine oil change, or checking tire pressure, and the app works out the next due date and reminds you.

■ See the time left at a glance
· A ring and a countdown show how long until the next due date
· Status comes through color, icon, and wording: Plenty of time / Coming up soon / Due today / Overdue
· The Home tab shows only what needs attention today, and the All tab shows everything in one place

■ Reminders on the due date
· Get a gentle reminder the day before, on the day, and after it passes (and a week ahead for long cycles)
· Choose "I did it" or "Tomorrow" right from the notification
· Set the reminder time to the minute, or turn reminders off

■ Urgent alarms for what can't wait
· Set an urgent alarm time for any item, and on the due date you'll be reminded every minute for 10 minutes from that time
· It repeats every cycle until you turn it off
· Sound and Focus follow your device settings

■ Your own categories
· Create, rename, and delete categories that fit your life, like Home, Car, Work, or Study (up to 10)
· Swipe through your categories on the All tab to filter

■ Easy to use
· Enter a cycle in days, weeks, or months and tell the app when you last did it, and it calculates the next due date. If you don't remember, choose "I don't know"
· Start quickly with suggested items such as replacing the A/C filter
· Undo a completion you tapped by mistake, or skip a cycle
· Available in English, 한국어, 日本語, and 简体中文

■ Your information stays on your device
· No sign-in is needed. Without signing in, everything stays on your device
· If you like, sign in with Apple to sync and back up across your devices
· No ads and no tracking

name: Tucano: AI Agents
description:
Tucano is a team of AI agents that works for you: they research, write, organize and use your company's tools, and you decide how far each one goes. This app brings your Tucano to the iPhone.

TODAY
Who on the team is working right now and everything that needs you: the questions the agents asked and the actions waiting for your approval. Answer and approve right there.

CONVERSATIONS
Talk to each agent in a direct conversation or call the team into a channel with @. Replies arrive live, with the steps the agent took, the files it made and the sources it used. Dictate instead of typing, send photos and files.

YOUR TEAM
Create agents by talking to Tuca, adjust routines that run on their own, see the team's memory and the wiki the agents keep.

FOR TEAMS
Several people in the same Tucano: each with their own private conversations with the agents, the questions and approvals that are theirs, and someone who covers for them while they're away. Invite someone with a link, and they join through the app.

HOW TO CONNECT
The app connects to a Tucano that already exists: Tucano Pro, which we host for you, or a Tucano on your own server. In Tucano, open Settings › People › Connect a phone and scan the QR code; or paste the invite link you were sent. Each phone gets a key of its own.

PRIVACY
The app only talks to your Tucano: no ads, no tracking. Before first use, it shows what goes to the AI providers. Anyone who was invited can leave and delete their own data from the app.

Learn more at tucano.sh.

name: Turizma
description:
Turizma je onlajn škola za zaposlene u turizmu i ugostiteljstvu: recepcija, hotelsko domaćinstvo, prodaja aranžmana, usluživanje i vođenje grupa. Kurseve prolazite na telefonu, između smena, kad vam odgovara.

- Svi vaši kursevi na jednom mestu, sa rokovima i napretkom
- Kratke lekcije sa video snimcima, primerima iz prakse i scenarijima „šta biste uradili“
- Pitanje posle svake lekcije i završni test, sa rezultatom odmah
- Sertifikat odmah po položenom kursu, sa javnom proverom
- Obaveštenje čim dobijete nov kurs ili se rok približi
- Moja statistika: bodovi, prolaznost i rezultati po kursu
- Pretraga kurseva i lekcija iz gornjeg menija
- Dodatni materijali i PDF dokumenti otvaraju se u samoj aplikaciji
- Nastavljate tamo gde ste stali, na telefonu ili na sajtu

Kurseve priprema škola Turizma (turizma.rs) sa stručnjacima iz hotelijerstva i turističkih agencija. Pristup vam dodeljuje poslodavac koji je klijent škole; nalog dobijate pozivnicom na mejl.
Privacy Policy: https://syntesta.com/politika-privatnosti
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Turnuva Pro
description:
Arkadaş grubunun, okulunun ya da mahallenin futbol turnuvasını kolayca yönet.

Takımları ekle, Turnuva Pro fikstürü senin için hazırlasın. Her maçın skorunu girdikçe puan tablosu kendiliğinden güncellensin. Sonuçları tek dokunuşla resim olarak paylaş.

• Tek sayıda takımla da çalışır

• Hesap gerekmez, internetsiz çalışır, verilerin cihazında kalır

name: TV Binge Diary
description:
Your shows. Your films. One very well-kept diary.

"Wait, which episode was I on?" Never again. TV Binge Diary remembers where you stopped, lines up what's next, and gives you a nudge when a new episode lands. Your only job is pressing play.

ALWAYS KNOW WHAT'S NEXT
• Up next picks up exactly where you left off, in every show you're halfway through.
• One Schedule for every new episode of everything you follow, in your own timezone. No more checking five sites to find out what airs this week.
• Optional alerts shortly before a new episode airs, and when a film on your watchlist can be watched at home.
• Home screen widgets put tonight's plans one glance away.

TICK IT OFF. IT FEELS GREAT.
• Tick an episode and every earlier one is marked with it. Undo is one tap.
• Binged the lot? Say you're up to date and the whole show is marked watched.
• Keep a film watchlist and log every viewing. Rewatches very much count.
• Watching, Plan to watch, On hold, Up to date, Dropped: sort your library the way you think about it.
• Coming from another tracker? Import your history and carry on.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Flip back through your diary and see exactly what you watched and when.
• Heart your favourites and build your own lists, like "Rewatch" or "Korean comedies".
• Look back on your viewing with your own Wrapped.

HAVE OPINIONS
• Rate shows, episodes and films out of ten. Yes, you can finally give that finale what it deserves.
• Talk it over with other viewers, with spoilers kept behind a warning until you've watched.

FIND YOUR NEXT OBSESSION
• Search more than 170,000 series, plus films.
• Browse by genre, see what's popular, and get recommendations shaped by what you've watched, rated and dropped.
• See which streaming services have a show or film in your country.

WATCH ALONG WITH FRIENDS
• See what your friends are watching and how far they've got, with no spoilers.
• Spot which friends are watching a show or have seen a film, right on its page.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Your library, your ratings and what you've watched stay private until you accept a friend, and you can hide any title from friends. No ads, no analytics, no tracking. Comments are public, and you can delete your account and everything in it from the Profile screen at any time.

Go on. One more episode.

name: Twenty-Four Nights Clock
description:
Twenty-Four Nights Clock puts the stills of the visual novel "Twenty-Four Nights in New York" on your Home Screen, your Mac desktop and your desk.

• Widgets for iPhone, iPad and Mac — small, medium and large, plus Lock Screen widgets on iPhone
• Four looks: flip, typewriter, subtitle and neon
• 53 scenes from the story, changing every 15, 30 or 60 minutes — pick one heroine or let all six take turns
• The clock moves to the quiet side of each scene, so faces stay clear
• Night counter: which of the twenty-four nights it is (December 1 to Christmas Eve)
• Desk clock mode: full screen on iPad, on a Mac or second display, or on an iPhone while it charges — the screen stays on
• No account, no ads, no tracking — everything works offline

How to add a widget
iPhone and iPad: touch and hold the Home Screen, tap Edit, then Add Widget, and choose "밤 시계" (Night Clock). Touch and hold the widget to change the look, heroine and interval.
Mac: right-click the desktop, choose Edit Widgets, and drag "스물네 번의 밤 시계" onto the desktop.

The app's menus are in Korean; the clock itself is numbers and works anywhere.

Made by Uncrumpled Pictures. The artwork was created with AI image tools, then selected and edited by hand.

name: Twistday: Daily Side Quests
description:
Hum along with your fridge. Rate 3 waters like a sommelier. Be an inflatable tube man for 30 seconds.
Every day you crank Twisty, a small red gumball machine, and one tiny real-world quest rolls out.
Do it, snap proof, and by December your year is full of weird little firsts.

HOW IT WORKS
Crank once a day. A capsule drops. Inside is one quest. That's the whole deal.

571 quests across 9 flavors: notice, move, create, learn, taste, connect, kind, explore, calm. None of them repeat. A few real ones:
• Write a breakup letter to your alarm clock
• Rank every door handle in your home
• Walk one street past your usual border
• Compliment a stranger's taste
• Wash one dish like it's a priceless vase
• Pack tomorrow-you a lunch with a tiny note

IT KNOWS WHAT KIND OF DAY IT IS
• Easy quests your first week
• Short ones on weekdays, bigger ones on weekends
• Indoor quests when it rains
• Special capsules on your birthday, full moons, solstices, Halloween and New Year

NOT FEELING IT?
Swap twice a day: "just a different one", "I'm stuck at home", "I've only got 2 minutes" or "low battery today".

PROOF IT HAPPENED
Snap a photo, write one line, record a 30-second voice note, and add a "first time ever" sticker.

STREAKS WITHOUT GUILT
One rest day a week is built in. Miss a Sunday, keep your streak.

YOUR CHARACTER SHEET
Every quest feeds six stats: Curious, Brave, Kind, Creative, Wild, Chill. Earn XP, level up, collect titles like Rookie Sweetheart and Legendary Wildcard.

YOUR YEAR, WRAPPED UP
Monthly and yearly story slides: how many twists you did, your firsts, your top stat, a map of where they happened, your weirdest quest, your best streak and a mosaic that hides a face. Share them as images.

OFF THE APP, ON YOUR PHONE
• Home and Lock Screen widgets
• A Live Activity with a countdown ring in the Dynamic Island
• Tap "Done it!" right from the Island

Every day is Twistday.

No account. No ads. No tracking. Everything stays on your phone.

name: TypeOut: Clipboard Keyboard
description:
TypeOut is a keyboard that types the text you copied, one key at a time, at a human pace, instead of pasting it all at once.

Write and check your text wherever you like, copy it, switch to TypeOut in any app and tap Type clipboard. Watch it appear the way it would if you typed it yourself.

HOW IT TYPES
• Four speeds, from Relaxed (about 30 words a minute) to Rapid (about 75), and you can switch while it types
• Every run varies a little, with pauses after sentences and the odd glance back at the text
• Now and then it hits a nearby key, notices and fixes it. Never inside @names, #tags, links, emails or numbers, and the final text always matches what you copied
• Turn typos off any time

MADE FOR REAL USE
• Stop whenever you like. If you tap inside the text, switch text boxes or the screen locks, it pauses, and Continue picks up exactly where it stopped
• Where the return key sends or submits, line breaks are typed as spaces so nothing gets sent halfway
• Up to 5,000 characters at a time
• Tap ABC for ordinary letter keys when you want to type by hand
• A practice box in the app shows you how it works before you use it for real

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no tracking, no analytics, no ads
• Nothing you copy or type ever leaves your device. TypeOut's only network request is a tiny check for updates, which sends nothing about you
• The keyboard reads your clipboard only when you tap Type clipboard, and only to type it
• It saves just your speed and typo settings, on your device

ABOUT FULL ACCESS
Apple only lets a keyboard read the clipboard when Allow Full Access is on, and shows the same general warning for every keyboard that asks. TypeOut needs it for that one job. Without Full Access, TypeOut still works as an ordinary letter keyboard.

name: Umbra: Shoot Planner
description:
Plan every shoot around the light.

Umbra is a free shoot planner for photographers and videographers who run the business from their iPhone. Find golden hour for any spot, keep the whole day in one brief, and send quotes and invoices that look the part.

THE LIGHT
• Golden hour, blue hour, sunrise and sunset for the exact spot and date, worked out on your iPhone with no signal needed
• A sun map that shows where the light falls at any time of day
• Glow forecast: the chance of a colourful sunrise or sunset
• Rain watch: a heads-up the evening before a shoot
• Light check: Umbra flags harsh midday light when you book

THE DAY OF THE SHOOT
• One brief with when to leave (with traffic), the light, the forecast, your shot list, notes and mood board
• A Live Activity on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• A prep card for your client with the time, place, light and what to wear

THE BUSINESS SIDE
• Quotes with deposits and payment plans that become invoices when each part is due
• Clean PDF invoices sent straight from your phone
• Scan receipts with your camera and file them against expenses
• Revenue, profit and your financial year goal at a glance
• A tax time pack for your accountant
• Set up for Australia, New Zealand, the UK, Ireland, Canada and the US, with the right currency, tax and financial year

TOOLS
• A posing guide with cues to say and setup notes
• Shot list templates for weddings, families and brand shoots
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Smart help on Apple Intelligence iPhones: a morning brief and plain-English finance summaries, written on the device

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything lives on your iPhone and in your own iCloud. No accounts, no ads, no tracking, and it works offline.

Free, with no in-app purchases and no subscriptions.

name: unbounds - Mindful Notes
description:
unbounds is a quiet sanctuary for your mind - a tactile, private place to capture fleeting sparks, voice notes, and everyday reflections without the weight of rigid folders or endless to-do lists.

Most note apps demand that you organize before you even know what you want to say. unbounds does the opposite: it gives you space to be disorganized first, and brings harmony when you are ready.

KEY EXPERIENCES:

• THE LIQUID GLASS VESSEL (CHAOS VIEW)
When thoughts are fresh, they don’t belong in neat rows. Drop your notes into a tranquil Liquid Glass jar where they float and drift naturally with device tilt. Give your device a mindful shake to let ideas bump and mingle peacefully.

• EXHALE TO ALIGN
Whenever you feel ready to organize, rest your thumb on the Align button. Take a mindful breath as subtle haptic pulses guide you, and watch your scattered slips settle seamlessly into an ordered timeline.

• ZERO-FRICTION CAPTURE
Jot down quick thoughts or record voice memos with live, on-device transcription. Your spoken words are transcribed instantly in total privacy.

• SMART CONTEXT RECOGNITION
unbounds quietly recognizes the nature of your thoughts - Ideas, Tasks, Work, Personal, Meetings, or Finance—and tints them with a muted Japanese Cel-Glass color palette without requiring manual tagging.

• BUILT FOR PRIVACY & STILLNESS
- No accounts, no logins, no email signups.
- Zero ads, zero trackers, zero analytics.
- 100% private on-device processing.
- Seamless, encrypted iCloud sync across all your devices.
- Export and import your thoughts anytime in open JSON format.

Give your restless thoughts a place to rest. Download unbounds and experience notes in stillness.

name: Until – Visual Timer
description:
Until shows how much time is left as color that fills the screen. A full screen is an hour; as time runs out, the color goes down. You see it at a glance, from across the room, without reading a number.

Drag up to set a time. Let go and tap Start. That is all.

- Tap the time to pause, then resume or stop.
- Hold to change a running timer: the phone buzzes, then you drag.
- Swipe left on the empty screen to make a full screen 15 minutes instead of 60.
- The screen stays on while a timer runs.
- When you leave the app, the time left is shown in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen.
- When the time is up, Until rings, also when the phone is locked or silenced.

No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

name: UNTOLD: Anonymous Confessions
description:
UNTOLD is a quiet place for the things people don't say out loud.

Write a story without a name, a photo, or a profile. Read honest stories from other people, and let them know they're not alone.

SHARE WHAT'S ON YOUR MIND
Choose a space for your story: Vent, Regrets, Secrets, Small Wins, or Life Lessons. There's no account to set up, no email, and no password.

READ STORIES THAT FEEL TRUE
Browse Trending, Latest, and Top, or explore a single category. Give Hype to the stories that move you, and respond with a simple reaction.

NO FOLLOWERS. NO COMMENTS. NO MESSAGES.
UNTOLD has no profiles, comments, or direct messages. Each story stands on its own, and nobody can browse what you've written.

YOUR SPACE
See whether each of your stories is published, in review, or rejected. Save the stories you want to keep, and delete your stories or your whole account at any time.

SAFETY COMES FIRST
Automatic safety checks screen every story, and stories may be published automatically or held for a person to review. You can hide a story, report it, or block its author. People reviewing reports never see who sent them, and authors aren't told.

UNTOLD is for adults aged 18 and over, and it's in English for now. It isn't a crisis or mental health service. If you're struggling, the app includes support resources, and if you may be in danger, please contact your local emergency number.

Your anonymous account lives on your device, so it may not be recoverable if you delete the app or change phones.

Please leave out anything that could identify you or someone else. Your own words can give you away to people who know you.

name: Urbane Labs
description:
Urbane Labs is a free community app for car enthusiasts across the Northeast, built by Urbane Performance Co. Everything the scene needs, in one place.

MEETS & CLUBS
- Find upcoming car meets, cruises and drives near you, hosted by trusted local clubs
- Start your own club, set your rules and host meets without waiting on anyone
- Share club invite links and meet flyers straight to Instagram stories
- Club group chats to keep your crew together

MARKETPLACE
- Buy and sell cars and parts with local enthusiasts
- Fill listings straight from your garage with specs, mods and build photos
- Message sellers in the app and hand off at an upcoming meet

COMMUNITY
- Post build updates, questions, tech tips and meet recaps
- Channels for JDM, Subaru, Euro, American, show builds, track and detailing

BACKROADS & SHOT LIST
- Driving roads rated by the community, with routes on the map
- Photo spots with the best time of day to shoot, plus shot ideas
- Find local car photographers and request a quote

SHOP FINDER
- Vetted local shops matched to your car and the job, from ceramic coating to tuning

YOUR GARAGE
- Save your cars, build photos and mods
- A public profile you control, with show and hide switches for everything

REGIONS
Capital Region, Hudson Valley, Long Island, NYC, North Jersey and Connecticut, with more on the way.

Urbane Labs is free. Members must be 13 or older. Report and block tools keep the community respectful.

name: US Beauty Bazaar
description:
Shop skincare, hair care, body care, and beauty essentials with US Beauty Bazaar.

Explore recently added products and best sellers, search by product name or SKU, and save favorites on your phone. Tap + to add available products quickly, or open a product to choose its options.

Choose payment and delivery options at checkout. Sign in to your customer account to view orders and order status, request a password reset, manage account privacy, and enable order notifications.

Read customer reviews, report inappropriate content, and hide reviews or reviewers you do not want to see.

name: Usher Auth
description:
Usher Auth shows the codes for two-step sign-in. Use it with Usher Identity and any other service that offers an authenticator app.

When you turn on two-step sign-in, the service shows you a QR code. Usher Auth reads it, and from then on shows a fresh code for that account, usually six digits every 30 seconds. You type the code after your password, so your password alone isn't enough to get into your account.

Adding an account
• Point your camera at the QR code in the service's security settings.
• Or choose a photo or screenshot of the QR code.
• Or type in the setup key the service gives you.
• Or, where a service offers one, tap its "Add to Usher Auth" link.

Your keys stay on this device
• Your keys are kept in this device's Keychain, for this device only. They aren't synced to iCloud or anywhere else.
• Usher Auth makes no network calls at all. There's no account to make, no tracking, and no data collected.
• Lock Usher Auth with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode, so nobody else can see your codes, even when your device is unlocked.
• Your codes are hidden in the app switcher.
• A code you copy is kept for one minute, and you can paste it on your Mac or iPad too.

Before you start
Because your keys never leave this device, they don't move to a new iPhone or iPad. Keep each service's backup codes somewhere safe. They let you sign in if you lose or replace your device, and then you can add each account to Usher Auth again.

Easy to read
• Codes are split into two groups, like 482 913, so they're easy to read out.
• In a code's last five seconds, the next one shows beside it, so the change never catches you out.
• VoiceOver reads each code digit by digit, with the seconds it has left. Text grows with Dynamic Type, up to the largest sizes.
• Light, dark, or the same as your device.
• On iPhone and iPad: a list on narrow screens, and a grid of two, three or four columns when there's room.
• In 55 languages.

Works with standard codes
Usher Auth makes time-based codes (RFC 6238): SHA-1, SHA-256 or SHA-512, 6 to 8 digits, and any period from 10 to 300 seconds.

Usher Auth is free, and needs iOS 18 or later.

Questions? Write to support@usheridentity.com.

name: Vaktlogg
description:
Vaktlogg er loggen for vektere og dørvakter. Tell gjestene inn og ut, før hendelser og notater mens vakta pågår, og ha en logg som stemmer når den er over.

Telling
• Ny inn, Retur inn og Ut, med tallet på hvor mange som er inne.
• Hvert trykk gir et støt i hånda, så du kan telle uten å se på skjermen.
• Del vakta med kollegene, så teller dere på det samme tallet. Kolleger uten konto kan bli med som gjest.
• Bare logg: slå av tellinga når vakta bare trenger hendelser og notater.

Hendelser
• Nekt og bortvisning med grunnen, registrert med ett trykk.
• Rapporter og notater med tid og beskrivelse.
• Loggen rettes, ikke slettes: en feil rettes med en ny hendelse, og den gamle blir stående.
• Mister du dekningen, ligger det du fører på telefonen til det er sendt.

På iPhone
• Legg Ny inn og Ut på låseskjermen, i Kontrollsenteret eller på Handling-knappen.
• Widgeten «Vakta» viser hvor mange som er inne.
• Vakta du har åpen, står på låseskjermen og i Dynamic Island, med objektnavnet, tallet og knappene.

Planlegging og praksis
• Planlegg vaktene i kalenderen.
• Går du i praksis, regnes timene ut fra vaktene dine.

Tilgang
• Du får tilgang gjennom arbeidsplassen din, med en invitasjon eller en tilgangskode.
• Inviter kolleger med lenke, QR-kode eller e-post.
• Logg inn med idgo eller med brukernavn og passord.
• «Slett kontoen» står under Konto på profilsida.

name: Vale!
description:
Vale! writes down what is said in the room, live and in large type, for
anyone who is losing their hearing or finds a conversation hard to follow.

Put your iPhone on the table, or stand an iPad up in front of you, and tap
Start. What people say appears on the screen as they say it: the newest
words huge at the bottom, what came before just above.

MADE TO BE READ
• Nine text sizes, from comfortable to very large, with A− and A+.
• Four high-contrast themes: Day, Night, Yellow on black and Paper.
• Light, dark or automatic appearance.
• One big Start / Stop button. Nothing to set up first.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Speech is recognized on your device. No audio and no transcript is sent
anywhere.
• After a one-time download of the language, works without an internet
connection.
• No account, no ads, no tracking.

LANGUAGES
• Listens in Spanish, German or English.
• The app itself is in English or Spanish, chosen apart from the language
it listens for.

ON EVERY SCREEN
• iPhone, iPad and Mac. On iPad held sideways the controls move to the side,
so the text gets the whole width. On the Mac: ⌘R or Space to start and
stop, ⌘+ and ⌘− for the text size.

Vale! complements hearing aids and a hearing check-up; it does not replace
them. It is not a medical device.

name: VAR MANAGER
description:
VAR Manager is the management platform used by football federations to run their refereeing and VAR departments.

• Match archive with VAR incidents and video tags
• Officials' registry, appointments and availability
• Observer reports, including UEFA observer reports with marks and KPIs
• Referee rankings and performance indicators
• Video Hub, match clips and playlists for training
• Fitness module with watch integration
• Replay Station: the VAR simulator and training programme

The app is for federation staff and match officials who already have an account on var-pro.it: accounts are created by the federation administrator. Access is protected with Face ID / Touch ID. Subscriptions are managed by the federation; nothing is sold inside the app.

name: VarioDeck
description:
Bring a cockpit-inspired view to your everyday adventures.

VarioDeck turns your iPhone or Apple Watch into a clear, compact panel for ground speed, heading, altitude and vertical speed. See how fast you are moving, which way you are facing and how your elevation is changing, with analog-style gauges and digital readouts.

FOUR GAUGES, ONE PANEL
• Ground speed in mph, km/h or knots, with a dial that automatically changes range as you speed up or slow down.
• A rotating compass card with magnetic or true north where available, plus GPS track fallback while moving when compass heading is unavailable.
• A cockpit-style analog altimeter with a digital altitude window and ambient pressure in inHg or hPa.
• A vertical speed indicator with green climbs, orange descents and selectable full-scale ranges in ft/min or m/min.

KEEP AN EYE ON THE CLIMB
View temporary elevation gain and loss, plus your highest and lowest displayed altitudes. Reset the statistics when you are ready for a fresh outing. These are live session statistics, not a saved trip log.

YOUR WATCH, ON ITS OWN
Use VarioDeck independently on Apple Watch without the iPhone app running nearby. Swipe or turn the Digital Crown between screen-filling gauges and the Trip page. The display adapts to your watch size.

CALIBRATE YOUR WAY
Set a known elevation, use an available GPS elevation or enter a local QNH pressure setting. Choose feet or meters, your speed and pressure units, and the vertical-speed scale that suits your activity. QNH is entered manually; the app does not fetch weather.

LOCAL AND SIMPLE
No account, ads, analytics, tracking or in-app purchases. The app makes no network requests of its own. Live sensor readings stay on the device; only preferences and calibration settings are saved. Phone and watch settings are separate, with no sync or route-history feature.

REQUIREMENTS AND LIMITATIONS
Requires iOS 17 or later or watchOS 10 or later. Absolute barometric altitude requires supported hardware, generally iPhone 12 or later or Apple Watch Series 6 or later. Other readings depend on available sensors, permissions and GPS reception. GPS altitude can provide a fallback when barometric readings are unavailable. Sensor updates stop in the background; this is not a background trip recorder. Active GPS and sensors can use additional battery power.

VarioDeck is for informational and recreational use only. It is not a certified aviation instrument and must not be used as a primary flight or navigation instrument. Barometric readings drift with weather and pressure changes. Always use appropriate certified equipment and independent sources for safety-critical decisions. Ground speed is not airspeed, and GPS track is direction of travel rather than necessarily where you are pointing. Do not interact with the app while driving or piloting.

User Guide: https://www.tyloal.com/variodeck/user-guide/
Privacy Policy: https://www.tyloal.com/variodeck/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://www.tyloal.com/variodeck/terms-of-service/

name: Vawk CRM
description:
Vawk CRM puts your whole sales day in your pocket. See who to follow up, reply to every chat and never miss a meeting, without hunting for numbers, messages or notes.

Vawk CRM is for sales agents whose business already uses Vawk CRM. Your admin creates your account and shares your sign-in, or you continue with Google if your admin has set it up. You cannot create an account in the app.

TODAY TELLS YOU WHAT TO DO FIRST
- Follow-ups due, with overdue ones in red
- Your next meetings and site visits, with one tap to join Google Meet or call
- New leads the moment they come in, with Call and Message buttons
- Your targets and whether you are on pace
Tick a follow-up and it is done.

EVERY LEAD, WITH THE FULL STORY
Search by name, phone or email. Work the board by stage, filter by Hot, New or Follow-up today, or use the lists your team has made. Open a lead to see every call, message, note, meeting and file in one timeline. Change the stage, add a follow-up, write a note and mention a teammate, right from the lead.

REPLY ON EVERY CHANNEL
One inbox for the channels your business has connected: WhatsApp, email and SMS. Use quick replies and approved templates, send photos and files, and pick up chats that are waiting on you.

AI THAT KEEPS YOU MOVING
A short summary of each lead and the best next step, a suggested reply in chat and help writing an email. You stay in charge of what is sent.

A CALENDAR THAT MATCHES THE WEB
Follow-ups, callbacks, meetings and site visits in one Schedule. Book, reschedule and record the result from your phone.

NOTIFICATIONS THAT MATTER
New leads, replies and reminders reach you at once. Turn each kind on or off in the app.

CALL AND LOG IT
Tap Call to open your phone's dialler. When you come back, a short sheet logs the outcome, a note and the next follow-up.

WORKS WHEN THE NETWORK DOES NOT
Notes, follow-ups, stage changes and messages wait while you are offline and go out in order when you are back.

LIGHT AND DARK
The app follows your phone, or you can choose.

Made for agents. Setup, billing, team and reports stay in the web app for owners and admins.

Vawk CRM is a Nevrio product.

name: Venta Taxi
description:
Venta Taxi takes you anywhere in Yerevan and across Armenia.

• Order in a few taps — set where to go, see the price before you order and pick a tariff: Economy, Comfort, child seat, cargo and more.
• Watch your car arrive — live map, the driver's name, car and plate, the time of arrival.
• Call or chat with your driver right in the app, without sharing your number.
• Pay the way you like — cash, card online or your in-app balance. An e-receipt arrives after every trip.
• Safe on every trip — verified drivers, a trip PIN, an SOS button and a live route you can share with your family.
• Book ahead, add stops, order for someone else, travel together with others going the same way.
• In Armenian, Russian and English.

name: Vesperpin
description:
Pin a monster’s shadow to the floor, then move the lantern to stretch it. Hold the tension to lift your foes like puppets. Ring your bell to break armor, interrupt a boss’s ritual, or unleash an Umbra Choir when two or three enemies are suspended.

Guide a little bellkeeper through 12 handcrafted vigils in a storybook Gothic world. Face three distinct bosses, earn relics, and unlock an endless mode.

name: Villainfoca
description:
Find a villa for your stay in Foça, on the Turkish Aegean coast. Choose your arrival and departure dates and the number of guests to see which villas are available.

Browse photos, check amenities and see each villa’s location on the map. Open the price breakdown for your dates and review the house rules before sending your request.

The Villainfoca team reviews each request and contacts you to confirm the booking. You can follow its status in Trips using your reservation reference. You can browse and request a stay without creating an account. Payment is arranged separately.

Use the app in English, Turkish, German or Dutch and display prices in Turkish lira, euros, pounds or US dollars.

name: vinRECON Display
description:
vinRECON Display turns an Apple TV or iPad into a live screen for your dealership, powered by your vinRECON account.

LIVE BOARDS FOR YOUR TEAM
• Make Ready board — every car being prepared for delivery, by stage, with who's on it and how long it's been there.
• Recon board — reconditioning work in progress, grouped by person or department.
• Changes appear on screen within seconds of being saved in vinRECON. No refreshing, no remote.

DIGITAL SIGNAGE
• Show your Welcome and Customer Delivery signage boards in the showroom or waiting area.
• Edit slides in vinRECON and every screen updates on its own.

SHOWROOM CHECK-IN (iPad)
• Customers check themselves in on an iPad at the front desk.
• Your sales team sees the visit in vinRECON right away.
• The form clears itself after each customer, and after two minutes if someone walks away.

SET UP IN A MINUTE
• Open the app — it shows a QR code and a 6-character code.
• Scan the code with your phone (or enter it in vinRECON → Settings → TV Displays) and pick what the screen should show.
• Switch a screen to a different board, turn it off or rename it from vinRECON at any time.

BUILT FOR THE SHOWROOM FLOOR
• Runs all day without anyone touching it and recovers on its own after a Wi-Fi drop.
• Store managers can reconnect a screen to a different display with the store's admin PIN.
• iPad: plug into a TV with HDMI and the TV shows the board while the iPad becomes the control panel.

vinRECON Display requires a vinRECON dealership account. Learn more at vinrecon.com.

name: VistaWalk: 360° Street Walks
description:
VistaWalk helps you follow curated 360° street walks stop by stop.

Pick a walk, move through ordered stops, and explore immersive Look Around scenes where Apple coverage is available. Stamp landmarks in your passport, open a daily spot, and save favorites — organized as walking routes, not live camera desks.

CURATED WALKS
• Featured and popular street walks with clear stop counts and times
• Stop-by-stop progress with Previous / Next
• Immersive Look Around at each stop when available

PLACES & PASSPORT
• Browse landmarks and cities
• Read short place notes and stamp your passport
• Explore on the map and open 360° where supported

DAILY DISCOVERY
• A new spot each day
• Track passport progress on your device

FAVORITES & LANGUAGE
• Star walks and landmarks
• Multiple languages for guides and labels
• Share the app with friends

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account or sign-up
• No ads or third-party analytics in version 1.0
• Preferences stay on your iPhone

Look Around coverage varies by region and device. When a 360° scene is unavailable, VistaWalk shows a map preview instead.

Questions? Email loco@huitongshijie.com or open Support in the app.

Terms of Use: https://huitongshijie.com/vistawalk/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://huitongshijie.com/vistawalk/privacy.html

name: Void: Dark Dungeon Disaster
description:
Void: Dark Dungeon Disaster is a first-person co-op roguelite with a PS1-style look. Fight down through the dark as a Swordsman, Archer or Mage, and survive for as long as you can.

Every run is different. Clear rooms full of enemies, solve puzzles, collect weapons, armor, skills and relics, then take on the boss at the end of each stage.

PLAY TOGETHER
Team up online with friends on iPhone or PC. Host a lobby, share a code or browse public lobbies. Talk with proximity voice chat, where voices fade with distance.

MADE FOR IPHONE
This is the full game with touch controls built for your thumbs. Adjust the look speed, aim assist, button size and opacity, or switch to left-handed mode.

MAKE YOUR MARK
Create your own character, earn ranks and climb the world leaderboard.

GAME MODE STAGES
Occasionally, the game will switch it's genre! From Horror Mode, to Platformer, Escape Room, and even 2D!

name: Voky – Learn Vocabulary
description:
Voky is a friendly clay chameleon who helps you learn vocabulary in five minutes a day. Pick the language you know and the one you want to learn, tell Voky how old you are and how you like to learn, and start right away.

WORDS THAT STICK
• 840 everyday words in 14 topics: essentials, numbers, food, drinks, family, colors, animals, body, home, travel, time, weather, clothes and shopping
• 6 levels in every topic – the next one unlocks when you master 80% of the previous level
• A hand-made 3D clay illustration for every word
• Natural-sounding recorded pronunciation for every word
• Spaced repetition based on the FSRS algorithm brings each word back just before you would forget it

YOUR LANGUAGES
• Learn Croatian, German, English, Spanish, Italian or French – more languages are on the way
• The app speaks your language: the interface is available in 24 languages
• Download the pronunciation pack once and learn offline

FOR EVERY AGE
• Child mode: shorter sessions, bigger pictures and a playful voice
• Standard mode for teens and adults
• Senior mode: bigger text, high contrast, calmer motion and slower pronunciation

LEARN YOUR WAY
• Speak: check your pronunciation with your device's speech recognition
• Write, choose and match pairs
• Pick the exercises you like and mix them freely

YOUR PET VOKY
• Voky grows from an egg into a teacher as you learn
• Reviewing words feeds Voky, a one-minute quiz quenches his thirst, speaking and typing make him strong and fixing mistakes gives him a bath. He sleeps at night, grows a few centimetres as you learn and never punishes you for a break – he’s simply happy you’re back.

STAY MOTIVATED
• A daily goal and streaks
• About 100 achievements with badges
• Optional leaderboards: today, this week, this month, your league and your friends
• Friendly 10-word challenges with your friends
• Leaderboards and challenges need a free account; nicknames are filtered and can be reported

PRIVACY FIRST
• No ads, no in-app purchases and no tracking
• The account is optional – it only syncs your progress and unlocks leaderboards and challenges
• Delete your account in the app at any time

Privacy policy: https://getvoky.com/legal/privacy

name: VOLTIXY Nest
description:
VOLTIXY Nest backs up your photos and videos to an SSD attached to your own Nest device. Your media goes directly from your phone to your drive — nothing is uploaded to VOLTIXY servers.

• Back up original photos and videos, including Live Photos
• Bulk backup resumes where it left off and never re-uploads
• Browse backed-up content in the My Files screen
• Track backup status and missing items via the central registry
• Free up phone space safely for verified backups
• Delete your account permanently from within the app

Requires a VOLTIXY Nest device. Your data is yours: files live only on your SSD, and the registry stores metadata only.

name: Vowtable: Wedding Seating
description:
Plan your wedding on the room itself. Vowtable draws your real venue to scale, seats your guests with one tap, and prints everything the day needs.

THE ROOM, TO SCALE
• Start from the room's size, lay your venue's own floor plan underneath (photo or PDF, set the scale with one known distance), or scan the room with LiDAR on iPhone Pro and iPad Pro
• Round, rectangular, long, head and sweetheart tables, with chairs drawn where they really go
• Dance floor, stage, music, bar, buffet, cake table, doors and more

SEATING THAT THINKS WITH YOU
• Drag a guest or a whole household onto a table
• Auto-seat keeps households together, follows your wishes (“keep apart”, “keep together”, “near the dance floor”, “away from the music”) and seats guests who need step-free access near the door
• Write wishes in plain words; Apple Intelligence reads them on your device
• Live checks: broken wishes, split households, babies away from their family, missing meals

GUESTS
• Paste a list from a spreadsheet, notes or a message — couples and +1s are understood
• Pick from Contacts on iPhone and iPad
• Answers, meals, dietary notes, groups and sides

THE DAY
• Running order on the venue's clock, even when you plan from another country
• Every moment linked to a place in the room and the people needed
• Live view on the day, local reminders, calendar file
• Starting templates for one-day and multi-day weddings, all editable

BUDGET AND TASKS
• Costs per table, chair or guest follow the room and the guest list
• Deposits due, paid and left
• A starting checklist dated from your wedding day

PRINT AND SHARE
• Seating board, folded place cards, table numbers, kitchen sheet, venue pack and call sheets as PDF
• Guest list as a spreadsheet, running order as a calendar

FIND YOUR SEAT
Put an iPad or a Mac at the entrance: guests type their name and see their table light up on the plan.

ONE FILE PER WEDDING
Each wedding is a Vowtable file you keep in iCloud Drive or Files and share with your partner or planner. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Buy once and use Vowtable on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

name: Vroom GPS
description:
Vroom est un GPS communautaire gratuit : les conducteurs signalent en direct ce qu'ils voient sur la route, et tout le monde en profite pour arriver plus vite et plus sereinement.

GUIDAGE COMPLET
• Itinéraires voiture, moto, à pied, à vélo et en transports en commun
• Guidage vocal clair, qui continue écran verrouillé et baisse votre musique le temps d'une consigne
• Recalcul automatique si vous sortez de l'itinéraire, et propositions de trajets plus rapides en route
• Limitations de vitesse, voies à prendre aux sorties d'autoroute, heure d'arrivée mise à jour en continu
• Options : éviter les péages, les autoroutes ou les ferries

LA ROUTE EN DIRECT
• Signalez en un geste — ou à la voix — un bouchon, un accident, des travaux, un danger ou un contrôle
• Les signalements des autres conducteurs s'affichent sur la carte et sont annoncés à l'approche
• Confirmez ou infirmez un signalement : la carte reste fiable
• Trafic en temps réel et zones de danger conformes à la réglementation française

PRATIQUE AU QUOTIDIEN
• Prix des carburants et bornes de recharge le long de votre trajet
• Zones à faibles émissions (ZFE) : indiquez votre vignette Crit'Air, Vroom vous prévient
• Coût du trajet (carburant ou recharge, péages) et consommation de votre véhicule
• « Partez à l'heure » : Vroom surveille le trafic et vous dit quand partir pour arriver à temps
• Retrouvez où vous avez garé votre voiture
• Favoris (maison, travail, salle de sport…) et partage de votre heure d'arrivée par SMS ou WhatsApp
• Partagez votre trajet en direct : vos proches suivent votre position jusqu'à l'arrivée
• Ouvrez dans Vroom une adresse reçue par message, ou un lien Google Maps, Plans ou Waze

RESPECT DE VOTRE VIE PRIVÉE
• Aucun compte, aucun e-mail : un identifiant anonyme suffit
• Aucune publicité, aucun pistage, aucune revente de données
• Votre position n'est utilisée en arrière-plan que pendant une navigation

Cartes © les contributeurs OpenStreetMap.

name: Wakaba: Japanese Vocabulary
description:
Grow your Japanese vocabulary with a little practice every day.

Wakaba is for learners who know some Japanese grammar and want to become more comfortable with the words. Practice at your own pace, with a calm interface, friendly folklore guides and no ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

A PATH THROUGH YOUR VOCABULARY
Explore more than 1,100 words across ten levels. Short sessions introduce unfamiliar words before asking you to read, recall, listen or write. Practice adapts to your progress, revisits weaker skills and offers a longer exam at the end of each level. Choose any session or return to earlier lessons whenever you like.

WORDS IN CONTEXT
Go beyond isolated translations with more than 2,100 example sentences. Build sentences from word tiles, fill in missing words and practice verb forms. Open a word's flashcard to see its Japanese spelling, reading, romaji and meaning, or turn it over for grammar details and conjugations.

READ, LISTEN AND SPEAK
Start with kana and meet kanji gradually. Hear Japanese pronunciation with system voices. Optional speaking exercises use on-device recognition on supported devices. Choose a Japanese voice and practice preferences in system Settings.

KANA AND KANJI AT HAND
Consult hiragana, katakana and particle references. Trace kana with your finger or Apple Pencil, following stroke order. Explore the kanji index grouped by stroke count and watch numbered stroke guides.

A LITTLE GROWTH EVERY DAY
See your daily streak and a bonsai that grows with your total practiced days. Add progress and word-of-the-day widgets, and choose an optional daily practice reminder.

YOUR PRACTICE, YOUR DEVICE
Core practice works offline. No Wakaba account is needed. Optional private iCloud sync keeps practice progress across your devices, and backup tools let you export and import your data. The interface and word meanings are available in English and Spanish.

Made for iPhone and iPad. Free, without ads.

name: Wanasna Games
description:
Enjoy word puzzles, picture memory games and gentle daily challenges at your own pace.

Wanasna Games offers four simple, senior-friendly games: Complete the Proverb, Crosswords, Picture Memory and Word Search.

Large touch targets, readable text and no countdown timers make playing comfortable. Try the daily challenge, collect points and choose whether to join the optional public leaderboard using a nickname and emoji avatar. Reminders are optional too.

Wanasna Games is a separate games app from the Wanasna family.

name: Wanderly: Trip Planner
description:
Your whole trip, in one place.

Wanderly brings your travel plans, spending, packing and memories together on your iPhone. Create a trip before you leave, keep the details close while you travel, and save the memories when you return.

PLAN YOUR DAYS
Build a day-by-day itinerary, reorder activities, and keep destinations, stays and flight expenses alongside your trip.

KEEP TRACK OF SPENDING
Compare estimated and actual spending, organize expenses by category, attach receipts, and record payment methods and status. Use live exchange rates when connected or enter your own rates.

PACK WITH CONFIDENCE
Create checklists, reuse packing templates, and see what is ready to go.

KEEP DOCUMENTS CLOSE
Organize passports, visas, tickets and bookings behind device authentication. Document files use iOS Data Protection on your device.

SAVE THE MEMORIES
Write a trip journal and collect saved places with notes and photos.

TAKE YOUR DATA WITH YOU
Export a trip spreadsheet or save a JSON backup. Choose whether to include saved travelers and document or photo files. Keep sensitive exports somewhere safe.

PLAN OFFLINE, SYNC WITH ICLOUD
Manual planning and saved trip information work offline. Sync trip records through your iCloud account and invite others to a trip as editors or viewers. Internet and iCloud are required for sync and sharing; live rates and address lookup also require a connection. Keep local document and photo files backed up using file-enabled export.

No Wanderly account, advertising, or analytics SDK. AI planning is not included in version 1.0.

Requires iOS 18 or later. Designed for iPhone.

name: WashIt: Halls Laundry
description:
Never wait for a washer again.

WashIt watches your hall's laundry room and reserves the next free washer the second it frees up. One press and it hunts for you.

- One press: WashIt reserves the next washer the moment it is free.
- Your own countdown: see exactly how long is left, on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
- Dryer sorted: it grabs one dryer 5 minutes before your wash ends.
- Alerts when a machine is yours, when your wash is done, and when your hold is about to run out.
- Best time to wash: see when washers are usually free at your hall.
- Works with any site that uses Washnet machines.

WashIt reserves machines with your own Washnet account, exactly like tapping Make reservation yourself. Your password goes straight to Washnet.

WashIt is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Washnet. Washnet is a trademark of its owner.

WashIt is invite only. Ask a friend who has it for a code.

name: Water Lu
description:
Make every sip a little step forward.

Water Lu turns your daily water routine into a pixel-art collection journey. Track your drinks, help your companion Lulu grow, unlock badges, and discover surprises in drift bottles as you fill your collection.

TRACK YOUR DRINKS
Log water, tea, coffee, milk, and more. Set your own daily goal, check your progress, and explore your intake history and statistics.

GROW WITH LULU
Build a drinking habit with a little companion by your side. As your progress adds up, watch Lulu level up, change forms, and discover new stages of growth.

COLLECT YOUR LITTLE VICTORIES
Earn achievement badges through daily use and consistent habits. Open earned drift bottles to discover pixel collectibles, explore themed collections, and find seasonal and holiday items.

REMINDERS THAT FIT YOUR DAY
Choose your waking hours and reminder interval to create a water routine that works for you.

QUICK LOGGING, WHEREVER YOU ARE
Record drinks from your iPhone, Apple Watch, or widgets. Use Siri and Shortcuts to add water without opening the app.

YOUR RECORDS, ON YOUR DEVICES
No account required. Your records stay on your devices, with optional sync through your own private iCloud account and exportable backups. If you choose, Water Lu can write your water intake to Apple Health.

One purchase. No subscriptions, ads, or in-app purchases. Badges and virtual collectibles are earned through app use; they cannot be bought or redeemed for money.

Start with your next sip, and grow with Lulu.

Water Lu is for everyday hydration tracking and habit building. It does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment advice. Set a goal appropriate to your circumstances and follow any fluid guidance from your healthcare professional.

name: Way Too Easy
description:
Way Too Easy ist dein persönliches Kundenportal bei der Agentur Way Too Easy aus Hannover. Alles, was wir für dich machen, siehst und steuerst du hier: vom Reel bis zur Rechnung.

FREIGEBEN MIT EINEM TIPP
Reels, Designs, Webseiten und Werbebudgets landen direkt bei dir. Ansehen, freigeben oder eine Änderung wünschen, direkt im Bild markiert. Fertige Lieferungen kommen als große Premiere.

DEINE ZAHLEN LIVE
Aufrufe, Follower, Werbung und Leads aus TikTok, Instagram und deinen Werbekonten auf einen Blick, mit Gesamtanalyse, Verlauf und Berichten als PDF.

MEETINGS UND GESPRÄCHE
Videocalls mit deinem Team direkt in der App, mit Untertiteln in deiner Sprache, Chat und Bildschirm teilen. Danach siehst du das Ergebnis und die Aufträge daraus mit Stand.

TERMINE IM BLICK
Drehtage, Kampagnenstarts und Meetings im Kalender, mit Countdown und Checkliste. Termine schlägst du selbst vor, wir bestätigen.

AUFTRÄGE UND KONTINGENT
Neue Aufträge mit wenigen Tipps anfragen. Dein Kontingent aus dem Vertrag zählt automatisch mit: was geliefert ist und was noch aussteht.

POSTFACH, RECHNUNGEN, DOKUMENTE
Deine Adressen bei uns zum Mitlesen, alle Rechnungen offen oder bezahlt, Verträge und Dokumente sauber abgelegt und als PDF.

DIREKT ZU DEINEM TEAM
Nachrichten und Anrufe an dein Team bei uns, Benachrichtigungen, sobald etwas auf dich wartet. Im Notfall erreichst du uns mit einem Knopf.

DEIN TEAM, DEINE STANDORTE
Lade Kolleginnen und Kollegen ein und gib jedem genau die Rechte, die er braucht. Mehrere Filialen? Wechsle mit einem Tipp zwischen den Standorten.

Zu jedem Bereich gibt es ein kurzes Erklärvideo, das dir in rund einer Minute zeigt, wie alles funktioniert.

Wichtig: Die App ist für Kundinnen und Kunden von Way Too Easy. Den Zugang bekommst du per Einladung von uns. Noch kein Kunde? Schreib uns über waytooeasy.de.

name: WaynVibe
description:
WaynVibe is your guide to dining and nights out.

Discover restaurants ,cafes and pubs near you, browse upcoming events, and book tickets in a few taps.
